examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么爱出风头了，收敛一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a show-off, it's better to be more reserved.

english_meaning: Brown-noser; Ass-kisser; Sycophant
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢奉承、谄媚别人的人，通常带有贬义。比喻像鬼一样在别人屁股后面转，专为讨好别人而行动。
explanation_english: A derogatory term referring to someone who excessively flatters and attempts to ingratiate themselves with others, often for personal gain.  The term implies that the person is constantly lingering around someone's "butt" (figuratively), behaving like a "ghost" to please them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前擦鞋，真係一個屎窟鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 caat3 haai4, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 si2 fat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前拍马屁，真是一个马屁精。
examples.english_sentence: He's always brown-nosing the boss, he's such an ass-kisser.

english_meaning: Grasshopper, locust
explanation_mandarin: 指蚱蜢或蝗虫。有时也用来形容跳跳扎扎，坐不定的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a grasshopper or locust. Sometimes used to describe someone who is restless and can't sit still.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似隻屎蜢咁，成日跳嚟跳去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zek3 si2 maang2 gam2, seng4 jat6 tiu3 lai4 tiu3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像一只蚱蜢一样，整天跳来跳去。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a grasshopper, always hopping around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 田入面有好多屎蜢，食晒啲菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 si2 maang2, sik6 saai3 di1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 田地里有很多蝗虫，吃光了蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: There are many locusts in the field, eating all the vegetables.

english_meaning: Dung beetle; figuratively: a mean or despicable person
explanation_mandarin: 本义指蜣螂，一种以粪便为食的昆虫。在粤语中，有时也用来形容卑鄙、可憎的人。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a dung beetle, an insect that feeds on feces. In Cantonese, it can also be used figuratively to describe a mean, despicable, or unlikeable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友咁衰格，真係屎蟲咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, zan1 hai6 si2 cung4 gam3 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人那么恶劣，真像个屎壳郎一样。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is so awful; he's like a dung beetle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做啲咁屎蟲嘅嘢啦，會俾人睇唔起㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 di1 gam3 si2 cung4 ge3 je5 laa1, wui5 bei2 jan4 tai2 m4 hei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做那么卑鄙的事情啦，会被人看不起的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do such despicable things, you'll be looked down upon.

english_meaning: bad idea, lousy plan, stupid scheme
explanation_mandarin: 指很差劲、不靠谱、愚蠢的主意或计划。
explanation_english: Refers to a very bad, unreliable, or stupid idea or plan. Suggests the plan is likely to fail or cause problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諗埋啲屎計，梗係搞衰晒啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nam2 maai4 di1 si2 gai3, gang2 hai6 gaau2 seoi1 saai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 尽想些馊主意，肯定搞砸的！
examples.english_sentence: Always coming up with bad ideas, of course it will be a complete mess!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再諗啲屎計嚟搞我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 nam2 di1 si2 gai3 lai4 gaau2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再想一些馊主意来烦我啦！
examples.english_sentence: Please don't come up with any more bad ideas to bother me!

english_meaning: Shitty situation; Mess; A bad outcome; A disaster
explanation_mandarin: 比喻糟糕的情况或不幸的结果，类似于“烂摊子”。通常用于形容事情搞砸了，或者遇到了令人不愉快的事情。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a terrible situation, mess, or unfavorable outcome. Usually used to describe a situation that has gone wrong or an unpleasant experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試肥佬，真係食咗舊屎餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, zan1 hai6 sik6 zo2 gau6 si2 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，真是倒霉透了。
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam this time, it's really a shitty situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠，成班同事一齊食屎餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1, sing4 baan1 tung4 si6 jat1 cai4 sik6 si2 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，整组同事一起倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, the whole team is in a shitty situation together.

mandarin_meaning: 屏蔽; 挡住; 抑制
english_meaning: screen; to block; to ward off; to suppress; to hold back
explanation_mandarin: 阻挡，遮蔽；抑制，控制；屏幕。
explanation_english: To block or screen off; to suppress or control; a screen (physical or electronic).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦個mon嘅解像度好高，畫面好清，完全冇屏嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 go3 mon1 ge3 gaai2 soek3 dou6 hou2 gou1, waa2 min6 hou2 ching1, wun4 cyun4 mou5 beng2 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑显示器的分辨率很高，画面很清晰，完全没有屏幕的感觉。
examples.english_sentence: The resolution of this computer monitor is very high, and the picture is very clear. There's no screen graininess at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忍住唔俾自己喊出嚟，盡力屏住呼吸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan2 zyu6 m4 bei2 zi6 gei2 haam3 chut1 lai4, zeon6 lik6 beng2 zyu6 fu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她忍住不让自己哭出来，尽力屏住呼吸。
examples.english_sentence: She held back from crying and tried to hold her breath.

english_meaning: Ping Shan (place name in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港新界元朗区的一个地方，以其历史悠久的邓氏宗族和古迹而闻名。
explanation_english: A place in Yuen Long District, New Territories, Hong Kong, known for its historical Tang clan and heritage sites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日去屏山參觀吓啲古蹟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 bing2 saan1 caam1 gun1 haa5 di1 gu2 jik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天去屏山参观一下古迹吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Ping Shan today to visit the historical sites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屏山嘅鄧氏宗祠歷史好悠久㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bing2 saan1 ge3 dang6 si6 zung1 ci4 lik6 si2 hou2 jau4 gau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屏山的邓氏宗祠历史很悠久。
examples.english_sentence: The Tang Clan Ancestral Hall in Ping Shan has a very long history.

english_meaning: screen (display)
explanation_mandarin: 显示图像或文字的装置表面。
explanation_english: A surface or device that displays images or text, especially on a television, computer, or mobile phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦個屏幕壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 go3 ping4 mok6 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电脑屏幕坏了。
examples.english_sentence: My computer screen is broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對住個屏幕，好傷眼㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 go3 ping4 mok6, hou2 soeng1 ngaan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天对着屏幕，很伤眼睛的。
examples.english_sentence: He spends all day staring at the screen, it's bad for his eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個屏幕嘅解像度好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ping4 mok6 ge3 gaai2 soeng6 dou6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个屏幕的分辨率很高。
examples.english_sentence: This screen has a very high resolution.

english_meaning: To hold one's breath and concentrate; to hold one's breath and remain quiet; breathless and still
explanation_mandarin: 形容聚精会神，不敢发出声音的样子，或者为了避免被发现而屏住呼吸，保持安静。
explanation_english: Describes a state of concentrating intently, refraining from making any noise, or holding one's breath and remaining quiet to avoid being detected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屏息靜氣噉望住個魔術表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bing2 sik1 zing6 hei3 gam2 mong6 zyu6 go3 mo1 seot6 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们屏气凝神地看着魔术表演。
examples.english_sentence: They watched the magic show, holding their breath and concentrating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要屏息靜氣，唔好俾佢哋發現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bing2 sik1 zing6 hei3, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 faat3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要屏气凝神，不要让他们发现。
examples.english_sentence: We need to hold our breath and remain quiet, so they don't discover us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家屏息靜氣等住醫生嘅宣佈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 bing2 sik1 zing6 hei3 dang2 zyu6 ji1 sang1 ge3 syun1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家屏气凝神地等待医生的宣布。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone held their breath, waiting for the doctor's announcement.

english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to reject, to forsake
explanation_mandarin: 抛弃，放弃，不再使用。
explanation_english: To abandon, discard, or reject something; to no longer use or accept something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該屏棄啲過時嘅觀念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 bing2 hei3 di1 gwo3 si4 ge3 gun1 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该抛弃那些过时的观念。
examples.english_sentence: We should abandon outdated ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定屏棄舊嘅生活方式，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 bing2 hei3 gau6 ge3 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定放弃旧的生活方式，重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to abandon his old lifestyle and start anew.

english_meaning: to block, to shield, to filter, to censor
explanation_mandarin: 遮蔽；阻挡；过滤信息；审查内容，使其无法被看见或听到。
explanation_english: To block, shield, or filter something, especially information, signals, or content, so that it cannot be seen, heard, or accessed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司會屏蔽啲對公司唔好嘅網站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 wui5 ping3 bik1 di1 deoi3 gung1 si1 m4 hou2 ge3 mong5 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司会屏蔽那些对公司不好的网站。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will block websites that are bad for the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個防火牆可以屏蔽網絡攻擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong2 wo2 cheung4 ho2 ji5 ping3 bik1 mong5 lok3 gung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个防火墙可以屏蔽网络攻击。
examples.english_sentence: This firewall can block network attacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅社交媒體賬戶俾人屏蔽咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 se5 giao1 mui4 tai2 zoeng3 wu6 bei2 jan4 ping3 bik1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的社交媒体账户被人屏蔽了。
examples.english_sentence: His social media account was blocked.

english_meaning: to exclude; to eliminate; to get rid of
explanation_mandarin: 排除、除去。多指排除雜念、偏見等。
explanation_english: To exclude, eliminate, or get rid of something, often referring to eliminating distracting thoughts, prejudices, or obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要屏除所有嘅雜念，專心應付考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bing2 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 zaap6 nim6, zyun1 sam1 jing3 fu6 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该排除所有的杂念，专心应付考试。
examples.english_sentence: We should eliminate all distracting thoughts and concentrate on preparing for the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗達到目標，佢決定屏除所有嘅障礙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 daat6 dou3 muk6 biu1, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 bing2 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了达到目标，他决定排除所有的障碍。
examples.english_sentence: In order to achieve his goal, he decided to eliminate all obstacles.

english_meaning: barrier, obstacle, screen
explanation_mandarin: 阻挡或遮蔽的东西；也指障碍。
explanation_english: Something that blocks or shields; also refers to an obstacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語言嘅唔同係溝通嘅一大屏障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jin4 ge3 m4 tung4 hai6 gau1 tung1 ge3 jat1 daai6 bing2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 语言的不同是沟通的一大屏障。
examples.english_sentence: Language differences are a major barrier to communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個山脈係天然嘅屏障，保護咗個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saan1 maak6 hai6 tin1 jin4 ge3 bing2 zoeng3, bou2 wu6 zo2 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座山脉是天然的屏障，保护了这座城市。
examples.english_sentence: This mountain range is a natural barrier that protects the city.

english_meaning: screen (furniture); windbreak
explanation_mandarin: 一种室内陈设品，用来遮挡视线或风。
explanation_english: A piece of furniture, usually folding, used to divide a room or conceal something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房入邊擺咗個屏風嚟間開個空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 jap6 bin1 baai2 zo2 go3 bing1 fung1 lai4 gaan1 hoi1 go3 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房间里放了一个屏风来隔开空间。
examples.english_sentence: He put a screen in the room to divide the space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅設計用咗好多屏風，感覺好傳統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sat3 gai3 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 bing1 fung1, gam2 gok3 hou2 cyun4 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的设计使用了许多屏风，感觉很传统。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this company uses many screens, giving a very traditional feel.

mandarin_meaning: 屏蔽效应; 挡风效应
english_meaning: Windbreak effect; Screening effect; Shielding effect
explanation_mandarin: 指物体或结构阻挡风或其他外力所产生的效果。也比喻某些事物起到了遮挡、掩盖、或减少负面影响的作用。
explanation_english: Refers to the effect created when an object or structure blocks wind or other external forces. Metaphorically, it describes how something can shield, cover, or reduce negative impacts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 棟新樓咁高，搞到我哋後面啲樓有屏風效應，完全曬唔到太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 san1 lau4 gam3 gou1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hau6 min6 di1 lau4 jau5 ping4 fung1 haau6 ying3, jyun4 cyun4 saai3 m4 dou2 taai3 yeung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋新楼太高了，导致我们后面的楼有屏蔽效应，完全晒不到太阳。
examples.english_sentence: This new building is so tall that it's creating a windbreak effect for the buildings behind us, and we can't get any sunlight at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府希望呢項政策可以有屏風效應，減低樓市下跌嘅衝擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing4 fu2 hei1 mong6 ni1 hong6 jing3 caak3 ho2 ji5 jau5 ping4 fung1 haau6 ying3, gaam2 dai1 lau4 si5 haa6 dit3 ge3 cung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府希望这项政策可以起到屏蔽效应，降低楼市下跌的冲击。
examples.english_sentence: The government hopes that this policy can have a shielding effect and reduce the impact of the property market decline.

mandarin_meaning: 屏风楼 (指高楼大厦阻挡空气流通，像屏风一样)
english_meaning: Screen building (refers to tall buildings that block air circulation, acting like a screen)
explanation_mandarin: 指由于高楼大厦密集兴建，阻挡了空气流通，导致风速减弱，污染物不易扩散，影响城市空气质量的建筑物。形象地比喻这些高楼像屏风一样。
explanation_english: Refers to buildings, usually high-rise residential or commercial blocks, that are densely constructed and obstruct air circulation, resulting in reduced wind speed and poor air quality. The term is a metaphorical description of these buildings as 'screens'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲屏風樓阻住晒啲風，搞到成個社區好焗促。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ping4 fung1 lau4 zo2 zyu6 saai3 di1 fung1, gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 se5 keoi1 hou2 guk6 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些屏风楼挡住了所有的风，导致整个社区很闷热。
examples.english_sentence: These screen buildings are blocking all the wind, making the whole community stuffy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該嚴格控制屏風樓嘅發展，改善城市嘅空氣質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 yim4 gaak3 hung3 zai3 ping4 fung1 lau4 ge3 faat3 zin2, gai2 sin6 sing4 si5 ge3 hung1 hei3 zat1 so3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该严格控制屏风楼的发展，改善城市的空气质量。
examples.english_sentence: The government should strictly control the development of screen buildings to improve the city's air quality.

english_meaning: clogs (wooden sandals)
explanation_mandarin: 一种木制的鞋子，鞋底上有两根横木，穿的时候用脚趾夹住。
explanation_english: A type of wooden footwear, traditionally with two wooden supports on the sole, held to the foot by a thong between the toes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日著住屐周圍行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 kek6 zau1 wai4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人经常穿着木屐到处走。
examples.english_sentence: People used to wear clogs and walk around everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨天著屐就唔怕整濕對鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 tin1 zoek3 kek6 zau6 m4 paa3 zing2 sip3 deoi3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨天穿木屐就不怕弄湿鞋子。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing clogs on a rainy day, you don't have to worry about getting your shoes wet.

english_meaning: to despise, to disdain, to scorn, to look down upon
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻视、瞧不起。一种负面的情感表达。
explanation_english: Expressing disdain or contempt towards someone or something. A negative emotional expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最屑呢啲恃老賣老嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 sit3 ni1啲 ci5 lou5 maai6 lou5 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最瞧不起那些倚老卖老的人。
examples.english_sentence: I despise those people who act important because they're old.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁屑佢嘅，佢都係想幫你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 sit3 keoi5 ge3, keoi5 dou1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么瞧不起他的，他也是想帮你而已。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so scornful of him, he's just trying to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度好囂張，令人好屑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 hiu1 zoeng1, ling6 jan4 hou2 sit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度很嚣张，令人很瞧不起。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is very arrogant, making people despise him.

english_meaning: exhibit; exhibition; display; extend; stretch; unfold
explanation_mandarin: 展示；舒展开来；展开
explanation_english: to exhibit; to display; to unfold; to extend or stretch out

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去睇畫展啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 tai2 waa2 zin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去看画展吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go see the art exhibition tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢伸展吓啲手脚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 zin2 haa5 di1 sau2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他伸展一下手脚。
examples.english_sentence: He stretches his arms and legs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港書展每年都好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 syu1 zin2 mui5 nin4 dou1 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港书展每年都有很多人。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong Book Fair attracts a lot of people every year.

english_meaning: to exhibit, to display, exhibition
explanation_mandarin: 展示出来，公开陈列。
explanation_english: To display or exhibit something publicly; can also refer to the exhibition itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日博物館會有個畫展展出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 bok3 mat6 gun2 wui5 jau5 go3 waa2 zin2 zin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天博物馆会有一个画展展出。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a painting exhibition at the museum tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係今次展出嘅藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 gam1 ci3 zin2 ceot1 ge3 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是这次展出的艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: These are all the artworks on display at this exhibition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司展出咗最新嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zin2 ceot1 zo2 zeoi3 san1 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司展出了最新的产品。
