examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么紧张，不然待会儿出丑就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, otherwise you'll screw up and it'll be terrible.

mandarin_meaning: 泄气; 出问题; 搞砸; 掉链子
english_meaning: To fail; to mess up; to screw up; to drop the ball; to lay an egg (lit. to lay an egg)
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情搞砸，没有达到预期的目标。比喻事情失败，或表现不如人意。
explanation_english: Refers to messing up a task or failing to achieve the expected outcome. Figuratively speaking, it means that something has failed or the performance is unsatisfactory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我屙咗蛋，得咗個包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 o1 zo2 daan2, dak1 zo2 go3 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考砸了，只得了及格。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up this exam and only got a passing grade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份project咁重要，你唔好屙蛋呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 project gam3 zung6 jiu3, nei5 m4 hou2 o1 daan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么重要，你别搞砸了！
examples.english_sentence: This project is so important, don't mess it up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨尾屙蛋，搞到成隊波輸埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 mei5 o1 daan2, gaau2 dou3 seng4 deoi2 bo1 syu1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在最后关头掉链子，导致整个球队都输了。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped the ball at the last minute, causing the whole team to lose.

english_meaning: Difficulty urinating; painful urination
explanation_mandarin: 指排尿困难，小便不畅顺，可能伴有疼痛。
explanation_english: Refers to difficulty in urinating, often accompanied by pain or discomfort. It suggests a problem with the urinary system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日開始屙遏尿，可能係膀胱炎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 hoi1 si2 o1 aat3 niu6, ho2 nang4 hai6 pong4 gwong1 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天开始排尿困难，可能是膀胱炎。
examples.english_sentence: He's been having difficulty urinating since yesterday, it might be cystitis.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻胡说八道，说话没谱
english_meaning: To talk nonsense; to spout rubbish; to be full of it; to make things up as you go along; (literally) to shit chains
explanation_mandarin: “屙”是排泄的意思，“鎖鏈”是锁链。 整个词语比喻说话内容荒谬，毫无逻辑，就像拉出锁链一样，毫无关联且不合常理。多用于贬义，表示对对方说话内容的不满或不信任。
explanation_english: "O1" (屙) means to excrete. "So2 lin2" (鎖鏈) means chain. The whole phrase is a metaphor for speaking nonsense, talking illogically, and without any basis in reality, as if one were excreting chains. It carries a negative connotation and is used to express dissatisfaction or disbelief in what someone is saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度屙鎖鏈啦，冇人信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 o1 so2 lin2 laa1, mou5 jan4 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里胡说八道了，没有人相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking rubbish here; no one believes you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都屙鎖鏈，講啲嘢冇句真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 o1 so2 lin2, gong2 di1 je5 mou5 geoi3 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡说八道，说的话没有一句是真的。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense; nothing he says is true.

english_meaning: to urinate, to pee
explanation_mandarin: 指排泄尿液，小便。
explanation_english: To urinate, to pee; to excrete urine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔，你想唔想去屙𡲢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 o1 niu6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子，你想不想去小便啊？
examples.english_sentence: Son, do you want to go pee?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好急，想屙𡲢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gap1, soeng2 o1 niu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好急，想小便。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, I need to pee.

english_meaning: drawer
explanation_mandarin: 一种家具的组成部分，可以拉出或推进，用于存放物品。
explanation_english: A component of furniture that can be pulled out or pushed in, used for storing items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將啲衫擺喺個櫃桶嘅第二格屜度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 saam1 baai2 hai2 go3 gwai6 tung2 ge3 dai6 ji6 gaak3 tai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把那些衣服放在抽屉的第二格里。
examples.english_sentence: I put those clothes in the second drawer of the dresser.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打開個屜，攞啲文件出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 hoi1 go3 tai3, lo2 di1 man4 gin2 cheut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打开抽屉，把文件拿出来。
examples.english_sentence: Open the drawer and take out the documents.

english_meaning: shoe
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中指鞋子。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it refers to shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對屝太細，我著唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 bei2 taai3 sai3, ngo5 zoek3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋太小了，我穿不进去。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are too small, I can't wear them.

english_meaning: to belong to; to be; belong to (a zodiac sign)
explanation_mandarin: 表示归属，属于; 表示生肖
explanation_english: To belong to; to be classified as belonging to; to belong to a zodiac sign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係屬你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 suk6 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是属于你的。
examples.english_sentence: This belongs to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你屬咩生肖呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 suk6 me1 sang1 siu3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你属什么生肖？
examples.english_sentence: What is your zodiac sign?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屬同一間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 suk6 tung4 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们属于同一家公司。
examples.english_sentence: They belong to the same company.

english_meaning: to slaughter, to massacre
explanation_mandarin: 宰杀牲畜；大规模杀戮。
explanation_english: To slaughter livestock; to massacre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屠殺咗好多無辜嘅市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tou4 saat3 zo2 hou2 do1 mou4 gu1 ge3 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们屠杀了许多无辜的市民。
examples.english_sentence: They massacred many innocent citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾農場會屠豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 nung4 coeng4 wui5 tou4 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年底农场会宰猪。
examples.english_sentence: The farm will slaughter pigs at the end of the year.

english_meaning: slaughterhouse, abattoir
explanation_mandarin: 宰杀牲畜的场所。
explanation_english: A place where animals are slaughtered for food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屠場啲環境好污糟，成日臭氣熏天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 tou4 coeng4 di1 waan4 ging2 hou2 wu1 zou1, seng4 jat6 cau3 hei3 fan1 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个屠宰场的环境很脏，整天臭气熏天。
examples.english_sentence: That slaughterhouse is very dirty, always with a terrible stench.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屠場做嘢，日日都要劏雞劏豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou4 coeng4 zou6 je5, jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 tong2 gai1 tong2 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在屠宰场工作，每天都要杀鸡杀猪。
examples.english_sentence: He works in the slaughterhouse, having to slaughter chickens and pigs every day.

english_meaning: Butcher; slaughterer; executioner (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 指以宰杀牲畜为职业的人；也比喻残酷杀害人民的人。
explanation_english: A person whose profession is slaughtering animals for food; figuratively, a cruel person or executioner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街市做屠夫，日日劏雞劏豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 si5 zou6 tou4 fu1, jat6 jat6 tong2 gai1 tong2 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在菜市场做屠夫，每天杀鸡杀猪。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a butcher in the market, slaughtering chickens and pigs every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個發展商簡直係個屠夫，拆咗好多舊樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 faat3 zin2 soeng1 gaan2 zik6 hai6 go3 tou4 fu1, caak3 zo2 hou2 do1 gau6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个开发商简直是个屠夫，拆了很多旧楼。
examples.english_sentence: That developer is simply a butcher, tearing down many old buildings.

english_meaning: to slaughter; to butcher
explanation_mandarin: 指宰杀牲畜，通常是为了食用。
explanation_english: To slaughter livestock, usually for consumption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司專門做屠宰豬嘅生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 zou6 tou4 zoi2 zyu1 ge3 saang1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司专门做屠宰猪的生意。
examples.english_sentence: This company specializes in the business of slaughtering pigs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屠宰場嘅環境好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 zoi2 coeng4 ge3 waan4 ging2 hou2 wu1 zou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屠宰场的环境很脏。
examples.english_sentence: The environment of the slaughterhouse is very dirty.

english_meaning: slaughterhouse; abattoir
explanation_mandarin: 宰杀牲畜的场所。
explanation_english: A place where animals are slaughtered for food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屠房長期超時工作，啲工人做到冇停手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 tou4 fong2 coeng4 kei4 ciu1 si4 gung1 zok3, di1 gung1 yan4 zou6 dou3 mou5 ting4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家屠宰场长期超时工作，工人们一直不停地工作。
examples.english_sentence: This slaughterhouse has been working overtime for a long time, and the workers are working non-stop.

english_meaning: massacre, slaughter
explanation_mandarin: 大规模地残杀无辜者。
explanation_english: The act of killing a large number of people indiscriminately and brutally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭入面，平民百姓經常受到屠殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zaang1 jap6 min6, ping4 man4 baak3 sing3 ging1 seung4 sau6 dou6 tou4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在战争中，平民百姓经常受到屠杀。
examples.english_sentence: In wars, civilians are often subjected to massacres.

english_meaning: Skills in slaying dragons; useless skills; impractical knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 比喻虽有很高超的技能，但没有实际用途。
explanation_english: Metaphor for highly skilled but ultimately useless techniques or knowledge, as dragons are mythical creatures and slaying them is an impossible task. It refers to skills that are impressive in theory but have no practical application in reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學埋啲屠龍技，都唔知第時做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 maai4 di1 tou4 lung4 gei6, dou1 m4 zi1 dai6 si4 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学了那些屠龙之技，也不知道将来做什么。
examples.english_sentence: Learning all those useless skills, I don't even know what I'll do in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢咪就係屠龍技囉，根本冇人會咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 mai1 zau6 si6 tou4 lung4 gei6 lo1, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 wui5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的那些不就是屠龙之技吗，根本没有人会那样做。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is just dragon-slaying skills; nobody would actually do that.

english_meaning: repeatedly, frequently, time and again
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情或行为重复发生多次。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or an action happens repeatedly, many times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屢次考試都唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 leoi5 ci3 haau2 si3 dou1 m4 gok3 gap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他屡次考试都不及格。
examples.english_sentence: He has repeatedly failed the exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屢勸佢唔好咁做，但係佢都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 leoi5 hyun3 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我屡次劝他不要这样做，但是他都不听。
examples.english_sentence: I repeatedly advised him not to do that, but he wouldn't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳屢獲殊榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 leoi5 wok6 syu4 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅屡获殊荣。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has repeatedly won awards.

english_meaning: To fight many times and lose every time; a string of defeats
explanation_mandarin: 多次作战，多次失败。形容一直失败。
explanation_english: Describes repeated attempts to achieve something that end in failure each time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機成日都屢戰屢敗，不過佢都唔放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 sing4 jat6 dou1 leoi5 zin3 leoi5 baai6, bat1 gwo3 keoi5 dou1 m4 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打游戏总是屡战屡败，不过他都不放弃。
examples.english_sentence: He always loses when playing video games, but he never gives up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘗試煮呢個食譜好多次，但係都屢戰屢敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si4 soeng5 zyu2 ni1 go3 sik6 pu2 hou2 do1 ci3, daan6 hai6 dou1 leoi5 zin3 leoi5 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我尝试煮这个食谱很多次，但是都屡战屡败。
examples.english_sentence: I've tried cooking this recipe many times, but always fail.

english_meaning: To fight on despite repeated defeats; to keep fighting despite setbacks.
explanation_mandarin: 多次失败，多次继续战斗。形容意志坚强，不屈不挠。
explanation_english: Describes a person who continues to fight or try even after repeated failures; persistent and indomitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考大學考咗好多次都唔成功，但係佢都屢敗屢戰，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 daai6 hok6 haau2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 sing4 gung1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 leoi5 baai6 leoi5 zin3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考大学考了很多次都没有成功，但是他都屡败屡战，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the university entrance exam many times, but he kept fighting despite the repeated failures. He's really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業嘅路好難行，你要有屢敗屢戰嘅精神先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 ge3 lou6 hou2 naan4 haang4, nei5 jiu3 jau5 leoi5 baai6 leoi5 zin3 ge3 zing1 san4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创业的路很难走，你必须要有屡败屡战的精神才行。
examples.english_sentence: The path of entrepreneurship is difficult. You must have the spirit of fighting on despite repeated defeats.

english_meaning: repeatedly; time and again; again and again
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情或情况重复发生很多次。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens repeatedly, many times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屢次遲到，搞到經理好唔高興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 leoi5 ci3 ci4 dou3, gaau2 dou3 ging1 lei5 hou2 m4 gou1 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他屡次迟到，弄得经理很不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He's repeatedly late, which makes the manager very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經屢次提醒你，唔好再犯同樣嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 leoi5 ci3 tai4 sing2 nei5, m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经多次提醒你，不要再犯同样的错。
examples.english_sentence: I have reminded you repeatedly not to make the same mistake again.

english_meaning: nothing new; a common occurrence; happens frequently
explanation_mandarin: 常常见到，并不新奇。指某种事物或现象经常出现，不足为奇。
explanation_english: A common sight; nothing new. Describes something or a phenomenon that occurs frequently and is not surprising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，物價貴到離譜，已經屢見不鮮喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, mat6 gaa3 gwai3 dou3 lei4 pou2, ji5 ging1 leoi5 gin3 bat1 sin1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，物价贵得离谱，这已经屡见不鲜了。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, prices are ridiculously expensive, which is nothing new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔成日轉工，都屢見不鮮㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 zyun2 gung1, dou1 leoi5 gin3 bat1 sin1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人经常换工作，这都是屡见不鲜的了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, it's common for young people to change jobs frequently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網絡詐騙嘅新聞，而家已經屢見不鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 lok6 zaa3 pin3 ge3 san1 man2, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 leoi5 gin3 bat1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网络诈骗的新闻，现在已经屡见不鲜了。
examples.english_sentence: News of online scams is now a common occurrence.

english_meaning: layer; storey; level
explanation_mandarin: 量词，用于重叠或分层的事物；名词，指事物分成的层次或建筑物的一层。
explanation_english: Classifier, used for things that are layered or stratified; noun, referring to a layer of something or a storey of a building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟大廈有三十層咁高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 daai6 haa6 jau5 saam1 sap6 cang4 gam3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋大厦有三十层那么高。
examples.english_sentence: This building is thirty storeys high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊蛋糕有幾層忌廉㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 daan6 gou1 jau5 gei2 cang4 gei1 lim2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块蛋糕有几层奶油啊。
examples.english_sentence: This cake has several layers of cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢層樓係辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cang4 lau2 hai6 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这层楼是办公室。
examples.english_sentence: This floor is an office.

english_meaning: to emerge in an endless stream; to spring up in endlessly
explanation_mandarin: 形容接连不断地出现，没有穷尽。
explanation_english: Describes something that emerges or arises continuously without end; to appear one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾年啲新款手機層出不窮，真係唔知揀邊部好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 nin4 di1 san1 fun2 sau2 gei1 cang4 ceot1 bat1 kung4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 gaan2 bin1 bou6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这几年新款手机层出不穷，真不知道选哪一部好。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, new models of mobile phones have been emerging endlessly; I really don't know which one to choose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會問題層出不窮，政府要諗辦法解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 man6 tai4 cang4 ceot1 bat1 kung4, zing3 fu2 jiu3 nam2 bin6 faat3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会问题层出不穷，政府要想办法解决。
examples.english_sentence: Social problems are constantly emerging, and the government needs to find solutions.

english_meaning: Pyramid scheme
explanation_mandarin: 一种通过发展下线来获取利润的商业模式，通常承诺高额回报，但实际上只有顶端的人才能获利，下线则面临亏损风险。
explanation_english: A business model that recruits members via a promise of payments or services for enrolling others into the scheme, rather than supplying investments or sale of products. As recruiting multiplies, recruiting becomes quickly impossible, and most members are unable to profit; as such, pyramid schemes are unsustainable and often illegal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅生意模式係層壓式，你小心啲啊，唔好俾佢呃啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 saang1 ji3 mou4 sik1 hai6 cang4 aap3 sik1, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 aak1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的生意模式是传销式的，你小心点，别被他骗了。
examples.english_sentence: Their business model is a pyramid scheme, be careful and don't get scammed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府經常警告市民唔好參與層壓式嘅投資計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ging1 seong4 ging2 gou3 si5 man4 m4 hou2 caam1 jyu5 cang4 aap3 sik1 ge3 tau4 zi1 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府经常警告市民不要参与传销式的投资计划。
examples.english_sentence: The government often warns citizens not to participate in pyramid scheme investment plans.

english_meaning: Pyramid scheme, Ponzi scheme
explanation_mandarin: 一种非法的商业模式，通过招募新成员而非销售产品或服务来获取利润。早期加入者通过后续加入者缴纳的资金获利，最终模式会崩溃，导致大部分参与者损失资金。
explanation_english: An illegal business model that recruits members via a promise of payments or services for enrolling others into the scheme, rather than supplying investments or sale of products or services. As recruiting multiplies, recruiting becomes quickly impossible, and most members are unable to profit; as such, pyramid schemes are unsustainable and often illegal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好信嗰啲層壓式推銷啊，呃人㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 go2 di1 cang4 aap3 sik1 teoi1 siu1 aa3, aak1 jan4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要相信那些层压式推销啊，是骗人的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't ever trust those pyramid schemes, they're scams!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人呃咗入層壓式推銷，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 jap6 cang4 aap3 sik1 teoi1 siu1, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗进了层压式推销，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He was scammed into a pyramid scheme and lost a lot of money.

english_meaning: Jenga (the game); building blocks; to stack up
explanation_mandarin: 指一种堆叠积木的游戏，通常由木块组成，玩家轮流取走木块并放到顶层，直到积木塔倒塌。也泛指堆叠东西。
explanation_english: Refers to the game Jenga, where players take turns removing blocks from a tower and placing them on top until the tower collapses. It can also generally refer to stacking things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚玩層層疊啦，睇下邊個整冧佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 waan2 cang4 cang4 dip6 laa1, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 zing2 lam1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚玩叠叠高吧，看看谁把它弄倒。
examples.english_sentence: Let's play Jenga tonight and see who makes it fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲文件層層疊咁高，睇到都覺得頭暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 man4 gin2 cang4 cang4 dip6 gam3 gou1, tai2 dou3 dou1 gok3 dak1 tau4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件一层一层叠得这么高，看到都觉得头晕。
examples.english_sentence: The documents are stacked so high, it makes me dizzy just looking at them.

english_meaning: shelf
explanation_mandarin: 指用于放置物品的板状结构，通常固定在墙上或作为架子的一部分。
explanation_english: A flat, rigid structure, typically made of wood, metal, or plastic, used to hold or support objects. Often attached to a wall or part of a shelving unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺廚房裝多幾塊層板嚟擺嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 cyu4 fong2 zong1 do1 gei2 faai3 cang4 baan2 lai4 baai2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在厨房多装几块搁板来放东西。
examples.english_sentence: We need to install a few more shelves in the kitchen to put things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書重到差啲將塊層板壓冧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 cung5 dou3 caa1 di1 zoeng1 faai3 cang4 baan2 aat3 lam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书重得差点把那块搁板压塌了。
examples.english_sentence: This book is so heavy that it almost collapsed the shelf.

english_meaning: level; layer; hierarchy; sophistication; standard
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的等级，水平，境界等。
explanation_english: Refers to the level, standard, or sophistication of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲畫嘅層次好高，唔係人人都可以欣賞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei1 waa2 ge3 cang4 ci3 hou2 gou1, m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 yan1 seong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画的层次很高，不是每个人都能欣赏。
examples.english_sentence: The level of sophistication in his paintings is very high, not everyone can appreciate it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物層次唔同，價錢都貴啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 cang4 ci3 m4 tung4, gaa3 cin4 dou1 gwai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物水准不一样，价格也贵一些。
examples.english_sentence: The standard of food in this restaurant is different, and the prices are also a bit more expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品嘅設計層次好低，好易壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 ge3 cit3 gai3 cang4 ci3 hou2 dai1, hou2 ji6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品的设计水平很低，很容易坏。
examples.english_sentence: The design standard of this product is very low, it breaks easily.

english_meaning: level, rank, grade, hierarchy
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的等级或级别。
explanation_english: Refers to the levels or ranks of something, often in a hierarchy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面嘅層級好多，晉升都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 cang4 gap1 hou2 do1, zeon3 sing1 dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司内部的层级很多，晋升也挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: There are many levels in the company, making promotion quite difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅批准需要唔同層級嘅領導同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 pat1 zeon2 seoi1 jiu3 m4 tung4 cang4 gap1 ge3 ling5 dou6 tung3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的批准需要不同层级的领导同意。
examples.english_sentence: The approval of this plan requires the consent of leaders from different levels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路都想爬上更高嘅層級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 dou1 soeng2 paa4 soeng5 gang1 gou1 ge3 cang4 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都想爬上更高的层级。
examples.english_sentence: He always wanted to climb to a higher level.

english_meaning: level; aspect; facet; dimension
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所表现的方面或层次。
explanation_english: Refers to the aspects or layers in which something is manifested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺唔同嘅層面去分析呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 cang4 min6 heoi3 fan1 sik1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要从不同的层面去分析这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to analyze this problem from different levels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事涉及好多個層面，唔可以單單睇表面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 sik6 gap6 hou2 do1 go3 cang4 min6, m4 ho2 ji5 daan1 daan1 tai2 biu2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事涉及很多个层面，不可以只看表面。
examples.english_sentence: This matter involves many aspects and we cannot just look at the surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教育制度改革需要喺唔同層面取得共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 goi2 gaak3 seoi1 jiu3 hai2 m4 tung4 cang4 min6 ceoi2 dak1 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教育制度改革需要在不同层面取得共识。
examples.english_sentence: Reforms to the education system require consensus at different levels.

english_meaning: shoes, footwear
explanation_mandarin: 鞋子，通常指正式场合或特殊用途的鞋。
explanation_english: Shoes, often referring to formal or special-purpose footwear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 著返對履先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoek3 faan1 deoi3 leoi5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把鞋穿上。
examples.english_sentence: Put your shoes on first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住對新履去見工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 deoi3 san1 leoi5 heoi3 gin3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着一双新鞋去面试。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a pair of new shoes to the job interview.

english_meaning: caterpillar track; tank tread
explanation_mandarin: 用于车辆（如坦克、拖拉机）的一种环形装置，由一系列相互铰接的金属板或橡胶块组成，绕着两个或多个轮子转动，以增加与地面的接触面积，提高行驶能力。
explanation_english: A track made of a series of hinged metal plates or rubber blocks that revolves around two or more wheels on a vehicle (such as a tank or tractor) to increase the contact area with the ground and improve traction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架坦克嘅履帶爛咗，行唔到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 taan2 hak1 ge3 leoi5 daai2 laan6 zo2, hang4 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坦克的履带坏了，走不了啦。
examples.english_sentence: The tank's caterpillar track is broken, it can't move.

english_meaning: to assume a new post, to take up a new position, to start a new job
explanation_mandarin: 指官员或职员到新的工作岗位上任。
explanation_english: Refers to an official or employee taking up a new position in a new workplace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個禮拜就會履新，做經理嘅位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 wui5 leoi5 san1, zou6 ging1 lei5 ge3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个星期就会上任，做经理的职位。
examples.english_sentence: He will assume his new post as manager next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱履新，好多嘢都仲未上手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 leoi5 san1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 zung1 mei6 soeng5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚上任，很多东西都还没有上手。
examples.english_sentence: He has just taken up his new position, and he is not familiar with many things yet.

english_meaning: resume, curriculum vitae (CV)
explanation_mandarin: 个人经历的摘要，通常用于求职。
explanation_english: A summary of a person's experience and skills, often used for job applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寫緊份履歷準備搵新工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 se2 gan2 fan6 leoi5 lik6 zyun2 bei6 wan2 san1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在写简历准备找新工作。
examples.english_sentence: I'm writing my resume to prepare for finding a new job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份履歷好impressive呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 leoi5 lik6 hou2 impressive aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的简历很令人印象深刻啊！
examples.english_sentence: His resume is very impressive!

english_meaning: to fulfill, to perform, to carry out, to implement
explanation_mandarin: 执行，实践承诺或职责。
explanation_english: To carry out, execute, or fulfill a promise, duty, or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋履行咗合約入面嘅承諾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 leoi5 hang4 zo2 hap6 joek3 jap6 min6 ge3 sing4 nok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们履行了合同里的承诺。
examples.english_sentence: They fulfilled the promises in the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府必須履行對市民嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bit1 seoi1 leoi5 hang4 deoi3 si5 man4 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府必须履行对市民的责任。
examples.english_sentence: The government must fulfill its responsibilities to the citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會盡力履行任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zeon6 lik6 leoi5 hang4 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会尽力履行任务。
examples.english_sentence: We will do our best to fulfill the mission.

english_meaning: to belong to; to be; to be born in (year of the zodiac)
explanation_mandarin: 表示归属关系；生肖属相。
explanation_english: Indicates belonging or affiliation; relates to the Chinese zodiac animal sign associated with a birth year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書屬我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 suk6 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是我的。
examples.english_sentence: This book belongs to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屬兔嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 suk6 tou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我属兔的。
examples.english_sentence: I was born in the year of the Rabbit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係屬同一間公司嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 suk6 tung4 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们属于同一家公司。
examples.english_sentence: They belong to the same company.

english_meaning: subordinate, underling
explanation_mandarin: 指在职位或等级上低于自己的人，接受自己领导或指挥的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is lower in position or rank than oneself and who is led or commanded by oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅屬下，做嘢好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 suk6 haa6, zou6 je5 hou2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的下属，工作很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He is my subordinate and he works very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為上司，要尊重屬下嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 soeng6 si1, jiu3 zyun1 zung6 suk6 haa6 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为上司，要尊重下属的意见。
examples.english_sentence: As a boss, you should respect the opinions of your subordinates.

mandarin_meaning: 接地气, 实干, 务实
english_meaning: down-to-earth, practical, realistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人性格务实，不浮夸，贴近实际，能够脚踏实地地工作或生活。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is down-to-earth, practical, realistic, and grounded, not pretentious or out of touch with reality. It suggests someone who can work or live in a practical and sensible way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好屬土㗎，唔鍾意吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 suk6 tou2 gaa3, m4 zung1 ji3 cheui1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很务实，不喜欢吹牛。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very down-to-earth person and doesn't like to brag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃好屬土，一定可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 suk6 tou2, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划很接地气，一定可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very down-to-earth and is sure to succeed.

english_meaning: territory, dependent territory
explanation_mandarin: 指隶属于某国管辖但并非其本土的地区，通常指殖民地或附属地。
explanation_english: A territory that is under the jurisdiction of a country but is not an integral part of that country, often referring to a colony or dependent territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前係英國嘅屬地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 hai6 jing1 gwok3 ge3 suk6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港以前是英国的属地。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to be a British territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想將嗰個島變成新嘅屬地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 zoeng1 go2 go3 dou2 bin3 sing4 san1 ge3 suk6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想把那个岛变成新的属地。
examples.english_sentence: They want to turn that island into a new territory.

english_meaning: to be true; factual; verifiable; to hold true
explanation_mandarin: 指情况或叙述符合事实，真实可靠。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or statement that aligns with the facts, is genuine, and reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事係咪屬實㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hai6 mai6 suk6 sat6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is this matter true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢係咪屬實，重要查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 hai6 mai6 suk6 sat6, zung6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话是否属实，还需要查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Whether what he said is true needs to be investigated thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果消息屬實，咁就大件事喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 siu1 sik1 suk6 sat6, gam2 zau6 daai6 gin6 si6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果消息属实，那就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: If the news is true, then it's a big deal.

english_meaning: attribute; property; characteristic
explanation_mandarin: 指事物本身所固有的性质或特点。
explanation_english: Refers to an inherent quality or characteristic of a thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個角色嘅屬性好複雜，一時又好人，一時又好衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 ge3 suk6 sing3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jat1 si4 jau6 hou2 jan4, jat1 si4 jau6 hou2 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个角色的属性很复杂，一会儿是好人，一会儿又是坏人。
examples.english_sentence: This character's attributes are very complex; sometimes he is a good person, and sometimes he is bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每種物質都有佢自己獨特嘅屬性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 zung2 mat6 zat1 dou1 jau5 keoi5 zi6 gei2 duk6 dak6 ge3 suk6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每种物质都有它自己独特的属性。
examples.english_sentence: Every substance has its own unique attributes.

english_meaning: to have one's eye on (something or someone); to favour; to be inclined towards; to prefer
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事感到满意，倾向选择。
explanation_english: To have a preference for someone or something; to be inclined towards or favour a particular choice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屬意呢間公司，因為佢哋嘅福利好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 suk6 ji3 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fuk1 lei6 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我中意这家公司，因为他们的福利好一些。
examples.english_sentence: I favour this company because their benefits are better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細屬意佢升職，因為佢表現出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 suk6 ji3 keoi5 sing1 zik1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 biu2 hin3 seot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板看中他升职，因为他表现出色。
examples.english_sentence: The boss favours him for promotion because of his outstanding performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間餐廳，你屬意邊間啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 caan1 teng1, nei5 suk6 ji3 bin1 gaan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家餐厅，你中意哪家啊？
examples.english_sentence: Between those two restaurants, which one do you prefer?

english_meaning: to belong to, to be part of, to be owned by
explanation_mandarin: 表示归于某个范围、类别或个人所有。
explanation_english: To belong to a certain range, category, or be owned by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書屬於我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 suk6 jyu5 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是属于我的。
examples.english_sentence: This book belongs to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港屬於中國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 suk6 jyu5 zung1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港属于中国。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong belongs to China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲問題唔屬於我哋嘅範疇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 man6 tai4 m4 suk6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 ge3 faan6 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些问题不属于我们的范畴。
examples.english_sentence: These problems are not within our scope.

english_meaning: to hoard, to store up, to stock up
explanation_mandarin: 积存货物，以备急用或升价时出售。
explanation_english: To accumulate and store goods, especially to prepare for emergencies or to sell when prices rise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排疫情嚴重，好多人去超市屯糧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 jik6 cing4 jim4 zung6, hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 siu1 si5 tyun4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近疫情严重，很多人去超市囤积粮食。
examples.english_sentence: The pandemic is serious these days, so many people are going to supermarkets to stock up on food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好屯咁多嘢啦，好阻地方㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tyun4 gam3 do1 je5 laa1, hou2 zo2 dei6 fong1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要囤积那么多东西了，很占地方的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hoard so many things, it takes up a lot of space.

english_meaning: Tuen Mun, Yuen Long, Tin Shui Wai
explanation_mandarin: 指香港新界西部的三个地区：屯门、元朗和天水围的合称。
explanation_english: A collective term referring to three districts in the western New Territories of Hong Kong: Tuen Mun, Yuen Long, and Tin Shui Wai.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話住喺屯元天嘅人返工好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jyu6 hai2 tyun4 jyun4 tin1 ge3 jan4 faan1 gung1 hou2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说住在屯门、元朗、天水围的人上班很远。
examples.english_sentence: They say that people who live in Tuen Mun, Yuen Long, and Tin Shui Wai have a long commute to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屯元天嘅樓價相對市區平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tyun4 jyun4 tin1 ge3 lau4 gaa3 soeng1 deoi3 si5 keoi1 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屯门、元朗、天水围的房价相对市区便宜一些。
examples.english_sentence: The property prices in Tuen Mun, Yuen Long, and Tin Shui Wai are relatively cheaper compared to the urban areas.

english_meaning: Tuen Mun Road
explanation_mandarin: 指连接香港新界屯门和荃湾的屯门公路。
explanation_english: Refers to the Tuen Mun Road, a major highway connecting Tuen Mun and Tsuen Wan in the New Territories, Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝屯公又塞車，遲咗成個鐘返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 tyun4 gung1 jau6 sak1 ce1, ci4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上屯门公路又堵车了，迟到了整整一个小时上班。
examples.english_sentence: This morning Tuen Mun Road was jammed again, I was late for work by a whole hour.

english_meaning: Tuen Mun (a district in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一个地区，位于新界西部。
explanation_english: A district in Hong Kong, located in the western New Territories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺屯門㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 tyun4 mun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在屯门。
examples.english_sentence: I live in Tuen Mun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屯門嘅海灘幾靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tyun4 mun4 ge3 hoi2 taan1 gei2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屯门的海滩挺漂亮的。
examples.english_sentence: The beaches in Tuen Mun are quite beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去屯門探朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 tyun4 mun4 taam3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去屯门拜访朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Tuen Mun to visit a friend tomorrow.

english_meaning: A person from Tuen Mun who is known for being physically strong and resilient; a hard worker.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人像屯门出产的牛一样，身体强壮，能吃苦耐劳。因为屯门以前是农地，很多人务农，需要强壮的劳动力。现在多用来形容一个人特别能吃苦，做事勤奋。
explanation_english: Describes a person, particularly someone from Tuen Mun (a district in Hong Kong), as being physically strong, resilient, and capable of hard work, similar to an ox. This originates from Tuen Mun's history as an agricultural area where strong labor was needed. Nowadays, it's often used to describe someone who is particularly hardworking and can endure hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係屯門牛嚟㗎，日頭返工，夜晚仲要返夜校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 tyun4 mun4 ngau4 lai4 gaa3, jat6 tau3 faan1 gung1, je6 maan1 zung6 jiu3 faan1 je6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个屯门牛，白天上班，晚上还要上夜校。
examples.english_sentence: He is really a Tuen Mun ox; he works during the day and goes to night school in the evening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢咁瘦，佢做嘢好似屯門牛咁，好捱得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 gam3 sau3, keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 tyun4 mun4 ngau4 gam2, hou2 aai1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要看他这么瘦，他工作起来像屯门牛一样，非常能吃苦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look at him being so skinny; he works like a Tuen Mun ox; he can endure a lot.

english_meaning: Tuen Ma Line (Hong Kong MTR Line)
explanation_mandarin: 香港地铁的一条线路，连接屯门和马鞍山。
explanation_english: A railway line of the Hong Kong MTR that connects Tuen Mun and Ma On Shan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要搭屯馬綫去尖沙咀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 daap3 tyun4 maa5 sin3 heoi3 zim1 saa1 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要搭屯马线去尖沙咀。
examples.english_sentence: I need to take the Tuen Ma Line to Tsim Sha Tsui tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屯馬綫方便咗好多新界西嘅居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tyun4 maa5 sin3 fong1 bin6 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 gaai3 sai1 ge3 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屯马线方便了很多新界西的居民。
examples.english_sentence: The Tuen Ma Line has made things easier for many residents in the New Territories West.

english_meaning: mountain, hill
explanation_mandarin: 指地球表面隆起的地形，通常比丘陵高大。
explanation_english: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level; a large steep hill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We are going hiking tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多山。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many mountains.

english_meaning: hill; knoll
explanation_mandarin: 指小山或丘陵。
explanation_english: Refers to a small mountain or hill; a knoll.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺個山丘上面野餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 go3 saan1 jau1 soeng6 min6 je5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在小山丘上野餐。
examples.english_sentence: We are having a picnic on the hill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個山丘嘅風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 saan1 jau1 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小山丘的风景很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery on that hill is very beautiful.

english_meaning: Hillbilly; Country bumpkin; Hermit; Reclusive person
explanation_mandarin: 指乡下人，带有贬义。也指隐居山林的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person from the countryside, often used pejoratively. Can also refer to a hermit or a reclusive person living in the mountains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁睇唔起山人啦，人地都好有能力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tai2 m4 hei2 saan1 jan4 laa1, jan4 dei6 dou1 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么瞧不起乡下人，他们也很有能力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on hillbillies like that, they are also very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隱居山林，過住山人嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan2 geoi1 saan1 lam4, gwo3 zyu6 saan1 jan4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他隐居山林，过着隐士的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He lives in seclusion in the mountains, living the life of a hermit.

jyutping: saan1 jan4 zi6 jau5 miu6 gai3
english_meaning: I/He/She has a plan/trick up my/his/her sleeve; I/He/She has a clever plan to solve the problem.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对解决某个问题或困境有自己的独到方法和策略，不必担心。
explanation_english: Expresses confidence in having a clever plan or strategy to solve a problem or overcome a difficult situation. It implies that one doesn't need to worry because the speaker (or the subject) has a solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁擔心嘅，山人自有妙計啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 ge3, saan1 jan4 zi6 jau5 miu6 gai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么担心，我自有妙计。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to worry so much, I have a plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁鬼馬，次次遇到麻煩，都話山人自有妙計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gwai2 maa5, ci3 ci3 jyu6 dou3 maa4 faan4, dou1 waa6 saan1 jan4 zi6 jau5 miu6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很鬼灵精怪，每次遇到麻烦，都说自有妙计。
examples.english_sentence: He's so mischievous. Every time he encounters trouble, he says he has a plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單deal咁難搞，唔知佢係咪真係山人自有妙計呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 deal gam3 naan4 gaau2, m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 saan1 jan4 zi6 jau5 miu6 gai3 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这个项目这么难搞，不知道他是不是真的自有妙计呢？
examples.english_sentence: This deal is so difficult. I wonder if he really has a clever plan?

english_meaning: valley; depression between hills
explanation_mandarin: 两山之间低凹的地方。
explanation_english: A depression or low-lying area between two mountains or hills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條村喺個山凹入面，好隱蔽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 cyun1 hai2 go3 saan1 au1 jap6 min6, hou2 yan2 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个村庄在山坳里，很隐蔽。
examples.english_sentence: The village is located in the valley, very secluded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行咗好耐先至去到個山凹，真係攰死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 zi3 heoi3 dou3 go3 saan1 au1, zan1 hai6 gui6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走了很久才到达那个山坳，真是累死了。
examples.english_sentence: We walked for a long time before reaching the valley, it's so tiring.

english_meaning: Topography; Configuration of mountains; Mountainous terrain; Momentum of a mountain
explanation_mandarin: 指山脉的形态、走向和高低起伏的态势。
explanation_english: Refers to the shape, direction, and elevation variations of a mountain range; the general appearance of mountainous terrain; also, the perceived momentum or power emanating from a mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方嘅山勢好險峻，攀登起嚟好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 saan1 sai3 hou2 him2 seon3, paan1 dang1 hei2 lai4 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方的山势非常险峻，攀登起来很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: The mountainous terrain in this place is very steep and dangerous to climb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢哋間屋嘅風水，都好重視背後嘅山勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 ge3 fung1 seoi2, dou1 hou2 zung6 si6 bui3 hau6 ge3 saan1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他们家的风水，都很重视背后的山势。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at the feng shui of their house, they place great importance on the mountain behind it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個畫家畫嘅山水畫，將山勢嘅雄偉表現得淋漓盡致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 waa2 gaa1 waa2 ge3 saan1 seoi2 waa2, zoeng1 saan1 sai3 ge3 hung4 wai2 biu2 hin6 dak1 lam4 lei4 zeon6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个画家画的山水画，将山势的雄伟表现得淋漓尽致。
examples.english_sentence: The landscape painting by that artist perfectly captures the magnificence of the mountain topography.

english_meaning: mountainous area; mountain region
explanation_mandarin: 指山地所在的区域，通常地势崎岖，交通不便。
explanation_english: Refers to a mountainous area, typically characterized by rugged terrain and inconvenient transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺偏遠嘅山區，出入都好唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 pin1 jyun5 ge3 saan1 keoi1, ceot1 jap6 dou1 hou2 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在偏远的山区，进出都很不方便。
examples.english_sentence: They live in a remote mountainous area, and it's very inconvenient to get in and out.

english_meaning: remote area, backwoods, hicksville
explanation_mandarin: 指位置偏远、交通不便的地区，通常带有贬义，形容某个地方落后、不发达。
explanation_english: Refers to a remote and inaccessible area, often with a negative connotation, describing a place as backward or underdeveloped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方真係山卡啦，搭車都要搭成個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 zan1 hai6 saan1 kaa1 laa1, daap3 ce1 dou1 jiu3 daap3 sing4 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方真是偏僻，坐车都要坐一个小时。
examples.english_sentence: This place is really out in the sticks, it takes an hour by car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搬咗去山卡啦地方住，好少見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun1 zo2 heoi3 saan1 kaa1 laa1 dei6 fong1 zyu6, hou2 siu2 gin3 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搬到了偏僻的地方住，很少见到他。
examples.english_sentence: He moved to a remote area, so we rarely see him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小啲山卡啦地方，可能會有意想不到嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 di1 saan1 kaa1 laa1 dei6 fong1, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 ji3 soeng2 bat1 dou2 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看那些偏远的地方，可能会有意想不到的发展。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate those remote areas, they might have unexpected development.

english_meaning: remote area, backwoods, boonies
explanation_mandarin: 指非常偏远、落后的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a very remote, isolated, and underdeveloped area. Often implies a lack of convenience and accessibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺山卡罅地方，出入都唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 saan1 kaa1 laa3 dei6 fong1, ceot1 jap6 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在偏僻的地方，出入都不方便。
examples.english_sentence: He lives in a remote area, and it's not convenient to get around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為我哋鄉下山卡罅就咩都冇，其實好多嘢都好正㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 dei6 hoeng1 haa2 saan1 kaa1 laa3 zau6 me1 dou1 mou5, kei4 sat6 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hou2 zeng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为我们的乡下很偏僻就什么都没有，其实很多东西都很好啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that our village is a backwoods and has nothing. Actually, a lot of things are pretty great.

mandarin_meaning: 山头; 山岬; 山嘴
english_meaning: headland; promontory; mountain peak; tip of a mountain
explanation_mandarin: 指山的山头，山岬，或山嘴等突出的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the headland, promontory, or tip of a mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺山咀睇日落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 zeoi2 tai2 jat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在山头上看日落。
examples.english_sentence: We watch the sunset on the mountain peak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個山咀伸咗入海度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 saan1 zeoi2 san1 zo2 jap6 hoi2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个山岬伸入了海中。
examples.english_sentence: That headland extends into the sea.

english_meaning: cliff
explanation_mandarin: 山的突出部分，通常指陡峭的崖壁。
explanation_english: A protruding part of a mountain, usually referring to a steep cliff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好行咁埋山嘴邊，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai5 saan1 zeoi2 bin1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要走得离山崖边那么近，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk so close to the cliff edge, it's very dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢企喺山嘴度，望住個海，好似諗緊嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kei5 hai2 saan1 zeoi2 dou6, mong6 zyu6 go3 hoi2, hou2 ci5 nam2 gan2 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在山崖上，望着大海，好像在想事情。
examples.english_sentence: He stood on the cliff, looking at the sea, as if he was thinking about something.

mandarin_meaning: 土里土气的人; 乡下人
english_meaning: Unrefined person; bumpkin; someone from the countryside
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不时尚、没有见过世面、言行举止粗俗，像从乡下来的。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is unfashionable, unsophisticated, and has crude manners, like someone from the countryside. It has a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著啲咁嘅衫，真係好山地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 gam3 ge3 saam1, zan1 hai6 hou2 saan1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿这些土气的衣服，真的很土。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears such unfashionable clothes; he's really a bumpkin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁山地啦，嚟香港咁耐都唔識用八達通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saan1 dei6 laa1, lai4 hoeng1 gong2 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 sik1 yung6 baat3 daat6 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么土气啦，来香港这么久都不会用八达通。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unsophisticated; you've been in Hong Kong for so long and still don't know how to use the Octopus card.

english_meaning: Mountain bike
explanation_mandarin: 一种适合在崎岖山地骑行的自行车。
explanation_english: A bicycle designed for riding on rough terrain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去踩山地車啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 caai2 saan1 dei6 ce1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去骑山地自行车吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go mountain biking tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗架新款嘅山地車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gaa3 san1 fun2 ge3 saan1 dei6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆新款的山地自行车。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new mountain bike.

english_meaning: mountain stream; ravine; gully; a remote and underdeveloped area (often rural)
explanation_mandarin: 指山区中的小溪流或山沟。也常用来形容偏远落后的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a small stream or ravine in the mountains. It is also often used to describe remote and underdeveloped areas, typically rural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺條山坑入面，出入都好唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 tiu4 saan1 haang1 jap6 min6, ceot1 jap6 dou1 hou2 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在山沟里面，出入很不方便。
examples.english_sentence: They live in a mountain ravine, so it's very inconvenient to get in and out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間度假屋喺山坑，環境好清靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dou6 gaa3 uk1 hai2 saan1 haang1, waan4 ging2 hou2 cing1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间度假屋在山沟，环境很清静。
examples.english_sentence: This holiday home is located in a ravine, and the environment is very peaceful.

mandarin_meaning: 不正规的水货；来路不明的商品；非正统的
english_meaning: Irregular goods; Goods of dubious origin; Non-genuine; Substandard
explanation_mandarin: 原指山上水沟里的水，比喻来路不明或质量不好的商品或非正统的东西。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Originally refers to water from mountain streams. It's used metaphorically to describe goods of dubious origin, substandard quality, or non-genuine items. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥係山坑水嚟㗎，唔好亂咁食呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 hai6 saan1 haang1 seoi2 lei4 gaa3, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 sik6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些药是来路不明的，不要乱吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: These medicines are of dubious origin; don't take them carelessly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司啲貨成日都係山坑水，唔好幫襯佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 fo3 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 saan1 haang1 seoi2, m4 hou2 bong1 caan3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的货经常都是水货，不要光顾他们了。
examples.english_sentence: The goods from their company are often substandard; don't patronize them.

synonyms: 冒牌貨 (mou6 paai4 fo3) - fake goods

english_meaning: hillside; slope of a hill
explanation_mandarin: 山的倾斜的地面。
explanation_english: The sloping side of a hill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺山坡上面野餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 bo1 soeng6 min6 je5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在山坡上野餐。
examples.english_sentence: We are having a picnic on the hillside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋起喺個山坡上面，風景好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 hei2 hai2 go3 saan1 bo1 soeng6 min6, fung1 ging2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房子建在山坡上，风景很好。
examples.english_sentence: His house is built on the hillside, the scenery is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲羊喺山坡上面食草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 joeng4 hai2 saan1 bo1 soeng6 min6 sik6 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 羊在山坡上吃草。
examples.english_sentence: The sheep are grazing on the hillside.

english_meaning: mountain pass; mountain hollow; saddle (between two peaks)
explanation_mandarin: 两山之间凹下的地方。
explanation_english: A low-lying area between two mountains or hills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺山坳嗰度休息一陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 aau3 go2 dou6 jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先在山坳那里休息一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a break in the mountain pass first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路要經過一個好大嘅山坳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 jiu3 ging1 gwo3 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 saan1 aau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路要经过一个很大的山坳。
examples.english_sentence: This road has to pass through a very large mountain pass.

english_meaning: cyanide, highly poisonous substance
explanation_mandarin: 氰化物的俗称，泛指剧毒的物质或情况。
explanation_english: Colloquial term for cyanide. Generally refers to highly poisonous substances or dangerous situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢食落肚簡直係食山埃咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 sik6 lok6 tou5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 sik6 saan1 aai1 gam3 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃这些东西简直就像吃氰化物一样。
examples.english_sentence: Eating these things is practically like eating cyanide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好 mean 㗎，同佢合作簡直係攞山埃嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 min1 gaa3, tung4 keoi5 hap6 zok3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 lo2 saan1 aai1 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很坏的，和他合作简直是找死。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very mean person, working with him is like eating cyanide (suicide).

english_meaning: Poisonous tip, a deadly/destructive piece of advice
explanation_mandarin: 指会给人带来严重损失或者伤害的建议。山埃是一种剧毒物质，比喻该建议有毒，会害人。
explanation_english: Refers to advice that will cause significant loss or harm. '山埃' (saan1 aai1) is cyanide, a deadly poison, used metaphorically to describe advice that is toxic and harmful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢講買嗰隻股票真係攞命，簡直係山埃貼士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 keoi5 gong2 maai5 go2 zek3 gu2 piu3 zan1 hai6 lo2 meng6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 saan1 aai1 tip1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听他说的买那支股票简直是害死人，简直是馊主意。
examples.english_sentence: Listening to him to buy that stock is really deadly, it's simply a poisonous tip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢呀，佢嘅貼士通常都係山埃貼士嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 ge3 tip1 si2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 saan1 aai1 tip1 si2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他，他的建议通常都是害人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, his tips are usually poisonous tips.

synonyms: 攞命貼士 (lo2 meng6 tip1 si2)

english_meaning: Shanty town; slum; makeshift dwelling; shack
explanation_mandarin: 指用简陋材料搭建的房屋聚集地，通常是贫民居住的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a settlement of makeshift dwellings constructed from rudimentary materials, typically inhabited by impoverished people; a slum or shanty town.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 果度有個山塘，住咗好多窮人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo2 dou6 jau5 go3 saan1 tong4, zyu6 zo2 hou2 do1 kung4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有一个贫民窟，住着很多穷人。
examples.english_sentence: There is a slum there, where many poor people live.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋逼于无奈，只能住喺山塘里面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bik1 jyu1 mou4 noi6, zi2 nang4 zyu6 hai2 saan1 tong4 lei5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们迫于无奈，只能住在贫民窟里面。
examples.english_sentence: They were left with no choice but to live in the slum.

english_meaning: Grave; Tomb (usually located on a hillside)
explanation_mandarin: 指位于山上的坟墓，通常规模较小，多为土葬。
explanation_english: Refers to a grave or tomb located on a hillside or mountain. It often implies a smaller, less elaborate burial site, often an earthen grave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嘅時候，好多人都會上山掃山墳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 soeng5 saan1 sou3 saan1 fan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节的时候，很多人都会上山扫墓。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming Festival, many people go up the mountains to sweep the graves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲風水先生話個山墳嘅位置唔好，影響後人嘅運程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fung1 seoi2 sin1 saang1 waa6 go3 saan1 fan4 ge3 wai6 zi3 m4 hou2, jing2 hoeng2 hau6 jan4 ge3 wan6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水先生说那个坟墓的位置不好，影响后代的运势。
examples.english_sentence: The Feng Shui master said that the location of that grave is not good, affecting the fortunes of the descendants.

jyutping: saan1 daai6 zaam2 maai4 jau5 caai4
mandarin_meaning: 家底再厚也有用完的一天
english_meaning: Even a mountain can be exhausted by chopping it down; No matter how wealthy you are, resources are finite.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻再多的财富，如果不节俭使用，也会有耗尽的一天。劝人要节俭。
explanation_english: This idiom means that even a mountain can be exhausted if you keep chopping it down. It is used to convey the idea that no matter how wealthy or abundant someone is, their resources are finite and can be depleted if not used wisely. It emphasizes the importance of frugality and saving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估你老竇真係大富豪咩？山大斬埋有柴㗎，都要慳住使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 nei5 lou5 dau6 zan1 hai6 daai6 fu3 hou4 me1? saan1 daai6 zaam2 maai4 jau5 caai4 gaa3, dou1 jiu3 haan1 zyu6 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为你爸爸真的是大富豪吗？家底再厚也有用完的一天，还是要省着点花。
examples.english_sentence: Do you think your father is a real tycoon? Even a mountain can be exhausted by chopping it down, you still need to spend sparingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，山大斬埋有柴，啲錢要用得精明啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, saan1 daai6 zaam2 maai4 jau5 caai4, di1 cin2 jiu3 yung6 dak1 zing1 ming4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，家底再厚也有用完的一天，钱要用得精明一点。
examples.english_sentence: With the economy being so bad now, even a mountain can be exhausted by chopping it down, so we need to be smarter about how we spend our money.

english_meaning: Country bumpkin, hillbilly, someone unsophisticated or from a rural area (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指來自鄉下或農村地區，見識較少、不太懂城市生活的人。 通常帶有貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to someone from the countryside or a rural area who is considered to be less knowledgeable or sophisticated, and unfamiliar with city life. Usually used in a derogatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁山婆啦，唔好喺餐廳大聲講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saan1 po4 laa1, m4 hou2 hai2 caan1 teng1 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么土包子啦，不要在餐厅大声说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a country bumpkin, don't talk loudly in the restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著衫好山婆，成日都著啲好老土嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 hou2 saan1 po4, seng4 jat6 dou1 zoek3 di1 hou2 lou5 tou2 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿衣服很土气，总是穿一些很老土的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: Her dressing style is very unsophisticated, she always wears old-fashioned clothes.

english_meaning: copycat, counterfeit, knock-off, unofficial
explanation_mandarin: 指模仿名牌产品，但质量较差，价格较低的仿冒品。也指非官方的，不正规的。
explanation_english: Refers to counterfeit or knock-off products, usually of inferior quality and lower price, that imitate well-known brands. Also refers to something unofficial or unregulated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部山寨手機用咗幾個月就壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 saan1 zaai2 sau2 gei1 yung6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台山寨手机用了几个月就坏了。
examples.english_sentence: This copycat mobile phone broke after a few months of use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞咗個山寨春晚，都幾好笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 zo2 go3 saan1 zaai2 ceon1 maan5, dou1 gei2 hou2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搞了个山寨春晚，还挺好笑的。
examples.english_sentence: They put on a knock-off Spring Festival Gala, which was quite funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好貪平買山寨嘢呀，好易壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taam1 peng4 maai5 saan1 zaai2 je5 aa3, hou2 ji6 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要贪便宜买山寨货呀，很容易坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be greedy and buy counterfeit goods, they break easily.

mandarin_meaning: 山寨币, 仿冒加密货币
english_meaning: Shanzhai coin, copycat cryptocurrency, altcoin
explanation_mandarin: 指模仿或复制主流加密货币而产生的加密货币，通常技术较为简单，安全性较低，价值波动较大。 "山寨" 本意为山寨货，意为仿冒品，这里指仿冒的加密货币。
explanation_english: Refers to cryptocurrencies that are created by imitating or copying mainstream cryptocurrencies. They typically have simpler technology, lower security, and greater price volatility. "Shanzhai" originally means counterfeit products, and here it refers to counterfeit cryptocurrencies or altcoins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多人炒山寨幣，要小心啲呀，風險好高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 jan4 caau2 saan1 zaai2 bai3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3, fung1 him2 hou2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多人炒山寨币，要小心点啊，风险很高的。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, many people are trading altcoins, you need to be careful, the risk is very high.

english_meaning: Knock-off factory; Counterfeit manufacturer; Shanzhai factory
explanation_mandarin: 指生产仿冒或盗版商品的工厂，通常规模较小，技术水平相对较低。
explanation_english: Refers to a factory that produces counterfeit or pirated goods, typically small in scale and with relatively low technological capabilities. It is usually associated with lower quality and cheaper alternatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間山寨廠啲貨真係唔掂，用唔耐就壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 saan1 zaai6 cong2 di1 fo3 zan1 hai6 m4 dim6, yung6 m4 noi6 zau6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家山寨厂的货真是不行，用不了多久就坏。
examples.english_sentence: The products from this knock-off factory are really bad, they break down quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好貪平買山寨廠嘅嘢，質量冇保證㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taam1 peng4 maai5 saan1 zaai6 cong2 ge3 je5, zat1 loeng6 mou5 bou2 zing3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要贪便宜买山寨厂的东西，质量没有保证的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be tempted to buy things from knock-off factories, the quality is not guaranteed.

english_meaning: King of counterfeits; Leader of a mountain stronghold (historical); A leader known for using imitations or knock-offs
explanation_mandarin: 原指占据山寨的首领。现在多用于讽刺那些擅长制造或销售仿冒品的人，表示他们是仿冒品领域的领头羊。也带有贬义，指靠仿冒他人产品而获得利益的人。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the leader of a mountain stronghold (historically, often outlaws). Now, it's mostly used sarcastically to describe someone who is very skilled at producing or selling counterfeit goods, implying they are the leader in the field of imitation. It carries a negative connotation, referring to someone who profits by imitating other people's products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賣嘅嘢全部都係山寨貨，根本就係山寨王嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai6 ge3 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 saan1 zaai6 fo3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 saan1 zaai6 wong4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卖的东西全部都是仿冒品，简直就是仿冒品之王。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he sells is counterfeit; he's practically the king of counterfeits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司靠抄襲人哋嘅設計起家，而家變成咗山寨王，真係諷刺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 kaau3 caau1 sik6 jan4 dei6 ge3 sat3 gai3 hei2 gaa1, ji4 gaa1 bin3 sing4 zo2 saan1 zaai6 wong4, zan1 hai6 fung3 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司靠抄袭别人的设计起家，现在变成了仿冒品之王，真是讽刺。
examples.english_sentence: This company started by copying other people's designs and now it's become the king of counterfeits, it's really ironic.

english_meaning: Cyanide, highly poisonous substance
explanation_mandarin: 指氰化物，一种剧毒物质。 在粤语中，常用来比喻非常糟糕或致命的东西/局面。
explanation_english: Refers to cyanide, a highly poisonous substance. In Cantonese, it is often used metaphorically to describe something extremely bad or disastrous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個計劃簡直係山埃，肯定會失敗㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 gai3 waak6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 saan1 aai1, hang2 ding6 wui5 sat1 baai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的计划简直是氰化物，肯定会失败的。
examples.english_sentence: Your plan is simply cyanide, it's definitely going to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅財政狀況好似山埃噉，隨時都會破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 zing3 zong6 fong3 hou2 ci5 saan1 aai1 gam2, ceoi4 si4 dou1 wui5 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财政状况就像氰化物一样，随时都会破产。
examples.english_sentence: The financial situation of this company is like cyanide; it could go bankrupt anytime.

english_meaning: mountains; ranges of mountains
explanation_mandarin: 指连绵的山岭。多用于书面语。
explanation_english: Refers to a continuous range of mountains. Mostly used in written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鍾意去啲山岳地區探險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zung1 ji3 heoi3 di1 saan1 ngok6 dei6 keoi1 taam3 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们喜欢去山区探险。
examples.english_sentence: They like to go to mountainous regions for adventures.

english_meaning: mountain peak; summit
explanation_mandarin: 山的顶端，尖锐突出的部分。
explanation_english: The pointed summit of a mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成功登上咗個山峯喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 dang1 soeng5 zo2 go3 saan1 fung1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们成功登上山峰了！
examples.english_sentence: We successfully climbed the mountain peak!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遠處嘅山峯睇起嚟好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun5 chu3 ge3 saan1 fung1 tai2 hei2 lai4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 远处山峰看起来很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain peaks in the distance look very beautiful.

english_meaning: mountain peak; summit
explanation_mandarin: 山的尖顶；山顶。
explanation_english: The pointed top of a mountain; the summit or peak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋終於爬上咗山峰嘅頂點啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 paa4 soeng5 zo2 saan1 fung1 ge3 ding2 dim2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们终于爬上了山峰的顶点了！
examples.english_sentence: We finally climbed to the summit of the mountain!

english_meaning: cliff, precipice
explanation_mandarin: 陡峭的山壁；悬崖。
explanation_english: A steep cliff face; a precipice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嘅時候，要小心唔好行到山崖邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 haang4 dou3 saan1 ngaai4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山的时候，要小心不要走到悬崖边。
examples.english_sentence: When hiking, be careful not to walk to the edge of the cliff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺山崖上面睇到好靚嘅風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 saan1 ngaai4 soeng6 min6 tai2 dou2 hou2 leng3 ge3 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在悬崖上面看到了很美的风景。
examples.english_sentence: He saw a very beautiful view from the cliff.

english_meaning: hillock, small hill
explanation_mandarin: 指较小的山丘，比山要矮小。
explanation_english: Refers to a small hill, smaller and lower than a mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺山崗上面睇日落，好靚㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 gong1 soeng6 min6 tai2 jat6 lok6, hou2 leng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在小山丘上看日落，非常漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: We watched the sunset on the hillock, it was very beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個山崗唔高，好容易行上去嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saan1 gong1 m4 gou1, hou2 jung4 ji6 haang4 soeng5 heoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小山丘不高，很容易走上去的。
examples.english_sentence: This hillock isn't high, it's easy to walk up.

english_meaning: landslide, mountain collapse
explanation_mandarin: 指山体突然崩塌，通常由自然因素或人为因素引起。
explanation_english: Refers to the sudden collapse of a mountain, usually caused by natural or human factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連場大雨搞到嗰邊山崩咗，好多屋都浸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 go2 bin1 saan1 bang1 zo2, hou2 do1 uk1 dou1 zam3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连续的大雨导致那边山体滑坡了，很多房子都被淹了。
examples.english_sentence: The continuous heavy rain caused a landslide over there, and many houses were flooded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話俾人揭穿咗，好似山崩咁，所有嘢都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 jan4 kit3 cyun1 zo2, hou2 ci5 saan1 bang1 gam2, so2 jau5 je5 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说谎被人揭穿了，好像山崩一样，什么都没了。
examples.english_sentence: His lies were exposed, it was like a landslide, everything was gone.

english_meaning: mountain range; ridge
explanation_mandarin: 连绵的山峰。
explanation_english: A series of mountains or hills forming a continuous elevated crest for some distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行咗成日，終於越過咗呢條山嶺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 seng4 jat6, zung1 jyu1 jyut6 gwo3 zo2 ni1 tiu4 saan1 ling5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走了一整天，终于越过了这条山岭。
examples.english_sentence: We walked all day and finally crossed this mountain range.

explanation_english: A sudden, violent flood that occurs in mountainous areas, typically caused by heavy rainfall or melting snow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日落咗場大雨，啲新聞話有啲山區地方爆發咗山洪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 lok6 zo2 coeng4 daai6 jyu5, di1 san1 man4 waa6 jau5 di1 saan1 keoi1 dei6 fong1 baau3 faat3 zo2 saan1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天下了场大雨，新闻说有些山区爆发了山洪。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday there was a heavy rain, and the news said that some mountainous areas experienced flash floods.

english_meaning: mountain stream; mountain brook
explanation_mandarin: 山中的小溪，通常指水量较小、比较清澈的溪流。
explanation_english: A small stream or brook in the mountains, usually characterized by clear, shallow water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行山嘅時候，聽到潺潺嘅山澗流水聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6, ting1 dou2 saan4 saan4 ge3 saan1 gaan3 lau4 seoi2 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们爬山的时候，听到了潺潺的山涧流水声。
examples.english_sentence: When we were hiking, we heard the murmuring sound of the mountain stream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天喺山澗度游水好涼爽啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 hai2 saan1 gaan3 dou6 jau4 seoi2 hou2 loeng4 song2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天在山涧里游泳很凉爽啊。
examples.english_sentence: Swimming in the mountain stream is so refreshing in summer!

english_meaning: wildfire, forest fire, bushfire
explanation_mandarin: 发生在山上的火灾。
explanation_english: An uncontrolled fire in a wooded or grassy area; a wildfire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年天氣乾燥，好容易有山火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 tin1 hei3 gon1 cou3, hou2 jung4 ji6 jau5 saan1 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年天气干燥，很容易发生山火的。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is dry this year, it's very easy to have wildfires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府呼籲市民唔好喺郊外生火，以防山火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 fu1 yu6 si5 man4 m4 hou2 hai2 haau1 ngoi6 saang1 fo2, ji5 fong4 saan1 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府呼吁市民不要在郊外生火，以防山火。
examples.english_sentence: The government is urging the public not to light fires in the countryside to prevent wildfires.

english_meaning: delicacies of land and sea; exotic foods
explanation_mandarin: 指山野和海里出产的珍贵食品。形容非常丰盛精美的菜肴。
explanation_english: Refers to rare and precious foods produced in mountains and the sea. Describes a very sumptuous and exquisite meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋食山珍海味，慶祝你生日！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 sik6 saan1 zan1 hoi2 mei6, hing3 zuk1 nei5 saang1 jat6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们吃山珍海味，庆祝你生日！
examples.english_sentence: Today we're eating delicacies of land and sea to celebrate your birthday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳專賣山珍海味，所以價錢都好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zyun1 maai6 saan1 zan1 hoi2 mei6, so2 ji5 gaa3 cin2 dou1 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那家餐厅专门卖山珍海味，所以价格都很贵。
examples.english_sentence: His restaurant specializes in delicacies of land and sea, so the prices are very expensive.

english_meaning: Chinese softshell turtle, turtle (slang for a man with a receding hairline or bald head)
explanation_mandarin: 本指甲鱼或鳖。在香港，也常用来形容头发稀疏或秃头的人。
explanation_english: Literally means a Chinese softshell turtle or turtle. In Hong Kong, it is also commonly used as slang to describe a man with a receding hairline or bald head, likening the shape of the head to the turtle's shell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個頭開始變山瑞喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 tau4 hoi1 chi2 bin3 saan1 seoi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的头开始变成秃头了。
examples.english_sentence: His head is starting to become a turtle (he's getting bald).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫佢山瑞啦，好衰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 saan1 seoi6 laa1, hou2 seoi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫他秃头啦，很不好听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call him 'turtle' (baldy), it's very rude.

english_meaning: solemn pledges of love; vows of eternal love (as high as the mountains and as deep as the sea)
explanation_mandarin: 指男女相爱时立下的誓言，像山和海一样永恒不变。形容爱情的盟约非常庄重、坚固。
explanation_english: Refers to vows made by lovers to be together forever, as eternal and unchanging as mountains and seas. It describes the solemnity and firmness of a love covenant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個山盟海誓，話要永遠喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 saan1 mang4 hoi2 sai6, waa6 jiu3 wing5 jyun5 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个山盟海誓，说要永远在一起。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them made solemn pledges of love, saying they would be together forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁輕易相信人哋嘅山盟海誓，好多時都係得個講字㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji6 seong1 seon3 jan4 dei6 ge3 saan1 mang4 hoi2 sai6, hou2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gong2 zi6 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易相信别人的山盟海誓，很多时候都只是说说而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't easily believe other people's vows of eternal love; many times they are just empty words.

english_meaning: at the end of one's rope; at one's wit's end; in dire straits; a dead end
explanation_mandarin: 比喻陷入绝境，没有任何出路。形容境地非常困难。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one is in dire straits, with no way out; to be at one's wit's end or at a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到山窮水盡，連屋企都賣埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 saan1 kung4 seoi2 zeon6, lin4 uk1 kei2 dou1 mai6 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌到山穷水尽，连房子都卖了。
examples.english_sentence: He gambled until he was at the end of his rope, and even sold his house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋再唔諗辦法，就真係山窮水盡㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 m4 lam2 baan6 faat3, zau6 zan1 hai6 saan1 kung4 seoi2 zeon6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们再不想法子，就真的是山穷水尽了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't come up with a solution, we'll really be at a dead end.

synonyms: 走投無路 (zau2 tau4 mou4 lou6)

english_meaning: cave; hole in a mountain; (slang) a remote or isolated place
explanation_mandarin: 指山上的洞穴。也用来形容偏远、人迹罕至的地方。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a cave or a hole in a mountain. Figuratively, it can describe a remote, isolated, and underdeveloped place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搬咗去個山窿度住，真係好隔涉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun1 zo2 heoi3 go3 saan1 lung1 dou6 zyu6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gaak3 sip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搬去一个偏远的地方住了，真的很偏僻。
examples.english_sentence: He moved to live in a remote place, it's really isolated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日匿喺山窿度啦，出嚟見下人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nik1 hai2 saan1 lung1 dou6 laa1, chut1 lai4 gin3 haa5 yan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是躲在家里，出来见见人吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always hide at home, come out and see people.

english_meaning: Mountain caves and crevices; Remote and obscure places; Every nook and cranny.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常偏僻、人迹罕至的地方，也指所有的角落、缝隙。
explanation_english: Describes very remote and inaccessible places, or refers to every nook and cranny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢匿埋喺啲山窿山罅度，好難搵到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nik1 maai4 hai2 di1 saan1 lung1 saan1 laa3 dou6, hou2 naan4 wan2 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他躲藏在山洞缝隙里，很难找到他。
examples.english_sentence: He is hiding in the mountain caves and crevices, it's very difficult to find him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢唔好擺喺山窿山罅度，擺銀行穩陣啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 chin2 m4 hou2 baai2 hai2 saan1 lung1 saan1 laa3 dou6, baai2 ngan4 hong4 wan2 zan6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱不要放在犄角旮旯里，放在银行稳妥些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put the money in every nook and cranny, it's safer to put it in the bank.

english_meaning: Mangosteen
explanation_mandarin: 一种热带水果，果皮厚而硬，果肉白色，味道酸甜。
explanation_english: A tropical fruit with a thick, hard rind and white, sweet and sour pulp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食山竹喇，又甜又好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 yi3 sik6 saan1 zuk1 laa3, jau6 tim4 jau6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃山竹了，又甜又好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I love eating mangosteen, it's sweet and delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家山竹當造，好抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 saan1 zuk1 dong3 zou6, hou2 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在山竹当季，很划算。
examples.english_sentence: Mangosteen is in season now, it's very good value.

english_meaning: Steamed meatballs with bean curd skin (Dim Sum)
explanation_mandarin: 一种港式点心，将牛肉馅裹在腐皮里蒸制而成，因为外形凹凸不平，像山竹的表面而得名。
explanation_english: A type of Hong Kong dim sum. It consists of steamed meatballs wrapped in bean curd skin. The uneven surface of the meatballs resembles the bumpy surface of a mangosteen, hence the name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲茶嘅時候，我通常都會叫一籠山竹牛肉嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 caa4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 giu3 jat1 lung4 saan1 zuk1 ngau4 juk6 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝茶的时候，我通常都会叫一笼山竹牛肉来吃。
examples.english_sentence: When having dim sum, I usually order a basket of steamed meatballs with bean curd skin to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒樓嘅山竹牛肉做得好入味，好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lau4 ge3 saan1 zuk1 ngau4 juk6 zou6 dak1 hou2 jap6 mei6, hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐馆的山竹牛肉做得非常入味，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The steamed meatballs with bean curd skin at this restaurant are very flavorful and delicious.

english_meaning: goat
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的家畜，以吃草为主。
explanation_english: A common domestic animal that primarily eats grass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 果度有好多山羊喺度食草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo2 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 saan1 joeng4 hai2 dou6 sik6 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有很多山羊在吃草。
examples.english_sentence: There are many goats grazing there.

english_meaning: Capricorn
explanation_mandarin: 黄道十二宫之一，摩羯座。出生于12月22日至1月19日之间的人。
explanation_english: One of the twelve astrological signs in the zodiac, Capricorn. People born between December 22nd and January 19th.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係山羊座嘅，你呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 saan1 joeng4 zo6 ge3, nei5 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是摩羯座的，你呢？
examples.english_sentence: I'm a Capricorn, what about you?

english_meaning: mountain range
explanation_mandarin: 连绵不断的山群。
