examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pro-foreign; local things can be good too.

english_meaning: lofty, sublime, noble
explanation_mandarin: 形容思想、境界、品格等高尚伟大，值得尊敬。
explanation_english: Describes something (like ideals, accomplishments, character) that is lofty, sublime, noble, and deserving of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好崇高，值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 hou2 sung4 gou1, zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很崇高，值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: His actions are very noble and worthy of our learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗國家犧牲，精神非常崇高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 gwok3 gaa1 hei1 saang1, zing1 san4 fei1 soeng4 sung4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了国家牺牲，精神非常崇高。
examples.english_sentence: They sacrificed themselves for the country; their spirit is very noble.

english_meaning: steep; rugged; uneven
explanation_mandarin: 形容地勢或表面不平坦，傾斜度大。
explanation_english: Describes a terrain or surface that is uneven and has a steep slope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路好崎啊，行路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 hou2 kei1 aa3, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很陡峭，走路要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: This road is very steep, be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個山坡好崎嶇，唔容易爬上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saan1 bo1 hou2 kei1 keoi1, m4 jung4 ji6 paa4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个山坡很崎岖，不容易爬上去。
examples.english_sentence: This hillside is very rugged, it's not easy to climb up.

english_meaning: rugged; rough; uneven (of roads, paths, etc.); arduous
explanation_mandarin: 形容山路或道路不平坦，难行。
explanation_english: Describes a path, road, or journey that is rough, uneven, or difficult to traverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條山路好崎嶇，行起嚟都幾辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 saan1 lou6 hou2 kei1 kui1, haang4 hei2 lai4 dou1 gei2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条山路很崎岖，走起来挺辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: This mountain path is very rugged; it's quite tiring to walk on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋經歷咗一段崎嶇嘅路先至成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging1 lik6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 kei1 kui1 ge3 lou6 sin1 zi3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经历了一段崎岖的道路才成功。
examples.english_sentence: They went through a rough patch before they succeeded.

english_meaning: foolish, silly, stupid
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，不明事理。
explanation_english: Describes a person as foolish, silly, or stupid; lacking understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁崑，邊個信你呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 kwan1, bin1 go3 seon3 nei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的话这么傻，谁会相信你啊？
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is so foolish, who would believe you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁崑啦，咁明顯嘅嘢都睇唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 kwan1 laa1, gam3 ming4 hin2 ge3 je5 dou1 tai2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么傻啦，这么明显的东西都看不出来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you can't even see something so obvious.

english_meaning: Kunqu Opera
explanation_mandarin: 中国传统戏曲剧种之一，又称昆剧、昆腔，是中国最古老的剧种之一，被誉为“百戏之祖”。
explanation_english: Kunqu Opera, also known as Kun Opera or Kunqiang, is one of the oldest forms of traditional Chinese opera. It is considered the "mother of all Chinese operas".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時阿嫲好鍾意睇崑曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 aa3 maa4 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 kwan1 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候奶奶很喜欢看昆曲。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my grandma really liked to watch Kunqu Opera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家後生仔好少會睇崑曲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 siu2 wui5 tai2 kwan1 kuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人很少会看昆曲了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people rarely watch Kunqu Opera.

english_meaning: to urge; to press; to hurry; to expedite
explanation_mandarin: 催促，加速进行。
explanation_english: To urge someone to do something; to press someone to hurry up or to expedite a process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再崔我啦，我盡量快啲搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceoi1 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zeon6 loeng4 faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再催我了，我会尽量快点搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't urge me anymore, I'll try my best to get it done quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日崔我結婚，好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 ceoi1 ngo5 git3 fan1, hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是催我结婚，很烦。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always urges me to get married, it's annoying.

english_meaning: cliff; precipice
explanation_mandarin: 指陡峭的山壁或悬崖。
explanation_english: A steep cliff or precipice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嗰陣要小心啲，唔好行咁埋崖邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai5 ngaai4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山的时候要小心点，不要走那么靠近悬崖边。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when hiking, don't walk so close to the edge of the cliff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條崖度跳咗落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 ngaai4 dou6 tiu3 zo2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从悬崖上跳了下去。
examples.english_sentence: He jumped off the cliff.

english_meaning: dependent on others, sponger, parasite, freeloader
explanation_mandarin: 指依靠别人生活的人，通常是指依靠伴侣提供经济支持的人，贬义词。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who depends on others for a living, usually referring to someone who relies on their partner for financial support. It's a derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗個崖鷹，靠老婆養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 go3 ngaai4 ying1, kaau3 lou5 po4 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当了个靠老婆养的。
examples.english_sentence: He became a freeloader at such a young age, relying on his wife to support him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做崖鷹啦，自己搵份工做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 ngaai4 ying1 laa1, zi6 gei2 wan2 fan6 gung1 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要当靠别人的人了，自己找份工作做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a sponger, go find a job and work.

english_meaning: post; station; job; position
explanation_mandarin: 指职位，通常指需要值守的职位。
explanation_english: Refers to a position, often one that requires duty or guarding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工要做埋夜崗，幾辛苦㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 jiu3 zou6 maai4 je6 gong1, gei2 san1 fu2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作还要上夜班，很辛苦的！
examples.english_sentence: His job also requires him to work the night shift, it's very tiring!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日返咩崗啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 faan1 me1 gong1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天上什么班啊？/你今天站什么岗啊？
examples.english_sentence: What post are you working today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要堅守崗位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 sau2 gong1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要坚守岗位。
examples.english_sentence: We must stand fast at our posts.

english_meaning: post; job; position
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或职务的职位。
explanation_english: A post, job, or position of work or duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職，去咗一個新嘅崗位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1, heoi3 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 gong1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，去了一个新的岗位。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted and took a new position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要招聘更多人手去填補呢啲崗位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 ziu1 ping3 gang3 do1 jan4 sau2 heoi3 tin4 bou2 ni1 di1 gong1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要招聘更多人手去填补这些岗位。
examples.english_sentence: We need to recruit more staff to fill these positions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個崗位都有佢嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 gong1 wai2 dou1 jau5 keoi5 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个岗位都有它的责任。
examples.english_sentence: Every position has its responsibilities.

english_meaning: Rose myrtle; downy rose myrtle
explanation_mandarin: 一种生长在山坡上的灌木，果实可以食用，根和叶有药用价值。
explanation_english: A shrub growing on hillsides; its fruit is edible and its roots and leaves have medicinal value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣成日上山摘崗棯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 soeng5 saan1 zaak6 gong1 nim2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常上山摘山稔吃。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went up the mountain to pick rose myrtle to eat.

english_meaning: to deceive; to cheat; to trick; to fool
explanation_mandarin: 指通过虚假的信息或承诺，使他人相信并做出对自己有利的行为。
explanation_english: To deceive or trick someone by giving false information or promises, so that they believe and act in a way that benefits you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好想崙我喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 soeng2 leon4 ngo5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想骗我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about deceiving me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度崙人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 leon4 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是到处骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He is always cheating people everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢係鍾意崙人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 hai6 zung1 ji3 leon4 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他说的话，他喜欢骗人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he likes to deceive people.

mandarin_meaning: 冒出; 突出; 暴发; 发迹
english_meaning: to suddenly emerge; to spring up; to rise abruptly; to become prominent quickly; to burst forth (of power, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指突然冒出、兴起、发迹等。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden emergence, rise, or sudden prominence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排好似發咗達咁，忽然間崛咗起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai2 hou2 ci5 faat3 zo2 daat6 gam2, fat1 jin4 gaan1 gwat1 zo2 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近好像发财了，突然间就发达起来了。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have become rich recently; he has suddenly risen to prominence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅業績好快就崛咗起，成為咗行內嘅領導者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 yip6 jik1 hou2 faai3 zau6 gwat1 zo2 hei2, sing4 wai4 zo2 hang4 noi6 ge3 ling5 dou6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的业绩很快就突飞猛进，成为了行业内的领导者。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance quickly surged and became a leader in the industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新人好快就崛頭，好多人都睇好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 jan4 hou2 faai3 zau6 gwat1 tau4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 tai2 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新人很快就崭露头角，很多人都看好他。
examples.english_sentence: This newcomer quickly stood out, and many people are optimistic about him.

english_meaning: to rise abruptly; to spring up; to emerge suddenly; to become prominent
explanation_mandarin: 指事物突然兴起并变得强大。
explanation_english: Refers to something suddenly rising up and becoming powerful; to suddenly become prominent or influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中國經濟近年崛起得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 gwok3 ging1 zai3 gan6 nin4 kyut6 gat1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中国经济近年来崛起得很快。
examples.english_sentence: China's economy has risen very quickly in recent years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間初創公司崛起得好犀利，好快就成為行業嘅領頭羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 co1 chong3 gung1 si1 kyut6 gat1 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing4 wai4 hang4 yip6 ge3 ling5 tau4 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家初创公司崛起得非常厉害，很快就成为行业的领头羊。
examples.english_sentence: This startup company rose very sharply and quickly became a leader in the industry.

english_meaning: Lofty; towering; outstanding; extraordinary
explanation_mandarin: 形容山勢高峻；也形容人不平凡，有氣概。
explanation_english: Describes the towering and imposing appearance of a mountain. Also describes a person as outstanding and possessing great spirit or ambition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得幾崢嘅，望落好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 sang1 dak1 gei2 zaang1 ge3, mong6 lok6 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长得挺不凡的，看上去很有气势。
examples.english_sentence: He has a quite striking appearance, looking very imposing.

english_meaning: Relaxed, at ease, comfortable (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情放松，感觉舒服，无拘无束的状态。通常用于描述心情或状态，也可以指一种感觉或氛围。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being relaxed, comfortable, and carefree. Usually used to describe a mood or state, but can also refer to a feeling or atmosphere. It is a slang term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後返到屋企，沖個涼，真係好崧啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, cung1 go3 loeng4, zan1 hai6 hou2 sung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班回家之后，冲个澡，真舒服啊！
examples.english_sentence: After work, going home and taking a shower, it's so relaxing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽住輕音樂，嘆住咖啡，成個人都鬆晒，好崧呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 zyu6 hing1 jam1 ngok6, taan3 zyu6 gaa3 fe1, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 sung1 saai3, hou2 sung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听着轻音乐，喝着咖啡，整个人都放松了，好舒服呀！
examples.english_sentence: Listening to light music and enjoying coffee, my whole body is relaxed, it's so comfortable!

english_meaning: to collapse, to break down, to fall apart, to chip, to lose
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指事物崩塌，损坏。2. 指心情崩溃，精神状态不好。3. 指钱财损失。4. 指物体表面出现缺口。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to something collapsing, breaking down, or being damaged. 2. Refers to emotional breakdown or a poor mental state. 3. Refers to financial loss. 4. Refers to a chip or a missing piece on the surface of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日炒股票炒到崩潰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 caau2 gu2 piu3 caau2 dou3 bang1 kui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天炒股炒到崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost so much money speculating on stocks yesterday that he had a breakdown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻碗崩咗一忽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 wun2 bang1 zo2 jat1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的碗缺了一块。
examples.english_sentence: My bowl has a chip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好易崩潰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 ji6 bang1 kui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很容易崩溃。
examples.english_sentence: He's the type of person who easily breaks down.

english_meaning: idiot, fool, moron
explanation_mandarin: 指愚笨、傻气的人，带有贬义。多用于口语，语气较轻蔑。
explanation_english: Refers to a foolish, silly, or stupid person. It's a derogatory term, mostly used in spoken Cantonese with a slightly contemptuous tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜咁蠢呀？你係咪崩仔嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 gam3 ceon2 aa3? nei5 hai6 mai1 bang1 zai2 lai4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么笨啊？你是傻瓜吗？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so stupid? Are you an idiot?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣對人講嘢，話人係崩仔好無禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 jan4 gong2 je5, waa6 jan4 hai6 bang1 zai2 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样对人说话，说别人是傻瓜很没有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk to people like that. It's impolite to call someone an idiot.

english_meaning: chipped (e.g., a cup or bowl); notched
explanation_mandarin: 指物体边缘或表面出现破损，形成缺口。
explanation_english: Refers to a small break or chip on the edge or surface of an object, creating a notch or gap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻碗崩口，唔好用喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 wun2 bang1 hau2, m4 hou2 yung6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个碗有个缺口，别用了。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl is chipped, don't use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把刀崩口崩得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 dou1 bang1 hau2 bang1 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的刀缺口缺得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: His knife is chipped very badly.

jyutping: bang1 hau2 jan4 gei6 bang1 hau2 wun2
mandarin_meaning: 有缺陷的人忌讳看到有缺陷的事物； 自己有短处，就忌讳别人谈论同样的短处。
english_meaning: A person with a chipped tooth dislikes seeing a chipped bowl; People are sensitive about their own flaws and don't want to be reminded of them.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是缺口的人忌讳看到缺口的碗。比喻自己有缺点或短处，就特别忌讳别人提起类似的缺点或短处，怕被触及痛处。
explanation_english: Literally, it means a person with a chipped tooth dislikes seeing a chipped bowl. It's a metaphor for people being sensitive about their own flaws and not wanting others to mention similar flaws for fear of being reminded of their own weaknesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人最怕人哋講佢矮，真係崩口人忌崩口碗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zeoi3 paa3 jan4 dei6 gong2 keoi5 ai2, zan1 hai6 bang1 hau2 jan4 gei6 bang1 hau2 wun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人最怕别人说他矮，真是自己有短处，就忌讳别人说。
examples.english_sentence: He is most afraid of people saying he is short; it's truly a case of a person with a chipped tooth disliking seeing a chipped bowl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明成日唔交功課，你又喺度提，咪就係崩口人忌崩口碗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 sing4 jat6 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, nei5 jau6 hai2 dou6 tai4, mai6 zau6 hai6 bang1 hau2 jan4 gei6 bang1 hau2 wun2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明总是不做作业，你又在这里提，不就是自己有短处就忌讳别人说吗？
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming never hands in his homework, and you're mentioning it again; isn't that a case of a person with a chipped tooth disliking seeing a chipped bowl?

jyutping: bang1 zeoi2 caa4 wu2 – naan4 zam1
mandarin_meaning: 缺口茶壶——不好倒水; 不好辦事的人
english_meaning: A chipped teapot - difficult to pour; (figurative) someone difficult to deal with or work with.
explanation_mandarin: 崩嘴的茶壺很難倒水，容易灑出來。比喻一個人難以相處，做事很難順利完成，或者很難滿足別人的要求。
explanation_english: A chipped teapot is difficult to pour from, as the water is likely to spill. This idiom is used metaphorically to describe someone who is difficult to get along with, whose actions are hard to accomplish smoothly, or who is hard to satisfy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人崩嘴茶壺咁，乜嘢都唔肯合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 bang1 zeoi2 caa4 wu2 gam3, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那个人像个缺口茶壶一样，什么都不肯合作。
examples.english_sentence: That person is like a chipped teapot, unwilling to cooperate in anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同佢做嘢真係崩嘴茶壺，搞到我好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 keoi5 zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 bang1 zeoi2 caa4 wu2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 和他一起工作真是像个缺口茶壶，搞得我很头疼。
examples.english_sentence: Working with him is really like dealing with a chipped teapot, it gives me a headache.

english_meaning: to breach a dam; to collapse (figuratively, like a dam bursting); to lose control
explanation_mandarin: 原指水坝崩塌。引申为控制不住局面，或情绪爆发。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to a dam collapsing. Figuratively, it means losing control of a situation or having an emotional outburst, like a dam bursting under pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忍唔住啲眼淚，好似崩堤咁流晒出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 di1 ngaan5 leoi6, hou2 ci5 bang1 dai1 gam2 lau4 saai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忍不住眼泪，好像决堤一样都流了出来。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't hold back his tears, they flowed out like a dam had burst.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔盡快處理件事，成件事就好似崩堤咁，失控㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 zeon6 faai3 cyu2 lei5 gin6 si6, sing4 gin6 si6 zau6 hou2 ci5 bang1 dai1 gam2, sat1 hung3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不能尽快处理这件事，整个事情就像决堤一样，会失控的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't deal with this matter quickly, the whole thing will be like a dam bursting and will get out of control.

english_meaning: collapse, crumble, fall apart (literally or figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指物体倒塌或崩裂；也比喻事物瓦解、崩溃。
explanation_english: Refers to the collapse or crumbling of an object; also used metaphorically to describe the disintegration or breakdown of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 棟舊樓年久失修，好易會崩塌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 gau6 lau2 nin4 gau2 sat1 sau1, hou2 ji6 wui5 bang1 taap3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那栋旧楼年久失修，很容易会倒塌的。
examples.english_sentence: That old building hasn't been maintained for a long time, it's very likely to collapse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢公司破產之後，佢嘅精神支柱就崩塌咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 gung1 si1 po3 caan2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 zing1 san4 zi1 cyu5 zau6 bang1 taap3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他公司破产之后，他的精神支柱就崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: Since his company went bankrupt, the pillar of his spirit collapsed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 座山因為連日暴雨而崩塌咗一部分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 saan1 jan1 wai6 lin4 jat6 bou6 jyu5 ji4 bang1 taap3 zo2 jat1 bu6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座山因为连日暴雨而塌了一部分。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain collapsed in part due to days of heavy rain.

english_meaning: to collapse, to crumble, to break down, to deteriorate (in quality or condition), to become dysfunctional
explanation_mandarin: 指事物由良好状态变得破败、损坏、功能失常，通常带有负面含义。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of collapse, deterioration, or dysfunctionality from a previously better state. Usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從間工廠執咗笠之後，佢個人就崩壞曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gaan1 gung1 cong2 zap1 zo2 lap1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 go3 jan4 zau6 bang1 waai6 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从那家工厂倒闭后，他整个人就崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: Since that factory closed down, he's completely broken down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅劇情崩壞得好緊要，完全唔好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 bang1 waai6 dak1 hou2 gan2 jiu3, jyun4 cyun4 m4 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情崩坏得很严重，完全不好看。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie has deteriorated so badly that it's unwatchable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦用咗咁耐，開始有啲崩壞嘅跡象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 yung6 zo2 gam3 noi6, hoi1 ci2 jau5 di1 bang1 waai6 ge3 zik1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑用了这么久，开始有一些损坏的迹象。
examples.english_sentence: This computer has been used for so long, it's starting to show signs of deterioration.

english_meaning: Asiatic Pennywort, Gotu Kola (Centella asiatica)
explanation_mandarin: 一种草本植物，学名积雪草，也称雷公根，在中医药中被认为具有清热解毒、利湿消肿的功效。
explanation_english: A herbaceous plant, scientifically known as Centella asiatica, also called Gotu Kola or Asiatic Pennywort. In Traditional Chinese Medicine, it is believed to have properties that clear heat and toxins, promote diuresis, and reduce swelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日話飲崩大碗涼茶可以清熱解毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 waa6 jam2 bang1 daai6 wun2 loeng4 caa4 ho2 ji5 cing1 jit6 gaai2 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是说喝雷公根凉茶可以清热解毒。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always says that drinking Asiatic Pennywort herbal tea can clear heat and toxins.

mandarin_meaning: 形容人很土气、没见过世面
english_meaning: unsophisticated, countrified, rustic, hick
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人穿着打扮或行为举止很土气，没有见过世面，不时尚。也指来自农村或乡下，不熟悉城市生活。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is unsophisticated, countrified, or rustic in their appearance, behavior, or manners. It can also refer to someone from a rural area who is unfamiliar with city life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著啲老土衫，真係好崩沙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 lou5 tou2 saam1, zan1 hai6 hou2 bang1 saa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿一些老土的衣服，真的很土气。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears old-fashioned clothes, he's really unsophisticated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋崩沙啦，每個人都有唔同嘅生活方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 bang1 saa1 laa1, mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 sang1 wut6 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人土气啦，每个人都有不同的生活方式。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people countrified, everyone has a different way of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鄉下嚟嘅，對好多嘢都唔係咁熟，唔好覺得佢崩沙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng1 haa6 lei4 ge3, deoi3 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 hai6 gam2 suk6, m4 hou2 gok3 dak1 keoi5 bang1 saa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是从乡下来的，对很多东西都不太熟悉，不要觉得他土气。
examples.english_sentence: He's from the countryside, and not familiar with many things, don't think he's unsophisticated.

english_meaning: Brisket point (a cut of beef brisket)
explanation_mandarin: 崩沙腩是牛腩的一种，位于牛腩的顶部，肉质比较松软，脂肪分布均匀，口感丰富。适合炖煮或卤制。
explanation_english: Brisket point is a specific cut of beef brisket, located at the top portion. It is known for its tender texture, even fat distribution, and rich flavor. It's well-suited for braising or stewing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買斤崩沙腩返屋企炆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gan1 bang1 saa1 naam5 faan1 uk1 kei2 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一斤崩沙腩回家炖。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a pound of brisket point to braise at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅清湯腩河啲崩沙腩炆得好入味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 cing1 tong1 naam5 ho2 di1 bang1 saa1 naam5 man1 dak1 hou2 jap6 mei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的清汤牛腩河粉的崩沙腩炖得很入味。
examples.english_sentence: The brisket point in the clear broth beef brisket rice noodles at this restaurant is very flavorful from the braising.

english_meaning: collapse; crumble; break down (mentally or emotionally)
explanation_mandarin: 形容精神或情绪方面完全崩溃、瓦解的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of complete mental or emotional collapse or breakdown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考得唔好，崩潰咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, bang1 kui2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考得不好，崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well on the exam, and he broke down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲壓力大到我差啲崩潰呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 aat3 lik6 daai6 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 bang1 kui2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 压力大得我差点崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: The pressure is so great that I almost collapsed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多問題，佢個人都崩潰曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 man6 tai4, keoi5 go3 jan4 dou1 bang1 kui2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多问题，他整个人都崩溃了。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with so many problems, he completely broke down.

english_meaning: chipped tooth; missing tooth
explanation_mandarin: 指牙齿缺损或脱落。
explanation_english: Refers to a chipped, broken, or missing tooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時成日跌親，搞到依家有隻崩牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 seng4 jat6 dit3 can1, gaau2 dou3 ji1 gaa1 jau5 zek3 bang1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常摔倒，导致现在有一颗缺牙。
examples.english_sentence: He used to fall a lot when he was little, resulting in a chipped tooth now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好笑人哋崩牙，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 siu3 jan4 dei6 bang1 ngaa4, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嘲笑别人缺牙，很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at someone for having a missing tooth, it's very rude.

english_meaning: collapse; crash; plummet
explanation_mandarin: 指价格或价值突然大幅度下跌，通常用于股市、楼市等金融市场。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden and drastic drop in price or value, often used in the context of financial markets like the stock market or real estate market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市尋日崩盤，好多人輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 cam4 jat6 bang1 pun4, hou2 do1 jan4 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市昨天崩盘了，很多人都输光了钱。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crashed yesterday, and many people lost all their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果樓市崩盤，香港經濟都會受到影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 lau4 si5 bang1 pun4, hoeng1 gong2 ging1 zai3 dou1 wui5 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果楼市崩盘，香港经济也会受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: If the housing market collapses, Hong Kong's economy will also be affected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 專家預計今年個加密貨幣市場可能會崩盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun1 gaa1 jyu6 gai3 gam1 nin4 go3 gaa1 mat6 fo3 pui3 si5 cheung4 ho2 nang4 wui5 bang1 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 专家预计今年加密货币市场可能会崩盘。
examples.english_sentence: Experts predict that the cryptocurrency market may collapse this year.

english_meaning: Shortbread cookie, biscuit
explanation_mandarin: 一种酥松的饼干，通常以牛油和面粉制成。
explanation_english: A type of crumbly and buttery cookie, often made with butter and flour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭嘅崩砂好好食呀，又鬆又脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 bang1 saa1 hou2 hou2 sik6 aa3, jau6 sung1 jau6 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的曲奇饼很好吃，又松又脆。
examples.english_sentence: The shortbread cookies at this shop are delicious, so crumbly and crispy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候，阿嫲成日整崩砂俾我食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, aa3 maa4 seng4 jat6 zing2 bang1 saa1 bei2 ngo5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，奶奶经常做曲奇饼给我吃。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, my grandma often made shortbread cookies for me.

mandarin_meaning: 赘肉；肥肉；肚子上的肥肉
english_meaning: Spare tire; love handles; belly fat; flabby stomach
explanation_mandarin: 指腹部堆积的肥肉，通常指男性腹部两侧或前面的赘肉。
explanation_english: Refers to the accumulated fat around the abdomen, typically referring to the excess fat on the sides or front of a man's stomach. Often implies a lack of physical fitness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日坐喺度，都冇做運動，依家都生咗個崩砂腩出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 dou6, dou1 mou5 zou6 wan6 dung6, ji1 gaa1 dou1 sang1 zo2 go3 bang1 saa1 naam5 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天坐着，也不运动，现在都长出个赘肉出来了。
examples.english_sentence: He sits all day and doesn't exercise, now he's grown a spare tire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好食咁多啦，小心食到有崩砂腩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sik6 gam3 do1 laa1, siu2 sam1 sik6 dou3 jau5 bang1 saa1 naam5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别吃那么多啦，小心吃到有肚子上的肥肉呀！
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so much, or you'll end up with a spare tire!

mandarin_meaning: 出糗; 丢脸; 露馅
english_meaning: To make a fool of oneself; to embarrass oneself; to be exposed (a secret or lie)
explanation_mandarin: 指做了出丑的事情，或者原本想要隐藏的事情被揭露出来。
explanation_english: Refers to making a fool of oneself or having something you wanted to hide being exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上唱歌唱到走音，真係崩紗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dou3 zau2 jam1, zan1 hai6 bang1 saa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上唱歌走音，真丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: He sang out of tune on stage, it was really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事俾佢哋爆出嚟，我咪崩曬紗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 bei2 keoi5 dei6 baau3 ceot1 lai4, ngo5 mai1 bang1 saai3 saa1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事被他们爆出来了，我不是出丑了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Now that they've revealed the matter, I'm going to be embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講咁多啦，再講落去我就崩紗㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 gam3 do1 laa1, zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3 ngo5 zau6 bang1 saa1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别说那么多了，再说下去我就要出糗了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say so much, if you keep talking I'm going to make a fool of myself.

english_meaning: Hard of hearing; deaf (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 形容听力不好，听不清楚，比较口语化的说法。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has difficulty hearing, or is hard of hearing. It is an informal term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆開始有啲崩耳，講嘢要大聲啲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hoi1 chi2 jau5 di1 bang1 ji5, gong2 je5 jiu3 daai6 seng1 di1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶开始有点耳背，说话要大声点才行。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is starting to get hard of hearing, you need to speak louder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日戴住耳機聽歌，唔怪得咁快就崩耳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 ji5 gei1 teng1 go1, m4 gwaai3 dak1 gam3 faai3 zau6 bang1 ji5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天戴着耳机听歌，难怪这么快就耳背了。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears headphones to listen to music, no wonder he's gone deaf so quickly.

english_meaning: To injure one's forehead; to have bad luck; to fail
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是撞伤额头。引申为遇到倒霉事，遭受打击，或者事情失败。
explanation_english: Literally means to injure one's forehead. Figuratively, it refers to having bad luck, experiencing a setback, or failing at something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波嗰陣唔小心崩咗頭，流晒血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 m4 siu2 sam1 bang1 zo2 tau4, lau4 saai3 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球的时候不小心撞破了头，流了很多血。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally injured his forehead while playing football and bled a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我崩頭喇，咩都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 bang1 tau4 laa3, me1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考砸了，什么都不会。
examples.english_sentence: I failed this exam; I didn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司投資失利，搞到老細崩頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 tau4 zi1 sat1 lei6, gaau2 dou3 lou5 sai3 bang1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司投资失败，搞得老板很倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: The company's investment failed, causing the boss to have bad luck.

english_meaning: Small hill; Name of a mountain
explanation_mandarin: 指小山或山峰，也用作山名。
explanation_english: Refers to a small hill or mountain peak. Also used as a name of a mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度有座崳山，唔算高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 jau5 zo6 jyu4 saan1, m4 syun3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有一座小山，不算高。
examples.english_sentence: There is a small hill there, not very high.

english_meaning: son, child (often used pejoratively)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指儿子或孩子，但在粤语中，常带有一种轻蔑或不屑的语气。
explanation_english: Typically refers to a son or child. However, in Cantonese, it often carries a contemptuous or disdainful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條死崽，咁唔聽話！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 sei2 zai2, gam3 m4 ting1 waa6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个死小子，这么不听话！
examples.english_sentence: You little rascal, so disobedient!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話佢個崽幾叻，其實都係咁咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 go3 zai2 gei2 lek1, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 gam2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说他的儿子有多厉害，其实也就那样。
examples.english_sentence: He always says his son is so talented, but he's really just so-so.

english_meaning: to embed, to inlay, to set (in), to be stuck, to be caught
explanation_mandarin: 将一个物体牢固地放入另一个物体中，使二者结合在一起。也指陷入，卡住。
explanation_english: To fix or insert something firmly into something else; to embed, inlay, or set. It can also mean to be stuck or caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 粒石仔嵌咗喺我對鞋底度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lap1 sek6 zai2 haam3 zo2 hai2 ngo5 deoi3 haai4 dai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一块小石头卡在我的鞋底了。
examples.english_sentence: A small stone is stuck in the sole of my shoe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢粒鑽石要嵌喺隻戒指度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 lap1 zyun3 sek6 jiu3 haam3 hai2 zek3 gaai3 zi2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这颗钻石要镶嵌在这枚戒指上。
examples.english_sentence: This diamond needs to be set into this ring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅車嵌咗喺條坑渠度，郁都郁唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ce1 haam3 zo2 hai2 tiu4 hang1 keoi5 dou6, juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的车卡在下水道里，动都动不了。
examples.english_sentence: His car is stuck in the drain and can't move.

english_meaning: mountain mist, haze
explanation_mandarin: 指山间的雾气。
explanation_english: Refers to the mist or haze found in the mountains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上嘅嵐好大，睇唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng6 ge3 laam4 hou2 daai6, tai2 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上的雾气很大，看不见东西。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain mist is so thick, I can't see anything.

english_meaning: to stack up; to pile up
explanation_mandarin: 指将东西堆积起来，通常指叠放整齐或数量多。
explanation_english: Refers to stacking things up, usually neatly or in large quantities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲書嵩埋一邊先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 syu1 sung1 maai4 jat1 bin1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把那些书堆在一边。
examples.english_sentence: Stack those books aside first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲衫嵩到好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 saam1 sung1 dou3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把衣服叠得很高。
examples.english_sentence: He stacked the clothes very high.

english_meaning: To exaggerate; to boast; to talk big; to bluff
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话夸大不实，吹牛皮。
explanation_english: Describes someone who exaggerates or boasts; to brag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度嵩山，話自己幾咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 sung1 saan1, waa6 zi6 gei2 geoi3 gam2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里吹牛，说自己多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's always boasting here, saying how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再嵩山喇，冇人信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 sung1 saan1 laa3, mou5 jan4 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再吹牛了，没人相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop exaggerating, no one believes you.

english_meaning: screen; barrier; mountain peak
explanation_mandarin: 指高耸的山峰，或像屏障一样阻挡视线的山体。
explanation_english: Refers to high mountain peaks, or a mountain range that blocks the view like a screen or barrier. Often used in geographical descriptions or literature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雲遮住咗啲嶂，乜都睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wan4 ze1 zyu6 zo2 di1 zoeng3, mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 云把山峰遮住了，什么都看不到了。
examples.english_sentence: The clouds are blocking the mountain peaks, so you can't see anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行到上山頂，可以睇到連綿嘅山嶂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 dou3 soeng5 saan1 deng2, ho2 ji5 tai2 dou2 lin4 min4 ge3 saan1 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走到山顶，可以看到连绵的山峰。
examples.english_sentence: When you get to the top of the mountain, you can see the continuous mountain peaks.

english_meaning: brand new, fresh, start anew
explanation_mandarin: 全新的，刚开始的。 常与“新”字连用，表示“崭新”。
explanation_english: Brand new, newly started. Often used with the word "新 (san1)" to mean "brand new."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗部嶄新嘅電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 bou6 zaam2 san1 ge3 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了一台崭新的电脑。
examples.english_sentence: He changed to a brand new computer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新一年，我哋要有一個嶄新嘅開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jat1 nin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jau5 jat1 go3 zaam2 san1 ge3 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的一年，我们要有一个崭新的开始。
examples.english_sentence: In the new year, we need to have a fresh start.

english_meaning: brand new; completely new; fresh
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物是全新的，没有使用过的。
explanation_english: Describes something that is brand new and unused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司裝修完之後，好似變咗間嶄新嘅公司咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zong1 sau1 jyun4 zi1 hau6, hou2 ci5 bin3 zo2 gaan1 zaam2 san1 ge3 gung1 si1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司装修完之后，好像变成了一家全新的公司一样。
examples.english_sentence: After the renovation, this company looks like a brand new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部嶄新嘅電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 zaam2 san1 ge3 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一部全新的电话。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a brand new phone.

english_meaning: to show one's talent; to stand out; to distinguish oneself; to come to the fore
explanation_mandarin: 比喻初步显露出才能或锋芒。
explanation_english: A metaphor for initially revealing one's talent or outstanding qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個比賽度嶄露頭角，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 bei2 coi3 dou6 zaam2 lou6 tau4 gok3, lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中崭露头角，获得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He distinguished himself in the competition and won the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾年嘅努力，佢終於喺公司裡面嶄露頭角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 ge3 nu5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 hai2 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6 zaam2 lou6 tau4 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几年的努力，他终于在公司里崭露头角。
examples.english_sentence: After several years of hard work, he finally stood out in the company.

synonyms: 鋒芒畢露 (fung1 mong4 bat1 lou6)

english_meaning: rugged; rough; uneven (of a road or path)
explanation_mandarin: 形容道路或地面不平坦。
explanation_english: Describes a road or ground that is not flat or even.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條山路好嶇啊，行到我腳都痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 saan1 lou6 hou2 keoi1 aa3, haang4 dou3 ngo5 goek3 dou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条山路很崎岖啊，走到我的脚都疼了。
examples.english_sentence: This mountain road is so rugged; walking it makes my feet ache.

english_meaning: protruding; jagged; craggy
explanation_mandarin: 形容山石等突兀不平的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the appearance of mountains and rocks that are jagged, uneven, and protruding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲石好嶙峋啊，行路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sek6 hou2 leon4 seon1 aa3, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些石头很嶙峋啊，走路要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The rocks are very jagged, be careful when walking.

english_meaning: towering; prominent; distinguished
explanation_mandarin: 多形容山勢高峻或事業成就顯赫。
explanation_english: Often used to describe towering mountains or distinguished career achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅事業發展得好威猛，好嶸㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 si6 jip6 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 wai1 maang5, hou2 wing4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的事业发展得非常出色，很辉煌！
examples.english_sentence: Their careers have developed very well, they are very distinguished!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座山好嶸，好壯觀啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 saan1 hou2 wing4, hou2 zong3 gun1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座山很高耸，非常壮观！
examples.english_sentence: This mountain is very towering, very magnificent!

english_meaning: mountain ridge; mountain range; mountain
explanation_mandarin: 指连绵的山峰或山脉。
explanation_english: Refers to a continuous range of mountains or mountain peaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個山嶺好高，爬上去都幾辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saan1 ling5 hou2 gou1, paa4 seung5 heoi3 dou1 gei2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座山岭很高，爬上去很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: This mountain ridge is very high, it's quite tiring to climb it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港四面環山，有好多山嶺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 sei3 min6 waan4 saan1, jau5 hou2 do1 saan1 ling5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港四面环山，有很多山岭。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is surrounded by mountains on all sides and has many mountain ridges.

english_meaning: Lingnan (region in South China)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国南方五岭以南的地区，主要包括广东、广西及海南等地。也常用于指代广州及其周边地区。
explanation_english: Refers to the region south of the Five Ridges (Nan Ling) in Southern China, primarily including Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan provinces. It is often used to refer to Guangzhou and its surrounding areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嶺南文化歷史悠久，充滿特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling5 naam4 man4 faa3 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2, cung1 mun5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 岭南文化历史悠久，充满特色。
examples.english_sentence: Lingnan culture has a long history and is full of characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想去嶺南玩幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 heoi3 ling5 naam4 waan2 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想去岭南玩几天。
examples.english_sentence: They want to go to Lingnan for a few days.

english_meaning: Lingnan University
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一所公立博雅大学。
explanation_english: A public liberal arts university in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥喺嶺南大學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 hai2 ling5 naam4 daai6 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥在岭南大学读书。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother is studying at Lingnan University.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得嶺南大學嘅環境點樣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 ling5 naam4 daai6 hok6 ge3 waan4 ging2 dim2 joeng2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得岭南大学的环境怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: What do you think of the environment at Lingnan University?

english_meaning: Lingnan School of Painting
explanation_mandarin: 岭南画派，是中国近现代绘画流派之一，是岭南文化的重要代表。它融合了中国传统绘画、日本绘画和西方绘画的技法，形成了独特的风格，强调写实和创新。
explanation_english: The Lingnan School of Painting is a style of Chinese painting that originated in the Guangdong region of southern China in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It is known for its fusion of traditional Chinese painting techniques with Japanese and Western influences, emphasizing realism and innovation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅作品好有嶺南畫派嘅風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zok3 ban2 hou2 jau5 ling5 naam4 waa2 paai3 ge3 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作品很有岭南画派的风格。
examples.english_sentence: His works have a strong Lingnan School of Painting style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意欣賞嶺南畫派嘅畫，因為佢哋啲顏色好鮮艷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 jan1 seung2 ling5 naam4 waa2 paai3 ge3 waa2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 di1 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 sin1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢欣赏岭南画派的画，因为它们的颜色非常鲜艳。
examples.english_sentence: I really enjoy appreciating Lingnan School of Painting because their colors are very vibrant.

english_meaning: Lingnan University
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一所公立大学，全称是岭南大学。
explanation_english: A public liberal arts university in Hong Kong, officially known as Lingnan University.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個表妹喺嶺大讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 biu2 mui1 hai2 ling5 daai6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的表妹在岭南大学读书。
examples.english_sentence: My cousin is studying at Lingnan University.

english_meaning: islet, small island
explanation_mandarin: 小岛。
explanation_english: A small island; islet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多大大小小嘅島嶼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 daai6 siu2 siu2 ge3 dou2 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多大大小小的岛屿。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many islands of all sizes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個嶼仔好細，上面乜嘢都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zeoi6 zai2 hou2 sai3, soeng6 min6 mat1 je5 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小岛很小，上面什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: That islet is very small, there's nothing on it.

english_meaning: father-in-law (wife's father)
explanation_mandarin: 指妻子的父亲，即岳父。
explanation_english: Refers to the father of one's wife; father-in-law (wife's father).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要同老婆返去見嶽父嶽母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 tung4 lou5 po4 faan1 heoi3 gin3 ngaak6 fu2 ngaak6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要和老婆回去见岳父岳母。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going back to see my father-in-law and mother-in-law with my wife tomorrow.

english_meaning: jagged; uneven; rough (surface)
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面凹凸不平，不光滑。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is rough, uneven, and jagged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲石頭好巉腳呀，行路小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sek6 tau4 hou2 caam4 goek3 aa3, haang4 lou6 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些石头很扎脚，走路小心点。
examples.english_sentence: These stones are very jagged, be careful when you walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊面唔平滑，好巉㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 min6 m4 ping4 waat6, hou2 caam4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 脸部不平滑，很粗糙。
examples.english_sentence: The face is not smooth, it's very rough.

english_meaning: prickly; thorny; troublesome; difficult to handle
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或人难以应付，像带刺一样令人感到棘手。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone difficult to deal with, like something thorny and prickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單case真係好巉手，搞咗好耐都搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 case zan1 hai6 hou2 caam4 sau2, gaau2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个案例真的很棘手，弄了很久都没弄好。
examples.english_sentence: This case is really troublesome; we've been working on it for ages and still can't resolve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好巉手，唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 caam4 sau2, m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很棘手，不要惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a difficult person to deal with; don't mess with him.

english_meaning: towering, majestic, lofty
explanation_mandarin: 形容山或建筑物高大雄伟的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the appearance of mountains or buildings as tall, majestic, and imposing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 座山好巍峨啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 saan1 hou2 ngai4 ngo4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座山真巍峨啊！
examples.english_sentence: This mountain is so majestic!

english_meaning: mountain range, mountain peaks
explanation_mandarin: 指连绵的山峰。
explanation_english: Refers to a series of connected mountain peaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度啲山巒真係好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 di1 saan1 lün4 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里的山峦真漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain range there is really beautiful.

english_meaning: peak; summit; crazy; high (on drugs or excitement)
explanation_mandarin: 1. (形容词)指最高的、最顶端的状态。2. (动词/形容词)指极度兴奋、疯狂、嗨的状态，多用于口语，含有贬义色彩，有时也表示非常棒、厉害。
explanation_english: 1. (Adjective) Refers to the highest or peak state. 2. (Verb/Adjective) Refers to a state of extreme excitement, craziness, or being high, often used in colloquial speech and carrying a slightly negative connotation, but sometimes used to express something is excellent or amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋玩到好顛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waan2 dou3 hou2 din1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们玩得很疯狂啊！
examples.english_sentence: They're having a crazy time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日好似有啲顛喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 din1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天好像有点疯癫啊！
examples.english_sentence: You seem a bit crazy today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻歌真係顛，我好鍾意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 go1 zan1 hai6 din1, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌真劲爆，我很喜欢！
examples.english_sentence: This song is so crazy (good), I really like it!

english_meaning: peak, summit, apex, pinnacle; highest point
explanation_mandarin: 指事物发展或状态的最高点，最好的阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest point or best stage of development or state of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業已經去到巔峯，好難再有突破啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip3 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 din1 fung1, hou2 naan4 zoi3 jau5 dat6 po3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业已经到达顶峰，很难再有突破了。
examples.english_sentence: His career has already reached its peak, it's difficult to have any further breakthroughs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個運動員正值巔峯狀態，有望攞到金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wan6 dung6 yun4 zing3 zik6 din1 fung1 zong6 taai3, yau5 mong6 lo2 dou3 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个运动员正值巅峰状态，有望获得金牌。
examples.english_sentence: This athlete is in peak condition and is expected to win a gold medal.

english_meaning: peak; summit; apex; pinnacle; zenith
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事物发展达到最高点。也指最优秀的状态或水平。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest point of development of something. Also refers to the most outstanding state or level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業而家去到巔峰狀態啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 dou3 din1 fung1 zong6 taai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业现在达到了巅峰状态了。
examples.english_sentence: His career has reached its peak now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅生意喺星期六晚去到巔峰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 saang1 yi3 hai2 sing1 kei4 luk6 maan5 heoi3 dou3 din1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的生意在星期六晚上达到顶峰。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's business reaches its peak on Saturday nights.

english_meaning: suitable; correct; right; agreeable; fitting
explanation_mandarin: 表示适合，正确，赞同。
explanation_english: Expresses suitability, correctness, or agreement. Can also mean to fit or be compatible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫巖唔啱你著呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 nei5 zoek3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服你穿合不合适呀？
examples.english_sentence: Does this piece of clothing fit you well?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個都好啱傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 leong5 go3 dou1 hou2 ngaam1 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个很合得来。
examples.english_sentence: We two get along very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得啱呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说得对呀！
examples.english_sentence: You are right!

mandarin_meaning: 岩石层；坚硬的表层；顽固；固执
english_meaning: rock layer; hard outer layer; stubborn; obstinate
explanation_mandarin: 原指岩石的层次，引申为指某人性格固执、不容易改变。也形容物体表面坚硬。
explanation_english: Originally refers to rock layers. By extension, it means someone's personality is stubborn and difficult to change. It can also describe the hard surface of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好巖層，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ngaam4 cang4, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很固执，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He's very stubborn; he doesn't listen no matter what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢層嘢好巖層，好難打開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cang4 je5 hou2 ngaam4 cang4, hou2 naan4 daa2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个东西的表层很坚硬，很难打开。
examples.english_sentence: The outer layer of this thing is very hard; it's hard to open.

english_meaning: ugly, uneven, rough; rugged (of terrain); unattractive
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体表面凹凸不平，不美观；也形容山路崎岖难行，或人长相丑陋。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is uneven, rough, and unattractive. It can also describe rugged mountain roads or an unattractive appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚿石頭好巖巉，唔好坐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 sek6 tau4 hou2 ngaam4 caam4, m4 hou2 co5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块石头很粗糙不平，别坐了。
examples.english_sentence: This stone is very rough and uneven, don't sit on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路好巖巉，行路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 hou2 ngaam4 caam4, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很崎岖，走路要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: This road is very rugged, be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋個樣巖巉啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 go3 joeng2 ngaam4 caam4 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人长相丑陋，很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that someone has an unattractive appearance, it's very rude.

english_meaning: rough; uneven; jagged; bumpy; having a rough or uneven surface or edge.
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面凹凸不平，不光滑。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is uneven, rough, and not smooth; can also describe something unrefined or unpleasant in character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路巖巖巉巉，行路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 ngaam4 ngaam4 caam4 caam4, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路凹凸不平，走路要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The road is rough and uneven, you need to be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人都幾巖巖巉巉，唔係咁易相處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 dou1 gei2 ngaam4 ngaam4 caam4 caam4, m4 hai6 gam2 ji6 seung1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人有点粗鲁，不容易相处。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is quite rough around the edges, he's not easy to get along with.

english_meaning: Cave, grotto
explanation_mandarin: 指由岩石构成的大型洞穴。
explanation_english: Refers to a large cave formed from rock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去咗一個好大嘅巖洞探險呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 ngaam4 dung6 taam3 him2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去了一个很大的岩洞探险了！
examples.english_sentence: We went to explore a very big cave!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個巖洞入面黑麻麻，乜都睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ngaam4 dung6 jap6 min6 hak1 maa4 maa4, mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 岩洞里面黑乎乎的，什么都看不到。
examples.english_sentence: It's very dark inside the cave, and you can't see anything.

english_meaning: rock, boulder
explanation_mandarin: 坚硬的石头；构成地壳的主要物质之一。
explanation_english: A naturally occurring solid aggregate of one or more minerals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海邊有好多大嚿巖石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 bin1 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 gau6 ngaam4 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海边有很多大块的岩石。
examples.english_sentence: There are many big rocks by the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺啲巖石上面爬嚟爬去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 di1 ngaam4 sek6 soeng6 min6 paa4 lai4 paa4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在那些岩石上爬来爬去。
examples.english_sentence: They are climbing all over the rocks.

english_meaning: cave; grotto; cavern
explanation_mandarin: 指山中的洞穴。通常指天然形成的洞穴。
explanation_english: Refers to a cave in the mountains. Usually refers to a naturally formed cave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行山嘅時候，見到一個好大嘅巖穴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6, gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 ngaam4 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们爬山的时候，看到一个很大的山洞。
examples.english_sentence: When we were hiking, we saw a very big cave.

english_meaning: cliff, steep rock face
explanation_mandarin: 指高峻的山崖。在粤语中，虽然单独使用较少，但常见于地名或古文引用。
explanation_english: Refers to a high and steep cliff. Although less commonly used alone in Cantonese nowadays, it is often found in place names or quotations from classical Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺嗰條巗邊嘅村莊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 go2 tiu4 ngam4 bin1 ge3 cyun1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在那个悬崖边的村庄。
examples.english_sentence: They live in the village on the edge of that cliff.

english_meaning: to flow out; to gush; to spurt; to string together (e.g., meat on a skewer)
explanation_mandarin: 表示液体快速地流出或者涌出。也可用作量词，表示将东西串在一起。
explanation_english: Indicates a rapid flow or gush of liquid. Can also be used as a classifier, indicating things strung together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鼻血川出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei6 hyut3 cyun1 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鼻血喷出来了。
examples.english_sentence: Nosebleed gushed out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲肉川埋一齊做串燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 yuk6 cyun1 maai4 jat1 cai4 zou6 chuan3 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把肉串在一起做烤肉串。
examples.english_sentence: He strung the meat together to make skewers.

english_meaning: ceaseless flow; the stream flows on forever; an unending stream (of people, traffic, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容像河流一样连续不断。比喻人、车马等连续不断地来往。
explanation_english: Describes a continuous flow like a river. A metaphor for a continuous stream of people, vehicles, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過海嘅時候，啲車川流不息，好塞車㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 hoi2 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 ce1 cyun1 lau4 bat1 sik1, hou2 sak1 ce1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过海的时候，车水马龙，经常堵车。
examples.english_sentence: When crossing the harbor, the traffic is ceaseless, so it's often congested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年期間，花市嘅人川流不息，好熱鬧呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 kei4 gaan1, faa1 si5 ge3 jan4 cyun1 lau4 bat1 sik1, hou2 jit6 naau6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年期间，花市的人川流不息，非常热闹！
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, the flow of people at the flower market is ceaseless, it's very lively!

english_meaning: province; state
explanation_mandarin: 指行政区域，比“省”小，但现在中国的行政区划里已经没有“州”这一级了，一般用在古时候或者外国的行政区划里。
explanation_english: Refers to an administrative region, smaller than a 'province', but the administrative division of 'state' no longer exists in China. It's generally used in ancient times or in the administrative divisions of foreign countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美洲有好多唔同嘅州。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 zau1 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美洲有很多不同的州。
examples.english_sentence: America has many different states.

english_meaning: governor (of a state)
explanation_mandarin: 美国等国家的州政府的行政首脑。
explanation_english: The governor of a state, especially in the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想競選做加州州長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ging6 syun2 zou6 gaa1 zau1 zau1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想竞选加州州长。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to run for governor of California.

english_meaning: to patrol, to inspect, to make a round
explanation_mandarin: 指在一定区域内来回走动，查看情况，以防止意外或维护秩序。
explanation_english: To patrol or inspect an area by moving around, checking for potential issues or maintaining order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺街度巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 gaai1 dou6 ceon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在街上巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: The police are patrolling the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸每日都會巡視佢嘅花園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 ceon4 si6 keoi5 ge3 faa1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸每天都会巡视他的花园。
examples.english_sentence: Dad inspects his garden every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保安員每晚都巡樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 on1 jyun4 mui5 maan5 dou1 ceon4 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保安员每晚都巡楼。
examples.english_sentence: The security guard patrols the building every night.

mandarin_meaning: 闲逛的人；漫无目的游荡的人
english_meaning: Wandering around aimlessly; loafing around; someone who aimlessly wanders around a city
explanation_mandarin: 指漫无目的地在城市里游荡的人。比喻没有固定目标，四处闲逛的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who aimlessly wanders around a city. It is a metaphor for someone who wanders around without a fixed goal, often perceived as lazy or unproductive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都好似隻巡城馬咁，周圍去，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 ci5 zek3 ceon4 sing4 maa5 gam2, zau1 wai4 heoi3, m4 zi1 dou1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都像一只闲逛的马一样，到处去，不知道在干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He wanders around like a loafer every day, going everywhere, I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做巡城馬啦，搵份工做下好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 ceon4 sing4 maa5 laa1, wan2 fan6 gung1 zou6 haa5 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做闲逛的人了，找份工作做更好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a loafer, it's better to find a job.

synonyms: 遊手好閒 (jau4 sau2 hou3 haan4)

english_meaning: to patrol, to make rounds
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个区域内来回走动，查看情况，以确保安全或秩序。
explanation_english: To patrol or make rounds in a specific area to check the situation, ensuring safety or order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保安日日都要巡場㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 on1 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 ceon4 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保安每天都要巡逻的。
examples.english_sentence: The security guards have to patrol every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺商場入面巡場，睇吓有冇人偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 ceon4 coeng4, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 jan4 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在商场里面巡逻，看看有没有人偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: They are patrolling in the shopping mall, checking if anyone is stealing things.

english_meaning: to inspect; to patrol; inspection
explanation_mandarin: 指官员或上级领导到下属机构或地方进行视察，了解情况，检查工作。
explanation_english: To inspect; to patrol; to supervise. Usually refers to officials or superiors inspecting subordinate organizations or local areas to understand the situation and check on the work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嚟緊會嚟巡察我哋公司嘅運作情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lai4 gan2 wui5 lai4 ceon4 caat3 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 wan6 zok3 cing4 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们接下来会来巡察我们公司的运作情况。
examples.english_sentence: They will come to inspect the operation of our company soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次巡察嘅重點係安全問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ceon4 caat3 ge3 zung6 dim2 hai6 on1 cyun4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次巡察的重点是安全问题。
examples.english_sentence: The focus of this inspection is safety issues.

english_meaning: rounds (hospital); to make rounds
explanation_mandarin: 指医生或护士定期检查病房，查看病人的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to doctors or nurses regularly checking hospital wards to examine patients' conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生每日都會巡房，睇吓病人情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 ceon4 fong2, tai2 haa5 beng6 jan4 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生每天都会查房，看看病人的情况。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors make rounds every day to check on the patients' conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋而家巡緊房，唔好打擾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ceon4 gan2 fong2, m4 hou2 daa2 jiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们现在正在巡视病房，不要打扰。
examples.english_sentence: They are making rounds now, don't disturb them.

english_meaning: to patrol; to be on the night watch
explanation_mandarin: 指在特定区域内按规定的路线来回走动，以进行警戒、检查或维持秩序。通常在夜间或特定时间进行。
explanation_english: To patrol; to make rounds within a specific area according to a designated route, in order to maintain security, conduct inspections, or maintain order. Typically done at night or during specific times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲保安每晚都要喺工廠度巡更。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bou2 on1 mui5 maan5 dou1 jiu3 hai2 gung1 cong2 dou6 ceon4 gang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些保安每晚都要在工厂里巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: The security guards have to patrol the factory every night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日巡更，確保呢個區域嘅安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 ceon4 gang1, kok3 bou2 ni1 go3 kui1 wik6 ge3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天巡逻，确保这个区域的安全。
examples.english_sentence: They patrol all day to ensure the safety of this area.

english_meaning: to patrol, to inspect
explanation_mandarin: 指有组织地在一定区域内走动检查，观察情况，维护秩序。
explanation_english: To patrol; to go around an area in an organized manner to inspect and observe the situation and maintain order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察每日都會喺呢個區巡查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 hai2 ni1 go3 khu1 ceon4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察每天都会在这个区巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: The police patrol this area every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保安員需要定時巡查大廈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 on1 jyun4 seoi1 jiu3 ding6 si4 ceon4 caa4 daai6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保安员需要定时巡查大厦。
examples.english_sentence: Security guards need to patrol the building regularly.

english_meaning: cruiser (warship)
explanation_mandarin: 一种军舰，通常比驱逐舰大，比战列舰小，用于执行巡逻、侦察等任务。
explanation_english: A type of warship, generally larger than a destroyer and smaller than a battleship, used for tasks such as patrolling and reconnaissance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰艘巡洋艦好大架，望落去好有霸氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 sau1 ceon4 joeng4 gaam3 hou2 daai6 gaa3, mong6 lok6 heoi3 hou2 jau5 baa3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那艘巡洋舰很大，看上去很有霸气。
examples.english_sentence: That cruiser is very big, it looks very imposing.

english_meaning: Procession, parade, tour, pilgrimage
explanation_mandarin: 指有组织的游行活动，常带有仪式或庆祝性质。也指巡回展示或访问。
explanation_english: Refers to an organized parade or procession, often with a ceremonial or celebratory nature. It can also refer to a touring exhibition or a visit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋每年都會搞一個花車巡禮慶祝新年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 gaau2 jat1 go3 faa1 ce1 ceon4 lai5 hing3 zuk1 san1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每年都会举办一个花车巡游庆祝新年。
examples.english_sentence: They hold a float parade every year to celebrate the New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間畫廊搞咗個世界名畫巡禮展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 waa2 long4 gaau2 zo2 go3 sai3 gaai3 ming4 waa2 ceon4 lai5 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个画廊举办了一个世界名画巡回展览。
examples.english_sentence: This gallery is holding a touring exhibition of world-famous paintings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃緊一個美食巡禮，去唔同嘅地方試當地嘅嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 gan2 jat1 go3 mei5 sik6 ceon4 lai5, heoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1 si3 dong1 dei6 ge3 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划着一个美食之旅，去不同的地方品尝当地的美食。
examples.english_sentence: They are planning a culinary tour to try local food in different places.

mandarin_meaning: 巡航控制; 定速巡航
english_meaning: Cruise control
explanation_mandarin: 一种汽车上的自动控制车速的系统，驾驶员设定好速度后，系统会自动维持这个速度。
explanation_english: A system in a motor vehicle that automatically maintains a constant speed set by the driver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺高速公路揸車用巡航定速舒服好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gou1 suk1 gung1 lou6 zaa1 ce1 yung6 ceon4 hong4 ding6 suk1 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在高速公路上开车用巡航控制舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: It's much more comfortable to drive on the highway using cruise control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢部車有巡航定速功能，長途駕駛都唔會咁攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 ce1 jau5 ceon4 hong4 ding6 suk1 gung1 nang4, coeng4 tou4 gaa3 sai2 dou1 m4 wui5 gam3 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的车有定速巡航功能，长途驾驶都不会那么累。
examples.english_sentence: His car has cruise control function, so long-distance driving won't be so tiring.

english_meaning: to patrol; to parade; to tour
explanation_mandarin: 指有秩序地在某一区域内走动，进行视察或警戒。
explanation_english: To move systematically within an area, inspecting or guarding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲警察喺條街度巡行，維持治安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ging2 caat3 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 ceon4 hang4, wai4 ci4 zi6 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在街上巡逻，维持治安。
examples.english_sentence: The police are patrolling the street to maintain public order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊樂場入面嘅工作人員會定時巡行，確保所有設施都安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 lok6 coeng4 jap6 min6 ge3 gung1 zok3 jan4 jyun4 wui5 ding6 si4 ceon4 hang4, kok3 bou2 so2 jau5 sat1 si1 dou1 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游乐场里的工作人员会定时巡视，确保所有设施都安全。
examples.english_sentence: The staff in the amusement park patrol regularly to ensure that all the facilities are safe.

english_meaning: to inspect, to patrol, to tour
explanation_mandarin: 指为了监督、检查或安全等目的而四处视察。
explanation_english: To inspect or patrol an area, often for supervisory, security, or inspection purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理成日落工場巡視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 sing4 jat6 lok6 gung1 coeng4 ceon4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经理经常下车间巡视。
examples.english_sentence: The manager often goes to the factory to inspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋會定時巡視邊界，確保安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wui5 ding6 si4 ceon4 si6 bin1 gaai3, kok3 bou2 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们会定时巡视边界，确保安全。
examples.english_sentence: They patrol the border regularly to ensure safety.

english_meaning: police patrol; patrol officer
explanation_mandarin: 指负责在特定区域巡逻，维护治安的警察。
explanation_english: Refers to a police officer responsible for patrolling a specific area to maintain public order and security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺條街度見到兩個巡警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 gin3 dou2 loeng5 go3 ceon4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上看到两个巡警。
examples.english_sentence: I saw two police patrol officers on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲巡警喺度維持秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ceon4 ging2 hai2 dou6 wai4 ci4 dit6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 巡警在那里维持秩序。
examples.english_sentence: The patrol officers are maintaining order there.

english_meaning: touring, circuit, go the rounds
explanation_mandarin: 指在不同的地方或组织之间进行循环活动或表演。
explanation_english: Refers to a circular activity or performance that takes place in different locations or organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋樂隊嚟緊會喺亞洲搞巡迴演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lok6 deoi2 lai4 gan2 wui5 hai2 aa3 zau1 gaau2 ceon4 wui4 jin2 coeng3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的乐队接下来会在亚洲举办巡回演唱会。
examples.english_sentence: Their band will be doing a concert tour in Asia soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個醫療隊會去偏遠地區巡迴義診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ji1 liu4 deoi2 wui5 heoi3 pin1 jyun5 dei6 keoi1 ceon4 wui4 ji6 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医疗队会去偏远地区巡回义诊。
examples.english_sentence: The medical team will go to remote areas for mobile charity clinics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣舞台劇會喺唔同嘅城市巡迴演出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 mou5 toi4 kek6 wui5 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 sing4 si5 ceon4 wui4 jin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这出舞台剧会在不同的城市巡回演出。
examples.english_sentence: This stage play will tour different cities.

english_meaning: parade; procession; to parade; to march
explanation_mandarin: 指有组织的队伍在公共场所行进，通常伴有音乐、表演等，以庆祝或展示。
explanation_english: Refers to an organized group of people moving along a public route, usually with music, performances, etc., to celebrate or showcase something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年嘅新年都有好多巡遊睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 ge3 san1 nin4 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 ceon4 jau4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年新年都有很多巡游可以看。
examples.english_sentence: There are many parades to watch every New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞咗個盛大嘅巡遊嚟慶祝勝利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 zo2 go3 sing6 daai6 ge3 ceon4 jau4 lai4 hing3 zuk1 sing3 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们举办了一个盛大的巡游来庆祝胜利。
examples.english_sentence: They organized a grand parade to celebrate the victory.

english_meaning: to patrol, patrol
explanation_mandarin: 指在一定区域内来回走动，进行警戒或检查。
explanation_english: To patrol; to walk around an area at regular intervals to guard it or check for problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲警察成日喺呢條街巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ging2 caat3 seng4 jat6 hai2 ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ceon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察经常在这条街巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: The police often patrol this street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保安員每晚都會喺大廈入面巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 on1 jyun4 mui5 maan5 dou1 wui5 hai2 daai6 haa6 jap6 min6 ceon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保安人员每晚都会在大厦里面巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: Security guards patrol the building every night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派咗士兵去邊境巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 zo2 si1 bing1 heoi3 bin1 ging2 ceon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派了士兵去边境巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: They sent soldiers to patrol the border.

english_meaning: nest; den; lair; to copy (homework, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 鸟类或其他动物居住的窝；比喻坏人的老巢；抄袭。
explanation_english: A nest of a bird or other animal; a lair or den, especially a place where bad people gather; to copy, especially homework or answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雀仔喺樹上面起咗個巢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoek3 zai2 hai2 syu6 soeng6 min6 hei2 zo2 go3 caau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小鸟在树上搭了一个窝。
examples.english_sentence: The bird built a nest on the tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好抄人哋啲功課，自己諗啦，抄巢就冇意思嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caau1 jan4 dei6 dik1 gung1 fo3, zi6 gei2 lam2 laa1, caau4 caau4 zau6 mou5 ji3 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抄别人的作业，自己想吧，抄袭就没有意义了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't copy other people's homework, think for yourself, copying is meaningless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人搗破咗個毒品巢穴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 jan4 dou2 po3 zo2 go3 duk6 ban2 caau4 jyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察捣毁了一个毒品窝点。
examples.english_sentence: The police raided a drug den.

english_meaning: Don't make a fuss; Don't cause trouble; Don't be a nuisance.
explanation_mandarin: “巢”指吵闹、惹事；“咪”即“不要”；“掹”有拉扯、纠缠的意思。整个词语指不要吵闹惹事，保持安静，不要制造麻烦。
explanation_english: "巢 (caau4)" refers to making noise or causing trouble; "咪 (mai1)" means "don't"; "掹 (mang1)" has the meaning of pulling or entangling. The whole phrase means don't make a fuss, keep quiet, and don't cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔，喺度要乖乖哋，唔好巢咪掹啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2, hai2 dou6 jiu3 gwaai1 gwaai1 dei2, m4 hou2 caau4 mai1 mang1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友，在这里要乖乖的，不要吵闹。
examples.english_sentence: Little kids, be good here, don't make a fuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都咁大人喇，仲喺度巢咪掹，好唔好意思啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gam3 daai6 jan4 laa3, zung6 hai2 dou6 caau4 mai1 mang1, hou2 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都这么大人了，还在那里吵闹，好不好意思啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're such a grown-up now, still making a fuss, aren't you embarrassed?

mandarin_meaning: 粗糙的；简陋的；质量差的
english_meaning: Rough; crude; shoddily made; of poor quality; ramshackle
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物粗糙、简陋，质量不好，或者制造得很马虎。
explanation_english: Describes something that is rough, crude, of poor quality, or made carelessly and shoddily. Often refers to workmanship or materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋啲裝修巢掹掹，睇落好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 di1 zong1 sau1 caau4 mang1 mang1, tai2 lok6 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的装修很粗糙，看起来很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The renovation of this house is very rough; it looks uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲手工咁巢掹掹嘅嘢，都敢攞出嚟賣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sau2 gung1 gam3 caau4 mang1 mang1 ge3 je5, dou1 gam2 lo2 ceot1 lai4 maai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些手工如此粗糙的东西，也敢拿出来卖？
examples.english_sentence: You dare to sell these things with such shoddy workmanship?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整嘅嘢永遠都咁巢掹掹，真係唔可以期望太高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 ge3 je5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 gam3 caau4 mang1 mang1, zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 kei4 mong6 taai3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的东西永远都这么粗糙，真的不能期望太高。
examples.english_sentence: The things he makes are always so rough; you really can't expect too much.

synonyms: 是是但但 (si6 si6 daan6 daan6)

mandarin_meaning: 丢脸; 出丑; 掉价
english_meaning: to lose face; to be embarrassed; to be humiliated; to be discredited
explanation_mandarin: 指丢脸，出丑，丧失面子或声誉。形容令人尴尬或羞愧的境地。
explanation_english: Refers to losing face, being embarrassed, or losing one's reputation. Describes a situation that is embarrassing or shameful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁多人面前講錯嘢，真係好巢皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 caau4 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多人面前说错话，真的很丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: Saying the wrong thing in front of so many people is really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試肥佬，覺得好巢皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2, gok3 dak1 hou2 caau4 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不及格，觉得很丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and feels very embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，真係會巢皮架！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, zan1 hai6 wui5 caau4 pei4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，真的会丢脸的！
examples.english_sentence: Doing it like this will really make you lose face!

english_meaning: To try to get a bargain or advantage, often in a petty or stingy way; penny-pinching; to be opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人斤斤计较，想方设法占小便宜，显得很抠门。 “巢皮” 指寻找好处或漏洞，“掹雞” 指拔鸡毛，比喻获取微小的利益。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is calculative and tries to get small advantages or bargains, often appearing stingy. "巢皮" refers to looking for benefits or loopholes, and "掹雞" (pulling chicken feathers) is a metaphor for extracting tiny benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度巢皮掹雞，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 caau4 pei4 mang1 gai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着占小便宜，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to get a bargain in a petty way, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁巢皮掹雞啦，請人飲杯嘢啫，使唔使咁計較啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 caau4 pei4 mang1 gai1 laa1, ceng2 jan4 jam2 bui1 je5 ze1, sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 gai3 gaau3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么抠门了，请别人喝一杯东西而已，需要这么计较吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, it's just buying someone a drink, do you need to be so calculative?

english_meaning: To feign ability; to bluff; to pretend to be capable when one is not; to overreach oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人没有真本事却硬要装作很有能力的样子，通常结果会很糟糕。 "巢皮"指不实在，虚假。"掹鷄"指拉扯小鸡，形容无力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who pretends to be capable when they are not, often leading to negative consequences. "巢皮" (caau4 pei4) refers to something that is insincere or false. "掹鷄" (maang1 gai1) literally means pulling a chicken, implying weakness or a lack of power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，但係又要巢皮掹鷄，結果搞到一鑊粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 jau6 jiu3 caau4 pei4 maang1 gai1, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，但是又要装模作样，结果搞得一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he pretends to be capable, and as a result, he made a complete mess of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好巢皮掹鷄啦，你嘅能力去到邊，大家都知㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 caau4 pei4 maang1 gai1 laa1, nei5 ge3 nang4 lik6 heoi3 dou3 bin1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要装模作样了，你的能力到哪里，大家都知道的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be more capable than you are, everyone knows your limits.

synonyms: 充大頭鬼 (cung1 daai6 tau4 gwai2)

mandarin_meaning: 爱出风头的人；喜欢炫耀的人
english_meaning: Show-off; Someone who likes to show off
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人喜欢炫耀、爱出风头。通常带有贬义色彩，指其行为令人反感。
