examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 mung4 pin3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他欺骗啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be deceived by him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都幪在鼓裡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mung4 zoi6 gu2 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是被蒙在鼓里。
examples.english_sentence: He's always kept in the dark.

english_meaning: to help; to assist; group; party
explanation_mandarin: 动词：给予支援，使对方得到利益或满足需求。名词：指团体或组织。
explanation_english: Verb: to provide assistance; to help someone achieve something or meet a need. Noun: a group or gang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫下手啦，我搬唔郁啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1, ngo5 bun1 m4 juk1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮帮忙吧，我搬不动这些东西。
examples.english_sentence: Give me a hand, I can't move these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢加入咗個黑社會嘅幫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa1 jap6 zo2 go3 hak1 se5 wui2 ge3 bong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他加入了一个黑社会的帮派。
examples.english_sentence: He joined a triad gang.

english_meaning: To help keep an eye on something; to help watch out for something; to give a quick look
explanation_mandarin: 请求他人帮忙照看或留意某事物。表示请求对方稍微帮忙注意一下。
explanation_english: A request for someone to help keep an eye on or watch out for something. It implies asking someone to pay a little attention to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫下手，幫下眼啲行李啊，我去買啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 haa5 sau2, bong1 haa5 ngaan5 di1 hang4 lei5 aa3, ngo5 heoi3 maai5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮个忙，帮我看一下行李，我去买点东西。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please help me out and keep an eye on the luggage? I'm going to buy something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫下眼個火，唔好煮燶啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 haa5 ngaan5 go3 fo2, m4 hou2 jyu2 nung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮忙看着火，别煮糊了！
examples.english_sentence: Please keep an eye on the fire, don't let it burn!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫下眼啲小朋友，唔好俾佢哋周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 haa5 ngaan5 di1 siu2 peng4 jau5, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮忙照看一下小朋友，不要让他们到处乱跑。
examples.english_sentence: Please keep an eye on the children, don't let them run around.

english_meaning: Gang leader; head of a gang or society; chief
explanation_mandarin: 指黑社会或帮派的首领。
explanation_english: Refers to the leader of a triad, gang, or society.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go2 go3 hak1 se5 wui2 ge3 bong1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是那个黑社会的帮主。
examples.english_sentence: He is the head of that triad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲講述幫主嘅崛起同埋衰落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 syut6 bong1 zyu2 ge3 fat6 hei2 tung4 ma4 seoi1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述了帮主的崛起和衰落。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the story of a gang leader's rise and fall.

mandarin_meaning: 多管闲事; 好管闲事
english_meaning: To meddle in other people's marital affairs (husband-related); To interfere in someone else's marriage
explanation_mandarin: 指多管闲事，干涉别人的婚姻关系，特别是涉及对方丈夫的事情。通常带有负面含义，表示不应该插手别人的家务事。
explanation_english: This phrase refers to meddling in other people's marital affairs, especially those concerning the husband. It usually has a negative connotation, implying that one should not interfere in other people's domestic matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好幫人敎老公啦，人哋兩公婆嘅嘢，你插手盞搞衰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 bong1 jan4 gaau3 lou5 gung1 laa1, jan4 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 ge3 je5, nei5 chaap3 sau2 zaan2 gaau2 seoi2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要多管别人的婚姻事，他们夫妻的事情，你插手只会把事情搞砸。
examples.english_sentence: You better not meddle in other people's marital affairs, you'll only mess things up by interfering in their relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫人敎老公，結果搞到自己同啲朋友都反晒面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4 gaau3 lou5 gung1, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 dou1 faan2 saai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是喜欢多管别人的婚姻事，结果弄得自己和朋友都翻脸了。
examples.english_sentence: She always likes to meddle in other people's marital affairs, which ended up causing rifts between her and her friends.

synonyms: [雞蛋裏挑骨頭 (gai1 daan2 leoi5 tiu1 gwat1 tau4) - to nitpick]

english_meaning: Helping someone else discipline/manage their husband (usually negatively connotated)

explanation_english: Refers to interfering in or participating in someone else's marital problems, especially helping the wife to discipline or manage her husband. It usually carries a negative connotation, implying being meddlesome or overestimating one's abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都未結婚，唔好咁多事幫人教老公啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 mei6 git3 fan1, m4 hou2 gam3 do1 si6 bong1 jan4 gaau3 lou5 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都还没结婚，不要管这么多事，帮别人管教丈夫了。
examples.english_sentence: You're not even married, don't be so nosy and try to help other people manage their husbands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿玲成日幫人教老公，結果搞到自己屋企都嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ling4 sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 gaau3 lou5 gung1, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei2 dou1 caau4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿玲总是帮别人管教丈夫，结果搞得自己家里都吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ling is always helping other people manage their husbands, and as a result, her own family is always arguing.

synonyms: 多管閒事 (do1 guan3 haan4 si6)
狗咬耗子，多管閒事 (gau2 ngaau5 hou6 zi2, do1 guan3 haan4 si6)

english_meaning: accomplice; accessory

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是主谋，但是他是帮凶，也要负责任。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't the mastermind, but he was an accomplice and must take responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做幫兇啊，要分清楚邊啲啱邊啲唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 bong1 hung1 aa3, jiu3 fan1 cing1 chu2 bin1 di1 aam1 bin1 di1 m4 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做帮凶啊，要分清楚哪些是对的哪些是错的。

english_meaning: to help; assistance

examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your help!

explanation_mandarin: 指在别人遇到困难或争执时，出面帮助说话，支持某一方。

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 naau6, nei5 m4 bong1 hau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骂，你不帮他说话吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's being scolded, aren't you going to speak up for him?

examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 bong1 hau2 waa6 ngo5 gwaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是帮我说我是个乖孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always speaks up for me, saying I'm a good kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我喺老細面前幫口講幾句啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 bong1 hau2 gong2 gei2 geoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我在老板面前说几句好话吧。

explanation_mandarin: 指帮忙留意或者照看一下。通常用于比较轻松的语境，请求别人帮忙简单地观察或者检查。
explanation_english: To help take a look or keep an eye on something. Usually used in a casual context, requesting someone to simply observe or check something.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 haa5 ngaan5 tai2 zyu6 di1 hang4 lei5, ngo5 hui3 maai5 je5 yam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮忙看一下行李，我去买饮料。
examples.english_sentence: Please help keep an eye on the luggage while I go buy some drinks.

examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 haa5 ngaan5 tai2 haa5 go3 lou4 hai6 mai6 sik1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮忙看一下炉子是不是关了。
examples.english_sentence: Can you help take a look and see if the stove is turned off?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 麻煩你幫吓眼睇住個小朋友，我要去洗手間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 faan4 nei5 bong1 haa5 ngaan5 tai2 zyu6 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5, ngo5 jiu3 hui3 sai2 sau2 gaan1.

examples.english_sentence: Could you please help keep an eye on the child? I need to go to the restroom.

explanation_mandarin: 表示因为自身能力或客观条件限制，无法提供帮助。强调能力或条件的不足。
explanation_english: Indicates the inability to help due to limitations in one's own capabilities or objective conditions. Emphasizes the lack of ability or suitable conditions for assistance.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gam3 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2, ngo5 dou1 bong1 m4 lok6 nei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这么多人排队，我也帮不了你啊。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people queuing now, I can't help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自己都搞唔掂，點幫唔落人呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 gei2 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6, dim2 bong1 m4 lok6 jan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自己都搞不定，怎么能帮别人呢？
examples.english_sentence: He can't even manage himself, how can he help others?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事太複雜，我都幫唔落手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 taai3 fuk1 zaap6, ngo5 dou1 bong1 m4 lok6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事太复杂，我都没法下手帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is too complicated, I can't even begin to help.

explanation_english: Refers to helping someone with work or labour; to assist in performing tasks.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 lai4 bong1 gung1, bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天来帮忙干活，帮我搬家。
examples.english_sentence: He came to help with work today, helping me move house.

examples.english_sentence: My house is being renovated, I hired a helper to paint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農忙時節，好多人會互相幫工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 mong4 si4 jit3, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 wu6 seong1 bong1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农忙时节，很多人会互相帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: During the busy farming season, many people help each other with work.

explanation_english: A person who helps in the kitchen; to assist the chef in cooking.

examples.english_sentence: I'm helping in the kitchen tonight, what do you guys want to eat?

english_meaning: to help, to assist, to do a favour
explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人做事情，提供协助。
explanation_english: To help someone do something, to provide assistance.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮忙拿着这个袋子。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me hold this bag.

examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 mong4 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is there anything I can help with?

examples.english_sentence: I need someone to help me move house.

explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人做事情；提供协助。
explanation_english: To assist someone in doing something; to provide help or assistance.

examples.english_sentence: Could you help me move this cabinet?

examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 bong1 sau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你这么帮忙！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much for your help!

explanation_mandarin: 提供帮助，协助他人完成任务。
explanation_english: To provide assistance or support to someone in completing a task or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫拖執下嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 to1 zap1 haa5 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以帮我收拾一下东西吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me tidy up a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢搞唔掂，我哋咪幫拖囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 gaau2 m4 dim6, ngo5 dei6 mai1 bong1 to1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他搞不定，我们就帮他一把吧。
examples.english_sentence: If he can't handle it, we'll give him a hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫拖啊，如果唔係我唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 to1 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮忙啊，不然我不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your help, otherwise I wouldn't know what to do.

english_meaning: gang; triad; secret society
explanation_mandarin: 指黑社会组织，或秘密结社。
explanation_english: Refers to a criminal organization, such as a triad or other secret society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話佢以前係個幫會嘅大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 go3 bong1 wui2 ge3 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说他以前是个帮会的大哥。
examples.english_sentence: They said he used to be a boss of a triad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前有好多幫會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 jau5 hou2 do1 bong1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港以前有很多帮会。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to have many triads.

english_meaning: gang, gangland
explanation_mandarin: 指有组织的、以非法活动为主要手段的团伙。
explanation_english: A group of people organized for criminal purposes; a gang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一個好出名嘅幫派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 bong1 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一个很有名的帮派。
examples.english_sentence: They are a very famous gang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港曾經有好多唔同嘅幫派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 cang4 ging1 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 bong1 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港曾经有很多不同的帮派。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to have many different gangs.

english_meaning: To side with reason, not with relatives/friends; to be impartial
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情公正，不偏袒亲属或朋友，只按道理办事。
explanation_english: Describes handling matters fairly and impartially, not favoring relatives or friends, but acting according to reason and principle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官判案要幫理不幫親，唔可以因為被告係佢親戚就偏袒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 pun3 on3 jiu3 bong1 lei5 bat1 bong1 can1, m4 ho2 ji5 jyun4 wai4 bei6 gou3 hai6 keoi5 can1 cik1 zau6 pin1 taan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官判案要帮理不帮亲，不可以因为被告是他的亲戚就偏袒。
examples.english_sentence: A judge must be impartial when making a judgment, and cannot be biased just because the defendant is a relative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢係我最好嘅朋友，但係喺工作上面，我都會幫理不幫親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5, daan6 hai6 hai2 gung1 zok3 soeng6 min6, ngo5 dou1 wui5 bong1 lei5 bat1 bong1 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他是我最好的朋友，但是在工作上，我都会帮理不帮亲。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is my best friend, in work, I will still side with reason, not with friends.

english_meaning: to help take a look; to give advice/assistance based on observation; to keep an eye on
explanation_mandarin: 帮助观察，提供意见或协助；协助照看。
explanation_english: To help by taking a look, offering advice, or providing assistance based on what one observes. Also, can mean to help keep an eye on something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫眼睇吓呢份合約有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngaan5 tai2 haa5 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮忙看看这份合同有没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me take a look at this contract and see if there are any problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我出去買嘢，你幫眼睇住啲行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 chut1 heoi3 maai5 ye5, nei5 bong1 ngaan5 tai2 zyu6 di1 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我出去买东西，你帮忙看着行李。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going out to buy something, can you help me keep an eye on the luggage?

english_meaning: to chime in; to back up; to support verbally; to echo; to second
explanation_mandarin: 指在别人说话时，从旁附和，支持或帮助说话。多含贬义，指没有主见，盲目支持。
explanation_english: To chime in with someone's opinion or statement, often to support or agree with them. It can sometimes have a negative connotation, implying a lack of independent thought and blind support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都喺度幫佢哋幫腔，有冇諗過自己嘅立場呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 bong1 keoi5 dei6 bong1 koeng1, jau5 mou5 nim2 gwo3 zi6 gei2 ge3 lip6 coeng2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是帮他们帮腔，有没有考虑过自己的立场啊？
examples.english_sentence: You always chime in to support them. Have you ever considered your own position?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一唱一和，夾埋一齊幫腔，真係好難應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 coeng3 jat1 wo4, gaap3 maai4 jat1 cai4 bong1 koeng1, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 jing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个一唱一和，合伙一起帮腔，真难应付。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them sing in harmony and work together to support each other, making them really difficult to deal with.

english_meaning: to subsidize, to supplement, to help out (financially)
explanation_mandarin: 指提供经济上的帮助，使不足的得以补充。
explanation_english: To provide financial assistance to supplement an existing source of income or to cover a shortfall; to help out financially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做多份兼職，幫補下屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 do1 fan6 gim1 zik1, bong1 bou2 haa5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我多做一份兼职，补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking on an extra part-time job to supplement the family income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工唔係好多錢，但係都叫做可以幫補下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 m4 hai6 hou2 do1 cin2, daan6 hai6 dou1 giu3 zou6 ho2 ji5 bong1 bou2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作挣不了多少钱，但至少可以补贴一下。
examples.english_sentence: His job doesn't pay much, but it helps to supplement his income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派錢，希望可以幫補下市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 cin2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bong1 bou2 haa5 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府发钱，希望可以补贴一下市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government is giving out money, hoping to subsidize the citizens.

english_meaning: to supplement the family income; to contribute to household expenses
explanation_mandarin: 帮助家庭增加收入，以减轻经济负担。
explanation_english: To contribute to the family's income, often to alleviate financial burdens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放工之後仲會做兼職，幫補家計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 zung6 wui5 zou6 gim1 zik1, bong1 bou2 gaa1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下班后还会做兼职，补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: After work, he also does part-time jobs to supplement the family income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，佢想搵份工幫補家計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, keoi5 soeng2 wan2 fan6 gung1 bong1 bou2 gaa1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，他想找份工作补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't good now, he wants to find a job to contribute to the household expenses.

english_meaning: to patronize, to support a business by buying goods or services
explanation_mandarin: 惠顾，光顾。指顾客对商店或服务机构购买商品或接受服务。
explanation_english: To patronize, meaning to support a business by purchasing goods or services from it. It implies giving business to a particular establishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日都幫襯呢間餐廳㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 bong1 can3 ni1 gaan1 can1 teng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常光顾这家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: We often patronize this restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你今日嚟幫襯啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam1 jat6 lai4 bong1 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你今天来光顾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for patronizing us today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新開嘅舖頭要多啲人幫襯先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 hoi1 ge3 pou3 tau2 jiu3 do1 di1 jan4 bong1 can3 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新开的店铺需要多一些人光顾才可以。
examples.english_sentence: A newly opened shop needs more people to patronize it in order to succeed.

english_meaning: to patronize, to do business with
explanation_mandarin: 惠顾，光顾，照顾生意。
explanation_english: To patronize a business; to support a business by being a customer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日都幫襯呢間餐廳㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 dou1 bong1 can3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常光顾这家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: We often patronize this restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你今日嚟幫襯啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam1 jat6 lai4 bong1 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你今天来光顾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for patronizing us today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望大家多多幫襯我哋嘅新店啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 daai6 gaa1 do1 do1 bong1 can3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 san1 dim3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望大家多多光顾我们的新店。
examples.english_sentence: We hope everyone will patronize our new store.

english_meaning: to lighten the burden; to help; to alleviate
explanation_mandarin: 减轻别人的负担或工作量，提供帮助。
explanation_english: To reduce someone's burden or workload, to provide assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家咁忙，我幫輕你手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 mong4, ngo5 bong1 heng1 nei5 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在这么忙，我帮你一把吧。
examples.english_sentence: You are so busy now, let me give you a hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，我幫輕你溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si5, ngo5 bong1 heng1 nei5 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，我帮你复习。
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow, I'll help you revise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司裁員，希望可以幫輕返公司嘅經濟壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 coi4 wun4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bong1 heng1 faan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ging1 zai3 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裁员，希望可以减轻公司的经济压力。
examples.english_sentence: The company is laying off employees, hoping to alleviate the company's financial pressure.

english_meaning: Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) or similar rank; low-ranking police officer
explanation_mandarin: 旧时香港警队中级别较低的警官称谓，相当于助理警司或更低的级别。
explanation_english: A term used in the old Hong Kong police force to refer to a low-ranking police officer, equivalent to an Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) or lower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣做過幫辦，不過後嚟升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 zou6 gwo3 bong1 baan6, bat1 gwo3 hau6 lai4 sing1 zo2 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候做过帮办，不过后来升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be an Assistant Superintendent of Police when he was young, but he got promoted later.

english_meaning: Junior police officer; Little helper; A somewhat derogatory term for a junior police officer
explanation_mandarin: “幫辦”指旧时的警官，相当于现在的督察级别。“幫辦仔”指资历浅，级别低的年轻警官。带有轻蔑或戏谑的意味。
explanation_english: "幫辦" (bong1 baan6) refers to a police officer in the old days, roughly equivalent to the rank of Inspector now. "幫辦仔" (bong1 baan6 zai2) refers to a young and inexperienced police officer of low rank. It carries a slightly derogatory or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗警隊唔夠一年，都仲係個幫辦仔啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 ging2 deoi2 m4 gau3 jat1 nin4, dou1 zung1 hai6 go3 bong1 baan6 zai2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他加入警队还不到一年，还是个小警官而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in the police force for less than a year, he's just a junior police officer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪睇小佢係幫辦仔，佢好醒目㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tai2 siu2 keoi5 hai6 bong1 baan6 zai2, keoi5 hou2 sing2 muk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别小看他是个小警官，他很精明的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him just because he's a junior police officer, he's very clever.

english_meaning: to do, to work, to manage, to make, to engage in; (slang) to have sex
explanation_mandarin: 表示做、进行、从事某种活动。在口语中也表示弄，搞。有时也作为粗俗用语表示性行为。
explanation_english: Indicates doing, carrying out, or engaging in a certain activity. In colloquial Cantonese, it can also mean 'to make' or 'to manage'. Sometimes it can be used as a vulgar term for sexual intercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日想干啲乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 soeng2 gon3 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天想做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to do today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齐干杯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gon1 bui1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起干杯吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's cheers together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂干嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gon3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱搞事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess things up.

english_meaning: War; weapons of war
explanation_mandarin: 指战争或兵器。多用于书面语。
explanation_english: Refers to war or weapons of war. Mostly used in formal written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望世界可以冇晒干戈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 sai3 gaai3 ho2 ji5 mou5晒 gon1 go1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望世界可以没有战争了。
examples.english_sentence: I hope there will be no more wars in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅干戈終於平息咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gon1 go1 zung1 jyu1 ping4 sik1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的战争终于平息了。
examples.english_sentence: The war between them has finally subsided.

english_meaning: to interfere; to disturb; interference; disturbance
explanation_mandarin: 打扰；妨碍。
explanation_english: To interfere with; to disturb; to hinder; also refers to the interference or disturbance itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好干擾我做嘢啦，我好忙㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gon1 jiu2 ngo5 zou6 je5 laa1, ngo5 hou2 mong4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要干扰我工作了，我很忙的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't disturb me while I'm working, I'm very busy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電話訊號受到干擾，聽唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 waa2 seon3 hou6 sau6 dou2 gon1 jiu2, teng1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话信号受到干扰，听不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The phone signal is experiencing interference, I can't hear clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅行為干擾咗附近居民嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 wai4 gon1 jiu2 zo2 fu6 gan6 geoi1 man4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的行为干扰了附近居民的生活。
examples.english_sentence: Their behavior disturbed the lives of nearby residents.

english_meaning: Stem-Branch system; sexagenary cycle
explanation_mandarin: 中国古代的一种纪年方法，用天干（甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、癸）和地支（子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥）依次循环搭配，组成六十个基本单位，用来记录年、月、日、时。
explanation_english: The Stem-Branch system, also known as the sexagenary cycle, is a traditional Chinese system for numbering years, months, days, and hours. It uses a combination of ten Heavenly Stems and twelve Earthly Branches to create a cycle of sixty unique units.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年係咩干支年啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hai6 me1 gon1 zi1 nin4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年是什么干支年？
examples.english_sentence: What Stem-Branch year is this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好識計干支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 sik1 gai3 gon1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太会计算干支。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very good at calculating the Stem-Branch.

english_meaning: to interfere in politics; to meddle in government
explanation_mandarin: 指干预政府或政治事务。
explanation_english: Refers to interfering with governmental or political affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好干政啦，做好你自己嘅嘢咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gon1 zing3 laa1, zou6 hou2 nei5 zi6 gei2 ge3 je5 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要干涉政治了，做好你自己的事情不就行了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't interfere in politics, just do your own job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都干政，搞到個政府亂晒籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gon1 zing3, gaau2 dou3 go3 zing3 fu2 lyun6晒籠.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是干涉政治，搞得整个政府一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: He always interferes in politics, making the government a mess.

english_meaning: to interfere, to intervene, to meddle
explanation_mandarin: 介入或过问（别人的事情）。
explanation_english: To interfere or intervene in (someone else's affairs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好干涉我嘅事啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gon1 sip3 ngo5 ge3 si6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要干涉我的事了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't interfere in my affairs!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔應該干涉商業活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 jing1 goi1 gon1 sip3 soeng1 jip6 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不应该干涉商业活动。
examples.english_sentence: The government shouldn't interfere in commercial activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔鍾意人干涉佢嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zung1 yi3 jan4 gon1 sip3 keoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不喜欢别人干涉她的决定。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't like people interfering with her decisions.

english_meaning: to offend; to violate; to infringe upon
explanation_mandarin: 冒犯、触犯法律、规定或他人。
explanation_english: To offend, to violate laws, regulations, or others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢干犯咗法律，要受到法律嘅制裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gon1 faan6 zo2 faat3 leot6, jiu3 sau6 dou2 faat3 leot6 ge3 zai3 caai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他触犯了法律，要受到法律的制裁。
examples.english_sentence: He violated the law and will be subject to legal sanctions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好干犯人哋嘅私隱。

english_meaning: Tones in Chinese poetry; even and oblique tones
explanation_mandarin: 平仄是指汉语诗词中声调的抑扬顿挫，是中国古典诗歌格律的重要组成部分。平声和仄声的交替使用，使诗歌富有音乐美。
explanation_english: "Ping Zak" (平仄) refers to the tonal patterns in Chinese poetry, specifically the alternation of level (ping) and oblique (zak) tones. It's a crucial element in the prosody of classical Chinese poetry, contributing to its rhythmic and musical quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫舊詩要留意平仄，唔係就唔啱格律啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 gau6 si1 jiu3 lau4 ji3 ping4 zak1, m4 hai6 zau6 m4 ngaam1 gaak3 leot6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写旧诗要注意平仄，不然就不符合格律了。
examples.english_sentence: When writing classical poetry, you need to pay attention to the tones, otherwise it won't conform to the rules.

english_meaning: to subside, to calm down, to quell, to alleviate

english_meaning: cheap, inexpensive, bargain-priced

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来想着随便买个便宜的手提包而已，结果用了几天就坏了，真是便宜没好货。

english_meaning: level ground; flat land; ground level
explanation_mandarin: 指平坦的土地。
explanation_english: Refers to flat, level ground or land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係平地，好適合起樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 ping4 dei6, hou2 sik1 hap6 hei2 lau2.

examples.english_sentence: This is flat land, very suitable for building houses.

examples.english_sentence: We'll set up camp on flat ground, it's more convenient.

english_meaning: average; mean; equally; evenly
explanation_mandarin: 指把总数按份儿均匀计算； 平均地分配或承担；中间的; 一定的程度.
explanation_english: To calculate the average or mean; to distribute or bear equally; of moderate or intermediate degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋平均分咗啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ping4 gwan1 fan1 zo2 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们平均分了这些钱。
examples.english_sentence: We divided the money equally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢科嘅平均分係幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 ge3 ping4 gwan1 fan1 hai6 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这门课的平均分是多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: What is the average grade for this course?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現只係平均水平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 hin3 zi2 hai6 ping4 gwan1 seoi2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现只是平均水平。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is only at an average level.

english_meaning: average, mean
explanation_mandarin: 一组数据的平均数，将所有数值加起来然后除以数值的个数。
explanation_english: The average or mean of a set of data, calculated by adding all the values together and dividing by the number of values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班學生嘅平均值係七十分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 hok6 sang1 ge3 ping4 gwan1 zik6 hai6 cat1 sap6 fan1.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計下今年嘅收入平均值有幾多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 haa5 gam1 nin4 ge3 sau1 jap6 ping4 gwan1 zik6 jau5 gei2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们计算一下今年的收入平均值有多少。
examples.english_sentence: Let's calculate what the average income is this year.

english_meaning: flat; level; smooth
explanation_mandarin: 指地面或物体表面没有高低不平，光滑。
explanation_english: Describing a surface or ground that is without bumps or unevenness; smooth and level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路好平坦，單車都踩得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 hou2 ping4 taan2, daan1 ce1 dou1 caai2 dak1 syu1 fuk1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很平坦，骑自行车都舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: The road is very flat, so it's more comfortable to ride a bike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊地夠平坦，起樓就啱曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 dei6 gau3 ping4 taan2, hei2 lau2 zau6 ngaam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块地足够平坦，盖楼就最合适了。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of land is flat enough; it's perfect for building a house.

english_meaning: Pyongyang (capital of North Korea)
explanation_mandarin: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的首都。
explanation_english: The capital city of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺地圖上面搵到平壤嘅位置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 wan2 dou2 ping4 joeng2 ge3 wai6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在地图上找到了平壤的位置。
examples.english_sentence: We found the location of Pyongyang on the map.

english_meaning: safe and sound; peaceful; without incident; security; peace
explanation_mandarin: 形容没有危险，没有事故发生；指平静、安宁的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being safe from danger or harm; refers to a peaceful and tranquil state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你一路平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 jat1 lou6 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你一路平安。
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a safe journey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係希望佢哋可以平安返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ping4 on1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只希望他们可以平安回来。
examples.english_sentence: I just hope they can come back safe and sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，身體健康，出入平安！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, cheut1 jap6 ping4 on1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，身体健康，出入平安！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year, good health, and safe travels!

mandarin_meaning: 平安包 (传统上在太平清醮时派发的包子)
english_meaning: Peace bun; safety bun (a type of bun traditionally distributed during the Cheung Chau Bun Festival or other religious festivals for good luck and safety)
explanation_mandarin: 一种在香港长洲太平清醮或其他宗教节日期间派发的传统包子，象征平安和好运。
explanation_english: A traditional bun distributed during the Cheung Chau Bun Festival in Hong Kong, or other religious festivals. It symbolizes peace, safety, and good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年嘅長洲太平清醮，都有好多人去搶平安包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 ge3 coeng4 zau1 taai3 ping4 cing1 ziu3, dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 coeng2 ping4 on1 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年的长洲太平清醮，都有很多人去抢平安包。
examples.english_sentence: Every year during the Cheung Chau Bun Festival, many people go to grab the peace buns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗個平安包，希望今年可以平平安安啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 go3 ping4 on1 baau1, hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 ping4 ping4 on1 on1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了平安包，希望今年可以平平安安。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a peace bun, hoping for a safe and peaceful year.

english_meaning: Christmas Eve
explanation_mandarin: 指圣诞节的前一天晚上，即12月24日。
explanation_english: Christmas Eve, the evening before Christmas Day on December 24th.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋平安夜會一齊食飯慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ping4 on1 je2 wui5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们平安夜会一起吃饭庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: We will have dinner together to celebrate on Christmas Eve.

english_meaning: Rice for blessing and protection (usually obtained from temples)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指从寺庙或道观中求来，用于保佑平安的米。人们认为这些米经过神灵的加持，具有保平安、祛病消灾的功效。
explanation_english: Refers to rice obtained from temples (Buddhist or Taoist) believed to bring blessings and protection. It is believed to be blessed by deities and capable of ensuring safety, health, and warding off misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆成日都去廟度攞平安米，話食咗會身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 miu6 dou6 lo2 ping4 on1 mai5, waa6 sik6 zo2 wui5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶总是去庙里拿平安米，说吃了会身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: My grandma always goes to the temple to get rice for blessing, saying that eating it will keep you healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講食平安米可以保平安，所以我都買咗啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 sik6 ping4 on1 mai5 ho2 ji5 bou2 ping4 on1, so2 ji5 ngo5 dou1 maai5 zo2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说吃平安米可以保平安，所以我也买了一些。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that eating rice for blessing can ensure safety and protection, so I bought some.

english_meaning: Will (legal document)
explanation_mandarin: 指在生前预先写好，并在过世后生效的法律文件，用以分配遗产。
explanation_english: A legal document written in advance while alive that takes effect after death, used to distribute assets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢立咗平安紙，將所有財產都留俾佢個仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lap6 zo2 ping4 on1 zi2, zoeng1 so2 jau5 choi4 saan2 dou1 lau4 bei2 keoi5 go3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他立了遗嘱，将所有财产都留给了他的儿子。
examples.english_sentence: He made a will, leaving all his assets to his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好都係搵律師寫返份平安紙，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 wan2 leot6 si1 se2 faan1 fan6 ping4 on1 zi2, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好还是找律师写一份遗嘱，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better find a lawyer to write a will, just in case.

english_meaning: Herbal tea for good health and safety; herbal tea for peace
explanation_mandarin: 一种通常由多种中草药熬制而成的茶，具有清热解毒、祛湿等功效。人们饮用平安茶，希望能保平安健康，预防疾病。
explanation_english: A herbal tea typically made from various Chinese medicinal herbs, believed to have heat-clearing, detoxifying, and dampness-reducing effects. People drink 'Ping On Cha' hoping to maintain good health, safety, and prevent illnesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯平安茶先，祛下濕氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 bui1 ping4 on1 caa4 sin1, keoi1 haa5 sap1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先喝一杯平安茶，去除一些湿气。
examples.english_sentence: Drink a cup of herbal tea first to get rid of some dampness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間涼茶鋪嘅平安茶好出名，好多人都嚟飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 leung4 caa4 pou3 ge3 ping4 on1 caa4 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 lai4 yam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家凉茶店的平安茶很有名，很多人都来喝。
examples.english_sentence: This herbal tea shop's 'Ping On Cha' is very famous, many people come to drink it.

mandarin_meaning: 镇静药物, 保平安的药
english_meaning: Mild sedative, medicine for safety and peace of mind
explanation_mandarin: 指一些药性比较温和，主要作用是镇静，使人心情平静，或者是有助于睡眠的药物。也泛指一些能带来安慰，让人感觉安心的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to mild sedatives or medications that calm the nerves and promote a sense of peace. It can also refer to things that bring comfort and a sense of security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近瞓得唔好，醫生開咗啲平安葯俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 fan3 dak1 m4 hou2, yi1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 di1 ping4 on1 joek6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近睡不好，医生开了一些镇静药给他。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been sleeping well lately, so the doctor prescribed him some mild sedatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽下啲輕音樂當食平安葯啦，放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 haa5 di1 hing1 jam1 ngok6 dong3 sik6 ping4 on1 joek6 laa1, fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听些轻音乐当吃镇静药吧，放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: Listen to some light music as if you're taking a sedative, relax a bit.

english_meaning: placebo, dummy pill
explanation_mandarin: 一种没有药理作用的物质，用来安慰病人或作为对照组使用。
explanation_english: A substance that has no therapeutic effect, used to comfort patients or as a control in experimental testing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生開咗啲平安藥畀佢，等佢心理上好過啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 di1 ping4 on1 joek6 bei2 keoi5, dang2 keoi5 sam1 lei5 soeng6 hou2 gwo3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生给他开了一些安慰剂，让他心理上好过一些。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor prescribed him some placebos to make him feel better psychologically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時平安藥嘅作用都幾大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 ping4 on1 joek6 ge3 jok6 yung6 dou1 gei2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候安慰剂的作用也挺大的。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes the effect of a placebo is quite significant.

english_meaning: Personal emergency alarm system; Panic alarm for the elderly/vulnerable
explanation_mandarin: 一种为老年人或需要帮助的人士设计的紧急呼叫系统。通常是一个可以随身携带的按钮或装置，使用者在遇到紧急情况时可以按下按钮，连接到服务中心寻求帮助。
explanation_english: A personal emergency alarm system designed for the elderly or individuals who need assistance. It is typically a button or device that can be carried around. When the user encounters an emergency, they can press the button to connect to a service center for help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆一個人住，屋企裝咗個平安鐘，有咩事都可以即刻搵人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6, uk1 kei2 zong1 zo2 go3 ping4 on1 zung1, jau5 me1 si6 dou1 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 wan2 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶一个人住，家里安装了平安钟，有什么事都可以立刻找人帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma lives alone, so she has a personal emergency alarm system installed at home. If anything happens, she can immediately get help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 平安鐘嘅作用就係喺緊急嘅時候可以快速咁聯絡到救援人員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 on1 zung1 ge3 zok3 yung6 zau6 hai6 hai2 gan2 gap1 ge3 si4 hau6 ho2 ji5 faai3 suk1 gam2 lyun4 lok3 dou3 gau3 wun4 jan4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 平安钟的作用就是在紧急的时候可以快速地联系到救援人员。
examples.english_sentence: The function of a personal emergency alarm system is to quickly contact rescue personnel in an emergency.

english_meaning: to pacify; to quell; to stabilize
explanation_mandarin: 使动乱或局面安定下来。
explanation_english: To bring peace and stability to a situation that is in turmoil; to suppress unrest or rebellion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府軍隊好快就平定咗叛亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gwan1 deoi6 hou2 faai3 zau6 ping4 ding6 zo2 bun6 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府军队很快就平定了叛乱。
examples.english_sentence: The government troops quickly quelled the rebellion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年嘅努力，佢終於平定咗嗰個地區嘅局勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 nu5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ping4 ding6 zo2 go2 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 guk6 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年的努力，他终于平定了那个地区的局势。
examples.english_sentence: After many years of effort, he finally stabilized the situation in that region.

mandarin_meaning: 朴实, 平淡, 实在
english_meaning: simple and unadorned, down-to-earth, unpretentious, practical, realistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人的风格简单朴素，不追求华丽和虚浮。也指实在，不花哨。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as simple and unadorned, not pursuing luxury and superficiality. It also refers to being practical and not flashy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好平實，唔鍾意啲花巧嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ping4 sat6, m4 zung1 ji3 di1 faa1 haau2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很朴实，不喜欢花哨的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very down-to-earth person and doesn't like fancy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計好平實，但係好實用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 hou2 ping4 sat6, daan6 hai6 hou2 sat6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计很朴实，但是很实用。
examples.english_sentence: This design is very simple, but very practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好平實，做嘢好踏實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 ping4 sat6, zou6 je5 hou2 daap6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人很实在，做事很踏实。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very down-to-earth person and works very diligently.

english_meaning: usually, ordinarily, normally, commonly; common, ordinary, usual
explanation_mandarin: 一般的情况，通常的状态；指普通，不特别。
explanation_english: Refers to the usual or normal situation or state; means common, ordinary, not special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋平常七點起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ping4 soeng4 cat1 dim2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们平常七点起床。
examples.english_sentence: We usually get up at 7 o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係平常事嚟啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 ping4 soeng4 si6 lai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是平常事而已。
examples.english_sentence: These are just ordinary things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日嘅表現唔係平常咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ge3 biu2 hin3 m4 hai6 ping4 soeng4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天的表现不像平常一样。
examples.english_sentence: His performance today is not like usual.

english_meaning: ordinary person, common person, average person
explanation_mandarin: 指普通，平凡的人，没有特别的才能或地位。
explanation_english: Refers to an ordinary, common person who does not possess special talents or status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係一個平常人，唔係咩大人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 ping4 soeng4 jan4, m4 hai6 me1 daai6 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是一个普通人，不是什么大人物。
examples.english_sentence: He's just an ordinary person, not some big shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係平常人，過住平凡嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 ping4 soeng4 jan4, gwo3 zyu6 ping4 faan4 ge3 saang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是普通人，过着平凡的生活。
examples.english_sentence: We are all ordinary people, living ordinary lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估下佢係咪一個平常人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 haa5 keoi5 hai6 mai6 jat1 go3 ping4 soeng4 jan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜猜他是不是一个普通人？
examples.english_sentence: Guess if he's an ordinary person?

english_meaning: equanimity, a calm and composed state of mind, to keep a level head
explanation_mandarin: 指在面对各种情况时，保持心态平和、冷静的态度，不轻易被外界影响。
explanation_english: Refers to maintaining a calm and composed state of mind when facing various situations, not easily swayed by external influences; keeping things in perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考成點都好，最緊要係保持平常心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 sing4 dim2 dou1 hou2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 bou2 ci4 ping4 soeng4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考得怎么样都好，最重要的是保持平常心。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how the exam goes, the most important thing is to keep a level head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人呢，平常心面對挑戰就得㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 ne1, ping4 soeng4 sam1 min6 deoi3 tiu1 zin3 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人啊，用平常心面对挑战就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: In life, just face challenges with a calm attitude.

english_meaning: Ordinary; common; so-so; mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或某人的表现、质量等处于一般的水平，不高也不低。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone's performance, quality, etc., being at an average level, neither high nor low. Indicates mediocrity or being ordinary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試成績平平啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 sing4绩 ping4 ping2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的考试成绩一般般。
examples.english_sentence: His exam results were so-so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食味道平平，唔值得推薦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 mei6 dou6 ping4 ping2, m4 zik6 dak1 tui1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物味道一般，不值得推荐。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is mediocre, not worth recommending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人平平，冇乜特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 ping4 ping2, mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6.

english_meaning: square foot, sq ft
explanation_mandarin: 一种面积单位，相当于边长为一英尺的正方形的面积。
explanation_english: A unit of area equal to the area of a square with sides of 1 foot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋有五百平方尺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jau5 ng5 baak3 ping4 fong1 chek2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子有五百平方英尺。
examples.english_sentence: This apartment has five hundred square feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅樓通常都係用平方尺嚟計價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lau2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 jung6 ping4 fong1 chek2 lai4 gai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的房子通常都是用平方英尺来计价。
examples.english_sentence: Apartments in Hong Kong are usually priced by the square foot.

english_meaning: square root
explanation_mandarin: 一个数的平方根是指一个数，当它自身乘以自身时等于给定的数。例如，4的平方根是2，因为2乘以2等于4。
explanation_english: The square root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself, gives the original number. For example, the square root of 4 is 2 because 2 multiplied by 2 equals 4.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 四嘅平方根係二。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 ge3 ping4 fong1 gan1 hai6 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 4的平方根是2。
examples.english_sentence: The square root of 4 is 2.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 計平方根要用啲乜嘢公式？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 ping4 fong1 gan1 jiu3 yung6 di1 mat1 je5 gung1 sik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 计算平方根需要用什么公式？
examples.english_sentence: What formula is needed to calculate the square root?

english_meaning: square meter
explanation_mandarin: 面积单位，等于边长为一米的正方形的面积。
explanation_english: A unit of area equal to the area of a square with sides one meter long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋有幾大啊？大約一百平方米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 jau5 gei2 daai6 aa3? daai6 joek3 jat1 baak3 ping4 fong1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子有多大？大约一百平方米。
examples.english_sentence: How big is the apartment? Approximately 100 square meters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊地有成千平方米，可以起幾棟樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 dei6 jau5 seng4 cin1 ping4 fong1 mai5, ho2 ji5 hei2 gei2 dung6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块地有整一千平方米，可以盖几栋楼。
examples.english_sentence: This plot of land is a whole thousand square meters, enough to build several buildings.

english_meaning: ordinarily; usually; normally; weekdays
explanation_mandarin: 通常情况下，一般的时间；也指工作日，非周末或节假日。
explanation_english: Refers to the usual time or ordinary days; also refers to weekdays, non-weekends or holidays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋平日都好忙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ping4 jat6 dou1 hou2 mong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们平时都很忙的。
examples.english_sentence: We are usually very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 平日我搭地鐵返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 jat6 ngo5 daap3 dei6 tit3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 平时我坐地铁上班。
examples.english_sentence: I usually take the MTR to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 平日呢間餐廳都好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 jat6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 dou1 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 平时这家餐厅都很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is usually crowded.

english_meaning: approachable; amiable; easy to get along with; affable
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度谦逊和蔼，容易接近。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is modest, kind, and easy to approach; someone who is amiable and down-to-earth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好平易近人，好容易同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ping4 ji6 gan6 jan4, hou2 jung4 yi6 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很平易近人，很容易和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very approachable person; it's easy to chat with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位老闆冇乜架子，好平易近人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 lou5 baan2 mou5 mat1 gaa3 zi2, hou2 ping4 ji6 gan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位老板没什么架子，很平易近人。
examples.english_sentence: This boss isn't pretentious and is very approachable.

synonyms: 和藹可親 (wo4 oi2 ho2 can1)

english_meaning: usually; normally; ordinarily; in normal times; at ordinary times; on weekdays; habitually
explanation_mandarin: 通常的时候；一般情况下。也指平常的日子。
explanation_english: Refers to the usual time; normally; generally. Can also refer to ordinary days or weekdays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你平時鍾意做啲咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ping4 si4 zung1 ji3 zou6 di1 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你平时喜欢做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What do you usually like to do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我平時返工都搭地鐵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ping4 si4 faan1 gung1 dou1 daap3 dei6 tit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我平时上班都坐地铁。
examples.english_sentence: I usually take the subway to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時唔係咁㗎，今日唔知點解咁靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 m4 hai6 gam2 gaa3, gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时不是这样的，今天不知道为什么这么安静。
examples.english_sentence: He's not usually like this; I don't know why he's so quiet today.

english_meaning: Tablet computer; Flat, even; Bland, uninteresting
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指平板电脑。 2. 形容东西表面平坦。3. 形容事物缺乏趣味，平淡。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a tablet computer. 2. Describes a surface that is flat and even. 3. Describes something that is bland, uninteresting, or lacks depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部新平板嚟睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ping4 baan2 lai4 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一部新平板电脑来看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new tablet to watch movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路好平板，啱晒踩單車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 ping4 baan2, ngaam1 saai3 caai2 daan1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很平坦，非常适合骑自行车。
examples.english_sentence: This road is very flat, perfect for cycling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅情節好平板，一啲都唔吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 cing4 zit3 hou2 ping4 baan2, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的情节很平淡，一点都不吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very bland, not attractive at all.

english_meaning: Tablet computer, tablet
explanation_mandarin: 一种便携式个人电脑，主要通过触摸屏操作。
explanation_english: A portable personal computer operated primarily by a touchscreen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部平板電腦壞咗，攞去整都整唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 ping4 baan2 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, lo2 heoi3 zeng2 dou1 zeng2 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的平板电脑坏了，拿去修也修不好。
examples.english_sentence: My tablet computer is broken, and I can't get it fixed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲細路仔好叻用平板電腦嚟睇卡通片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 hou2 lek1 yung6 ping4 baan2 din6 nou5 lai4 tai2 kaa1 tung1 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的小孩很会用平板电脑来看卡通片。
examples.english_sentence: Kids nowadays are good at using tablets to watch cartoons.

english_meaning: Equal Opportunities Commission (EOC)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的法定机构，负责执行反歧视条例，促进平等机会。
explanation_english: The statutory body in Hong Kong responsible for implementing anti-discrimination ordinances and promoting equal opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你覺得受到歧視，可以向平機會投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 sau6 dou3 kei4 si6, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 ping4 gwai1 wui2 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你觉得自己受到歧视，可以向平等机会委员会投诉。
examples.english_sentence: If you feel discriminated against, you can file a complaint with the Equal Opportunities Commission.

english_meaning: Equal rights; equality
explanation_mandarin: 指所有人在法律、政治、经济和社会等各个方面享有同等的权利和机会。
explanation_english: Refers to the principle that all individuals should have equal rights and opportunities under the law, in politics, economics, and society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為女性爭取平權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai4 neoi5 sing3 zaang1 ceoi2 ping4 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为女性争取平权。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fight for equal rights for women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港都需要平權，唔應該歧視任何國籍嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 ping4 kyun4, m4 jing1 goi1 kei4 si6 jam6 ho2 gwok3 zik3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港也需要平权，不应该歧视任何国籍的人。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong also needs equal rights; we shouldn't discriminate against people of any nationality.

english_meaning: to have a meteoric rise; to rapidly rise to a high position; to have a smooth and rapid career advancement
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一下子轻易登上很高的官位。也比喻很快就得到很高的成就。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a rapid and smooth career advancement, suggesting someone quickly attains a high position or achieves great success effortlessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一畢業就入咗大公司，好快就平步青雲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 yat1 bat1 gip3 jau6 yap6 zo2 daai6 gung1 si1, hou2 faai3 jau6 ping4 bou6 ching1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一毕业就进入大公司，很快就平步青云。
examples.english_sentence: He joined a big company right after graduation and quickly rose to a high position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住自己嘅努力，喺公司裡面平步青雲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 kaau3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6, hai2 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6 ping4 bou6 ching1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他依靠自己的努力，在公司里平步青云。
examples.english_sentence: He relied on his own hard work and achieved a meteoric rise within the company.

english_meaning: common people; ordinary people; civilian
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上普通老百姓，相对于统治阶级、权贵或精英而言。
explanation_english: Refers to the common people in society, as opposed to the ruling class, the powerful, or the elite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲政策應該照顧到平民嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jing1 caak3 ying1 goi1 ziu3 gu3 dou3 ping4 man4 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些政策应该照顾到平民的需求。
examples.english_sentence: These policies should cater to the needs of ordinary people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出身平民家庭，靠自己努力先至成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheot1 san1 ping4 man4 gaa1 ting4, kaau3 zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6 sin1 zai3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身于平民家庭，靠自己的努力才成功。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from a common family and succeeded through his own efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭傷害嘅往往都係平民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 jaang4 soeng1 hoi6 ge3 waang5 waang5 dou1 hai6 ping4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争伤害的往往都是平民。
examples.english_sentence: It is often the common people who are harmed by war.

english_meaning: to popularize, to make accessible to the common people, to democratize
explanation_mandarin: 使事物变得适合或能够被普通大众接受和使用；使高档或昂贵的事物变得更便宜，更普及。
explanation_english: To make something accessible, affordable, or relatable to the general public. It often implies making something that was previously exclusive or expensive more common and within reach of ordinary people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食平民化咗好多，以前好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 ping4 man4 faa3 zo2 hou2 do1, ji5 cin4 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物变得大众化了很多，以前很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant has become much more affordable. It used to be very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該將醫療服務平民化，等更多人可以得到醫治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 zoeng1 yi1 liu4 fuk6 mou6 ping4 man4 faa3, dang2 gang3 do1 jan4 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 yi1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该将医疗服务普及化，让更多人可以得到医治。
examples.english_sentence: The government should democratize healthcare services so that more people can receive treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想將藝術平民化，所以搞咗好多免費嘅展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 ngai6 seot6 ping4 man4 faa3, so2 ji5 gaau2 zo2 hou2 do1 min5 fai3 ge3 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想将艺术大众化，所以举办了很多免费的展览。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to popularize art, so he organized many free exhibitions.

english_meaning: spirit level
explanation_mandarin: 一种测量物体表面是否水平的工具。通过气泡在液体中的位置来判断。
explanation_english: A tool used to determine if a surface is level (horizontal). It works by using a bubble in a liquid to indicate whether the surface is level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用平水尺檢查下個檯面平唔平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ping4 seoi2 cek3 gim2 caa4 haa5 go3 toi2 min2 ping4 m4 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用水平仪检查一下桌面平不平。
examples.english_sentence: Use a spirit level to check if the table surface is level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅用平水尺較正咗個門框。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 jung6 ping4 seoi2 cek3 gaau3 zing3 zo2 go3 mun4 kwaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅用水平仪校正了门框。
examples.english_sentence: The craftsman used a spirit level to adjust the door frame.

mandarin_meaning: 不景气的行业；夕阳产业
english_meaning: a stagnant industry; a sunset industry
explanation_mandarin: 指发展停滞不前，缺乏增长前景的行业或领域。类似于夕阳产业。
explanation_english: Refers to an industry or field that is stagnant in development and lacks growth prospects. Similar to a sunset industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視行業而家都變咗平水樓咁滯啦，好多人都轉睇網上媒體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 hang4 jip6 ji4 gaa1 dou1 bin3 zo2 ping4 seoi2 lau4 gam2 zai6 laa1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zyun2 tai2 mong5 soeng6 mui4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视行业现在几乎都变成了夕阳产业了，很多人都转去看网络媒体。
examples.english_sentence: The television industry is almost a sunset industry now, a lot of people have switched to watching online media.

english_meaning: to sell off cheaply; to dump; to sell at a loss
explanation_mandarin: 以低于成本价或市价的价格出售。
explanation_english: To sell something at a price lower than its cost or market value, often due to financial difficulties or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公司因為財政困難，要將啲貨平沽出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 si1 yan1 wai6 coi4 zing3 kwan3 naan4, yiu3 jeung1 di1 fo3 ping4 gu1 cheut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司因为财政困难，要把货物贱卖出去。
examples.english_sentence: His company has to sell off its goods cheaply due to financial difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果樓市繼續跌，發展商可能要平沽啲樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 lau4 si5 gai3 zuk6 dit3, faat3 zin2 seung1 ho2 nang4 yiu3 ping4 gu1 di1 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果楼市继续下跌，发展商可能要贱卖一些楼房。
examples.english_sentence: If the property market continues to fall, developers may have to dump some properties.

english_meaning: ordinary; commonplace; uneventful; bland; insipid; flat
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或生活缺乏变化和刺激，没有特别之处。
explanation_english: Describing something or a life lacking change and excitement, without anything special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅婚姻生活好平淡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fan1 yan1 sang1 wut6 hou2 ping4 daam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的婚姻生活很平淡。
examples.english_sentence: Their married life is very ordinary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意啲情節太過平淡嘅戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 di1 ching4 jit3 taai3 gwo3 ping4 daam6 ge3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢情节太平淡的电影。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like movies with plots that are too uneventful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅生活日日都係咁，好平淡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 sang1 wut6 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2, hou2 ping4 daam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的生活每天都这样，很平淡。
examples.english_sentence: My life is the same every day, very ordinary.

english_meaning: smooth
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面光滑，没有凹凸或粗糙的地方。
explanation_english: Describing a surface that is smooth, without bumps or roughness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊木板表面好平滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 biu2 min6 hou2 ping4 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块木板表面很平滑。
examples.english_sentence: The surface of this wooden board is very smooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢塊面皮膚好平滑，睇落好後生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faai3 min6 pei4 fu1 hou2 ping4 waat6, tai2 lok6 hou2 hau6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的脸部皮肤很平滑，看起来很年轻。
examples.english_sentence: Her facial skin is very smooth, she looks very young.

english_meaning: lifetime; all one's life; in one's life
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的一生，或者一生中所经历的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's lifetime or the events experienced during one's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我平生最憎人講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ping4 sang1 zeoi3 zang1 jan4 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一生中最讨厌别人说谎。
examples.english_sentence: In my life, I hate liars the most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平生都好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 sang1 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生都很努力。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked hard all his life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平生最大嘅願望就係環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 sang1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 jyun6 mong6 zau6 hai6 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生最大的愿望就是环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: His greatest wish in life is to travel around the world.

english_meaning: stable, steady, smooth
explanation_mandarin: 指事物发展或运行状态稳定，没有大的波动或变化。
explanation_english: Describes a state of stability, steadiness, and smoothness, without significant fluctuations or changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸車揸得好平穩，我瞓得好冧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 ce1 zaa1 dak1 hou2 ping4 wan2, ngo5 fan3 dak1 hou2 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开车开得很平稳，我睡得很香。
examples.english_sentence: He drives very smoothly; I slept soundly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟情況都算平穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 cing4 fong3 dou1 syun3 ping4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济情况还算平稳。
examples.english_sentence: The economic situation is relatively stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病情已經平穩落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bing6 cing4 ji5 ging1 ping4 wan2 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病情已经稳定下来了。
examples.english_sentence: The patient's condition has stabilized.

english_meaning: equality; equal
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会地位、权利等方面处于相同的地位。
explanation_english: The state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該爭取男女平等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zaang1 ceoi2 naam4 neoi5 ping4 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该争取男女平等。
examples.english_sentence: We should strive for gender equality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法律面前，人人平等。

explanation_english: In Mahjong, winning with the most basic hand, without any special patterns or bonuses.

english_meaning: usually; ordinarily; normally; in ordinary times
explanation_mandarin: 指平常，通常的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the usual or normal situation; ordinarily.

examples.english_sentence: He is usually rarely late. I don't know why he's so late today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 平素我哋都喺度食飯嘅。

english_meaning: Level tone (in Chinese phonetics); first tone in Mandarin
explanation_mandarin: 指汉语声调的一种，普通话里的第一声，即阴平。
explanation_english: Refers to one of the tones in Chinese phonetics, specifically the first tone in Mandarin (yinping), characterized by a high and level pitch.

english_meaning: to split evenly; to go halves; to share equally; to divide 50/50
explanation_mandarin: 指将费用或利益平分，通常是两人之间。
explanation_english: Refers to splitting expenses or benefits evenly, usually between two people.

examples.english_sentence: How about we split the cost to buy a gift for him?

english_meaning: parallel
explanation_mandarin: 指向同一方向延伸的两条直线，在同一平面内永远不会相交。也比喻同时进行，互不干扰。
explanation_english: Refers to two straight lines that extend in the same direction and never intersect on the same plane. Also used figuratively to describe simultaneous activities that do not interfere with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩條線係平行㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 tiu4 sin3 hai6 ping4 hang4 gaa3.

examples.english_sentence: We are working on different projects at the same time, everyone is developing in parallel.

english_meaning: Parallel universe
explanation_mandarin: 指与我们所处的宇宙平行存在的，可能具有不同物理规律和历史的宇宙。
explanation_english: Refers to a hypothetical self-contained separate reality coexisting with our own.

examples.english_sentence: If parallel universes really exist, does that mean there's another me?

english_meaning: parallel universe; alternate reality
explanation_mandarin: 指与我们所处的宇宙平行存在的其他宇宙或时空，这些宇宙可能遵循不同的物理定律，拥有不同的历史和发展轨迹。
explanation_english: Refers to other universes or spacetime that exist parallel to our own, which may follow different physical laws and have different histories and developmental trajectories.  It's a concept often found in science fiction and philosophical discussions about possibility.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常想，会不会真的有平行时空呢？
examples.english_sentence: I often wonder if there really are parallel universes.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 在平行时空，可能我已经是个超级富豪了。
examples.english_sentence: In a parallel universe, I might already be a super-rich person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲講嘅就係主角穿梭唔同嘅平行時空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 ge3 zau6 hai6 zyu2 gok3 cyun1 so1 m4 tung4 ge3 ping4 hang4 si4 hung1.

examples.english_sentence: This movie is about the protagonist traveling through different parallel universes.

english_meaning: balance, equilibrium
explanation_mandarin: 指事物处于一种稳定、均衡的状态，或使事物达到这种状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of stability and equilibrium of things, or to bring things to this state.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财政状况很平衡。
examples.english_sentence: The financial situation of this company is very balanced.

english_meaning: paperback edition; softcover

english_meaning: cheap goods; bargain; cheap stuff
explanation_mandarin: 指价格低廉的商品，质量通常也相对较差。

english_meaning: to call it even, to break even, to offset, to cancel out

explanation_english: To make something balanced or even, typically after a loss or imbalance. It can also mean to call it even, to forget about something, or not pursue it further.

examples.english_sentence: This time we lost a little, next time we'll earn it back and call it even.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，这次这件事就放过他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, let's just call it even with him this time.

english_meaning: to be on an equal footing; to be on par with; to stand shoulder to shoulder
explanation_mandarin: 指地位、权力等方面相等或相近。
explanation_english: To be on an equal footing, often referring to status, power, or rank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司規模唔細，有機會同大公司平起平坐。

english_meaning: person of the same generation; peer; contemporary
explanation_mandarin: 指辈分相同的人，同辈。
explanation_english: Refers to someone of the same generation or social standing; a peer or contemporary.

examples.english_sentence: I am of the same generation as his children.

mandarin_meaning: 非常便宜; 到处都很便宜
english_meaning: Dirt cheap; extremely cheap; cheap everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 形容某样东西非常便宜，或者某个地方的东西普遍都很便宜。
explanation_english: Describes something as being very cheap, or a place where things are generally very cheap. Implies the cheapness is widespread and easily found.

english_meaning: to narrate plainly and directly; to present facts simply and straightforwardly
explanation_mandarin: 指叙述或描写事情平淡、直接，不加修饰，着重于陈述事实。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告平铺直叙地交代了整件事情的经过。
examples.english_sentence: His report narrated the whole course of events in a straightforward manner.

explanation_mandarin: 指用平淡的语言，按照事情发生的先后顺序进行叙述，不加任何修饰和渲染。

jyutping: nin4 co1 sei3 gam2 ge3 joeng2
mandarin_meaning: 形容一个人面有菜色，疲惫不堪的样子
english_meaning: Looking pale and tired, appearing worn out and weary (like after a long and busy Chinese New Year)
explanation_mandarin: 农历新年期间，初一到初三人们通常忙于拜年、聚会，比较操劳。到了初四，很多人就会显得疲惫不堪，面色也不太好。“年初四噉嘅樣”就用来形容一个人面容憔悴，疲惫的样子。
explanation_english: During the Lunar New Year, people are usually busy visiting relatives and friends from the first to the third day, which can be tiring. By the fourth day, many people look exhausted and pale. "年初四噉嘅樣" is used to describe someone who looks tired, worn out, and often pale.

examples.english_sentence: You've been looking pale and tired lately. Have you been very busy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴晚通宵打牌，而家年初四噉嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 maan1 tung1 siu2 daa2 paai2, ji4 gaa1 nin4 co1 sei3 gam2 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚通宵打牌，现在看起来很疲惫。
examples.english_sentence: He played cards all night last night, and now he looks completely worn out.

english_meaning: Lunar New Year's Eve

mandarin_meaning: 腊月二十八大扫除，腊月二十九用柚子叶洗澡
english_meaning: On the 28th day of the last month of the year, give everything a thorough cleaning; on the 29th day, bathe with pomelo leaves.
explanation_mandarin: 这是过年前的传统习俗。腊月二十八进行大扫除，清除一年的污垢，寓意辞旧迎新。腊月二十九用柚子叶洗澡，也寓意驱除霉运，在新的一年里带来好运。
explanation_english: This is a traditional custom before the Lunar New Year. On the 28th day of the last month of the year, people give their homes a thorough cleaning to sweep away the dirt and grime of the past year, symbolizing bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new. On the 29th day, people bathe with pomelo leaves, which is believed to ward off bad luck and bring good fortune in the coming year.
