examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了一本关于他爷爷的年谱，记录了他一生中的重要事迹。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a chronicle about his grandfather, recording all the important events of his life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係佢嘅年譜，你可以喺度了解佢嘅生平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 nin4 pou2, nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 dou6 liu5 gaai2 keoi5 ge3 sang1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是他的年谱，你可以在这里了解他的一生。
examples.english_sentence: This book is his chronicle, you can learn about his life here.

english_meaning: New Year goods; goods bought for the Lunar New Year celebration
explanation_mandarin: 春节前购买的各种物品，包括食品、装饰品等，用于过节。
explanation_english: Goods bought in preparation for the Lunar New Year celebration, including food, decorations, and gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要去行年貨，買啲好嘢過年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 haang4 nin4 fo3, maai5 di1 hou2 je5 gwo3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天要去逛年货市场，买些好东西过年。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the New Year market today to buy some nice things for the New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅年貨好貴啊，樣樣都加價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 nin4 fo3 hou2 gwai3 aa3, yeung2 yeung2 dou1 ga1 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的年货好贵啊，样样都涨价。
examples.english_sentence: This year's New Year goods are so expensive, everything is increasing in price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽準備咗好多豐富嘅年貨，包括糖果、瓜子同埋賀年食品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zyun2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 fung1 fu3 ge3 nin4 fo3, baau1 kwut3 tong2 gwo2, gwaa1 zi2 tung4 maai4 ho6 nin4 sik6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈准备了很多丰富的年货，包括糖果、瓜子和新年食品。
examples.english_sentence: Mom has prepared a lot of abundant New Year goods, including candy, melon seeds, and Lunar New Year food.

english_meaning: annual fee
explanation_mandarin: 每年需要支付的费用，通常指会员费、服务费等。
explanation_english: An annual fee is a fee charged once per year, often for memberships, subscriptions, or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張信用卡嘅年費幾多錢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 ge3 nin4 fai3 gei2 do1 chin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张信用卡的年费多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much is the annual fee for this credit card?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多健身室都有年費計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 gin3 san1 sat1 dou1 jau5 nin4 fai3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多健身房都有年费计划。
examples.english_sentence: Many gyms have annual fee plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間銀行豁免咗我今年嘅年費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 ngan4 hong4 wut6 min5 zo2 ngo5 gam1 nin4 ge3 nin4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行免除了我今年的年费。
examples.english_sentence: The bank waived my annual fee for this year.

english_meaning: seniority, length of service
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个机构工作的时间长短，通常用于衡量员工的经验和福利待遇。
explanation_english: Refers to the length of time someone has worked for an organization. Usually used to measure an employee's experience and benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司做咗十年，年資好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4, nin4 zi1 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司工作了十年，年资很深。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked at that company for ten years; he has a lot of seniority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年資越高，福利就越好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 zi1 yuet6 gou1, fuk1 lei6 zau6 yuet6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年资越高，福利就越好。
examples.english_sentence: The longer the seniority, the better the benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為年資嘅關係，佢升咗做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 nin4 zi1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为年资的关系，他升职成了经理。
examples.english_sentence: Because of his seniority, he was promoted to manager.

english_meaning: young
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄不大，生命力旺盛的阶段。
explanation_english: Referring to being of a young age, characterized by vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣好靚女㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 gwo2 zan6 hou2 leng3 neoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她年轻的时候很漂亮的。
examples.english_sentence: She was very beautiful when she was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁年輕，學嘢一定好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 nin4 hing1, hok6 je5 jat1 ding6 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么年轻，学东西肯定很快。
examples.english_sentence: You're so young, you must learn things very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家啲年輕人好有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人很有创意。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays are very creative.

english_meaning: young people, youth
explanation_mandarin: 指年纪较轻的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are young in age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲年輕人真係好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 nin4 ging1 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays are really capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後生嗰陣都係個年輕人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 dou1 hai6 go3 nin4 ging1 jan4 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我年轻的时候也是个年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: I was also a young person when I was young.

english_meaning: young and strong; in the prime of one's youth
explanation_mandarin: 形容人年纪轻，身体强壮，精力充沛。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is young, physically strong, and full of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生仔，年輕力壯，做嘢好快手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 zai2, nin4 ging1 lik6 zong3, zou6 je5 hou2 faai3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个年轻人，年轻力壮，做事很快。
examples.english_sentence: He is a young man, young and strong, and works very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋年輕力壯，應該多啲運動，唔好成日坐喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 nin4 ging1 lik6 zong3, ying1 goi1 do1 di1 wan6 dung6, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 co5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们年轻力壮，应该多做运动，不要总是坐在这里。
examples.english_sentence: You are young and strong, you should exercise more, don't always sit here.

english_meaning: growth rings (of a tree); annual rings
explanation_mandarin: 树木一年生长一轮，形成的环状纹理。
explanation_english: The concentric circles formed annually in the wood of a tree, representing a year's growth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇住樹嘅年輪，我哋可以估計到佢有幾老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 zyu6 syu6 ge3 nin4 leon4, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gu2 gai3 dou3 keoi5 jau5 gei2 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看着树的年轮，我们可以估计到它有多老。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at the tree's growth rings, we can estimate how old it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年輪好似係時間嘅紀錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 leon4 hou2 ci5 hai6 si4 gaan3 ge3 gei3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轮好像是时间的记录。
examples.english_sentence: Growth rings are like a record of time.

english_meaning: aged, elderly, old and frail
explanation_mandarin: 形容人年纪大，身体衰弱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is old and whose health is declining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爺爺已經好年邁，行路都要人扶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 je4 je4 ji5 ging1 hou2 nin4 maai6, haang4 lou6 dou1 jiu3 jan4 fu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的爷爷已经很年迈了，走路都要人扶。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is already very old and frail; he needs support to walk.

english_meaning: annuity; pension; yearly allowance
explanation_mandarin: 一种定期支付的金融产品，通常指每年或定期支付一定金额的投资或保险产品，类似于养老金。
explanation_english: A financial product that provides a stream of payments, typically annually or periodically. It is often used in the context of retirement planning, similar to a pension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋買咗份年金，等退休之後有穩定嘅收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maai5 zo2 fan6 nin4 gam1, dang2 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 jau5 wan2 ding6 ge3 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们买了一份年金，等退休之后有稳定的收入。
examples.english_sentence: They bought an annuity so they will have a stable income after retirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅年金計劃可以幫到好多長者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 nin4 gam1 gai3 waak6 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 ho2 do1 zoeng2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的年金计划可以帮助很多长者。
examples.english_sentence: The government's annuity scheme can help many elderly people.

english_meaning: yearbook; annual
explanation_mandarin: 按年度汇编的资料性书籍，通常包含上一年度的重要事件、统计数据和相关信息。
explanation_english: An annual publication that compiles information, typically including important events, statistics, and related information from the previous year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋學校每年都會出版一本年鑑，記錄學校嘅大事同埋學生嘅活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hok6 haau6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 ceot1 baan2 jat1 bun2 nin4 gaam3, gei3 luk6 hok6 haau6 ge3 daai6 si6 tung4 mai4 hok6 sang1 ge3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的学校每年都会出版一本年鉴，记录学校的大事和学生的活动。
examples.english_sentence: Their school publishes a yearbook every year, recording important events and student activities.

english_meaning: elderly; older; senior
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄较大。
explanation_english: Refers to being older in age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位年長嘅女士，好有經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 nin4 zoeng2 ge3 neoi5 si6, hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一位年长的女士，很有经验。
examples.english_sentence: She is an elderly lady with a lot of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重年長嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 nin4 zoeng2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重年长的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect elderly people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面，佢算係年長嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6, keoi5 syun3 hai6 nin4 zoeng2 ge3 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司里面，他算是年长的员工。
examples.english_sentence: In the company, he is considered a senior employee.

english_meaning: the end of the year (esp. referring to financial difficulties and pressure to settle debts before the Chinese New Year)
explanation_mandarin: 指农历年底，尤其指临近过年时，人们面临的经济压力、债务清偿等问题。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of the lunar year, especially the financial pressures and debt settlements people face as the Chinese New Year approaches. It implies a period of increased financial strain and difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年年關難過呀，爭人好多錢都未還到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 nin4 gwaan1 naan4 gwo3 aa3, zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2 dou1 mei6 waan4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年年关难过啊，欠别人很多钱都还没还到。
examples.english_sentence: This year the end of the year is going to be tough, I owe people a lot of money and haven't been able to pay it back yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一到年關，就好多人周圍撲水還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 dou3 nin4 gwaan1, zau6 hou2 do1 jan4 zau1 wai4 puk1 seoi2 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一到年关，就很多人到处筹钱还钱。
examples.english_sentence: As the end of the year approaches, many people are scrambling to find money to pay back debts.

english_meaning: young; youthful
explanation_mandarin: 指年纪不大，充满活力。
explanation_english: Referring to someone of a young age, full of energy and vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣好年青㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 gwo2 zan6 hou2 nin4 cing1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候很年轻的。
examples.english_sentence: He was very young when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅員工都好年青。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 wun4 gung1 dou1 hou2 nin4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的员工都很年轻。
examples.english_sentence: The employees of this company are all very young.

english_meaning: young people, youth
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的人，通常指青少年或刚成年的人。
explanation_english: Refers to young people, usually teenagers or those who have just reached adulthood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲年青人真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 cing1 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人真的很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: Young people these days are really smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要多啲支持年青人嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 do1 di1 zi1 ci4 nin4 cing1 jan4 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要多支持年轻人的发展。
examples.english_sentence: We need to support the development of young people more.

mandarin_meaning: 年初; 年初的时候; 年景
english_meaning: beginning of the year; early part of the year; crop year; harvest
explanation_mandarin: 指一年的开始，年初的时候。也可指年景，收成情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the beginning of the year, the early part of the year. Can also refer to the crop year or harvest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年年頭經濟唔係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 nin4 tau4 ging1 zai3 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年年初经济不太好。
examples.english_sentence: The economy hasn't been doing so well at the beginning of this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望今年年頭有個好開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 nin4 tau4 jau5 go3 hou2 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望今年年初有个好的开始。
examples.english_sentence: I hope this year has a good start at the beginning of the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊年年頭買咗層樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 nin4 nin4 tau4 maai5 zo2 cang4 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年年初买了一套房子。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an apartment at the beginning of last year.

english_meaning: age
explanation_mandarin: 指人或其他生物生存的时期长短。
explanation_english: The length of time that a person or other living being has existed; age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今年幾多歲呀？即係你嘅年齡係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 nin4 gei2 do1 seoi3 aa3? zik1 hai6 nei5 ge3 nin4 ling4 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今年多大年纪了？也就是说你的年龄是多少？
examples.english_sentence: How old are you this year? That is, what is your age?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想講我嘅年齡，因為我覺得自己仲後生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gong2 ngo5 ge3 nin4 ling4, jan1 wai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 zung1 hau6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想说我的年龄，因为我觉得自己还年轻。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to talk about my age because I feel young.

english_meaning: age group; age bracket
explanation_mandarin: 指按年龄划分的不同人群范围。
explanation_english: Refers to different groups of people categorized by age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲嘅目標觀眾係青少年年齡層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 ge3 muk6 biu1 gun1 zung3 hai6 cing1 siu2 nin4 nin4 ling4 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的目标观众是青少年年龄段。
examples.english_sentence: The target audience for this movie is the teenage age group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔同年齡層嘅人對呢件事嘅睇法都唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 tung4 nin4 ling4 cang4 ge3 jan4 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 dou1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不同年龄段的人对这件事的看法都不同。
examples.english_sentence: People of different age groups have different views on this matter.

english_meaning: and, moreover, furthermore; actually, definitely
explanation_mandarin: 表示顺承或递进关系；表示强调或肯定。
explanation_english: Expresses a sequential or progressive relationship; indicates emphasis or affirmation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聰明並勤力，所以考試成績好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 ming4 bing6 kan4 lik6, so2 ji5 haau2 si5 sing4 zik1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他既聪明又努力，所以考试成绩很好。
examples.english_sentence: He is both smart and hardworking, so his exam results are very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我並唔係唔想幫你，而係我真係冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bing6 m4 hai6 m4 soeng2 bong1 nei5, ji4 hai6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我并不是不想帮你，而是我真的没时间。
examples.english_sentence: It's not that I don't want to help you, it's just that I really don't have the time.

english_meaning: hot; excited; trendy; popular
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物很热、很流行、很受欢迎，或者形容人很兴奋。
explanation_english: Describes something as hot, popular, or well-received; also used to describe a person as excited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近興緊呢隻歌，好㷫㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hing3 gan2 ni1 zek3 go1, hou2 hing3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近流行这首歌，非常火！
examples.english_sentence: This song is trending recently, it's really hot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日去睇演唱會，諗起都覺得好㷫奮！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 heoi3 tai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2, lam2 hei2 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 hing3 fan5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天去看演唱会，想起都觉得很兴奋！
examples.english_sentence: Going to the concert tomorrow, I feel so excited just thinking about it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近撈到好㷫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 lou1 dou3 hou2 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近混得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He's been doing very well lately.

english_meaning: luck; fortunately; luckily
explanation_mandarin: 表示幸运，好的运气。也表示庆幸，还好。
explanation_english: Indicates good luck or fortune. It can also express relief or thankfulness that something fortunate happened, often despite potential negative outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次執到平飛睇演唱會，真係好幸運啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zap1 dou2 ping4 fei1 tai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hang6 wan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次捡到便宜的票去看演唱会，真是太幸运了！
examples.english_sentence: I got cheap tickets to the concert this time. I'm so lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幸好你及時趕到，唔係就大鑊喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang6 hou2 nei5 kap6 si4 gon2 dou3, m4 hai6 zau6 daai6 wok6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好你及时赶到，不然就糟糕了！
examples.english_sentence: Luckily you arrived in time, otherwise it would have been a disaster!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大病一場，好在有屋企人照顧，先至好返晒。 佢好幸運。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jyun4 zyu6 gon3 sin3 zaa1 ce1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要沿着干线开车去机场。
examples.english_sentence: We need to drive along the trunk road to the airport.

english_meaning: police officer
explanation_mandarin: 指执行治安、刑事侦查等任务的警察。
explanation_english: Refers to a police officer who performs tasks such as maintaining public order and criminal investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個幹警好盡責，成日都見到佢巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gon3 ging2 hou2 zeon6 zaak3, seng4 jat6 dou1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 ceon4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个警察很尽责，经常都能看到他巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: That police officer is very responsible; you can often see him on patrol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係做個幹警，保障市民嘅安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 go3 gon3 ging2, bou2 zoeng3 si5 man4 ge3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是做个警察，保障市民的安全。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a police officer and protect the safety of citizens.

english_meaning: main road; thoroughfare; trunk road
explanation_mandarin: 主要道路，交通流量大的道路。
explanation_english: A main road designed to carry a large amount of traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條幹道一到繁忙時間就塞車塞到pk。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gon3 dou6 jat1 dou3 faan4 gung1 si4 gaan3 zau6 sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 pe1 kai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条干道一到高峰期就堵车堵得厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This main road gets extremely jammed during rush hour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃擴闊呢條幹道，紓緩交通擠塞問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 kong3 kwok3 ni1 tiu4 gon3 dou6, syu1 wun6 giao1 tung1 zai1 sak1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划扩宽这条干道，缓解交通拥堵问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to widen this main road to alleviate traffic congestion.

english_meaning: cadre, official, executive, manager
explanation_mandarin: 指在政府机关、企事业单位等组织中担任一定职务的领导人员。
explanation_english: Refers to leadership personnel holding certain positions in government agencies, enterprises, and other organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅高層幹部嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 gou1 cang4 gon3 bou6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的高层干部。
examples.english_sentence: He is a high-level executive in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲幹部成日開會，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gon3 bou6 seng4 jat6 hoi1 wui2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些干部经常开会，不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: Those cadres are always in meetings, I don't know what they're doing.

mandarin_meaning: 小, 一 (在電話號碼或房間號碼中)
english_meaning: Small; one (used in phone numbers or room numbers)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港，很多人在讀電話號碼、房間號碼、車牌號碼等時，會用「幺」代替「一」，以避免與「七」混淆。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong, many people use "幺 (jiu1)" instead of "一 (jat1)" when reading phone numbers, room numbers, license plate numbers, etc., to avoid confusion with "七 (cat1)".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅電話號碼係九八三二，幺幺四七。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 hai6 gau2 baat3 saam1 ji6, jiu1 jiu1 sei3 cat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电话号码是九八三二，一一四七。
examples.english_sentence: My phone number is 9832, 1147.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你住邊個單位？我住二樓幺零四室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyu6 bin1 go3 daan1 wai2? ngo5 zyu6 ji6 lau2 jiu1 ling4 sei3 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你住哪个单元？我住二楼一零四室。
examples.english_sentence: Which unit do you live in? I live in room 104 on the second floor.

english_meaning: illusion, fantasy, unreal, visionary
explanation_mandarin: 指虚假的景象，不存在的；或者指想象。
explanation_english: Refers to a false or unreal image; something that does not exist; or imagination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界好似好幻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 hou2 ci5 hou2 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界好像很虚幻。
examples.english_sentence: This world seems so unreal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發咗個幻夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 zo2 go3 waan6 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做了一个幻梦。
examples.english_sentence: I had a fantastical dream.

english_meaning: multicolored; iridescent; kaleidoscopic
explanation_mandarin: 形容颜色变化多样，像梦幻般的色彩。
explanation_english: Describes something with a multitude of colors that change and blend together in a dreamlike way; iridescent or kaleidoscopic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 維多利亞港嘅幻彩詠香江真係好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 do1 lei6 aa3 gong2 ge3 waan6 coi2 wing6 hoeng1 gong1 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 维多利亚港的幻彩咏香江真是太美了。
examples.english_sentence: A Symphony of Lights in Victoria Harbour is truly beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗件幻彩嘅衫，喺燈光下會變色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gin6 waan6 coi2 ge3 saam1, hai2 dang1 gwong1 haa6 wui bin3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她买了一件幻彩色的衣服，在灯光下会变色。
examples.english_sentence: She bought a multicolored shirt that changes color under the light.

english_meaning: phantom, illusion, apparition
explanation_mandarin: 虚幻的影像，不存在的事物的影子。
explanation_english: An illusory image; a phantom or apparition; something that appears to exist but is not real.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢喺古堡見到幻影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hai2 gu2 bou2 gin3 dou2 waan6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他在古堡里看到了幻影。
examples.english_sentence: He said he saw a phantom in the castle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都只係幻影嚟啫，唔係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 zi2 hai6 waan6 jing2 lai4 ze1, m4 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都只是幻影而已，不是真的。
examples.english_sentence: These are just illusions, they aren't real.

english_meaning: fantasy, illusion, imagine, daydream
explanation_mandarin: 凭空想象；虚构的形象或景象。
explanation_english: To imagine; to daydream; a product of the imagination; an illusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日咁多幻想啦，現實啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gam3 do1 waan6 soeng2 laa1, jin6 sat6 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是这么多幻想了，现实一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop fantasizing so much, be more realistic!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幻想緊如果我中咗六合彩會點樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waan6 soeng2 gan2 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 wui dim2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我幻想如果我中了彩票会怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: I'm imagining what would happen if I won the lottery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲充滿幻想元素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 cung1 mun5 waan6 soeng2 jyun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影充满了幻想元素。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is full of fantasy elements.

english_meaning: disillusionment, dashed hopes, fading of a dream
explanation_mandarin: 理想或希望破灭；原有的美好形象消失。
explanation_english: The loss of illusions; disillusionment. The disappointment that follows the discovery that something is not as good as one believed it to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅幻想幻滅晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 waan6 soeng2 waan6 mit6 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的幻想都幻灭了。
examples.english_sentence: My illusions about him have all been shattered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多事之後，佢對愛情幻滅咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 si6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 deoi3 oi3 cing4 waan6 mit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历了这么多事之后，他对爱情幻灭了。
examples.english_sentence: After experiencing so many things, he became disillusioned with love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政治嘅黑暗令好多人對未來幻滅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 zi6 ge3 hak1 am3 ling6 hou2 do1 jan4 deoi3 mei6 loi4 waan6 mit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政治的黑暗让很多人对未来幻灭。
examples.english_sentence: The darkness of politics has caused many people to become disillusioned with the future.

english_meaning: Slide (in a presentation); Slideshow
explanation_mandarin: 指在演示文稿中使用的，通过投影仪或其他显示设备展示的单独的图片或文本页面。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual page of images or text in a presentation, displayed via a projector or other display device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚要準備份幻燈片，聽日開會要用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 zyun2 bei6 fan6 waan6 dang1 pin3, ting1 jat6 hoi1 wui2 jiu3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚要准备一份幻灯片，明天开会要用。
examples.english_sentence: He needs to prepare a slideshow tonight, he needs to use it for the meeting tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份幻燈片太長喇，可唔可以精簡啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 waan6 dang1 pin3 taai3 coeng4 laa3, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zing1 gaan2 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幻灯片太长了，可不可以精简一点？
examples.english_sentence: The slideshow is too long, can you make it more concise?

english_meaning: Auditory hallucination, hallucination of hearing
explanation_mandarin: 指在没有外界声音刺激的情况下，感觉到有声音存在。
explanation_english: The perception of sound without an external auditory stimulus. Hearing sounds that aren't really there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢可能有幻聽嘅症狀，叫佢要覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ho2 nang4 jau5 waan6 ting1 ge3 zing3 zong6, giu3 keoi5 jiu3 fuk1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他可能出现了幻听的症状，让他去复诊。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he might have symptoms of auditory hallucination and told him to come back for a follow-up appointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰排我成日失眠，有時會覺得有幻聽，好恐怖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 paai4 ngo5 seng4 jat6 sat1 min4, jau5 si4 wui5 gok3 dak1 jau5 waan6 ting1, hou2 hung2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那段时间我经常失眠，有时候会觉得有幻听，很恐怖。
examples.english_sentence: I suffered from insomnia a lot during that period, and sometimes I felt like I was having auditory hallucinations, it was terrifying.

english_meaning: magic, illusion
explanation_mandarin: 指一种通过技巧和手法制造出来的虚幻效果，通常用于娱乐表演。
explanation_english: Refers to an illusionary effect created through skillful techniques and manipulations, usually for entertainment purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅幻術表演真係好精彩，睇到我哋眼都定埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waan6 seot6 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zing1 cai2, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ngaan5 dou1 deng6 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的魔术表演真的很精彩，看得我们眼睛都直了。
examples.english_sentence: His magic performance was really amazing, it made our eyes glued to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信曬佢哋嘅幻術，好多都係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 waan6 seot6, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要全信他们的魔术，很多都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't completely trust their magic, many of them are fake.

english_meaning: hallucination
explanation_mandarin: 感官上的错误感知，没有实际的外部刺激而产生的感知体验。
explanation_english: A sensory perception that occurs in the absence of an external stimulus. It is a false perception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢見到啲奇奇怪怪嘅嘢，可能係有幻覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 gin3 dou2 di1 kei4 kei4 gwaai3 gwaai3 ge3 ye5, ho2 nang4 hai6 jau5 waan6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他看到一些奇奇怪怪的东西，可能是出现了幻觉。
examples.english_sentence: He said he saw some strange things, he might be hallucinating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗啲藥之後，佢開始產生幻覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 di1 yoek6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 hoi1 chi2 chan2 saang1 waan6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了那些药之后，他开始产生幻觉。
examples.english_sentence: After taking those drugs, he started to have hallucinations.

english_meaning: illusion, phantom, hallucination
explanation_mandarin: 虚幻的景象；虚假的表象。
explanation_english: An illusion; a false appearance; something that appears real but is not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先見到嘅嘢可能只係幻象嚟啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 gin3 dou2 ge3嘢 ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 waan6 zoeng6 lai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才看到的可能只是幻象而已。
examples.english_sentence: What I saw just now might just be an illusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲沉迷喺佢嘅成功嘅幻象入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 cam4 mai4 hai2 keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 ge3 waan6 zoeng6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仍然沉迷于他成功的幻象中。
examples.english_sentence: He is still immersed in the illusion of his success.

english_meaning: young; small; delicate; fine
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄小，细小，或者细嫩。
explanation_english: Refers to being young in age, small in size, or delicate and tender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個皮膚好幼滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 pei4 fu1 hou2 jau3 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的皮肤很细腻光滑。
examples.english_sentence: His skin is very delicate and smooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係幼鹽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 jau3 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是细盐。
examples.english_sentence: This is fine salt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲好幼嫩，唔識照顧自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 hou2 jau3 nyun6, m4 sik1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她还很年轻，不懂得照顾自己。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is still very young and doesn't know how to take care of himself/herself.

english_meaning: infant; toddler; young child
explanation_mandarin: 指年纪很小的儿童。
explanation_english: Refers to very young children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間幼稚園主要收幼兒班嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jau1 zi1 jyun2 zyu2 jiu3 sau1 jau3 ji4 baan1 ge3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家幼儿园主要招收幼儿班的学生。
examples.english_sentence: This kindergarten mainly accepts students from the nursery class (toddler class).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幼兒嘅發展好快，一日一個樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau3 ji4 ge3 faat3 zin2 hou2 faai3, jat1 jat6 jat1 go3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幼儿的发展很快，一天一个样。
examples.english_sentence: The development of toddlers is very fast; they change every day.

english_meaning: child care centre, nursery, kindergarten
explanation_mandarin: 为婴幼儿提供照料和教育的机构。
explanation_english: An institution providing care and education for infants and young children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔喺附近間幼兒中心返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 hai2 fu6 gan6 gaan1 jau3 ji4 zung1 sam1 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子在附近的幼儿中心上学。
examples.english_sentence: My son goes to the child care centre nearby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想幫個女報名入幼兒中心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 bong1 go3 neoi2 bou3 ming4 jap6 jau3 ji4 zung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想帮女儿报名进幼儿中心。
examples.english_sentence: They want to register their daughter for the child care centre.

english_meaning: kindergarten, nursery school
explanation_mandarin: 学前教育机构，为幼儿提供教育和照料的场所。
explanation_english: A preschool educational institution providing education and care for young children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔下年就讀幼兒園喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 haa6 nin4 zau6 duk6 jau3 ji4 jyun4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子明年就要上幼儿园了。
examples.english_sentence: My son will be going to kindergarten next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間幼兒園嘅校舍好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jau3 ji4 jyun4 ge3 haau6 se3 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所幼儿园的校舍很大。
examples.english_sentence: This kindergarten has a very large campus.

english_meaning: To be well-educated and cultivated from a young age due to family upbringing; Received proper family education from a young age.
explanation_mandarin: 指从小就受到家庭的良好教育和熏陶，品德修养很好。
explanation_english: Refers to receiving good education and cultivation from the family since childhood, resulting in good character and upbringing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幼受庭訓，所以做人做事都好有分寸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau3 sau6 ting4 fan3, so2 ji5 zou6 jan4 zou6 si6 dou1 hou2 jau5 fan1 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小受到家庭的良好教育，所以为人处事都很有分寸。
examples.english_sentence: He received proper family education from a young age, so he is very measured in his words and actions.

jyutping: jau3 ng5 jau3 ji5 gap3 yan4 zi1 jau3
mandarin_meaning: 爱自己的孩子，也爱别人的孩子
english_meaning: To love your own children and extend that love to the children of others.
explanation_mandarin: 出自《孟子·梁惠王上》。意思是：在赡养孝敬自己的长辈时不应忘记其他没有亲缘关系的老人，在抚养教育自己的子女时不应忘记其他没有亲缘关系的孩子。指推己及人，泛指对老幼的关怀。
explanation_english: This idiom comes from Mencius. It means to care for the young of others as one cares for one's own. It promotes the idea of extending one's care and concern beyond one's own family to the broader community, especially towards the young and vulnerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該要幼吾幼以及人之幼，盡力幫助有需要嘅小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 jiu3 jau3 ng5 jau3 ji5 gap3 yan4 zi1 jau3, zeon6 lik6 bong1 zo6 yau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该爱护自己的孩子，也爱护别人的孩子，尽力帮助有需要的小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We should love our own children and extend that love to others' children, doing our best to help those in need.

english_meaning: young girl, little girl
explanation_mandarin: 指年纪很小的女孩。
explanation_english: Refers to a very young girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有個好得意嘅幼女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 go3 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 jau3 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有一个很可爱的小女孩。
examples.english_sentence: They have a very cute little girl.

english_meaning: tender; delicate; young and tender (e.g., skin, leaves); naive
explanation_mandarin: 形容年纪小，不成熟；或指质地细嫩，柔软。
explanation_english: Describes something young, immature, or delicate in texture, often referring to skin, plants, or a person's inexperience and naivety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個BB嘅皮膚好幼嫩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bi1 bi1 ge3 pei4 fu1 hou2 jau3 nyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个婴儿的皮肤很幼嫩。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意去啲幽靜嘅地方散步，可以放鬆心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 heoi3 di1 jau1 zing6 ge3 dei6 fong1 saan3 bou6, ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1 sam1 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢去一些幽静的地方散步，可以放松心情。
examples.english_sentence: I like to go for walks in quiet and secluded places to relax.

english_meaning: ghost, spirit, phantom
explanation_mandarin: 指死者的灵魂，通常指徘徊不定的鬼魂。
explanation_english: The soul of a deceased person, typically referring to a wandering or restless ghost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話間屋成日有幽魂出現，嚇死人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 gaan1 uk1 seng4 jat6 jau5 jau1 wan4 ceot1 jin6, haak3 sei2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说这房子经常有幽灵出现，吓死人了。
examples.english_sentence: They say this house is haunted by ghosts, it's terrifying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 萬聖節好多人扮幽魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan6 sing3 zit3 hou2 do1 jan4 baan6 jau1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 万圣节很多人扮幽灵。
examples.english_sentence: Many people dress up as ghosts for Halloween.

english_meaning: humor; humorous; witty
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话、文章或行为有趣、滑稽，能引人发笑的特质。也指这种能引人发笑的特质本身。
explanation_english: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially in a clever and witty way. It also refers to the ability to perceive, appreciate, or express what is amusing, funny, or comical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好幽默，成日講啲嘢都好好笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 jau1 mak6, sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 je5 dou1 hou2 hou2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很幽默，总是说一些东西都很好笑。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very humorous person, he always says funny things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係好有幽默感，講啲嘢咁惹笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jau1 mak6 gam2, gong2 di1 je5 gam3 je5 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真的很有幽默感，说的话这么搞笑。
examples.english_sentence: You are really humorous, you say such funny things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅幽默感幫佢喺社交場合好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jau1 mak6 gam2 bong1 keoi5 hai2 se5 gaau1 coeng4 hap6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的幽默感帮助他在社交场合很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: His humor helps him to be popular in social situations.

english_meaning: sense of humor
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人具有引人发笑的能力，能以轻松、诙谐的方式表达观点或处理问题。
explanation_english: The ability to perceive, appreciate, or express what is funny, amusing, or incongruous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好有幽默感，成日都講啲嘢搞到我哋笑死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau1 mak6 gam2, seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 di1 je5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 siu3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很有幽默感，经常说一些话逗得我们笑死了。
examples.english_sentence: He really has a great sense of humor, he always says things that make us die laughing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做 sales 最緊要有幽默感，咁樣先容易同客打開話題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 sales zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 jau1 mak6 gam2, gam2 joeng2 sin1 jung4 ji6 tung4 haak3 daa2 hoi1 waa6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做销售最重要的是有幽默感，这样才容易和客人打开话题。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing for salespersons is to have a sense of humor, that way it's easier to start a conversation with customers.

english_meaning: how many, several, few, some, approximately
explanation_mandarin: 1.表示不确定的较小数量。2.表示疑问，询问数量。
explanation_english: 1. Indicates an indefinite small quantity. 2. Used in questions to ask about quantity or number. It can also indicate 'quite' or 'very' depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有幾多錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much money do you have?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識得幾個人喺嗰度做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 dak1 gei2 go3 jan4 hai2 go2 dou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认识几个人在那里工作。
examples.english_sentence: I know a few people who work there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幾叻㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gei2 lek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害的！
examples.english_sentence: He's quite smart!

english_meaning: A little bit of...; Some...; Do something briefly/quickly
explanation_mandarin: 表示稍微或短暂地做某事。 "幾" 表示少量或不长的时间， "下" 加强语气，表示动作的轻微和快速。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something briefly or slightly. "幾" indicates a small amount or short duration, and "下" reinforces the tone, indicating the action is light and quick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你得閒嘅時候幫我睇幾下份報告啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dak1 haan4 ge3 si4 hau6 bong1 ngo5 tai2 gei2 haa5 fan6 bou3 gou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有空的时候帮我看一下这份报告吧。
examples.english_sentence: When you have time, please take a quick look at this report for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，借借，俾我撳幾下電梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ze3 ze3, bei2 ngo5 gam6 gei2 haa5 din6 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，让一下，让我按一下电梯。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, excuse me, let me press the elevator button for a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住畫幾下就走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 waak6 gei2 haa5 zau6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想着画几下就走。
examples.english_sentence: I was thinking of doing a few strokes (of painting) and then leaving.

english_meaning: a few times; a couple of times; a little bit; a short while
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或状态持续的时间短暂或次数不多。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or state lasts for a short time or happens a few times. The '...' represents the verb or adjective being modified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍咗我膊頭幾下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 zo2 ngo5 bok3 tau4 gei2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拍了我的肩膀几下。
examples.english_sentence: He patted my shoulder a few times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我考慮幾下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 hau2 leoi6 gei2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让我考虑一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let me think about it for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾下，依家好返好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 haa5, ji1 gaa1 hou2 faan1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了一阵子，现在好多了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a little while, and now he's much better.

english_meaning: almost; nearly; practically
explanation_mandarin: 表示接近某种状态或程度。
explanation_english: Indicates being close to a certain state or degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋幾乎贏咗場波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gei1 fu4 wing4 zo2 coeng4 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们几乎赢了这场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: We almost won the game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幾乎每日都嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gei1 fu4 mui5 jat6 dou1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他几乎每天都来。
examples.english_sentence: He comes almost every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事幾乎就搞掂喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gei1 fu4 zau6 gaau2 dim6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事几乎就完成了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is almost finished.

english_meaning: how many; how much; how few; (mathematics) geometry
explanation_mandarin: 1. 表示数量多少。 2. 数学的一个分支，研究空间形式的性质及其度量。
explanation_english: 1. Used to ask about quantity. 2. (Mathematics) The branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估下佢哋有幾何個人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 jau5 gei2 ho4 go3 jan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜猜他们有多少人？
examples.english_sentence: Guess how many people there are in their group?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幾何會見到佢㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei2 ho4 wui5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有多大可能会见到他呢？
examples.english_sentence: How likely am I to see him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對幾何好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gei2 ho4 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对几何很有兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in geometry.

mandarin_meaning: 几何级数，呈几何级数增长
english_meaning: geometric progression; exponential growth
explanation_mandarin: 原指数学上的几何级数，引申为增长速度非常快，呈指数增长。
explanation_english: Originally referring to geometric progression in mathematics, it's extended to mean a very rapid growth rate, growing exponentially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近呢幾年，智能手機嘅銷量用幾何級數咁升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kan5 ni1 gei2 nin4, zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1 ge3 siu1 loeng6 yung6 gei2 ho4 kap1 sou3 gam2 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近几年，智能手机的销量呈几何级数增长。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, the sales of smartphones have increased exponentially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上嘅假新聞，傳播速度快到好似幾何級數咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng5 ge3 gaa2 san1 man4, cyun4 bo3 suk1 dou6 faai3 dou3 hou2 ci5 gei2 ho4 kap1 sou3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上的假新闻，传播速度快得像几何级数一样。
examples.english_sentence: Fake news online spreads at an exponential rate.

english_meaning: somewhat like, rather like, a bit like, seems like
explanation_mandarin: 表示有点像，带有模仿或相似的意味。也用来描述某事物表现出某种状态或特征。
explanation_english: Expresses resemblance or similarity, often implying imitation. Can also describe something exhibiting a certain state or characteristic. It indicates a degree of approximation or resemblance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢幾係啲明星咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gei2 hai6 di1 ming4 sing1 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话有点像那些明星。
examples.english_sentence: He talks somewhat like those celebrities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食幾係正宗意大利菜咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gei2 hai6 zing3 zung1 yi3 daai6 lei6 coi3 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物有点像正宗的意大利菜。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is rather like authentic Italian cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日打扮幾係要去約會咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 daa2 bun3 gei2 hai6 jiu3 heoi3 joek3 wui2 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天打扮得好像要去约会一样。
examples.english_sentence: You're dressed up today as if you're going on a date.

mandarin_meaning: 有点东西, 不简单, 有实力
english_meaning: To be quite something, to be capable, to have some skills, to be impressive in a subtle way.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事物有一些特别之处，不简单，有一定实力或能力，但通常不直接表达非常厉害，而是一种比较含蓄的称赞。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something possesses special qualities, is not simple, and has a certain level of skill or ability. It's often used as a subtle compliment, rather than a direct expression of great strength or talent. It suggests they are more capable than they initially appear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書唔叻，但係做嘢幾係嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 m4 lek1, daan6 hai6 zou6 je5 gei2 hai6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学习不好，但是工作还挺厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He's not good at studying, but he's quite something at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳睇落普通，但係啲嘢食幾係嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 tai2 lok6 pou2 tung1, daan6 hai6 di1 je5 sik6 gei2 hai6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅看起来很普通，但是食物味道很好。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant looks ordinary, but the food is actually quite something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇小佢，佢其實幾係嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, keoi5 kei4 sat6 gei2 hai6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看他，他其实挺厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him, he's actually quite something.

mandarin_meaning: 很多, 数不清, 多得是
english_meaning: many, countless, a lot of
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多，无法确切计算，也带有说话人轻蔑的语气，类似于“一抓一大把”。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity that is difficult to count exactly. It often carries a dismissive tone, similar to saying 'a dime a dozen'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲人才幾十百，唔使愁搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jyun4 coi4 gei2 sap6 baak3, m4 sai2 sau4 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种人才多的是，不用愁找不到。
examples.english_sentence: These kinds of talents are a dime a dozen; no need to worry about not finding any.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話呢度嘅餐廳好食？ 幾十百間都好食過佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ni1 dou6 ge3 caan1 teng1 hou2 sik6? gei2 sap6 baak3 gaan1 dou1 hou2 sik6 gwo3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说这家餐厅好吃？ 好吃的餐厅数不胜数。
examples.english_sentence: You say this restaurant is delicious? There are countless restaurants that are better than it.

english_meaning: almost indistinguishable from the real thing; lifelike; true to life
explanation_mandarin: 形容模仿得非常逼真，几乎可以与真品相混淆。
explanation_english: Describes something that is imitated or reproduced so realistically that it is almost impossible to distinguish it from the original.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫畫得幾可亂眞，好似真嘅一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 waa2 dak1 gei2 ho2 lyun6 zan1, hou2 ci5 zan1 ge3 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画画得栩栩如生，好像真的一样。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is so lifelike, it looks like the real thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮嘢扮得幾可亂眞，真係睇唔出佢係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 je5 baan6 dak1 gei2 ho2 lyun6 zan1, zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 chut1 keoi5 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他模仿得惟妙惟肖，真是看不出他是假的。
examples.english_sentence: His impersonation is so convincing that you can't tell he's faking it.

english_meaning: lifelike; indistinguishable from the real thing; deceptively realistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容虚假的事物和真实的事物非常相似，几乎可以混淆。
explanation_english: Describes something fake or artificial that is so similar to the real thing that it can be easily mistaken for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蠟像做得幾可亂真，好似真人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 laap6 zoeng6 zou6 dak1 gei2 ho2 lyun6 zan1, hou2 ci5 zan1 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蜡像做得以假乱真，好像真人一样。
examples.english_sentence: This wax figure is so lifelike, it looks like a real person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮嘢扮得幾可亂真，我差啲俾佢呃咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 je5 baan6 dak1 gei2 ho2 lyun6 zan1, ngo5 caa1 di1 bei2 keoi5 aak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他演戏演得惟妙惟肖，我差点儿被他骗了。
examples.english_sentence: His acting is so deceptively realistic, I almost got fooled by him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個假嘅鑽石戒指做得幾可亂真，唔係專家都睇唔出係假嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa2 ge3 zyun3 sek6 gaan1 zi2 zou6 dak1 gei2 ho2 lyun6 zan1, m4 hai6 zyun1 gaa1 dou1 tai2 m4 chut1 hai6 gaa2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个假的钻石戒指做得以假乱真，不是专家都看不出来是假的。
examples.english_sentence: This fake diamond ring is so realistic that even experts can't tell it's fake.

english_meaning: How; How very; To what extent; So
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，相当于“多么”、“这么”。 多用于感叹句中，表示程度很高。
explanation_english: Used to express degree, similar to "how much," "so much," or "to what extent." Often used in exclamatory sentences to indicate a high degree of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幾咁錫你個仔呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 gam1 sek3 nei5 go3 zai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你多么疼爱你儿子啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much do you love your son?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個戲幾咁好睇呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hei3 gei2 gam1 hou2 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影多么好看啊！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is so good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢幾咁傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gei2 gam1 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他有多么伤心。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how sad he is.

english_meaning: What's the big deal?
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事不屑一顾，认为没什么大不了的。带有轻蔑或不以为然的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses disdain or indifference towards something, implying that it's not a big deal. Used to downplay a situation or show contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到幾分鐘啫，幾咁閒呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 gei2 fan1 zung1 ze1, gei2 gam2 haan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到几分钟而已，算什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: It's just a few minutes late, what's the big deal?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試肥佬啫，幾咁閒，下次考好啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 fei4 lou2 ze1, gei2 gam2 haan4, haa6 ci3 haau2 hou2 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试没及格而已，算什么，下次考好点不就行了吗？
examples.english_sentence: So I failed the exam, what's the big deal? I'll just do better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔鍾意你啫，幾咁閒，大把人鍾意我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5 ze1, gei2 gam2 haan4, daai6 baa2 jan4 zung1 ji3 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不喜欢你而已，算什么，很多人喜欢我！
examples.english_sentence: So she doesn't like you, what's the big deal? Plenty of people like me!

english_meaning: how much; how many
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问数量或程度。相当于普通话的“多少”。
explanation_english: Used to ask about quantity or degree. Equivalent to 'how much' or 'how many' in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想要幾多錢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jiu3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想要多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much money do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有幾多人呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 gei2 do1 jan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有多少人啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many people are there here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲有幾多時間？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 jau5 gei2 do1 si4 gaan3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还有多少时间？
examples.english_sentence: How much time do you still have?

english_meaning: how many people; how many
explanation_mandarin: 询问人数的多少。
explanation_english: Used to ask about the number of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚開party，你估下會有幾多人嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hoi1 paati1, nei5 gu2 haa5 wui5 jau5 gei2 do1 jan4 lai4?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾歹都唔可以放棄！

examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何都不可以放弃！
examples.english_sentence: No matter what, we can't give up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幾歹都想贏呢場比賽。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我无论如何都想赢得这场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: I want to win this match no matter what it takes.

jyutping: gei2 baak3 maan6 mei6 hoi1 tau4
mandarin_meaning: 几百万算不上什么; 算不上大数目
english_meaning: Several million is just the beginning; A few million is nothing; It's just the tip of the iceberg (when talking about money/investment)
explanation_mandarin: 形容花费巨大，几百万只是开始，之后还会有更多的花费。常用于形容投资巨大或费用高昂。
explanation_english: Describes a massive expenditure where several million is just the initial cost, implying that much more will be spent later. Often used to describe large investments or exorbitant fees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起呢棟醫院，幾百萬未開頭，分分鐘要過億。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 ni1 dung6 ji1 jyun2, gei2 baak3 maan6 mei6 hoi1 tau4, fan1 fan1 chung1 jiu3 gwo3 yik1.

examples.english_sentence: Building this hospital, a few million is nothing, it will easily cost over a hundred million.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞科研，幾百萬未開頭，你預咗要燒銀紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 fo1 jin4, gei2 baak3 maan6 mei6 hoi1 tau4, nei5 jyu6 zo2 jiu3 siu1 ngan4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞科研，几百万算不上什么，你准备好要烧钱。
examples.english_sentence: Doing scientific research, a few million is just the start, you should be prepared to burn money.

english_meaning: after many experiences; after many twists and turns; after going through a lot
explanation_mandarin: 表示经历了很多次，通常指经历了很多困难或挑战。
explanation_english: Indicates having experienced something many times, usually referring to experiencing many difficulties or challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幾經辛苦，終於考到大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gei2 ging1 san1 fu2, zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经过多次努力，终于考上了大学。
examples.english_sentence: After much hard work, he finally got into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事幾經波折，先至搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gei2 ging1 bo1 zit3, sin1 zi3 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事经过多次波折，才解决。
examples.english_sentence: This matter was only resolved after many twists and turns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾經考慮，我決定辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 ging1 hau2 leoi6, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多次考虑，我决定辞职。
examples.english_sentence: After much deliberation, I decided to resign.

english_meaning: how long; how much time
explanation_mandarin: 询问时间长度，相当于普通话的“多久”。
explanation_english: Asks about the duration of time; equivalent to "how long" or "how much time" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要幾耐先返嚟呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 gei2 noi6 sin1 faan1 lai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要多久才回来啊？
examples.english_sentence: How long will it take you to come back?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋等咗你幾耐喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dang2 zo2 nei5 gei2 noi6 laa3!

examples.english_sentence: We've been waiting for you for so long!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲要播幾耐呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 jiu3 bo3 gei2 noi6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影要放映多久啊？
examples.english_sentence: How long will this movie be playing?

english_meaning: what date; what number
explanation_mandarin: 询问日期（几号）或号码（几号）。
explanation_english: Used to ask for the date (what day of the month) or a number (what number).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日幾號啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gei2 hou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天几号啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's the date today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你住幾號房？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyu6 gei2 hou6 fong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你住几号房间？
examples.english_sentence: What number room do you live in?

examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 zung2 zaam6 hai2 bin1 aa3? gei2 hou6 baa1 si2 heoi3 dou3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 巴士总站在哪里啊？几号巴士可以到啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where is the bus terminus? Which bus number can get there?

english_meaning: how much; how many; a certain amount; somewhat
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量或程度，相当于“多少”。较文雅的说法。
explanation_english: Indicates quantity or degree, equivalent to "how much" or "how many". A more refined or literary expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲有幾許錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 jau5 gei2 heoi2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还有多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much money do you still have?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年，佢嘅樣貌都有幾許改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4, keoi5 ge3 joeng2 maau6 dou1 jau5 gei2 heoi2 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年，他的样貌也有一些改变。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years, his appearance has changed somewhat.

english_meaning: How much (money)?
explanation_mandarin: 询问价格的疑问代词，相当于普通话的“多少钱”。
explanation_english: An interrogative pronoun used to ask about the price of something; equivalent to "How much (money)?" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋幾錢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 gei2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much is this handbag?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買份禮物，有啲咩好介紹？幾錢左右？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 fan6 lai5 mat6, jau5 di1 me1 hou2 gaai3 siu6? gei2 cin2 zo2 jau6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买份礼物，有什么好的推荐吗？大概多少钱左右？
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a gift. Do you have any good recommendations? Around how much?

english_meaning: Only with great difficulty; very difficult to
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事很难实现，需要克服很大的困难才能做到。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is very difficult to achieve and requires overcoming significant difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要靠自己買到樓，幾難先至得㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 maai5 dou2 lau2, gei2 naan4 sin1 zi3 dak1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要靠自己买房，很难才能实现啊！
examples.english_sentence: Buying a flat relying on yourself is only possible with great difficulty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人咁固執，想改變佢嘅諗法，幾難先至搞得掂啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gam3 gu3 zap1, soeng2 goi2 bin3 keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3, gei2 naan4 sin1 zi3 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人这么固执，想要改变他的想法，很难才能搞定啊！
examples.english_sentence: He is so stubborn, it will be very difficult to change his mind!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個競爭咁激烈嘅社會生存，幾難先至可以出人頭地㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 ging6 zang1 gam3 gik1 lit6 ge3 se5 wui2 sang1 cyun4, gei2 naan4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jan4 tau4 dei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个竞争这么激烈的社会生存，很难才能出人头地啊。
examples.english_sentence: Surviving in such a competitive society, it's very difficult to become successful.

english_meaning: It's difficult before... / It's not easy until...
explanation_mandarin: 表示达到某个目标或状态需要克服很大的困难和很长的时间。通常用于表达对某件事情的难度或完成时间长短的强调。
explanation_english: Indicates that reaching a certain goal or state requires overcoming significant difficulties and a long time. It's often used to emphasize the difficulty or length of time to complete something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾難先至搵到份好工㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 naan4 sin1 zi3 wan2 dou2 fan6 hou2 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要找到一份好工作很不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to find a good job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾難先至可以儲夠錢買樓㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 naan4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 cyu5 gau3 cin2 maai5 lau2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要存够钱买房谈何容易？
examples.english_sentence: How difficult is it to save enough money to buy a house?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾難先至學識晒啲廣東話㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 naan4 sin1 zi3 hok6 sik1晒 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要完全学会广东话太难了。
examples.english_sentence: It's very difficult to learn all of Cantonese.

synonyms: 唔容易先至… (m4 jung4 ji6 sin1 zi3…)

english_meaning: Very; Extremely; Awfully; Terribly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，相当于普通话的“非常”、“很”。 多用于形容负面的事物。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree, equivalent to "very" or "extremely" in Mandarin. Often used to describe negative things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日幾鬼凍呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gei2 gwai2 dung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天非常冷啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's awfully cold today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食幾鬼難食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gei2 gwai2 naan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很难吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is terribly awful.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作非常辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: This job is awfully hard.

english_meaning: What time is it?
explanation_mandarin: 询问时间的表达方式，相当于普通话的“几点”。
explanation_english: An expression used to ask for the time, equivalent to "What time is it?"

examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 gei2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在几点啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time is it now?

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约了什么时候见面啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time did we agree to meet?

english_meaning: What time is it?

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2 zung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问，现在几点钟啊？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, what time is it now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約咗八點鐘食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 zo2 baat3 dim2 zung1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约了八点钟吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: We arranged to have dinner at eight o'clock.

english_meaning: wide, broad, spacious; large
explanation_mandarin: 指面积大，范围宽阔。 也可表示大，例如：大件事叫“广嘢”。

examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hou2 gwong2 kwut3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子很宽敞啊！
examples.english_sentence: This house is very spacious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好广嘢，要小心处理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 gwong2 je5, jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很大，要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: This is a big deal; we need to handle it carefully.

english_meaning: light; ray; bright
explanation_mandarin: 指光线，也形容明亮。
explanation_english: Refers to light or rays of light; can also describe something as bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房好広猛啊。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳光很刺眼啊。
examples.english_sentence: The sunlight is very dazzling.

english_meaning: to celebrate
explanation_mandarin: 庆祝，祝贺。
explanation_english: To celebrate; to congratulate.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 sik6 faan6 hing3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去吃饭庆祝成功。
examples.english_sentence: We're going out for dinner tonight to celebrate our success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生日要好好哋庆吓先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 jat6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 dei2 hing3 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生日要好好地庆祝一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: You have to celebrate your birthday properly.

english_meaning: to protect, to shelter, to cover
explanation_mandarin: 保护；遮盖。
explanation_english: To protect; to shelter; to cover.

examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 jau6 nei5 ping4 ping4 on1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保佑你平平安安。
examples.english_sentence: May (God) protect you and keep you safe and sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸喺差館做嘢，佢哋有庇蔭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 hai2 caa1 gun2 zou6 je5, keoi5 dei6 jau5 bei3 jam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸在警局工作，他们有庇护。
examples.english_sentence: His father works at the police station, they have protection.

english_meaning: to bless; to protect; to have divine protection
explanation_mandarin: 神或上天保护、帮助某人或事物。
explanation_english: To bless, protect, or have divine protection from a higher power (e.g., gods, deities). It implies receiving favorable care and warding off harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望神明庇佑我哋一家人身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 san4 ming4 bei3 yau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望神明保佑我们一家人身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: I hope the gods will bless my family with good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話係祖先庇佑，先可以大步檻過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hai6 zou2 sin1 bei3 yau6, sin1 ho2 ji5 daai6 bou6 laam5 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这是祖先保佑，才能平安度过难关。
examples.english_sentence: He said it's thanks to the ancestors' blessing that he was able to overcome the difficulty.

english_meaning: to protect and bless; divine protection
explanation_mandarin: 指神明或上天保佑、庇护。
explanation_english: Refers to protection and blessings from deities or heaven; divine protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望神明庇祐我哋一家人平安健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 san4 ming4 bei3 jau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ping4 on1 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望神明保佑我们一家人平安健康。
examples.english_sentence: Hoping that the gods will protect and bless our family with peace, safety, and health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝天后娘娘庇祐，出海嘅漁民都可以平平安安返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 tin1 hau6 noeng4 noeng2 bei3 jau6, ceot1 hoi2 ge3 jyu4 man4 dou1 ho2 ji5 ping4 ping4 on1 on1 faan1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多谢天后娘娘庇佑，出海的渔民都可以平平安安地回来。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you, Tin Hau (Goddess of the Sea), for your protection so that the fishermen who go out to sea can return safely.

english_meaning: to shelter, to protect, to bless, to have the protection or blessing of (someone influential)
explanation_mandarin: 指受到上级或长辈的保护和照顾。
explanation_english: To receive protection and blessing, often from someone superior in rank or seniority. It implies a sense of being sheltered or favored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有阿爺庇蔭，佢喺公司咪可以橫行囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 aa3 je4 bei3 jam3, keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 mai1 ho2 ji5 waang4 hang4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有爷爷的庇荫，他才能在公司里横行霸道。
examples.english_sentence: With his grandfather's protection, he can act as he pleases in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望祖先庇蔭我哋一家人平平安安，身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 zou2 sin1 bei3 jam3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ping4 ping4 on1 on1, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望祖先保佑我们一家人平平安安，身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: Hope our ancestors will bless our family with peace, safety, and good health.

english_meaning: to shelter; to protect; protection; asylum
explanation_mandarin: 动词：保护、袒护。名词：保护或被保护的状态。
explanation_english: Verb: To shelter, protect, or provide asylum. Noun: The act of protecting or the state of being protected; asylum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嚟香港尋求政治庇護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 cam4 kiu4 zing3 zi6 bei3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们来香港寻求政治庇护。
examples.english_sentence: They came to Hong Kong seeking political asylum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要你嘅庇護啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 ge3 bei3 wu6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要你的保护啊！
examples.english_sentence: I need your protection!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個組織提供庇護畀啲受虐婦女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zou2 zik1 tai4 gung1 bei3 wu6 bei2 di1 sau6 joek6 fu5 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个组织为受虐妇女提供庇护。
examples.english_sentence: This organization provides shelter for abused women.

english_meaning: sheltered workshop; halfway house; asylum center
explanation_mandarin: 为有特殊需要的人士（如残疾人士、精神病康复者等）提供庇护性就业、生活技能训练和社会适应服务的场所。
explanation_english: A facility that provides sheltered employment, life skills training, and social adaptation services for people with special needs (such as people with disabilities, mental illness recovery patients, etc.). It provides a supportive environment for them to develop skills and integrate into the community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺庇護中心學識咗好多技能，而家可以自己搵到份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei3 wu6 zung1 sam1 hok6 sik1 zo2 ho2 do1 gei1 nang4, ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 wan2 dou3 fun6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在庇护中心学会了很多技能，现在可以自己找到一份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He learned many skills in the sheltered workshop and can now find a job on his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府資助唔少庇護中心，幫助殘疾人士融入社會。
