explanation_mandarin: 形容夫妻之间即使吵架，也会很快和好，感情深厚。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how quarrels between a married couple are quickly resolved, signifying a strong and loving relationship. It implies that disagreements are temporary and don't damage the fundamental bond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日嘈交，但係都係床頭打交床尾和，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 cou4 gaau1, daan6 hai6 dou1 hai6 cong4 tau4 daa2 gaau1 cong4 mei5 wo4, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常吵架，但是都是床头吵架床尾和，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: They often quarrel, but it's always a case of fighting at the head of the bed and making up at the foot of the bed, so don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夫妻之間有啲拗撬好正常，最緊要係床頭打交床尾和啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu1 cai1 zi1 gaan1 jau5 di1 aau3 kiu5 hou2 zing3 soeng4, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 cong4 tau4 daa2 gaau1 cong4 mei5 wo4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夫妻之间有些争执很正常，最重要的是床头吵架床尾和。
examples.english_sentence: It's normal for couples to have disagreements, the most important thing is that they make up quickly.

english_meaning: nightstand, bedside table
explanation_mandarin: 放在床边的矮柜，通常用于放置灯具、书籍、闹钟等物品。
explanation_english: A small table or cabinet placed beside a bed, typically used to hold a lamp, books, alarm clock, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺床頭櫃上面放咗本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 cong4 tau4 gwai6 soeng6 min6 fong3 zo2 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把一本书放在床头柜上了。
examples.english_sentence: I put a book on the nightstand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺前鍾意將手機擺喺床頭櫃上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 cin4 zung1 ji3 zoeng1 sau2 gei1 baai2 hai2 cong4 tau4 gwai6 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡觉前喜欢把手机放在床头柜上面。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to put his phone on the bedside table before going to sleep.

english_meaning: bed bug
explanation_mandarin: 一种寄生在床垫、床板等处的昆虫，以吸食人血为生。
explanation_english: A parasitic insect that lives in mattresses, bed frames, etc., and feeds on human blood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房有好多床𩩍，搞到我晚晚都瞓唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 jau5 hou2 do1 cong4 laai1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 maan5 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里有很多床虱，搞得我每晚都睡不好。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of bed bugs in the room, which makes it difficult for me to sleep well every night.

english_meaning: order; sequence; preface; introduction
explanation_mandarin: 指事物排列的先后次第，也可指文章的开头或说明主旨的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the order or sequence of things; can also refer to the beginning of an article or the part explaining the main idea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋排隊嘅時候唔跟次序，搞到好亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai4 deoi2 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 gan1 ci3 zeoi6, gaau2 dou3 hou2 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们排队的时候不按次序，搞得很乱。
examples.english_sentence: They didn't follow the order when queuing, making it very chaotic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書前面有篇序，解釋咗作者嘅創作理念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 cin4 min6 jau5 pin1 zeoi6, gaai2 sik1 zo2 zo2 ze2 ge3 chong3 zok3 lei5 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书前面有一篇序，解释了作者的创作理念。
examples.english_sentence: There is a preface at the beginning of the book, explaining the author's creative ideas.

english_meaning: prelude, prologue, opening scene
explanation_mandarin: 戏剧、歌剧等开始时的第一场戏，也比喻事情的开始阶段。
explanation_english: The opening scene of a play, opera, etc.; figuratively, the initial stage of an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲嘅序幕好精彩，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 chut1 hei3 ge3 zeoi6 mok6 hou2 zing1 coi2, hou2 kap1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的序幕非常精彩，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: The prelude of this play is very brilliant and attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事只係個序幕，之後仲有好多嘢會發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zi2 hai6 go3 zeoi6 mok6, zi1 hau6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ye5 wui5 faat3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事只是一个序幕，之后还有很多事情会发生。
examples.english_sentence: This event is just a prelude, there will be many more things happening afterwards.

english_meaning: ordinal number
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物次序的数，如第一、第二等。
explanation_english: A number that indicates the position or order of something in a sequence (e.g., first, second, third).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺比賽攞到第幾名呀？ 係序數嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bei2 coi3 lo2 dou2 dai6 gei2 ming4 aa3? hai6 zeoi6 sou3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在比赛中获得了第几名？这是一个序数。
examples.english_sentence: What place did you get in the competition? That's an ordinal number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要用序數嚟標記步驟嘅先後次序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 yung6 zeoi6 sou3 lai4 biu1 gei3 bou6 zau6 ge3 sin1 hau6 ci3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要用序数来标记步骤的先后顺序。
examples.english_sentence: We need to use ordinal numbers to mark the order of the steps.

english_meaning: prologue, introduction, opening chapter
explanation_mandarin: 故事、剧本等作品的开头部分，通常用来介绍背景、人物等。
explanation_english: The introductory part of a story, play, or other work, usually serving to introduce the background, characters, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔嘅序章好吸引人，令我好想睇落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 ge3 zeoi6 zoeng1 hou2 kap1 jan4, ling6 ngo5 hou2 soeng2 tai2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事的序章很吸引人，让我很想看下去。
examples.english_sentence: The prologue of this story is very captivating, making me want to keep reading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢出戲嘅序章交代咗主角嘅身世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 ge3 zeoi6 zoeng1 gaau1 dai6 zo2 zyu2 gok3 ge3 san1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这出戏的序章交代了主角的身世。
examples.english_sentence: The prologue of this play explains the protagonist's background.

english_meaning: serial number; sequence number; index number
explanation_mandarin: 排列事物时，用于标识次序的号码。
explanation_english: A number used to identify the order of items in a sequence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請喺張表格上面填寫你嘅會員序號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 hai2 zoeng1 biu2 gaak3 soeng6 min6 tin4 se2 nei5 ge3 wui2 jyun4 zeoi6 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请在表格上填写你的会员序号。
examples.english_sentence: Please fill in your membership serial number on the form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗我張優惠券嘅序號啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 ngo5 zoeng1 jau1 wai6 hyun3 ge3 zeoi6 hou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不记得我的优惠券的序号了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot the serial number of my coupon.

english_meaning: preface, foreword, introduction
explanation_mandarin: 书或文章前面说明内容、目的等的部分。
explanation_english: An introductory statement at the beginning of a book or article, outlining its scope, aims, or justification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書嘅序言寫得好好，清楚噉介紹咗成本書嘅重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ge3 zeoi6 jin4 se2 dak1 hou2 hou2, cing1 co2 gam2 gaai3 siu6 zo2 sing4 bun2 syu1 ge3 zung1 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的序言写得很好，清楚地介绍了整本书的重点。
examples.english_sentence: The preface of this book is well-written, clearly introducing the key points of the entire book.

mandarin_meaning: 答应; 回应; 应该
english_meaning: to answer; to respond; to agree; should; ought to
explanation_mandarin: 1. 回答，答覆。 2. 答应，同意。 3. 应该，应当。
explanation_english: 1. To answer, reply. 2. To agree, consent. 3. Should, ought to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢应承咗帮我哋手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing3 sing4 zo2 bong1 ngo5 dei6 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应帮我们忙了。
examples.english_sentence: He agreed to help us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫佢，佢唔应嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 keoi5, keoi5 m4 jing3 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你叫他，他不应答吗？
examples.english_sentence: You called him, didn't he answer?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都应该咁做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jing1 goi1 gam2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也应该那样做的。
examples.english_sentence: You should do that too.

mandarin_meaning: 底, 基础, 底部, 根源
english_meaning: bottom, base, foundation, background, origin, end (of the year/month), deposit (money)
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指物体的最下面部分；基础；底细。量词：用于计算文件的份数。
explanation_english: Noun: The bottom part of something; foundation; inside information. Measure word: Used to count the number of copies of a document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱嘅底花晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 ge3 dai2 faa1 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子的底部都花了。
examples.english_sentence: The bottom of the table is all scratched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好有底蘊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 dai2 wan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很有内涵。
examples.english_sentence: He is a person with a lot of substance/depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影張相，打個靚底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ying2 zoeng1 soeng3, daa2 go3 leng1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍张照片，打个好的底光。
examples.english_sentence: Take a photo and use good lighting from the background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺銀行度放咗啲錢落個戶口度打底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ngan4 hang4 dou6 fong3 zo2 di1 cin2 lok6 go3 wu6 hau2 dou6 daa2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把一些钱存到银行户口里。
examples.english_sentence: I deposited some money into my bank account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畀多兩底文件佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 do1 loeng5 dai2 man4 gin2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再给他两份文件。
examples.english_sentence: Give him two more copies of the document.

english_meaning: underneath, below, under
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某物体的下方或在某种情况之后。
explanation_english: Indicates a position below something or after a certain event or situation. It can also refer to subordinates or employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張檯底下有隻貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 dai2 haa6 jau5 zek3 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子下面有一只猫。
examples.english_sentence: There's a cat under the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細底下啲員工好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dai2 haa6 di1 jyun4 gung1 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板手下的员工很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: The employees under the boss are very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事底下，佢受到好多壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 dai2 haa6, keoi5 sau6 dou3 hou2 do1 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事之后，他受到了很多压力。
examples.english_sentence: After this incident, he received a lot of pressure.

english_meaning: reserve price, minimum price, floor price
explanation_mandarin: 指商品或资产交易中允许成交的最低价格。
explanation_english: The lowest price at which a seller is willing to sell a commodity or asset, often used in auctions or negotiations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅底價係十萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 dai2 gaa3 hai6 sap6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的底价是十万。
examples.english_sentence: The reserve price for this car is 100,000.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋拍賣嘅底價好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 paak3 maai6 ge3 dai2 gaa3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子拍卖的底价很高。
examples.english_sentence: The reserve price for the auction of this house is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以俾個底價我參考下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 dai2 gaa3 ngo5 caam1 kaau2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以给我一个底价参考一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me a reserve price for me to take as a reference?

english_meaning: foundation, basis, groundwork, inherent quality, natural ability
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的基础，根基；也指人天生的素质或能力。
explanation_english: Refers to the foundation or basis of something; also refers to a person's inherent qualities or natural abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中文底子好好，所以學起日文都好快上手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 man4 dai2 zi2 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 hok6 hei2 jat6 man4 dou1 hou2 faai3 so2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的中文基础很好，所以学起日语都很快上手。
examples.english_sentence: His Chinese foundation is very good, so he learns Japanese quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢功夫底子好扎實，打起嚟好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 fu1 dai2 zi2 hou2 zaat3 sat6, daa2 hei2 lai4 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功夫底子很扎实，打起来很有气势。
examples.english_sentence: His Kung Fu foundation is very solid, he has a strong presence when he fights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅底子唔錯，應該好快可以賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 dai2 zi2 m4 co3, jing1 goi1 hou2 faai3 ho2 ji5 zaan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的基础不错，应该很快可以赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a good foundation, it should be able to make money soon.

english_meaning: lower level; bottom level; grassroots; underprivileged
explanation_mandarin: 指社会阶层中较低的阶级或群体，也指建筑物或结构的最下层。
explanation_english: Refers to the lower class or group in a social hierarchy; also refers to the lowest level of a building or structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚟自社會底層，好明白窮人嘅苦況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lai4 zi6 se5 wui2 dai2 cang4, hou2 ming4 baak6 kung4 jan4 ge3 fu2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他来自社会底层，很明白穷人的苦况。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from the bottom of society and understands the suffering of the poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟大廈嘅底層係停車場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 daai6 haa6 ge3 dai2 cang4 hai6 ting4 ce1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋大厦的底层是停车场。
examples.english_sentence: The bottom level of this building is a car park.

english_meaning: Underwear, underpants
explanation_mandarin: 指穿在最里面的贴身衣物，通常遮盖臀部和生殖器官。
explanation_english: Refers to undergarments worn close to the skin, typically covering the buttocks and genitals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我着返條底底，費事凍親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 zoek3 faan1 tiu4 dai2 dai2, fai3 si5 dung3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我穿上内裤，免得着凉。
examples.english_sentence: My mom told me to put on underwear, to avoid catching a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條底底洗乾淨未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 dai2 dai2 sai2 gon1 zing6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 内裤洗干净了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is the underwear washed clean?

mandarin_meaning: 底子; 基础; 底蕴
english_meaning: foundation; basis; underlying strength; inner resources; background
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人或事物的内在基础，积累和实力。 也可指某些事物的物理底层。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's or thing's inner foundation, accumulated knowledge/experience, and strength. It can also refer to the physical base layer of some objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢英文底板好好，所以學起其他語言都好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ying1 man2 dai2 baan2 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 hok6 hei2 kei4 taa1 yu5 yin2 dou1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英文基础很好，所以学其他语言都很快。
examples.english_sentence: His English foundation is very good, so he learns other languages quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅成功，在於佢哋有紮實嘅底板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1, zoi6 yu1 keoi5 dei6 jau5 zaat3 sat6 ge3 dai2 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的成功，在于他们有扎实的基础。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this company lies in its solid foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 層樓嘅底板好穩固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cang4 lau2 ge3 dai2 baan2 hou2 wan2 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼的地基很稳固。
examples.english_sentence: The foundation of this building is very solid.

mandarin_meaning: 蛮横无理, 嚣张跋扈
english_meaning: unreasonable, overbearing, bossy, arrogant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不讲道理，态度强硬，蛮不讲理。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is unreasonable, has a tough attitude, and is generally unwilling to listen to reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好底橫㗎，你最好唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 dai2 waang4 gaa3, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很蛮横的，你最好别惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very overbearing person, you better not mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁底橫啦，有咩事慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dai2 waang4 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 maan6 maan6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么蛮横，有什么事慢慢说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unreasonable, let's talk about it slowly.

english_meaning: Confidence; Inner strength; Self-assurance; A sense of security based on one's resources or abilities.
explanation_mandarin: 指内在的力量、自信心、实力或后盾。指有足以依靠或依仗的条件或能力，因此感到有自信。
explanation_english: Refers to inner strength, confidence, capability, or backing. Implies having conditions or abilities to rely on, thus feeling confident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得好好，所以好有底氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 hou2 jau5 dai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得很好，所以很有底气。
examples.english_sentence: He did very well in the exam this time, so he is very confident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢間公司做咗好耐，所以講嘢都好有底氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 hou2 noi6, so2 ji5 gong2 je5 dou1 hou2 jau5 dai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这家公司做了很久，所以说话都很有底气。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked in this company for a long time, so he speaks with a lot of confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁冇底氣啦，相信自己得嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou5 dai2 hei3 laa1, soeng1 seon3 zi6 gei2 dak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么没底气了，相信自己可以的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so lacking in confidence, believe in yourself that you can do it.

english_meaning: photographic film; negative
explanation_mandarin: 摄影用的底片，经过曝光和显影处理后，可以印制照片。
explanation_english: Photographic film; a strip or sheet of transparent plastic film bearing a photographic image, from which positives can be printed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲有好多舊嘅底片，唔知擺咗喺邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 gau6 ge3 dai2 pin3-2, m4 zi1 baai2 zo2 hai2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还有很多旧的底片，不知道放在哪里了。
examples.english_sentence: I still have a lot of old photographic film, I don't know where I put them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲人影相都用數碼相機，好少人用底片機啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 jan4 ying2 soeng2 dou1 yung6 sou3 maa5 soeng1 gei1, hou2 siu2 yan4 yung6 dai2 pin3-2 gei1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人拍照都用数码相机，很少人用胶卷相机了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays people use digital cameras to take pictures, very few people use film cameras.

english_meaning: hole card; trump card; hidden information; the bottom line; trump card
explanation_mandarin: 原指扑克牌游戏中隐藏的牌。引申为隐藏的实力、秘密或关键信息。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the hidden card in a card game like poker. Figuratively, it refers to hidden strength, secrets, or key information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲未攞晒啲底牌出嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 mei6 lo2 saai3 di1 dai2 paai4 chut1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还没有把所有的底牌都亮出来。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't shown all his cards yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快show曬你啲底牌，留返啲睇門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 show saai3 nei5 di1 dai2 paai4, lau4 faan1 di1 tai2 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快就把你的底牌都亮出来，留一些以备不时之需。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show all your cards so quickly, keep some in reserve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗佢今次係出晒啲底牌喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 keoi5 gam1 ci3 hai6 chut1 saai3 di1 dai2 paai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想他这次是把所有的底牌都打出来了。
examples.english_sentence: I think he's played all his cards this time.

mandarin_meaning: 底子; 基础; 根基
english_meaning: Foundation; basis; groundwork; (figuratively) staying power; resilience
explanation_mandarin: 指基础、根基，也指人在某个领域的能力和实力。 比喻一个人在某个方面的基础、实力或经验。 也可指汽车的底盘。
explanation_english: Refers to the foundation, basis, or groundwork. Figuratively refers to a person's ability, strength, or experience in a certain field. It can also refer to the chassis of a car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢英文底盤打得好穩固，所以學其他外語都好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing1 man4 dai2 pun4 daa2 dak1 hou2 wan2 gu3, so2 ji5 hok6 kei4 taa1 ngoi6 jyu5 dou1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语基础打得很好，所以学其他外语都很快。
examples.english_sentence: His English foundation is very solid, so he learns other foreign languages quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅底盤唔夠穩，好易執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 dai2 pun4 m4 gau3 wan2, hou2 ji6 zaap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的基础不够稳固，很容易倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This company's foundation is not stable enough, it's easy to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車嘅底盤好堅固，撞落去都冇乜事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 ge3 dai2 pun4 hou2 gin1 gu3, zong6 lok6 heoi3 dou1 mou5 mat1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的底盘很坚固，撞上去也没什么事。
examples.english_sentence: The chassis of this car is very sturdy, even if it crashes, nothing much will happen.

english_meaning: draft, manuscript, original copy
explanation_mandarin: 指未定稿的初稿，或原始文件。
explanation_english: Refers to the preliminary draft or original copy of a document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份底稿仲有好多地方要改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 dai2 gou2 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 jiu3 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份草稿还有很多地方需要修改。
examples.english_sentence: This draft still has a lot of places that need to be revised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以睇下你份底稿先嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 tai2 haa5 nei5 fan6 dai2 gou2 sin1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以先看一下你的草稿吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I see your draft first?

english_meaning: details, inside story, the whole story, background, particulars, truth
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的来龙去脉、内情详情。
explanation_english: Refers to the details, origins, and insider information of a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想知清楚成件事嘅底細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 cing1 chu2 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 dai2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想清楚地了解整件事情的底细。
examples.english_sentence: I want to know the complete details of the whole matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似知道啲咩底細咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zi1 dou3 di1 me1 dai2 sai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像知道一些内情。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like he knows some inside information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好問清楚佢嘅底細先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 man6 cing1 chu2 keoi5 ge3 dai2 sai3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好先问清楚他的底细。
examples.english_sentence: You better find out his background first.

english_meaning: bottom line, line in the sand, limit, the minimum acceptable standard
explanation_mandarin: 指最低的限度或标准，不可逾越的界限。
explanation_english: Refers to the minimum limit or standard, an impassable boundary. It signifies a point beyond which one will not go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要有底線，唔可以乜嘢都妥協。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 dai2 sin3, m4 ho2 ji5 mat1 je5 dou1 to2 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要有底线，不可以什么都妥协。
examples.english_sentence: A person should have a bottom line and not compromise on everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅底線係唔可以講粗口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 dai2 sin3 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 cou1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的底线是不可以说脏话。
examples.english_sentence: My bottom line is that I can't swear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好挑戰我嘅底線，我會嬲㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tiu1 zin3 ngo5 ge3 dai2 sin3, ngo5 wui5 nau1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要挑战我的底线，我会生气的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't challenge my bottom line, I will get angry!

english_meaning: Cross from the byline (football term)
explanation_mandarin: 在足球比赛中，球员带球到球场底线附近，然后将球传向球门前方的行为。
explanation_english: In football (soccer), it refers to the act of a player dribbling the ball to the byline (end line of the field) and then crossing the ball towards the area in front of the goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都係底線傳中，但係都冇乜入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 dai2 sin3 cyun4 zung1, daan6 hai6 dou1 mou5 mat1 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是底线传中，但是没有进几个球。
examples.english_sentence: They always cross from the byline, but they haven't scored many goals.

mandarin_meaning: 突破底线，一再降低标准
english_meaning: Lowering the bar, constantly compromising one's principles, a race to the bottom
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了达到某种目的，不断降低自己的原则和标准，甚至突破原有的底线。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes the act of continuously lowering one's principles and standards to achieve a goal, often crossing previously established bottom lines. Usually has a negative connotation, implying a lack of integrity or a race to the bottom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司為咗搶生意，底線傳底，搞到啲貨品質素差晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 wai4 zo2 coeng2 saang1 yi3, dai2 sin3 cyun4 dai2, gaau2 dou3 di1 fo3 ban2 zat1 so3 caa1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司为了抢生意，不断降低标准，导致货物质量都变差了。
examples.english_sentence: This company, in order to compete for business, has constantly lowered its standards, resulting in a significant drop in the quality of its goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好底線傳底呀，做人要有原則嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dai2 sin3 cyun4 dai2 aa3, zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 jyun2 zak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一再降低底线啊，做人要有原则的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't constantly lower your standards, you need to have principles in life.

synonyms: 步步退让 (bou6 bou6 teoi3 joeng6)

english_meaning: background color, underlying tone, basic characteristic
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指背景的颜色。2. 比喻事物所具有的基本特征或性质。
explanation_english: 1. Literally refers to the background color. 2. Figuratively refers to the underlying tone, basic characteristic, or inherent nature of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅底色係藍色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 dai2 sik1 hai6 laam4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画的底色是蓝色。
examples.english_sentence: The background color of this painting is blue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個性格嘅底色係悲觀嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 gaak3 ge3 dai2 sik1 hai6 bei1 gwaan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格的底色是悲观的。
examples.english_sentence: The underlying tone of his personality is pessimistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅底色係自由開放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 dai2 sik1 hai6 zi6 jau4 hoi1 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的底色是自由开放。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's underlying characteristic is freedom and openness.

english_meaning: basic salary; base salary
explanation_mandarin: 指基本工资，不包括奖金、提成等额外收入。
explanation_english: Refers to the basic salary, excluding bonuses, commissions, or other extra income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工嘅底薪唔高，但係有好多佣金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 ge3 dai2 san1 m4 gou1, daan6 hai6 jau5 hou2 do1 jung2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的这份工作的底薪不高，但是有很多佣金。
examples.english_sentence: The basic salary of his job isn't high, but there's a lot of commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你期望嘅底薪係幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei4 mong6 ge3 dai2 san1 hai6 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你期望的底薪是多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's the basic salary you're expecting?

english_meaning: inner resources, background, foundation, substance, depth, profound knowledge, reserves
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所蕴含的内在力量、文化积淀、知识积累或个人所具有的内在修养、才能。
explanation_english: Refers to the inner strength, cultural accumulation, knowledge base, or personal cultivation and talent that something possesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好有底藴，講嘢好有深度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 dai2 wan3, gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 sam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很有底蕴，说话很有深度。
examples.english_sentence: He's a person with a lot of inner resources, and what he says has a lot of depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間大學歷史悠久，底藴深厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2, dai2 wan3 sam1 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学历史悠久，底蕴深厚。
examples.english_sentence: This university has a long history and a rich foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成為一個成功嘅藝術家，除咗天份之外，仲要有深厚嘅文化底藴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 sing4 gung1 ge3 ngai6 seot1 gaa1, ceoi4 zo2 tin1 fan6 zi1 ngoi6, zung6 jiu3 jau5 sam1 hau5 ge3 man4 faa3 dai2 wan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成为一个成功的艺术家，除了天赋之外，还要有深厚的文化底蕴。
examples.english_sentence: To become a successful artist, in addition to talent, you also need a deep cultural foundation.

mandarin_meaning: 底蕴; 内涵; 蕴底
english_meaning: Inner strength; substance; foundation; depth; background; cultural deposit; reserve (of knowledge, talent, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指事物蕴藏的内在力量、文化底蕴、内在修养或实力。也指隐藏的、不为人知的基础或资本。
explanation_english: Refers to the inherent strength, cultural background, inner cultivation, or strength that something possesses. It can also refer to a hidden or unknown foundation or capital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅嘢好有底蘊，睇得出佢讀過好多書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 je5 hou2 jau5 dai2 wan5, tai2 dak1 chut1 keoi5 duk6 gwo3 hou2 do1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的东西很有底蕴，看得出他读过很多书。
examples.english_sentence: What he writes has a lot of substance, you can tell he's read a lot of books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司歷史悠久，底蘊深厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2, dai2 wan5 sam1 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司历史悠久，底蕴深厚。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a long history and a solid foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫作睇得出佢有深厚嘅藝術底蘊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 jok3 tai2 dak1 chut1 keoi5 jau5 sam1 hau5 ge3 ngai5 seot dai2 wan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画作看得出他有深厚的艺术底蕴。
examples.english_sentence: His paintings show that he has a strong artistic background.

mandarin_meaning: 底蕴, 内涵, 积累
english_meaning: background, foundation, substance, depth, accumulation of knowledge or experience
explanation_mandarin: 指深厚的积累，包括知识、经验、文化修养等方面。
explanation_english: Refers to a solid accumulation of knowledge, experience, and cultural refinement; a deep and rich background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好有底蘊，講嘢好有深度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 dai2 wan5, gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 sam1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很有底蕴，说话很有深度。
examples.english_sentence: He is a person with a lot of substance, his words are very profound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間老字號嘅餐廳，真係好有底蘊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 lou5 zi3 hou6 ge3 caan1 teng1, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 dai2 wan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家老字号的餐厅，真的很有底蕴。
examples.english_sentence: This long-established restaurant really has a lot of history and depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要做好呢份研究，需要相當嘅底蘊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zou2 hou2 ni1 fan6 jin4 gau3, seoi1 jiu3 soeng1 dong1 ge3 dai2 wan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要做好这份研究，需要相当的底蕴。
examples.english_sentence: To do this research well, you need a considerable amount of background knowledge.

english_meaning: undershirt, vest, undergarment
explanation_mandarin: 贴身穿着的衬衫，通常穿在其他衣服里面。
explanation_english: An undershirt, vest, or undergarment worn close to the body, usually underneath other clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好凍，你最好着多件底衫啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zoek3 do1 gin6 dai2 saam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很冷，你最好多穿一件内衣。
examples.english_sentence: It's very cold today, you better wear an undershirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企成日都係着住件底衫周圍行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 zoek3 zu6 gin6 dai2 saam1 zau1 wai4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家常常穿着一件内衣走来走去。
examples.english_sentence: I often wear just an undershirt around the house.

english_meaning: slip (undergarment)
explanation_mandarin: 穿在裙子或连衣裙里面的内衣，通常是为了防止走光或使裙子垂顺。
explanation_english: An undergarment worn under a dress or skirt, usually to prevent see-through or to make the skirt hang smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙太薄喇，要著返條底裙先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 taai3 bok6 laa3, jiu3 zoek3 faan1 tiu4 dai2 kwan4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子太薄了，得穿一件衬裙才行。
examples.english_sentence: This skirt is too thin, I need to wear a slip underneath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條裙好透，所以佢著咗條底裙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 tau3, so2 ji5 keoi5 zoek3 zo2 tiu4 dai2 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的裙子很透，所以她穿了件衬裙。
examples.english_sentence: Her skirt is very see-through, so she wore a slip.

english_meaning: underwear; underpants
explanation_mandarin: 穿在最里面的裤子，通常是贴身的。
explanation_english: Underwear; underpants. Clothing worn next to the skin, typically under other garments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日唔記得咗換底褲啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 wun6 dai2 fu3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天忘记换内裤了！
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to change my underwear today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條底褲太鬆啦，要買過條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 dai2 fu3 taai3 sung1 laa1, jiu3 maai5 gwo3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条内裤太松了，要买一条新的。
examples.english_sentence: These underpants are too loose; I need to buy a new pair.

synonyms: 孖煙通 (maa1 jin1 tung1) - men's briefs/boxers

english_meaning: bottom, base
explanation_mandarin: 指物体的最下端或最底部的位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the lowest part or the base of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個煲嘅底部燒燶咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bou1 ge3 dai2 bou6 siu1 nung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 锅的底部烧焦了。
examples.english_sentence: The bottom of the pot is burnt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個袋嘅底部好硬淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 doi2 ge3 dai2 bou6 hou2 ngaang6 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包的底部很结实。
examples.english_sentence: The bottom of this bag is very sturdy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺底部簽咗名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dai2 bou6 cim1 zo2 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在底部签了名。
examples.english_sentence: He signed his name at the bottom.

mandarin_meaning: 情面，脸面; 表面和内心
english_meaning: face (as in social standing or prestige); consideration; surface and hidden aspects
explanation_mandarin: 指人情、面子，也指事物的表面和内在。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's face or prestige in a social context. It can also refer to the surface and hidden aspects of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾返啲底面佢啦，唔好咁衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 faan1 di1 dai2 min6 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给他留点面子吧，别那么过分。
examples.english_sentence: Give him some face, don't be so harsh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人好識做底面功夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 sik1 zou6 dai2 min6 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很会做表面功夫。
examples.english_sentence: This person is good at putting on a show (keeping up appearances).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢撕破底面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 si1 po3 dai2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他彻底撕破脸。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to completely fall out with him.

english_meaning: inherent nature; intrinsic quality; underlying substance; fundamentals; backbone
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物的内在本质、基础或根基。也指人的性格、本性。
explanation_english: Refers to the inherent nature, foundation, or base of a person or thing. It can also refer to a person's character or disposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友底骨唔係咁好，成日諗住搵快錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 dai2 gwat1 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2, seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 wan2 faai3 cin2.

english_meaning: To measure the buttocks and then cut the trousers; to act without considering the actual situation; to be inflexible and unrealistic.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是按照屁股的大小来裁剪裤子，比喻做事不根据实际情况，生搬硬套，非常死板。通常用来形容人做事没有弹性，只看表面，不考虑内在或者变化。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to cut trousers according to the size of the buttocks. Figuratively, it means to act without considering the actual situation, to be inflexible and unrealistic. It is often used to describe someone who is rigid, only looks at the surface, and does not consider the internal or changing aspects.

jyutping: dok6 zyu6 si2 fat1 caai4 fu3
english_meaning: To measure the buttocks while tailoring pants; to only see what's in front of you without considering the bigger picture; to act reactively rather than proactively; to address a problem only when it arises instead of preventing it.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只顾眼前，不作长远打算；或指遇到问题才临时解决，缺乏计划性。
explanation_english: This idiom metaphorically describes the act of measuring the buttocks while making pants, implying a lack of foresight and planning. It suggests addressing problems only when they become immediately apparent, rather than anticipating and preventing them. It's similar to being short-sighted or lacking a strategic perspective.

english_meaning: Resort
explanation_mandarin: 提供住宿、餐饮、娱乐等服务的场所，供人们度假休闲。
explanation_english: A place providing accommodation, food, and entertainment services for people to spend their vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃下個月去峇里島嘅度假村放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 baa1 lei5 dou2 ge3 dou6 gaa3 cyun1 fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们计划下个月去巴厘岛的度假村放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to go to a resort in Bali next month to relax.

english_meaning: Wise person; resourceful person; someone with good ideas or strategies; strategist
explanation_mandarin: 指有智慧、有计谋、能提供好主意的人。通常带有尊敬或赞赏的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a wise, resourceful person who can provide good ideas or strategies. Usually used with respect or admiration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係我哋公司嘅度叔，咩問題都難唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 dok6 suk1, me1 man6 tai4 dou1 naan4 m4 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是我们公司的智者，什么问题都难不倒他。
examples.english_sentence: He is truly our company's strategist; no problem can stump him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有佢呢個度叔喺度，我哋就唔使咁擔心喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 keoi5 ni1 go3 dok6 suk1 hai2 dou6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有他这个智者在这里，我们就不用那么担心了。
examples.english_sentence: With this resourceful person here, we don't have to worry so much.

english_meaning: everywhere, all over, in every place
explanation_mandarin: 表示所有的地点或范围，每个地方。
explanation_english: Indicates all locations or areas, every place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港度度都係人，逼死人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dou6 dou6 dou1 hai6 jan4, bik1 sei2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港到处都是人，挤死人了。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is crowded with people everywhere; it's suffocating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢度度去旅行，好羡慕佢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou6 dou6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, hou2 sin6 mou6 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到处去旅行，好羡慕他啊！
examples.english_sentence: He travels everywhere; I'm so jealous of him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你度度都滴晒啲水，抹乾淨佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou6 dou6 dou1 dip1 saai3 di1 seoi2, mut3 gon1 zeng6 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你到处都滴满了水，擦干净它吧！
examples.english_sentence: You've dripped water everywhere, wipe it clean!

english_meaning: Degree (of glasses, alcohol, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指眼镜的度数、酒精的浓度等。
explanation_english: Refers to the degree of glasses (prescription strength), alcohol content, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我副眼鏡有三百度數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fu3 ngaan5 geng2 jau5 saam1 baak3 dou6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的眼镜有三百度。
examples.english_sentence: My glasses are 300 degrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支酒嘅度數好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 zau2 ge3 dou6 sou3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶酒的度数很高。
examples.english_sentence: The alcohol content of this bottle of alcohol is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅近視度數又加深咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gan6 si6 dou6 sou3 jau6 gaa1 sam1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的近视度数又加深了。
examples.english_sentence: His myopia (nearsightedness) has gotten worse again.

english_meaning: to live; to spend one's days; to get by; to eke out a living
explanation_mandarin: 指生活、过日子，尤指勉强维持生计。
explanation_english: Refers to living or spending one's days, often implying struggling to make a living or getting by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好多人都好難度日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 naan4 dok6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多人都很难过日子。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, and it's difficult for many people to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠執紙皮度日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zap1 zi2 pei4 dok6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠捡纸皮过日子。
examples.english_sentence: He makes a living by collecting cardboard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港生活，物價咁貴，真係唔容易度日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 sang1 wut6, mat6 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6 dok6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港生活，物价这么贵，真是不容易过日子。
examples.english_sentence: Living in Hong Kong, with such high prices, it's really not easy to get by.

english_meaning: Every day feels like a year (due to boredom, suffering, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容日子过得很慢，感觉像过了一年一样。通常用于形容日子非常难熬，或非常无聊。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where each day feels exceptionally long and drawn out, as if a year has passed. It's often used to depict a period of suffering, extreme boredom, or intense longing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢失業之後，日日都度日如年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, jat6 jat6 dou1 dok6 jat6 jyu4 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他失业之后，每天都度日如年。
examples.english_sentence: Since he lost his job, every day feels like a year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺醫院等報告，真係度日如年咁難受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ji1 jyun2 dang2 bou3 gou3, zan1 hai6 dok6 jat6 jyu4 nin4 gam3 naan4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在医院等报告，真是度日如年那么难受。
examples.english_sentence: Waiting for the report in the hospital is really painful; every day feels like a year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放監前嘅日子，對佢嚟講，度日如年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaam1 cin4 ge3 jat6 zi2, deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2, dok6 jat6 jyu4 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出狱前的日子，对他来说，度日如年。
examples.english_sentence: The days before his release from prison felt like an eternity to him.

mandarin_meaning: 安排时间, 协调日期
english_meaning: to schedule, to arrange a date, to find a free slot in one's schedule
explanation_mandarin: 安排或协调某个活动的日期或时间，通常指在繁忙的日程中找到空闲时间。
explanation_english: To schedule or arrange a date or time for an activity, usually referring to finding a free slot in a busy schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要度期食飯喇，好耐冇見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dok6 kei4 sik6 faan6 laa3, hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得安排时间吃饭了，好久没见了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to schedule a time to have dinner, it's been a long time since we last met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我呢排好忙，要度期先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ni1 paai4 hou2 mong4, jiu3 dok6 kei4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我最近很忙，要安排一下时间才行。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm very busy lately, I need to schedule it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日唔得閒，你度吓其他期囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4, nei5 dok6 haa5 kei4 taa1 kei4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天没空，你安排一下其他时间吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow, you find another time.

english_meaning: to brainstorm, to come up with ideas, to figure out a plan
explanation_mandarin: 指思考并制定解决方案、计划或策略。通常用于解决问题或实现目标。
explanation_english: Refers to thinking and developing solutions, plans, or strategies. It is often used to solve problems or achieve goals. It implies brainstorming and collaborative idea generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齐度橋，睇下点样可以搞掂件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 dok6 kiu4, tai2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 gaau2 dim6 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起想办法，看看怎样可以搞定这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Let's brainstorm together and see how we can solve this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得度橋，每次遇到难题都搵佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 dok6 kiu4, mui5 ci3 jyu6 dou2 naan4 tai4 dou1 wan2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会想办法，每次遇到难题都找他。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at coming up with ideas, so we always ask him when we encounter difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要度條好橋先可以喺竞争入面赢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 dok6 tiu4 hou2 kiu4 sin1 ho2 ji5 hai2 ging6 zang1 jap6 min6 win4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要想个好办法才能在竞争中获胜。
examples.english_sentence: We need to come up with a good plan in order to win in the competition.

english_meaning: to raise money; to find money (usually urgently); to come up with cash
explanation_mandarin: 指设法筹集资金，通常用于紧急情况或急需用钱的场合。
explanation_english: To find a way to raise money, usually urgently or when there is an immediate need for cash. It implies finding or borrowing money when one is short on funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，老友，我爭人錢聽日就要還，你幫我度下水啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, lou5 jau5, ngo5 zaang1 jan4 cin2 ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 waan4, nei5 bong1 ngo5 dok6 haa5 seoi2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，老朋友，我欠别人的钱明天就要还了，你帮我想办法筹点钱吧！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, buddy, I owe someone money that I have to pay back tomorrow. Can you help me raise some money?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司週轉唔靈，要諗辦法度水先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zau1 zyun2 m4 ling4, jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 dok6 seoi2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司资金周转不灵，要想法子筹钱才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company's cash flow is tight, we need to find a way to raise money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要交學費，阿媽仲喺度度水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 hok6 fai3, aa3 maa1 zung6 hai2 dou6 dok6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要交学费，妈妈还在想办法筹钱。
examples.english_sentence: School fees are due tomorrow, and my mom is still trying to find the money.

english_meaning: to draft (a document, speech, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指起草、撰写文稿，例如演讲稿、宣传稿等。
explanation_english: To draft, write, or prepare a manuscript, such as a speech, promotional material, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日阿頭要我喺會議上面講嘢，我今晚要度稿喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 aa3 tau4 jiu3 ngo5 hai2 wui5 ji5 soeng6 min6 gong2 je5, ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 dok6 gou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天老板要我在会议上讲话，我今晚要写稿了。
examples.english_sentence: My boss wants me to speak at the meeting tomorrow, so I need to draft my speech tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份新聞稿係邊個度稿㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 san1 man4 gou2 hai6 bin1 go3 dok6 gou2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份新闻稿是谁写的？
examples.english_sentence: Who drafted this press release?

english_meaning: stingy; miserly; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常小气，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好度縮，一蚊都唔捨得使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 dok6 suk1, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很吝啬，一分钱都舍不得花。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy, he is unwilling to spend even a penny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁度縮啦，請我飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dok6 suk1 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气啦，请我喝杯东西嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just buy me a drink.

english_meaning: to go on a honeymoon; honeymoon
explanation_mandarin: 指新婚夫妇结婚后一起旅行度假，庆祝新婚。
explanation_english: To spend a honeymoon; a vacation taken by a newly married couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結完婚之後，打算去歐洲度蜜月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 jyun4 fan1 zi1 hau6, daa2 syun3 heoi3 au1 zau1 dok6 mat6 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚之后，打算去欧洲度蜜月。
examples.english_sentence: After they get married, they plan to go to Europe for their honeymoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅度蜜月真係好浪漫呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 dok6 mat6 jyut6 zan1 hai6 hou2 long6 maan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的蜜月旅行真是太浪漫了！
examples.english_sentence: Their honeymoon is so romantic!

english_meaning: to wander around the streets, to stroll around, to go window shopping
explanation_mandarin: 指在街上闲逛，没有特定目的的走动，通常是为了消遣或放松。
explanation_english: Refers to wandering around the streets, walking without a specific purpose, usually for leisure or relaxation. Often involves looking at shops without necessarily buying anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇嘢做，不如我哋出去度街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 je5 zou6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 cheot1 heoi3 dok6 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚没事做，不如我们出去逛街吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's nothing to do tonight, how about we go for a stroll?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放工就度街，買好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fong3 gung1 zau6 dok6 gaai1, maai5 ho2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常下班就逛街，买很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often wanders around the streets after work and buys a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺尖沙咀度咗成日街，攰到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 jim1 saa1 zeoi2 dok6 zo2 seng4 jat6 gaai1, gui6 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在尖沙咀逛了一整天街，累死了。
examples.english_sentence: We strolled around Tsim Sha Tsui all day, we're exhausted.

english_meaning: to brainstorm, to come up with ideas, to figure out a solution, to scheme
explanation_mandarin: 指为了解决问题或达到某种目的而积极思考，出谋划策。
explanation_english: To actively think, strategize, and come up with plans or solutions to solve a problem or achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要度條蹺先搞得掂件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dok6 tiu4 kiu2 sin1 gaau2 dak1 dim6 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得先想个办法才能把这件事搞定。
examples.english_sentence: We need to come up with a plan first to be able to handle this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係呻，不如度下蹺點樣解決問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 san1, bat1 jyu4 dok6 haa5 kiu2 dim2 joeng2 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别光抱怨，不如想想办法怎么解决问题吧。
examples.english_sentence: Instead of just complaining, why don't we brainstorm how to solve the problem?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班同事成日一齊度蹺，諗啲新嘅市場推廣策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 tung4 si6 sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 dok6 kiu2, nam2 di1 san1 ge3 si5 coeng4 tui1 gwong2 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群同事经常一起想办法，想一些新的市场推广策略。
examples.english_sentence: That group of colleagues often brainstorm together to come up with new marketing strategies.

english_meaning: tailor-made; customized; to measure (someone for clothes)
explanation_mandarin: 按照个人尺寸或需求制作或修改。
explanation_english: To make or modify something according to individual measurements or needs; tailor-made or customized to fit a specific person or purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係度身訂造嘅，啱晒你身形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 dok6 san1 ding6 zou6 ge3, ngaam1 saai3 nei5 san1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是量身定制的，非常合你的身材。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is tailor-made, it fits your figure perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以度身訂造一個方案，解決你嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 dok6 san1 ding6 zou6 jat1 go3 fong1 on3, gaai2 kyut3 nei5 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以量身定制一个方案，解决你的问题。
examples.english_sentence: We can tailor-make a solution to solve your problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程係度身設計嘅，針對唔同程度嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 hai6 dok6 san1 she3 gai3 ge3, zaam1 deoi3 m4 tung4 ching4 dou6 ge3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这门课程是量身设计的，针对不同程度的学生。
examples.english_sentence: This course is tailor-made, targeting students of different levels.

english_meaning: tailor-made; custom-made
explanation_mandarin: 按照个人的需要和尺寸来制作。比喻根据具体情况制定相应的方案或措施。
explanation_english: Made to order according to individual needs and measurements; custom-made. Figuratively, to formulate plans or measures according to specific circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係我度身定做嘅，所以啱啱好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 ngo5 dok6 san1 ding6 zou6 ge3, so2 ji5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是我量身定做的，所以非常合身。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is tailor-made for me, so it fits perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為每個學生度身定做學習計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai4 mui5 go3 hok6 sang1 dok6 san1 ding6 zou6 hok6 zaap6 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为每个学生量身定制学习计划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to tailor-make learning plans for each student.

english_meaning: tailor-made; custom-made; bespoke
explanation_mandarin: 根据个人具体情况进行设计、制作或安排。
explanation_english: Made or designed to fit a particular person or meet a specific need; custom-made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程係度身訂做㗎，啱晒你嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 hai6 dok6 san1 ding3 zou6 gaa3, ngaam1 saai3 nei5 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个课程是量身定制的，非常适合你的需求。
examples.english_sentence: This course is tailor-made and perfectly suits your needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅服務可以度身訂做，好有彈性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ho2 ji5 dok6 san1 ding3 zou6, hou2 jau5 taan4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的服务可以量身定制，非常有弹性。
examples.english_sentence: This company's services are custom-made and very flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫係度身訂做嘅，所以好啱身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 hai6 dok6 san1 ding3 zou6 ge3, so2 ji5 hou2 ngaam1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服是量身定制的，所以很合身。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are tailor-made, so they fit very well.

english_meaning: tailor-made, custom-made, bespoke
explanation_mandarin: 按照个人需求和尺寸进行制作。通常用于形容物品或服务是专门为某人或某个目的设计的。
explanation_english: Made or fitted to individual requirements; custom-made or bespoke. It implies something is specifically designed or created for a particular person or purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係度身訂造㗎，所以咁啱身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 dok6 san1 ding3 zou6 gaa3, so2 ji5 gam3 ngaam1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是量身定做的，所以这么合身。

english_meaning: warehouse, storehouse, repository
explanation_mandarin: 储存物品的地方。也可用作量词，表示仓库的数量。
explanation_english: A place for storing goods; a warehouse. It can also be used as a measure word, referring to the number of warehouses.

explanation_english: Coulomb is the SI unit of electric charge. It is the amount of electric charge transported by a current of one ampere flowing for one second.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電容器可以儲存幾多庫侖嘅電荷？

examples.english_sentence: I forgot the formula for Coulomb's law.

english_meaning: courtyard; patio

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋晏晝喺庭院入面飲茶，吹下水。

explanation_english: A place of religious residence, specifically a nunnery or sometimes just a temple.

explanation_mandarin: 指一般的平民百姓，与统治阶级相对。
explanation_english: Refers to ordinary people, the general public, as opposed to the ruling class or elite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅政策都係為咗庶民而設嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jing3 caak3 dou1 hai6 wai4 zo2 syu3 man4 ji4 cit3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的政策都是为了老百姓而设立的。
examples.english_sentence: His policies are all designed for the common people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢啲庶民，邊有咁多錢去旅行呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 di1 syu3 man4, bin1 jau5 gam3 do1 cin2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这些平民百姓，哪有那么多钱去旅行啊？
examples.english_sentence: We commoners, how can we afford to travel so much?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出身庶民，一步一步爬到高位，好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 san1 syu3 man4, jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 paa4 dou3 gou1 wai2, hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身平民，一步一步爬到高位，很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He came from humble beginnings and climbed his way up to a high position, he's really capable.

english_meaning: healthy, health, well-being
explanation_mandarin: 表示身体健康，没有疾病。也可以指身体的健康状态。
explanation_english: Refers to being healthy and free from illness. Can also refer to the state of one's health and well-being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你身體健康，生活安康！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, sang1 wut6 on1 hong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你身体健康，生活安康！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you good health and a peaceful life!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，依家終於康復喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji1 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 hong1 fuk6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，现在终于康复了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a long time, but he has finally recovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個療程可以幫助你恢復健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 liu4 ching4 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 nei5 fui1 fuk6 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个疗程可以帮助你恢复健康。
examples.english_sentence: This treatment can help you regain your health.

english_meaning: Carnation
explanation_mandarin: 一种花，常用于母亲节，象征着对母亲的爱。
explanation_english: A type of flower, often used on Mother's Day, symbolizing love for one's mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 母親節送康乃馨畀阿媽係傳統嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 can1 zit3 sung3 hong1 naai5 hing1 bei2 a3 maa1 hai6 cyun4 tung2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 母亲节送康乃馨给妈妈是传统。
examples.english_sentence: It's a tradition to give carnations to mothers on Mother's Day.

english_meaning: LOHAS Park (MTR station and surrounding area)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港港鐵將軍澳綫的康城站，以及車站上蓋的住宅發展項目一帶的區域。
explanation_english: Refers to LOHAS Park MTR station on the Tseung Kwan O Line in Hong Kong, as well as the surrounding residential development area built above the station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日喺康城見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 hai2 hong1 sing4 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天在康城见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet in LOHAS Park tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 康城啲樓都幾新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hong1 sing4 di1 lau2 dou1 gei2 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 康城的楼都挺新的。
examples.english_sentence: The buildings in LOHAS Park are quite new.

english_meaning: Cannes Film Festival
explanation_mandarin: 指法国戛纳电影节，是一个国际性的电影节，以其艺术性和影响力而闻名。
explanation_english: Refers to the Cannes Film Festival in France, an international film festival known for its artistic merit and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年香港都有幾部戲入圍咗康城影展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 jau5 gei2 bou6 hei3 jap6 wai4 zo2 hong1 sing4 jing2 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年香港也有几部电影入围了戛纳电影节。
examples.english_sentence: This year, several Hong Kong films have been nominated for the Cannes Film Festival.

english_meaning: to recover; to recuperate; recovery
explanation_mandarin: 恢复健康，恢复正常状态。
explanation_english: To return to a normal or healthy condition after illness or injury; the process of returning to a normal or healthy condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，而家終於康復啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 hong1 fuk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，现在终于康复了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a long time and has finally recovered now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你可以早日康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 zou2 jat6 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你可以早日康复。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you recover soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢康復嘅進度比預期快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hong1 fuk6 ge3 zeon3 dou6 bei2 jyu6 kei4 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他康复的进度比预期快。
examples.english_sentence: His recovery progress is faster than expected.

english_meaning: Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD)
explanation_mandarin: 香港特别行政区政府的一个部门，负责提供康乐和文化服务，包括管理公园、体育馆、博物馆、图书馆等。
explanation_english: A department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government responsible for providing leisure and cultural services, including the management of parks, sports grounds, museums, and libraries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想喺康文署個游泳池學游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 hong1 man4 cyu5 go3 jau4 wing6 ci4 hok6 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想在康文署的游泳池学游泳。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn swimming at the LCSD's swimming pool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 康文署搞嘅節目都幾多元化㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hong1 man4 cyu5 gaau2 ge3 zit3 muk6 dou1 gei2 do1 jyun4 faa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 康文署举办的节目都很多元化。
examples.english_sentence: The programmes organised by the LCSD are quite diverse.

english_meaning: recreation, entertainment, leisure
explanation_mandarin: 指健康的快乐，通常与休闲活动相关。
explanation_english: Refers to healthy happiness, usually associated with leisure activities and recreation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有個康樂部，成日搞活動俾大家放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 go3 hong1 lok6 bou6, seng4 jat6 gaau2 wut6 dung6 bei2 daai6 gaa1 fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有个康乐部，经常举办活动让大家放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has a recreation department that often organizes activities for everyone to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意參加康樂活動，例如行山、游水噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 caam1 gaa1 hong1 lok6 wut6 dung6, lai6 jyu4 haang4 saan1, jau4 seoi2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢参加康乐活动，例如爬山、游泳等等。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to participate in recreational activities, such as hiking and swimming.

english_meaning: Chinese Checkers
explanation_mandarin: 一种棋类游戏，通常由二至六人玩，棋盘上有六角星形的图案。
explanation_english: A board game typically played by two to six players. The board is in the shape of a six-pointed star.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日同屋企人玩康樂棋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 waan2 hong1 lok6 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常和家人玩康乐棋。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often played Chinese Checkers with my family.

mandarin_meaning: 宽阔平坦的大路；比喻光明的前途
english_meaning: broad and smooth road; a bright future
explanation_mandarin: 比喻平坦顺利的道路，也比喻光明的前途。多用于积极正面的语境，表示发展前景一片光明。
explanation_english: A broad and smooth road; a metaphor for a bright and promising future. It is often used in positive contexts to indicate that the prospects for development are bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要你肯努力，一定可以行上康莊大道㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 nei5 hang2 nu5 lik6, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 haang4 soeng5 hong1 zong1 daai6 dou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要你肯努力，一定可以走上康庄大道的。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you are willing to work hard, you will surely be able to embark on a bright future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家政府嘅政策對年輕人嚟講，好似冇乜康莊大道可以行咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3 deoi3 nin4 hing1 jan4 lai4 gong2, hou2 ci5 mou5 mat1 hong1 zong1 daai6 dou6 ho2 ji5 haang4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在政府的政策对年轻人来说，好像没有什么康庄大道可以走。
examples.english_sentence: The current government policies seem to offer young people few paths to a bright future.

english_meaning: mediocre, ordinary, vulgar, commonplace
explanation_mandarin: 指才能、品德等平常，不高明；也指庸俗，不高雅。
explanation_english: Describes something that is mediocre, ordinary, lacking in talent or virtue; can also refer to something vulgar or lacking in refinement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好庸俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 jung1 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很庸俗。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very vulgar person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做個庸人，要有自己嘅理想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 go3 jung1 jan4, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei5 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做一个庸人，要有自己的理想。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a mediocre person, have your own ideals.

mandarin_meaning: 庸人自扰 (yōng rén zì rǎo)
english_meaning: Borrowing trouble; making a fuss over nothing; a commoner troubling himself.
explanation_mandarin: 指本来没有事，自己找麻烦。形容人无事生非，庸俗的人自找麻烦，庸人自扰。
explanation_english: Refers to creating trouble for oneself where none existed before. It describes someone who makes trouble out of nothing, or that a common or mediocre person creates trouble for themselves. A fuss about nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都諗太多喇，庸人自擾啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 lam2 taai3 do1 laa3, jung1 jan4 zi6 jiu2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想太多了，庸人自扰而已。
examples.english_sentence: You're overthinking it; you're just making a fuss over nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁庸人自擾啦，件事冇你諗得咁複雜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung1 jan4 zi6 jiu2 laa1, gin6 si4 mou5 nei5 lam2 dak1 gam3 fuk1 zaap6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要庸人自扰了，事情没有你想象的那么复杂。
examples.english_sentence: Don't borrow trouble, it's not as complicated as you think.

synonyms: 杞人憂天 (kei5 jan4 yau1 tin1)

english_meaning: vulgar, banal, philistine, tasteless
explanation_mandarin: 形容缺乏品味，格调低下，平庸低俗。
explanation_english: Describing something or someone lacking taste, being of low quality, and generally vulgar or banal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好庸俗，成日講埋啲低級笑話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jung1 suk6, seng4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 dai1 kap1 siu3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很庸俗，总是讲一些低级笑话。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very vulgar person, always telling low-class jokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲設計好庸俗，冇咩品味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sat3 gai3 hou2 jung1 suk6, mou5 me1 ban2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些设计很庸俗，没什么品味。
examples.english_sentence: These designs are very vulgar, they lack taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢嘅品味好庸俗，成日著啲好誇張嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 ban2 mei6 hou2 jung1 suk6, seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 hou2 kwaa1 zoeng1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他的品味很庸俗，总是穿一些很夸张的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I think his taste is very vulgar, always wearing very extravagant clothes.

english_meaning: mediocre talent, a person of limited ability, incompetent person
explanation_mandarin: 指才能平庸的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person of mediocre talent and ability; someone who is not particularly skilled or competent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個位度做咗咁耐都冇咩表現，真係庸才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 wai2 dou6 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mou5 me1 biu2 hin3, zan1 hai6 jung1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个职位做了这么久都没有什么表现，真是个庸才。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in this position for so long and hasn't shown much progress, he's truly a mediocre talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己好叻，如果唔努力嘅話，好快就會變咗庸才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 nu5 lik6 ge3 waa6, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 bin3 zo2 jung1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为自己很厉害，如果不努力的话，很快就会变成庸才。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're so great, if you don't work hard, you'll quickly become a mediocre talent.

english_meaning: mediocre, ordinary, undistinguished; to live a life without great achievements
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人平庸，没有作为，过着普通的生活。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is mediocre, lacking accomplishments, and living an ordinary life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想自己一生人庸碌噉過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zi6 gei2 jat1 sang1 jan4 jung1 luk1 gam2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想自己一生庸碌地过。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to live a mediocre life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好甘心庸碌一生，要努力實現自己嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam1 sam1 jung1 luk1 jat1 sang1, jiu3 nu5 lik6 sat6 hin6 zi6 gei2 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要甘心庸碌一生，要努力实现自己的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be content with a mediocre life, strive to realize your dreams.

english_meaning: gaudily dressed, vulgar woman; ordinary and unattractive women; common women with vulgar makeup
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子外表打扮俗气，没有气质和品味。也指平凡普通的女子，缺乏吸引力。
explanation_english: Describes women who are gaudily dressed, lack taste, and have vulgar makeup. It can also refer to ordinary and unattractive women, lacking any special qualities or charm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話人係庸脂俗粉，其實佢自己都唔好得幾多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 jan4 hai6 jung1 zi1 suk6 fan2, kei4 sat6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 dou1 m4 hou2 dak1 gei2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说别人是庸脂俗粉，其实她自己也好不到哪里去。
examples.english_sentence: She always calls others gaudily dressed and vulgar, but she's not much better herself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為搽咁多化妝品就唔係庸脂俗粉，最緊要係要有氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 caa4 gam3 do1 faa3 zong1 ban2 zau6 m4 hai6 jung1 zi1 suk6 fan2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 jiu3 jau5 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为涂这么多化妆品就不是庸俗的女人，最重要的是要有气质。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that wearing a lot of makeup makes you not vulgar; the most important thing is to have elegance.

english_meaning: quack doctor, incompetent doctor
explanation_mandarin: 指医术不高明的医生，水平差的医生。
explanation_english: Refers to a doctor with poor medical skills; an incompetent or unqualified doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪睇個庸醫呀，佢會醫死你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tai2 go3 jung1 ji1 aa3, keoi5 wui5 ji1 sei2 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别去看那个庸医啊，他会把你治死的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't see that quack doctor, he'll kill you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾個庸醫誤診咗，搞到病情仲差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 jung1 ji1 ng6診 zo2, gaau2 dou3 bing6 cing4 zung6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被庸医误诊了，导致病情更糟。
examples.english_sentence: He was misdiagnosed by an incompetent doctor, which made his condition even worse.

synonyms: 蒙古醫生 (mung4 gu2 yi1 sang1)

english_meaning: a fathom; the length of both arms stretched out
explanation_mandarin: 指两臂伸开的长度，大约等于五尺。
explanation_english: A unit of length approximately equal to the distance between the fingertips of a person's outstretched arms. Roughly five Chinese feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩有幾庹長啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sing2 jau5 gei2 to5 coeng4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条绳子有多长啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many fathoms long is this rope?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋闊十幾庹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 fut3 sap6 gei2 to5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子宽十几拃。
examples.english_sentence: This house is a dozen or so fathoms wide.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常吝啬，不舍得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好庹縮㗎，一蚊都唔捨得洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 tok3 suk1 gaa3, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很吝啬，一元钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stingy person, he wouldn't even spend one dollar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁庹縮啦，請我食餐飯啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tok3 suk1 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 sik6 caan1 faan6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么小气啦，请我吃顿饭而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, it's just treating me to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係庹縮到出晒名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 tok3 suk1 dou3 chut1晒 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是吝啬到出了名。
examples.english_sentence: He is really notoriously stingy.

english_meaning: To reveal, to show, to expose
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，通常与“晒”连用，表示炫耀，显摆的意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, usually used with "saai3" to mean showing off, flaunting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交媒體度庾命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 se3 gaau1 mui4 tai2 dou6 jyu5 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在社交媒体上炫耀自己。
examples.english_sentence: He often shows off on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日庾晒你啲新衫啦，人哋會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 jyu5 saai3 nei5 di1 san1 saam1 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是炫耀你的新衣服，别人会不开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always flaunt your new clothes, others will be unhappy.

english_meaning: toilet, restroom, lavatory
explanation_mandarin: 指供人大小便的地方，通常也指洗手间。
explanation_english: A place for urination and defecation, usually also including a place for washing hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去廁所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 ci3 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去厕所。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the toilet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅廁所好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ci3 so2 hou2 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的厕所很干净。
examples.english_sentence: The restroom in this restaurant is very clean.

explanation_english: Literally means toilet water. Figuratively, it refers to cheap and low-quality perfume. This is because in the past, toilets had poor hygiene, so "toilet water" is used to describe perfume with an unpleasant smell.

explanation_english: Describes a place or scope as wide and spacious; can also refer to an outline or shape.
