examples.english_sentence: He's from Guangxi, his Mandarin has a slight accent.

english_meaning: wide-angle lens
explanation_mandarin: 一种焦距短、视角大的镜头，能拍摄较广范围的景物。
explanation_english: A lens with a short focal length and a wide angle of view, capable of capturing a wider range of scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用廣角鏡影張相，可以影晒成班人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 gwong2 gok3 geng3 ying2 zoeng1 soeng2, ho2 yi5 ying2 saai3 sing4 baan1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用广角镜头拍一张照片，可以把一整群人都拍进去。
examples.english_sentence: I'll use a wide-angle lens to take a photo so I can capture the whole group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個風景好靚呀，用廣角鏡影就啱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3 aa3, yung6 gwong2 gok3 geng3 ying2 zau6 ngaam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个风景很漂亮啊，用广角镜头拍就最合适了。
examples.english_sentence: This scenery is beautiful, it's perfect to capture with a wide-angle lens.

english_meaning: wide-angle lens
explanation_mandarin: 一种焦距短于标准镜头、视角大于标准镜头的镜头。
explanation_english: A lens with a short focal length and a wider angle of view than a standard lens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用廣角鏡頭影相可以影到更多嘅景物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 gwong2 gok3 geng3 tau4 ying2 seung2 ho2 yi5 ying2 dou3 gang3 do1 ge3 ging2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用广角镜头拍照可以拍到更多的景物。
examples.english_sentence: Using a wide-angle lens for taking photos allows you to capture more scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買個廣角鏡頭嚟影風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seung2 maai5 go3 gwong2 gok3 geng3 tau4 lai4 ying2 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一个广角镜头来拍风景。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a wide-angle lens to take landscape photos.

english_meaning: wide; broad; vast; extensive
explanation_mandarin: 形容面积、范围等宽广，辽阔。
explanation_english: Describing an area, range, etc., as wide, broad, or vast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅草原非常廣闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 cou2 jyun4 fei1 soeng4 gwong2 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的草原非常广阔。
examples.english_sentence: The grassland here is very vast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅知識面好廣闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zi1 sik1 min6 hou2 gwong2 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的知识面很广阔。
examples.english_sentence: His breadth of knowledge is very wide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅發展前景好廣闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 faat3 zin2 cin4 ging2 hou2 gwong2 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的发展前景很广阔。
examples.english_sentence: The development prospects for Hong Kong are very broad.

mandarin_meaning: 房子, 小屋, 简陋的住所
english_meaning: Hut, cottage, simple dwelling
explanation_mandarin: 通常指简陋的住所或小屋。也可引申为某人居住或工作的地方。
explanation_english: Generally refers to a simple dwelling or cottage. Can also be extended to refer to a place where someone lives or works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺山上面起咗間草廬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 saan1 soeng6 min6 hei2 zo2 gaan1 cou2 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在山上盖了一间草庐。
examples.english_sentence: He built a thatched hut on the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我間屋仔都好似間廬咁，又細又殘舊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaan1 uk1 zai2 dou1 hou2 ci5 gaan1 lou4 gam3, jau6 sai3 jau6 caan4 gau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的房子就像个小屋一样，又小又破旧。
examples.english_sentence: My house is like a hut, small and dilapidated.

english_meaning: the true face of Mount Lu; the true nature of something; the real story
explanation_mandarin: 比喻隐藏或遮蔽得很深，不容易被人们了解的真相或本质。出自苏轼《题西林壁》诗：'不识庐山真面目，只缘身在此山中。'
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the true face or nature of something that is hidden or obscured, making it difficult to understand. It originates from Su Shi's poem "Inscription on West Forest Temple" where he wrote: 'I cannot recognize the true face of Mount Lu because I am in the mountain myself.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年，我終於睇到佢嘅廬山眞面目喇，原來佢係咁樣嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4, ngo5 zung1 jyu1 tai2 dou2 keoi5 ge3 lou4 saan1 zan1 min6 muk6 laa3, jyun4 loi4 keoi5 hai6 gam2 joeng2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年，我终于看到了他的庐山真面目了，原来他是这样的人。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years, I finally saw his true colors, and it turns out he's this kind of person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快做決定，要睇清楚件事嘅廬山眞面目先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 zou6 kyut3 ding6, jiu3 tai2 cing1 chu2 gin6 si6 ge3 lou4 saan1 zan1 min6 muk6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么快做决定，要看清楚这件事的庐山真面目先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a decision so quickly. You need to see the true nature of the matter first.

mandarin_meaning: 庐山真面目 (lú shān zhēn miàn mù)
english_meaning: the true face of Mount Lu; the true nature of something; the real picture
explanation_mandarin: 出自苏轼《题西林壁》。比喻真相或本来面目。
explanation_english: From Su Shi's poem "Inscription on West Forest Temple Wall".  It refers to the true nature or original appearance of something, often something that was previously unclear or obscured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅廬山真面目，始終都會揭曉㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 lou4 saan1 zan1 min6 muk6, chi2 chung1 dou1 wui5 kit3 hiu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情的庐山真面目，始终都会揭晓的。
examples.english_sentence: The true nature of the matter will eventually be revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係睇表面，要睇清楚件事嘅廬山真面目啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 biu2 min6, jiu3 tai2 ching1 chu2 gin6 si6 ge3 lou4 saan1 zan1 min6 muk6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只看表面，要看清楚事情的庐山真面目啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just look at the surface, you need to see the true picture of the matter.

synonyms: 本來面目 (bun2 loi4 min6 muk6)

english_meaning: hall, living room, lobby
explanation_mandarin: 指住宅中用于会客、休息、娱乐等活动的房间；也指较大的公共空间，如礼堂、展厅等。
explanation_english: Refers to a room in a house used for receiving guests, relaxing, or entertaining; also refers to a large public space, such as an auditorium or exhibition hall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間屋個廳好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 go3 ting1 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家的客厅很大。
examples.english_sentence: Our living room is very big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺酒店個大廳等我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zau2 dim3 go3 daai6 ting1 dang2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在酒店的大厅等我。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me in the hotel lobby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去咗文化中心嘅展覽廳參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 man4 faa3 zung1 sam1 ge3 zin2 laam5 ting1 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去了文化中心的展览厅参观。
examples.english_sentence: We went to visit the exhibition hall in the cultural center.

english_meaning: hall; main room; living room; formal reception hall
explanation_mandarin: 指房屋中最大的房间，通常用于接待客人、家庭活动等。
explanation_english: Refers to the main room of a house, typically used for receiving guests, family activities, etc. It can also refer to a formal reception hall, especially in older or traditional buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間屋個廳堂好大，可以擺好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 go3 ting1 tong4 hou2 daai6, ho2 ji5 baai2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家的客厅很大，可以放很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: Our living room is very big; we can put a lot of things in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，我哋會喺廳堂擺桃花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 hai2 ting1 tong4 baai2 tou4 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，我们会在客厅摆桃花。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, we put peach blossoms in the living room.

english_meaning: Director (of a department or bureau); Bureau Chief
explanation_mandarin: 政府部门或机构的首长，通常指省级或更高级别的部门负责人。
explanation_english: A high-ranking official in a government department or organization, usually referring to the head of a provincial or higher-level department or bureau.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係教育廳廳長，宜家升咗做副省長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 gaau3 juk6 ting1 ting1 zoeng2, ji4 gaa1 sing1 zo2 zou6 fu3 saang2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是教育厅厅长，现在升为副省长了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be the Director of the Education Bureau, and now he has been promoted to Vice Governor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢有望做埋下屆嘅衛生廳廳長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 jiu5 mong6 zou6 maai4 haa6 gaai3 ge3 wai6 sang1 ting1 ting1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他有望做下届的卫生厅厅长。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he is likely to become the Director of the next term's Health Bureau.

english_meaning: to extend; to prolong; to postpone; to delay
explanation_mandarin: 使时间或期限延长。
explanation_english: To make the duration or deadline longer; to prolong or postpone something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要延遲個會議喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4 ci4 go3 wui6 ji5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要延迟会议了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to postpone the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以將個 deadline 延一延。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 deadline jin4 jat1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以将截止日期延长一下。
examples.english_sentence: We can extend the deadline a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望可以延續呢種文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jin4 zuk6 ni1 zung2 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望可以延续这种文化。
examples.english_sentence: Hoping to continue this culture.

english_meaning: to extend; to stretch; to prolong; extension
explanation_mandarin: 延长；伸展。
explanation_english: To extend or stretch out in space or time; to prolong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路延伸到山頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 jin4 san1 dou3 saan1 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路延伸到山顶。
examples.english_sentence: The road extends to the top of the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅業務要延伸到海外市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 jip6 mou6 jiu3 jin4 san1 dou3 hoi2 ngoi6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的业务要延伸到海外市场。
examples.english_sentence: We need to extend our business to overseas markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個議題可以延伸到好多唔同嘅方面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 ho2 ji5 jin4 san1 dou3 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 fong1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个议题可以延伸到很多不同的方面。
examples.english_sentence: This topic can be extended to many different aspects.

english_meaning: to prolong life and improve health; to increase longevity
explanation_mandarin: 延长寿命，增进健康。多用作祝颂之词。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to prolong life and improve health. Often used as a blessing or wish for longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋祝你延年益壽，身體健康！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zuk1 nei5 jin4 nin4 jik1 sau6, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们祝你延年益寿，身体健康！
examples.english_sentence: We wish you a long life and good health!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多啲運動可以延年益壽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 di1 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 jin4 nin4 jik1 sau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多做运动可以延年益寿的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing more exercise can prolong your life.

english_meaning: to recruit, to enlist, to bring in (talent)
explanation_mandarin: 指招纳并聘用人才。
explanation_english: To recruit and employ talented people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定延攬一位經驗豐富嘅經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 jin4 laam5 jat1 wai2 ging1 gim6 fung1 fu3 ge3 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定招揽一位经验丰富的经理。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to recruit an experienced manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望可以延攬到更多後生嘅人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jin4 laam5 dou3 gang3 do1 hau6 saang1 ge3 tin1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望可以招揽到更多年轻的人才。
examples.english_sentence: We hope to recruit more young talents.

english_meaning: to postpone; to defer; to put off; postponement
explanation_mandarin: 推迟到较晚的日期或时间。
explanation_english: To put off to a later date or time; to postpone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個會議要延期到下個禮拜先開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 wui2 ji5 jiu3 jin4 kei4 dou3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 sin1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议要延期到下个星期才开。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting will be postponed until next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為天氣唔好，所以比賽延期咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 bei2 coi3 jin4 kei4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为天气不好，所以比赛延期了。
examples.english_sentence: Because the weather is bad, the competition has been postponed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢申請咗延期交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 cing2 zo2 jin4 kei4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他申请了延期交作业。
examples.english_sentence: He applied for an extension to hand in his homework.

english_meaning: to delay menstruation, to postpone period
explanation_mandarin: 使用药物或其他方式来推迟女性的月经周期。
explanation_english: To delay the menstrual cycle of a woman, usually through medication or other methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去旅行，所以諗住食藥延經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, so2 ji5 lam2 jyu6 sik6 yoek6 yin4 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去旅行，所以想吃药推迟月经。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a trip tomorrow, so I'm thinking of taking medicine to delay my period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好問下醫生先，唔好自己隨便延經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 man6 haa5 yi1 sang1 sin1, m4 hou2 zi6 gei2 ceoi4 bin2 yin4 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好先问一下医生，不要自己随便推迟月经。
examples.english_sentence: You should ask a doctor first, don't delay your period casually.

english_meaning: to extend continuously; to stretch far and wide; continuous
explanation_mandarin: 指连续不断，延伸不绝。多用于形容山脉、河流等自然景观，也可用于形容时间或情感的持续。
explanation_english: Refers to extending continuously and without interruption. Often used to describe natural landscapes like mountain ranges and rivers, but can also describe the continuation of time or emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅山脈延綿幾百公里。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 saan1 mak6 jin4 min4 gei2 baak3 gung1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的山脉绵延几百公里。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain range here extends for hundreds of kilometers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個傳統文化延綿咗幾百年，一直都冇斷過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 jin4 min4 zo2 gei2 baak3 nin4, jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 dyun6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个传统文化绵延了几百年，一直都没有中断过。
examples.english_sentence: This traditional culture has continued for hundreds of years without interruption.

english_meaning: to postpone, to delay, to defer
explanation_mandarin: 推迟、延期。
explanation_english: To delay or postpone something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情嘅關係，我哋要延緩個婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai4 jik6 cing4 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4 wun6 go3 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情的关系，我们要延缓婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the pandemic, we have to postpone the wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定咗延緩新產品嘅推出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zo2 jin4 wun6 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 tui1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定了延缓新产品的推出。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to delay the launch of the new product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議佢延緩做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 keoi5 jin4 wun6 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议他延缓做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor advised him to postpone the surgery.

english_meaning: to continue; to go on; to last
explanation_mandarin: 继续发展，持续下去。
explanation_english: To continue; to prolong; to extend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要延續呢個傳統落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4 zuk6 ni1 go3 tyun4 tung2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要延续这个传统下去。
examples.english_sentence: We must continue this tradition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望呢份友誼可以延續落去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ni1 fan6 jau5 ji5 ho2 ji5 jin4 zuk6 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望这份友谊可以延续下去。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully this friendship can continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業可以延續到下一代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 ho2 ji5 jin4 zuk6 dou3 haa6 jat1 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业可以延续到下一代。
examples.english_sentence: His career can be passed down to the next generation.

english_meaning: delay, to delay, to hold up
explanation_mandarin: 延迟，耽误
explanation_english: To cause to be late or postponed; to delay or hold up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火車因為天氣問題而延誤咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 ce1 jan1 wai4 tin1 hei3 man6 tai4 ji4 jin4 ng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火车因为天气问题而延误了。
examples.english_sentence: The train was delayed due to the weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程進度延誤，要加班趕工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 jin4 ng6, jiu3 gaa1 baan1 gon2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程进度延误了，要加班赶工。
examples.english_sentence: The project progress is delayed, we need to work overtime to catch up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再延誤落去喇，要快啲決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 jin4 ng6 lok6 heoi3 laa3, jiu3 faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再拖延下去了，要快点决定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't delay any further, we need to decide quickly.

english_meaning: delay, postpone, defer
explanation_mandarin: 推迟，延缓。
explanation_english: To delay, postpone, or defer something to a later time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班機延遲咗三個鐘，我哋要喺機場等好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 gei1 jin4 ci4 zo2 saam1 go3 zung1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 gei1 coeng4 dang2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 航班延误了三个小时，我们要在机场等很久。
examples.english_sentence: The flight is delayed by three hours, we have to wait a long time at the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於天氣唔好，會議要延遲到下個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, wui5 ji5 jiu3 jin4 ci4 dou3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于天气不好，会议要延迟到下个星期。
examples.english_sentence: Due to bad weather, the meeting will be postponed to next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好延遲交功課，如果唔係會扣分㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jin4 ci4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 wui5 kau3 fan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要延迟交作业，不然会被扣分的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't delay submitting your homework, otherwise you will lose marks.

mandarin_meaning: 延请医生; 请医生; 耽误就医
english_meaning: to call in a doctor; to seek medical attention; to delay seeking medical attention
explanation_mandarin: （1）请医生。 （2）耽误就医，拖延看病。具体意义需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: (1) To call in a doctor; to seek medical treatment. (2) To delay seeking medical attention; to put off seeing a doctor. The specific meaning needs to be determined based on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔舒服就快啲睇醫生，唔好延醫呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 syu1 fuk6 zau6 faai3 di1 tai2 ji1 sang1, m4 hou2 jin4 ji1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不舒服就快点看医生，不要耽误就医啊！
examples.english_sentence: If you feel unwell, see a doctor quickly. Don't delay seeking medical attention!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗咁耐都唔延醫，真係唔錫身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 jin4 ji1, zan1 hai6 m4 sek3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了这么久都不请医生，真是不爱惜身体。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for so long and hasn't seen a doctor. He really doesn't care about his health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一有唔妥就延醫，好過捱到入醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 jau5 m4 to2 zau6 jin4 ji1, hou2 gwo3 ngaai4 dou3 jap6 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一有什么不对劲就请医生，好过硬撑到住院。
examples.english_sentence: Call in a doctor as soon as something feels wrong. It's better than enduring it until you need to be hospitalized.

english_meaning: to extend; to prolong; to lengthen
explanation_mandarin: 使时间或长度加长。
explanation_english: To make something longer, either in time or length.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要延長會議嘅時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4 coeng4 wui6 ji5 ge3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要延长会议的时间。
examples.english_sentence: We need to extend the meeting time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要求延長簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu1 kiu4 jin4 coeng4 cin1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他要求延长签证。
examples.english_sentence: He asked for an extension of his visa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路要延長一百米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 jiu3 jin4 coeng4 jat1 baak3 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路要延长一百米。
examples.english_sentence: This road needs to be extended by a hundred meters.

english_meaning: court; imperial court; palace courtyard
explanation_mandarin: 指古代君主處理政事的地方，也指朝廷。
explanation_english: Refers to the place where the ancient monarch dealt with political affairs, also refers to the imperial court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個大臣喺朝廷入面好有地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daai6 san4 hai2 ciu4 ting4 jap6 min6 hou2 jau5 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个大臣在朝廷里很有地位。
examples.english_sentence: This minister has a high position in the imperial court.

english_meaning: Taxi, cab
explanation_mandarin: 指香港对出租车的称呼，是“的士”的粤语音译。
explanation_english: Refers to a taxi or cab in Hong Kong Cantonese. It is a transliteration of the English word "taxi".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，幫我截架廸士啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, bong1 ngo5 zit6 gaa3 dik6 si2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，帮我拦辆出租车吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, please hail a taxi for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚落咁大雨，好難截到廸士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, hou2 naan4 zit6 dou2 dik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚下这么大的雨，很难打到出租车。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining so heavily tonight, it's difficult to get a taxi.

english_meaning: to force, to compel, to press, urgent, pressing
explanation_mandarin: 强迫，逼迫；紧急，急迫。
explanation_english: To force, compel, or press someone to do something; also means urgent or pressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好廹我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bik1 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要逼我啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't force me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間好廹，我哋要快啲走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 hou2 bik1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间很紧迫，我们要快点走。
examples.english_sentence: Time is pressing, we need to leave quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人廹到冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 bik1 dou3 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人逼得没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He was forced into a situation where he had no choice.

mandarin_meaning: 为难; 强迫; 勉强
english_meaning: to force; to compel; to push someone into a difficult situation
explanation_mandarin: 强迫别人做不愿意做的事情；让人处于为难的境地。
explanation_english: To force someone to do something they don't want to do; to put someone in a difficult or awkward situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好廹鈕我啦，我真係做唔到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bik1 nau2 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 zou6 m4 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要勉强我了，我真的做不到的。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't force me, I really can't do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日廹鈕同事幫佢做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bik1 nau2 tung4 si6 bong1 keoi5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是强迫同事帮他做事。
examples.english_sentence: He always forces his colleagues to help him with his work.

english_meaning: silly; foolish; idiotic; absurd; ridiculous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物荒谬、愚蠢，不合常理。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as silly, foolish, idiotic, absurd, or not conforming to common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢真係好建。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西真的很荒谬。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is really ridiculous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做埋啲咁建嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 gin3 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做那些这么愚蠢的事情了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do such silly things anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃好建，根本行唔通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 gin3, gan1 bun2 hang4 m4 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划很荒谬，根本行不通。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is absurd; it won't work at all.

english_meaning: to establish diplomatic relations
explanation_mandarin: 国家之间建立外交关系。
explanation_english: To establish formal diplomatic relations between countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國同中國喺一九七九年建交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 tung4 zung1 gwok3 hai2 jat1 gau2 cat1 gau2 nin4 gin3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国和中国在1979年建交。
examples.english_sentence: The United States and China established diplomatic relations in 1979.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果兩國可以建交就好喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 loeng5 gwok3 ho2 ji5 gin3 gaau1 zau6 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果两国可以建交就好了。
examples.english_sentence: It would be great if the two countries could establish diplomatic relations.

english_meaning: establishment; pro-establishment (faction)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港语境中，主要指支持政府和北京的政治派别或势力。有时也指代现有的政治和社会体制。
explanation_english: In the Hong Kong context, primarily refers to the pro-government and pro-Beijing political factions or forces. It can also refer to the existing political and social system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係建制派嘅議員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gin3 zai3 paai3 ge3 yi5 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是建制派的议员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a pro-establishment legislator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人唔滿意而家嘅建制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 m4 mun5 yi3 ji4 gaa1 ge3 gin3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人不满意现在的体制。
examples.english_sentence: Many people are dissatisfied with the current establishment.

english_meaning: Pro-establishment camp
explanation_mandarin: 指香港政治中支持政府（通常指中国中央政府和香港特区政府）的政治势力或团体。
explanation_english: Refers to the political forces or groups in Hong Kong that support the government (usually referring to the Central People's Government of China and the Hong Kong SAR government).  Often used to describe political parties and individuals perceived as aligned with Beijing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人覺得建制派淨係識得支持政府嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 gok3 dak1 gin3 zai3 paai3 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 zi1 chi4 zheng3 fu2 ge3 zheng3 chaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人觉得建制派只会支持政府的政策。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think that the pro-establishment camp only knows how to support the government's policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屬於建制派，所以喺立法會入面通常會投贊成票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 suk6 jyu1 gin3 zai3 paai3, so2 ji5 hai2 lap1 faat3 wui2 jap6 min6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tau4 zaan3 sing4 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们属于建制派，所以在立法会里面通常会投赞成票。
examples.english_sentence: They belong to the pro-establishment camp, so they usually vote in favor in the Legislative Council.

english_meaning: to achieve merit, to render outstanding service, to perform a feat, to make a contribution
explanation_mandarin: 指建立功劳，取得成就。通常用于描述在工作、事业或战斗中取得显著的成绩。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving merit or accomplishment. It is usually used to describe achieving significant results in work, career, or battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次幫公司傾到呢個大project，真係建功喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 bong1 gung1 si1 king1 dou2 ni1 go3 daai6 project, zan1 hai6 gin3 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次帮公司谈成了这个大项目，真是立功了。
examples.english_sentence: He really achieved merit this time by securing this big project for the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋可以成功研發呢個技術，就真係喺醫療界建功喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1 jin4 faat3 ni1 go3 gei6 seot6, zau6 zan1 hai6 hai2 ji1 liu4 gaai3 gin3 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们能成功研发这项技术，就在医疗界立功了。
examples.english_sentence: If we can successfully develop this technology, we will have made a contribution to the medical field.

mandarin_meaning: 建功立业 (jiàn gōng lì yè)
english_meaning: to achieve merit and establish a career; to accomplish great things
explanation_mandarin: 指建立功勋，创立事业。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to achieving great accomplishments and establishing a successful career, often implying making a significant contribution to society or one's profession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生仔就咁有抱負，想將來建功立業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 zai2 zau6 gam3 jau5 pou5 fu6, soeng2 zoeng1 loi4 gin3 gung1 lap6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年纪轻轻就很有抱负，想要将来建功立业。
examples.english_sentence: He is very ambitious at a young age and wants to achieve great things in the future.

synonyms: 功成名就 (gung1 sing4 ming4 zau6)

english_meaning: to found a nation; to establish a country
explanation_mandarin: 建立国家。
explanation_english: To found a nation; to establish a country. Usually refers to the act of establishing a new country or government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗建國而奮鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 gin3 gwok3 ji4 fan5 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了建国而奋斗。
examples.english_sentence: They fought for the establishment of the nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孫中山先生致力於喺中國建國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun1 zung1 saan1 sin1 sang1 zi3 lik6 jyu1 hai2 zung1 gwok3 gin3 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孙中山先生致力于在中国建国。
examples.english_sentence: Dr. Sun Yat-sen devoted himself to founding a nation in China.

english_meaning: based on; founded on; predicated on
explanation_mandarin: 以…为基础；基于…之上
explanation_english: To be based on something; to be founded on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個理論建基於一啲假設之上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 gin3 gei1 jyu1 jat1 di1 ga2 sat3 zi1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个理论建立在一些假设之上。
examples.english_sentence: This theory is based on some assumptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅合作建基於互相嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 hap6 zok3 gin3 gei1 jyu1 wu6 seung1 ge3 sun3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的合作建立在相互的信任之上。
examples.english_sentence: Our cooperation is based on mutual trust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功建基於佢嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 gin3 gei1 jyu1 keoi5 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功建立在他的努力之上。
examples.english_sentence: His success is based on his hard work.

english_meaning: building materials
explanation_mandarin: 建造建筑物所需的各种材料。
explanation_english: Materials used for constructing buildings and other structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地盤用嘅建材都係最新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 pun4 yung6 ge3 gin3 coi4 dou1 hai6 zeui3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工地用的建筑材料都是最新的。
examples.english_sentence: The building materials used on this construction site are all the latest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋裝修，要揀啲好嘅建材先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zong1 sau1, jiu3 gaan2 di1 hou2 ge3 gin3 coi4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修房子，要选一些好的建筑材料才行。
examples.english_sentence: When renovating the house, you need to choose some good building materials.

english_meaning: to construct; to build; to create; to establish
explanation_mandarin: 建造、构成；建立某种体系或结构。
explanation_english: To build, construct, or create something, often referring to abstract systems or structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要建構一個更美好嘅社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin3 gau3 jat1 go3 gang3 mei5 hou2 ge3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要构建一个更美好的社会。
examples.english_sentence: We need to build a better society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個理論建構喺好多實驗嘅基礎上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 gin3 gau3 hai2 hou2 do1 sat6 jim6 ge3 gei1 co2 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个理论构建在很多实验的基础上。
examples.english_sentence: This theory is constructed on the basis of many experiments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃建構一個全新嘅網絡系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 gin3 gau3 jat1 go3 cyun4 san1 ge3 mong5 lok6 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划构建一个全新的网络系统。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to construct a brand new network system.

english_meaning: contribution, achievement, accomplishment
explanation_mandarin: 指建立功绩或成就，通常用于褒义。
explanation_english: Refers to establishing meritorious deeds or achievements, usually used in a positive sense. It signifies making significant contributions to a field or society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺科研方面有好多建樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fo1 jin4 fong1 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gin3 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在科研方面有很多建树。
examples.english_sentence: He has made many contributions in scientific research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對香港嘅經濟發展有重大建樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 jau5 zung6 daai6 gin3 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对香港的经济发展有重大建树。
examples.english_sentence: He has made significant contributions to the economic development of Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅成功，佢功不可沒，貢獻咗好多建樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sing4 gung1, keoi5 gung1 bat1 ho2 mut6, gung3 hiun3 zo2 hou2 do1 gin3 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的成功，他功不可没，贡献了很多建树。
examples.english_sentence: His contribution to the success of this project is undeniable; he made many achievements.

english_meaning: to establish; to build; to found; to set up
explanation_mandarin: 创建、设立，使事物从无到有。
explanation_english: To bring something into existence, to create or establish something new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要建立一間新嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin3 lap6 jat1 gaan1 san1 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要建立一间新的公司。
examples.english_sentence: We want to establish a new company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府正努力建立一個更公平嘅社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zeng3 nou5 lik6 gin3 lap6 jat1 go3 gang3 gung1 ping4 ge3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府正努力建立一个更公平的社会。
examples.english_sentence: The government is working hard to establish a more equitable society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋建立咗深厚嘅友誼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gin3 lap6 zo2 sam1 hau5 ge3 jau5 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们建立了深厚的友谊。
examples.english_sentence: They established a deep friendship.

english_meaning: architecture; building; construction
explanation_mandarin: 指建造建筑物，也指建筑物本身的设计和结构。
explanation_english: Referring to the art and science of designing and constructing buildings. It can also refer to the buildings themselves and their structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅建築好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gin3 zuk1 hou2 jau5 te1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的建筑很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's architecture is very distinctive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀建築。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 gin3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学学习建筑。
examples.english_sentence: He studies architecture in university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起呢棟樓嘅建築費好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 ni1 dung6 lau2 ge3 gin3 zuk1 fai3 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 建造这栋楼的建筑费很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The construction cost of building this building is very expensive.

english_meaning: Construction company; building company
explanation_mandarin: 从事建筑工程的企业。
explanation_english: A company that undertakes construction projects, such as building houses, roads, or bridges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爸爸喺一間建築公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baa4 baa1 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gin3 zuk1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸在一家建筑公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: My father works at a construction company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間建築公司起咗好多地標性嘅建築物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gin3 zuk1 gung1 si1 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 dei6 biu1 sing3 ge3 gin3 zuk1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家建筑公司建造了很多地标性的建筑物。
examples.english_sentence: This construction company has built many landmark buildings.

english_meaning: Architecture
explanation_mandarin: 研究建筑物及其环境的学科。
explanation_english: The art and science of designing and constructing buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀緊建築學，將來想做建築師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 gan2 gin3 zuk1 hok6, zoeng1 loi4 soeng2 zou6 gin3 zuk1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在读建筑学，将来想当建筑师。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying architecture, and I want to be an architect in the future.

english_meaning: architect
explanation_mandarin: 设计建筑物的人。
explanation_english: A person who designs buildings and in many cases also supervises their construction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係做一個出色嘅建築師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 jat1 go3 ceot1 sik1 ge3 gin3 zuk1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一名出色的建筑师。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become an outstanding architect.

english_meaning: building; structure; edifice
explanation_mandarin: 指用砖、石、木材、钢筋水泥等材料建造的房屋、桥梁、道路等固定建筑物。
explanation_english: A building or structure, such as a house, bridge, or road, constructed from materials like bricks, stones, wood, reinforced concrete, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟建築物嘅設計好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 gin3 zuk1 mat6 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座建筑物的设计很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this building is very distinctive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多又高又靚嘅建築物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 jau6 gou1 jau6 leng3 ge3 gin3 zuk1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多又高又漂亮的建筑物。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many tall and beautiful buildings.

english_meaning: Gross Floor Area (GFA)
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物各层外围线测量的面积之和，包括使用面积、公摊面积等，是衡量建筑物大小的重要指标。
explanation_english: Refers to the total floor area of a building as measured from the outer walls of each floor, including the usable area, common area, etc. It is an important indicator of the building's size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個單位嘅建築面積係六百呎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan1 wai2 ge3 gin3 zuk1 min6 zik1 hai6 luk6 bak3 cek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个单元的建筑面积是六百平方英尺。
examples.english_sentence: The gross floor area of this unit is six hundred square feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司發展緊一個建築面積超過一百萬呎嘅商場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 faat3 zin2 gan2 jat1 go3 gin3 zuk1 min6 zik1 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 bak3 maan6 cek3 ge3 soeng1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司正在开发一个建筑面积超过一百万平方英尺的商场。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is developing a shopping mall with a gross floor area of over one million square feet.

english_meaning: to build; to construct; construction
explanation_mandarin: 建立，建造；所建立的建筑物或事物。
explanation_english: To build, construct; also refers to the building or things that are built.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港政府不斷建設新嘅基建設施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zing3 fu2 bat1 dyun6 gin3 cit3 san1 ge3 gei1 cin2 cit3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港政府不断建设新的基础设施。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong government is constantly constructing new infrastructure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市嘅建設好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 gin3 cit3 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个城市的建设很快。
examples.english_sentence: The construction of this city is very fast.

english_meaning: constructive
explanation_mandarin: 指有积极意义、能够促进事物发展的。
explanation_english: Having a positive effect; helpful; designed to improve or develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要俾啲建設性嘅意見，唔好淨係鬧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bei2 di1 gin3 cit3 sing3 ge3 ji3 gin3, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 naau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该给一些建设性的意见，不要只是骂人。
examples.english_sentence: We should give some constructive feedback, not just criticize people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢个提議好有建設性，值得考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 hou2 jau5 gin3 cit3 sing3, zik6 dak1 haau2 leui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个提议很有建设性，值得考虑。
examples.english_sentence: This suggestion is very constructive and worth considering.

english_meaning: suggestion, advice; to suggest, to advise
explanation_mandarin: 提出自己的主张或意见，供参考。
explanation_english: To offer a proposal or opinion for consideration; advice or suggestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我建議你早啲瞓覺，唔好咁夜瞓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 ji5 nei5 zou2 di1 fan3 gaau3, m4 hou2 gam3 je6 fan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我建议你早点睡觉，不要这么晚睡了。
examples.english_sentence: I suggest you go to bed earlier, don't sleep so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗好多有用嘅建議我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 hou2 do1 jau5 jung6 ge3 gin3 ji5 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我很多有用的建议。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a lot of useful suggestions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對呢件事有咩建議？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 gin3 ji5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对这件事有什么建议？
examples.english_sentence: What suggestions do you have regarding this matter?

english_meaning: proposal; suggestion letter; recommendation report
explanation_mandarin: 书面提出的建议，通常用于正式场合。
explanation_english: A written document containing suggestions or recommendations, usually for formal purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要寫一份詳細嘅建議書，先可以爭取到呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 se2 jat1 fan6 cheung4 sai3 ge3 gin3 ji5 syu1, sin1 ho2 ji5 jaang1 cheui2 dou2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要写一份详细的建议书，才能争取到这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to write a detailed proposal in order to win this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇吓呢份建議書有冇咩需要修改嘅地方？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 fan6 gin3 ji5 syu1 jau5 mou5 me1 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 goi2 ge3 dei6 fong1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看这份建议书有没有什么需要修改的地方？
examples.english_sentence: Could you take a look at this proposal and see if there's anything that needs to be modified?

english_meaning: to build, to construct, to make
explanation_mandarin: 修建；建筑。
explanation_english: To build or construct something, usually a large structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃喺嗰度建造一間新嘅學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 hai2 go2 dou6 gin3 zou6 jat1 gaan1 san1 ge3 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划在那里建造一所新学校。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to build a new school there.

english_meaning: twenty
explanation_mandarin: 数字，表示二十。
explanation_english: The number twenty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年廿歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 jaa6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年二十岁。
examples.english_sentence: I am twenty years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個橙賣廿蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caang2 maai6 jaa6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个橙子卖二十块钱。
examples.english_sentence: This orange costs twenty dollars.

english_meaning: Twenty-One (blackjack)
explanation_mandarin: 一种扑克牌游戏，目标是使手中的牌的点数之和尽可能接近21点，但不能超过21点。
explanation_english: A card game, also known as Blackjack, where the goal is to reach a hand value as close as possible to 21 without exceeding it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去賭場玩廿一點啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 dou2 coeng4 waan2 jaa6 jat1 dim2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去赌场玩二十一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the casino to play blackjack tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻玩廿一點，成日都贏錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 waan2 jaa6 jat1 dim2, seng4 jat6 dou1 wing4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长玩二十一点，总是赢钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at playing blackjack, and he always wins money.

english_meaning: Herbal tea (usually bitter); Twenty-four Flavors
explanation_mandarin: 一种广东凉茶，由多种中草药熬制而成，味道苦涩，通常用于清热解毒。
explanation_english: A type of traditional Cantonese herbal tea made from a mixture of various herbs. It is known for its bitter taste and is often consumed to relieve heatiness and detoxify the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱氣啊，飲杯廿四味降下火啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 hei3 aa3, jam2 bui1 jaa6 sei3 mei6 gong3 haa5 fo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上火了，喝杯凉茶降降火吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're feeling heaty, drink a cup of herbal tea to reduce the heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廿四味真係好苦，但係對身體好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jaa6 sei3 mei6 zan1 hai6 hou2 fu2, daan6 hai6 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凉茶真的很苦，但是对身体好。
examples.english_sentence: Herbal tea is really bitter, but it's good for your health.

english_meaning: extremely filial; excessively devoted (to one's parents)
explanation_mandarin: 形容对父母非常孝顺，甚至到了过分的程度。这个词带有一种讽刺的意味，暗示这种孝顺已经超出常理，可能对父母或自己造成负担。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely filial to their parents, often to an excessive or exaggerated degree. The term often carries a slightly sarcastic tone, implying that such filial piety is beyond what is reasonable and might burden the parents or the person themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢阿媽真係廿四孝，乜都聽晒阿媽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 aa3 maa1 zan1 hai6 jaa6 sei3 haau3, mat1 dou1 teng1晒 aa3 maa1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的妈妈真是太孝顺了，什么都听妈妈的。
examples.english_sentence: He is so devoted to his mother, he listens to everything she says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做廿四孝父母呀，仔女大咗要俾佢哋自己決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jaa6 sei3 haau3 fu6 mou5 aa3, zai2 neoi5 daai6 zo2 jiu3 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做过分溺爱的父母啊，孩子大了要让他们自己决定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be overly doting parents; you need to let your children make their own decisions when they grow up.

english_meaning: 24 hours; around the clock
explanation_mandarin: 指一天的时间长度，通常表示全天候，不间断。
explanation_english: Refers to the duration of a day, often used to describe something that operates continuously or around the clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間便利店廿四小時營業㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 jaa6 sei3 siu2 si4 jing4 jip6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家便利店二十四小时营业。
examples.english_sentence: This convenience store is open 24 hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋提供廿四小時嘅客戶服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cung4 gung1 jaa6 sei3 siu2 si4 ge3 haak3 fu6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们提供二十四小时的客户服务。
examples.english_sentence: They provide 24-hour customer service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場保安廿四小時戒備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 bou2 on1 jaa6 sei3 siu2 si4 gaai3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场保安二十四小时戒备。
examples.english_sentence: Airport security is on alert 24 hours a day.

english_meaning: Twenty-four Solar Terms
explanation_mandarin: 中国传统历法中用来指导农业生产和气候变化的二十四个节气。
explanation_english: The twenty-four solar terms, a traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar system that divides the year into 24 segments, each named for a different phenomenon or activity. These terms are used to guide agricultural practices and reflect seasonal changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日講廿四節氣，話要跟住嚟耕田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 gong2 jaa6 sei3 zit3 hei3, waa6 jiu3 gan1 zyu6 lai4 gaang1 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是说二十四节气，说要跟着节气来种田。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always talks about the twenty-four solar terms, saying that farming should follow them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅廿四節氣好似有啲亂，天氣都唔係好穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 jaa6 sei3 zit3 hei3 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 lyun6, tin1 hei3 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的二十四节气好像有点乱，天气也不是很稳定。
examples.english_sentence: This year's twenty-four solar terms seem a bit off; the weather isn't very stable.

english_meaning: to open / to turn on / to start / to drive
explanation_mandarin: 表示打开，启动，开始等动作或状态。
explanation_english: Indicates the action or state of opening, turning on, starting, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 开门啦，边个呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 mun4 laa1, bin1 go3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开门吧，谁啊？
examples.english_sentence: Open the door, who is it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢开咗间铺头喺旺角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 pou3 tau4 hai2 wong6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在旺角开了一家店。
examples.english_sentence: He opened a shop in Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你开冷气未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hoi1 laang5 hei3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你开空调了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you turned on the air conditioner?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔识开车。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 hoi1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会开车。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to drive.

english_meaning: different, strange, peculiar, odd
explanation_mandarin: 表示不同，不寻常，或者奇怪的。
explanation_english: Indicates difference, unusualness, or strangeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法同其他人好异。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 hou2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法和别人很不同。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very different from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好异乎寻常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 ji6 fu4 cam4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很异乎寻常。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very unusual.

english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to renounce, to give up
explanation_mandarin: 舍弃，放弃。丢掉不要。
explanation_english: To abandon, discard, give up, or renounce something. To throw away something that is no longer wanted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢弃咗份工，去咗旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei3 zo2 fan6 gung1, heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃了工作，去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job and went traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁轻易就弃咗你嘅梦想啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji4 zau6 hei3 zo2 nei5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么轻易就放弃你的梦想啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up on your dreams so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人弃养。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 hei3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被遗弃。
examples.english_sentence: He was abandoned.

english_meaning: to play with, to fiddle with, to do, to manage, to get something done
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“弄”通常指玩弄、摆弄、做、搞等意思，含义广泛，具体含义需要结合语境理解。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "弄" generally refers to playing with, fiddling with, doing, or managing. It has a wide range of meanings that need to be understood in context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁弄啲嘢，整爛咗就麻煩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 lung6 di1 je5, zing2 laan6 zo2 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱弄这些东西，弄坏了就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around with these things. It would be troublesome if you break them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住弄啲嘢食俾你食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 lung6 di1 je5 sik6 bei2 nei5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想做点东西给你吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of making something for you to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搞掂佢未？我搞唔掂呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 mei6? ngo5 lung6 m4 dim6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你搞定他了吗？我搞不定啊！
examples.english_sentence: Have you settled it with him? I can't manage it!

english_meaning: What starts as a pretense becomes reality; a pretense turns into reality; something that began as a joke becomes serious
explanation_mandarin: 本来是假的，结果变成真的。
explanation_english: Something that initially was a pretense, a joke, or a fabrication eventually becomes real or true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋初頭係扮情侶，點知最後弄假成眞，真係拍拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 co1 tau4 hai6 baan6 cing4 leoi5, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 lung6 gaa2 sing4 zan1, zan1 hai6 paak3 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们起初是假扮情侣，没想到最后弄假成真，真的谈恋爱了。
examples.english_sentence: They initially pretended to be a couple, but unexpectedly, the pretense became reality, and they really started dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來只係講笑咁講，點知佢又真係咁做，今次真係弄假成眞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 lai4 zi2 hai6 gong2 siu3 gam2 gong2, dim2 zi1 keoi5 jau6 zan1 hai6 gam2 zou6, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 lung6 gaa2 sing4 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来只是开玩笑说说，没想到他真的这么做了，这次真的弄假成真了。
examples.english_sentence: I was just saying it as a joke, but unexpectedly he actually did it, this time the pretense has really turned into reality.

english_meaning: To make something false become real; to turn pretense into reality; to start out joking but end up serious.
explanation_mandarin: 本来是假的，结果却变成了真的。比喻最初是虚假的行为或想法，最终却变成了真实的情况。
explanation_english: Originally fake or not serious, but ends up becoming real. It describes a situation where something that started as a pretense or joke eventually becomes a genuine reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋初頭係假扮情侶咋，點知後尾弄假成真，真係拍拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co1 tau4 hai6 gaa2 baan6 cing4 leoi5 zaa3, dim2 zi1 hau6 mei5 lung6 gaa2 sing4 zan1, zan1 hai6 paak3 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们起初只是假扮情侣而已，没想到后来弄假成真，真的谈恋爱了。
examples.english_sentence: We were just pretending to be a couple at first, but unexpectedly, the pretense turned into reality, and we actually started dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來佢淨係想嚇下佢，點知講講下，弄假成真，佢真係辭咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 keoi5 zing6 hai6 hek3 haa5 keoi5, dim2 zi1 gong2 gong2 haa5, lung6 gaa2 sing4 zan1, keoi5 zan1 hai6 ci4 zo2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来他只是想吓唬吓唬他，没想到说着说着，弄假成真，他真的辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: Originally, he just wanted to scare him, but unexpectedly, as he kept talking, the pretense turned into reality, and he actually quit his job.

english_meaning: To try to be clever only to end up making a mess of things; to overdo it; to be too clever by half and spoil things.
explanation_mandarin: 本意是想耍弄技巧，結果反而把事情辦糟。形容本想取巧，卻反而壞了事。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone tries to be clever or cunning in order to improve a situation, but ends up making it worse instead. It suggests that trying too hard or being too clever can backfire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住走精面呀，如果唔係好易弄巧反拙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 zau2 zing1 min6 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 lung6 haau2 faan2 zyut3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想着耍小聪明，不然很容易弄巧成拙的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about being too clever, or you'll easily end up messing things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來想幫佢哋嘅，點知越幫越忙，真係弄巧反拙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 lai4 soeng2 bong1 keoi5 dei6 ge3, dim2 zi1 yut6 bong1 yut6 mong4, zan1 hai6 lung6 haau2 faan2 zyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来想帮他们的，没想到越帮越忙，真是弄巧成拙。
examples.english_sentence: I originally wanted to help them, but I ended up being more of a hindrance. It's a case of trying to be too clever and making things worse.

mandarin_meaning: 玩弄权术; 舞弊弄权
english_meaning: to abuse power; to manipulate power; to engage in corruption and abuse of power
explanation_mandarin: 指玩弄权术，利用职权营私舞弊。
explanation_english: Refers to abusing power, manipulating official authority for personal gain, and engaging in corrupt practices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面成日弄權，搞到啲同事好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 sing4 jat6 lung6 kyun4, gaau2 dou3 di1 tung4 si6 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里经常弄权，搞得同事们很不满意。
examples.english_sentence: He often abuses his power in the company, which makes his colleagues very dissatisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府官員唔可以弄權，一定要公正廉潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 m4 ho2 ji5 lung6 kyun4, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gung1 zeng3 lim4 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府官员不可以弄权，一定要公正廉洁。
examples.english_sentence: Government officials must not abuse their power and must be fair and honest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要防止有人利用職權弄權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fong2 zi2 jau5 jan4 lei6 jung6 zik1 kyun4 lung6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要防止有人利用职权弄权。
examples.english_sentence: We must prevent people from abusing their power.

english_meaning: to clarify, to figure out, to understand clearly, to ascertain
explanation_mandarin: 使某事变得清晰明白。
explanation_english: To make something clear or understandable; to ascertain the facts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好弄清件事嘅真相先好講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 lung6 cing1 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2 sin1 hou2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好弄清楚事情的真相再说话。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better clarify the truth of the matter before you speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要弄清呢件事嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lung6 cing1 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要弄清楚这件事的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: We need to figure out the ins and outs of this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多時間去弄清個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 lung6 cing1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间去弄清楚那个问题。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time clarifying the problem.

english_meaning: to give birth to a son
explanation_mandarin: 旧时祝贺别人生儿子的贺词。璋是一种玉器。
explanation_english: An old-fashioned congratulatory phrase used to celebrate the birth of a son. Zhang (璋) is a type of jade artifact. The phrase originates from the ancient custom of giving a jade 'zhang' to a newborn boy, symbolizing his future importance and potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你弄璋之喜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 lung6 zoeng1 zi1 hei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你生了儿子！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on the birth of your son!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生尋日弄璋，一家人都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sang1 cam4 jat6 lung6 zoeng1, jat1 gaa1 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生昨天生了儿子，一家人都很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li had a son yesterday, and the whole family is very happy.

english_meaning: To give birth to a daughter
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指生女孩，源于古代女孩出生后玩瓦片的习俗。
explanation_english: An old-fashioned expression referring to giving birth to a daughter. It originates from the ancient custom of girls playing with tiles (瓦片) after being born.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽聞佢哋啱啱弄瓦，恭喜晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 man4 keoi5 dei6 aam1 aam1 lung6 ngaa5, gung1 hei2 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们刚刚生了个女儿，恭喜恭喜！
examples.english_sentence: I heard they just had a daughter, congratulations!

english_meaning: to practice fraud; to engage in deception; to fake; to sham
explanation_mandarin: 指玩弄虚假，以假乱真，欺骗他人。
explanation_english: To engage in deceptive practices, present something false as genuine, and deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人最緊要老實，唔好弄虛作假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 lou5 sat6, m4 hou2 lung6 heoi1 zok3 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人最重要的是诚实，不要弄虚作假。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in life is to be honest, don't practice fraud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅財報有問題，好似有啲弄虛作假嘅成分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 bou3 jau5 man6 tai4, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 lung6 heoi1 zok3 gaa2 ge3 sing4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的财务报表有问题，好像有一些弄虚作假的成分。
examples.english_sentence: There are problems with this company's financial statements. It seems like there's some element of fraud involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試作弊，就係一種弄虛作假嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 zok3 bai6, zau6 hai6 jat1 zung2 lung6 heoi1 zok3 gaa2 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊，就是一种弄虚作假的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Cheating on an exam is a form of deception.

english_meaning: to play chess (or similar board game)
explanation_mandarin: 指下棋，尤指下圍棋或象棋等棋類活動。
explanation_english: Refers to playing chess, especially Go or Chinese chess and similar board games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺公園弈棋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 jik6 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在公园下棋。
examples.english_sentence: They often play chess in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺好鍾意弈象棋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hou2 zung1 ji3 jik6 zoeng6 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷很喜欢下象棋。
examples.english_sentence: My grandpa loves playing Chinese chess.

english_meaning: bad, terrible, awful, disastrous; something bad
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况不好，糟糕，不利，或者指不好的事情。
explanation_english: Indicates a bad situation, terrible, disadvantageous, or refers to something bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊喇！我唔記得帶銀包！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 laa3! ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！我忘记带钱包了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! I forgot to bring my wallet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次弊家伙喇，考試唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bai6 gaa1 fo2 laa3, haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次糟糕了，考试不及格。
examples.english_sentence: This is bad, I failed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊！架車撻唔著！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6! gaa3 ce1 taat3 m4 zoek3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！车启动不了！
examples.english_sentence: Damn! The car won't start!

english_meaning: Oh no! Bummer! Something bad happened!
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情不妙，出了问题，带有懊恼或惊讶的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling that something bad has happened or is about to happen. It conveys dismay, annoyance, or surprise at a negative situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊傢伙！我哋遲到啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 fo2! ngo5 dei6 ci4 dou3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！我们迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! We are late!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊傢伙，電話冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 fo2, din6 waa2 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕，手机没电了。
examples.english_sentence: Bummer, my phone is dead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊傢伙！唔記得帶銀包！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 fo2! m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！忘记带钱包了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! I forgot to bring my wallet!

english_meaning: The problem lies in, the trouble is, the disadvantage is
explanation_mandarin: 表示问题或者困难的关键所在。
explanation_english: Indicates the key issue or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋弊在冇錢，如果唔係就可以去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bai6 zoi6 mou5 cin2, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的问题在于没钱，不然就可以去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: The trouble is we don't have money, otherwise we could go travelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃弊在太過複雜，難以實行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 bai6 zoi6 taai3 gwo3 fuk1 zaap6, naan4 ji5 sat6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的坏处就在于太过复杂，难以实行。
examples.english_sentence: The disadvantage of this plan is that it's too complicated and difficult to implement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢弊在太過自信，所以成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bai6 zoi6 taai3 gwo3 zi6 seon3, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的问题在于太过自信，所以经常出错。
examples.english_sentence: The problem with him is he is too confident, so he often makes mistakes.

english_meaning: More harm than good; the disadvantages outweigh the advantages
explanation_mandarin: 坏处比好处多。指事情的负面影响超过正面影响。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that the disadvantages or harms outweigh the advantages or benefits; more harm than good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策雖然有啲好處，但係弊多於利，唔應該推行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 sui1 jin4 jau5 di1 hou2 chu3, daan6 hai6 bai6 do1 jyu1 lei6, m4 jing1 goi1 tui1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策虽然有一些好处，但是弊大于利，不应该推行。
examples.english_sentence: Although this policy has some benefits, the disadvantages outweigh the advantages, so it shouldn't be implemented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得成日打機弊多於利，影響學業又傷眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 seng4 jat6 daa2 gei1 bai6 do1 jyu1 lei6, jing2 hoeng2 hok6 jip6 jau6 soeng1 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得整天打游戏弊大于利，影响学业又伤眼睛。
examples.english_sentence: I think playing video games all day is more harmful than beneficial. It affects studies and hurts your eyes.

mandarin_meaning: 糟糕了; 坏了; 完蛋了
english_meaning: Oh no! / Bummer! / That's bad! / We're in trouble!
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情不妙，情况糟糕时的感叹语，带有懊恼、后悔、失望的情绪。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing dismay, regret, disappointment, or a feeling that something has gone wrong or that one is in trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家leu！我唔記得帶銀包！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 lau2! ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕了！我忘记带钱包了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! I forgot to bring my wallet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家leu！聽日要考試，我仲未溫習！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 lau2! ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si5, ngo5 zung6 mei6 wan1 zaap6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕了！明天要考试，我还没复习！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! There's an exam tomorrow, and I haven't revised yet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家leu，遲到喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 lau2, chi4 dou3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕，迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no, I'm late!

mandarin_meaning: 糟糕了; 坏了; 糟了
english_meaning: Oh no!; Disaster!; Something bad has happened; Oops!
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况不妙，出了问题，带有惊慌失措的情绪。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of panic or distress when something bad has happened or is about to happen. It implies that the situation is unfavorable or disastrous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家伙！我唔記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 fo2! ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕了！我忘记带钥匙了。
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! I forgot to bring my keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家伙！聽日要交功課，但我仲未做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 fo2! ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3, daan6 ngo5 zung6 mei6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕了！明天要交作业，但我还没做。
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! The homework is due tomorrow, but I haven't done it yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家伙！落大雨，我冇帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 fo2! lok6 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 mou5 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟了！下大雨，我没带伞。
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! It's raining heavily, and I didn't bring an umbrella.

english_meaning: Oh dear, that's bad, what a disaster, oh no
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况不妙，非常糟糕。带有懊恼或无奈的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of dismay, something bad has happened. It carries a tone of annoyance or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家溜！我唔記得帶銀包出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 lau1! ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！我忘记带钱包出门了。
examples.english_sentence: Oh dear! I forgot to bring my wallet out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家溜！聽日要交功課，但我仲未做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 lau1! ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3, daan6 ngo5 zung6 mei6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！明天要交作业，但我还没做。
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! The homework is due tomorrow, but I haven't done it yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊家溜！落咁大雨，唔記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 gaa1 lau1! lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！下这么大的雨，忘记带伞了。
examples.english_sentence: Oh dear! It's raining so heavily, and I forgot to bring an umbrella.

mandarin_meaning: 糟糕透顶，糟糕得不能再糟糕
english_meaning: The worst of the worst; as bad as it can possibly be; extremely terrible.
explanation_mandarin: 形容情况非常糟糕，坏到极点。强调情况的严重性。
explanation_english: Describes a situation as being extremely bad, the worst possible. It emphasizes the severity of the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試肥佬，仲要俾阿媽鬧，弊弊冇咁弊呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, zung6 jiu3 bei2 aa3 maa1 nau6, bai6 bai6 mou5 gam3 bai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，还要被妈妈骂，真是糟糕透顶！
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam this time, and on top of that, I'm going to get scolded by my mother. It's the worst of the worst!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車壞咗，又落大雨，弊弊冇咁弊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2, jau6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, bai6 bai6 mou5 gam3 bai6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车坏了，又下大雨，真是糟糕透顶！
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down, and it's raining heavily. It's as bad as it can possibly be!

jyutping: bai6 bai6 dou1 mou5 gam2 bai6
english_meaning: Extremely bad; the worst of the worst; as bad as it can possibly get
explanation_mandarin: 形容情况非常糟糕，已经坏到极点，没有更坏的可能性了。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is extremely bad, the worst possible scenario, with no room for further deterioration. Often used to express exasperation or resignation about a hopeless situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試弊弊都冇咁弊，肯定肥佬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 bai6 bai6 dou1 mou5 gam2 bai6, hang2 ding6 fei4 lou2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试糟糕透顶，肯定要不及格了！
examples.english_sentence: This exam was as bad as it can get, I'm definitely going to fail!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞到弊弊都冇咁弊，唔知幾時先返到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 bai6 bai6 dou1 mou5 gam2 bai6, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵到糟糕透顶，不知道什么时候才能回到家。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam is the worst it could possibly be, I don't know when I'll get home.

mandarin_meaning: 糟糕; 坏了; 出事了
english_meaning: Oops!; Bad news; In trouble; Screwed up; Catastrophe
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况不妙，事情搞砸了，或者遇到麻烦了。
explanation_english: An interjection or adjective used to express dismay, trouble, or a screwed-up situation. It indicates that something has gone wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 弊煲！我唔記得咗帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bai6 bou1! ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糟糕！我忘记带钥匙了。
examples.english_sentence: Oops! I forgot to bring my keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係弊煲喇，考試唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 bai6 bou1 laa3, haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的糟糕了，考试没及格。
examples.english_sentence: This time it's really bad news, I failed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，弊煲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, bai6 bou1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，坏了！
examples.english_sentence: The computer is broken, screwed up!

mandarin_meaning: 弊端, 缺点, 毛病
english_meaning: defect, flaw, shortcoming, weakness
explanation_mandarin: 指事物中的缺点、毛病、不足之处。
explanation_english: A flaw, defect, shortcoming or weakness in something; an undesirable quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統嘅弊病就係速度太慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 bai6 beng6 zau6 hai6 suk1 dou6 taai3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个系统的弊病就是速度太慢。
examples.english_sentence: The flaw of this system is that the speed is too slow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅管理制度有好多弊病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 zai3 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 bai6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理制度有很多弊端。
examples.english_sentence: This company's management system has many flaws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁做係有弊病嘅，你諗清楚先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 zou6 hai6 jau5 bai6 beng6 ge3, nei5 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做是有弊端的，你考虑清楚再做吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are shortcomings to doing it this way, think it through carefully first.

english_meaning: drawback, disadvantage, flaw, defect
explanation_mandarin: 指事物中存在的缺点或不良方面。
explanation_english: A drawback, disadvantage, or flaw in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個制度有好多弊端，需要改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zai3 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 bai6 dyun1, seoi1 jiu3 goi2 gaak3.
