english_meaning: Cheung Po Tsai Cave (Hong Kong place name)
explanation_mandarin: 香港长洲岛上的一个著名景点，相传是清朝海盗张保仔藏宝的地方。
explanation_english: A famous scenic spot on Cheung Chau Island in Hong Kong, traditionally said to be a hiding place for the pirate Cheung Po Tsai's treasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去長洲，一定要去張保仔洞睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 coeng4 zau1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 heoi3 zoeng1 bou2 zai2 dung6 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去长洲，一定要去张保仔洞看看。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Cheung Chau tomorrow, we definitely have to go see Cheung Po Tsai Cave.

english_meaning: to put Zhang's hat on Li's head; to attribute something to the wrong person; to mix things up; to misattribute
explanation_mandarin: 比喻认错了对象，弄错了事实。
explanation_english: An idiom that means to misattribute something to the wrong person or thing, or to confuse one thing with another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你張冠李戴呀！我講嘅唔係呢件事，係另一件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 gun3 lei5 daai3 aa3! ngo5 gong2 ge3 m4 hai6 ni1 gin6 si6, hai6 ling6 jat1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你张冠李戴了！我说的不是这件事，是另一件事。
examples.english_sentence: You're mixing things up! I wasn't talking about this matter, but another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好張冠李戴，佢哋嘅錯唔應該由我嚟負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 gun3 lei5 daai3, keoi5 dei6 ge3 co3 m4 jing1 goi1 jau4 ngo5 lai4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要张冠李戴，他们的错不应该由我来负责。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mix things up, their mistakes shouldn't be my responsibility.

english_meaning: tension; stress; tensile force
explanation_mandarin: 物理学、心理学等领域指拉伸的力量或状态，也指紧张的气氛或关系。
explanation_english: In physics, psychology, etc., it refers to tensile force or state, and also refers to a tense atmosphere or relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲充滿住懸疑嘅張力，令人睇得好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 cung1 mun5 zyu6 hyun4 ji4 ge3 zoeng1 lik6, ling6 jan4 tai2 dak1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影充满了悬疑的张力，让人看得非常紧张。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is full of suspense and tension, making people very nervous while watching it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個關係嘅張力好大，成日鬧交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gwaan1 hai6 ge3 zoeng1 lik6 hou2 daai6, seng4 jat6 naau6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个关系的张力很大，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: The tension in their relationship is very high, they often quarrel.

english_meaning: to open one's mouth; to speak; to ask
explanation_mandarin: 指打开嘴巴，或者开始说话、提问等动作。
explanation_english: Refers to opening one's mouth, or the action of starting to speak, ask a question, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好一味齋坐喺度，有乜嘢疑問就張口問啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jat1 mei6 zaai1 co5 hai2 dou6, jau5 mat1 je5 ji1 waan6 zau6 zoeng1 hau2 man6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要一味只是坐在那里，有什么疑问就开口问吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just sit there, if you have any questions, just ask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗咗好耐都冇張口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 zoeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想了很久都没有开口。
examples.english_sentence: He thought for a long time without saying a word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一朝早起身就張口打乞嗤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 zau6 zoeng1 hau2 daa2 hat1 ci1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上一起床就张口打喷嚏。
examples.english_sentence: I sneeze as soon as I get up in the morning.

english_meaning: To alternate tension and relaxation; to have a proper balance between work and rest; to know when to tighten and when to loosen.
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作、生活等有节奏，不松懈也不过分紧张。
explanation_english: Describes a rhythmic approach to work, life, etc., neither too lax nor too tense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要張弛有度，唔好逼死自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 zoeng1 ci4 jau5 dou6, m4 hou2 bik1 sei2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作要有张有弛，不要把自己逼死。
examples.english_sentence: You need to balance work with rest, don't push yourself to the breaking point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢教仔好有心得，張弛有度，所以啲細路好生性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau3 zai2 hou2 jau5 sam1 dak1, zoeng1 ci4 jau5 dou6, so2 ji5 di1 sai3 lou6 hou2 saang1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他教育孩子很有心得，有张有弛，所以孩子们很懂事。
examples.english_sentence: He has a good way of raising his kids, knowing when to be strict and when to be lenient, so they are well-behaved.

english_meaning: to publicize; to make known; ostentatious; flamboyant; showy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人炫耀自己的能力或成就，或公开宣扬某件事。
explanation_english: To publicize or make something widely known, often with the intention of showing off or drawing attention. Can also describe someone who is ostentatious or flamboyant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好張揚，成日要show off自己幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zoeng1 joeng4, seng4 jat6 jiu3 show off zi6 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很张扬，总是要炫耀自己有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very showy person; he always wants to show off how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁張揚啦，低調啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zoeng1 joeng4 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么张扬了，低调一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so flamboyant; it's better to be more low-key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事唔好咁張揚，等我哋處理完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 m4 hou2 gam3 zoeng1 joeng4, dang2 ngo5 dei6 cyu2 lei5 jyun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不要那么张扬，等我们处理完再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't publicize this matter too much; let us handle it first.

english_meaning: to look around; to peer about; to crane one's neck to see
explanation_mandarin: 到处看，四处看。
explanation_english: To look around; to look in all directions, often to search for something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺火車站周圍張望，好似搵緊人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fo2 ce1 zaam6 zau1 wai4 zoeng1 mong6, hou2 ci5 wan2 gan2 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在火车站周围张望，好像在找人一样。
examples.english_sentence: He was looking around the train station, as if he was looking for someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺人群裡面張望，希望可以見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jan4 kwan4 leoi5 min6 zoeng1 mong6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在人群中张望，希望可以见到他。
examples.english_sentence: I was looking around in the crowd, hoping to see him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人哋屋企外面張望，咁樣好無禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei5 ngoi6 min6 zoeng1 mong6, gam2 joeng2 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在别人家外面张望，这样很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look around outside other people's houses, it's impolite.

english_meaning: to decorate with lanterns and colored streamers (for a festive occasion)
explanation_mandarin: 形容节日或喜庆的场面，挂起彩灯，系上彩带。
explanation_english: Describes a festive or celebratory scene, decorating with lanterns and colorful streamers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣屋企人會張燈結綵，好有節日氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6 uk1 kei2 jan4 wui5 zoeng1 dang1 git3 coi2, hou2 jau5 zit3 jat6 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过新年的时候，家人会张灯结彩，很有节日气氛。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, the family will decorate with lanterns and streamers, creating a very festive atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚擺酒一定要張燈結綵，等大家開心下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 baai2 zau2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zoeng1 dang1 git3 coi2, dang2 daai6 gaa1 hoi1 sam1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚办喜宴一定要张灯结彩，让大家都开心一下。
examples.english_sentence: When having a wedding banquet, you must decorate with lanterns and streamers to make everyone happy.

mandarin_meaning: 张牙舞爪 (zhāng yá wǔ zhǎo)
english_meaning: to bare fangs and brandish claws; to make threatening gestures; fierce-looking; aggressive; menacing
explanation_mandarin: 形容外表凶猛可怕，或指气势逼人，盛气凌人。
explanation_english: Describes a fierce and terrifying appearance, or refers to an intimidating or overbearing manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發起爛渣上嚟，真係張牙舞爪咁款，嚇死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 hei2 laan6 zaa1 soeng5 lei4, zan1 hai6 zoeng1 ngaa4 mou5 zaau2 gam2 kwan2, haak3 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发起脾气来，真是张牙舞爪的样子，吓死人了。
examples.english_sentence: When he throws a tantrum, he really looks fierce and menacing, it's terrifying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司個經理成日張牙舞爪咁，啲同事個個都好驚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 go3 ging1 lei5 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 ngaa4 mou5 zaau2 gam2, di1 tung4 si6 go3 go3 dou1 hou2 geng1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的经理整天张牙舞爪的，同事们都很怕他。
examples.english_sentence: The manager of the company is always intimidating and aggressive, the colleagues are all very afraid of him.

english_meaning: to arrange; to prepare; to get ready; to organize; to attend to
explanation_mandarin: 为达到某种目的而四处奔走、筹划准备。
explanation_english: To busily arrange and prepare for something in order to achieve a certain goal; to take care of arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋忙住張羅婚禮嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mong4 zyu6 zoeng1 lo4 fan1 lai5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们忙着筹备婚礼的事情。
examples.english_sentence: They are busy arranging the wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗個派對，佢哋張羅咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 go3 paai3 deoi2, keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 lo4 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这个派对，他们准备了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: They arranged a lot of things for the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日幫我哋張羅三餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 lo4 saam1 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常帮我们准备三餐。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always prepares our meals for us.

english_meaning: to post, to stick (a notice, poster etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 把纸张、海报等贴在墙上或其他表面上。
explanation_english: To affix or attach a piece of paper, poster, or other material to a wall or surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得將啲海報張貼喺告示板上面啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 zoeng1 di1 hoi2 bou3 zoeng1 tip3 hai2 gou3 si1 baan2 soeng6 min6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得把海报贴在告示板上面啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to post the posters on the notice board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要張貼更多宣傳單張，等更多人知道呢個活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 zoeng1 tip3 gang3 do1 syun1 cyun4 daan1 zoeng1, dang2 gang3 do1 jan4 zi1 dou3 ni1 go3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要张贴更多宣传单张，让更多人知道这个活动。
examples.english_sentence: We need to post more leaflets so that more people know about this event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便張貼嘢喺牆上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 zoeng1 tip3 je5 hai2 coeng4 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便在墙上张贴东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just post things on the wall haphazardly.

english_meaning: Cheung Leung (personal name)
explanation_mandarin: 一个人名，姓张，名亮。
explanation_english: A personal name; Cheung Leung in Cantonese, Zhang Liang in Mandarin. Often refers to a person with the surname Cheung/Zhang and given name Leung/Liang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個同學叫張量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 tung4 hok6 giu3 zoeng1 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的同学叫张亮。
examples.english_sentence: My classmate's name is Cheung Leung.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識張量啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zoeng1 loeng6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你认识张亮吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know Cheung Leung?

english_meaning: to open; to spread out
explanation_mandarin: 使本来合拢的物体展开。 用于描述打开或展开的状态。
explanation_english: To open or spread something that was previously closed or folded. Describes the action of opening or spreading out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢張開把口，想講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 hoi1 baa2 hau2, soeng2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他张开嘴，想说话。
examples.english_sentence: He opened his mouth, wanting to say something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻蝴蝶張開咗翅膀，飛走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 wu4 dip6 zoeng1 hoi1 zo2 ci3 pong4, fei1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蝴蝶张开了翅膀，飞走了。
examples.english_sentence: The butterfly opened its wings and flew away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張開雙手，俾我攬下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 hoi1 soeng1 sau2, bei2 ngo5 laam5 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 张开双手，让我抱一下。
examples.english_sentence: Open your arms, let me give you a hug.

english_meaning: To stare angrily; to glare (like Zhang Fei)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人发怒时瞪大眼睛的样子，像三国演义中的张飞一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person staring angrily with wide eyes, like Zhang Fei in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, known for his fierce appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩呀？唔好張飛頸咁望住我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 aa3? m4 hou2 zoeng1 fei1 geng2 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛呀？不要怒目圆睁地看着我！
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing? Don't glare at me like that!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到張飛頸，好似想打人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zoeng1 fei1 geng2, hou2 ci5 soeng2 daa2 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得怒目圆睁，好像想打人一样。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he glared, like he wanted to hit someone.

english_meaning: trap (for catching animals)
explanation_mandarin: 一种捕捉鸟兽的工具，利用机关使之突然关闭。
explanation_english: A tool used to trap birds and animals, using a mechanism that suddenly closes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋阿爺以前成日攞弶去捉雀仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aa3 je4 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 lo2 gong6 heoi3 zuk1 zoek3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们爷爷以前经常拿捕鸟器去捉小鸟。
examples.english_sentence: Our grandfather used to take traps to catch birds all the time.

english_meaning: strong, powerful, hard, better than, good
explanation_mandarin: 表示力气大，能力强；表示坚硬，牢固；表示胜过，比…好；或者表示程度深，好。
explanation_english: Describes physical strength, ability, or power; indicates hardness or firmness; signifies being better than something; or expresses a high degree of goodness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身體好強壯呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 tai2 hou2 koeng5 zong3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身体很强壮啊！
examples.english_sentence: He is very strong!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個理由唔夠強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lei5 jau2 m4 gau3 koeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个理由不够强。
examples.english_sentence: This reason is not strong enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢英文強過我好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing1 man2 koeng5 gwo3 ngo5 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他英文比我好很多。
examples.english_sentence: His English is much better than mine.

jyutping: koeng4 zung1 zi6 jau5 koeng4 zung1 sau2
mandarin_meaning: 强中自有强中手 (qiáng zhōng zì yǒu qiáng zhōng shǒu)
english_meaning: There's always someone better; No matter how good you are, there's always someone stronger.
explanation_mandarin: 形容不要骄傲自满，无论你有多强，总会有人比你更强。 告诫人要谦虚谨慎。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of humility. It suggests that no matter how skilled or powerful someone is, there will always be someone even more skilled or powerful. It serves as a reminder not to be arrogant or complacent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你踢波咁叻都唔好驕傲，強中自有強中手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tek3 bo1 gam3 lek1 dou1 m4 hou2 giu1 ngou6, koeng4 zung1 zi6 jau5 koeng4 zung1 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你踢球这么厉害也不要骄傲，强中自有强中手啊。
examples.english_sentence: Even though you're so good at playing soccer, don't be arrogant. There's always someone better.

synonyms: 人外有人，天外有天 (jan4 ngoi6 jau5 jan4, tin1 ngoi6 jau5 tin1)

english_meaning: Strong person; powerful figure; capable person; a person of strong will or ability
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人能力很强，意志坚定，有魄力，通常在政治或商业领域中表现突出。
explanation_english: Describes a person with strong capabilities, firm will, and charisma. Often used to describe prominent figures in politics or business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係商界嘅強人，好有遠見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 soeng1 gaai3 ge3 koeng4 jan4, hou2 jau5 jyun5 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是商界的强人，很有远见。
examples.english_sentence: He is a powerful figure in the business world, with great vision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人叫做政壇強人，好有影響力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 zing3 taan4 koeng4 jan4, hou2 jau5 ying2 heong2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人称为政坛强人，很有影响力。
examples.english_sentence: He is known as a powerful figure in politics, with great influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要做到成功，你一定要做個強人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zou6 dou3 sing4 gung1, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 go3 koeng4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要做到成功，你一定要做一个强人。
examples.english_sentence: To achieve success, you must be a strong person.

english_meaning: to force someone to do something difficult; to make unreasonable demands on someone; to ask the impossible
explanation_mandarin: 勉强别人做他们做不到或不愿意做的事情。
explanation_english: To force someone to do something that is beyond their capabilities or that they are unwilling to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叫佢一個人搬晒啲嘢，咪即係強人所難囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: giu3 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 bun1 saai3 di1 je5, mai1 zik1 hai6 koeng5 jan4 so2 naan4 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让他一个人搬完所有的东西，这不是强人所难吗！
examples.english_sentence: Asking him to move all the things by himself is just asking the impossible!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好強人所難啦，佢真係唔識㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 koeng5 jan4 so2 naan4 laa1, keoi5 zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要强人所难了，他真的不会的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force him to do something he can't, he really doesn't know how.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該強人所難，應該尊重返人哋嘅意願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 koeng5 jan4 so2 naan4, jing1 goi1 zyun1 zung6 faan1 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该强人所难，应该尊重别人的意愿。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't force people to do what they don't want to do, we should respect their wishes.

synonyms: 逼人太甚 (bik1 jan4 taai3 sam6)

english_meaning: strong and healthy, robust
explanation_mandarin: 指身体强壮健康。
explanation_english: Describes a person's physical condition as strong and healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身體好強健，日日都跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 tai2 hou2 koeng4 gin6, jat1 jat1 dou1 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身体很强健，每天都跑步。
examples.english_sentence: He is very strong and healthy, he runs every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要保持強健嘅體魄，除咗運動之外，飲食都好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 bou2 ci4 koeng4 gin6 ge3 tai2 pok3, ceoi4 zo2 wan6 dung6 zi1 ngoi6, jam2 sik6 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要保持强健的体魄，除了运动之外，饮食也很重要。
examples.english_sentence: To maintain a strong and healthy body, diet is also very important besides exercise.

english_meaning: force; compel; coerce; mandatory; compulsory
explanation_mandarin: 用外力迫使；强迫性的，必须执行的。
explanation_english: To force or compel someone to do something; to make something mandatory or compulsory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以強制佢做佢唔想做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 koeng5 zai3 keoi5 zou6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能强制他做他不想做的事。
examples.english_sentence: You can't force him to do something he doesn't want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府強制所有學童都要打防疫針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 koeng5 zai3 so2 jau5 hok6 tung4 dou1 jiu3 daa2 fong4 jik6 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府强制所有学童都要打疫苗。
examples.english_sentence: The government makes it compulsory for all students to get vaccinated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個合約嘅條款帶有強制性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap6 joek3 ge3 tiu4 kwan2 daai3 jau5 koeng5 zai3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个合同的条款带有强制性。
examples.english_sentence: The terms of this contract are mandatory.

english_meaning: Mandatory order; Compulsory order; Restraining order
explanation_mandarin: 具有法律效力的，强制执行的命令。通常指政府或法院发出的强制执行的命令。
explanation_english: A legally binding order that must be obeyed. Typically refers to a mandatory order issued by the government or a court that compels or restrains a specific action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府頒布咗口罩強制令，所有人都一定要戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 baan1 bou3 zo2 hau2 zaau3 koeng5 zai3 ling6, so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府颁布了口罩强制令，所有人都必须要戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: The government has issued a mandatory mask order, and everyone must wear a mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭發出咗禁制令，即係一種強制令，阻止佢再騷擾佢前妻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 faat3 ceot1 zo2 gam3 zai3 ling6, zik1 hai6 jat1 zung2 koeng5 zai3 ling6, zo2 zi2 keoi5 zoi3 saau1 jiu2 keoi5 cin4 cai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭发出了禁制令，即是一种强制令，阻止他再骚扰他的前妻。
examples.english_sentence: The court has issued a restraining order, which is a type of mandatory order, to prevent him from harassing his ex-wife again.

english_meaning: powerful, strong, forceful
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量强大，作用显著。
explanation_english: Describing something as having great power, strength, or force; effective, impactful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個清潔劑好強力，可以輕鬆去除污漬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing1 git3 zai1 hou2 koeng4 lik6, ho2 ji5 hing1 sung1 keoi2 ceoi5 wu1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个清洁剂很强力，可以轻松去除污渍。
examples.english_sentence: This cleaner is very powerful and can easily remove stains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府採取咗強力嘅措施嚟控制疫情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 cai2 ceoi3 zo2 koeng4 lik6 ge3 mok6 si1 lai4 hung3 zai3 yik6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府采取了强力的措施来控制疫情。
examples.english_sentence: The government took strong measures to control the epidemic.

english_meaning: Powerful department, influential department, department with authority
explanation_mandarin: 指拥有强大权力或影响力的部门。常用于政府机关、企业等，形容其地位重要，权力较大。
explanation_english: Refers to a department with significant power and influence. Often used in the context of government agencies, corporations, etc., to describe a department with an important position and considerable authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係強力部門嚟㗎，做嘢好有影響力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 koeng4 lik6 bou6 mun4 lai4 gaa3, zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 jing2 hoeng2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是强力部门，做事很有影响力。
examples.english_sentence: They are a powerful department, their work has a lot of influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個部門喺公司入面係強力部門，好多重要嘅決策都係佢哋決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hai6 koeng4 lik6 bou6 mun4, hou2 do1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 kyut3 caak3 dou1 hai6 keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个部门在公司里是强力部门，很多重要的决策都是他们决定的。
examples.english_sentence: This department is a powerful department within the company, many important decisions are made by them.

english_meaning: powerful; strong; robust
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量或势力强大。
explanation_english: Describing something that is powerful, strong, or robust in strength or force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅經濟增長非常強勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 ging1 zai3 zang1 zoeng2 fei1 soeng4 koeng4 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的经济增长非常强劲。
examples.english_sentence: This time the economic growth is very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌喉好強勁，唱到人好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 hau4 hou2 koeng4 ging6, coeng3 dou3 jan4 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌喉很强劲，唱得很感人。
examples.english_sentence: His singing voice is very powerful, singing in a very moving way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個風嘅威力真係好強勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fung1 ge3 wai1 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 koeng4 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个风的威力真的好强劲。
examples.english_sentence: The power of this wind is really strong.

english_meaning: powerful; strong; aggressive; assertive
explanation_mandarin: 指力量强大，态度强硬，有压迫感。
explanation_english: Describing something or someone as powerful, strong, assertive, or even aggressive, often implying a dominant or imposing presence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個態度好強勢，搞到冇人敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 taai3 dou6 hou2 koeng4 sai3, gaau2 dou3 mou5 jan4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度很强势，搞得没人敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is very aggressive, making everyone afraid to speak up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺市場上面嘅強勢地位，令競爭對手好難挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 min6 ge3 koeng4 sai3 dei6 wai2, ling6 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 hou2 naan4 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在市场上的强势地位，令竞争对手很难挑战。
examples.english_sentence: This company's dominant position in the market makes it difficult for competitors to challenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺談判嘅時候表現得好強勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 taam4 pun3 ge3 si4 hau6 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 koeng4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在谈判的时候表现得很强势。
examples.english_sentence: He behaved very assertively during the negotiation.

english_meaning: strengthen, reinforce, enhance
explanation_mandarin: 使更坚固，更有效力。
explanation_english: To make something stronger, more effective, or more intensified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要強化網絡安全，防止黑客入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 koeng4 faa3 mong5 lok3 on1 cyun4, fong2 zi2 hak1 hak1 jap6 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要强化网络安全，防止黑客入侵。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strengthen network security to prevent hackers from intruding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品嘅配方已經強化咗，效果更加好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 ge3 pui3 fong1 ji5 ging1 koeng4 faa3 zo2, haau6 gwo2 gaang3 gaa1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品的配方已经强化了，效果更好。
examples.english_sentence: The formula of this product has been enhanced, and the effect is better.

english_meaning: tempered glass, toughened glass
explanation_mandarin: 一种经过特殊处理的玻璃，强度比普通玻璃高得多，不易破碎，即使破碎也会碎成小块，减少伤人的可能性。
explanation_english: A type of safety glass processed by controlled thermal or chemical treatments to increase its strength compared with normal glass. Tempered glass is much more resistant to breakage than normal glass and, if broken, it shatters into small, relatively harmless pieces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅螢幕係用強化玻璃做嘅，冇咁易花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 jing4 mok6 hai6 yung6 koeng4 faa3 bo1 lei1 zou6 ge3, mou5 gam3 ji6 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机的屏幕是用钢化玻璃做的，没那么容易刮花。
examples.english_sentence: This phone's screen is made of tempered glass, so it's not so easy to scratch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企嘅窗都換曬強化玻璃，安全啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei1 ge3 coeng1 dou1 wun6 saai3 koeng4 faa3 bo1 lei1, on1 cyun4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家里的窗户都换了钢化玻璃，安全一点。
examples.english_sentence: We replaced all the windows in our house with tempered glass, it's safer.

english_meaning: Powerful country; (often used ironically) China
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指强大的国家。在香港和粤语社区中，通常带有一种讽刺意味，指代中国大陆，暗示其虽然经济和军事实力强大，但在人权、自由、法治等方面有所欠缺。该词带有一定程度的负面含义。
explanation_english: Literally means "powerful country." In Hong Kong and the Cantonese-speaking community, it is often used ironically to refer to mainland China, implying that while the country may be strong in terms of economy and military power, it lacks in areas such as human rights, freedom, and the rule of law. The term carries a somewhat negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲強國遊客周圍都係，真係好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 koeng4 gwok3 jau4 hak3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6, zan1 hai6 hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这些强国游客到处都是，真的很吵。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, these mainland Chinese tourists are everywhere, it's really noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人成日話香港無得同強國比，但係我哋始終有自己嘅文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 hoeng1 gong2 mou5 dak1 tung4 koeng4 gwok3 bei2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ci2 zung1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们总是说香港没法和强国比，但是我们始终有自己的文化。
examples.english_sentence: People always say that Hong Kong can't compare to the powerful country, but we still have our own culture.

english_meaning: strong, robust, healthy
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体健康有力。
explanation_english: Describes being physically strong, robust, and healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都做運動，所以身體好強壯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zou6 wan6 dung6, so2 ji5 san1 tai2 hou2 koeng4 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都做运动，所以身体很强壮。
examples.english_sentence: He exercises every day, so he's very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻狗好強壯，成日都好有活力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gau2 hou2 koeng4 zong3, seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只狗很强壮，总是很有活力。
examples.english_sentence: This dog is very strong and always full of energy.

english_meaning: powerful; strong; mighty; formidable
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量、实力或能力非常强大。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as being very powerful, strong, or mighty in terms of strength, ability, or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅實力好強大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sat6 lik6 hou2 koeng4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的实力非常强大。
examples.english_sentence: This company's strength is very powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意志力好強大，咩困難都克服到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 zi3 lik6 hou2 koeng4 daai6, me1 kwan3 naan4 dou1 hak1 fuk6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意志力非常强大，什么困难都能克服。
examples.english_sentence: His willpower is very strong, he can overcome any difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中國經濟變得越來越強大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 gwok3 ging1 zai3 bin3 dak1 yuet6 lai4 yuet6 koeng4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中国的经济变得越来越强大。
examples.english_sentence: China's economy is becoming increasingly powerful.

english_meaning: rape, to rape
explanation_mandarin: 指违背女性意愿，使用暴力或威胁等手段与其发生性行为。
explanation_english: The act of forcing sexual intercourse on a person against their will, typically through violence or intimidation. Can also refer to the act of committing rape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人強姦咗，好慘呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 koeng4 gaan1 zo2, hou2 caam2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被人强奸了，好可怜啊。
examples.english_sentence: She was raped, it's so tragic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 強姦係一種好嚴重嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: koeng4 gaan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 jim4 zung6 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 强奸是一种很严重的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: Rape is a very serious crime.

english_meaning: barely satisfactory; not up to expectations; disappointing
explanation_mandarin: 表示勉强能够使人满意，但离期望还差很远。比喻工作或事物的结果不尽如人意，让人感到失望。
explanation_english: Describes something that is barely satisfactory or just acceptable, falling short of expectations. It implies a sense of disappointment because the outcome is not as good as hoped for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅成績強差人意，下次要努力啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 koeng5 caa1 jan4 ji3, haa6 ci3 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的成绩差强人意，下次要努力些了。
examples.english_sentence: The results of this exam were barely satisfactory. You need to work harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅服務強差人意，嘢食都唔係咁好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 koeng5 caa1 jan4 ji3, je5 sik6 dou1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务差强人意，食物也不是很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant was disappointing, and the food wasn't that great either.

english_meaning: intensity; strength; magnitude
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物所达到的强烈程度或力量。
explanation_english: The degree or level of something; the amount of force or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場雨嘅強度好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 jyu5 ge3 koeng4 dou6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场雨的强度很大。
examples.english_sentence: The intensity of this rain is very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢訓練嘅強度好高，所以進步好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 lin6 ge3 koeng4 dou6 hou2 gou1, so2 ji5 zeon3 bou6 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他训练的强度很高，所以进步很快。
examples.english_sentence: The intensity of his training is high, so he improves quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地震嘅強度有幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 zan3 ge3 koeng4 dou6 jau5 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地震的强度有多少？
examples.english_sentence: What is the magnitude of this earthquake?

mandarin_meaning: 强弩之末 (qiáng nǔ zhī mò)
english_meaning: The end of a powerful crossbow's flight; Spent force; At the end of its tether; Last gasp
explanation_mandarin: 比喻强大的力量已经衰竭，不能再发挥作用。也指处于衰弱阶段的强大势力。
explanation_english: Refers to a powerful force or influence that is exhausted and unable to exert further power. Can also describe a once-powerful entity in a state of decline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司擴張得太快，依家已經係強弩之末，好快就會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 kwok3 zoeng1 dak1 taai3 faai3, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai6 koeng4 nou5 zi1 mut6, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 zaap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司扩张得太快，现在已经是强弩之末，很快就会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: Their company expanded too quickly and is now at the end of its tether, it will soon go bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃搞咗咁耐，已經係強弩之末，不如算數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, ji5 ging1 hai6 koeng4 nou5 zi1 mut6, bat1 jyu4 syun3 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划搞了这么久，已经是强弩之末了，不如算了。
examples.english_sentence: This project has been going on for so long, it's at the end of its rope, we might as well give up.

synonyms: 日薄西山 (jat6 bok6 sai1 saan1)
力不從心 (lik6 bat1 cung4 sam1)

english_meaning: strength and weakness; relative strength; strong and weak
explanation_mandarin: 指力量、能力或影响力的强弱程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the degree of strength, ability, or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩隊波嘅強弱好明顯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 deoi2 bo1 ge3 koeng4 joek6 hou2 ming5 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两支球队的强弱很明显。
examples.english_sentence: The strength and weakness of these two teams are very obvious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要分析競爭對手嘅強弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fan1 sik1 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 ge3 koeng4 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要分析竞争对手的强弱。
examples.english_sentence: We need to analyze the strengths and weaknesses of our competitors.

english_meaning: cardiac stimulant; heart stimulant; (figuratively) a shot in the arm, boost, morale booster
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是增强心脏功能的药物，比喻指能给人带来希望、激励或增强信心的事物。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to a drug that strengthens heart function. Figuratively, it refers to something that brings hope, encouragement, or boosts confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅成功對佢嚟講真係一支強心針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 sing4 gung1 deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 jat1 zi1 koeng4 sam1 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的成功对他来说真是一支强心剂。
examples.english_sentence: This success is really a shot in the arm for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完你嘅鼓勵，我覺得好似打咗支強心針咁，充滿力量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 nei5 ge3 gu2 lai6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 daa2 zo2 zi1 koeng4 sam1 zam1 gam2, cung1 mun5 lik6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完你的鼓励，我感觉好像打了一针强心剂一样，充满了力量。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to your encouragement, I felt like I had a cardiac stimulant, full of energy.

english_meaning: to suppress; to endure; to force oneself to bear
explanation_mandarin: 勉强忍受，强迫自己忍耐。
explanation_english: To force oneself to endure something unpleasant or painful; to suppress or hold back feelings or expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢痛到想喊，但係強忍住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung3 dou3 soeng2 haam3, daan6 hai6 koeng5 jan2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他疼得想哭，但是强忍住了。
examples.english_sentence: He was in so much pain he wanted to cry, but he forced himself to hold back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗唔想屋企人擔心，所以強忍住唔講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 m4 soeng2 uk1 kei5 jan4 daam1 sam1, so2 ji5 koeng5 jan2 zyu6 m4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了不让家人担心，他强忍着没说。
examples.english_sentence: In order not to worry his family, he forced himself not to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事佢已經強忍咗好耐，終於爆發出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 koeng5 jan2 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 baau3 faat3 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事他已经强忍了很久，终于爆发出来了。
examples.english_sentence: He had been suppressing this matter for a long time, and it finally exploded.

english_meaning: Strong and brave; tough; valiant; robust; redoubtable
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物非常强硬，有力量，不轻易屈服。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being very strong, powerful, and not easily defeated or subdued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個性格好強悍，唔容易認輸嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 koeng4 hon6, m4 jung6 ji6n6 jing6 syu1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的性格很强悍，不容易认输的。
examples.english_sentence: Her personality is very strong and tough, she doesn't give up easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊波嘅實力好強悍，今年應該有機會攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi2 bo1 ge3 sat6 lik6 hou2 koeng4 hon6, gam1 nin4 jing1 goi1 jau5 gei1 wui5 lo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支球队的实力很强悍，今年应该有机会拿冠军。
examples.english_sentence: This team's strength is very robust, they should have a chance to win the championship this year.

english_meaning: compulsory sale; forced auction
explanation_mandarin: 香港法律术语，指发展商或持有大部分业权的业主通过法律途径强制收购余下小业主单位，然后进行重建或发展。
explanation_english: A legal term in Hong Kong referring to the compulsory acquisition of remaining units from minority owners by developers or owners holding the majority of property rights through legal means, for the purpose of redevelopment or development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舊樓俾發展商申請咗強拍，啲住客都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gau6 lau2 bei2 faat3 zin2 soeng1 san1 cheng2 zo2 koeng5 paak3, di1 zyu6 haak3 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋旧楼被开发商申请了强制拍卖，住户们都不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: The developer has applied for a compulsory sale of this old building. The residents don't know what to do.

english_meaning: to heavily promote; to push strongly; to vigorously recommend
explanation_mandarin: 强力推荐，通常指为了某种目的而大力推销或推举。
explanation_english: To heavily promote or vigorously recommend something, usually for a specific purpose or gain. It implies a strong and often forceful push.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司強推緊個新產品，日日都喺電視賣廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 koeng5 teoi1 gan2 go3 san1 caan2 ban2, jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 din6 si6 maai6 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司正在强推新产品，每天都在电视上打广告。
examples.english_sentence: The company is heavily promoting their new product, advertising it on TV every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀老細強推上去做經理，但係啲經驗唔夠，搞到一鑊粥咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 koeng5 teoi1 soeng5 heoi3 zou6 ging1 lei5, daan6 hai6 di1 ging1 jim6 m4 gau3, gaau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 zuk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板强行推上去当经理，但是经验不足，搞得一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: He was heavily promoted by the boss to become a manager, but he didn't have enough experience, making a complete mess of things.

english_meaning: to attack forcefully; to storm; to push through forcefully; to charge
explanation_mandarin: 以强大的力量进行攻击；猛烈地进攻。
explanation_english: To attack with great force; to make a forceful assault; to overcome a problem or obstacle with brute force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定強攻呢座山頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 koeng5 gung1 ni1 zo6 saan1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定强攻这个山头。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to storm this hilltop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對噉嘅難題，淨係識得強攻係唔得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam2 ge3 naan4 tai4, zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 koeng5 gung1 hai6 m4 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这样的难题，只会强攻是不行的。
examples.english_sentence: When facing such a difficult problem, simply using brute force won't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前一日，唔應該強攻，應該放鬆心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 jat1 jat6, m4 jing1 goi1 koeng5 gung1, jing1 goi1 fong3 sung1 sam1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试前一天，不应该强攻，应该放松心情。
examples.english_sentence: On the day before the exam, you shouldn't cram forcefully; you should relax.

english_meaning: rape, sexual assault; violence; to rape, to sexually assault
explanation_mandarin: 指以暴力手段强迫与他人发生性行为的行为，也泛指暴力行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of forcing someone to have sexual intercourse against their will; also refers to violence in general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人強暴咗，好慘呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 koeng5 bou6 zo2, hou2 caam2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被人强暴了，好可怜啊。
examples.english_sentence: She was raped, it's so terrible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該譴責所有嘅強暴行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 kin2責ze3 so2 jau5 ge3 koeng5 bou6 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该谴责所有的强暴行为。
examples.english_sentence: We should condemn all acts of violence.

english_meaning: domineering, tyrannical, overbearing, high-handed
explanation_mandarin: 形容人专断蛮横，仗势欺人。
explanation_english: Describes a person as arbitrary, unreasonable, and bullying using power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好強橫㗎，唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 koeng4 waang6 gaa3, m4 hou2 ze2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很强横，不要惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very domineering person, don't mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅做法好強橫，完全唔理其他人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zou6 faat3 hou2 koeng4 waang6, jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 gei2 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的做法很强横，完全不理会其他人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Their approach is very overbearing, completely ignoring the opinions of others.

english_meaning: compulsory testing, mandatory testing
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或机构强制要求特定人群进行检测，通常用于健康或安全相关的场合。
explanation_english: Refers to mandatory testing required by the government or organizations, usually in contexts related to health or safety. It often refers to COVID-19 testing in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話我哋棟樓要強檢，聽日要落去做測試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 ngo5 dei6 dung6 lau2 jiu3 koeng5 gim2, ting1 jat6 jiu3 lok6 heoi3 zou6 cak1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府说我们这栋楼需要强制检测，明天要下去做测试。
examples.english_sentence: The government said our building requires compulsory testing; we need to go downstairs for testing tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為有確診個案，所以佢哋成條街都要強檢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jau5 kok3 can2 go3 on3, so2 ji5 keoi5 dei6 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 jiu3 koeng5 gim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为有确诊病例，所以他们整条街都要强制检测。
examples.english_sentence: Because there are confirmed cases, the whole street needs to undergo compulsory testing.

english_meaning: hegemony, power politics, might
explanation_mandarin: 指凭借强大的实力推行霸权主义的势力或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a power or action that promotes hegemony based on its strong power and influence; power politics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋反對強權政治，支持和平解決爭端。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faan2 deoi3 koeng4 kyun4 zing3 zi6, zi1 ci4 wo4 ping4 gaai2 kyut3 zang1 dyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们反对强权政治，支持和平解决争端。
examples.english_sentence: They oppose power politics and support peaceful resolution of disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲國家靠住強權去影響其他國家嘅內政。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gwok3 gaa1 kaau3 zyu6 koeng4 kyun4 heoi3 jing2 hoeng2 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 noi6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些国家依靠强权去影响其他国家的内政。
examples.english_sentence: Some countries rely on hegemony to influence the internal affairs of other countries.

english_meaning: to force, to demand unreasonably, to insist on something against someone's will
explanation_mandarin: 勉强地去要求得到，指不顾对方意愿或客观条件，强行索取或要求。
explanation_english: To force or demand something, often against someone's will or disregarding the objective conditions. It implies an unreasonable insistence or coercion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 感情嘅嘢唔可以強求㗎，勉強冇幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 cing4 ge3 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 koeng5 kau4 gaa3, min5 koeng5 mou5 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感情的事情不能强求，勉强没有幸福。
examples.english_sentence: You can't force matters of the heart; forcing it won't bring happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鍾意佢，點解重要強求自己同佢一齊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5, dim2 gai2 zung6 jiu3 koeng5 kau4 zi6 gei2 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不喜欢他，为什么还要强求自己和他在一起？
examples.english_sentence: You don't like him, why are you still forcing yourself to be with him?

english_meaning: strong; intense; vehement
explanation_mandarin: 指程度很深，力度很大。
explanation_english: Describes something with a high degree of intensity or strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對呢個建議有強烈嘅反對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 go3 gin3 ji5 jau5 koeng4 lit6 ge3 faan2 doi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对这个建议有强烈的反对。
examples.english_sentence: We have a strong objection to this proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋強烈譴責暴力行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 koeng4 lit6 kin2 zaak3 bou6 lik6 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们强烈谴责暴力行为。
examples.english_sentence: They strongly condemn acts of violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紫外線強烈，記得搽防曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 ngoi3 sin3 koeng4 lit6, gei3 dak1 caa1 fong4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 紫外线强烈，记得擦防晒霜。
examples.english_sentence: The ultraviolet rays are strong, remember to apply sunscreen.

english_meaning: powerful and prosperous; flourishing
explanation_mandarin: 指国家或事物发展强大而繁荣。
explanation_english: Describes a nation or entity that is powerful and flourishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望香港可以再次變得強盛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 hoeng1 gong2 ho2 ji5 zoi3 ci3 bin3 dak1 koeng4 sing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望香港可以再次变得强盛。
examples.english_sentence: We hope Hong Kong can become powerful and prosperous again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唐朝係中國歷史上一個強盛嘅朝代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong4 ciu4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 soeng6 jat1 go3 koeng4 sing6 ge3 ciu4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唐朝是中国历史上一个强盛的朝代。
examples.english_sentence: The Tang Dynasty was a powerful and prosperous dynasty in Chinese history.

english_meaning: robber, bandit, brigand
explanation_mandarin: 指使用暴力或威胁手段抢劫他人财物的人。
explanation_english: A person who uses violence or threats to steal property from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋俾啲強盜打劫咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei2 di1 koeng4 dou6 daa2 gip3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被强盗抢劫了。
examples.english_sentence: They were robbed by robbers.

english_meaning: tough; firm; unyielding; uncompromising; forceful
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度、立场、方法等强硬，不妥协。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude, stance, or method that is tough, firm, unyielding, and uncompromising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度好強硬，唔肯讓步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 koeng4 ngaang6, m4 hang2 joeng6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度很强硬，不肯让步。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is very firm, he refuses to compromise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府對呢件事嘅處理手法好強硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 cyu2 lei5 sau2 faat3 hou2 koeng4 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府对这件事的处理手法很强硬。
examples.english_sentence: The government's handling of this matter is very tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用強硬嘅手段未必可以解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 koeng4 ngaang6 ge3 sau2 dyun6 mei6 bit1 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用强硬的手段未必可以解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Using tough measures may not necessarily solve the problem.

english_meaning: Mandatory Provident Fund (MPF)
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府设立的一项强制性退休金计划，雇主和雇员都需要按比例供款。
explanation_english: A mandatory retirement scheme in Hong Kong, where both employers and employees are required to contribute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每個月都要供強積金㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 gung1 koeng4 zik1 gan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每个月都要交强制性公积金。
examples.english_sentence: We have to contribute to the Mandatory Provident Fund every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揀咗邊間公司嘅強積金計劃呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan2 zo2 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 koeng4 zik1 gan1 gai3 waak6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你选择了哪家公司的强制性公积金计划啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which company's Mandatory Provident Fund scheme did you choose?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 強積金到咗退休年齡先可以攞返出嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: koeng4 zik1 gan1 dou3 zo2 teoi3 jau1 nin4 ling4 sin1 ho2 ji5 lo2 faan1 ceot1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 强制性公积金要到退休年龄才可以取出来。
examples.english_sentence: You can only withdraw the Mandatory Provident Fund when you reach retirement age.

english_meaning: Strong person; powerful individual; the strong
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一方面非常优秀，能力很强的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is outstanding and highly capable in a particular area; a strong or powerful individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺投資界係個強者嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tau4 zi1 gaai3 hai6 go3 koeng4 ze2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在投资界是个强者。
examples.english_sentence: He is a strong player in the investment world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要喺呢個社會生存，你一定要做個強者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2 sang1 cyun4, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 go3 koeng4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要想在这个社会生存，你一定要成为一个强者。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to survive in this society, you have to be a strong person.

english_meaning: rigid, inflexible, stubborn
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或者事物过于僵硬，不灵活，不懂变通。也可以指人的性格固执，不听劝。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is too rigid, inflexible, or unyielding. Can also refer to a person's stubborn personality, unwilling to listen to advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁強脊嘅，點做嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 koeng4 zek3 ge3, dim2 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么死板，怎么做事啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're so rigid, how are you going to get anything done?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁強脊啦，聽吓人哋意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 koeng4 zek3 laa1, ting1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么固执了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: forcibly; forcefully; to force; to impose
explanation_mandarin: 用强硬的手段或力量去做某事。
explanation_english: To do something by force; to impose or carry out something forcefully or against someone's will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋強行入咗間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 koeng5 hang4 jap6 zo2 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们强行进入了那间房子。
examples.english_sentence: They forced their way into the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以強行改變人哋嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 koeng5 hang4 goi2 bin3 jan4 dei6 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能强行改变别人的想法。
examples.english_sentence: You can't forcibly change other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆強行要求我哋加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 koeng5 hang4 jiu1 kiu4 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板强行要求我们加班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss forced us to work overtime.

english_meaning: to argue illogically; to quibble; to resort to sophistry; to twist words and force reason; specious reasoning
explanation_mandarin: 指没有道理硬要说成有道理，强行辩解。
explanation_english: To argue in a way that is illogical or unreasonable, twisting words and forcing reason to justify oneself or a point, even when it's clearly wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明做錯咗，唔好再強詞奪理啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 zou6 co3 zo2, m4 hou2 zoi3 koeng5 ci4 dyut6 lei5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明做错了，不要再强词夺理了！
examples.english_sentence: You clearly made a mistake, stop quibbling!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都強詞奪理，真係冇得同佢講道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 koeng5 ci4 dyut6 lei5, zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是强词夺理，真是没法和他讲道理。
examples.english_sentence: He always argues illogically; it's impossible to reason with him.

english_meaning: to emphasize, to stress, to highlight
explanation_mandarin: 着重指出，使突出。
explanation_english: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上面強調咗呢個計劃嘅重要性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 koeng4 diu6 zo2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上强调了这个计划的重要性。
examples.english_sentence: He emphasized the importance of this plan in the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日強調準時返工嘅重要性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 koeng4 diu6 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是强调准时上班的重要性。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always emphasizes the importance of arriving at work on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要強調保護環境嘅重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 koeng4 diu6 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2 ge3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要强调保护环境的重要性。
examples.english_sentence: We need to emphasize the importance of protecting the environment.

english_meaning: to strengthen the body and improve health
explanation_mandarin: 使身体强壮，保持健康。
explanation_english: To strengthen the body and improve overall health through exercise, diet, or other means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該多啲做運動嚟強身健體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 do1 di1 zou6 wan6 dung6 lai4 koeng4 san1 gin6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多做运动来强身健体。
examples.english_sentence: We should exercise more to strengthen our bodies and improve our health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都跑步，為咗強身健體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 paau2 bou6, wai6 zo2 koeng4 san1 gin6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都跑步，为了强身健体。
examples.english_sentence: He runs every day to strengthen his body and improve his health.

english_meaning: to force, to compel
explanation_mandarin: 用强力或手段迫使。
explanation_english: To force or compel someone to do something against their will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以強迫佢做啲佢唔想做嘅嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 koeng5 bik1 keoi5 zou6 di1 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不可以强迫他做一些他不想做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: You can't force him to do things he doesn't want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔會強迫你接受我嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wui5 koeng5 bik1 nei5 zip3 sau6 ngo5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会强迫你接受我的意见。
examples.english_sentence: I won't force you to accept my opinion.

english_meaning: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
explanation_mandarin: 一种精神疾病，患者会受到无法控制的、重复的想法（强迫观念）和/或行为（强迫行为）的困扰。
explanation_english: A mental disorder in which people have unwanted and repeated thoughts, feelings, ideas, sensations (obsessions), or behaviors that drive them to do something over and over (compulsions).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有強迫症，一定要將啲嘢擺到好整齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 koeng5 bik1 zing3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 je5 baai2 dou3 hou2 zing2 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有强迫症，一定要把东西摆放得很整齐。
examples.english_sentence: He has OCD and needs to arrange things very neatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢有啲強迫症傾向，成日都要洗手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 jau5 di1 koeng5 bik1 zing3 king1 hoeng3, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 sai2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他有点强迫症倾向，总是要洗手。
examples.english_sentence: I think he has some OCD tendencies, always needing to wash his hands.

english_meaning: to force; to compel; to coerce
explanation_mandarin: 使用力量或权威迫使他人做某事。
explanation_english: To force or compel someone to do something against their will, often using power or authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好強逼佢做佢唔想做嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 koeng5 bik1 keoi5 zou6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要强迫他做他不想做的事情了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force him to do something he doesn't want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細強逼OT，搞到好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 koeng5 bik1 OT, gaau2 dou3 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板强迫加班，搞得很累。
examples.english_sentence: He was forced to work overtime by his boss and it made him very tired.

english_meaning: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
explanation_mandarin: 一种精神障碍，以反复出现的强迫思维和强迫行为为特征。
explanation_english: A mental disorder characterized by recurrent, unwanted obsessions and/or compulsions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似有啲強逼症，成日都要檢查幾次先放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 koeng5 bik1 zing3, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 gim2 caa4 gei2 ci3 sin1 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像有点强迫症，总是要检查好几次才放心。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like he has some OCD; he always needs to check several times before he feels relieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥有強逼症，屋企一定要執到好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 jau5 koeng5 bik1 zing3, uk1 kei2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zap1 dou3 hou2 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥有强迫症，家里一定要收拾得很干净。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother has OCD; the house must be cleaned very thoroughly.

english_meaning: strong acid
explanation_mandarin: 化学名词，指在水溶液中能完全或几乎完全电离的酸。
explanation_english: A chemical term referring to an acid that completely or almost completely ionizes in an aqueous solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掂佢呀，呢啲係強酸嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dim6 keoi5 aa3, ni1 di1 hai6 koeng4 syun1 lei4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碰它，这些是强酸！
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch it, these are strong acids!

english_meaning: strength, forte, strong point, advantage
explanation_mandarin: 擅长的项目或方面，优势。
explanation_english: An area or aspect in which someone excels or has a particular advantage; a strength or forte.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱歌係佢嘅強項。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 go1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 koeng4 hong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱歌是他的强项。
examples.english_sentence: Singing is his strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅強項係數學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 koeng4 hong6 hai6 sou3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的强项是数学。
examples.english_sentence: His strong point is mathematics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅強項唔係運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 koeng4 hong6 m4 hai6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的强项不是运动。
examples.english_sentence: My strength is not sports.

mandarin_meaning: 强颜欢笑 (qiáng yán huān xiào)
english_meaning: to force a smile; to put on a happy face
explanation_mandarin: 勉强装出高兴的样子。 形容内心悲伤，表面却要装作快乐。
explanation_english: To force oneself to smile or appear happy when one is actually sad or upset. It describes the act of feigning happiness despite inner turmoil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸過咗身，佢喺葬禮上面都要強顏歡笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 hai2 zong3 lai5 soeng6 min6 dou1 jiu3 koeng5 ngaan4 fun1 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸去世了，他在葬礼上也要强颜欢笑。
examples.english_sentence: His father passed away, but he had to force a smile at the funeral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢失咗業，但係佢喺朋友面前都強顏歡笑，唔想俾人知佢唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 sat1 zo2 jip6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hai2 pang4 jau5 min6 cin4 dou1 koeng5 ngaan4 fun1 siu3, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他失业了，但是他在朋友面前都强颜欢笑，不想让人知道他不开心。
examples.english_sentence: Although he lost his job, he forced a smile in front of his friends, not wanting them to know he was unhappy.

english_meaning: strong; powerful; capable; better than
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量大，能力强，或者比别人好。
explanation_english: Describes being strong, powerful, capable, or better than others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好强㗎，考試次次都第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 koeng5 gaa3, haau2 si5 ci3 ci3 dou1 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害的，每次考试都是第一名。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable; he always gets first place in exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部冷氣机好强劲，好快就冻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 hou2 koeng5 ging6, hou2 faai3 zau6 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台空调很强劲，很快就冷了。
examples.english_sentence: This air conditioner is very powerful and cools down quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你强过我好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 koeng5 gwo3 ngo5 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你比我强很多。
examples.english_sentence: You are much better than me.

english_meaning: to assist; to help; to support
explanation_mandarin: 辅助，匡正。多用于辅助君王或长辈。
explanation_english: To assist, support, and correct. Often used to describe assisting a ruler or elder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想弼我上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 bat1 ngo5 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想辅佐我上位。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to help me get to a higher position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路弼住阿爸打理盤生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 bat1 zyu6 aa3 baa4 daa2 lei5 pun4 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直帮助爸爸打理这盘生意。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been assisting his father in managing the business.

english_meaning: to twist; awkward; contrary
explanation_mandarin: 指扭曲、别扭、不顺从。也形容性格倔强、执拗。
explanation_english: Refers to twisting, being awkward, or not complying. Also describes someone with a stubborn or obstinate personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條鎖匙好彆，擰唔郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 so2 si4 hou2 bat1, ning1 m4 juk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把钥匙很别扭，拧不动。
examples.english_sentence: This key is awkward, I can't turn it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好彆扭，乜嘢都唔肯聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 bat1 ngau2, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2 ting1 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很别扭，什么都不肯听别人的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very stubborn person, he doesn't listen to anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢件事嘅感覺好彆，講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 gam2 gok3 hou2 bat1, gong2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这件事的感觉很别扭，说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: I have an awkward feeling about this matter, I can't quite put it into words.

english_meaning: awkward, unnatural, uncomfortable, difficult, uncooperative, contrary
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不自然、不順暢的狀態。也指人性格上的倔強、不合群。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being unnatural, awkward, uncomfortable or difficult. Can also refer to someone's stubbornness or uncooperative nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好彆扭，成日都唔肯同人合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 bit6 nau2, sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 hang2 tung4 jan4 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很彆扭，总是都不肯跟人合作。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very awkward person, and he's always unwilling to cooperate with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對鞋著得好彆扭，唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 haai4 zoek3 dak1 hou2 bit6 nau2, m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋穿得很彆扭，不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are uncomfortable and awkward to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞到好彆扭，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 hou2 bit6 nau2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事搞得很彆扭，不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has become very awkward, I don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 指责，批评; 弹奏; 有弹性
english_meaning: to criticize, to censure; to play (a stringed instrument); to spring, to bounce; elastic
explanation_mandarin: 指责、批评某人；演奏弦乐器；具有弹力，能够反弹。
explanation_english: To criticize or censure someone; to play a stringed instrument; to be elastic and able to bounce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日彈人哋嘅缺點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 taan4 jan4 dei6 ge3 kyut3 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是批评别人的缺点。
examples.english_sentence: He always criticizes other people's shortcomings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識彈結他。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 taan4 git3 taa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会弹吉他。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to play the guitar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個波好彈手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 hou2 taan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球很有弹性。
examples.english_sentence: This ball is very bouncy.

mandarin_meaning: 应用程式崩溃/閃退 (yìngyòng chéngxù bēngkuì / shǎntuì)
english_meaning: App crash
explanation_mandarin: 指手机或电脑上的应用程序突然停止运行，强制关闭。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where a mobile or computer application suddenly stops running and forcibly closes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電話成日彈app，搞到我好鬼嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 seng4 jat6 taan4 aap1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gwai2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手机老是应用程式崩溃，搞得我很生气。
examples.english_sentence: My phone keeps crashing apps, which makes me very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個app彈咗出嚟，啲嘢全部冇晒，真係激死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 aap1 taan4 zo2 chut1 lai4, di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 mou5 saai3, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个应用程式崩溃了，所有东西都没了，真是气死人。
examples.english_sentence: The app crashed, and everything was lost. It's so frustrating!

mandarin_meaning: 弹丸之地 (dàn wán zhī dì)
english_meaning: A tiny place; a place as small as a bullet; a small, insignificant place.
explanation_mandarin: 形容地方非常小，像弹丸一样。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is very small, like a bullet or pellet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港真係彈丸之地，但係乜嘢都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zan1 hai6 daan6 jyun4 zi1 dei6, daan6 hai6 mat1 je5 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港真是弹丸之地，但是什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is really a tiny place, but it has everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋嘅地方係彈丸之地，但係我哋嘅文化好多姿多彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 dei6 fong1 hai6 daan6 jyun4 zi1 dei6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 man4 faa3 hou2 do1 zi1 do1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我们的地方是弹丸之地，但是我们的文化多姿多彩。
examples.english_sentence: Although our place is a tiny place, our culture is colourful and diverse.

synonyms: 細蚊仔地方 (sai3 man1 zai2 dei6 fong1)

english_meaning: to pop up; to spring out; to emerge suddenly
explanation_mandarin: 指突然出现或跳出。
explanation_english: Refers to something suddenly appearing or popping out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然間彈出嚟，嚇我一跳！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 taan4 ceot1 lai4, haak3 ngo5 jat1 tiu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然间弹出来，吓了我一跳！
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly popped out and gave me a fright!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個廣告成日彈出嚟，好煩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gwong2 gou3 seng4 jat6 taan4 ceot1 lai4, hou2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个广告总是弹出，好烦啊！
examples.english_sentence: That advertisement keeps popping up, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撳掣之後，個秘密通道就彈出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam6 zai3 zi1 hau6, go3 bei3 mat6 tung1 dou6 zau6 taan4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按下按钮之后，那个秘密通道就弹了出来。
examples.english_sentence: After pressing the button, the secret passage popped out.

jyutping: taan4 dou3 jat1 dung6 dou1 mou5
mandarin_meaning: 批评得体无完肤，一无是处
english_meaning: Criticized to the point of being completely worthless; to be utterly condemned
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事被批评得非常厉害，完全没有优点或可取之处，彻底否定。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that has been criticized so harshly that they are seen as having no redeeming qualities or value. It implies complete and utter condemnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份計劃書俾老細彈到一戙都冇，要重新再寫過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gai3 waak6 syu1 bei2 lou5 sai3 taan4 dou3 jat1 dung6 dou1 mou5, jiu3 cung4 san1 zoi3 se2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划书被老板批评得体无完肤，要重新再写一遍。
examples.english_sentence: His proposal was completely torn apart by the boss; he has to rewrite it from scratch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲俾啲影評人彈到一戙都冇，票房一定好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 chut1 hei3 bei2 di1 ying2 ping3 yan4 taan4 dou3 jat1 dung6 dou1 mou5, piu3 fong2 jat1 ding6 hou2 chaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影被影评人批评得一无是处，票房肯定很差。
examples.english_sentence: This movie was utterly panned by critics, so the box office will definitely be bad.

jyutping: taan4 dou3 syu6 jip6 dou1 lok6
english_meaning: To play (an instrument) so powerfully that the leaves fall from the trees; to play with great energy and skill; to play very loudly and energetically.
explanation_mandarin: 形容弹奏乐器时力量很大，技巧高超，声音很有气势，以至于树叶都震落下来。多用于形容弹奏乐器，也可用作夸张的形容词。
explanation_english: Describes playing a musical instrument with such power, skill, and energy that even the leaves fall from the trees. It is used to describe instrumental playing and can also be used hyperbolically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲結他彈到樹葉都落，真係好勁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 git3 taa1 taan4 dou3 syu6 jip6 dou1 lok6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他弹吉他弹得树叶都掉下来了，真是太厉害了！
examples.english_sentence: He plays the guitar so powerfully that the leaves fall from the trees, he's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個演唱會，佢哋嘅鼓佬打鼓打到樹葉都落，全場氣氛high到爆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2, keoi5 dei6 ge3 gu2 lou2 daa2 gu2 daa2 dou3 syu6 jip6 dou1 lok6, cyun4 coeng4 hei3 fan1 hai1 dou3 baau3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演唱会，他们的鼓手打鼓打得树叶都掉下来了，全场气氛嗨到爆！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight at the concert, their drummer played the drums so powerfully that the leaves fell from the trees, the atmosphere was electrifying!

english_meaning: elasticity; resilience; springiness
explanation_mandarin: 物体受力变形后，恢复原状的能力。
explanation_english: The ability of an object to return to its original shape after being deformed by force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲橡筋嘅彈力好好，拉極都唔會斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zoeng6 gan1 ge3 daan6 lik6 hou2 hou2, laai1 gik1 dou1 m4 wui5 tyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些橡皮筋的弹性很好，怎么拉都不会断。
examples.english_sentence: These rubber bands have good elasticity and won't break no matter how much you stretch them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅精神彈力好強，面對咁大壓力都冇放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zing1 san4 daan6 lik6 hou2 koeng4, min6 deoi3 gam3 daai6 aat3 lik6 dou1 mou5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的精神弹性很强，面对这么大的压力都没有放弃。
examples.english_sentence: His mental resilience is very strong; he didn't give up even when facing so much pressure.

english_meaning: to impeach, impeachment
explanation_mandarin: 指控官员有不法行为，并要求罢免其职务。
explanation_english: To impeach; to accuse a public official of serious misconduct, leading to possible removal from office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議員提出要彈劾個行政長官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 jyun4 tai4 ceot1 jiu3 daan6 hat6 go3 hang4 zing3 zoeng2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 议员提出要弹劾行政长官。
examples.english_sentence: The councilors proposed to impeach the Chief Executive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 彈劾嘅程序好複雜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan6 hat6 ge3 cing4 zeoi6 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弹劾的程序很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The impeachment process is very complicated.

english_meaning: magazine (firearms)
explanation_mandarin: 枪支中用来装弹药的弹匣，通常可拆卸。
explanation_english: A container for holding cartridges, typically detachable, that feeds rounds into the firing chamber of a firearm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗個新嘅彈匣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 daan6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了一个新的弹匣。
examples.english_sentence: He changed to a new magazine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個彈匣入面有幾多粒彈？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 hap6 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 do1 lap1 daan2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个弹匣里有多少颗子弹？
examples.english_sentence: How many bullets are in this magazine?

english_meaning: slingshot; catapult
explanation_mandarin: 一种玩具或工具，用橡皮筋或皮筋带动，发射小石子或其他弹丸。
explanation_english: A toy or tool that uses elastic bands to propel small stones or other projectiles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日用彈叉射雀仔，畀阿媽鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 yung6 daan6 caa1 se6 zoek3 zai2, bei2 aa3 maa1 nau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常用弹弓打鸟，被妈妈骂。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often used a slingshot to shoot birds and got scolded by my mom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲彈叉都幾先進，可以裝紅外線瞄準器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 daan6 caa1 dou1 gei2 sin1 zeon3, ho2 ji5 zong1 hung4 ngoi6 sin3 miu4 zeon2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的弹弓都很先进，可以装红外线瞄准器。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, slingshots are quite advanced, you can even install an infrared sight on them.

english_meaning: to tell on someone; to snitch; to tattle
explanation_mandarin: 指向老师或长辈报告别人的错误或不好的行为，通常带有负面含义。
explanation_english: To report someone's mistakes or bad behavior to a teacher or elder, usually with a negative connotation. It implies informing on someone to get them in trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日彈墨啦，好煩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 taan4 mak6 laa1, hou2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是告状，很烦人！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tell on people, it's annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日彈墨，啲同學都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 taan4 mak6, di1 tung4 hok6 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是告状，同学们都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always tells on people, so the classmates don't like him.

english_meaning: magazine (firearms)
explanation_mandarin: 枪械中用来储存子弹的装置，可以快速装填子弹。
explanation_english: A magazine is a container which holds cartridges, typically in a firearm, for repeated firing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗個彈夾，準備繼續射擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 go3 daan6 gaap3, zeon2 bei6 gai3 zuk6 se6 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了个弹匣，准备继续射击。
examples.english_sentence: He changed the magazine and prepared to continue shooting.

english_meaning: to play (a musical instrument)
explanation_mandarin: 用手指或拨子等拨动乐器使其发声。
explanation_english: To play a musical instrument by plucking or striking the strings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識彈奏好多種樂器，好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 daan6 zau3 hou2 do1 zung2 ngok6 hei3, hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会弹奏很多种乐器，很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to play many kinds of musical instruments, he's very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想聽我彈奏邊首歌啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 teng1 ngo5 daan6 zau3 bin1 sau2 go1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想听我弹奏哪首歌啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which song do you want to hear me play?

english_meaning: Catapult; Ejection seat; Launcher
explanation_mandarin: 一种能将物体弹射出去的装置。多指飞机上的弹射座椅，或是一些玩具上的发射器。
explanation_english: A device used to launch or eject objects with force. Commonly refers to ejection seats in aircraft, or launchers in toys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架戰機有彈射器，遇到緊急情況，飛行員可以即刻彈出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 zin3 gei1 jau5 daan6 se6 hei3, jyu6 dou2 gan2 gap1 ging2 fong3, fei1 hang4 jyun4 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 daan6 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这架战斗机有弹射器，遇到紧急情况，飞行员可以立刻弹射出去。
examples.english_sentence: This fighter jet has an ejection seat, so pilots can eject immediately in case of an emergency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗個彈射器玩具，可以將啲波射到好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 go3 daan6 se6 hei3 wan2 geoi6, ho2 ji5 zoeng1 di1 bo1 se6 dou3 hou2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了个弹射器玩具，可以将一些球射得很远。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a catapult toy that can launch balls very far.

english_meaning: trampoline; spring bed
explanation_mandarin: （主要用于香港）指蹦床，一种娱乐或体育器材，由绷紧的弹性布面构成，可以让人在上面跳跃。 也可指彈簧床。
explanation_english: (Mainly used in Hong Kong) Refers to a trampoline, a recreational or sporting device consisting of a taut elastic surface on which people can bounce. Can also refer to a spring bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔好鍾意喺彈床上面跳嚟跳去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 daan6 cong4 soeng6 min6 tiu3 lai4 tiu3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们很喜欢在蹦床上跳来跳去。
examples.english_sentence: The children love jumping up and down on the trampoline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張彈床好舒服，我一瞓落去就即刻瞓著咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 daan6 cong4 hou2 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 jat1 fan3 lok6 heoi3 zau6 zik1 hak1 fan3 zoek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张弹簧床很舒服，我一躺下去就立刻睡着了。
examples.english_sentence: This spring bed is very comfortable, I fell asleep as soon as I lay down.

english_meaning: Trampoline
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于娱乐或运动的设备，通常由一个用弹簧连接到框架上的大块结实的布料组成，人们可以在上面跳跃。
explanation_english: A piece of equipment consisting of a strong fabric sheet connected by springs to a frame, used for jumping on as a sport or for recreation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔喺彈床上面跳嚟跳去，玩得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 daan6 cong4 soeng6 min6 tiu3 lai4 tiu3 heoi3, waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们在蹦床上跳来跳去，玩得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The children are jumping on the trampoline, having a lot of fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日去咗個彈床樂園玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 go3 daan6 cong4 lok6 jyun4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天去了一个蹦床公园玩。
examples.english_sentence: We went to a trampoline park today.

english_meaning: slingshot, catapult; spring
explanation_mandarin: 指一种利用弹性势能发射石子等物体的玩具或工具；也可指机械装置中的弹簧。
explanation_english: Refers to a slingshot or catapult, a toy or tool that uses elastic potential energy to launch projectiles like pebbles; also refers to a spring in a mechanical device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日用彈弓射雀仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 yung6 daan6 gung1 se6 zoek3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常用弹弓打鸟。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often used a slingshot to shoot birds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架車嘅避震彈弓好硬。

explanation_mandarin: 一种刀具，刀刃可以自动弹出，通常通过按钮或开关触发。

examples.english_sentence: He secretly hid a switchblade in his backpack.

english_meaning: spring bed, mattress
explanation_mandarin: 指装有弹簧的床垫或床。
explanation_english: Refers to a bed or mattress with springs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張彈弓床瞓得好舒服呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 daan6 gung1 cong4 fan3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张弹簧床睡得很舒服啊！
examples.english_sentence: This spring bed is very comfortable to sleep on!

examples.english_sentence: The spring bed in my home has been used for many years, and it's starting to sag a bit.

explanation_english: A metaphor for someone who takes advantage of situations, especially sexually harassing by touching inappropriately. It implies someone who is quick to seize an opportunity for personal gain, often in a sneaky or underhanded way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 提防啲佢啦，聽講佢係個彈弓手嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai4 fong4 di1 keoi5 laa1, ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai6 go3 daan6 gung1 sau2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点他吧，听说他是个喜欢占人便宜的人。
