examples.mandarin_sentence: 别走那么近，一会儿他以为有机可乘，揩油就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk so close, in case he thinks there's an opportunity to take advantage, it'll be a problem if he starts groping.

mandarin_meaning: 扳机指; 屈指肌腱狭窄性腱鞘炎
english_meaning: Trigger finger; Stenosing tenosynovitis
explanation_mandarin: 一种手部疾病，手指屈曲或伸直时会卡住，类似扣动扳机。
explanation_english: A condition affecting the tendons in the fingers or thumb, causing a snapping or locking sensation when bending or straightening the affected digit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近隻手指成日彈弓指，好痛呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 zek3 sau2 zi2 sing4 jat6 daan6 gung1 zi2, hou2 tung3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近手指经常扳机指，很痛。
examples.english_sentence: My finger has been having trigger finger lately, it's very painful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我隻拇指有啲彈弓指，可能要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 zek3 mou5 zi2 jau5 di1 daan6 gung1 zi2, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的拇指有些扳机指，可能要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my thumb has some trigger finger, and I might need surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期重複同一動作，容易引發彈弓指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 cung4 fuk1 tung4 jat1 dung6 zok3, jung4 ji6 jan5 faat3 daan6 gung1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期重复同一个动作，容易引发扳机指。
examples.english_sentence: Performing the same action repeatedly for a long time can easily cause trigger finger.

english_meaning: flexibility, elasticity
explanation_mandarin: 指物体受外力作用后变形，除去外力后能恢复原状的性质；也指灵活变通。
explanation_english: The ability of an object to deform under stress and return to its original shape after the stress is removed; also refers to flexibility and adaptability.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 si4 gaan3 hou2 jau5 daan6 sing3, nei5 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 aan1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作的时间很有弹性，你可以自己安排。
examples.english_sentence: This job has flexible hours, you can arrange your own schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有彈性，乜嘢都會試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 daan6 sing3, mat1 je5 dou1 wui5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有弹性，什么都会尝试一下。
examples.english_sentence: He is very flexible, he'll try anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅政策比較有彈性，可以根據情況調整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zing3 caak3 bei2 gaau3 jau5 daan6 sing3, ho2 ji5 gan1 geoi3 cing4 kwong3 tiu4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的政策比较有弹性，可以根据情况调整。
examples.english_sentence: This company's policies are more flexible and can be adjusted according to the situation.

english_meaning: In the blink of an eye; in a flash; in an instant
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间极短，非常快。
explanation_english: Describes a very short period of time; extremely quickly. Refers to the time it takes to snap your fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢彈指之間就做晒啲功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan6 zi2 zi1 gaan1 zau6 zou6 saai3 di1 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他转眼之间就把功课都做完了。
examples.english_sentence: He finished all his homework in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世界變化彈指之間，我哋要不斷學習先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gaai3 bin3 faa3 daan6 zi2 zi1 gaan1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bat1 dyun6 hok6 zaap6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世界变化转眼之间，我们要不断学习才行。
examples.english_sentence: The world changes in the blink of an eye, we need to keep learning.

english_meaning: trampoline; springboard
explanation_mandarin: 一种体育器材，通常是蹦床或跳板，用于弹跳或辅助跳跃。
explanation_english: A piece of sports equipment, usually a trampoline or springboard, used for bouncing or assisting in jumping.

examples.english_sentence: He wants to use the springboard to help him jump higher.

explanation_english: Describes someone who talks big or makes many promises but doesn't follow through with actions, similar to 'firing blanks'. It implies a lack of substance behind the words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話要減肥，但係又唔做運動，根本就係彈槍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 zou6 wan6 dung6, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 daan6 coeng1.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划说了很久，但是到现在都还没有实行，看来大部分都是放空炮。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has been talked about for a long time, but it hasn't been implemented yet, it seems like it's mostly empty promises.

explanation_english: A small, usually glass, ball used as a toy.

examples.english_sentence: He started learning to play the piano when he was little.

english_meaning: To pass the buck; to shirk responsibility by passing it on to someone else; to play the blame game

explanation_english: A metaphor for shirking responsibility by passing the blame to someone else; no one is willing to take responsibility.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再互相推卸责任了，快点想想怎样解决问题吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop passing the buck, let's quickly think about how to solve the problem.

examples.english_sentence: His check was bounced by the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你嘅戶口冇錢，張票就會彈票㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ge3 wu6 hau2 mou5 cin2, zoeng1 piu3 zau6 wui5 taan4 piu3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你的账户没钱，支票就会跳票的。
examples.english_sentence: If there's no money in your account, the check will bounce.

english_meaning: spring (mechanical)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架車嘅避震彈簧好硬，所以揸起嚟好唔舒服。

english_meaning: switchblade; flick knife

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢袋住把彈簧刀，好似好惡咁。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要随身带着弹簧刀，犯法的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't carry a switchblade around, it's illegal.

english_meaning: to play the guitar
explanation_mandarin: 指演奏吉他这种乐器。
explanation_english: Refers to playing the guitar, a musical instrument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意彈結他，成日喺屋企彈。

explanation_english: A piece of equipment consisting of a strong fabric sheet connected by springs to a frame, used as a springboard for acrobatic exercises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路喺彈網上面跳得好開心呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou2 hai2 daan6 mong5 soeng6 min6 tiu3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们在蹦床上跳得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The children are jumping on the trampoline and having a lot of fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺後花園起咗個彈網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hau6 faa1 jyun2 hei2 zo2 go3 daan6 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在后花园里建了一个蹦床。
examples.english_sentence: They built a trampoline in the backyard.

english_meaning: criticism arises from all directions; a chorus of disapproval
explanation_mandarin: 形容很多人同时提出批评或反对的声音。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where criticism or opposition arises from many different sources simultaneously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃一公布，彈聲四起，好多人話唔實際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 jat1 gung1 bou3, daan6 seng1 sei3 hei2, hou2 do1 jan4 waa6 m4 sat6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划一公布，批评之声四起，很多人说不切实际。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the plan was announced, criticism arose from all directions, and many people said it was impractical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個決定引起彈聲四起，大家都覺得佢做得唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 kyut3 ding6 gan2 hei2 daan6 seng1 sei3 hei2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 zou6 dak1 m4 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的决定引起了批评之声四起，大家都觉得他做得不对。
examples.english_sentence: His decision caused a chorus of disapproval; everyone felt he did the wrong thing.

english_meaning: ammunition; bullets; figuratively, resources; backup
explanation_mandarin: 指枪炮使用的弹药，也比喻为支持行动所需的资源、材料或论据。
explanation_english: Refers to ammunition used in guns and cannons. Figuratively, it can also mean resources, materials, or arguments needed to support an action or debate. The * indicates that it can be used literally and figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打機嘅時候，我哋要儲多啲彈藥，先至夠打大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 gei1 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 chu5 do1 di1 daan6 joek6, sin1 zi3 gau3 daa2 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩游戏的时候，我们要储存多一点弹药，才足够打大Boss。
examples.english_sentence: When playing games, we need to store more ammunition in order to have enough to fight the big boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日開會要同老闆嘈，我哋要準備定啲彈藥先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hoi1 wui2 jiu3 tung4 lou5 baan2 caau2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 ding6 di1 daan6 joek6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天开会要和老板争论，我们必须要准备好一些论据。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow we have a meeting and will argue with the boss, we need to prepare some ammunition (arguments) beforehand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備咗好多彈藥去攻擊對方嘅論點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 daan6 joek6 heoi3 gung1 gik1 deoi3 fong1 ge3 leon6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备了很多论据去攻击对方的论点。
examples.english_sentence: They prepared a lot of ammunition (arguments) to attack the other side's points.

english_meaning: ammunition; bullets; (figuratively) resources; arguments
explanation_mandarin: 指枪炮等武器使用的弹丸和炸药，也比喻进行辩论、批评等所需的资料、论据。
explanation_english: Literally refers to ammunition used in firearms and artillery. Figuratively, it refers to the resources, arguments, or information needed for debate, criticism, or any kind of conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備咗好多彈藥，準備同對方理論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 daan6 joek6, zyun2 bei6 tung4 deoi3 fong1 lei5 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备了很多论据，准备和对方理论。
examples.english_sentence: They prepared a lot of ammunition (arguments), ready to argue with the other party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司冇晒彈藥，好快執笠㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 mou5 saai3 daan6 joek6, hou2 faai3 zap1 lap1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经耗尽所有资源，很快就要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has run out of ammunition (resources), it will be bankrupt soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要儲定啲彈藥，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cou5 ding6 di1 daan6 joek6, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要储备一些资源，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: We need to stock up on some ammunition (resources), just in case.

english_meaning: to bounce; to spring; to jump
explanation_mandarin: 指物体受力后迅速弹起，或人、动物跳跃。
explanation_english: To bounce or spring up quickly after being subjected to force; to jump (referring to people or animals).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻波彈跳得好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 bo1 taan4 tiu3 dak1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球弹跳得很高。
examples.english_sentence: The ball bounces very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢彈跳力好勁，可以輕易咁樣跳過個障礙物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taan4 tiu3 lik6 hou2 ging6, ho2 ji5 hing1 ji6 gam2 joeng2 tiu3 gwo3 go3 zoeng3 ngoi6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的弹跳力很强，可以轻易地跳过障碍物。
examples.english_sentence: His jumping ability is very strong; he can easily jump over the obstacle.

english_meaning: Ballistic missile
explanation_mandarin: 一种依靠弹道轨迹飞行的导弹，主要攻击地面目标。
explanation_english: A missile that follows a ballistic trajectory to deliver one or more warheads to a predetermined target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲國家不斷開發緊新型嘅彈道導彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gwok3 gaa1 bat1 dyun6 hoi1 faat3 gan2 san1 jing4 ge3 daan6 dou6 dou6 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些国家不断开发新型弹道导弹。
examples.english_sentence: Some countries are constantly developing new types of ballistic missiles.

english_meaning: to not show up, to flake, to miss an appointment
explanation_mandarin: 指没有按照约定赴约，爽约，放鸽子。
explanation_english: Refers to failing to keep an appointment or commitment; to not show up; to flake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日彈鐘，真係好冇信用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 taan4 zung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 seon3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是爽约，真没信用。
examples.english_sentence: He always flakes, it's really unreliable of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我今晚要彈鐘，因為我突然唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 taan4 zung1, jan1 wai6 ngo5 dat6 jin4 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我今晚要爽约了，因为我突然不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I have to flake tonight because I suddenly feel unwell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再彈鐘喇，我哋嘅計劃都俾你搞亂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 taan4 zung1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 dou1 bei2 nei5 gaau2 lyun6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再爽约了，我们的计划都被你搞乱了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flake again, you've messed up our plans.

english_meaning: to bounce away; to spring aside; to dodge; to move away quickly
explanation_mandarin: 指快速地弹跳开来，或迅速避开，躲闪。
explanation_english: Refers to bouncing away quickly or dodging/evading rapidly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波彈開咗，佢接唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bo1 taan4 hoi1 zo2, keoi5 zip3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球弹开了，他没接到。
examples.english_sentence: The ball bounced away, and he couldn't catch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到架車衝埋嚟，即刻彈開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 gaa3 ce1 cung1 maai4 lai4, zik1 hak1 taan4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到车冲过来，立刻躲开了。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the car rushing towards him, he dodged away immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，啲火花會彈開㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, di1 fo2 faa1 wui5 taan4 hoi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，火花会溅出来的。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, the sparks will fly off.

english_meaning: Bullet head; bulb-shaped head; blunt object; (slang) someone who is a troublemaker or causing problems
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是子弹的头部。 比喻指某物形状像子弹头，也指容易惹麻烦或制造问题的人。
explanation_english: Literally means the head of a bullet. Figuratively, it refers to something that is shaped like a bullet head. In slang, it can refer to someone who is a troublemaker or is causing problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺學校搞事，真係個彈頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 gaau2 si6, zan1 hai6 go3 daan6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在学校惹事，真是个惹麻烦的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is always causing trouble at school, he is a real troublemaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款車嘅設計好似彈頭咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 kwan2 ce1 ge3 sai3 gai3 hou2 ci5 daan6 tau4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款车的设计好像子弹头一样。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this car is like a bullet head.

synonyms: 百厭星 (baak3 jim3 sing1) - Naughty star

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate, unyielding
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人固执、不听劝告，性格强硬。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is stubborn, unwilling to listen to advice, and has a strong-willed personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好彊㗎，你講乜佢都唔會聽嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 goeng6 gaa3, nei5 gong2 mat1 keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 teng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很倔强，你说什么他都不会听的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very stubborn person, he won't listen to anything you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁彊啦，聽下人哋嘅意見都好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 goeng6 laa1, teng1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 dou1 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么倔强了，听听别人的意见也好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, it's good to listen to other people's opinions too.

english_meaning: to fill; to cover; full; all over; more
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词; 形容词; 副词
explanation_mandarin: 填补，补足；满，遍布；更加。
explanation_english: To fill or make up for something; full; all over; even more so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 彌補返個損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei4 bou2 faan1 go3 syun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弥补回损失。
examples.english_sentence: To make up for the loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煙霧彌漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yin1 mou6 nei4 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 烟雾弥漫。
examples.english_sentence: The smoke is dense and pervasive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個錯唔係咁容易彌補㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的错误不是那么容易弥补的。
examples.english_sentence: His mistake is not so easily made up for.

english_meaning: Maitreya (the future Buddha)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教中的未来佛，也称弥勒佛或弥勒菩萨。
explanation_english: Maitreya is regarded as the future Buddha of this world in Buddhist eschatology. In some Buddhist traditions and texts, such as the Amitabha Sutra and the Lotus Sutra, Maitreya is a bodhisattva who will appear on Earth in the future, achieve complete enlightenment, and teach the pure dharma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面擺咗尊彌勒佛，笑咪咪噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu2 jap6 min6 baai2 zo2 zeon1 mai4 lak6 fat6, siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庙里摆了一尊弥勒佛，笑眯眯的样子。
examples.english_sentence: There's a statue of Maitreya Buddha in the temple, smiling with narrowed eyes.

english_meaning: heinous crime; enormous sin; unpardonable offense
explanation_mandarin: 形容罪恶极大，如同弥漫天空一般。
explanation_english: Describes a crime or sin of immense magnitude, as if it fills the entire sky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做，簡直就係犯咗彌天大罪！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, gaan2 zik6 zau6 hai6 faan6 zo2 mei4 tin1 daai6 zeoi6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做，简直就是犯了滔天大罪！
examples.english_sentence: What he did is simply committing a heinous crime!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢以前犯咗彌天大罪，依家都已經改過自身啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 keoi5 ji5 cin4 faan6 zo2 mei4 tin1 daai6 zeoi6, ji1 gaa1 dou1 ji5 ging1 goi2 gwo3 zi6 san1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算他以前犯了滔天大罪，现在都已经改过自新了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he committed an unpardonable offense in the past, he has already reformed himself now.

english_meaning: Mass (religious service)
explanation_mandarin: 天主教、东正教等举行的礼仪，纪念耶稣基督的牺牲。
explanation_english: A religious service in the Roman Catholic, Eastern Orthodox, and some other Christian churches, commemorating the Last Supper and the sacrifice of Jesus Christ.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每個星期日都會去教堂參與彌撒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 gaau1 tong4 caam1 jyu5 mei4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每个星期天都会去教堂参加弥撒。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to church to participate in Mass every Sunday.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 sing3 daan3 zit3, ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 zi2 je6 mei4 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是圣诞节，我们一家人会去参加子夜弥撒。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is Christmas, our family will attend midnight Mass.

english_meaning: to pervade; to permeate; to fill the air; to diffuse
explanation_mandarin: 指某种气体、气味、气氛等充满空间，到处都是。
explanation_english: Refers to a gas, odor, atmosphere, etc., that fills a space and is everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房彌漫住陣陣嘅咖啡香味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 nei4 maan6 zyu6 zan6 zan6 ge3 gaa3 fe1 hoeng1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里弥漫着阵阵咖啡的香味。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen is filled with the aroma of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個城市都彌漫住煙霞，睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 go3 sing4 si5 dou1 nei4 maan6 zyu6 jin1 haa4, tai2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个城市都弥漫着烟雾，看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The whole city is pervaded with haze, and it's difficult to see clearly.

english_meaning: at one's last gasp; on the verge of death; in extremis
explanation_mandarin: 指病重将死，气息微弱。
explanation_english: Refers to being at the point of death due to serious illness, with weak breathing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺醫院彌留緊，屋企人都趕晒嚟見佢最後一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 ji1 yun2 nei4 lau4 gan2, uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 gon2 saai3 lai4 gin3 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在医院弥留之际，家人都赶来见他最后一面。
examples.english_sentence: He is now in the hospital at his last gasp, and his family has rushed here to see him for the last time.

english_meaning: to make up for; to compensate; to remedy; to offset
explanation_mandarin: 补偿，填补不足或过失。
explanation_english: To make amends for something; to compensate for a deficiency or mistake; to repair or restore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知我做錯咗，我會盡力去彌補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 ngo5 zou6 co3 zo2, ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 heoi3 nei4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道我做错了，我会尽力去弥补。
examples.english_sentence: I know I made a mistake, and I will do my best to make up for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想用物質去彌補對仔女嘅疏忽照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 yung6 mat6 zat1 heoi3 nei4 bou2 deoi3 zai2 nui2 ge3 so1 fat1 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想用物质去弥补对子女的疏忽照顾。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to use material things to compensate for neglecting his children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅損失好難彌補㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 syun2 sat1 hou2 naan4 nei4 bou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的损失很难弥补啊。
examples.english_sentence: This loss is difficult to make up for.

english_meaning: Messiah
explanation_mandarin: 指被期待的拯救者，尤指犹太教和基督教中预言的救世主。
explanation_english: The expected savior or liberator of a group of people, especially the figure prophesied in Judaism and Christianity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人認為佢係彌賽亞，嚟拯救我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 jing6 wai4 keoi5 hai6 nei4 coi3 aa3, lai4 cing2 gau3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人认为他是弥赛亚，来拯救我们。
examples.english_sentence: Some people believe he is the Messiah, coming to save us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自稱係彌賽亞，但係冇人相信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cing1 hai6 nei4 coi3 aa3, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 soeng1 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自称是弥赛亚，但是没有人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He claimed to be the Messiah, but no one believed him.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他弯了腰捡东西。
examples.english_sentence: He bent his back to pick something up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係彎嘅。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路很弯曲，开车要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The road is very winding, you need to be careful when driving.

explanation_mandarin: 身体向前或向下弯曲。
explanation_english: To bend the body forward or downward, usually from the waist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢彎腰執起地下嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waan1 jiu1 zap1 hei2 dei6 haa2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他弯腰捡起地上的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He bent down to pick up something from the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日彎腰，對條腰唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 waan1 jiu1, deoi3 tiu4 jiu1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是弯腰，对腰不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bend over all the time, it's not good for your back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢彎腰鞠躬，表示感謝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waan1 jiu1 guk1 gung1, biu2 si6 gam2 ze6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他弯腰鞠躬，表示感谢。
examples.english_sentence: He bowed to express his gratitude.

english_meaning: To echo; to support blindly; to agree with someone without critical thought; to be a yes-man; sycophant
explanation_mandarin: 指不加思考地盲目附和别人，通常用于贬义。形容人没有主见，只会跟随别人的意见。
explanation_english: Refers to blindly agreeing with someone without critical thought, usually with a negative connotation. It describes someone who lacks independent judgment and simply follows the opinions of others, often for personal gain or to avoid conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都淨係識得彎臣老細，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 waan1 san4 lou5 sai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都只会附和老板，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to echo his boss in everything, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日彎臣佢哋，要有自己嘅諗法呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 waan1 san4 keoi5 dei6, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是附和他们，要有自己的想法啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be a yes-man to them, you need to have your own opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 快速转弯; 快速转軚
english_meaning: Quick turn; Quick U-turn (often used figuratively to describe a rapid change of opinion or stance)
explanation_mandarin: 原指车辆快速转弯，引申为迅速改变主意、立场或策略。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a vehicle making a sharp turn at speed, it is extended to mean a rapid change of mind, position, or strategy. Often carries a slightly negative connotation of being opportunistic or insincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到風向唔對路，即刻彎速，轉軚撐政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 fung1 hoeng3 m4 deoi3 lou6, zik1 hak1 waan1 suk1, zyun2 taai3 caang1 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到风向不对，立刻快速转弯，转而支持政府。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the wind was blowing in the wrong direction, he immediately made a quick U-turn and started supporting the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅策略成日彎速，搞到啲員工唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caak3 leuk6 sing4 jat6 waan1 suk1, gaau2 dou3 di1 gung1 jyun4 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的策略经常快速转变，搞得员工们不知所措。
examples.english_sentence: This company's strategies are constantly changing quickly, leaving the employees at a loss.

mandarin_meaning: 归还; 返回; 属于
english_meaning: to return; to revert to; to belong to; to attribute to (cause etc.); return
explanation_mandarin: 表示返回，归还，或属于某人/某物。
explanation_english: Indicates returning, reverting to, or belonging to someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 将啲书归返原位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 syu1 gwai1 faan1 jyun4 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把这些书归还到原来的位置。
examples.english_sentence: Return these books to their original places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅成就归功于佢嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 sing4 zau6 gwai1 gung1 jyu1 keoi5 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的成就要归功于他的努力。
examples.english_sentence: Their achievement is attributed to his efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 所有嘅问题最终都归结于缺乏沟通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 jau5 ge3 man6 tai4 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 gwai1 git3 jyu1 kyut3 fat6 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有的问题最终都归结于缺乏沟通。
examples.english_sentence: All the problems ultimately come down to a lack of communication.

english_meaning: to record; to copy; to write down
explanation_mandarin: 记录，抄写；用录音设备记录声音；用录像设备记录影像。
explanation_english: To record, copy, or write down information. To record sound using audio equipment. To record video using video equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想录低呢段声。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 luk6 dai1 ni1 dyun6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想录下这段声音。
examples.english_sentence: I want to record this sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢录咗好多歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 luk6 zo2 hou2 do1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他录了很多歌。
examples.english_sentence: He has recorded many songs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以帮我录低呢个节目？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 luk6 dai1 ni1 go3 zit3 muk6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我录下这个节目吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me record this program?

english_meaning: intelligent; clever; bright
explanation_mandarin: 形容人聪明、机灵。在粤语中，通常形容小孩比较多。
explanation_english: Describes someone as intelligent and quick-witted. In Cantonese, it's often used to describe children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路仔真係好彗喎，乜嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 wai6 wo3, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩真聪明，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: This kid is really clever, he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鬼彗，一教就識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwai2 wai6, jat1 gaau3 zau6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常聪明，一教就会。
examples.english_sentence: He's very intelligent, he learns it right away.

english_meaning: Comet
explanation_mandarin: 一种外观像拖着尾巴的星星的天体。
explanation_english: A celestial body that appears as a star with a tail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋晚見到粒彗星，好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 maan1 gin3 dou2 lap1 wai6 sing1, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚看到一颗彗星，好漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: I saw a comet last night, it was so beautiful!

english_meaning: to collect, to gather, to compile
explanation_mandarin: 收集；把事物聚集起来。
explanation_english: To collect or gather things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要我哋將啲資料彙報畀經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 zi1 liu2 wui6 bou3 bei2 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要我们把这些资料汇报给经理。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants us to compile these data and report them to the manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將所有嘅意見彙集埋一齊，做咗份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 ji3 gin3 wui6 zip6 maai4 jat1 cai4, zou6 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将所有的意见汇集在一起，做了一份报告。
examples.english_sentence: He compiled all the opinions together and made a report.

english_meaning: to report; to give an account of; report
explanation_mandarin: 向上级或有关部门报告情况。
explanation_english: To report information to superiors or relevant departments; a report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜要向老細彙報進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 jiu3 hoeng3 lou5 sai3 wui6 bou3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个星期要向老板汇报进度。
examples.english_sentence: We need to report the progress to the boss next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，佢做咗一個詳細嘅彙報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 cheung4 sai3 ge3 wui6 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他做了一个详细的汇报。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a detailed report during the meeting.

english_meaning: to collect; to gather; to converge; a collection
explanation_mandarin: 汇集，聚集；集合起来的东西。
explanation_english: To gather, to collect; things that are collected together; a collection or compilation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係人流彚集嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 jan4 lau4 wui2 zaap6 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是人流汇集的地方。
examples.english_sentence: This is a place where people gather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲資料彚集起嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 zi1 liu2 wui2 zaap6 hei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将那些资料汇集起来。
examples.english_sentence: He compiled the information.

english_meaning: rites; norms; rules; ethical standards
explanation_mandarin: 指礼仪、规范、法则等。在粤语中，有时带有讽刺或贬义，指那些过于注重形式，不讲实际的人或事。
explanation_english: Refers to rites, norms, rules, and other standards. In Cantonese, it sometimes carries ironic or derogatory connotations, referring to people or things that are overly concerned with formalities and lack practicality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做嘢好跟啲彝嘅，唔會變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 je5 hou2 gan1 di1 ji4 ge3, m4 wui5 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们做事很遵循那些规矩，不会变通。
examples.english_sentence: They follow the rules strictly in their work and don't adapt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講彝啦，最緊要實際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gong2 ji4 laa1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 sat6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么讲究规矩了，最重要的是实际。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so focused on the formalities; what matters most is practicality.

mandarin_meaning: 样子; 形状; 形象
english_meaning: shape; form; appearance; image
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的外观、形状或形态。
explanation_english: Refers to the external appearance, shape, or form of a thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個波嘅形狀係圓形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 ge3 ying4 zong6 hai6 jyun4 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球的形状是圆形的。
examples.english_sentence: The shape of this ball is round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重自己嘅身形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 san1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很注重自己的身材。
examples.english_sentence: She pays a lot of attention to her figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個件事仲未有咩形住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gin6 si6 zung6 mei6 jau5 me1 ying4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件事还没有什么进展。
examples.english_sentence: There's no progress in that matter yet.

english_meaning: to feel; to have a feeling that; to suspect
explanation_mandarin: 感觉好像会发生什么事情；觉得某事即将发生或存在某种状态。
explanation_english: To feel or sense that something is going to happen, or that a certain state exists. It often implies a premonition or suspicion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我形住聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing4 zyu6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我感觉明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: I feel like it's going to rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我形住佢呃緊我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing4 zyu6 keoi5 aak1 gan2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他在骗我。
examples.english_sentence: I suspect he is lying to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得咁快，我形住佢趕時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dak1 gam3 faai3, ngo5 jing4 zyu6 keoi5 gon2 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走得这么快，我觉得他赶时间。
examples.english_sentence: He's walking so fast, I have a feeling he's in a hurry.

english_meaning: situation; circumstances; state of affairs; trend; terrain
explanation_mandarin: 指局势、情势，一般指事物发展变化所呈现的状况。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of affairs, the circumstances, the trend, or the terrain in which something is happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟呢次嘅經濟形勢唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 ne1 ci3 ge3 ging1 zai3 ying4 sai3 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来这次的经济形势不太好。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like the economic situation this time isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要睇清楚個形勢先至做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 go3 ying4 sai3 sin1 zai3 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要看清楚形势再做决定。
examples.english_sentence: You need to understand the situation clearly before making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅政治形勢好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 jing1 zi3 ying4 sai3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的政治形势很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The current political situation is very complicated.

mandarin_meaning: 形同虚设 (xíng tóng xū shè)
english_meaning: Existing in name only; existing only in form; a mere formality; nominal
explanation_mandarin: 虽然存在，但实际上没有任何作用或效力。
explanation_english: Existing only in name or form, without any real effect or power; a system or rule that is supposed to exist but in practice does not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條例寫到好嚴，但係執法唔嚴，咪形同虛設囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lai6 se2 dou3 hou2 jim4, daan6 hai6 zap1 faat3 m4 jim4, mai1 jing4 tung4 heoi1 cit3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 条例写得很严格，但是执法不严，不就形同虚设了吗。
examples.english_sentence: The regulations are written strictly, but if the enforcement is lax, it's just a formality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個保安淨係得個樣，實際咩都唔做，根本形同虛設。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bou2 on1 zing6 hai6 dak1 go3 joeng2, sat6 zai3 me1 dou1 m4 zou6, gan1 bun2 jing4 tung4 heoi1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个保安只是个摆设，实际上什么都不做，根本形同虚设。
examples.english_sentence: That security guard is just for show; he doesn't actually do anything. He's completely useless.

synonyms: 有名無實 (jau5 ming4 mou4 sat6)
徒有虛名 (tou4 jau5 heoi1 ming4)

english_meaning: to be like strangers; to treat each other as strangers despite having a close relationship in the past
explanation_mandarin: 本来关系密切，后来变得像陌生人一样。
explanation_english: Originally close, but later became like strangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結咗婚十年，但係因為性格唔啱，而家形同陌路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 zo2 fan1 sap6 nin4, daan6 hai6 yan1 wai6 sing3 gaak3 m4 ngaam1, yi4 gaa1 ying4 tung4 mak6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚十年了，但是因为性格不合，现在形同陌路。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for ten years, but because their personalities clash, they are now like strangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從上次嗌交之後，我同佢就形同陌路，連招呼都唔打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 soeng5 ci3 aai3 gaau1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zau6 ying4 tung4 mak6 lou6, lin4 ziu1 fu1 dou1 m4 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从上次吵架之后，我和他就形同陌路，连招呼都不打。
examples.english_sentence: Since our last argument, we've been like strangers, not even acknowledging each other.

english_meaning: utterly alone; solitary; lonely and desolate
explanation_mandarin: 形容孤单，没有伴侣，只有自己的身影。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being alone, without companions; only one's shadow is present.  Implies loneliness and isolation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢移民咗去外國之後，覺得自己形單影隻，好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 zi1 hau6, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 ying4 daan1 ying2 zek3, hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他移民到国外之后，觉得自己形单影隻，很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: After immigrating abroad, he felt utterly alone and very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕節一個人過，真係形單影隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 zit3 jat1 go3 jan4 gwo3, zan1 hai6 ying4 daan1 ying2 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞节一个人过，真是孤零零。
examples.english_sentence: Spending Christmas alone is really lonely.

english_meaning: utterly alone; solitary; all by one's lonesome
explanation_mandarin: 形容孤零零一个人，非常孤独的样子。
explanation_english: Describes being utterly alone, feeling extremely lonely and isolated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢走咗之後，佢就一直形單隻影，好淒涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 jat1 zik6 ying4 daan1 jek3 ying2, hou2 cai1 leong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他走了以后，他就一直孤单一人，很凄凉。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he left, he has been utterly alone, it's very desolate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔慣一個人形單隻影噉過節，所以今年返屋企同屋企人一齊過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 gwaan3 jat1 go3 jan4 ying4 daan1 jek3 ying2 gam2 gwo3 zit3, so2 ji5 gam1 nin4 faan1 uk1 kei2 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 jat1 cai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不习惯一个人孤单地过节，所以今年回家和家人一起过。
examples.english_sentence: He's not used to spending holidays alone, so he's going home this year to spend them with his family.

english_meaning: to describe, to depict, to portray
explanation_mandarin: 用语言文字描绘、描写事物的形状、性质、特征等。
explanation_english: To describe or depict something, usually with words, focusing on its shape, nature, characteristics, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好難形容個情況，因為實在太混亂喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 naan4 jing4 jung4 go3 ching4 fong3, yan1 wai6 sat6 zoi6 taai3 wan6 lyun6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很难形容当时的情况，因为实在太混乱了。
examples.english_sentence: It was hard for him to describe the situation because it was too chaotic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫形容得呢個風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 jing4 jung4 dak1 ni1 go3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画把这个风景描绘得很美。
examples.english_sentence: This painting depicts the scenery beautifully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知點樣形容我依家嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 yeung2 jing4 jung4 ngo5 ji1 gaa1 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道怎么形容我现在的心情。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to describe my current feelings.

english_meaning: adjective
explanation_mandarin: 描述事物性质、状态的词语。
explanation_english: A word or phrase naming an attribute, added to or grammatically related to a noun to modify or describe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「大」同「細」都係形容詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 tung4 sai3 dou1 hai6 jing4 yung4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「大」和「小」都是形容词。
examples.english_sentence: "Big" and "small" are both adjectives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字係形容詞定動詞啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 hai6 jing4 yung4 ci4 ding6 dung6 ci4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字是形容词还是动词啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is this word an adjective or a verb?

english_meaning: form, shape, formality, ceremony
explanation_mandarin: 外表、形式、礼节或仪式。
explanation_english: Form, shape, formality, ceremony. Often refers to the outward appearance of something rather than its substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢只係得個形式，冇乜實際作用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 zi2 hai6 dak1 go3 ying4 sik1, mou5 mat1 sat6 zai3 zok3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西只是形式，没有什么实际作用。
examples.english_sentence: These things are just for show; they don't have much practical use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好咁注重形式，最緊要係結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 gam3 zyu3 zung6 ying4 sik1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不要太注重形式，最重要的是结果。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not focus too much on the formality; the most important thing is the result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅形式可以靈活啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 ying4 sik1 ho2 ji5 ling4 wut6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议的形式可以灵活一些。
examples.english_sentence: The format of the meeting can be more flexible.

english_meaning: all kinds of, various, a wide variety of
explanation_mandarin: 形容种类很多，各式各样。
explanation_english: Describes a wide variety of things, of all kinds and descriptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅人形形色色，咩國籍都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 yan4 ying4 ying4 sik1 sik1, me1 gwok3籍 dou1 yau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的人各种各样，什么国籍都有。
examples.english_sentence: The people here are all kinds, with all sorts of nationalities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個形形色色嘅城市，充滿活力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 ying4 ying4 sik1 sik1 ge3 sing4 si5, cung1 mun5 wut6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个各种各样的城市，充满活力。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a vibrant city of all kinds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣形形色色嘅糖，小朋友好鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau4 maai6 ying4 ying4 sik1 sik1 ge3 tong2, siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店卖各种各样的糖果，小朋友很喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells all kinds of sweets, kids love it.

english_meaning: inseparable, always together, like shadow and form
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常密切，无论走到哪里都在一起。
explanation_english: Describes a close relationship where people are always together and inseparable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹由細到大都形影不離嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 ying4 ying2 bat1 lei4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们姐妹俩从小到大都形影不离的。
examples.english_sentence: Those two sisters have been inseparable since they were little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好老友，成日形影不離，去邊都一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 lou5 jau5, seng4 jat6 ying4 ying2 bat1 lei4, heoi3 bin1 dou1 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是好朋友，经常形影不离，去哪里都一起。
examples.english_sentence: They are very good friends and are always inseparable, going everywhere together.

english_meaning: form, shape, pattern, appearance
explanation_mandarin: 事物所呈现出来的形状、形式或状态。
explanation_english: The shape, form, pattern, or appearance of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個病毒變咗幾種形態啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng6 duk6 bin3 zo2 gei2 zung2 hing4 taai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个病毒已经变异成几种形态了。
examples.english_sentence: This virus has mutated into several forms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺出唔同嘅形態嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 chut1 m4 tung4 ge3 hing4 taai3 lai4 ying2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆出不同的姿势来拍照。
examples.english_sentence: He strikes different poses for the photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司嘅組織形態好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zou2 zik1 hing4 taai3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司的组织形式非常复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The organizational structure of that company is very complex.

english_meaning: to form; to take shape; to come into being
explanation_mandarin: 指逐渐发展成为某种状态或形状。
explanation_english: To come into existence; to take shape; to develop into a particular state or form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條隊喺短時間裏面形成咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 deoi2 hai2 dyun2 si4 gaan3 leoi5 min6 ying4 sing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 队伍在短时间内形成了。
examples.english_sentence: The queue formed in a short period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個習慣係慢慢形成嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaap6 gwaan3 hai6 maan6 maan2 ying4 sing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个习惯是慢慢形成的。
examples.english_sentence: This habit was gradually formed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅友誼係經過好多事之後先至形成嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 jau5 ji5 hai6 ging1 gwo3 hou2 do1 si6 zi1 hau6 sin1 zi3 ying4 sing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的友谊是经过很多事之后才形成的。
examples.english_sentence: Their friendship was formed after going through many things.

english_meaning: shape, form
explanation_mandarin: 指物体呈现出来的外部轮廓、样子。
explanation_english: Refers to the external outline or appearance of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個餅乾嘅形狀好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng2 gan1 ge3 ying4 zong6 hou2 dak1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个饼干的形状很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: The shape of this biscuit is very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雲嘅形狀千變萬化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wan4 ge3 ying4 zong6 chin1 bin3 maan6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 云的形状千变万化。
examples.english_sentence: The shapes of the clouds are ever-changing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用模具整咗好多唔同形狀嘅蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 yung6 mou4 geui6 jing2 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ying4 zong6 ge3 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用模具做了很多不同形状的蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: He used molds to make many cakes of different shapes.

english_meaning: Resembling in both appearance and spirit; a spitting image; perfect imitation
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某物在外形和精神上都非常相似，达到了几乎无法区分的程度。可以是模仿得非常逼真，也可以是自然生成的相似。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is extremely similar in both appearance and spirit, to the point of being almost indistinguishable. This can refer to a perfect imitation or a natural resemblance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮嗰個明星扮得形神俱似，簡直好似真嘅一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 go2 go3 ming4 sing1 baan6 dak1 jing4 san4 geoi1 ci5, gaan2 zik6 hou2 ci5 zan1 ge3 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他模仿那个明星模仿得形神兼备，简直像真的一样。
examples.english_sentence: He imitated that celebrity so well that he resembled him perfectly in both appearance and spirit, almost like the real thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩姊妹真係形神俱似，唔熟嘅人好難分得出邊個打邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 zi2 mui6 zan1 hai6 jing4 san4 geoi1 ci5, m4 suk6 ge3 jan4 hou2 naan4 fan1 dak1 ceot1 bin1 go3 daa2 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两姐妹真是形神兼备，不熟悉的人很难分得清谁是谁。
examples.english_sentence: These two sisters are really spitting images of each other; it's hard for those who don't know them well to tell them apart.

synonyms: 惟妙惟肖 (wai4 miu6 wai4 siu2)

english_meaning: semantic component (radical) of a Chinese character
explanation_mandarin: 汉字中的一种构成部分，通常表示字义的类别。
explanation_english: A component part of a Chinese character, usually indicating the category of its meaning. It is also known as a radical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「樹」字嘅形符係「木」，表示佢同樹木有關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: “syu6” zi6 ge3 jing4 fu4 hai6 “muk6”, biu2 si6 keoi5 tung4 syu6 muk6 jau5 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “树”字的形旁是“木”，表示它和树木有关。
examples.english_sentence: The semantic component of the character 'tree (樹)' is 'wood (木)', indicating that it is related to trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 識得形符可以幫助我哋更容易理解生字嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 dak1 jing4 fu4 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 ngo5 dei6 gang3 jung4 ji6 lei5 gaai2 saang1 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 认识形旁可以帮助我们更容易理解生字的意思。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing semantic components can help us understand the meaning of new characters more easily.

english_meaning: metaphysical, abstract, philosophical
explanation_mandarin: 指抽象的、哲学的，超越感官经验的。
explanation_english: Refers to something abstract, philosophical, and beyond sensory experience. Often used in the context of metaphysics or deep thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題太形而上喇，我諗唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 taai3 jing4 ji4 soeng6 laa3, ngo5 lam2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题太形而上了，我想不明白。
examples.english_sentence: This question is too metaphysical, I can't figure it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗啲形而上嘅嘢，好似人生嘅意義咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lam2 di1 jing4 ji4 soeng6 ge3 ye5, hou2 ci5 jan4 sang1 ge3 ji3 yi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想一些形而上的东西，比如人生的意义。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks about metaphysical things, like the meaning of life.

english_meaning: pictophonetic character (Chinese character formed by combining a radical that gives a general meaning with a phonetic component that gives a pronunciation clue)
explanation_mandarin: 汉字的一种构造方式，由表示意义的形旁和表示读音的声旁组成。
explanation_english: A type of Chinese character construction in which the character is composed of a semantic radical (showing the meaning) and a phonetic component (giving a pronunciation clue).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大部分嘅中文字都係形聲字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 bou6 fan6 ge3 zung1 man4 zi6 dou1 hai6 jing4 seng1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大部分的汉字都是形声字。
examples.english_sentence: Most Chinese characters are pictophonetic characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「媽」字就係一個形聲字，女字邊代表意思，馬字代表讀音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa1 zi6 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 jing4 seng1 zi6, neoi5 zi6 bin1 doi6 biu2 ji3 si1, maa5 zi6 doi6 biu2 duk6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “妈”字就是一个形声字，女字旁代表意思，马字代表读音。
examples.english_sentence: The character "媽" (mother) is a pictophonetic character; the 'female' radical represents the meaning, and the component '馬' represents the pronunciation.

english_meaning: image; figure; form; appearance; impression
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物的外在表现，给人留下的印象。
explanation_english: Refers to the outward appearance or presentation of a person or thing, and the impression it leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重自己嘅形象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 jing4 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很注重自己的形象。
examples.english_sentence: He pays a lot of attention to his image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個牌子嘅形象好好，所以好多人都買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 jing4 zoeng6 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个牌子的形象很好，所以很多人都买。
examples.english_sentence: This brand has a very good image, so many people buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想改變自己喺人哋心目中嘅形象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 goi2 bin3 zi6 gei2 hai2 jan4 dei6 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 jing4 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想改变自己在别人心目中的形象。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to change the image he has in other people's minds.

english_meaning: to visualize, to make concrete, to illustrate, to personify
explanation_mandarin: 使抽象的事物变得具体、形象，容易理解。
explanation_english: To make something abstract or intangible concrete, vivid, and easy to understand through imagery, examples, or other means of representation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多例子去形象化個概念，令我哋容易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 lai6 zi2 heoi3 ying6 zoeng6 faa3 go3 koi3 nim6, ling6 ngo5 dei6 yung4 yi6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了许多例子去形象化这个概念，让我们容易明白。
examples.english_sentence: He used many examples to visualize the concept, making it easy for us to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將數據形象化，先可以俾老闆睇到有幾嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yiu3 zoeng1 sou3 geoi3 ying6 zoeng6 faa3, sin1 ho2 yi5 bei2 lou5 baan2 tai2 dou3 yau5 gei2 yim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要将数据形象化，才可以让老板看到有多严重。
examples.english_sentence: We need to visualize the data so that the boss can see how serious it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演嘗試將主角嘅內心掙扎形象化，通過一啲特別嘅視覺效果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jeng2 caang4 si3 zoeng1 zyu2 gok3 ge3 noi6 sam1 jaang1 zaat3 ying6 zoeng6 faa3, tung1 gwo3 yat1 di1 dak6 bit6 ge3 si6 gok3 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 导演尝试将主角的内心挣扎形象化，通过一些特别的视觉效果。
examples.english_sentence: The director tried to visualize the protagonist's inner struggle through some special visual effects.

english_meaning: vanity project; image project; showpiece project
explanation_mandarin: 指为了树立良好形象而兴建的、通常带有粉饰性质的工程项目。往往注重外表，忽略实际效益，甚至劳民伤财。
explanation_english: Refers to a project that is built primarily to create a positive image, often characterized by superficiality and prioritizing appearance over practical benefits. It can be wasteful and burdensome to the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起咁大嘅廣場，根本就係個形象工程嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 gam3 daai6 ge3 gwong2 coeng4, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 go3 jing4 zoeng6 gung1 cing4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 建这么大的广场，根本就是一个形象工程。
examples.english_sentence: Building such a huge plaza is just a vanity project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府成日搞啲形象工程，但係民生問題又唔解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 sing4 jat6 gaau2 di1 jing4 zoeng6 gung1 cing4, daan6 hai6 man4 sang1 man6 tai4 jau6 m4 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府总是搞些形象工程，但是民生问题又不解决。
examples.english_sentence: The government is always launching vanity projects, but doesn't solve livelihood issues.

english_meaning: suspicious, acting suspiciously, questionable behavior
explanation_mandarin: 指行为举止让人觉得可疑，不正常。
explanation_english: Describes behavior or actions that are suspicious and raise doubts or concerns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺銀行門口行嚟行去，形跡可疑，我諗我哋應該報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngan4 hong4 mun4 hau2 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3, jing4 jik1 ho2 ji4, ngo5 lam2 ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在银行门口走来走去，形迹可疑，我想我们应该报警。
examples.english_sentence: He was pacing back and forth in front of the bank, acting suspiciously, I think we should call the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個男人鬼鬼祟祟，形跡可疑，好似想偷嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 naam4 yan2 gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6, jing4 jik1 ho2 ji4, hou2 ci5 soeng2 tau1 ye5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男人鬼鬼祟祟的，行迹可疑，好像想要偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: That man is acting sneaky and suspicious, like he wants to steal something.

english_meaning: physical form; body
explanation_mandarin: 指人的身体或物体的外形。
explanation_english: Refers to the physical form of a person or the outward appearance of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅形體好健碩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jing4 tai2 hou2 gin6 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的形体很健壮。
examples.english_sentence: His physical form is very robust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個雕塑嘅形體好優美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 diu1 sok3 ge3 jing4 tai2 hou2 jau1 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个雕塑的形体很优美。
examples.english_sentence: The physical form of this sculpture is very beautiful.

english_meaning: red, vermilion
explanation_mandarin: 指红色。常用于描述颜色，尤其是鲜艳的红色。
explanation_english: Refers to the color red, especially a bright, vivid red. Often used to describe colors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅天空好似染咗一層彤雲咁，好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 tin1 hung1 hou2 ci5 jim5 zo2 jat1 cang4 tung4 wan4 gam2, hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的天空好像染上了一层红霞，很漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: Today's sky looks like it's dyed with a layer of red clouds, it's so beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫係鮮彤色嘅，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 hai6 sin1 tung4 sik1 ge3, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服是鲜红色的，很吸引眼球。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are bright red, very eye-catching.

english_meaning: Accomplished, talented person; scholar
explanation_mandarin: 指有才学、有德行的人。通常用于人名。
explanation_english: Refers to a person of talent and virtue. Usually used in names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名有個「彥」字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ming2 jau5 go3 "ngaan6" zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名字里有个“彥”字。
examples.english_sentence: His name has the character "彥" in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位才彥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 coi4 ngaan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位才彦。
examples.english_sentence: He is a talented person.

english_meaning: to pay attention to; to heed; to bother with
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，表示理睬、关注、在意，通常用于否定句，表示不理睬或不在乎。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it means to pay attention to, to heed, or to bother with. It's usually used in negative sentences to express not caring or ignoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我都唔彩佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 m4 coi2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我才不理他呢。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not going to bother with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講乜嘢都冇人彩佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 mat1 je5 dou1 mou5 jan4 coi2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说什么都没人理他。
examples.english_sentence: No one pays attention to what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好彩佢哋啦，佢哋講嘢好衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 coi2 keoi5 dei6 laa1, keoi5 dei6 gong2 je5 hou2 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别理他们啦，他们说话很难听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay attention to them, they say nasty things.

english_meaning: lottery ticket
explanation_mandarin: 一种有机会通过抽奖获得奖金的票据。
explanation_english: A ticket that offers a chance to win a prize through a lottery draw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張彩券，希望中頭獎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 coi2 gyun3, hei1 mong6 zung1 tau4 zoeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一张彩票，希望中头奖！
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lottery ticket, I hope I win the first prize!

english_meaning: color printing
explanation_mandarin: 指用彩色油墨进行印刷。
explanation_english: Printing using colored inks, resulting in a colored image or text.

explanation_english: Noun: shadow. Verb: to take a photo; to film or shoot.

explanation_english: A visual representation of something; a picture or likeness obtained by photography, television, or other means.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台复印机坏了，用不了。
examples.english_sentence: This photocopier is broken and cannot be used.

english_meaning: photocopy, duplicate, copy
explanation_mandarin: 通过影印技术复制的文件或物品。
explanation_english: A copy of a document or item made using a photocopying machine.

explanation_english: A machine for making copies of documents.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 jing2 jan3 gei1 waai6 zo2, yung6 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台复印机坏了，用不了了。
examples.english_sentence: This photocopier is broken, we can't use it.

examples.english_sentence: I need to use the photocopier to copy some documents.

english_meaning: Photography enthusiast, photographer (friend)
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢摄影的朋友或摄影爱好者。
explanation_english: Refers to friends who enjoy photography or photography enthusiasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成班影友禮拜六會去郊外影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 baan1 jing2 jau5 lai5 baai3 luk6 wui5 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 ying2 soeng2.

examples.english_sentence: Our group of photography enthusiasts will go to the countryside to take pictures on Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅影友，我哋成日一齊去影雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 jing2 jau5, ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 ying2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我的摄影朋友，我们经常一起去拍鸟。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my photography friend, we often go birdwatching together.

english_meaning: Movie queen, Best Actress (award title)
explanation_mandarin: 指电影界的女演员，尤其是指获得最佳女主角奖的女演员。
explanation_english: Refers to a female actress in the film industry, especially one who has won the Best Actress award.

examples.english_sentence: She won the Best Actress award at the Hong Kong Film Awards this year.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 jing2 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一直都是我心目中的影后。
examples.english_sentence: She has always been my Best Actress in my mind.

english_meaning: film industry, entertainment circle
explanation_mandarin: 指电影制作及相关的行业，包括演员、导演、制片人等。
explanation_english: Refers to the film industry and related fields, including actors, directors, producers, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想入影圈發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jap6 jing2 hyun1 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想进入电影界发展。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to develop his career in the film industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影圈嘅競爭好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing2 hyun1 ge3 ging6 zang1 hou2 daai6.

examples.english_sentence: The competition in the film industry is very fierce.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影界很有名。
examples.english_sentence: He is very famous in the film industry.

english_meaning: the film industry, the movie world
explanation_mandarin: 指电影界，电影行业。
explanation_english: Refers to the film industry, the movie world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺影壇好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jing2 taan4 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影界很有名。
examples.english_sentence: He is very famous in the film industry.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想加入电影界，但是竞争很大。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to join the film industry, but the competition is fierce.

english_meaning: shadow
explanation_mandarin: 物体挡住光线时，在光线照射不到的地方出现的黑暗形象。
explanation_english: A dark image cast by an object blocking light.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 taai3 joeng4 dai2 haa6 haang4, dei6 haa2 jau5 tiu4 coeng4 coeng4 ge3 jing2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在太阳底下走，地上有长长的影子。
examples.english_sentence: We're walking under the sun, and there's a long shadow on the ground.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 daai6 lou2 ge3 jing2 zi2 gam2, seng4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 keoi5.

explanation_mandarin: 用含蓄或隐晦的方式暗示或暗指。
explanation_english: To allude to someone or something indirectly, often in a critical or suggestive manner. It involves making a veiled reference without explicitly stating the target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢好明顯係影射緊老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3嘢好hau2 ming4 hin2係jing2 se6 gan2 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很明显是在影射老板。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was clearly alluding to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度影射人哋，有咩直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 jing2 se6 jan4 dei6, jau5 me1 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里影射别人，有什么直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make veiled references to people here, just say what you have to say directly.

examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie seems to allude to some social phenomena.

english_meaning: film festival; photo exhibition

english_meaning: Movie emperor; Best actor; master of acting; a very good actor; (derogatory) someone who is very good at faking or exaggerating emotions

explanation_english: Originally refers to the best actor in the film industry, someone who has won the Best Actor award. Now, it is also used to describe someone who is very good at acting, a master of acting. Sometimes, it has a derogatory meaning, referring to someone who is very good at pretending or putting on an act for others.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 ying2 daai2 waa2 zat1 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前录像带的画质不是那么好的。

english_meaning: to take passport photos; to take a quick photo (usually for official documents or IDs)

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一台新的影碟机。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new DVD player.

english_meaning: Candlestick chart; price chart
explanation_mandarin: 指股市中用来表示一段时间内股票价格变化的K线图。K线图由实体和影线组成，影线代表最高价和最低价。
explanation_english: Refers to the candlestick chart used in the stock market to represent the price changes of a stock within a certain period. A candlestick chart consists of a body and shadows (wicks/tails). The shadows represent the highest and lowest prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇影綫就知呢隻股票升定跌啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jing2 sin3 zau6 zi1 ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 sing1 ding6 dit3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看K线图就知道这只股票是涨还是跌了。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at the candlestick chart, you can tell whether this stock is going to rise or fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識睇影綫，所以唔敢炒股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 tai2 jing2 sin3, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 caau2 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不懂看K线图，所以不敢炒股票。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to read candlestick charts, so I don't dare to speculate on stocks.

english_meaning: Shadow line (in stock market charts, referring to the upper or lower shadow of a candlestick)
explanation_mandarin: 在股票或金融市场的K线图上，影线指的是从实体（蜡烛图的主体）向上或向下延伸的细线，分别代表了价格在一段时间内的最高价和最低价。上影线代表最高价，下影线代表最低价。
explanation_english: In stock market charts (specifically candlestick charts), a shadow line refers to the thin line extending upwards or downwards from the body (the main part of the candlestick). The upper shadow indicates the highest price reached during that period, and the lower shadow indicates the lowest price reached.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇返個圖，條影線咁長，證明嗰陣時嘅波動好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 faan1 go3 tou4, tiu4 jing2 sin3 gam3 coeng4, zing3 ming4 go2 zan6 si4 ge3 bo1 dung6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看回那张图，影线那么长，证明那时波动很大。
examples.english_sentence: Looking back at the chart, the shadow line is so long, proving that the volatility was very high at that time.

english_meaning: Performing arts (especially film and television)
explanation_mandarin: 指电影和电视等表演艺术。
explanation_english: Refers to performing arts such as film and television.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對影藝事業好有熱誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 jing2 ngai6 si6 jip6 hou2 jau5 jit6 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对影视艺术事业很有热情。
examples.english_sentence: He is very passionate about the performing arts, especially film and television.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅影藝界曾經好輝煌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jing2 ngai6 gaai3 cang4 ging1 hou2 fai1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的影视艺术界曾经很辉煌。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's film and television industry was once very glorious.

mandarin_meaning: 丢脸; 丢人; 影响声誉
english_meaning: To bring shame on; to embarrass; to disgrace; to tarnish the reputation of
explanation_mandarin: 指做了不光彩的事情，使自己或他人蒙羞，影响声誉。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something disgraceful that brings shame upon oneself or others, tarnishing their reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再咁做啦，影衰晒我哋成家人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gam2 zou6 laa1, jing2 seoi1晒 ngo5 dei6 seng4 gaa1 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再这样做了，给我们全家丢尽了脸！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that anymore, you're bringing shame on our whole family!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做真係影衰晒香港人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 jing2 seoi1晒 hoeng1 gong2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做真是给香港人丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: The way he did that really brought shame on Hong Kong people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔收口，小心影衰公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 sau1 hau2, siu2 sam1 jing2 seoi1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不闭嘴，小心影响公司的声誉。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't shut up, be careful you don't tarnish the company's reputation.

english_meaning: film and television
explanation_mandarin: 指电影和电视的总称，也包括相关的行业和活动。
explanation_english: A general term referring to movies and television, including related industries and activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅影視業曾經好輝煌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jing2 si6 jip6 cang4 ging1 hou2 fai1 wong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的影视业曾经非常辉煌。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's film and television industry used to be very prosperous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對影視製作好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 jing2 si6 zai3 zok3 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对影视制作很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in film and television production.

english_meaning: film review, movie review
explanation_mandarin: 对电影的评论文章，通常包括对电影的评价、分析和解读。
explanation_english: A critical review of a film, usually including an evaluation, analysis, and interpretation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇完套戲之後，好想睇下啲影評，睇下其他人點睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 yun4 tou3 hei3 zi1 hau6, hou2 soeng2 tai2 haa5 di1 jing2 ping3, tai2 haa5 kei4 taa1 jan4 dim2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看完这部电影后，很想看看影评，看看其他人怎么看。
examples.english_sentence: After watching the movie, I really want to read some film reviews to see what other people think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇影評寫得好深入，分析得好透徹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 jing2 ping3 se2 dak1 hou2 sam1 yap6, fan1 sik1 dak1 hou2 tau3 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇影评写得很深入，分析得很透彻。
examples.english_sentence: This film review is very insightful and the analysis is very thorough.

english_meaning: movie fan, film enthusiast
explanation_mandarin: 指非常喜欢看电影，对电影有浓厚兴趣的人。
explanation_english: A person who is a devoted fan of movies or films.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係周星馳嘅影迷，佢嘅戲佢都睇過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zau1 sing1 ci4 ge3 jing2 mai4, keoi5 ge3 hei3 keoi5 dou1 tai2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是周星驰的影迷，他的电影他都看过。
examples.english_sentence: He is a movie fan of Stephen Chow, and he has watched all of his movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多影迷為咗見偶像一面，專登去咗首映禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jing2 mai4 wai6 zo2 gin3 ngau5 zoeng2 jat1 min6, zyun1 dang3 heoi3 zo2 sau2 jing2 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多影迷为了见偶像一面，特地去了首映礼。
examples.english_sentence: Many movie fans went to the premiere specifically to see their idols.

english_meaning: Not a trace; not a sign; nowhere to be seen
explanation_mandarin: 形容完全消失，一点痕迹都没有。通常表示人或物完全不见了踪影。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that has completely disappeared without a trace. It implies that there is absolutely no sign of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等咗佢成個鐘，影都冇隻！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 zo2 keoi5 seng4 go3 zung1, jing2 dou1 mou5 zek3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等了他一个小时，连影子都没看到！
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for him for an hour, but he's nowhere to be seen!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份功課一交，佢就影都冇隻，唔知去咗邊度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 fo3 jat1 gaau1, keoi5 zau6 jing2 dou1 mou5 zek3, m4 zi1 heoi3 zo2 bin1 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一交完作业，他就消失得无影无踪，不知道去哪里玩了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he handed in his homework, he disappeared without a trace, I wonder where he went to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報警之後，嗰班賊仔就影都冇隻，唔知走咗去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 ging2 zi1 hau6, go2 baan1 caak6 zai2 zau6 jing2 dou1 mou5 zek3, m4 zi1 zau2 zo2 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报警之后，那班贼就消失得无影无踪，不知道跑到哪里去了。
examples.english_sentence: After the police were called, the thieves disappeared without a trace, I wonder where they ran off to.

english_meaning: cinema, movie theater
explanation_mandarin: 放映电影的场所。
explanation_english: A place where movies are shown to a paying audience; a cinema or movie theater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去影院睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 jing2 yun2 tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去电影院看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the cinema to watch a movie tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間影院嘅座位好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jing2 yun2 ge3 zo6 wai2 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家电影院的座位很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The seats in this cinema are very comfortable.

english_meaning: Audio-visual; audiovisual
explanation_mandarin: 指同时包含影像和声音的媒体形式，例如电影、电视节目、录像带等。
explanation_english: Refers to media formats that simultaneously contain images and sound, such as movies, television programs, videotapes, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意睇影音，得閒就睇吓戲或者聽吓歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 jing2 jam1, dak1 haan4 zau6 tai2 haa5 hei3 waak6 ze2 teng1 haa5 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢看影音，有空的时候就看看电影或者听听歌。
examples.english_sentence: I really like watching audio-visual content. I watch movies or listen to music when I have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部影音設備好先進，可以提供高品質嘅聲畫體驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 jing2 jam1 sai3 bei6 hou2 sin1 zeon3, ho2 ji5 tai4 gung1 gou1 pan2 zat1 ge3 seng1 waa2 tai2 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这套影音设备很先进，可以提供高品质的声画体验。
examples.english_sentence: This audio-visual equipment is very advanced and can provide a high-quality audio and visual experience.

english_meaning: Audio-visual equipment
explanation_mandarin: 指用于观看和收听的设备，包括电视、音响、投影仪等。
explanation_english: Refers to equipment used for viewing and listening, including televisions, audio systems, projectors, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年upgrade咗啲影音器材，開會presentation都方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 upgrade zo2 di1 jing2 jam1 hei3 coi4, hoi1 wui2 presentation dou1 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年升级了一些影音设备，开会做演示方便多了。
examples.english_sentence: Our company upgraded some of its audio-visual equipment this year, making presentations in meetings much easier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企間home theater真係好正，啲影音器材全部都係頂級嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 gaan1 home theater zan1 hai6 hou2 zeng3, di1 jing2 jam1 hei3 coi4 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ding2 kap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家里的家庭影院真的很棒，那些影音设备全部都是顶级的。
examples.english_sentence: His home theater is really great, all the audio-visual equipment is top-notch.

english_meaning: influence, affect, impact
explanation_mandarin: 动词：对人或事物产生作用；名词：起作用或有作用的力量。
explanation_english: Verb: To have an effect on someone or something. Noun: The power to have an effect on people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事對我哋公司嘅影響好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事对我们公司的影响很大。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has a big impact on our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意見影響咗我嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yi3 gin3 jing2 hoeng2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意见影响了我的决定。
examples.english_sentence: His opinion influenced my decision.

english_meaning: influence, impact
explanation_mandarin: 指对他人或事物产生作用或改变的力量。
explanation_english: The power to have an effect on someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅影響力好大，好多決策都要問過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 hou2 daai6, hou2 do1 kyut3 chaak3 dou1 jiu3 man6 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的影响力很大，很多决策都要问过他。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of influence in the company; many decisions need to be consulted with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電影對年輕人嘅影響力好深遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 ying2 deoi3 nin4 hing1 yan4 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 hou2 sam1 yun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影对年轻人的影响力很深远。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has a profound influence on young people.

english_meaning: Walk slowly, take small steps
explanation_mandarin: 形容慢步行走的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the manner of walking slowly, taking small steps. Often used as part of a radical (亻) in Chinese characters, representing a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢彳彳亍亍行咗入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cek1 cek1 cuk1 cuk1 haang4 zo2 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他慢慢吞吞地走了进来。
examples.english_sentence: He walked in slowly and hesitantly.

english_meaning: to pace back and forth; to hesitate; to waver; to dawdle
explanation_mandarin: 形容来回走动，缓慢行走，或者犹豫不决，举棋不定。
explanation_english: Describes walking back and forth, moving slowly, or hesitating and being indecisive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條街度彳亍咗好耐，好似諗緊啲乜嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 cik1 cuk1 zo2 hou2 noi6, hou2 ci5 lam2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上徘徊了很久，好像在想些什么。
examples.english_sentence: He paced back and forth on the street for a long time, as if he were thinking about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再喺度彳亍啦，快啲決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 cik1 cuk1 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再犹豫了，快点决定吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hesitate any longer, make a decision quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 慢吞吞地转圈; 徘徊
english_meaning: To walk around slowly and aimlessly; to dawdle; to meander
explanation_mandarin: 形容缓慢、犹豫地转动或走动，多指心神不定或无所事事的状态。
explanation_english: Describes moving or walking around slowly and hesitantly, often suggesting a state of being unsettled or aimless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條街度彳亍咁轉，好似有啲心事噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 cik1 cuk1 gam2 zyun3, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 sam1 si6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上慢吞吞地转，好像有什么心事一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's walking around slowly on the street, as if he has something on his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度彳亍咁轉啦，快啲決定去邊度啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 cik1 cuk1 gam2 zyun3 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里慢吞吞地转圈了，快点决定去哪里吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle around here, quickly decide where to go!

english_meaning: To wander around slowly; to pace back and forth aimlessly
explanation_mandarin: 形容慢吞吞地、没有目的地地走动或旋转。 "彳亍" 本身就有慢步行走的意思，加上 "噉轉" 强调缓慢旋转或来回走动。
explanation_english: Describes walking or rotating slowly and aimlessly. "彳亍" itself implies walking slowly, and adding "噉轉" emphasizes slow rotation or walking back and forth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房入邊彳亍噉轉，好似諗緊啲乜嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 jap6 bin1 cik1 cik1 gam2 zyun3, hou2 ci5 lam2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房间里慢吞吞地走来走去，好像在想些什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was pacing back and forth in the room, as if he was thinking about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部風扇壞咗， 葉都淨係彳亍噉轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 fung1 sin3 waai6 zo2, jip6 dou1 zing6 hai6 cik1 cik1 gam2 zyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这风扇坏了，叶子都只是慢吞吞地转动。
examples.english_sentence: The fan is broken, the blades are only turning slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度彳亍噉轉啦，阻住嗮！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 cik1 cik1 gam2 zyun3 laa1, zo2 zyu6 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里慢吞吞地走来走去了，挡住路了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't wander around here slowly, you're blocking the way!

english_meaning: as if, seemingly, resembles
explanation_mandarin: 表示好像，類似；也用作副詞，表示大約，似乎。
explanation_english: Indicates resemblance or similarity; also used as an adverb meaning approximately or seemingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅語氣彷彿好唔耐煩噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 jyu5 hei3 fong2 fat1 hou2 m4 noi6 faan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的语气好像很不耐烦的样子。
examples.english_sentence: The tone of his voice seemed very impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅樣彷彿有啲似佢阿爸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 joeng2 fong2 fat1 jau5 di1 ci5 keoi5 aa3 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子似乎有点像他爸爸。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to resemble his father somewhat.

english_meaning: seemingly; as if; similar
explanation_mandarin: 似乎；好像；有点像。
explanation_english: Indicates a resemblance or similarity; as if; seemingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似病咗咁，面色彷彿有啲唔妥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 beng6 zo2 gam2, min6 sik1 pong4 fat1 jau5 di1 m4 to2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像生病了，脸色似乎有点不对劲。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be sick; his complexion looks a bit off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我哋住嘅地方彷彿天堂咁靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 zyu6 ge3 dei6 fong1 pong4 fat1 tin1 tong4 gam3 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我们住的地方仿佛天堂般美丽。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, the place we lived was as beautiful as if it were paradise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容彷彿仲喺眼前，好似啱啱先見過佢噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 pong4 fat1 zung6 hai2 ngaan5 cin4, hou2 ci5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sin1 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容仿佛还在眼前，好像刚刚才见过他一样。
examples.english_sentence: His smile is still vivid in my mind, as if I just saw him.

english_meaning: labor; service; military service; campaign (military)
explanation_mandarin: 指强迫劳动、服兵役，或者指较大规模的军事行动。
explanation_english: Refers to forced labor, military service, or a large-scale military operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被逼去服役，好唔開心啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 bik1 heoi3 fuk6 jik6, hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被迫去服兵役，很不开心啊。
examples.english_sentence: He was forced to do military service and is very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場戰役傷亡慘重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 zin3 jik6 soeng1 mong4 caam2 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场战役伤亡惨重。
