explanation_english: A polite expression used to indicate that the other person is in the same situation or has the same qualities as oneself. It's often used in response to a compliment or expression of gratitude, suggesting that both parties are equally (adjective) or have made similar contributions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再激嬲佢啦，唔係佢會往死裏打你㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gik1 nau1 keoi5 laa1, m4 hai6 keoi5 wui5 wong5 sei2 lei5 daa2 nei5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再惹他生气了，不然他会往死里打你的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, or he'll beat the living daylights out of you!

mandarin_meaning: 往死里打; 狠狠地打; 痛打
english_meaning: To beat someone to death; to beat someone severely; to give someone a good thrashing
explanation_mandarin: 指非常狠地打某人，通常带有极强的愤怒和暴力倾向。结果可能导致对方重伤甚至死亡。
explanation_english: Refers to beating someone very harshly, usually with intense anger and violent intent. The result may lead to serious injury or even death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷咗我錢，我梗係要往死裡打佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 zo2 ngo5 cin2, ngo5 gang2 hai6 jiu3 wong5 sei2 leoi5 daa2 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷了我的钱，我肯定要往死里打他！
examples.english_sentence: He stole my money, of course I'm going to beat him to death!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班黑社會往死裡打佢，好慘啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 hak1 se5 wui2 wong5 sei2 leoi5 daa2 keoi5, hou2 caam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群黑社会往死里打他，好惨啊！
examples.english_sentence: The gang beat him to death, it's so terrible!

synonyms: 打到飛起 (daa2 dou3 fei1 hei2)

english_meaning: to pass away, to die (often used in a Buddhist context, suggesting rebirth)
explanation_mandarin: 指去世，死亡。常带有佛教色彩，暗示着轮回转世。
explanation_english: Refers to passing away or dying. Often used in a Buddhist context, implying reincarnation or rebirth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望阿婆可以早日往生極樂世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 aa3 po4 ho2 ji5 zou2 jat6 wong5 sang1 gik1 lok6 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望奶奶能早日往生极乐世界。
examples.english_sentence: I hope grandma can soon pass away and be reborn in the Western Paradise (Sukhavati).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢想往生之後可以投胎做返人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 soeng2 wong5 sang1 zi1 hau6 ho2 ji5 tau4 taai1 zou6 faan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他想去世后可以转世再做人。
examples.english_sentence: He said that after he passes away, he hopes he can be reborn as a human again.

english_meaning: past performance; track record; previous record
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的成绩和表现。
explanation_english: Refers to past achievements and performance; a history of successes or failures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅往績好好，應該可以信賴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 wong5 zik1 hou2 hou2, ying1 goi1 ho2 ji5 seon3 laai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的往绩很好，应该可以信赖。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a good track record, so it should be reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅往績顯示佢哋唔係一個可靠嘅團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 wong5 zik1 hin2 si6 keoi5 dei6 m4 hai6 yat1 go3 ho2 kao3 ge3 tyun4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的往绩显示他们不是一个可靠的团队。
examples.english_sentence: Their past performance shows that they are not a reliable team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會根據佢哋嘅往績嚟決定係咪投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui gun1 geui3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wong5 zik1 lai4 kyut3 ding6 hai6 mai1 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会根据他们的往绩来决定是否投资。
examples.english_sentence: We will decide whether to invest based on their past performance.

english_meaning: to go to and fro; round trip; back and forth
explanation_mandarin: 指来回走动；往来。
explanation_english: Refers to going back and forth; to travel between two places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都要往返屋企同公司，好攰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 wong5 faan2 uk1 kei2 tung4 gung1 si1, hou2 gui6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要往返家和公司，很累的。
examples.english_sentence: I have to travel back and forth between home and the office every day, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買張香港往返東京嘅機票要幾錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zoeng1 hoeng1 gong2 wong5 faan2 dung1 ging1 ge3 gei1 piu3 jiu3 gei2 chin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买一张香港往返东京的机票要多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much is a round trip ticket from Hong Kong to Tokyo?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日往返中港兩地做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 wong5 faan2 zung1 gong2 loeng5 dei6 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常往返中港两地做生意。
examples.english_sentence: They often travel back and forth between mainland China and Hong Kong for business.

english_meaning: to come and go; to have dealings with; to interact
explanation_mandarin: 来往；交流；交往
explanation_english: To come and go; to have dealings or interactions with someone or something. It implies a back-and-forth movement or exchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司之間冇乜往還嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 zi1 gaan1 mou5 mat1 wong5 waan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司之间没有什么往来。
examples.english_sentence: There isn't much interaction between the two companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前我哋成日往還香港同埋澳門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 wong5 waan4 Hoeng1 Gong2 tung4 maau4 Ou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前我们经常往返香港和澳门。
examples.english_sentence: We used to travel back and forth between Hong Kong and Macau often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同個班街童冇乜往還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 go3 baan1 gaai1 tung4 mou5 mat1 wong5 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跟那些街头小孩没什么来往。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have much interaction with those street kids.

english_meaning: formerly; in the past; back then; at that time
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的一段时间，常用来回忆或比较过去与现在的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a period in the past, often used to recall or compare past and present situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 往陣時啲戲院好平㗎，幾蚊雞就睇到一套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong5 zan6 si4 di1 hei3 yun2 hou2 peng4 gaa3, gei2 man1 gai1 zau6 tai2 dou2 jat1 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的电影院很便宜，几块钱就能看一部电影。
examples.english_sentence: Back then, cinemas were very cheap, you could watch a movie for just a few dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 往陣時啲人好純樸㗎，唔似而家咁複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong5 zan6 si4 di1 jan4 hou2 seon4 pok3 gaa3, m4 ci5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过去的人很淳朴，不像现在这么复杂。
examples.english_sentence: People were very simple and honest back then, not as complicated as they are now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 往陣時我仲係個細路仔，成日周圍去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong5 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung1 hai6 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2, seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时候我还是个小孩子，整天到处玩。
examples.english_sentence: Back then I was still a kid, always running around playing.

english_meaning: to doze; to nod off; to fall asleep briefly
explanation_mandarin: 指短时间内的睡眠，通常是在不适宜睡觉的场合。也指打瞌睡的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to a short period of sleep, usually in an inappropriate place. It also refers to the state of dozing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晏晝食飽飯好易征。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan3 zau3 sik6 baau2 faan6 hou2 ji6 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下午吃饱饭很容易打瞌睡。
examples.english_sentence: It's easy to doze off after a full meal in the afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣唔好征呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 zing1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候不要打瞌睡啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't nod off during the meeting!

mandarin_meaning: 征战, 战斗, 战争
english_meaning: to battle, to fight, to go to war, campaign
explanation_mandarin: 指进行战争或战斗，也可引申为在某个领域进行竞争。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in war or battle. It can also be extended to mean competing in a certain field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋經過多年征戰，終於贏咗呢場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 zing1 zin3, zung1 jyu1 wing4 zo2 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经过多年的征战，终于赢了这场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: After years of battling, they finally won this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上，就好似一場永無休止嘅征戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 seong1 coeng4 soeng6, zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 coeng4 wing5 mou4 jau1 chi2 ge3 zing1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上，就像一场永无休止的征战。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, it's like a never-ending battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隊波一路征戰，希望可以攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 deoi2 bo1 jat1 lou6 zing1 zin3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 lo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那支球队一路征战，希望可以拿到冠军。
examples.english_sentence: That team is battling all the way, hoping to win the championship.

english_meaning: to conquer; to subdue; to subjugate; to overcome
explanation_mandarin: 用武力降伏，或用其他手段使对方屈服。也指克服困难。
explanation_english: To conquer by force; to subdue; to subjugate. Also refers to overcoming difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成功征服咗珠穆朗瑪峰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 gung1 zing1 fuk6 zo2 zyu1 muk6 long5 maa5 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们成功征服了珠穆朗玛峰。
examples.english_sentence: They successfully conquered Mount Everest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想征服所有嘅困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zing1 fuk6 so2 jau5 ge3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想征服所有的困难。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to overcome all the difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個歌手嘅歌聲征服咗好多聽眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 go1 sau2 ge3 go1 seng1 zing1 fuk6 zo2 hou2 do1 ting1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个歌手的歌声征服了很多听众。
examples.english_sentence: This singer's singing conquered many listeners.

english_meaning: to send armed forces to suppress; to attack and subdue; to go on a punitive expedition
explanation_mandarin: 指奉命或擅自出兵去讨伐。
explanation_english: Refers to sending troops, either by order or on one's own initiative, to suppress or attack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定征討嗰個壓榨百姓嘅惡霸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zing1 tou2 go2 go3 aat3 zaai3 baak3 sing3 ge3 ok3 baa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定征讨那个压榨百姓的恶霸。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to launch a punitive expedition against the tyrant who was oppressing the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代皇帝經常會派兵去征討四方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 wong4 dai3 ging1 seung4 wui5 paai3 bing1 heoi3 zing1 tou2 sei3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代皇帝经常会派兵去征讨四方。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient emperors often sent troops to launch expeditions in all directions.

english_meaning: to requisition; to commandeer; to mobilize; to transfer
explanation_mandarin: 指官方或组织为特定目的而临时调用人力、物力。
explanation_english: Refers to the temporary mobilization of manpower or resources by the government or an organization for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府征調咗好多醫護人員去幫手抗疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing1 diu6 zo2 hou2 do1 ji1 wu6 yan4 yun4 heoi3 bong1 sau2 kong3 yik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府征调了很多医护人员去帮忙抗疫。
examples.english_sentence: The government requisitioned many medical personnel to help fight the epidemic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被公司征調咗去北京做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 gung1 si1 zing1 diu6 zo2 heoi3 bak1 ging1 zou6嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被公司调到北京工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He was transferred to Beijing by the company to work.

english_meaning: to go; to proceed; to pass away (time)
explanation_mandarin: 文言词，表示前往，过去，到达等意思。现在口语中较少单独使用，多见于成语或书面语。
explanation_english: A literary word meaning to go, to proceed, to pass away (referring to time). It is rarely used alone in spoken Cantonese nowadays, mostly found in idioms or written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光陰似箭，日月如徂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 jam1 ci5 zin3, jat6 jyut6 jyu4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光阴似箭，日月如梭。
examples.english_sentence: Time flies like an arrow; days and months pass swiftly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最終都係徂咗去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 hai6 ceoi4 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最终还是去了国外。
examples.english_sentence: They eventually went abroad.

mandarin_meaning: 等待; 待遇; 对待
english_meaning: to wait; to treat; treatment; to deal with; stay
explanation_mandarin: （动）等待；（动）对待，待遇；（名）等待
explanation_english: (verb) to wait; (verb) to treat, deal with; (noun) treatment, how someone is dealt with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣先，我仲有啲嘢待辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 sin1, ngo5 zung2 jau5 di1 je5 doi6 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下，我还有一些事情待办。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment, I still have some things to be dealt with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對我嘅招待好好，真係唔話得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 ziu1 doi6 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 m4 waa6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对我的招待很好，真是没话说。
examples.english_sentence: Their treatment of me was very good, I can't complain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度待咗成個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 doi6 zo2 seng4 go3 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这里待了一整个星期。
examples.english_sentence: I stayed here for a whole week.

english_meaning: to treat people and handle affairs; social interaction and etiquette
explanation_mandarin: 指对待他人和处理事务的方式方法，包含人际交往和礼仪方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the way one treats people and handles affairs, encompassing interpersonal skills and etiquette. It emphasizes the importance of proper conduct in social interactions and how one deals with situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢待人接物好有禮貌，所以好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 jan4 zip3 mat6 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6, so2 ji5 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他待人处事很有礼貌，所以很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He is very polite in his interactions, so he is very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要識得待人接物，咁先至會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 sik1 dak1 doi6 jan4 zip3 mat6, gam2 sin1 zi3 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作要懂得待人处事，这样才会成功。
examples.english_sentence: In work, you need to know how to treat people and handle affairs; only then will you succeed.

synonyms: 處世之道 (cyu2 sai3 zi1 dou6)
人情世故 (jan4 cing4 sai3 gu3)

english_meaning: the way one treats people and handles affairs; interpersonal skills and problem-solving abilities
explanation_mandarin: 指处理人际关系和处理事务的能力和方法。
explanation_english: Refers to one's ability and methods in dealing with interpersonal relationships and handling affairs. It encompasses both how one interacts with others and how one approaches tasks and situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢待人處事好成熟，好得人鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 jan4 cyu2 si6 hou2 sing4 suk6, hou2 dak1 jan4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他待人接物很成熟，很受人喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He's very mature in the way he treats people and handles things, and people like him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺職場上，待人處事嘅技巧好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6, doi6 jan4 cyu2 si6 ge3 gei2 haau2 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在职场上，待人接物的技巧很重要。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace, interpersonal skills are very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你學下點樣待人處事啦，唔好咁自私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hok6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 doi6 jan4 cyu2 si6 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 zi6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你学学怎么待人接物吧，不要这么自私。
examples.english_sentence: You should learn how to treat people and handle things, don't be so selfish.

english_meaning: to wait for the highest bidder, to hold out for a better offer, to bide one's time until an opportune moment arises
explanation_mandarin: 比喻等待好的价钱才肯出售，也比喻一个人等待好的机会才肯效力。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the act of waiting for the best possible price before selling something. Figuratively, it refers to someone waiting for the most advantageous opportunity to offer their services or talents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己好有價值，所以咪待價而沽囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 jau5 gaa3 zik6, so2 ji5 mai1 doi6 gaa3 ji4 gu1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己很有价值，所以才待价而沽嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he's valuable, so he's waiting for the best offer, that's all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔都好現實㗎，邊個開嘅條件好咪幫邊個，根本就係待價而沽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 dou1 hou2 jin6 sat6 gaa3, bin1 go3 hoi1 ge3 tiu4 gin2 hou2 mai1 bong1 bin1 go3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 doi6 gaa3 ji4 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人都很现实的，谁开出的条件好就帮谁，根本就是待价而沽。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays are very pragmatic. They help whoever offers the best conditions; it's basically just waiting for the best offer.

english_meaning: for sale; up for sale; on the market
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物正在等待出售，准备卖给买家。
explanation_english: Describes something that is available for sale and waiting to be sold to a buyer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋擺咗「待售」牌好耐喇，都冇人買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 baai2 zo2 "doi6 sau6" paai2 hou2 noi6 laa3, dou1 mou5 jan4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子挂着“待售”的牌子很久了，都没人买。
examples.english_sentence: This house has had a 'for sale' sign up for a long time, and no one has bought it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢架車都待售緊，如果有人想買就可以聯絡佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 gaa3 ce1 dou1 doi6 sau6 gan2, jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 soeng2 maai5 zau6 ho2 ji5 lyun4 lok3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的车也在待售中，如果有人想买就可以联系他。
examples.english_sentence: He said his car is also for sale, and people can contact him if they want to buy it.

english_meaning: to treat coldly; to neglect; to slight; to give someone the cold shoulder
explanation_mandarin: 指对人冷淡、招待不周到。
explanation_english: To treat someone coldly or with neglect; to fail to provide adequate hospitality or attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好待慢啲客人呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 doi6 maan6 di1 haak3 yan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别怠慢客人啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't neglect the guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似待慢咗我咁，唔同我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 doi6 maan6 zo2 ngo5 gam2, m4 tung4 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像怠慢我了，不跟我说话。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to be giving me the cold shoulder; he isn't talking to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想待慢任何一個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 doi6 maan6 jam6 ho4 jat1 go3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想怠慢任何一个人。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to neglect anyone.

english_meaning: to be investigated; to be verified; to be checked
explanation_mandarin: 等待核实、调查。指情况不明，需要进一步查证。
explanation_english: Awaiting investigation or verification; to be checked. Refers to a situation where the facts are unclear and further investigation is needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身份仲係待查，我哋要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 fan2 zung6 hai6 doi6 caa4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身份还有待查实，我们要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: His identity is still to be verified, we need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅真相仲係待查嘅狀態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2 zung6 hai6 doi6 caa4 ge3 zong6 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的真相还在待查的状态。
examples.english_sentence: The truth of this matter is still under investigation.

english_meaning: unemployed; awaiting employment; seeking employment
explanation_mandarin: 指等待就业机会，暂时没有工作。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of waiting for employment opportunities; temporarily without a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畢業之後待業咗半年，而家終於搵到份工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 doi6 jip6 zo2 bun3 nin4, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毕业后待业了半年，现在终于找到工作了。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating, he was unemployed for half a year, and now he finally found a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾年經濟唔好，好多人都待業緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 nin4 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 doi6 jip6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这几年经济不好，很多人都在待业。
examples.english_sentence: The economy hasn't been good these past few years, and many people are unemployed.

english_meaning: standby; to be on standby; waiting; on call
explanation_mandarin: 指电子设备处于准备工作状态，但并不完全运行；也指等待命令或机会。
explanation_english: Refers to an electronic device being in a state of readiness but not fully operating; also refers to waiting for orders or opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話喺待機狀態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 hai2 doi6 gei1 zong6 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话处于待机状态。
examples.english_sentence: The phone is on standby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要二十四小時待機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jiu3 ji6 sap6 sei3 siu2 si4 doi6 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生要二十四小时待命。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor has to be on call 24 hours a day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺呢度待機，等埋佢哋先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 ni1 dou6 doi6 gei1, dang2 maai4 keoi5 dei6 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在这里待机，等他们一起走。
examples.english_sentence: We have to wait here until they arrive before leaving together.

english_meaning: to await childbirth, to be in labor (before birth)
explanation_mandarin: 指孕妇临近分娩，等待生产的过程或状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the process or state of a pregnant woman nearing labor and awaiting childbirth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就嚟生得，而家喺醫院待產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 lai4 saang1 dak1, ji4 gaa1 hai2 ji1 jyun2 doi6 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她快要生了，现在在医院待产。
examples.english_sentence: She is about to give birth and is now in the hospital awaiting childbirth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經入咗產房待產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 jap6 zo2 caan2 fong4 doi6 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她已经进入产房待产。
examples.english_sentence: She has already been admitted to the labor room to await childbirth.

english_meaning: To be used, reserved (for someone in need); prepaid for someone in need
explanation_mandarin: 指预先支付费用，为需要帮助的人提供服务或物品。常见于餐饮业，顾客可以购买“待用”的餐点，留给有需要的人免费享用。
explanation_english: Refers to pre-paying for a service or item to be reserved for someone in need. Commonly seen in the food and beverage industry, where customers can purchase a "to be used" item, which will be available for someone in need to enjoy for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有「待用咖啡」計劃，你可以買多杯咖啡留俾有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 "doi6 jung6 gaa3 fe1" gai3 waak6, nei5 ho2 ji3 maai5 do1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 lau4 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅有“待用咖啡”计划，你可以多买一杯咖啡留给有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has a "suspended coffee" program. You can buy an extra cup of coffee and leave it for someone in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發起咗「待用飯盒」活動，希望可以幫助啲冇錢食飯嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 hei2 zo2 "doi6 jung6 faan6 hap2" wut6 dung6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji3 bong1 zo6 di1 mou5 cin2 sik6 faan6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发起了“待用饭盒”活动，希望可以帮助那些没钱吃饭的人。
examples.english_sentence: They launched a "suspended meal box" campaign, hoping to help people who don't have money to buy food.

english_meaning: to be continued
explanation_mandarin: 表示故事或事件尚未结束，将在之后继续。
explanation_english: Indicates that a story or event is not yet finished and will continue later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電視劇集好睇到不得了，今晚播完呢集就待續啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 si6 kek6 haau2 tai2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, gam1 maan1 bo3 jyun4 ni1 zaap6 zau6 doi6 zuk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电视剧非常好，今晚播完这集就未完待续了。
examples.english_sentence: This TV series is incredibly good. After tonight's episode, it will be continued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅故事仲有排講， 今日就講到呢度，待續啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gu3 si2 zung6 jau5 paai4 gong2, gam1 jat6 zau6 gong2 dou3 ni1 dou6, doi6 zuk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的故事还有很长的篇幅，今天就讲到这里，未完待续。
examples.english_sentence: Our story is long and we still have a lot to tell. We'll stop here for today, to be continued.

english_meaning: awaiting employment; available for hire; unemployed (but looking for work)
explanation_mandarin: 指正在等待被聘用，尚未找到工作。
explanation_english: Referring to the state of waiting to be hired; not yet employed but actively seeking employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家待聘緊，搵緊工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 doi6 pan3 gan2, wan2 gan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在待聘中，正在找工作。
examples.english_sentence: I am currently unemployed and looking for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畢業之後待聘咗幾個月，先搵到份好工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 doi6 pan3 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, sin1 wan2 dou2 fan6 hou2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毕业之后待聘了几个月，才找到一份好工作。
examples.english_sentence: He was unemployed for a few months after graduation before finding a good job.

english_meaning: to treat unfairly, to treat shabbily, to be unkind to, to maltreat
explanation_mandarin: 指给予不公平的待遇，刻薄对待。
explanation_english: To treat someone unfairly, unkindly, or with a lack of respect or consideration. It implies a lower quality or quantity of treatment than what is deserved or expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁待薄啲員工啦，佢哋好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 doi6 bok6 di1 wun4 gung1 laa1, keoi5 dei6 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么亏待员工了，他们很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat the employees so unfairly, they work very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都待薄自己，食啲嘢都好求其。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 doi6 bok6 zi6 gei2, sik6 di1 je5 dou1 hou2 kau4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是亏待自己，吃的东西都很随便。
examples.english_sentence: He always treats himself poorly, and eats anything carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得公司待薄我，人工咁低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 gung1 si1 doi6 bok6 ngo5, yan4 gung1 gam3 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得公司亏待我，工资这么低。
examples.english_sentence: I feel that the company is treating me unfairly, with such a low salary.

english_meaning: treatment; pay and perks; salary and benefits; remuneration
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人在工作或生活中所享受的报酬、福利、条件等。
explanation_english: Refers to the compensation, benefits, and conditions that a person enjoys in their work or life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工嘅待遇唔錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 daai6 jyu6 m4 co3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作的待遇不错。
examples.english_sentence: The pay and benefits for this job are pretty good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅待遇好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 jyu6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的待遇很好。
examples.english_sentence: He gets very good treatment in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得我需要更好嘅待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 hou2 ge3 daai6 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得我需要更好的待遇。
examples.english_sentence: I think I need better treatment.

english_meaning: to comply with, to accommodate, to give way to
explanation_mandarin: 顺从、迁就、迎合别人的意愿或要求。
explanation_english: To comply with, accommodate, or yield to someone else's wishes or demands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好少徇私嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 hou2 siu2 seon1 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很少徇私的。
examples.english_sentence: He rarely shows favoritism in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好徇人情啊，要公正處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon1 jan4 cing4 aa3, jiu3 gung1 zeng3 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要徇人情，要公正处理。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let personal connections influence you; handle it fairly.

mandarin_meaning: 应大众要求，按照大众要求
english_meaning: By popular demand, in response to popular requests
explanation_mandarin: 依照大多数人的要求去做。表示满足了大众的普遍需求。
explanation_english: To do something in response to popular demand; to comply with the requests of the majority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 徇眾要求，我哋決定加開多一場演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon4 zung3 jiu1 kau4, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 hoi1 do1 jat1 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 应大众要求，我们决定加开一场演唱会。
examples.english_sentence: By popular demand, we have decided to add an extra concert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影公司徇眾要求，重新上映咗經典版本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 gung1 si1 seon4 zung3 jiu1 kau4, cung4 san1 soeng5 ying2 zo2 ging1 din2 baan2 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影公司应大众要求，重新上映了经典版本。
examples.english_sentence: The film company, in response to popular demand, re-released the classic version.

mandarin_meaning: 徇私舞弊 (xùn sī wǔ bì)
english_meaning: to bend the law for personal gain; to abuse one's power for personal interests; favoritism
explanation_mandarin: 为了私人的利益而违反法律或规定。利用职权或关系为私人谋利。
explanation_english: To abuse one's power or bend the rules for personal gain or favoritism; to show partiality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日徇私，所以啲同事唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 heun1 si1, so2 ji5 di1 tung4 si6 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是徇私，所以同事们不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always bends the rules for personal gain at work, so his colleagues don't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官唔可以徇私，一定要公正審判。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 m4 ho2 ji5 heun1 si1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gung1 zeng3 sam2 pun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官不可以徇私，一定要公正审判。
examples.english_sentence: Judges cannot be partial; they must deliver a fair trial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司嘅管理層徇私，咁樣對其他員工好唔公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 cang4 heun1 si1, gam2 joeng2 deoi3 kei4 taa1 jyun4 gung1 hou2 m4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司的管理层徇私，这样对其他员工很不公平。
examples.english_sentence: If the management of a company shows favoritism, it is very unfair to other employees.

english_meaning: to comply with popular demand, due to popular demand
explanation_mandarin: 为了满足大众的要求。
explanation_english: To do something because a lot of people have asked for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 徇衆要求，我哋決定加開一場演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon4 zung3 jiu1 kau4, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 hoi1 jat1 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 应大众要求，我们决定加开一场演唱会。
examples.english_sentence: Due to popular demand, we have decided to add an extra concert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 徇衆要求，老闆終於肯加人工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon4 zung3 jiu1 kau4, lou5 baan2 zung1 jyu1 hang2 gaa1 yan4 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 应大众要求，老板终于肯加工资了。
examples.english_sentence: Due to popular demand, the boss finally agreed to increase salaries.

english_meaning: very
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度高的副词，相当于“非常”、“十分”。
explanation_english: An adverb indicating a high degree, equivalent to "very" or "extremely".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人很好。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very nice person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很热。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is very hot today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is very delicious.

english_meaning: to pace back and forth; to wander; to hesitate; to hover
explanation_mandarin: 指在一个地方来回走动，犹豫不决。
explanation_english: To walk back and forth in a place; to hesitate or wander.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度徘徊咗好耐，唔知應唔應該入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 pui4 wui4 zo2 hou2 noi6, m4 zi1 ying1 m4 ying1 goi1 yap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里徘徊了很久，不知道应不应该进去。
examples.english_sentence: He paced around there for a long time, not knowing whether he should go in or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺公園度徘徊，諗住等埋佢先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gung1 yun4 dou6 pui4 wui4, nam2 jyu6 dang2 maai4 keoi5 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在公园里徘徊，想着等他一起走。
examples.english_sentence: We wandered around in the park, planning to wait for him before leaving.

english_meaning: laws and regulations; statutes
explanation_mandarin: 法律和规章制度的总称。
explanation_english: A general term for laws and regulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅營運一定要遵守所有嘅律例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jing4 wan6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 so2 jau5 ge3 leot6 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的运营一定要遵守所有的法律条例。
examples.english_sentence: The operation of this company must comply with all laws and regulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會不時更新律例，以應付社會嘅轉變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 bat1 si4 gang1 san1 leot6 lai6, ji5 jing3 fu6 se5 wui2 ge3 zyun2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会不时更新法律条例，以应付社会的变化。
examples.english_sentence: The government will update laws and regulations from time to time to cope with societal changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋被指控違反咗相關嘅律例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei6 zi2 gung3 wai4 faan2 zo2 soeng1 gwaan1 ge3 leot6 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被指控违反了相关的法律条例。
examples.english_sentence: They are accused of violating the relevant laws and regulations.

english_meaning: rhythm, pulsation, beat
explanation_mandarin: 指有规律的跳动或运动；节奏。
explanation_english: Refers to a regular beat or movement; rhythm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲音樂嘅律動好強，令人忍唔住想跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jam1 ngok6 ge3 leot6 dung6 hou2 koeng4, ling6 jan4 jan2 m4 zyu6 soeng2 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这音乐的节奏很强，让人忍不住想跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: The rhythm of the music is so strong, it makes you want to dance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅舞蹈充滿咗力量同律動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 mou5 dou6 cung1 mun5 zo2 lik6 loeng6 tung4 leot6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的舞蹈充满了力量和节奏。
examples.english_sentence: Their dance is full of power and rhythm.

mandarin_meaning: 免费啤酒; 赠送的啤酒
english_meaning: Free beer; complimentary beer
explanation_mandarin: 指免费提供的啤酒，通常在酒吧或活动中赠送，用于促销或吸引顾客。
explanation_english: Refers to free beer, usually offered in bars or at events for promotion or to attract customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚酒吧有律啤飲，唔去就笨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 baa1 jau5 leot6 be1 yam2, m4 heoi3 zau6 ban6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚酒吧有免费啤酒喝，不去就傻了。
examples.english_sentence: There's free beer at the bar tonight, it'd be foolish not to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞活動，頭一百位入場嘅人有律啤送。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 wut6 dung6, tau4 jat1 baak3 wai2 jap6 coeng4 ge3 jan4 jau5 leot6 be1 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们举办活动，前一百位入场的人有免费啤酒送。
examples.english_sentence: They're holding an event, and the first hundred people to enter get free beer.

english_meaning: Forget about it, let it go, never mind
explanation_mandarin: 表示算了、放弃、不理会的意思，语气比较随意。
explanation_english: Expresses resignation, giving up, or not bothering with something. It carries a casual and somewhat dismissive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽你講，律囉，由佢自己撞板啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ting1 nei5 gong2, leot6 lo1, jau4 keoi5 zi6 gei2 zong6 baan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听你的话，算了吧，让他自己碰壁吧。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to you, forget about it, let him learn the hard way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，律囉，都已經咁樣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, leot6 lo1, dou1 ji5 ging1 gam2 joeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，别管了，都已经这样了。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, let it go, it's already like this.

english_meaning: lawyer, attorney
explanation_mandarin: 指受过法律专业训练，并通过资格考试，可以代表当事人进行诉讼或提供法律服务的专业人士。
explanation_english: A professional who has received legal training and passed the qualification exam, and can represent parties in litigation or provide legal services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好出名嘅律師，打贏咗好多官司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 leot6 si1, daa2 wing4 zo2 hou2 do1 gun1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很出名的律师，打赢了很多官司。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous lawyer and has won many lawsuits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要搵個律師嚟幫我哋搞清楚份合約嘅條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 wan2 go3 leot6 si1 lai4 bong1 ngo5 dei6 gaau2 cing1 co2 fan6 hap6 joek3 ge3 tiu4 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找个律师来帮我们搞清楚这份合同的条款。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a lawyer to help us clarify the terms of this contract.

english_meaning: lawyer's letter
explanation_mandarin: 律师代表客户发出的正式信件，通常带有法律警告，旨在要求对方采取某种行动或停止某种行为，否则可能面临法律诉讼。
explanation_english: A formal letter from a lawyer on behalf of a client, usually containing a legal warning and intended to demand that the recipient take or cease a specific action or face legal action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到律師信，嚇到即刻搵咗個律師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou3 leot6 si1 seon3, haak3 dou3 zik1 hak1 wan2 zo2 go3 leot6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到律师函，吓得立刻找了个律师。
examples.english_sentence: He received a lawyer's letter and was so scared that he immediately hired a lawyer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為侵權俾人發咗律師信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yan1 wai6 cam1 kyun4 bei2 yan4 faat3 zo2 leot6 si1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司因为侵权被人发了律师函。
examples.english_sentence: The company was issued a lawyer's letter for copyright infringement.

english_meaning: Law firm, law office
explanation_mandarin: 指律师办公的场所，通常是一个机构。
explanation_english: A place where lawyers work; a firm or office of lawyers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搵間律師樓幫手搞離婚手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wan2 gaan1 leut6 si1 lau2 bong1 sau2 gaau2 lei4 fan1 sau2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们找一家律师事务所帮忙办理离婚手续。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to find a law firm to help with the divorce proceedings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間大律師樓做嘢，人工好高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 leut6 si1 lau2 zou6 je5, jan4 gung1 hou2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家大型律师事务所工作，工资很高。
examples.english_sentence: He works at a large law firm; the salary is very high.

english_meaning: Lawyer's letter
explanation_mandarin: 指律师发出的正式信函，通常用于警告、通知或提出法律要求。
explanation_english: Refers to a formal letter issued by a lawyer, typically used for warnings, notifications, or legal demands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到封律師紙，話佢侵犯咗人哋嘅版權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou2 fung1 leot6 si1 zi2, waa6 keoi5 cam1 faan6 zo2 jan4 dei6 ge3 baan2 kuen4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到了一封律师函，说他侵犯了他人的版权。
examples.english_sentence: He received a lawyer's letter saying he infringed on someone else's copyright.

english_meaning: law firm, law office
explanation_mandarin: 提供法律服务的机构，即律师事务所。
explanation_english: An organization that provides legal services, i.e., a law firm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間大型嘅律師行度做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 hing4 ge3 leot6 si1 hong4 dou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家大型律师事务所工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works in a large law firm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想搵間律師行幫我搞離婚手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 wan2 gaan1 leot6 si1 hong4 bong1 ngo5 gaau2 lei4 fan1 sau2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想找一家律师事务所帮我办理离婚手续。
examples.english_sentence: I want to find a law firm to help me with the divorce procedures.

english_meaning: Legal affairs; Justice; Law and Justice
explanation_mandarin: 法律和政治事务的总称，通常指政府部门负责法律事务的机构。
explanation_english: A general term referring to legal and political affairs, often specifically referring to the government department responsible for legal matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺律政司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 leot6 zing3 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在律政司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works at the Department of Justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律政人員需要熟悉法律條文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 zing3 jan4 jyun4 seoi1 jiu3 suk6 sik1 leot6 leoi4 tiu4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法律工作者需要熟悉法律条文。
examples.english_sentence: Legal personnel need to be familiar with the legal provisions.

english_meaning: Secretary for Justice
explanation_mandarin: 香港特别行政区政府的主要官员，负责香港的法律事务。
explanation_english: The Secretary for Justice of Hong Kong is the principal legal adviser to the Chief Executive and the Government, and is also responsible for the administration of justice in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律政司負責處理香港嘅法律事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leut6 zing3 si1 fu3 zaak3 cyu5 lei5 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 leot6 leui5 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律政司负责处理香港的法律事务。
examples.english_sentence: The Secretary for Justice is responsible for handling Hong Kong's legal affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱俾人委任做律政司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 bei2 jan4 wai2 jam6 zou6 leut6 zing3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚被人委任为律政司。
examples.english_sentence: He was just appointed as the Secretary for Justice.

english_meaning: law, code of law
explanation_mandarin: 指成文的法律条文或法律体系。
explanation_english: Refers to written laws or a legal system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對律法好熟悉，所以成日幫人解答法律問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 leut6 faat3 hou2 suk6 sik1, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 bong1 yan4 gaai2 daap3 faat3 leut6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对法律很熟悉，所以经常帮别人解答法律问题。
examples.english_sentence: He is very familiar with the law, so he often helps people answer legal questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該修改呢條過時嘅律法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 siu1 gai2 ni1 tiu4 gwo3 si4 ge3 leut6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该修改这条过时的法律。
examples.english_sentence: The government should amend this outdated law.

english_meaning: regulated verse, regulated poem (a form of classical Chinese poetry)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国古典诗歌形式，格律有严格的规定，包括字数、对仗、押韵等。
explanation_english: A form of classical Chinese poetry that adheres to strict rules regarding the number of characters per line, parallelism, rhyme scheme, and tonal patterns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗好多首律詩，都好有水準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 sau2 leot6 si1, dou1 hou2 jau5 seoi2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了很多首律诗，都很有水准。
examples.english_sentence: He has written many regulated poems, and they are all of a high standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學寫律詩要花好多時間研究格律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 se2 leot6 si1 jiu3 faa1 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 jin4 gau3 gaak3 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习写律诗要花很多时间研究格律。
examples.english_sentence: Learning to write regulated verse takes a lot of time to study the rules.

english_meaning: voice recording tube; microphone (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語，指麥克風。因為其外形類似管狀。
explanation_english: Hong Kong slang for microphone. Named for its tube-like shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞支律音管嚟，等我唱歌俾你聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 zi1 leot6 jam1 gun2 lei4, dang2 ngo5 coeng3 go1 bei2 nei5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿支麦克风来，让我唱歌给你听。
examples.english_sentence: Bring the microphone over here, let me sing you a song.

english_meaning: behind; after; back; later
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置在后面的；时间在后面的；次序在后面的。
explanation_english: Indicates a position at the back; a time that follows; a sequence that comes later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 企喺我後邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei5 hai2 ngo5 hau6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 站在我的后面。
examples.english_sentence: Stand behind me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日先算啦，遲啲再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 sin1 syun3 laa1, chi4 di1 joi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天再说吧，以后再说。
examples.english_sentence: Let's talk about it tomorrow, we'll talk about it later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我後生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 hau6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的晚辈。
examples.english_sentence: He is my junior.

english_meaning: To join later; to join after something has already started
explanation_mandarin: 指在某项活动、组织、项目等已经开始后才加入。带有“之后”或“晚”的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to joining an activity, organization, project, etc., after it has already started. Implies joining 'later' or 'afterwards'. It often carries a sense of not being there from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先塞車，所以要後join你哋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 sak1 ce1, so2 ji5 jiu3 hau6 dʒɔin1 nei5 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才堵车了，所以要晚点加入你们了。
examples.english_sentence: I was stuck in traffic just now, so I'll have to join you guys later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後join咗個project，所以唔係好清楚啲background。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 dʒɔin1 zo2 go3 project, so2 ji5 m4 hai6 hou2 ching1 chu2 di1 background.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是后来加入这个项目的，所以不太清楚背景情况。
examples.english_sentence: He joined the project later, so he's not very clear about the background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔緊要，你可以後join我哋嘅whatsapp group。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gan2 jiu3, nei5 ho2 ji5 hau6 dʒɔin1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 whatsapp group.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没关系，你可以稍后加入我们的whatsapp群组。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay, you can join our WhatsApp group later.

synonyms: 遲啲加入 (chi4 di1 ga1 jap6)

english_meaning: future generations; posterity
explanation_mandarin: 指未来的世代，后代。
explanation_english: Refers to future generations; posterity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家嘅努力，都係為咗後世嘅幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 nou5 lik6, dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 hau6 sai3 ge3 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在的努力，都是为了后代的幸福。
examples.english_sentence: Our current efforts are all for the happiness of future generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望後世可以從歷史中吸取教訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 hau6 sai3 ho2 ji5 cung4 lik6 si2 zung1 kap1 cheui2 gaau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望后代可以从历史中吸取教训。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, future generations can learn from history.

english_meaning: funeral arrangements; matters after death; aftermath
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后的丧葬事宜；指事件的善后处理。
explanation_english: Refers to funeral arrangements and related matters after someone's death; also refers to the handling of the aftermath of an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺過咗身，佢哋一家人忙緊搞後事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 mang4 gan2 gaau2 hau6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷去世了，他们一家人正忙着处理后事。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather passed away, and his family is busy handling the funeral arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅後事好難搞，牽涉嘅人太多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 hau6 si6 hou2 naan4 gaau2, hin1 sip3 ge3 jan4 taai3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的善后处理很难搞，牵涉的人太多了。
examples.english_sentence: The aftermath of this event is difficult to handle; too many people are involved.

english_meaning: descendants; posterity
explanation_mandarin: 指后代子孙。
explanation_english: Refers to descendants or posterity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為後人保護好環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai6 hau6 jan4 bou2 wu6 hou2 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为后代保护好环境。
examples.english_sentence: We need to protect the environment well for future generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望可以留啲嘢畀後人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 lau4 di1 je5 bei2 hau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望可以留下一些东西给后代。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to leave something for his descendants.

english_meaning: Stepchildren (both sons and daughters)
explanation_mandarin: 指非亲生的儿子和女儿，因为父母再婚而产生的子女关系。
explanation_english: Refers to stepchildren (both sons and daughters) in a family formed through remarriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆對啲後仔乸都好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 deoi3 di1 hau6 zai2 naa2 dou1 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩对继子继女都很好。
examples.english_sentence: The couple treats their stepchildren very well.

english_meaning: descendant(s); posterity; offspring
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的后裔、子孙。
explanation_english: Refers to the descendants or offspring of a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望自己嘅後代可以過得幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 zi6 gei2 ge3 hau6 doi6 ho2 ji5 gwo3 dak1 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望自己的后代可以过得幸福。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes that his descendants can live happily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為咗後代保護環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai6 zo2 hau6 doi6 bou2 wu6 hwaan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为了后代保护环境。
examples.english_sentence: We need to protect the environment for future generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個傳統由佢嘅後代一直傳落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cyun4 tung2 jau4 keoi5 ge3 hau6 doi6 jat1 zik6 cyun4 lok6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个传统由他的后代一直传承下来。
examples.english_sentence: This tradition has been passed down by his descendants.

english_meaning: later; afterwards; after
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发生之后的一段时间。
explanation_english: Referring to a period of time after something has happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後來去咗英國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 loi4 heoi3 zo2 ying1 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他后来去英国读书了。
examples.english_sentence: He went to study in the UK later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋後來都無再見過面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hau6 loi4 dou1 mou5 zoi3 gin3 gwo3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们后来都没有再见过面。
examples.english_sentence: We never saw each other again afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後來發生咗好多事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 loi4 faat3 sang1 zo2 hou2 do1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 后来发生了许多事情。
examples.english_sentence: Many things happened later.

english_meaning: to surpass one's predecessors; the latecomer surpasses the early starter; to come from behind to win
explanation_mandarin: 指后来的超过先前的。
explanation_english: Describes someone who comes later surpassing those who came before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然起步遲，但係好勤力，相信佢將來會後來居上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hei2 bou6 ci4, daan6 hai6 hou2 kan4 lik6, seung1 seon3 keoi5 jeung1 loi4 wui5 hau6 loi4 geoi1 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然起步晚，但是很努力，相信他将来会后来居上。
examples.english_sentence: Although he started late, he is very diligent, and I believe he will eventually surpass others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司後生一輩好有活力，好快就會後來居上，超越老牌公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hau6 saang1 jat1 bui3 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6, hou2 faai3 jau5 wui5 hau6 loi4 geoi1 soeng5, chiu1 jyut6 lou5 paai4 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司年轻一代很有活力，很快就会后来居上，超越老牌公司。
examples.english_sentence: The younger generation in this company is very energetic, and they will soon surpass the established companies.

english_meaning: behind, back, rear
explanation_mandarin: 指在某物体的后面，或时间上较晚的阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the back or rear of something, or a later stage in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企喺我後便啦，唔好阻住我睇嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 hai2 ngo5 hau6 bin6 laa1, m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 tai2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站在我后面吧，不要挡住我看东西。
examples.english_sentence: Stand behind me, don't block my view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋後便有個花園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hau6 bin6 jau5 go3 faa1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子后面有个花园。
examples.english_sentence: There is a garden behind the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 排隊嘅時候唔好逼埋嚟，留返啲空間俾後便嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paai4 deoi2 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hou2 bik1 maai4 lai4, lau4 faan1 di1 hung1 gaan1 bei2 hau6 bin6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 排队的时候不要挤过来，留一些空间给后面的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't squeeze while queuing, leave some space for the people behind.

english_meaning: reserve; backup; spare
explanation_mandarin: 指事先准备好的，以备不时之需的人或物；候补的，作为替补的。
explanation_english: Referring to someone or something prepared in advance as a backup; a reserve; someone or something acting as a substitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋嘅後備方案，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hau6 bei6 fong1 on3, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们的备用方案，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: He is our backup plan, just in case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個波隊有好多後備球員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 deoi2 jau5 hou2 do1 hau6 bei6 kau4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球队有很多候补球员。
examples.english_sentence: This team has many reserve players.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我帶多咗一件後備衫，費事整污糟冇得換。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai3 do1 zo2 jat1 gin6 hau6 bei6 saam1, fai3 si6 zing2 wu1 zou1 mou5 dak1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我多带了一件备用衣服，免得弄脏了没得换。
examples.english_sentence: I brought an extra spare shirt, in case I get it dirty and have nothing to change into.

english_meaning: spare key
explanation_mandarin: 备用的钥匙，以防主要钥匙丢失或损坏。
explanation_english: A spare key, usually kept in a safe place, to be used if the primary key is lost or damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚整唔見條鎖匙，所以配咗條後備匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ging1 zing2 m4 gin3 tiu4 so2 si4, so2 ji5 pui3 zo2 tiu4 hau6 bei6 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕弄丢钥匙，所以配了一把备用钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid of losing the key, so I got a spare key made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得擺低條後備匙喺安全嘅地方，唔好等要用嗰陣搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 baai2 dai1 tiu4 hau6 bei6 si4 hai2 on1 cyun4 ge3 dei6 fong1, m4 hou2 dang2 jiu3 yung6 go2 zan6 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得把备用钥匙放在安全的地方，不要等到要用的时候找不到。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put the spare key in a safe place, don't wait until you need it and can't find it.

english_meaning: After-effect, lingering strength, lasting impact
explanation_mandarin: 指事情或事物发生后，产生的持续性的力量、影响或效果。也可形容酒的后劲。
explanation_english: Refers to the lasting power, influence, or effect produced after something happens. It can also describe the kick of alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻咖啡嘅後勁好犀利，飲完成晚都瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gaa3 fe1 ge3 hau6 ging6 hou2 sai1 lei6, yam2 yun4 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯咖啡的后劲很强，喝完一整晚都睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: This coffee has a strong after-effect; I couldn't sleep all night after drinking it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢一開始表現唔突出，但係佢嘅後勁好足，最後贏咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 keoi5 jat1 hoi2 ci2 biu2 hin3 m4 dat6 ceot1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 hau6 ging6 hou2 zuk1, zeoi3 hau6 win4 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他一开始表现不突出，但是他的后劲很足，最后赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Although his performance wasn't outstanding at the beginning, he had plenty of staying power and won the race in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲睇完之後嘅後勁好強，令人諗咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 tai2 yun4 zi1 hau6 ge3 hau6 ging6 hou2 keung4, ling6 jan4 nam2 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影看完之后的后劲很强，让人想了很久。
examples.english_sentence: This movie had a strong lasting impact after watching it, making people think for a long time.

english_meaning: logistics; rear services; support services; background support
explanation_mandarin: 指为前线工作或行动提供支持的部门或服务，如供应、运输、维修等。
explanation_english: Refers to the department or services that provide support for front-line work or operations, such as supply, transportation, maintenance, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅後勤做得好好，所以前線嘅同事可以專心做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hau6 kan4 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 cin4 sin3 ge3 tung4 si6 ho2 ji5 zyun1 sam1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的后勤做得很好，所以前线的同事可以专心工作。
examples.english_sentence: This company's logistics is very well done, so the front-line colleagues can focus on their work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊嘅後勤補給非常重要，如果唔夠，就好難打贏仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi2 ge3 hau6 kan4 bou2 gap1 fei1 soeng4 zung6 jiu3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 gau3, zau6 hou2 naan4 daa2 ying4 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队的后勤补给非常重要，如果不够，就很难打赢仗。
examples.english_sentence: The military's logistics support is very important. If it's not enough, it's difficult to win a war.

english_meaning: Backstage; backing; supporter; influence (in a powerful position)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 舞台后面，演员准备的地方。2. 比喻背后支持的力量或人物，靠山。
explanation_english: 1. Backstage, the area behind the stage in a theater. 2. Figuratively, a strong support or influential person who provides backing; someone with pull.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅後台好硬，所以做嘢先咁順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau6 toi4 hou2 ngaang6, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 sin1 gam3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的后台很硬，所以工作才这么顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He has very strong backing, which is why he's doing so well at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想靠後台上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 kaau3 hau6 toi4 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想靠后台上位。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to climb up the ranks by relying on his backers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個明星喺後台準備緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ming4 sing1 hai2 hau6 toi4 zeon2 bei6 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个明星在后台准备着。
examples.english_sentence: That celebrity is preparing backstage.

english_meaning: later; afterwards; subsequently
explanation_mandarin: 表示在較晚的時間或情況之後。
explanation_english: Indicates a time or situation that follows a previous one; afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後嚟佢去咗英國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 lei4 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 jing1 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 後來他去了英国读书。
examples.english_sentence: Later, he went to study in England.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後嚟先知佢結咗婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 lei4 sin1 zi1 keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我后来才知道他结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: I only found out later that he got married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後嚟點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 lei4 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 后来怎么样了？
examples.english_sentence: What happened afterwards?

english_meaning: back garden; backyard; rear garden
explanation_mandarin: 房屋后面的花园或空地。
explanation_english: The garden or open space at the back of a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺後園玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 hau6 jyun4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在后花园玩。
examples.english_sentence: We often play in the back garden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺後園種咗好多花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 hau6 jyun4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶在后花园种了很多花。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma planted a lot of flowers in the back garden.

english_meaning: dust kicked up behind; to follow in the footsteps of; to imitate
explanation_mandarin: 指后面的尘土，比喻追随别人之后。也指效仿、追随。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the dust kicked up behind someone. Figuratively, it means to follow in someone's footsteps, to imitate or emulate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想步佢老豆嘅後塵，揀咗另一條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 bou6 keoi5 lou5 dau6 ge3 hau6 can4, gaan2 ze2 liu5 ling6 jat1 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想步他父亲的后尘，选择了另一条路。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to follow in his father's footsteps, so he chose a different path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該盲目咁步人後塵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 maang4 muk6 gam2 bou6 jan4 hau6 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该盲目地效仿别人。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't blindly follow in other people's footsteps.

english_meaning: the day after tomorrow; acquired (characteristics, abilities, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指明天之后的一天；也指通过学习或训练获得的，而非天生的。
explanation_english: Refers to the day after tomorrow; also, refers to something that is acquired through learning or training, rather than being innate or hereditary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後天飛去日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 tin1 fei1 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我后天飞去日本。
examples.english_sentence: I'm flying to Japan the day after tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係後天培養嘅技能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 hau6 tin1 pui4 joeng5 ge3 gei1 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是后天培养的技能。
examples.english_sentence: These are skills that are developed later in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功唔係天生嘅，係後天努力嘅結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 tin1 sang1 ge3, hai6 hau6 tin1 nu5 lik6 ge3 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功不是天生的，是后天努力的结果。
examples.english_sentence: His success wasn't innate; it's the result of his hard work later in life.

english_meaning: to remedy something after the fact, to compensate for a deficiency through effort
explanation_mandarin: 指先天不足，通过后天的努力来弥补。
explanation_english: Refers to compensating for innate deficiencies or shortcomings through efforts made after the fact. It emphasizes that even if something is not naturally perfect, it can be improved through hard work and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣英文唔好，但係佢後天補救，依家講英文講得好流利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ying1 man2 m4 hou2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hau6 tin1 bou2 gau3, ji1 gaa1 gong2 ying1 man2 gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候英语不好，但是他后天补救，现在说英语说得很流利。
examples.english_sentence: His English wasn't good when he was young, but he made up for it later and now speaks English fluently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天生嘅嘢改唔到，但係可以後天補救㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 sang1 ge3 ye5 goi2 m4 dou2, daan6 hai6 ho2 ji5 hau6 tin1 bou2 gau3 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天生的东西改不了，但是可以后天补救嘛。
examples.english_sentence: You can't change what you're born with, but you can make up for it later, right?

english_meaning: stepmother
explanation_mandarin: 指父亲的再婚妻子，不是自己亲生的母亲。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who is married to one's father but is not one's biological mother; a stepmother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個後娘對佢唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 hau6 noeng4 deoi3 keoi5 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的继母对他不好。
examples.english_sentence: His stepmother isn't good to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲後娘好似童話故事咁，好惡毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 hau6 noeng4 hou2 ci5 tung4 waa2 gu3 si6 gam2, hou2 ok3 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些继母就像童话故事里一样，很恶毒。
examples.english_sentence: Some stepmothers are like those in fairy tales, very wicked.

english_meaning: stepmother
explanation_mandarin: 指父亲再婚后的妻子，即继母。
explanation_english: The wife of one's father after the death or divorce of one's natural mother; a stepmother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個後孃對佢唔好，成日恰佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 hau6 noeng4 deoi3 keoi5 m4 hou2, seng4 jat6 hap1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的继母对他不好，总是欺负他。
examples.english_sentence: His stepmother is not nice to him, always bullying him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想我爸爸再娶，費事有個後孃虐待我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 ngo5 baa4 baa1 zoi3 cheui2, fai3 si6 jau5 go3 hau6 noeng4 zoek3 doi6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想我爸爸再娶，免得有个继母虐待我。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want my father to remarry, in case a stepmother abuses me.

english_meaning: harem; imperial palace inner court; (figuratively) a group of female admirers or followers.
explanation_mandarin: 原指古代帝王的妃嫔居住的地方，也指妃嫔群体。在现代粤语中，常用来比喻一群围绕着某人的女性，通常带有戏谑的意味。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the place where the concubines of ancient emperors lived, and also the group of concubines. In modern Cantonese, it is often used metaphorically to refer to a group of women surrounding someone, usually with a teasing or joking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁受女仔歡迎，成班女仔圍住佢，簡直好似有個後宮咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sau6 neoi5 zai2 faan1 jing4, seng4 baan1 neoi5 zai2 wai4 zyu6 keoi5, gaan2 zik6 hou2 ci5 jau5 go3 hau6 gung1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很受女生欢迎，一群女生围着他，简直就像有个后宫一样。
examples.english_sentence: He is so popular with girls, a group of them surrounds him, it's just like he has a harem.

english_meaning: Later; afterwards
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间，指稍后的时间或事情发生之后。
explanation_english: Indicates a time later or after something has happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後尾佢都冇再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 mei5 keoi5 dou1 mou5 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 后来他都没再来了。
examples.english_sentence: He never came again afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後尾先知佢去咗英國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 mei5 sin1 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ying1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我后来才知道他去了英国。
examples.english_sentence: I only found out later that he had gone to England.

english_meaning: back of the head; pillow (literally, the back of the head acts as a pillow)
explanation_mandarin: 指头部的后部，靠近颈部的位置。在比喻意义上，也指背后被人议论、算计。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the back of the head. Figuratively, it can mean being talked about or plotted against behind one's back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日瞓覺都係瞓到後尾枕都濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fan3 gaau3 dou1 hai6 fan3 dou3 hau6 mei5 zam2 dou1 sip3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是睡觉睡得后脑勺都湿透了。
examples.english_sentence: He always sleeps so much that the back of his head is completely wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾人篤你後尾枕啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 duk1 nei5 hau6 mei5 zam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，别被人背后捅刀啊！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't let anyone stab you in the back!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事喺佢背後發生，佢完全唔知俾人篤後尾枕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai2 keoi5 bui3 hau6 faat3 sang1, keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 bei2 jan4 duk1 hau6 mei5 zam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事在他背后发生，他完全不知道被人算计。
examples.english_sentence: This happened behind his back; he had no idea he was being backstabbed.

english_meaning: back hill, hinterland
explanation_mandarin: 指某地后方的山或山區，通常較為偏遠。
explanation_english: Refers to the hills or mountainous area behind a certain place, usually more remote and less developed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋鄉下喺後山，交通唔方便㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoeng1 haa2 hai2 hau6 saan1, gaau1 tung1 m4 fong1 bin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的老家在后山，交通不方便。
examples.english_sentence: Our hometown is in the back hills, transportation is inconvenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日去後山行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 hau6 saan1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常去后山爬山。
examples.english_sentence: They often go hiking in the back hills.

english_meaning: back alley, back lane
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物后面的小巷或通道。
explanation_english: Refers to the narrow lane or passage located behind buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條後巷好污糟，好多垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 hau6 hong2 hou2 wu1 zou1, hou2 do1 laap6 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条后巷很脏，有很多垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: This back alley is very dirty, there is a lot of garbage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺後巷搞搞震，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 hau6 hong2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是经常在后巷里搞事情，不知道在干什么。
examples.english_sentence: They are always messing around in the back alley, I don't know what they're doing.

english_meaning: market outlook, future market trends
explanation_mandarin: 指股市或金融市场未来的走势或趋势。
explanation_english: Refers to the future trend or outlook of the stock market or financial market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得今年嘅後市都幾樂觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 gam1 nin4 ge3 hau6 si5 dou1 gei2 lok6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得今年的后市挺乐观的。
examples.english_sentence: I think the market outlook for this year is quite optimistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 專家預測下個月嘅後市會下跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zhun1 ga1 jyu6 chak1 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 hau6 si5 wui5 haa6 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 专家预测下个月的后市会下跌。
examples.english_sentence: Experts predict that the market outlook for next month will decline.

english_meaning: the year after next
explanation_mandarin: 指明年之后的那一年。
explanation_english: Refers to the year after next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋後年移民去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hau6 nin4 ji4 man4 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们后年移民去加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: We are immigrating to Canada the year after next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話後年結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hau6 nin4 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说后年结婚。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's getting married the year after next.

english_meaning: Unreliable; a backup plan; a trump card
explanation_mandarin: 1. 形容某人或某事不可靠，不稳定。2. 比喻隐藏的计划或秘密手段，作为最后的依靠。
explanation_english: 1. Used to describe someone or something as unreliable or unstable. 2. Metaphor for a hidden plan or secret means, used as a last resort; a backup plan; a trump card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人好後底㗎，千祈唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 hau6 dai2 gaa3, cin1 cai4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很不可靠的，千万不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very unreliable, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲有後底嘅，唔驚佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 jau5 hau6 dai2 ge3, m4 geng1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还有后备计划的，不怕他们。
examples.english_sentence: I still have a backup plan, I'm not afraid of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎咗張後底出嚟，一下子就贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zo2 zoeng1 hau6 dai2 ceot1 lai4, jat1 haa5 zi2 zau6 wing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿出了一张底牌，一下子就赢了。
examples.english_sentence: He played his trump card and won instantly.

mandarin_meaning: 女同性恋者中扮演男性角色的人
english_meaning: Butch lesbian, the more masculine partner in a lesbian relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指女同性恋关系中，性格和行为举止更像男性的那一方。通常穿着打扮也偏男性化。
explanation_english: Refers to the more masculine partner in a lesbian relationship.  They usually dress and act in a more masculine manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個拍拖好耐㗎喇，阿 May 係後底乸，阿 Jane 就比較 feminine 啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 paak3 to1 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa3, aa3 May hai6 hau6 dai2 naa2, aa3 Jane zau6 bei2 gaau3 feminine di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两个交往很久了，May是扮演男性角色的女同性恋，Jane就比较女性化。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for a long time. May is the butch lesbian, and Jane is more feminine.

english_meaning: Slowpoke, slow-witted person, someone who is slow to react or understand
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人反应迟钝，动作慢，理解能力差。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slow to react, slow in action, and has poor comprehension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁慢，真係後底爺咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 maan6, zan1 hai6 hau6 dai2 je4 gam2 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么慢，真是个慢郎中。
examples.english_sentence: You work so slowly, you're such a slowpoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁後底爺啦，快啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hau6 dai2 je4 laa1, faai3 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么慢吞吞的，快点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow, hurry up!

english_meaning: back seat (of a vehicle); rear seat
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆（如汽车、摩托车等）的后排座位。
explanation_english: Refers to the back seat or rear seat of a vehicle (e.g., car, motorcycle).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋坐後座得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co5 hau6 zo6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐后座就可以啦。
examples.english_sentence: We can just sit in the back seat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意坐喺電單車嘅後座。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 co5 hai2 din6 daan1 ce1 ge3 hau6 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢坐在摩托车的后座。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to sit on the back seat of the motorcycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後座有冇安全帶㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 zo6 jau5 mou5 on1 cyun4 daai2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 后座有安全带吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are there seatbelts in the back seat?

english_meaning: Anus; back passage
explanation_mandarin: 肛門，通常指男性的肛門，帶有性意味。
explanation_english: Anus, usually referring to the male anus, with sexual connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人爆咗後庭，痛到行唔到路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 baau3 zo2 hau6 ting4, tung3 dou3 haang4 m4 dou2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人爆了肛门，疼得走不了路。
examples.english_sentence: His anus was penetrated, and he was in so much pain that he couldn't walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞我後庭呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 ngo5 hau6 ting4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碰我的肛门啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch my anus!

english_meaning: to regret; remorseful
explanation_mandarin: 对过去做过的事感到懊悔，希望当初没有做。
explanation_english: To feel regret or remorse about something one has done or failed to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好後悔冇聽你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 hau6 fui3 mou5 teng1 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常后悔没听你的话。
examples.english_sentence: I really regret not listening to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千金難買早知道，後悔都冇用㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 zou2 zi1 dou3, hau6 fui3 dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千金难买早知道，后悔也没用了。
examples.english_sentence: It's no use crying over spilled milk; it's no use regretting it now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗當年嘅決定好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 dong1 nin4 ge3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为当年的决定感到非常后悔。
examples.english_sentence: He deeply regrets his decision back then.

english_meaning: Too late to regret
explanation_mandarin: 指事后后悔也来不及了。
explanation_english: To regret something when it's already too late; irremediable regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家唔努力，第時後悔莫及㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 m4 nou5 lik6, dai6 si4 hau6 fui3 mok6 kap6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在不努力，以后后悔就来不及了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work hard now, you'll regret it later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等到失去咗先至識得珍惜，到時後悔莫及就無用㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 dou3 sat1 heoi3 zo2 sin1 zai3 sik1 dak1 zan1 sik1, dou3 si4 hau6 fui3 mok6 kap6 zau6 mou5 yung6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等到失去后才懂得珍惜，到时后悔莫及也没有用了。
examples.english_sentence: It's useless to regret it when you only cherish something after you've lost it.

english_meaning: potential future trouble; lingering problem; future consequences
explanation_mandarin: 指将来可能发生的祸患或麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to potential troubles or problems that may arise in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔搞清楚呢件事，遲早會有後患㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 gaau2 cing1 chu2 ni1 gin6 si6, chi4 zou2 wui5 jau5 hau6 waan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不弄清楚这件事，迟早会有后患的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't clarify this matter, there will be future troubles sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 斬草唔除根，春風吹又生，留低咗後患。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaam2 cou2 m4 cheui4 gan1, cheun1 fung1 cheui1 jau6 saang1, lau4 dai1 zo2 hau6 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 斩草不除根，春风吹又生，留下了后患。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't pull out the roots when cutting grass, it will grow again in the spring breeze, leaving behind potential trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好貪一時嘅方便，費事有手尾跟，搞出後患。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taam1 jat1 si4 ge3 fong1 bin6, fai3 si6 jau5 sau2 mei5 gan1, gaau2 chut1 hau6 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要贪图一时的方便，以免留下麻烦，搞出后患。
examples.english_sentence: Don't seek convenience for the moment, to avoid leaving loose ends and creating future troubles.

english_meaning: endless troubles in the future; potentially disastrous consequences
explanation_mandarin: 指将来可能产生的无穷无尽的祸患。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where the future consequences are potentially disastrous and endless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家咁做，第時後患無窮㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 gam2 zou6, dai6 si4 hau6 waan6 mou4 kung4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在这样做，以后会后患无穷的！
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing now will lead to endless troubles later!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事處理唔好，真係後患無窮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 cyu2 lei5 m4 hou2, zan1 hai6 hau6 waan6 mou4 kung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事处理不好，真的是后患无穷。
examples.english_sentence: If this matter isn't handled well, it will truly have endless troubles later.

english_meaning: backup plan; hidden move; reserve measure; follow-up action
explanation_mandarin: 指事先预备好的，以应对突发情况的计划或措施。
explanation_english: Refers to a pre-arranged plan or measure to deal with unexpected situations or a backup plan; also, a hidden move or tactic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要留返啲後手，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lau4 faan1 di1 hau6 sau2, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要留一些后手，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: We must keep some backup plans, just in case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人好蠱惑，成日都有後手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 gu2 waak6, sing4 jat6 dou1 jau5 hau6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很狡猾，总是留着后手。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very cunning, always having hidden moves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經安排咗後手，就算今次失敗咗都唔驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 on1 paai4 zo2 hau6 sau2, zau6 syun3 gam1 ci3 sat1 baai6 zo2 dou1 m4 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经安排了后手，就算这次失败了也不怕。
examples.english_sentence: He has already arranged a backup plan, so he is not afraid even if he fails this time.

mandarin_meaning: 迟钝的女人；反应慢的女人
english_meaning: Slow-witted woman; dull woman; slow to react woman
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个女人反应迟钝、理解能力较差。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is slow to react, has poor comprehension, or is generally dull-witted. It is a derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢㗎，真係後抵乸噉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2 gaa3, zan1 hai6 hau6 dai2 naa2 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么笨，真是个反应迟钝的女人。
examples.english_sentence: She's so stupid, she's really like a slow-witted woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣講佢啦，佢可能只係一時諗唔通啫，唔係真係後抵乸嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 gong2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 jat1 si4 naam2 m4 tung1 ze1, m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 hau6 dai2 naa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样说她啦，她可能只是一时没想明白，不是真的迟钝。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about her, she might just not be thinking clearly at the moment, she's not really slow-witted.

english_meaning: backing; support; reinforcements
explanation_mandarin: 在后面支援或援助。
explanation_english: Support or assistance provided from behind or in reserve; reinforcements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要你哋嘅後援嚟完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 dei6 ge3 hau6 wun4 lai4 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要你们的后援来完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: I need your support to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有強大嘅後援團隊，所以可以咁成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 koeng4 daai6 ge3 hau6 wun4 teoi4 deoi2, so2 ji5 ho2 ji5 gam2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有强大的后援团队，所以可以这么成功。
examples.english_sentence: They have a strong support team, so they can be so successful.

english_meaning: to settle accounts later; to get even later; to have the last laugh; payback later
explanation_mandarin: 指事后报复或清算。通常指等待时机成熟后再进行报复或追究责任。
explanation_english: Refers to settling accounts or taking revenge later, usually after waiting for the right opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家蝦我，等我第日發達，我就同你後數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 haa1 ngo5, dang2 ngo5 dai6 jat6 faat3 daat6, ngo5 zau6 tung4 nei5 hau6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在欺负我，等我将来发达了，我再跟你算账。
examples.english_sentence: You're bullying me now, but when I become successful in the future, I'll get even with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要同我後數，我梗係驚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 hau6 sou3, ngo5 gang2 hai6 geng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要秋后算账，我当然害怕了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'll get even with me later, of course I'm scared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為今次冇事，佢一定會同你後數㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 gam1 ci3 mou5 si6, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 tung4 nei5 hau6 sou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为这次没事，他一定会秋后算账的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're safe this time, he will definitely get even with you later.
