synonyms: 秋後算帳 (cau1 hau6 syun3 zoeng3)

english_meaning: rear; behind; the back
explanation_mandarin: 指位置在后面的方向或区域。
explanation_english: Refers to the direction or area at the back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅後方要小心啲，可能會有人埋伏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 hau6 fong1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 jan4 maai4 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要小心我们的后方，可能有人埋伏。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be careful of our rear; there might be an ambush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭期間，後方嘅補給好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zang1 kei4 gaan1, hau6 fong1 ge3 bou2 gap1 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争期间，后方的补给很重要。
examples.english_sentence: During wartime, the supply line from the rear is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專心應付前面嘅考試，唔使擔心後方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 sam1 ying3 fu6 cin4 min6 ge3 haau2 si5, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 hau6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专心应付前面的考试，不用担心后方。
examples.english_sentence: He is concentrating on the exams ahead, so he doesn't need to worry about things at the back (i.e., other matters).

english_meaning: the day after tomorrow
explanation_mandarin: 指今天的两天之后。
explanation_english: Refers to the day that is two days after today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後日會去香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 jat6 wui5 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我后天会去香港。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Hong Kong the day after tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話後日先得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hau6 jat6 sin1 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说后天才有空。
examples.english_sentence: He said he will only be free the day after tomorrow.

english_meaning: the night after tomorrow
explanation_mandarin: 指明天晚上之後的晚上。
explanation_english: Refers to the night after tomorrow night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後晚見啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 maan5 gin3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 後天晚上見！
examples.english_sentence: See you the night after tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後晚要加班，唔得閒同你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 maan5 jiu3 gaa1 baan1, m4 dak1 haan4 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我後天晚上要加班，沒空跟你吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work overtime the night after tomorrow, I don't have time to have dinner with you.

english_meaning: We'll meet again; Until we meet again; See you later.
explanation_mandarin: 表示将来还会再见面，通常在离别时使用，带有祝福的意味。
explanation_english: An idiom used when parting ways, expressing hope or belief that you will meet again in the future. It carries a tone of farewell and good wishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，今次就講到呢度，後會有期啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, gam1 ci3 zau6 gong2 dou3 ni1 dou6, hau6 wui5 jau5 kei4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，这次就说到这里，后会有期了！
examples.english_sentence: Alright, that's all for now. Until we meet again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然唔知幾時再見，但後會有期！
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 m4 zi1 gei2 si4 zoi3 gin3, daan6 hau6 wui5 jau5 kei4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然不知道什么时候再见，但后会有期！
examples.english_sentence: Although I don't know when we'll meet again, I hope we will!

english_meaning: later stage; final period; post-production
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发展的较后阶段或时期；也指电影、电视等制作完成后的加工阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the later stage or period of the development of something; also refers to the post-production stage of filmmaking, television, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅後期製作搞咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 hau6 kei4 zai3 zok3 gaau2 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的后期制作弄了很久。
examples.english_sentence: The post-production of this movie took a very long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺佢嘅後期人生，佢過得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 keoi5 ge3 hau6 kei4 jan4 sang1, keoi5 gwo3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在他人生的后期，他过得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: In the later stage of his life, he lived happily.

english_meaning: Post-production
explanation_mandarin: 指电影、电视节目、音乐等作品完成拍摄或录制后的编辑、剪辑、特效、配乐、调色等一系列制作过程。
explanation_english: Refers to the stage of filmmaking or video production that occurs after principal photography has been completed. It includes tasks like editing, sound design, visual effects, color correction, and music composition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅後期製作做得好出色，啲特效好逼真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 hau6 kei4 zai3 zok3 zou6 dak1 hou2 cheut1 sik1, di1 dak1 haau6 hou2 bik1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的后期制作做得非常出色，特效很逼真。
examples.english_sentence: The post-production of this movie is excellent; the special effects are very realistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺一間製作公司做後期製作嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 zai3 zok3 gung1 si1 zou6 hau6 kei4 zai3 zok3 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在一家制作公司做后期制作的工作。
examples.english_sentence: I work in post-production at a production company.

english_meaning: back of the head
explanation_mandarin: 指头部的后方，颈部之上的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the back of the head, the part above the neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺成日都係側埋一邊，搞到後枕扁晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 zak1 maai4 jat1 bin1, gaau2 dou3 hau6 zam2 bin2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡觉总是侧着睡，搞得后脑勺都扁了。
examples.english_sentence: He always sleeps on his side, which made the back of his head flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撞到個後枕呀，好易暈㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zong6 dou3 go3 hau6 zam2 aa3, hou2 ji6 wan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别撞到后脑勺啊，很容易晕的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bump the back of your head, it's easy to get dizzy.

english_meaning: consequence, aftermath, result
explanation_mandarin: 事情发生之后的不良结果。
explanation_english: The unfavorable result or aftermath of an action or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔聽我講，到時有乜嘢後果自己負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 teng1 ngo5 gong2, dou3 si4 jau5 mat1 je5 hau6 gwo2 zi6 gei2 fu3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不听我的话，到时候有什么后果自己负责。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen to me, you'll be responsible for the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咁多酒嘅後果就係第二日頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 gam3 do1 zau2 ge3 hau6 gwo2 zau6 hai6 dai2 ji6 jat6 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝那么多酒的后果就是第二天头痛。
examples.english_sentence: The consequence of drinking so much alcohol is a headache the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做錯嘢就要承擔後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 co3 je5 zau6 jiu3 sing4 daam1 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做错事就要承担后果。
examples.english_sentence: If you do something wrong, you have to bear the consequences.

english_meaning: Back stairs; a backup plan; a way out; a safety net
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指建筑物的后楼梯，引申义指备用方案、退路、应急措施等。比喻在事情失败或遇到困难时，可以用来脱身的策略或方法。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the back stairs of a building. Figuratively, it means a backup plan, a way out, or emergency measures. It's a strategy or method to escape from a failure or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢一定要留返條後樓梯，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lau4 faan1 tiu4 hau6 lau4 tai1, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事一定要留一条后路，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: You must always leave a backup plan when you do things, just in case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好醒目，一定會預留後樓梯俾自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 seng2 muk6, jat1 ding6 wui5 jyu6 lau4 hau6 lau4 tai1 bei2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很聪明，一定会预留后路给自己。
examples.english_sentence: He's a smart person and will definitely leave a way out for himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁衝動，諗定條後樓梯先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6, nam2 ding6 tiu4 hau6 lau4 tai1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么冲动，先想好退路吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive, think of a backup plan first.

english_meaning: backyard; behind the scenes (of a business or organization); back door
explanation_mandarin: 指房屋后面的空地或区域；也比喻指内部、幕后。
explanation_english: Refers to the space or area behind a house (backyard). Figuratively, it can refer to the inside or behind the scenes (of an organization or business).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺後欄種咗好多花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hau6 laan4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在后院种了很多花。
examples.english_sentence: He planted a lot of flowers in the backyard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅後欄一定有古怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 hau6 laan4 jat1 ding6 jau5 gu2 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的背后一定有蹊跷。
examples.english_sentence: There must be something fishy going on behind the scenes of this matter.

english_meaning: stepmother
explanation_mandarin: 指父亲再婚的妻子，不是亲生母亲。
explanation_english: The wife of one's father by a subsequent marriage; not one's biological mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個後母對佢好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 hau6 mou5 deoi3 keoi5 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的继母对他很好。
examples.english_sentence: His stepmother is very nice to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多故仔都講後母好衰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 gu3 zai2 dou1 gong2 hau6 mou5 hou2 seoi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多故事都说继母很坏。
examples.english_sentence: Many stories say that stepmothers are bad.

english_meaning: Reverse gear (in a car); setback, regress, backslide
explanation_mandarin: 汽車上的倒車檔；比喻倒退、退步，情況變得更差。
explanation_english: Literally, 'reverse gear' in a car. Figuratively, it refers to a setback, regress, or backslide in progress or situation. It implies a worsening condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排經濟唔好，公司好似行緊後波噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 haang4 gan2 hau6 bo1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，公司好像在倒退一样。
examples.english_sentence: The economy hasn't been good lately, it feels like the company is going in reverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔努力，到時咪行後波囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 nou5 lik6, dou3 si4 mai1 haang4 hau6 bo1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不努力，到时候就退步了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work hard, you'll end up regressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車入咗後波，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 jap6 zo2 hau6 bo1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车挂了倒档，要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The car is in reverse, be careful.

english_meaning: next generation; rising generation; the younger generation (often used with a sense of potential and change)
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的一代人，通常带有潜力和变革的意味。在香港，有时也指新移民或者新加入某个行业的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the younger generation, often implying potential and change. In Hong Kong, it can sometimes refer to new immigrants or newcomers to a particular industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後浪推前浪，遲早都要俾佢哋取代㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 long6 tui1 cin4 long6, ci4 zou2 dou1 jiu3 bei2 keoi5 dei6 tai3 doi6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 后浪推前浪，迟早都要被他们取代的。
examples.english_sentence: The new generation pushes the old, sooner or later we'll be replaced by them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅後浪要更加努力，先可以追得上其他地方嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hau6 long6 jiu3 gang3 gaa1 nou5 lik6, sin1 ho2 ji5 zeoi1 dak1 soeng5 kei5 taa1 dei6 fong1 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的后浪要更加努力，才可以追得上其他地方的发展。
examples.english_sentence: The younger generation in Hong Kong needs to work harder to catch up with the development in other places.

english_meaning: stepfather
explanation_mandarin: 指母亲再婚后，与母亲结婚的男性，与子女之间没有血缘关系。
explanation_english: The man who marries one's mother after the death or divorce of one's father; a stepfather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個後父對我好好，當我係親生仔咁睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 hau6 fu6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2, dong3 ngo5 hai6 can1 sang1 zai2 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的继父对我很好，把我当亲生儿子一样看待。
examples.english_sentence: My stepfather is very good to me. He treats me like his own son.

english_meaning: postmodern
explanation_mandarin: 指20世纪后期出现的一种文化、哲学和社会思潮，通常与对传统观念的解构、怀疑以及多元化的强调有关。
explanation_english: Referring to a cultural, philosophical, and social movement that emerged in the late 20th century, typically associated with deconstruction, skepticism towards traditional ideas, and an emphasis on pluralism and diversity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅設計好後現代，用咗好多唔同嘅元素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sai3 gai3 hou2 hau6 mai5 dai6, yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 yun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计很后现代，用了许多不同的元素。
examples.english_sentence: His design is very postmodern, using many different elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情好抽離，好有後現代嘅風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 chau1 lei4, hou2 yau5 hau6 mai5 dai6 ge3 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很疏离，很有后现代的风格。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very detached, with a very postmodern style.

english_meaning: young; youthful
explanation_mandarin: 形容年纪轻。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is young in age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好後生啫，唔好咁嚴厲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hau6 saang1 ze1, m4 hou2 gam2 jim4 lai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还很年轻，不要太严格了。
examples.english_sentence: He's still young, don't be so strict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲後生仔好有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 jau5 chuong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人很有创意。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays are very creative.

english_meaning: young man; young people
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的男性，也泛指年轻人（不分性别）。
explanation_english: Refers to young men, but can also generally refer to young people (regardless of gender).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲後生仔而家好鬼鍾意上網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 ji4 gaa1 hou2 gwai2 zung1 ji3 soeng5 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人非常喜欢上网。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays really love going online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個後生仔，好有活力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hau6 sang1 zai2, hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个年轻人，很有活力。
examples.english_sentence: He is a young man, very energetic.

english_meaning: Young people; youngsters
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的男孩和女孩，通常指青少年或刚成年的年轻人。
explanation_english: Refers to young boys and girls, typically teenagers or young adults.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔女真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 neoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人真的很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: Young people nowadays are really smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔明啲後生仔女諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ming4 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2 neoi5 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不明白年轻人在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: I don't understand what young people are thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個活動好受後生仔女歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 hou2 sau6 hau6 sang1 zai2 neoi5 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个活动很受年轻人欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This event is very popular among young people.

english_meaning: The younger generation is to be held in awe (lit. the young are to be feared/respected)
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻人有知识、有才能，发展潜力大，令人敬畏。
explanation_english: Describes the younger generation as possessing knowledge, talent, and great potential for development, making them worthy of respect and even a little bit intimidating. It acknowledges the potential of the youth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔真係後生可畏，咁快就升到經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 zan1 hai6 hau6 saang1 ho2 wai3, gam3 faai3 zau6 sing1 dou3 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人真是后生可畏，这么快就升到经理了。
examples.english_sentence: Today's young people are truly to be held in awe; they got promoted to manager so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小佢哋，後生可畏，將來一定會有成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5 dei6, hau6 saang1 ho2 wai3, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 wui jau5 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他们，后生可畏，将来一定会有成就。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate them, the younger generation is to be held in awe; they will definitely achieve success in the future.

english_meaning: young woman, young girl
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的女性，通常指未婚的年轻女子。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman or girl, usually unmarried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個後生女好靚女喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hau6 sang1 neoi2 hou2 leng3 neoi2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个年轻女孩很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: That young girl is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日話我唔識照顧自己，當我係後生女咁睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 m4 sik1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2, dong3 ngo5 hai6 hau6 sang1 neoi2 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈总是说我不懂得照顾自己，把我当成年轻女孩一样看待。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always says I don't know how to take care of myself and treats me like a young girl.

english_meaning: young man; young lad
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的男子，通常带有年轻有活力，经验不足的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to a young man, usually implying youthfulness, energy, and inexperience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生細仔，做嘢梗係唔夠經驗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 sai3 zai2, zou6 je5 gang2 hai6 m4 gau3 ging1 jim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个年轻小伙子，做事肯定不够经验啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's a young lad, so of course he doesn't have enough experience in doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢要交俾啲後生細仔去做，佢哋有魄力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 jiu3 gaau1 bei2 di1 hau6 saang1 sai3 zai2 heoi3 zou6, keoi5 dei6 jau5 paak3 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些事情要交给那些年轻小伙子去做，他们更有魄力一些。
examples.english_sentence: These things should be handed over to the young men to do, they are more energetic.

english_meaning: Promising future; bright prospects
explanation_mandarin: 形容年轻人前途一片光明，未来发展空间很大。
explanation_english: Describes a young person with a bright future and vast potential for future development. It signifies great promise and good prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生遙遙，將來一定有成就㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 jiu4 jiu4, jeung1 loi4 jat1 ding6 jau5 sing4 jau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他前途无量，将来一定会有成就的。
examples.english_sentence: He has a promising future; he will definitely achieve something in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班後生遙遙嘅學生，個個都好有潛力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 hau6 saang1 jiu4 jiu4 ge3 hok6 saang1, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 jau5 chim4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群前途无量的学生，个个都很有潜力。
examples.english_sentence: These students with bright prospects all have a lot of potential.

english_meaning: backing; support; backup
explanation_mandarin: 比喻支持的力量或人物。
explanation_english: Figuratively refers to a force or person providing support or backing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有你做我嘅後盾，我就唔驚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 nei5 zou6 ngo5 ge3 hau6 deon6, ngo5 zau6 m4 geng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有你做我的后盾，我就不害怕了。
examples.english_sentence: With you as my backing, I'm not afraid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸係大老細，佢做乜都有後盾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 hai6 daai6 lou5 sai3, keoi5 zou6 mat1 dou1 jau5 hau6 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸是大老板，他做什么都有后盾。
examples.english_sentence: His father is a big boss, he has backing for everything he does.

english_meaning: post-truth
explanation_mandarin: 指在公共事务中，客观事实的影响力不如情感和个人信念的情况下。 真相变成退居其次的东西。
explanation_english: Relating to or denoting circumstances in which objective facts are less influential in shaping public opinion than appeals to emotion and personal belief. Truth becomes secondary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個後眞相嘅年代，好難分辨邊啲係事實，邊啲係假新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hau6 zan1 soeng3 ge3 nin4 doi6, hou2 naan4 fan1 bin6 ge3 di1 hai6 si6 sat6, bin1 di1 hai6 gaa2 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个后真相的年代，很难分辨哪些是事实，哪些是假新闻。
examples.english_sentence: In this post-truth era, it's hard to distinguish between facts and fake news.

english_meaning: post-truth
explanation_mandarin: 指在公共事务中，客观事实的影响力不如诉诸情感和个人信念的说辞。
explanation_english: Relating to or denoting circumstances in which objective facts are less influential in shaping public opinion than appeals to emotion and personal belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺後真相嘅時代，好多人淨係信自己想信嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hau6 zan1 soeng3 ge3 si4 doi6, hou2 do1 jan4 zing6 hai6 seon3 zi6 gei2 soeng2 seon3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在后真相时代，很多人只相信自己想相信的东西。
examples.english_sentence: In the post-truth era, many people only believe what they want to believe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社會充斥住後真相嘅資訊，好難分辨真假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 wui2 cung1 cik1 zyu6 hau6 zan1 soeng3 ge3 zi1 seon3, hou2 naan4 fan1 bin6 zan1 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社会充斥着后真相的信息，很难分辨真假。
examples.english_sentence: This society is flooded with post-truth information, making it hard to distinguish between truth and falsehood.

english_meaning: slow to realize; slow on the uptake; realizing something only after it has happened
explanation_mandarin: 指事后才明白过来，反应迟钝。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to realize or understand something, often after the fact. It implies a lack of quick wit or perception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋分手咗成年，我先後知後覺，原來佢對我咁重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 fan1 sau2 zo2 sing4 nin4, ngo5 sin1 hau6 zi1 hau6 gok3, jyun4 lai4 keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 gam3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们分手一年后，我才后知后觉，原来她对我这么重要。
examples.english_sentence: It was only a year after we broke up that I realized, slow to the uptake, how important she was to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁耐都唔明我講咩，真係後知後覺㗎喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 ming4 ngo5 gong2 me1, zan1 hai6 hau6 zi1 hau6 gok3 gaa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么久都不明白我在说什么，真是后知后觉啊。
examples.english_sentence: He took so long to understand what I was saying; he's really slow on the uptake.

english_meaning: Next autumn; after autumn
explanation_mandarin: 指下一個秋天；秋天之後的時間。
explanation_english: Refers to the next autumn; the time after autumn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事擺到後秋先算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 baai2 dou3 hau6 cau1 sin1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事放到明年秋天再说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's put this matter off until next autumn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋後秋再去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hau6 cau1 zoi3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明年秋天再去旅行吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go traveling again next autumn.

english_meaning: Power amplifier (audio)
explanation_mandarin: 音响设备中，将音频信号放大到足以驱动扬声器的放大器。
explanation_english: An amplifier in an audio system that amplifies the audio signal to a level sufficient to drive the speakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機個後級好勁，啲聲好夠力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 go3 hau6 kap1 hou2 ging6, di1 seng1 hou2 gau3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器的后级功放很强，声音很有力。
examples.english_sentence: This machine's power amplifier is very powerful, the sound is very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買個新嘅後級，提升音質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 go3 san1 ge3 hau6 kap1, tai4 sing1 jam1 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一个新的后级功放，提升音质。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a new power amplifier to improve the sound quality.

english_meaning: suffix
explanation_mandarin: 附加在词语后面的部分，用以改变词义或表示语法功能。
explanation_english: A morpheme added at the end of a word to form a derivative, e.g., -ing in forming English verbal nouns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「仔」呢個字喺「櫈仔」度係一個後綴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zai2 ne1 go3 zi6 hai2 "dang3 zai2" dou6 hai6 jat1 go3 hau6 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “仔”这个字在“凳仔”里面是一个后缀。
examples.english_sentence: The word "zai" in "dang zai" (small stool) is a suffix.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學緊點樣分析英文嘅後綴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 gan2 dim2 joeng2 fan1 sik1 ying1 man2 ge3 hau6 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在学习如何分析英文的后缀。
examples.english_sentence: We are learning how to analyze suffixes in English.

english_meaning: succession; to succeed; to follow on
explanation_mandarin: 指在原来的事物或职位之后继续下去，通常指继承或接替。
explanation_english: Refers to continuing after the original thing or position, usually meaning to inherit or succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司冇人後繼，遲早執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 mou5 jan4 hau6 gwai3, ci4 zou2 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司没有人继承，迟早倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This company has no one to succeed, it will close down sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅後繼無人，好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau6 gwai3 mou5 jan4, hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的后继无人，很可惜。
examples.english_sentence: He has no successor, which is a pity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望有後繼有人，可以將呢門手藝傳承落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 jau5 hau6 gwai3 jau5 jan4, ho2 ji5 zoeng1 ni1 mun4 sau2 ngai6 cyun4 sing4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望有后继有人，可以将这门手艺传承下去。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to have successors who can pass on this craftsmanship.

english_meaning: to have successors; to have someone to carry on the torch; there are people to follow in one's footsteps
explanation_mandarin: 指有后人继承事业或学业，不会失传。
explanation_english: This idiom means there are successors who will inherit the cause or studies, so it will not be lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生人致力推廣粵劇，而家見到後繼有人，都好安慰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sang1 jan4 zhi3 lik6 tui1 gwong2 jyut6 kek6, ji4 gaa1 gin3 dou3 hau6 gai3 jau5 jan4, dou1 hou2 on1 wai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生致力于推广粤剧，现在看到后继有人，感到很欣慰。
examples.english_sentence: He devoted his life to promoting Cantonese opera, and now he is very relieved to see that there are successors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間老字號做到咁成功，最緊要都係後繼有人，唔使擔心會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 zou6 dou3 gam3 sing4 gung1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 dou1 hai6 hau6 gai3 jau5 jan4, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 wui5 zap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家老字号能做得这么成功，最重要的是后继有人，不用担心会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing for this established brand to be so successful is that there are successors, so there is no need to worry about it closing down.

english_meaning: no successor; no one to carry on the work; lacking a successor; the line ends here
explanation_mandarin: 指没有后人继承事业或事业没有接班人。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where there is no one to inherit the business or career, or the business lacks a successor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間老字號茶餐廳冇人肯接手，驚會後繼無人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 caa4 caan1 teng1 mou5 jan4 hang2 zip3 sau2, geng1 wui5 hau6 gwai3 mou4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家老字号茶餐厅没有人愿意接手，担心会后继无人。
examples.english_sentence: No one is willing to take over this old and famous 'cha chaan teng' (Hong Kong-style cafe), worried that there will be no successor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻都冇仔女，真係後繼無人，好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 dou1 mou5 zai2 neoi5, zan1 hai6 hau6 gwai3 mou4 jan4, hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么能干却没有子女，真是后继无人，很可惜。
examples.english_sentence: He is so capable, but he has no children; it's truly a case of no successor, such a pity.

english_meaning: follow-up; subsequent development; continuation
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发生之后的发展或延续。
explanation_english: Refers to the development or continuation of something after it has happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅後續發展會點樣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 hau6 zuk6 faat3 zin2 wui5 dim2 joeng2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的后续发展会怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: What will be the subsequent developments of this matter?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會密切關注後續情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 mat6 ceot3 gwaan1 zyu3 hau6 zuk6 cing4 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会密切关注后续情况。
examples.english_sentence: We will closely monitor the follow-up situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲未收到任何後續消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 mei6 sau1 dou2 jam6 ho4 hau6 zuk6 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还没有收到任何后续消息。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't received any follow-up news yet.

english_meaning: the latter
explanation_mandarin: 指前面提到的两者中的第二个。
explanation_english: Refers to the second of two things or people mentioned previously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係識佢哋兩個，但係我比較鍾意後者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 sik1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3, daan6 hai6 ngo5 bei2 gaau3 zung1 ji3 hau6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只认识他们两个，但是我比较喜欢后者。
examples.english_sentence: I only know these two people, but I prefer the latter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺紅同埋藍入面，我揀咗後者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hung4 tung4 maai4 laam4 jap6 min6, ngo5 gaan2 zo2 hau6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在红色和蓝色里面，我选择了后者。
examples.english_sentence: Between red and blue, I chose the latter.

english_meaning: back (of the body)
explanation_mandarin: 指身体的后面，脊椎骨所在的部分。
explanation_english: The back of the body, the part where the spine is located.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日舉重整親條後背。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 geoi2 cung5 zing2 can1 tiu4 hau6 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天举重伤到了后背。
examples.english_sentence: I hurt my back lifting weights yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我捽吓條後背。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 seot1 haa5 tiu4 hau6 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我搓一下后背。
examples.english_sentence: He helps me rub my back.

english_meaning: behind someone's back; secretly; underhandedly
explanation_mandarin: 指在某人不知情的情况下，暗地里进行某种行为或活动。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something secretly or underhandedly, without the knowledge or consent of the person concerned. Often implies a negative action or hidden motive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後背底搞咁多嘢，真係唔知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 bui3 dai2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在背后搞这么多事，真不知道他想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing so much behind my back, I really don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好後背底話人，有咩就當面講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hau6 bui3 dai2 waa6 jan4, jau5 me1 zau6 dong1 min6 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在背后说人，有什么就当面说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about people behind their backs, say what you have to say to their face.

english_meaning: back of the head
explanation_mandarin: 头部后方，颈部以上的部位
explanation_english: The back of the head, the part above the neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親撞到後腦，暈咗一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1 zong6 dou3 hau6 nou5, wan4 zo2 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒撞到了后脑勺，晕了一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and hit the back of his head, and was unconscious for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後腦痕到不得了，幫我攞梳抓下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 nou5 han4 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, bong1 ngo5 lo2 so1 zaau2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的后脑勺痒得不得了，帮我拿梳子挠一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The back of my head is incredibly itchy, please get me a comb to scratch it.

english_meaning: backyard; back garden; (figurative) place for relaxation and leisure
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义指房屋后面的花园。引申意义指可以放松和休闲的地方。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the garden behind a house. Figuratively, it refers to a place for relaxation and leisure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺屋企嘅後花園種下花，好寫意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei2 ge3 hau6 faa1 jyun4 zung3 haa5 faa1, hou2 se2 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢在家的后花园种些花，很惬意的。
examples.english_sentence: He likes planting flowers in the backyard of his house; it's very relaxing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒吧對我嚟講就好似後花園咁，得閒就會去飲杯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 baa1 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 zau6 hou2 ci5 hau6 faa1 jyun4 gam2, dak1 haan4 zau6 wui5 heoi3 yam2 bui1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家酒吧对我来说就像后花园一样，有空就会去喝一杯。
examples.english_sentence: That bar is like my backyard, I go there for a drink whenever I'm free.

english_meaning: defender (sports)
explanation_mandarin: 体育运动中，负责防守的队员。
explanation_english: A player in a sports team whose primary role is to defend their team's goal or territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係球隊嘅後衛，好擅長攔截。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kau4 deoi2 ge3 hau6 wai6, hou2 sin6 coeng4 laan4 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是球队的后卫，很擅长拦截。
examples.english_sentence: He's the team's defender and is very good at tackling.

english_meaning: Defender (sports)
explanation_mandarin: 在足球、篮球等体育运动中，负责防守的队员。
explanation_english: In sports like football (soccer) and basketball, a player responsible for defense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係球隊嘅後衛，防守好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kau4 deoi2 ge3 hau6 wai6, fong4 sau2 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是球队的后卫，防守很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a defender of the team, he's a very skilled defender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練話今年要加強後衛嘅訓練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 waa6 gam1 nin4 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 hau6 wai6 ge3 fan3 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练说今年要加强后卫的训练。
examples.english_sentence: The coach said they need to strengthen the defender's training this year.

english_meaning: Defender (sports)
explanation_mandarin: 在足球、篮球等体育运动中，负责防守对方进攻的队员。
explanation_english: In sports like football (soccer) and basketball, a player whose primary role is to defend and prevent the opposing team from scoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係球隊嘅後衞，防守好勁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kau4 deoi2 ge3 hau6 wai6, fong4 sau2 hou2 ging6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是球队的后卫，防守很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He's the team's defender, his defense is very strong.

english_meaning: descendant; posterity
explanation_mandarin: 指后代子孙。
explanation_english: Descendants; offspring; posterity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係黃帝嘅後裔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 wong4 dai3 ge3 hau6 jeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是黄帝的后裔。
examples.english_sentence: They are descendants of the Yellow Emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要保護環境，為後裔留低美好嘅世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2, wai6 hau6 jeoi6 lau4 dai1 mei5 hou2 ge3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要保护环境，为后代留下美好的世界。
examples.english_sentence: We need to protect the environment and leave a beautiful world for our descendants.

english_meaning: reserve; standby; to be on the waiting list
explanation_mandarin: （动词）作为候补；（名词）等待的人，备用的人或物。
explanation_english: (verb) to be on the waiting list; (noun) a reserve; a standby; someone or something that is available to replace someone or something else if needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋報咗名參加比賽，但係而家仲係後補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bou3 zo2 meng2 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 zung2 hai6 hau6 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们报名参加比赛了，但是现在还是候补。
examples.english_sentence: We signed up for the competition, but we're still on the waiting list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話如果有人甩底，我就可以後補上場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 lat1 dai2, ngo5 zau6 ho2 ji5 hau6 bou2 soeng5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说如果有人退出，我就可以作为候补上场。
examples.english_sentence: He said if someone drops out, I can play as a substitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於反應熱烈，佢哋決定加多啲後補位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 faan2 jing3 jit6 lit6, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 do1 di1 hau6 bou2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于反响热烈，他们决定增加一些候补位置。
examples.english_sentence: Due to popular demand, they decided to add more reserve slots.

synonyms: 候補 (hau6 bou6) - formal written form

english_meaning: post-production
explanation_mandarin: 在拍摄完成之后进行的制作过程，包括剪辑、特效、调色、配音等。
explanation_english: The process of editing and producing a film or video after filming is complete, including editing, visual effects, color grading, and audio mixing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅後製做得好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 hau6 zai3 zou6 dak1 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的后期制作做得真漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: The post-production of this movie is beautifully done!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要趕工做埋啲後製先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gon2 gung1 zou6 maai4 di1 hau6 zai3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须赶工完成后期制作才行。
examples.english_sentence: We need to rush to finish the post-production.

english_meaning: postscript, afterword
explanation_mandarin: 书、文章等正文后面的补充说明、感想或总结。
explanation_english: An afterword or postscript, usually found at the end of a book or article, containing supplementary information, reflections, or a summary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書嘅後記寫得幾好，作者分享咗好多創作靈感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ge3 hau6 gei3 se2 dak1 gei2 hou2, zok3 ze2 fan1 hoeng2 zo2 hou2 do1 chong3 zok3 ling4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的后记写得很好，作者分享了很多创作灵感。
examples.english_sentence: The postscript of this book is well-written; the author shared a lot of creative inspiration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常會睇完本書嘅內容先睇後記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tai2 jyun4 bun2 syu1 ge3 noi6 yung4 sin1 tai2 hau6 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常看完书的内容才看后记。
examples.english_sentence: I usually read the content of the book before reading the afterword.

english_meaning: sequel; what happens later; the rest of the story; further developments
explanation_mandarin: 指事情之后发生的事或后来要说的话。
explanation_english: Refers to what happens later or what will be said later. It often implies that the details will be discussed or revealed at a later time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點解佢咁做，呢個係後話，遲啲再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 keoi5 gam2 zou6, ni1 go3 hai6 hau6 waa6, ci4 di1 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为什么这么做，这是后话，晚点再说。
examples.english_sentence: Why he did that is the rest of the story. We'll talk about it later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋點樣解決咗件事係後話，最緊要係依家冇事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 gin6 si6 hai6 hau6 waa6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 ji1 ga1 mou5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们怎么样解决这件事是后话，最重要的是现在没事了。
examples.english_sentence: How they resolved the matter is the rest of the story. The most important thing is that everything is fine now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋贏咗比賽先，攞獎嘅後話之後再諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jeng4 zo2 bei2 coi3 sin1, lo2 zoeng2 ge3 hau6 waa6 zi1 hau6 zoi3 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先赢了比赛，领奖的后话之后再想。
examples.english_sentence: Let's win the competition first. We'll think about receiving the award later.

english_meaning: rising star; up-and-comer; a promising newcomer
explanation_mandarin: 指后来出现的或新成长起来的优秀人物。
explanation_english: Refers to outstanding people who appear or grow up later; a talented individual who has recently emerged and is expected to achieve great things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司係後起之秀，好快就升咗做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hai6 hau6 hei2 zi1 sau3, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司是后起之秀，很快就升为了经理。
examples.english_sentence: He is a rising star in the company and was quickly promoted to manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樂壇近年都有唔少後起之秀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ngok6 taan4 gan6 nin4 dou1 jau5 m4 siu2 hau6 hei2 zi1 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港乐坛近年来也有不少后起之秀。
examples.english_sentence: There have been many up-and-comers in the Hong Kong music scene in recent years.

english_meaning: way out; means of retreat; contingency plan; backup plan
explanation_mandarin: 指预留的退路或备用方案。
explanation_english: Refers to a pre-arranged way out, means of retreat, or a backup plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做嘢一定要留定後路，唔可以咁衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lau4 ding6 hau6 lou6, m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做事一定要留有退路，不能这么冲动。
examples.english_sentence: We must have a backup plan when we do things, we can't be so impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工做得唔開心，所以開始搵定後路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 m4 hoi1 sam1, so2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 wan2 ding6 hau6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作做得不开心，所以开始找退路。
examples.english_sentence: He is not happy with his job, so he is starting to look for a way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買保險都係為咗自己留番條後路啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 bou2 him2 dou1 hai6 wai4 zo2 zi6 gei2 lau4 faan1 tiu4 hau6 lou6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买保险也是为了给自己留条后路而已。
examples.english_sentence: He buys insurance just to have a backup plan for himself.

english_meaning: to lag behind, to be slow in understanding, to be a step behind
explanation_mandarin: 形容理解力或行动反应迟缓，跟不上节奏。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to understand or react, lagging behind the others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉數慢，成日都後踿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 sou3 maan6, seng4 jat6 dou1 hau6 dap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他反应慢，总是慢半拍。
examples.english_sentence: He is slow to react and always a step behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁後踿啦，快啲跟上進度啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau6 dap6 laa1, faai3 di1 gan1 soeng5 zeon3 dou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要那么落后了，快点跟上进度吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow in doing things, catch up with the progress.

english_meaning: junior, younger generation, protege
explanation_mandarin: 指比自己资历浅，辈分低的年轻人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are younger or have less seniority than oneself; a junior, a younger generation member, or a protege.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋公司嘅後輩，好有潛力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 hau6 bui3, hou2 jau5 cim4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们公司的后辈，很有潜力。
examples.english_sentence: He's a junior in our company, very promising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要好好提拔啲後輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 tai4 bat6 di1 hau6 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要好好提拔后辈。
examples.english_sentence: We need to nurture the younger generation well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為前輩，我應該照顧下啲後輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 cin4 bui3, ngo5 ying1 goi1 ziu3 gu3 haa5 di1 hau6 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为前辈，我应该照顾一下后辈。
examples.english_sentence: As a senior, I should take care of the juniors.

english_meaning: to retreat; to fall back; to move backwards; to regress
explanation_mandarin: 向后移动；退步；倒退。
explanation_english: To move backwards; to retreat; to fall back; to regress (in progress or development).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再後退啲，我就影唔到你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 hau6 teoi3 di1, ngo5 zau6 ying2 m4 dou2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再往后退一点，我就拍不到你了。
examples.english_sentence: If you move back any further, I won't be able to take your picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟好似有啲後退噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 hou2 ci5 yau5 di1 hau6 teoi3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济好像有些倒退的样子。
examples.english_sentence: The economy seems to be regressing a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到後退咗一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 dou3 hau6 teoi3 zo2 yat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得后退了一步。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he took a step back.

english_meaning: sequelae; aftereffects; complications (after an illness or event)
explanation_mandarin: 指疾病或事故后遗留的症状或影响。
explanation_english: The aftereffects or lingering consequences of an illness, injury, or traumatic event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場車禍搞到佢有啲後遺症，成日頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 ce1 wo6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 jau5 di1 hau6 wai4 zing3, seng4 jat6 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那场车祸让他留下了一些后遗症，经常头痛。
examples.english_sentence: That car accident left him with some aftereffects; he gets headaches all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷過疫情之後，經濟都仲有好多後遺症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 gwo3 jik6 ching4 zi1 hau6, ging1 zai3 dou1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 hau6 wai4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历过疫情之后，经济还有很多后遗症。
examples.english_sentence: After the pandemic, the economy still has many aftereffects.

english_meaning: consequences, to clean up a mess, to deal with the aftermath
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情發生後所留下的爛攤子或不良後果。也可以用作動詞，表示收拾爛攤子，處理後果。
explanation_english: Refers to the aftermath or consequences of an event, often implying a messy or undesirable situation. It can also be used as a verb, meaning to clean up the mess or deal with the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞成咁嘅樣，我要幫佢執後鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 sing4 gam2 ge3 joeng2, ngo5 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 zap1 hau6 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搞成这样，我要帮他收拾残局。
examples.english_sentence: He made such a mess, I have to clean it up for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做，到時邊個幫你孭後鑊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6, dou3 si4 bin1 go3 bong1 nei5 be1 hau6 wok6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，到时候谁帮你承担后果啊？
examples.english_sentence: If you do that, who will bear the consequences for you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動，諗清楚有咩後鑊先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6, nam2 cing1 co2 jau5 me1 hau6 wok6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么冲动，想清楚有什么后果再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive, think clearly about the consequences first.

english_meaning: Back door; back entrance; going through the back door; under-the-table dealings; to pull strings; to use connections
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是建筑物后面的门，引申指通过不正当手段或关系获得好处，走捷径。
explanation_english: Literally means back door or rear entrance. Figuratively, it refers to obtaining benefits or advantages through improper means, connections, or influence; taking shortcuts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入呢間公司係行後門㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 haang4 hau6 mun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他进这家公司是走后门的。
examples.english_sentence: He got into this company through connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以行後門，考試要靠自己實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 haang4 hau6 mun4, haau2 si5 jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着可以走后门，考试要靠自己的实力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can pull strings, you have to rely on your own ability in the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲嘢好難搞，冇後門根本做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 je5 hou2 naan4 gaau2, mou5 hau6 mun4 gan1 bun2 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这些事情很难办，没有后门根本做不成事。
examples.english_sentence: These things are very difficult to handle now. Without using connections, you can't get anything done at all.

english_meaning: defense (rear guard); back line (sports)
explanation_mandarin: 指后面防守的区域或人员，多用于体育比赛中。
explanation_english: Refers to the area or personnel responsible for defense at the rear, often used in sports games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅後防企得好穩，對手好難入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 hau6 fong4 kei5 dak1 hou2 wan2, deoi3 sau2 hou2 naan4 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的后防站得很稳，对手很难进球。
examples.english_sentence: Our defense is very solid; it's hard for the opponent to score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係球隊嘅後防主力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kau4 deoi2 ge3 hau6 fong4 zyu2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是球队的后防主力。
examples.english_sentence: He is the main defender of the team.

mandarin_meaning: 后院; 比喻自己的势力范围或地盘
english_meaning: backyard; behind the scenes; one's own territory or sphere of influence (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义指房屋后面的院子。 比喻自己的势力范围，通常用于负面语境。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the backyard of a house. Figuratively, it refers to one's own territory or sphere of influence, often used in a negative context, implying something happening in secret or behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司搞小動作，搞到成個後院都烏煙瘴氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 gaau2 siu2 dung6 zok3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 hau6 jyun2 dou1 wu1 yin1 zong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在公司里搞小动作，搞得整个公司内部乌烟瘴气。
examples.english_sentence: He's always stirring up trouble at the company, making the whole place a mess behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我後院搞事啊，唔係我唔放過你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 hau6 jyun2 gaau2 si6 aa3, m4 hai6 ngo5 m4 fong3 gwo3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在我的地盘上闹事，不然我不会放过你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble in my territory, or I won't let you get away with it.

english_meaning: back; behind; rear
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个物体或位置的后方。
explanation_english: Refers to the back side of something; the rear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我企喺你後面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kei5 hai2 nei5 hau6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我站在你后面。
examples.english_sentence: I'm standing behind you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋後面有個花園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hau6 min6 jau5 go3 faa1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子后面有一个花园。
examples.english_sentence: There's a garden behind the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路跟住我後面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 gan1 zoek6 ngo5 hau6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直跟着在我后面。
examples.english_sentence: He was following behind me all the way.

english_meaning: behind; at the back; later
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置在後方，時間在稍後。
explanation_english: Refers to a position behind or a time later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我後頭排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 hau6 tau4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我後面排隊。
examples.english_sentence: He is queuing behind me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後頭再覆你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 tau4 zoi3 fuk1 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我之后再回复你吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll reply to you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇人哋後頭，要向前望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 jan4 dei6 hau6 tau4, jiu3 hoeng3 cin4 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要看别人的后面，要向前看。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look at what others have behind them, look forward.

english_meaning: worries about the future; fear of trouble in the rear (idiom)
explanation_mandarin: 指来自后方的顾虑和担忧，担心日后出现问题。
explanation_english: Refers to concerns and worries coming from the rear, worrying about problems that may arise in the future. Often used to describe the desire to settle something before moving on to other things to avoid future problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂啲文件先，唔想有後顧之憂嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 di1 man4 gin2 sin1, m4 soeng2 jau5 hau6 gu3 zi1 yau1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把这些文件处理好，不想有后顾之忧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's get these documents sorted out first, I don't want any worries about the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢解決咗家庭嘅問題，咁就可以全心全意做嘢，冇後顧之憂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 gaa1 ting4 ge3 man6 tai4, gam2 zau6 ho2 ji5 cyun4 sam1 cyun4 ji3 zou6 je5, mou5 hau6 gu3 zi1 yau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他解决了家庭的问题，这样就可以全心全意工作，没有后顾之忧了。
examples.english_sentence: He solved the family problem, so now he can wholeheartedly focus on work, without worries about the future.

english_meaning: slowly, gently, unhurriedly, surname Xu
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词, 动词, 名词
explanation_mandarin: 形容速度慢，不着急；舒缓；也用作姓氏。
explanation_english: Describes something slow, not in a hurry; gentle, unhurried. Also used as a surname (Xu).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢徐徐咁，好有耐性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ceoi4 ceoi4 gam2, hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话慢慢的，很有耐心。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks slowly and patiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風徐徐吹來，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 ceoi4 ceoi4 ceoi1 loi4, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风缓缓吹来，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The wind is blowing gently, it's very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 徐先生
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 sin1 saang1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 徐先生
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Xu

english_meaning: An aging woman who still tries to be alluring; past her prime but still trying to attract attention; a middle-aged woman who is still very charming or flirtatious.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻年老色衰，但仍旧风骚的妇人。出自南朝徐娘的故事。指中年以后仍然卖弄风情的女子，通常含贬义。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to a middle-aged woman who is past her prime but still tries to be charming and alluring, often in a flirtatious way. It originates from the story of Lady Xu in the Southern Dynasties. It usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都差唔多五十歲啦，仲成日化到徐娘半老咁，真係唔知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 caa1 m4 do1 ng5 sap6 seoi3 laa1, zung6 sing4 jat6 faa3 dou3 ceoi4 noeng4 bun3 lou5 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她都快五十岁了，还总是打扮得像半老徐娘一样，真不知道她想做什么。
examples.english_sentence: She's almost fifty, and she still dresses up like a middle-aged woman trying to be alluring. I really don't know what she's trying to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下佢啊，成日覺得自己仲後生女咁，徐娘半老，風韻猶存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 aa3, sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 zung6 hau6 saang1 neoi2 gam2, ceoi4 noeng4 bun3 lou5, fung1 wan5 jau4 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看她，总是觉得自己还像年轻女孩一样，半老徐娘，风韵犹存。
examples.english_sentence: Look at her, she always thinks she is still a young girl, a middle-aged woman trying to be alluring, with lingering charm.

english_meaning: slowly, gently, gradually
explanation_mandarin: 形容速度缓慢。多指速度非常慢，或者事情逐渐发生。
explanation_english: Describes something happening slowly or gradually. Often refers to a very slow pace or a process unfolding over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車徐徐噉駛走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ceoi4 ceoi4 gam2 sai2 zou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汽车缓缓地开走了。
examples.english_sentence: The car slowly drove away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢徐徐噉行埋嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceoi4 ceoi4 gam2 haang4 maai4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他慢慢地走了过来。
examples.english_sentence: He slowly walked over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日頭徐徐咁落山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 tau4 ceoi4 ceoi4 gam3 lok6 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳慢慢地落山了。
examples.english_sentence: The sun slowly set.

mandarin_meaning: 直接，筆直; 快捷方式，小路
english_meaning: Direct, straight; shortcut, narrow path
explanation_mandarin: 形容詞時，指直接的，不拐彎抹角的。名詞時，指狹窄的小路，或比喻快速便捷的方法。
explanation_english: As an adjective, it means direct or straight. As a noun, it refers to a narrow path or a quick and convenient method (figuratively).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路咁窄，行條徑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 gam3 zaak3, haang4 tiu4 ging3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路这么窄，走小路吧。
examples.english_sentence: The road is so narrow, let's take the shortcut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好徑，唔會轉彎抹角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 ging3, m4 wui5 zyun2 waan1 mut3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很直接，不会拐弯抹角。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very directly; he doesn't beat around the bush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有冇徑可以快啲去到機場呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 mou5 ging3 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 heoi3 dou3 gei1 coeng4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有没有快捷方式可以更快地到达机场啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is there a shortcut to get to the airport faster?

english_meaning: in vain; futile; to no avail
explanation_mandarin: 表示白白地，没有效果。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something in vain, without achieving any results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 徙氣啫，都冇用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 hei3 ze1, dou1 mou5 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 浪费力气而已，都没用的。
examples.english_sentence: It's just a waste of effort, it's all useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁做徙然㗎，唔會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 zou6 tou4 yin4 gaa3, m4 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做是徒劳的，不会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is futile, it won't succeed.

english_meaning: disciple; apprentice; (term of endearment) dear apprentice
explanation_mandarin: 指跟隨師父學習技藝的人。也可用作親暱的稱呼，多用於師父對徒弟。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who follows a master to learn a skill or art. It can also be used as an affectionate term, mostly by the master towards the apprentice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 徒兒，你學得好快喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 ji4, nei5 hok6 dak1 hou2 faai3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 徒弟，你学得很快啊！
examples.english_sentence: My dear apprentice, you learn so fast!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師父，徒兒唔明白呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2, tou4 ji4 m4 ming4 baak6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅，徒弟不明白啊。
examples.english_sentence: Master, the disciple doesn't understand.

english_meaning: imprisonment, penal servitude
explanation_mandarin: 指剥夺人身自由的刑罚，根据刑期长短可分为有期徒刑、无期徒刑等。
explanation_english: A form of punishment that deprives a person of their freedom. It can be divided into fixed-term imprisonment and life imprisonment depending on the length of the sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為打劫銀行，判咗五年徒刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 daa2 gip3 ngan4 hong4, pun3 zo2 ng5 nin4 tou4 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为抢劫银行，被判了五年徒刑。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to five years of imprisonment for robbing a bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅罪行好嚴重，隨時會被判終身徒刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zeoi6 hang4 hou2 jim4 zung6, ceoi4 si4 wui5 bei6 pun3 zung1 san1 tou4 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的罪行很严重，随时会被判终身徒刑。
examples.english_sentence: His crimes are very serious, he could be sentenced to life imprisonment at any time.

english_meaning: to work in vain; to make a futile effort
explanation_mandarin: 白白付出劳动而没有成效。指做了无用功。
explanation_english: To expend effort without achieving any result; to be a fruitless effort; wasted effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋噉樣做落去都係徒勞無功啫，不如諗下第啲方法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam2 joeng2 zou6 lok6 heoi3 dou1 hai6 tou4 lou4 mou4 gung1 ze1, bat1 jyu4 nam2 haa5 dai6 di1 fong1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这样继续做下去也是徒劳无功而已，不如想想其他方法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Continuing like this is just a futile effort, why don't we think of other methods?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同佢講道理都係徒勞無功㗎，佢根本唔會聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou6 lei5 dou1 hai6 tou4 lou4 mou4 gung1 gaa3, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和他讲道理也是徒劳无功的，他根本不会听。
examples.english_sentence: It's a futile effort to reason with him, he simply won't listen.

english_meaning: disciples and their descendants (followers); a large group of followers
explanation_mandarin: 指徒弟和徒孙，比喻数量众多的追随者或门生。
explanation_english: Refers to disciples and their descendants, figuratively meaning a large number of followers or students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲徒子徒孫遍佈成個行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tou4 zi2 tou4 syun1 pin3 bou3 sing4 go3 hong4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的徒弟和徒孙遍布整个行业。
examples.english_sentence: His disciples and followers are all over the industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢退休之後，佢嘅徒子徒孫就繼續發揚光大佢嘅理念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 teoi3休jau1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 tou4 zi2 tou4 syun1 zau6 gai3 zuk6 faat3 joeng4 gwong1 daai6 keoi5 ge3 lei5 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他退休以后，他的徒弟和徒孙就继续发扬光大他的理念。
examples.english_sentence: Since he retired, his disciples and followers have continued to promote and develop his ideas.

english_meaning: apprentice, disciple, student
explanation_mandarin: 学习技艺的人，跟随师傅学习的人。
explanation_english: A person learning a craft or skill; a student who follows a master.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅徒弟，學咗三年功夫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tou4 dai2, hok6 zo2 saam1 nin4 gung1 fu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的徒弟，学了三年功夫了。
examples.english_sentence: He's my apprentice, he's been learning Kung Fu for three years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收徒弟唔容易㗎，要睇品德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 tou4 dai2 m4 jung4 yi6 gaa3, jiu3 tai2 ban2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收徒弟不容易啊，要看品德。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to take on an apprentice, you have to look at their character.

english_meaning: barehanded; unarmed; empty-handed
explanation_mandarin: 指不使用任何工具或武器，只用手。
explanation_english: Referring to doing something with bare hands, without using any tools or weapons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢徒手爬上咗棟樓嘅外牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tou4 sau2 paa4 soeng5 zo2 dung6 lau4 ge3 ngoi6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他徒手爬上了大楼的外墙。
examples.english_sentence: He climbed up the outer wall of the building barehanded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好徒手摸啲化學品呀，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tou4 sau2 mo2 di1 faa3 hok6 ban2 aa3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要徒手触摸那些化学品啊，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch those chemicals barehanded, it's very dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢徒手將塊石劈開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tou4 sau2 zoeng1 faai3 sek6 pek1 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他徒手将石头劈开了。
examples.english_sentence: He split the stone open with his bare hands.

english_meaning: to hike; to walk on foot
explanation_mandarin: 指步行，尤指长距离的步行或远足。
explanation_english: To walk, especially for a long distance or as a form of recreation; to hike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去行山徒步啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1 tou4 bou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去爬山徒步吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go hiking tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意徒步旅行，周圍去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tou4 bou6 leoi5 hang4, zau1 wai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢徒步旅行，到处去。
examples.english_sentence: He likes hiking a lot and goes everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔趕時間，我哋不如徒步過去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gaan2 si4 gaan3, ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 tou4 bou6 gwo3 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果时间不赶，我们不如步行过去吧。
examples.english_sentence: If we are not in a hurry, how about we walk there?

english_meaning: in vain; futile; to no avail
explanation_mandarin: 表示白费力气，没有得到预期的结果。
explanation_english: Describes an action or effort that is unsuccessful and produces no useful result; in vain, futile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搞咗咁耐，到頭嚟都係徒然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou3 tau4 lai4 dou1 hai6 tou4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们搞了这么久，到头来都是徒劳。
examples.english_sentence: We've been working on this for so long, and in the end, it's all been in vain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再勸佢都係徒然㗎啦，佢唔會聽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 hyun3 keoi5 dou1 hai6 tou4 jin4 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 m4 wui5 teng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再劝他也是徒劳的，他不会听的。
examples.english_sentence: It's futile to try to persuade him again, he won't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇用㗎，你點做都係徒然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 yung6 gaa3, nei5 dim2 zou6 dou1 hai6 tou4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没用的，你做什么都是徒劳。
examples.english_sentence: It's useless, whatever you do will be in vain.

synonyms: 白費心機 (baak6 fai3 sam1 gei1)

mandarin_meaning: 可以, 行, 得到, 完成, 好
english_meaning: Can, may, able to, get, obtain, all right, done, finished
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词, 形容词, 助词
explanation_mandarin: “得”在粤语中用法广泛，可以表示“可以”、“行”、“得到”、“完成”、“好”等多种含义。具体意义需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: "Dak1" is a versatile word in Cantonese, meaning "can", "may", "able to", "get", "obtain", "all right", "done", "finished", etc. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得喇，我知喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 laa3, ngo5 zi1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，我知道了。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, I know already.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚得唔得閒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有没有空？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考試得咗一百分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 si5 dak1 zo2 jat1 baak3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考试考了一百分。
examples.english_sentence: I got 100 marks on the exam.

english_meaning: To want more after getting something; to be insatiable; to get an inch and want a mile.
explanation_mandarin: 得到了一点，还想得到更多。形容贪得无厌。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is never satisfied. After getting something, they immediately want something even better or more significant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁得一想二啦，有人肯幫手已經好好㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 dak1 jat1 soeng2 ji6 laa1, jau5 jan4 hang2 bong1 sau2 ji5 ging1 hou2 hou2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么得寸进尺了，有人愿意帮忙已经很好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so insatiable. It's already good that someone is willing to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工已經唔錯，但係佢仲得一想二，想升職加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 ji5 ging1 m4 co3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zung6 dak1 jat1 soeng2 ji6, soeng2 sing1 zik1 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资已经不错了，但是他仍然得寸进尺，想要升职加薪。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is already good, but he's still insatiable and wants a promotion and a raise.

synonyms: 貪得無厭 (taam1 dak1 mou4 jim3)

jyutping: dak1 soeng5 cong4 hin1 bei6 am1
english_meaning: To get into bed and immediately complain about being too hot under the covers; To be quick to criticize after barely getting started; To be fussy and complain easily.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻刚开始做某事就开始挑剔、抱怨，或者对事物要求过高，不切实际。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who starts complaining as soon as they begin something, or who has unrealistic and overly demanding expectations from the very beginning. It implies impatience and a tendency to criticize prematurely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢就係咁，得上床掀被罯，乜都嫌三嫌四。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢zeon6 hai6 gam2, dak1 soeng5 cong4 hin1 bei6 am1, mat1 dou1 him4 saam1 him4 sei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事就是这样，刚上床就嫌被子热，什么都挑三拣四。
examples.english_sentence: That's how he is with work. He complains about everything as soon as he starts, being picky about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁得上床掀被罯啦，俾啲時間自己適應吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 dak1 soeng5 cong4 hin1 bei6 am1 laa1, bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 zi6 gei2 sik1 ying3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别刚上床就嫌被子热了，给自己一些时间适应一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quick to complain; give yourself some time to adjust.

synonyms: 吹毛求疵 (ceoi1 mou1 kau4 ci1)

jyutping: dak1 soeng5 cong4 hin1 pei5 am1
english_meaning: To take an inch and want a mile; to keep pushing boundaries; to take advantage of someone's generosity.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人贪得无厌，得到一点好处就想得到更多，不停地得寸进尺。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is insatiable, constantly wanting more and more after receiving a small favor or benefit; pushing the limits of generosity or tolerance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁得上牀掀被罯啦，人哋幫你一次唔代表佢要幫你一世㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai1 gam3 dak1 soeng5 cong4 hin1 pei5 am1 laa1, jan4 dei6 bong1 nei5 jat1 ci3 m4 doi6 biu2 keoi5 jiu3 bong1 nei5 jat1 sai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么得寸进尺了，别人帮你一次不代表他要帮你一辈子啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so greedy. Just because someone helps you once doesn't mean they have to help you forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係得上牀掀被罯，借咗佢幾百蚊，佢依家仲想借多幾千。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 dak1 soeng5 cong4 hin1 pei5 am1, ze3 zo2 keoi5 gei2 baak3 man1, keoi5 ji1 gaa1 zung6 soeng2 ze3 do1 gei2 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是得寸进尺，借了他几百块钱，他现在还想借几千。
examples.english_sentence: He's really taking advantage. I lent him a few hundred dollars, and now he wants to borrow several thousand more.

synonyms: 貪得無厭 (taam1 dak1 mou4 jim3)
蹬鼻子上臉 (dang3 bei6 zi2 soeng5 lim5)

english_meaning: to gain little at great cost; more trouble than it's worth; the gain does not make up for the loss
explanation_mandarin: 得到的利益抵偿不了所受的损失。
explanation_english: The gain is not worth the loss; the benefits gained do not outweigh the cost or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗慳嗰少少錢，結果搞到架車壞咗，真係得不償失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 haan1 go2 siu2 siu2 cin2, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 gaa1 ce1 waai6 zo2, zan1 hai6 dak1 bat1 soeng4 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了省那一点钱，结果导致车坏了，真是得不偿失。
examples.english_sentence: Trying to save that little bit of money resulted in the car breaking down, it's really more trouble than it's worth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你為咗贏呢場比賽，搞到自己受傷，咁就得不償失啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai4 zo2 jeng4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 sau6 soeng1, gam2 zau6 dak1 bat1 soeng4 sat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为了赢这场比赛，搞得自己受伤，那就得不偿失了。
examples.english_sentence: If you injure yourself trying to win this competition, then it's not worth it.

english_meaning: winner; recipient; prize winner
explanation_mandarin: 指获得某种东西或奖项的人，强调得奖或获得的身份。
explanation_english: Refers to the person who wins something, receives an award, or is the recipient of something. It emphasizes the status of being a winner or receiver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今次大抽獎嘅得主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 ci3 daai6 cau1 zoeng2 ge3 dak1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这次抽奖的得主。
examples.english_sentence: He is the winner of this grand lottery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要恭喜今屆金像獎嘅最佳男主角得主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gung1 hei2 gam1 gaai3 gam1 zoeng6 zoeng2 ge3 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3 dak1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要恭喜这届金像奖的最佳男主角得主。
examples.english_sentence: We would like to congratulate the Best Actor winner of this year's Hong Kong Film Awards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢變成咗幸運兒，成為咗頭獎得主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bin3 sing4 zo2 hang6 wan6 ji4, sing4 wai4 zo2 tau4 zoeng2 dak1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他变成了幸运儿，成为了头奖得主。
examples.english_sentence: He became a lucky person and became the first prize winner.

english_meaning: That's enough; Alright; Okay; Fine; Used to indicate agreement or acceptance.
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意、认可、足够或停止的意思。常用于口语中。
explanation_english: Expresses agreement, acceptance, sufficiency, or a signal to stop. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得了得了，唔好再講啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 liu5 dak1 liu5, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了好了，别再说了！
examples.english_sentence: Alright, alright, don't say anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得了，我知啦，我會做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 liu5, ngo5 zi1 laa1, ngo5 wui5 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，我知道了，我会做的。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, I know, I will do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得喇，唔好阻住我做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 laa3, m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，别打扰我工作。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, don't bother me while I'm working.

jyutping: dak1 se1 hou2 ji3 seoi1 wui4 sau2
mandarin_meaning: 别人对你好，也要懂得回报
english_meaning: Return kindness when you receive it; One good turn deserves another.
explanation_mandarin: 表示受到别人的恩惠或帮助时，应该懂得感恩并给予回报。强调礼尚往来。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the importance of reciprocating kindness or favors received. It emphasizes the principle of reciprocity and gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁幫你，你都要得些好意須回手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 bong1 nei5, nei5 dou1 jiu3 dak1 se1 hou2 ji3 seoi1 wui4 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么帮你，你也要懂得回报的。
examples.english_sentence: He helped you so much, you should reciprocate his kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日送啲餸畀我哋，得些好意須回手，我哋都應該買啲嘢送返畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 sung3 di1 sung3 bei2 ngo5 dei6, dak1 se1 hou2 ji3 seoi1 wui4 sau2, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jing1 goi1 maai5 di1 je5 sung3 faan1 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是送一些菜给我们，得些好意须回手，我们都应该买些东西送回去给她。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always gives us food, we should reciprocate her kindness and buy something to give back to her.

english_meaning: likable; to be well-liked; to be popular
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很招人喜欢，很受欢迎。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is well-liked, popular, and attracts fondness from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好得意，好得人鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 dak1 ji3, hou2 dak1 jan4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很可爱，很讨人喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He is very cute and very likable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅主角好得人鍾意，所以票房好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zyu2 gok3 hou2 dak1 jan4 zung1 ji3, so2 ji5 piu3 fong2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的主角很讨人喜欢，所以票房很好。
examples.english_sentence: The protagonist of this movie is very likable, so the box office is very good.

english_meaning: to win the hearts of the people, popular, well-liked
explanation_mandarin: 得到人民的拥护和爱戴，形容非常受欢迎。
explanation_english: To win the support and affection of the people, describing someone or something as very popular and well-liked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅政策好得人心，所以好多人支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zing3 caak3 hou2 dak1 jan4 sam1, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 zi1 chi4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的政策很得人心，所以很多人支持他。
examples.english_sentence: His policies are very popular, so many people support him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食又好味又抵食，真係好得人心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 jau6 hou2 mei6 jau6 dai2 sik6, zan1 hai6 hou2 dak1 jan4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物又好吃又实惠，真的很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's food is delicious and affordable, it's really popular.

synonyms: 受人愛戴 (sau6 jan4 oi3 dai3)

english_meaning: frightening; intimidating; scary; someone who makes others afraid
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事让人感到害怕或恐惧。可以指外貌凶恶，也可以指行为令人不安。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is frightening, intimidating, or makes others feel afraid. It can refer to a fearsome appearance or disturbing behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日發脾氣，真係得人怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3, zan1 hai6 dak1 jan4 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是发脾气，真的很让人害怕。
examples.english_sentence: He always throws tantrums, he's really scary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間屋黑麻麻，好得人怕呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 uk1 hak1 maa4 maa4, hou2 dak1 jan4 paa3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间房子黑漆漆的，很吓人啊。
examples.english_sentence: That house is pitch black, it's very scary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好惡，好多人都話佢得人怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ok3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 keoi5 dak1 jan4 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很凶，很多人都说他很吓人。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very mean person, many people say he's intimidating.

english_meaning: scary, frightening, creepy
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或某人让人感到害怕、恐惧。也可能指某人或事物的外观或行为令人不安。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is scary, frightening, or creepy. It can also refer to someone or something whose appearance or behavior is unsettling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套恐怖片真係得人驚，我睇完瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2 zan1 hai6 dak1 jan4 ging1, ngo5 tai2 jyun4 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部恐怖片真的很吓人，我看完睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: That horror movie was really scary, I couldn't sleep after watching it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣成日都咁得人驚，好似欠咗佢幾百萬咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam2 dak1 jan4 ging1, hou2 ci5 him3 zo2 keoi5 gei2 baak3 maan6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的样子总是那么吓人，好像欠了他几百万一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always looks so scary, like he's owed millions.

english_meaning: able to; can; may; allowed to
explanation_mandarin: 表示能够、可以，有条件或机会做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates being able to or allowed to do something, often implying a condition or opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅幫忙，我先至得以完成呢份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4, ngo5 sin1 zi3 dak1 ji5 waan4 sing4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多谢你的帮忙，我才能够完成这份报告。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to your help, I was able to finish this report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一番努力，佢終於得以入到大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 faan1 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 ji5 jap6 dou3 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一番努力，他终于能够进入大学。
examples.english_sentence: After much effort, he was finally able to get into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔得以離開香港，因為我仲有好多嘢要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 dak1 ji5 lei4 hoi1 hoeng1 gong2, jan1 wai6 ngo5 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不能离开香港，因为我还有很多事要做。
examples.english_sentence: I cannot leave Hong Kong, because I still have a lot of things to do.

english_meaning: hard-earned; not easily gained; difficult to obtain
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或成就不是轻易获得的，而是经过努力、奋斗或者困难才得到的。
explanation_english: Describes something or an achievement that was not easily obtained, but rather gained through effort, struggle, or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個獎係我哋團隊上上下下努力咗好耐先至攞到，得來不易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 tyun4 doi2 soeng6 soeng6 haa6 haa6 nou5 lik6 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 zi3 lo2 dou2, dak1 loi4 bat1 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个奖是我们团队上上下下努力了很久才得到的，来之不易啊。
examples.english_sentence: This award was earned after a long time of hard work from everyone in our team. It wasn't easily gained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家嘅幸福生活得來不易，你要好好珍惜呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ge3 hang6 fuk1 sang1 wut6 dak1 loi4 bat1 ji6, nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在幸福的生活来之不易，你要好好珍惜啊。
examples.english_sentence: The happy life we have now was hard-earned. You need to cherish it.

synonyms: 千辛萬苦 (chin1 san1 maan6 fu2)

mandarin_meaning: 只是…而已, 只有…这个名称而已
english_meaning: It's all in name only, it's only in name, it's just the name
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物只有其名，缺乏实际价值、意义或能力。强调有名无实。
explanation_english: Indicates that something exists only in name, lacking practical value, meaning, or ability. Emphasizes that it is nominal, without substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係經理，但係得個經理字，咩權力都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 ging1 lei5, daan6 hai6 dak1 go3 ging1 lei5 zi6, me1 kuen4 lik6 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己是经理，但只是个经理的空名，什么权力都没有。
examples.english_sentence: He says he's the manager, but it's just the title of manager; he has no power at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司聲稱自己係環保企業，但其實得個環保字，做嘅嘢根本唔環保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seng1 cheng1 zi6 gei2 hai6 waan4 bou2 kei5 jip6, daan6 kei4 sat6 dak1 go3 waan4 bou2 zi6, zou6 ge3 je5 gan1 bun2 m4 waan4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司声称自己是环保企业，但其实只是环保的名头，做的事情根本不环保。
examples.english_sentence: The company claims to be an environmental enterprise, but it's just an environmental label; what they do is not environmentally friendly at all.

mandarin_meaning: 只是…而已; 只有…之名
english_meaning: Only…in name; All you get is the name; Just the word; nothing more than...
explanation_mandarin: 表示只有某個名稱或形式，但沒有實際的內容或價值。指某事物空有其名，實質上沒有任何作用。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has only a name or form, but no actual content or value. It implies that something is just in name and has no practical use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳得個名氣字，啲嘢食一啲都唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 dak1 go3 ming4 hei3 zi6, di1 je5 sik6 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅只是名气大而已，食物一点都不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is only famous in name, the food is not good at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗做經理，但係得個經理字，都係要做返啲雜務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5, daan6 hai6 dak1 go3 ging1 lei5 zi6, dou1 hai6 jiu3 zou6 faan1 di1 zaap6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职做了经理，但只是个经理的头衔，还是要干一些杂务。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted to manager, but it's just the title of manager; he still has to do the chores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃得個『環保』字，實際上對環境冇任何幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 dak1 go3 'waan4 bou2' zi6, sat6 zeoi3 soeng6 deoi3 hwaan4 ging2 mou5 jam6 ho4 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划只是打着“环保”的旗号，实际上对环境没有任何帮助。
examples.english_sentence: This project is just labeled 'environmentally friendly', but it doesn't actually help the environment at all.
