english_meaning: Emptiness; to get nothing; to be left with nothing; empty shell
explanation_mandarin: 指最终什么都没有得到，空手而归。形容徒劳无功，或者原本期望的东西没有实现，只剩下空虚。
explanation_english: Refers to getting nothing in the end; to go home empty-handed. Describes futile efforts, or when the expected outcome does not materialize, leaving only emptiness. Often used when there is an expectation of something, but the result is disappointment and a lack of substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我投資咗咁多錢落去，點知最後得個吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 zi1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2 lok6 heoi3, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dak1 go3 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我投资了这么多钱进去，没想到最后什么都没得到。
examples.english_sentence: I invested so much money into it, but unexpectedly ended up with nothing in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應承我會幫手，點知講完就算，得個吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ying1 sing3 ngo5 wui5 bong1 sau2, dim2 zi1 gong2 yun4 zau6 syun3, dak1 go3 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应我会帮忙，没想到说了就算，什么都没做。
examples.english_sentence: He promised he would help, but he just said it and didn't do anything. It was all talk and no action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為今次一定升職，點知結果都係得個吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yi5 wai4 gam1 ci3 yat1 ding6 sing1 jik1, dim2 zi1 git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为这次肯定会升职，没想到结果还是什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I would definitely get a promotion this time, but the result was still nothing.

english_meaning: To get nothing; to get zero; to get a goose egg; to get a lemon
explanation_mandarin: 表示一无所获，没有得到任何好处，或者事情毫无进展。
explanation_english: It means to get nothing, to gain nothing, or that something is fruitless and has no progress. '桔' (gat1) refers to tangerine, which is a common gift or decoration during Chinese New Year. However, just getting a tangerine is seen as insignificant compared to other possible gains, hence the expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我努力咗咁耐，點知最後都係得個桔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nu5 lik6 zo2 gam3 noi6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我努力了这么久，结果最后还是一无所得。
examples.english_sentence: I worked so hard for so long, but in the end I got nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋傾咗成日，都係得個桔，咩都冇決定到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 zo2 seng4 jat6, dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gat1, me1 dou1 mou5 kyut3 ding6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了一整天，还是一无所获，什么都没决定下来。
examples.english_sentence: They talked all day, but it was all for nothing, they didn't decide on anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資得個桔，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 dak1 go3 gat1, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资一无所获，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: This investment yielded nothing, and I lost a lot of money.

english_meaning: All looks, no substance; just for show; superficially attractive but lacking in real quality or usefulness.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物只注重外表，而缺乏实际的价值或功能。
explanation_english: Describes something that is only concerned with appearance and lacks practical value or function. It suggests that something is attractive or impressive at first glance, but ultimately disappointing because it doesn't have any real substance or quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車得個樣啫，唔襟用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 dak1 go3 joeng2 ze1, m4 gam1 jung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车只是好看而已，不耐用。
examples.english_sentence: This car is just for show, it's not durable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人得個樣，冇乜真材實料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 dak1 go3 joeng2, mou5 mat1 zan1 coi4 sat6 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人只是外表好看，没有什么真本事。
examples.english_sentence: He's all looks, no substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳得個樣，啲嘢食又貴又唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 dak1 go3 joeng2, di1 je5 sik6 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅只是好看，东西又贵又不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is all looks, the food is expensive and doesn't taste good.

english_meaning: Just a shell; all show and no substance; empty facade
explanation_mandarin: 指只有外表，没有实际内容或能力；形容华而不实，中看不中用。
explanation_english: Refers to something that only has an outer shell but lacks substance, content, or ability; describes something that is superficially attractive but ultimately useless or lacking in true value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司得個殼啫，其實冇乜生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 dak1 go3 hok3 ze1, kei4 sat6 mou5 mat1 seng1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司只是个空壳而已，实际上没什么生意。
examples.english_sentence: His company is just a shell; it doesn't really have much business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車得個殼靚，入面啲零件都好舊㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 dak1 go3 hok3 leng3, jap6 min6 di1 ling4 gin2 dou1 hou2 gau6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车只是外壳好看，里面的零件都很旧了。
examples.english_sentence: This car only looks good on the outside; the parts inside are quite old.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好叻，但係得個殼，冇實際行動嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 dak1 go3 hok3, mou5 sat6 zai3 hang4 dung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很厉害，但是只是嘴上说说，没有实际行动。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at talking, but it's all show; he doesn't take any real action.

mandarin_meaning: 只能看看而已，没有实际用处
english_meaning: Good for show only; only for display; just for looks; all show and no substance
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物只有外表，没有实际的用处或价值，只是用来观赏的。
explanation_english: Describes something that is only good for show or appearance but lacks practical value or substance; purely ornamental.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個裝飾品得個睇字，完全冇實際用途嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zong1 sik1 ban2 dak1 go3 tai2 zi6, wun4 cyun4 mou5 sat6 zai3 jung6 tou4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个装饰品只能看看而已，完全没有实际用途。
examples.english_sentence: This ornament is just for show; it has absolutely no practical use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人得個睇字，做嘢就唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 dak1 go3 tai2 zi6, zou6嘢 zau6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人只能看看而已，做事情就不行了。
examples.english_sentence: He's all show and no substance; he's not good at getting things done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅設計得個睇字，根本解決唔到用戶嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 cit3 gai3 dak1 go3 tai2 zi6, gan1 bun2 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 jung6 wu6 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的设计只能看看而已，根本解决不了用户的问题。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this company is just for looks; it doesn't solve the users' problems at all.

english_meaning: Just knowing about it (but no action taken); only knowing about it
explanation_mandarin: 表示只是知道某件事，但没有其他实际行动或影响。强调仅仅是了解情况，没有进一步的意义或改变。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is only aware of something but no further action or influence is taken. It emphasizes simply knowing about the situation without any further significance or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講咗件事，佢都係得個知字，冇幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2 gin6 si6, keoi5 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 zi1 zi6, mou5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他说了这件事，他也只是知道而已，没有帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I told him about this matter, but he just knew about it and didn't help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同佢投訴都冇用㗎，佢都係得個知字，唔會跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 keoi5 tau4 sou3 dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3, keoi5 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 zi1 zi6, m4 wui5 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和他投诉也没用，他只是知道而已，不会跟进。
examples.english_sentence: It's useless to complain to him, he just knows about it and won't follow up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆淨係得個知字，啲嘢都係我哋做晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zing6 hai6 dak1 go3 zi1 zi6, di1 je5 dou1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zou6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板只是知道而已，事情都是我们做完的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss just knows about it, we're the ones who do all the work.

mandarin_meaning: 光说不做; 只说不做
english_meaning: All talk and no action; all talk, no substance; just talking the talk
explanation_mandarin: 形容人只会说，但实际行动却跟不上。
explanation_english: Describes someone who only talks about doing something but never actually does it; all talk, no follow-through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話要減肥，但係日日都食咁多嘢，真係得個講字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, daan6 hai6 jat6 jat6 dou1 sik6 gam3 do1 je5, zan1 hai6 dak1 go3 gong2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说要减肥，但是每天都吃那么多东西，真是光说不做。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he wants to lose weight, but he eats so much every day. It's just all talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話今年會加人工，結果都係得個講字，一蚊都無加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 gam1 nin4 wui5 gaa1 jan4 gung1, git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gong2 zi6, jat1 man1 dou1 mou5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说今年会加工资，结果还是光说不做，一分钱都没加。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he would increase our salaries this year, but it was all talk and no action, not even a penny was added.

english_meaning: to have one's wish fulfilled; to get what one wished for
explanation_mandarin: 指实现了原来的愿望。
explanation_english: Describes the state of having achieved one's original wishes or desires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到醫生，真係得償所願喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 ji1 sang1, zan1 hai6 dak1 soeng4 so2 jyun6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了医生，真是如愿以偿了。
examples.english_sentence: He passed the exam to become a doctor; he really got what he wished for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年嘅努力，佢終於得償所願，開咗自己嘅餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 soeng4 so2 jyun6, hoi1 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年的努力，他终于如愿以偿，开了自己的餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years of hard work, he finally got what he wished for and opened his own restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一直都想去歐洲旅行，今年終於得償所願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng2 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4, gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 dak1 soeng4 so2 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直都想去欧洲旅行，今年终于如愿以偿。
examples.english_sentence: I've always wanted to travel to Europe, and this year I finally got my wish.

english_meaning: to be able to deduce, to be able to conclude, to be able to figure out, to be able to arrive at
explanation_mandarin: 通过推理或计算得出结果或结论。
explanation_english: To arrive at a conclusion or result through reasoning, calculation, or derivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我計咗好耐先得出呢個答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gai3 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 dak1 ceot1 ni1 go3 daap3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我算了很久才得出这个答案。
examples.english_sentence: I calculated for a long time before I could arrive at this answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點樣得出呢個結論㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 joeng2 dak1 ceot1 ni1 go3 git3 leon6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么得出这个结论的？
examples.english_sentence: How did you arrive at this conclusion?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過調查，我哋得出以下嘅結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 diu6 ca4, ngo5 dei6 dak1 ceot1 ji5 haa6 ge3 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过调查，我们得出以下的结果。
examples.english_sentence: After investigation, we have reached the following results.

english_meaning: to score (points); to get points; score
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛或游戏中获得分数。
explanation_english: To obtain points in a game or competition; to score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋上半場已經得分喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng6 baan3 coeng4 ji5 ging1 dak1 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们上半场已经得分了。
examples.english_sentence: They already scored in the first half.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋想贏，就要盡力得分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 soeng2 win4, zau6 jiu3 zeon6 lik6 dak1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们想赢，就要尽力得分。
examples.english_sentence: If we want to win, we must try our best to score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個遊戲入面，得分越高，就越容易升級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6, dak1 fan1 jyuet6 gou1, zau6 jyuet6 jung4 ji6 sing1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个游戏里面，得分越高，就越容易升级。
examples.english_sentence: In this game, the higher the score, the easier it is to level up.

english_meaning: to be enough; to have enough time; to be able to make it; to be on time
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或数量上足够，能满足需求。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is enough time or quantity to meet the needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋時間得切去睇多場戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 si4 gaan3 dak1 cit3 heoi3 tai2 do1 coeng4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们时间还来得及去看一场电影。
examples.english_sentence: We have enough time to go and watch another movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，錢得切用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, cin2 dak1 cit3 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，钱是够用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, there's enough money to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果依家出發，應該得切趕上火車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ji1 gaa1 ceot1 faat3, jing1 goi1 dak1 cit3 gon2 soeng5 fo2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果现在出发，应该来得及赶上火车。
examples.english_sentence: If we leave now, we should be able to catch the train.

english_meaning: to get, to obtain, to receive, to achieve
explanation_mandarin: 表示获取、获得、取得。可以是具体物品，也可以是抽象的东西，例如：机会、同意等。
explanation_english: To get, obtain, receive, or achieve something. It can refer to concrete objects or abstract concepts such as opportunities, agreements, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我終於得到我想要嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 ngo5 so2 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我终于得到我想要的东西了。
examples.english_sentence: I finally got what I wanted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試得到好好嘅成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 dak1 dou3 hou2 hou2 ge3 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试取得了好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: He achieved good results in the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得到一個好好嘅機會去外國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 dou3 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 gei1 wui2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我得到一个很好的机会去外国读书。
examples.english_sentence: I got a very good opportunity to study abroad.

english_meaning: capable; competent; effective; helpful
explanation_mandarin: 形容人办事能力强，有帮助。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is capable and effective in their work; helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅得力助手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 dak1 lik6 zo6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的得力助手。
examples.english_sentence: He is my capable assistant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方案好得力，可以解決好多問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 hou2 dak1 lik6, ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 hou2 do1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方案很有效，可以解决很多问题。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very effective and can solve many problems.

english_meaning: victory, triumph
explanation_mandarin: 指获得胜利，战胜对手。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving victory, triumphing over an opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波今次比賽得勝喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 dak1 sing3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们队这次比赛胜利了！
examples.english_sentence: Our team won the competition this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一番努力，佢終於得勝而歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 faan1 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 sing3 ji4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一番努力，他终于得胜归来。
examples.english_sentence: After a lot of effort, he finally returned victorious.

english_meaning: to be in power; to gain power; to be influential; to have one's way
explanation_mandarin: 指获得权力或优势，处于有利地位，可以随心所欲地行事。
explanation_english: To gain power or influence; to be in a position of power or advantage; to be able to have one's way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家得勢，咩都聽佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 dak1 sai3, me1 dou1 teng1 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在得势，什么都听他的。
examples.english_sentence: He's in power now, so everyone listens to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你一時得勢就囂張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 jat1 si4 dak1 sai3 zau6 hiu1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你一时得势就嚣张。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be arrogant just because you are powerful for a short time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋得勢咗之後，就開始排擠異己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dak1 sai3 zo2 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 chi2 paai4 zai1 ji6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们得势之后，就开始排挤异己。
examples.english_sentence: After they gained power, they started to exclude those who disagreed with them.

english_meaning: To abuse one's power; to take advantage of one's position to bully others; to be merciless when in power
explanation_mandarin: 形容人一旦有了权势，就毫不留情地欺压别人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, once in a position of power, mercilessly oppresses others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一升咗職就得勢不饒人，成日針對啲下屬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sing1 zo2 zik1 zau6 dak1 sai3 bat1 jiu4 jan4, sing4 jat6 zaam1 deoi3 di1 haa6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一升职就得势不饶人，总是针对下属。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got promoted, he started abusing his power, constantly targeting his subordinates.

english_meaning: Success! Got it! Done!
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情顺利完成或成功达到目标。也可用作感叹词，表达高兴、满足的心情。
explanation_english: Expresses that something has been successfully completed or a goal has been achieved. It can also be used as an exclamation to express happiness and satisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我終於考到車牌啦，得咗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou2 ce1 paai3 laa1, dak1 zo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我终于考到驾照了，搞定了！
examples.english_sentence: I finally passed my driving test, success!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂晒啲嘢，得咗，可以收工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5, dak1 zo2, ho2 ji5 sau1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把所有的事情都搞定了，成功了，可以下班了。
examples.english_sentence: Finished everything, done! Time to go home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次project得咗，老闆實會讚我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 project dak1 zo2, lou5 baan2 sat1 wui zaan3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目成功了，老板一定会赞扬我们。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a success, the boss will definitely praise us.

english_meaning: Sure, of course, no problem
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意，肯定，或者没有问题。语气比较轻松随意。
explanation_english: Expressing agreement, confirmation, or that there is no problem. The tone is light and casual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我買杯咖啡得哥，唔該晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 dak1 go1, m4 goi1 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我买一杯咖啡，没问题，谢谢！
examples.english_sentence: Sure, I can buy you a coffee. Thanks!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日同你一齊去睇戲，得哥！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3, dak1 go1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天和你一起去看电影，没问题！
examples.english_sentence: Sure, I'll go watch a movie with you tomorrow!

mandarin_meaning: 行不行; 可以不可以
english_meaning: Okay?; Is it alright?; Will it work?; Can it be done?
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问某件事是否可行、是否可以接受。常用于寻求对方同意或确认事情的可行性。
explanation_english: Used to ask if something is okay, acceptable, or feasible. Commonly used to seek agreement or confirmation about the possibility of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日想請假，得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 soeng2 ceng2 gaa3, dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天想请假，行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a day off tomorrow, is that okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可唔可以食埋你嗰份甜品？得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 sik6 maai4 nei5 go2 fan6 tim4 ban2? dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以把你的那份甜点也吃了吗？行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Can I eat your dessert too? Is that alright?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲啲交報告，得唔得呀，老師？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 di1 gaau1 bou3 gou3, dak1 m4 dak1 aa3, lou5 si1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚点交报告，行不行啊，老师？
examples.english_sentence: Can I submit the report later, is that okay, teacher?

english_meaning: Only good for a laugh; it's laughable; not to be taken seriously.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事荒谬可笑，只能当作笑话来看待，不必认真对待。
explanation_english: Describes something so ridiculous or absurd that it's only good for a laugh and shouldn't be taken seriously. It implies that the subject is foolish or ineffective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃根本得啖笑，冇人會認真聽佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 gan1 bun2 dak1 daam6 siu3, mou5 jan4 wui5 jing6 zan1 teng1 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划根本只是笑话，没有人会认真听他说。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is completely laughable; no one will seriously listen to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同佢講呢啲嘢咪得啖笑囉，佢根本唔會明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ni1 di1 ye5 mai6 dak1 daam6 siu3 lo1, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你跟他讲这些事情也只能当笑话听了，他根本不会明白。
examples.english_sentence: Telling him these things is just good for a laugh; he won't understand at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅管理簡直得啖笑，成日變嚟變去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 gaan2 zik6 dak1 daam6 siu3, seng4 jat6 bin3 lai4 bin3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理简直是个笑话，经常变来变去。
examples.english_sentence: The management of this company is a joke; it's always changing.

synonyms: 笑話一則 (siu3 waa6 jat1 zak1)

mandarin_meaning: 有那么一点; 稍微; 有进步
english_meaning: a little bit; somewhat; improved (slightly)
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度不高，稍微，有一点。也指略有进步。
explanation_english: Indicates a small degree, slightly, a little bit. Can also mean there's slight improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅中文得啲進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zung1 man2 dak1 di1 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的中文稍微进步了一点。
examples.english_sentence: His Chinese has improved a little bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日涼得啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 loeng4 dak1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天凉快了一点。
examples.english_sentence: It's a little cooler today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌得啲好聽咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 dak1 di1 hou2 teng1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌好听了一点。
examples.english_sentence: He sings a bit better now.

english_meaning: only; merely; just
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量很少，仅有。强调数量的稀少和不足。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity, 'only' or 'merely'. It emphasizes the scarcity and insufficiency of the amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得嗰十蚊，點夠買飯呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 go2 sap6 man1, dim2 gau3 maai5 faan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只有十块钱，怎么够买饭呢？
examples.english_sentence: He only has ten dollars, how is that enough to buy food?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得嗰一個鐘時間溫書咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 go2 jat1 go3 zung1 si4 gaan3 wan1 syu1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只有一个小时的时间复习。
examples.english_sentence: I only have one hour to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得嗰三歲，唔識字都正常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 go2 saam1 seoi3, m4 sik1 zi6 dou1 zing3 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他才三岁，不识字也很正常。
examples.english_sentence: He's only three years old, it's normal that he can't read.

mandarin_meaning: 能抽空; 能抽出时间; 有空
english_meaning: To be able to free up time; to find time; to have the time; available
explanation_mandarin: 表示能够抽出时间，有空的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates being able to find time or be available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜都唔得嚟，好多嘢要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 m4 dak1 lai4, hou2 do1嘢 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个星期都没空，有很多事情要做。
examples.english_sentence: I won't be available next week, I have a lot of things to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幾時得嚟飲茶呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 si4 dak1 lai4 yam2 caa4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你什么时候有空喝茶呀？
examples.english_sentence: When will you be free to have tea?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚唔得嚟食飯，要加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan1 m4 dak1 lai4 sik6 faan6, jiu3 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚没空吃饭，要加班。
examples.english_sentence: He can't make it for dinner tonight, he has to work overtime.

english_meaning: together; collectively; as a group
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或状态是共同进行的，一起，一块儿。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or state is performed together, collectively, or as a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋得埋一齊去睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dak1 maai4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the movies together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日得埋玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dak1 maai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: They often play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋得埋夾錢買份禮物俾佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 dak1 maai4 gaap3 cin2 maai5 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起凑钱给他买份礼物吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we pool our money together to buy him a gift?

english_meaning: much more; a lot more; significantly more
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度上的增加，比原来的程度高很多。
explanation_english: Indicates a significant increase in degree or quantity compared to the original state or thing. It implies a noticeable and substantial difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年嘅人工高得多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 ge3 yan4 gung1 gou1 dak1 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年的工资高得多啦。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is much higher this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電話快得多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 faai3 dak1 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台新电话快得多。
examples.english_sentence: This new phone is much faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話難得多過學普通話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 naan4 dak1 do1 gwo3 hok6 pou2 tung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学粤语比学普通话难得多。
examples.english_sentence: Learning Cantonese is much harder than learning Mandarin.

english_meaning: uniquely endowed by nature; blessed with exceptional advantages; favored by heaven
explanation_mandarin: 指具有特别优越的天然条件，也指所处的环境特别好，具备成功的有利条件。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or person that is uniquely blessed with natural advantages or exceptional circumstances that are conducive to success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅地理環境真係得天獨厚，好適合發展旅遊業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 dei6 lei5 waan4 ging2 zan1 hai6 dak1 tin1 duk6 hau5, hou2 sik1 hap6 faat3 zin2 leoi5 jau4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的地理环境真是得天独厚，很适合发展旅游业。
examples.english_sentence: The geographical environment here is truly uniquely endowed, making it very suitable for developing tourism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲得天獨厚，天生就係做歌手嘅材料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 dak1 tin1 duk6 hau5, tin1 sang1 zau6 hai6 zou6 go1 sau2 ge3 coi4 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嗓音得天独厚，天生就是做歌手的材料。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is uniquely blessed, he is naturally gifted to be a singer.

english_meaning: gain and loss; advantages and disadvantages; to offend (someone); to gain or lose (popularity, support, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指获得的和失去的东西，也指利弊；有时也指冒犯，得罪。
explanation_english: Refers to gains and losses, advantages and disadvantages. It can also mean to offend or displease someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做嘢唔想計較咁多得失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 je5 m4 soeng2 gai3 gaau3 gam3 do1 dak1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我工作不想计较那么多得失。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to worry too much about gains and losses when I'm working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講嘢好容易得失人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 je5 hou2 jung4 ji6 dak1 sat1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么说话很容易得罪人的。
examples.english_sentence: You can easily offend people by talking like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做任何決定都要考慮得失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jam6 ho4 kyut3 ding6 dou1 jiu3 haam1 leoi5 dak1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做任何决定都要考虑得失。
examples.english_sentence: You need to consider the advantages and disadvantages when making any decision.

english_meaning: to win an award; to be awarded
explanation_mandarin: 获得奖项，得到奖励。
explanation_english: To receive an award; to be awarded a prize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年得咗好多獎呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 dak1 zo2 hou2 do1 zoeng2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年得了很多奖啊。
examples.english_sentence: He has won many awards this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你得獎呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 dak1 zoeng2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你得奖啊！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on winning the award!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望可以憑住呢套戲得獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 pang4 zyu6 ni1 tou3 hei3 dak1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望可以凭借这部电影得奖。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to win an award with this film.

english_meaning: to be in favour, to be favored, to be in someone's good graces
explanation_mandarin: 得到喜爱和重视；受到宠爱。
explanation_english: To be favored, loved, and valued by someone, often someone in a position of power or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老細面前好得寵，成日都有好嘢益佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 hou2 dak1 cung2, sing4 jat6 dou1 jau5 hou2 je5 jik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前很受宠，经常有好东西给他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very favoured by the boss, and he always gets good things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你而家得寵就恃寵生驕啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 ji4 gaa1 dak1 cung2 zau6 ci5 cung2 sang1 giu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你现在受宠就恃宠而骄啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you're favoured now you can act arrogantly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前佢好得寵，但係而家已經失寵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 keoi5 hou2 dak1 cung2, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 sat1 cung2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前他很受宠，但是现在已经失宠了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be very favoured, but now he has fallen out of favour.

english_meaning: Give someone an inch and they'll take a mile; to take advantage of someone's generosity; to push one's luck; to overreach
explanation_mandarin: 比喻得到了小小的利益，还不满足，想要更大的利益。形容贪得无厌。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is never satisfied. They will take any small advantage offered and then try to exploit the situation further for their own benefit. It implies greediness and a lack of gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易俾佢哋佔便宜，如果唔係佢哋就會得寸進尺㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 yung4 yi6 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zim3 bin6 yi4, yu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 jau5 wui5 dak1 cyun3 zeon3 cek3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么容易让他们占便宜，不然他们会得寸进尺的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let them take advantage of you so easily, otherwise they'll take an inch and grab a mile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上次借咗佢一百蚊，佢今次居然問我借五百，真係得寸進尺！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 ci3 ze3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 baak3 man1, keoi5 gam1 ci3 geoi1 jin4 man6 ngo5 ze3 ng5 baak3, zan1 hai6 dak1 cyun3 zeon3 cek3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上次借了他一百块钱，他这次竟然问我借五百，真是得寸进尺！
examples.english_sentence: I lent him a hundred dollars last time, and this time he actually asked me to borrow five hundred, it's really taking advantage of my kindness!

english_meaning: very, extremely, to a great extent
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，相当于“很”、“非常”。多用在形容词或动词之后，表示程度的加深。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree, equivalent to "very", "extremely". Often used after adjectives or verbs to intensify the degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日開心得很。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hoi1 sam1 dak1 han2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天非常开心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very happy today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好食得很。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 can1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 sik6 dak1 han2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is extremely delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢大聲得很。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 daai6 seng1 dak1 han2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话声音非常大。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very loudly.

english_meaning: skillful and easy to handle; to do something easily and smoothly; to have a good grasp of something
explanation_mandarin: 心里怎么想，手上就能怎么做。形容技艺熟练，运用自如。
explanation_english: Describes being able to do something very skillfully and easily, as if one's thoughts and actions are perfectly coordinated. It implies a high level of proficiency and control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾年鋼琴，而家彈琴已經得心應手喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 nin4 gong3 kam4, yi4 gaa1 taan4 kam4 yi5 ging1 dak1 sam1 ying3 sau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几年钢琴，现在弹钢琴已经得心应手了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been learning piano for a few years, and now he plays with ease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式佢寫咗好多次，所以而家寫起嚟得心應手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 keoi5 se2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3, so2 yi5 yi4 gaa1 se2 hei2 lai4 dak1 sam1 ying3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序他写过很多次，所以现在写起来得心应手。
examples.english_sentence: He's written this program many times, so now he can write it with ease.

english_meaning: to learn of, to get to know, to be informed of
explanation_mandarin: 了解到，知道。
explanation_english: To learn or become aware of something, usually formally or in a written context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋得悉你已經辭咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dak1 sik1 nei5 ji5 ging1 ci4 zo2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得知你已经辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: We have learned that you have already resigned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得悉佢將會調去英國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 sik1 keoi5 zoeng1 wui5 diu6 heoi3 ying1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我得知他将会被调去英国。
examples.english_sentence: I have learned that he will be transferred to the UK.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺新聞度得悉呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 san1 man2 dou6 dak1 sik1 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从新闻里得知这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I learned about this from the news.

english_meaning: pleased with oneself; smug; proud; pleased; cute; lovely; interesting
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为某事而感到高兴、自豪，或者形容某事物可爱、有趣。
explanation_english: Describes being pleased or proud of oneself due to an achievement, or describing something as cute, lovely, or interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗冠軍，好得意咁笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 gwun3 gwan1, hou2 dak1 ji3 gam2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得了冠军，很得意地笑了。
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship and smiled smugly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻貓仔好得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 maau1 zai2 hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只小猫真可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: This kitten is so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日覺得自己好得意，其實麻麻地啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 dak1 ji3, kei4 sat6 maa4 maa2 dei2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是觉得自己很了不起，其实一般般而已。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks he's something special, but he's really just so-so.

english_meaning: to be so pleased with oneself as to lose all sense of measure; to let success go to one's head; to be carried away by one's success
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人因高兴而忘乎所以，失去应有的理智和节制。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is so overjoyed that they lose control and good judgment, forgetting proper restraint due to their success or happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗場波，開心到得意忘形，周圍同人講自己幾勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing4 zo2 coeng4 bo1, hoi1 sam1 dou3 dak1 ji3 wang4 ying4, zau1 wai4 tung4 jan4 gong2 zi6 gei2 gei6 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢了比赛，高兴得得意忘形，到处跟别人说自己有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He won the game and was so elated he became carried away, bragging to everyone about how great he was.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考到好成績唔好得意忘形，要繼續努力先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 dou2 hou2 sing1 jik1 m4 hou2 dak1 ji3 wang4 ying4, jiu3 gai3 zuk6 nu5 lik6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考得好成绩不要得意忘形，要继续努力才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get carried away with good grades, you have to keep working hard.

synonyms: [忘乎所以, mong4 fu1 so2 ji3]

english_meaning: triumphant; very pleased with oneself; beaming with pride
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常得意，高兴的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the appearance of being very pleased with oneself and happy, often showing a smug or proud attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞到第一名，得意洋洋咁返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, dak1 ji3 joeng4 joeng4 gam2 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了第一名，得意洋扬地回家了。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam and went home beaming with pride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好得意洋洋住，仲有下個比賽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dak1 ji3 joeng4 joeng4 zyu6, zung6 jau5 haa6 go3 bei2 coi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要得意洋洋的，还有下个比赛呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so triumphant, there's still the next competition.

english_meaning: smug, complacent, conceited, self-satisfied (often in a slightly annoying way)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因为某种成就或者优势而显得非常得意，甚至有些炫耀或者让人不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is smug, complacent, or conceited because of some achievement or advantage. It often carries a negative connotation, implying that the person is being overly self-satisfied or annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到第一，咪成日得戚囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1, mai6 sing4 jat6 dak1 cik1 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考了第一名，还不成天得意洋洋的！
examples.english_sentence: He got first place, so he's been smug about it all day!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁得戚啦，下次未必係你贏㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dak1 cik1 laa1, haa6 ci3 mei6 bit1 hai6 nei5 wing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么得意洋洋的，下次不一定是你能赢的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so smug, you might not win next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見佢升咗職之後，日日都得戚到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, jat6 jat6 dou1 dak1 cik1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他升职之后，每天都得意到不行。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he got promoted, he's been insufferably smug every day.

english_meaning: to succeed, to accomplish one's goal, to get one's hands on (something illegally)
explanation_mandarin: 表示成功达到目的，或是成功地获取了某事物。有时也指用不正当手段取得。
explanation_english: Indicates success in achieving a goal or successfully acquiring something. Sometimes, it also implies obtaining something through improper means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住偷嘢，但係最後都冇得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 zyu6 tau1 je5, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想偷东西，但是最后都没有得逞。
examples.english_sentence: He planned to steal something, but in the end, he didn't succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多努力，佢終於得手，攞到個冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 sau2, lo2 dou2 go3 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多努力，他终于成功了，拿到了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: After so much effort, he finally succeeded and won the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用不正當嘅手段先可以得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 bat1 zing3 dong3 ge3 sau2 dyun6 sin1 ho2 ji5 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了不正当的手段才可以得逞。
examples.english_sentence: He had to use improper means to succeed.

english_meaning: All talk and no action; only good at talking
explanation_mandarin: 指只会说，却不做事，光说不练。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is good at talking but does not take action; all talk and no action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得把口啫，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 baa2 hau2 ze1, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是说说而已，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's all talk, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係得把口，要做嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dak1 baa2 hau2, jiu3 zou6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是说说，要行动啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk, you need to take action.

synonyms: 齋講唔做 (zaai1 gong2 m4 zou6)

english_meaning: All talk, no action; just a voice
explanation_mandarin: 指只会说，没有实际行动或能力。形容人夸夸其谈，却不能付诸实践。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who only talks a lot but doesn't take any real action or have any real ability. Describes someone who is all talk and no action, and unable to put their words into practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都話要減肥，但係得把聲，成日都食零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, daan6 hai6 dak1 baa2 seng1, seng4 jat6 dou1 sik6 ling4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都说要减肥，但是光说不做，总是吃零食。
examples.english_sentence: He says he wants to lose weight every day, but it's all talk and no action. He's always eating snacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啦，佢得把聲㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dak1 baa2 seng1 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他，他只是嘴上说说而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe him, he's just all talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得把聲，叫佢做嘢就唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 baa2 seng1, giu3 keoi5 zou6 je5 zau6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会嘴上说，叫他做事就不行。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to talk, he can't do anything.

english_meaning: to handle something successfully, to get something done properly, to manage, to settle, to resolve
explanation_mandarin: 表示能够成功地处理或解决某件事情，使其达到令人满意的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates the ability to successfully handle or resolve a matter, bringing it to a satisfactory state. It implies capability and successful completion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我一定會幫你得掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 bong1 nei5 dak1 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我一定会帮你搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: I will definitely help you handle this matter successfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，呢啲小事我得掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ni1 di1 siu2 si6 ngo5 dak1 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，这些小事我能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I can handle these small matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你搞唔掂，就嚟搵我幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gaau2 m4 dim6, zau6 lei4 wan2 ngo5 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你搞不定，就来找我帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you can't handle it, come and ask me for help.

english_meaning: to be saved, to be rescued
explanation_mandarin: 从危险或困境中脱身，获得拯救。
explanation_english: To be saved from danger or difficulty; to be rescued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢差啲浸死，好彩俾人救返，先至得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa1 di1 zam3 sei2, hou2 coi2 bei2 jan4 gau3 faan1, sin1 zi3 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他差点淹死了，幸好被人救回来，才得救。
examples.english_sentence: He almost drowned, luckily he was rescued and saved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次經濟危機，如果政府唔出手，好多公司都唔會得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ging1 zai3 ngai4 gei1, jyu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 m4 chut1 sau2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 m4 wui2 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次经济危机，如果政府不出手，很多公司都不会得救。
examples.english_sentence: In this economic crisis, if the government doesn't intervene, many companies won't be saved.

english_meaning: Smug, pleased with oneself, triumphant, arrogant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人因为成功或成就而显得骄傲、自满和神气。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is smug, pleased with themselves, or triumphant, often to the point of being arrogant, due to a success or accomplishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞到第一名，咪得敕囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lo2 dou2 dai6 jat1 ming4, mai1 dak1 cik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了第一名，当然得意洋洋了。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam, of course he's smug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁得敕啦，贏少少嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dak1 cik1 laa1, wing4 siu2 siu2 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么得意，只是赢了点小东西而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so smug, you only won a little something.

english_meaning: too much, excessive, over the top
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度超出合适的范围，带有贬义，形容某事物或行为过分、太过。
explanation_english: Describes something that is excessive or goes too far, often with a negative connotation. It signifies that the degree or extent of something is inappropriate or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，得滯喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, dak1 zai6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，太过分了！
examples.english_sentence: You're going too far with what you're doing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工高得滯，點解佢可以咁好待遇嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 gou1 dak1 zai6, dim2 gaai2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 gam3 hou2 doi6 jyu6 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资太高了，为什么他可以有这么好的待遇？
examples.english_sentence: His salary is excessively high. Why does he get such good treatment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買咁多嘢，得滯喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 gam3 do1 je5, dak1 zai6 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买这么多东西，太过分了吧！
examples.english_sentence: You're buying way too much stuff!

english_meaning: To have something but be unable to use it; to be useless for the purpose; to be of no practical use
explanation_mandarin: 指得到某样东西，但是却没办法使用它，或对实际情况没有帮助，显得多余或无用。
explanation_english: Refers to obtaining something but being unable to use it, or it being unhelpful in a practical situation, appearing redundant or useless. It implies that possession does not equal utility; the object is rendered useless due to circumstances or lack of ability to utilize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買咗部咁貴嘅電腦，但係我唔識用，咪即係得物無所用囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zo2 bou6 gam3 gwai3 ge3 din6 nou5, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 sik1 jung6, mai1 zik1 hai6 dak1 mat6 mou4 so2 jung6 lo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买了这么贵的电脑，但是我不会用，不就是得物无所用吗！
examples.english_sentence: Bought such an expensive computer, but I don't know how to use it, isn't that just having something but being unable to use it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個軟件好複雜，雖然功能好多，但係我哋公司都唔識用，真係得物無所用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyun5 gin2 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, seui1 jin4 gung1 nang4 hou2 do1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 dou1 m4 sik1 jung6, zan1 hai6 dak1 mat6 mou4 so2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个软件很复杂，虽然功能很多，但是我们公司都不会用，真是得物无所用。
examples.english_sentence: This software is very complicated. Although it has many features, our company doesn't know how to use it, it's really having something but being unable to use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部新車，但係佢冇車牌，咪即係得物無所用囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ce1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 mou5 ce1 paai4, mai1 zik1 hai6 dak1 mat6 mou4 so2 jung6 lo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆新车，但是他没有驾照，不就是得物无所用嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car, but he doesn't have a driver's license, isn't that just having something but being unable to use it?

english_meaning: to win an award; to be awarded a prize
explanation_mandarin: 获得奖励或奖项。
explanation_english: To receive an award or prize for achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺電影節度得咗最佳男主角獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 din6 jing2 zit3 dou6 dak1 zo2 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影节获得了最佳男主角奖。
examples.english_sentence: He won the Best Actor award at the film festival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果努力啲，你都有機會得獎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nou5 lik6 di1, nei5 dou1 jau5 gei1 wui2 dak1 zoeng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再努力一些，你也有机会得奖的。
examples.english_sentence: If you work harder, you also have a chance to win an award.

english_meaning: to press one's advantage; to rub it in; to not let someone off even when one is in the right
explanation_mandarin: 指自己占了理，也不肯轻易放过对方，总是要得寸进尺。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, even when in the right, is unforgiving and relentlessly pursues their advantage, often to an excessive degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔真係得理不饒人，明明人哋都道咗歉，仲要係咁鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 zan1 hai6 dak1 lei5 bat1 jiu4 jan4, ming4 ming4 jan4 dei6 dou1 dou6 zo2 hip3, zung6 jiu3 hai6 gam2 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人真是得理不饶人，明明人家都道歉了，还要一直骂。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is really unforgiving when he's in the right. Even though the other person apologized, he's still yelling at them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好得理不饒人啦，佢都知錯㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dak1 lei5 bat1 jiu4 jan4 laa1, keoi5 dou1 zi1 co3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要得理不饶人啦，他都知道错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unforgiving! He already knows he's wrong.

english_meaning: appropriate, proper, suitable
explanation_mandarin: 形容处理事情或者表达方式很合适，很妥当。
explanation_english: Describes something being handled or expressed in a suitable and proper way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你處理得好得當喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cyu5 lei5 dak1 hou2 dak1 dong3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你处理得真恰当！
examples.english_sentence: You handled it really well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用詞要得當先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ci4 jiu3 dak1 dong3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用词要恰当才行。
examples.english_sentence: The wording needs to be appropriate.

english_meaning: to benefit; to profit; benefit; profit
explanation_mandarin: 获得好处；得到利益。
explanation_english: To receive benefits or advantages; to profit from something. Can be used as a verb (to benefit) or a noun (benefit).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次經濟好轉，好多公司都得益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ging1 zai3 hou2 zyun2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 dak1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次经济好转，很多公司都得益。
examples.english_sentence: This time, the economy has improved, and many companies have benefited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得益於阿爸嘅關係先可以升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 jik1 jyu1 aa3 baa1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得益于爸爸的关系才可以升职。
examples.english_sentence: He benefited from his dad's connections and was able to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策對窮人嚟講，係一個好大嘅得益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 deoi3 kung4 jan4 lei4 gong2, hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 dak1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策对穷人来说，是一个很大的好处。
examples.english_sentence: This policy is a great benefit to the poor.

mandarin_meaning: 占便宜的规定/规定中的漏洞
english_meaning: Exploitable loophole; rules that benefit someone unfairly; loophole in a system designed for personal gain
explanation_mandarin: 指可以利用规则或制度中的漏洞，从而获得不正当利益的规定或情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a rule or situation where one can exploit loopholes in rules or systems to gain unfair advantages or personal benefits. Often implies a degree of opportunism or exploitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲得益規條好多，好多人都搵到油水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 dak1 jik1 kwai1 tiu4 hou2 do1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wan2 dou2 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的漏洞很多，很多人都从中捞到好处。
examples.english_sentence: There are many exploitable loopholes in this company, and many people are profiting from them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻搵得益規條，次次都攞到最多著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 wan2 dak1 jik1 kwai1 tiu4, ci3 ci3 dou1 lo2 dou2 zeoi3 do1 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长寻找规则中的漏洞，每次都能拿到最多的好处。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at finding exploitable loopholes, and always gets the most benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該堵塞呢啲得益規條，唔可以畀人濫用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 du2 sak1 ni1 di1 dak1 jik1 kwai1 tiu4, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 jan4 laam6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该堵塞这些漏洞，不可以让人滥用。
examples.english_sentence: The government should close these exploitable loopholes to prevent abuse.

synonyms: 灰色地帶 (fui1 sik1 dei6 daai3)

english_meaning: to succeed; to get one's way; to win a lawsuit; to have one's grievance addressed
explanation_mandarin: 指成功达到目的，尤指经过努力后申诉得到公正对待，或在竞争中获胜。
explanation_english: Refers to successfully achieving a goal, especially after making efforts to have a grievance fairly addressed, or winning in a competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢告到個老細得直，真係好叻呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gou3 dou3 go3 lou5 sai3 dak1 zik6, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他告老板成功了，真厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He succeeded in suing his boss. He's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我一定要上訴到得直為止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 soeng5 sou3 dou3 dak1 zik6 wai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我一定要上诉直到成功为止。
examples.english_sentence: This time, I must appeal until I get my way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺呢件事上面得直，都唔係咁容易嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 seong6 min6 dak1 zik6, dou1 m4 hai6 gam2 jung4 ji6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在这件事上得逞，也不是那么容易的。
examples.english_sentence: It's not that easy for him to succeed in this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 收获, 得到, 获得
english_meaning: gain, achievement, acquisition, to obtain, to achieve
explanation_mandarin: 指获得的成果或好处。也可指获取的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to gains, achievements, or benefits obtained. Can also refer to the act of acquiring something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次比賽你得着好多嘢喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 nei5 dak1 zoek3 hou2 do1 je5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛你收获了很多东西啊。
examples.english_sentence: You gained a lot from this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺呢份工度學到好多嘢，真係得着唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ni1 fan6 gung1 dou6 hok6 dou2 hou2 do1 je5, zan1 hai6 dak1 zoek3 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这份工作中学到了很多东西，真的收获不少。
examples.english_sentence: I've learned a lot in this job, I've really gained a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力，一定會有得着嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nu5 lik6, jat1 ding6 wui5 jau5 dak1 zoek3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，一定会有收获的。
examples.english_sentence: If he works so hard, he will definitely have some gains.

english_meaning: to learn, to know, to be informed of
explanation_mandarin: 知道，知晓，获悉。通常指通过某种方式获取了信息。
explanation_english: To learn of something, to become aware of something, to find out. It usually implies gaining information through a particular source or method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日先得知佢結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 sin1 dak1 zi1 keoi5 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天才知道他结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: I only learned yesterday that he got married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋得知公司下個月會搬寫字樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dak1 zi1 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 bun1 se2 zi6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得知公司下个月会搬办公室。
examples.english_sentence: We learned that the company will move offices next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想俾人得知佢嘅私事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 dak1 zi1 keoi5 ge3 si1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想让人知道他的私事。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want people to learn about his private affairs.

english_meaning: to succeed, to achieve one's goal, to score (win/success)
explanation_mandarin: 指取得成功，达到目的。比喻事情办成了，或计划实现了。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving success and reaching a goal. It's a metaphor for successfully completing a task or realizing a plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我終於得米啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 mai5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我终于成功了！
examples.english_sentence: I finally succeeded in this exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢落咗咁多苦功，今次一定得米嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lok6 zo2 gam3 do1 fu2 gung1, gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 dak1 mai5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下了这么多苦功，这次一定能成功。
examples.english_sentence: He put in so much effort, he's bound to succeed this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多努力，佢哋嘅計劃終於得米喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nu5 lik6, keoi5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 zung1 jyu1 dak1 mai5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多努力，他们的计划终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: After so much effort, their plan finally succeeded.

english_meaning: to offend; to displease; to affront; to be rude to; to excuse me (for disturbing you)
explanation_mandarin: 冒犯、得罪，使人不高兴或生气。
explanation_english: To offend, displease, or cause someone to be upset or angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係有意得罪你㗎，唔好嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 ji3 dak1 zeoi6 nei5 gaa3, m4 hou2 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是故意要冒犯你的，别生气了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't mean to offend you, don't be angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，得罪晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, dak1 zeoi6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰了。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me (for disturbing everyone).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講嘢小心啲，唔好得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 je5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说话小心一点，不要得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful what you say, don't offend people.

jyutping: dak1 zeoi6 jan4 do1, cing1 fu1 jan4 siu2
mandarin_meaning: 得罪的人多，能叫出名字的人少
english_meaning: Having offended many people, but knowing few by name; having more enemies than friends (lit. offending many people, calling few by name)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人际关系不好，得罪的人很多，但真正能称得上朋友的人却很少。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone has bad interpersonal relationships, having offended many people, yet has very few true friends or acquaintances whom they can call by name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁串，日日都鬧人，而家咪得罪人多，稱呼人少囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 cyun3, jat1 jat1 dou1 naau6 jan4, ji4 gaa1 mai1 dak1 zeoi6 jan4 do1, cing1 fu1 jan4 siu2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人这么傲慢，每天都骂人，现在就是得罪的人多，能叫出名字的人少。
examples.english_sentence: He's so arrogant, scolding people every day, so now he's offended many and knows few by name.

english_meaning: No offense, but...
explanation_mandarin: 表示说话人在说一些可能冒犯对方的话之前，先声明，希望对方不要介意。
explanation_english: An expression used before saying something that might be offensive or critical, indicating that the speaker doesn't intend to cause offense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得罪講句，你今日件衫真係唔係咁襯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 zeoi6 gong2 geoi3, nei5 gam1 jat6 gin6 saam1 zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 gam2 can3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恕我直言，你今天这件衣服真是不太适合你。
examples.english_sentence: No offense, but that outfit doesn't really suit you today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得罪講句，你嘅提議我覺得唔係幾可行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 zeoi6 gong2 geoi3, nei5 ge3 tai4 ji5 ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 hai6 gei2 ho2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恕我直言，我觉得你的提议不太可行。
examples.english_sentence: No offense, but I don't think your suggestion is very feasible.

english_meaning: To have the heart to; to bring oneself to do something; to be able to stomach (doing something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示能够忍心去做某事，通常指去做一些不好的事情或让人不舒服的事情。
explanation_english: Indicates being able to bring oneself to do something, usually something bad or unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解得落手打個細路㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 dak1 lok6 sau2 daa2 go3 sai3 lou6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么下得了手打小孩？
examples.english_sentence: How could you bring yourself to hit a child?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴嘅嘢，我都唔得落手買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 ge3 je5, ngo5 dou1 m4 dak1 lok6 sau2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵的东西，我都下不了手买。
examples.english_sentence: Such an expensive thing, I can't bring myself to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人咁差，你都得落同佢做朋友？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gam3 caa1, nei5 dou1 dak1 lok6 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人这么差，你都忍心和他做朋友？
examples.english_sentence: He's such a bad person, how can you bring yourself to be friends with him?

english_meaning: to gain; to obtain; to acquire; gain; benefit; lesson learned
explanation_mandarin: 动词：获得，得到。名词：收获，成果，经验。
explanation_english: Verb: to gain, to obtain, to acquire. Noun: gain, benefit, result, lesson learned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅經驗，我得著好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 ging1 jim6, ngo5 dak1 zoek6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的经验，我收获很多。
examples.english_sentence: I gained a lot from this experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參加呢個比賽，唔係為咗贏，而係為咗得著更多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 gaa1 ni1 go3 bei2 coi3, m4 hai6 wai4 zo2 wing4, ji4 hai6 wai4 zo2 dak1 zoek6 gang3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参加这个比赛，不是为了赢，而是为了获得更多。
examples.english_sentence: Participating in this competition is not about winning, but about gaining more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多次失敗，佢終於得著成功嘅秘訣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 ci3 sat1 baai6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 zoek6 sing4 gung1 ge3 bei3 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多次失败，他终于获得了成功的秘诀。
examples.english_sentence: After so many failures, he finally gained the secret to success.

english_meaning: to succeed (in a plot); to get one's way; to have one's wish fulfilled (often in a negative sense)
explanation_mandarin: 指阴谋或不正当的愿望实现，达到目的。通常带贬义。
explanation_english: To succeed in achieving something, usually a plot or a dishonorable goal. Often used in a negative context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想呃我錢，不過最後都冇得逞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ngaak1 ngo5 cin2, bat1 gwo3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 dak1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想骗我的钱，不过最后都没有得逞。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to scam me out of my money, but in the end, he didn't succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班壞人嘅陰謀冇得逞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 waai6 jan4 ge3 jam1 mau4 mou5 dak1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些坏人的阴谋没有得逞。
examples.english_sentence: The villains' plot didn't succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅詭計始終都冇得逞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gwai2 gai3 ci2 zung1 dou1 mou5 dak1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的诡计始终没有得逞。
examples.english_sentence: His trick never succeeded.

english_meaning: to get by; to make do; passable; just good enough
explanation_mandarin: 指做事马虎，随便应付，只求过得去，不追求卓越或完美。
explanation_english: Refers to doing things sloppily, just trying to get by without striving for excellence or perfection. It suggests a lack of dedication or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 是但啦，得過且過咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 daan6 laa1, dak1 gwo3 ce2 gwo3 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随便啦，得过且过就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever, just get by and that's enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好求其㗎，得過就算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 kau4 kei4 gaa3, dak1 gwo3 zau6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很随便的，得过且过。
examples.english_sentence: He does things very casually, just trying to get by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告得過，唔夠詳細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 dak1 gwo3, m4 gau3 cheung4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告只是过得去，不够详细。
examples.english_sentence: This report is just passable, not detailed enough.

mandarin_meaning: 得过且过 (dé guò qiě guò)
english_meaning: Muddling along; taking things as they come; getting by as best one can; taking a lackadaisical approach; living for the moment without planning for the future.
explanation_mandarin: 形容过一天算一天，没有长远打算，不求上进。
explanation_english: Describes a way of life where one lives only for the present without considering the future, and without striving for improvement; taking a passive and unmotivated approach to life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都得過且過，所以咪俾老細鬧囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 dak1 gwo3 che2 gwo3, so2 ji5 mai1 bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是得过且过，所以才被老板骂。
examples.english_sentence: He always muddles along with his work, that's why he gets scolded by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好得過且過啦，要為自己嘅將來諗下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dak1 gwo3 che2 gwo3 laa1, jiu3 wai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 jeung1 loi4 nam2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别得过且过了，要为自己的将来想想。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just muddle along, you need to think about your future.

synonyms: hea (Cantonese slang, meaning to slack off)

english_meaning: to have free time, to be free, when free
explanation_mandarin: 表示有空闲时间，可以做某事。既可以作为动词表示“有空”，也可以作为形容词表示“空闲的”。
explanation_english: Indicates having free time to do something. It can be used as a verb meaning 'to have free time' or as an adjective meaning 'free'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得閑嘅時候會打電話俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 haan4 ge3 si4 hau6 wui5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我空闲的时候会打电话给你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you when I'm free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日得唔得閑啊？一齊去睇戲吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3? jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天有没有空啊？一起去看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Are you free tomorrow? Let's go see a movie together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得閑飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 haan4 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有空喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have tea when we're free.

english_meaning: to have free time; to be available; free
explanation_mandarin: 表示有空闲时间，可以做某事。
explanation_english: Describes having free time or being available to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你得閒嘅時候可唔可以幫我手啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dak1 haan4 ge3 si4 hau6 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你空闲的时候可不可以帮我一下忙？
examples.english_sentence: When you're free, can you help me out?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日都唔得閒，後日得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 dou1 m4 dak1 haan4, hau6 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天都没空，后天可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow either, is the day after tomorrow okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得閒飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 haan4 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有空喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have tea sometime when you are free.

english_meaning: So idle as to have nothing to do, even taking a dump.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常空闲，无所事事，连上厕所这种事情都变得没有了。带有夸张和讽刺的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely idle and has nothing to do, to the point where even something as basic as taking a dump becomes unnecessary. It is used with exaggeration and irony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都得閒冇屎屙咁，真係羨慕死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 dak1 haan4 mou5 si2 o1 gam2, zan1 hai6 sin6 mou6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都闲得没事做，真让人羡慕死了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so idle every day, it's really enviable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排得閒冇屎屙，不如我幫你手做啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 dak1 haan4 mou5 si2 o1, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 bong1 nei5 sau2 zou6 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近闲得没事做，不如我帮你做点事吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so idle these days, how about I help you with something?

jyutping: dak1 haan4 sei2 m4 dak1 haan4 beng6
mandarin_meaning: 宁愿有空的时候死，没空的时候生病
english_meaning: Too busy to be sick, but not too busy to die.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常忙碌，连生病的时间都没有，但总有一天会因为过度劳累而倒下。是一种讽刺的说法，暗示工作狂最终会付出健康的代价。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is so busy that they don't have time to be sick, implying that they will eventually collapse from overwork. It's a satirical expression highlighting the health costs of being a workaholic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日做到三更半夜，真係得閒死唔得閒病啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 zou6 dou3 saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6, zan1 hai6 dak1 haan4 sei2 m4 dak1 haan4 beng6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天工作到深夜，真是宁愿有空的时候死，没空的时候生病啊。
examples.english_sentence: He works until the wee hours of the morning every day, he's really too busy to be sick, but not too busy to die.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁搏命啦，得閒死唔得閒病，到時後悔就嚟唔切㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 bok3 ming6 laa1, dak1 haan4 sei2 m4 dak1 haan4 beng6, dou3 si4 hau6 fui3 zau6 lei4 m4 cit3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么拼命了，宁愿有空的时候死，没空的时候生病，到时候后悔就来不及了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard, you're going to be too busy to be sick, but not too busy to die. It will be too late to regret it later.

english_meaning: Let's have tea when you're free.
explanation_mandarin: 一种客套的邀请，表示希望以后有机会一起喝茶聊天。通常在告别时使用，不一定真的会安排具体时间。
explanation_english: A polite invitation suggesting that you should get together for tea and a chat when you're free. It's often used as a parting phrase and doesn't necessarily mean a specific time will be arranged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，今日傾到呢度，得閒飲茶！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, gam1 jat6 king1 dou3 ni1 dou6, dak1 haan4 jam2 caa4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，今天就聊到这里，有空喝茶！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, we've chatted enough for today, let's have tea when you're free!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次再見，得閒飲茶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 zoi3 gin3, dak1 haan4 jam2 caa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次再见，有空喝茶啊。
examples.english_sentence: See you next time, let's have tea when you're free.

jyutping: dak1 jiu4 yan4 cyu3 ce2 jiu4 yan4
english_meaning: Where it is possible to pardon, then pardon.
explanation_mandarin: 指应该宽容别人的地方，就应该宽容别人。劝人要宽容待人，不要过于苛刻。
explanation_english: This idiom advises people to be tolerant and forgiving of others, especially when they have made a mistake. It suggests showing leniency and avoiding being overly harsh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都知錯喇，得饒人處且饒人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 zi1 co3 laa3, dak1 jiu4 yan4 cyu3 ce2 jiu4 yan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都知道错了，得饶人处且饶人吧。
examples.english_sentence: He already knows he's wrong, where it is possible to pardon, then pardon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，得饒人處且饒人，下次小心啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, dak1 jiu4 yan4 cyu3 ce2 jiu4 yan4, haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，得饶人处且饶人，下次小心点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, where it is possible to pardon, then pardon. Just be more careful next time.

english_meaning: appropriate; suitable; proper; tasteful; decent
explanation_mandarin: 指言行举止合适，合乎礼仪规范，使人感觉舒服。
explanation_english: Describes behavior, speech, or appearance that is appropriate, suitable, and in good taste, making others feel comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著得好得體，睇嚟佢好重視呢個場合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 dak1 tai2, tai2 lai4 keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 ni1 go3 ho2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得很得体，看来她很重视这个场合。
examples.english_sentence: She is dressed very appropriately today; it seems she values this occasion a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺正式場合，講嘢要得體啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 sik1 ho2 hoeng2, gong2 je5 jiu3 dak1 tai2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在正式场合，说话要得体一些。
examples.english_sentence: In formal occasions, one should speak more appropriately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅回應好得體，避開咗好多尷尬嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wui4 ying3 hou2 dak1 tai2, bei6 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 gaam3 gaai3 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的回应很得体，避免了很多尴尬的情况。
examples.english_sentence: His response was very appropriate, avoiding many awkward situations.

english_meaning: to pace back and forth, to walk around, to loiter
explanation_mandarin: 形容在一个地方来回走动，犹豫不决的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the act of walking back and forth in a place, often indicating hesitation or indecisiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺門口徘咗好耐，都唔知入唔入去好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mun4 hau2 pui4 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 m4 zi1 jap6 m4 jap6 heoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在门口徘徊了很久，都不知道进不进去好。
examples.english_sentence: He paced back and forth at the doorway for a long time, not knowing whether to go in or not.

english_meaning: to pace back and forth; to hesitate; to waver; to linger
explanation_mandarin: 来回走动，犹豫不定；比喻事物在某个范围内来回浮动。
explanation_english: To move back and forth, usually because of hesitation or indecision; also used metaphorically to describe something fluctuating within a certain range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條街度徘徊咗好耐，好似諗緊啲乜嘢噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 pui4 wui4 zo2 hou2 noi6, hou2 ci5 lam2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上徘徊了很久，好像在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He paced back and forth on the street for a long time, as if he was thinking about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個股市一路喺高位徘徊，唔知幾時會跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gu2 si5 jat1 lou6 hai2 gou1 wai2 pui4 wui4, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 wui5 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市一直在高位徘徊，不知道什么时候会下跌。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has been hovering at a high level, not knowing when it will fall.

english_meaning: to move, to migrate, to shift
explanation_mandarin: 移动位置；搬迁。
explanation_english: To move from one place to another; to migrate or shift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成家要徙去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 gaa1 jiu3 sai2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家要移民去加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family is going to migrate to Canada.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司下個月會徙辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 sai2 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司下个月会搬办公室。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will move the office next month.

english_meaning: resettlement; to resettle; public housing estate (historical context in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 将人或物迁移到新的地方安置。在香港，特指早期的公共房屋计划，将贫民安置在新建的徙置区。
explanation_english: To relocate and resettle people or things. In Hong Kong, it specifically refers to the early public housing schemes designed to resettle squatters and the poor into newly built resettlement estates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人住喺山邊嘅木屋，政府就將佢哋徙置去徙置區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 zyu6 hai2 saan1 bin1 ge3 muk6 uk1, zing3 fu2 zau6 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 sai2 zi3 heoi3 sai2 zi3 khu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们住在山边的木屋里，政府就把他们安置到徙置区。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people lived in wooden huts on the hillsides, and the government resettled them to resettlement estates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆以前住喺徙置區，嗰度嘅環境唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 ji5 cin4 zyu6 hai2 sai2 zi3 khu1, go2 dou6 ge3 waan4 ging2 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶以前住在徙置区，那里的环境不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother used to live in a resettlement estate, the environment there wasn't very good.

english_meaning: Resettlement Estate
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府在1950年代至1970年代为了安置大量贫民而兴建的公共房屋。
explanation_english: Resettlement Estates were public housing estates built by the Hong Kong government from the 1950s to the 1970s to resettle large numbers of poor people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候住喺徙置區，環境真係好擠迫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zyu6 hai2 sai2 zi3 keoi1, waan4 ging2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zai1 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候住在安置区，环境真的很拥挤。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I lived in a resettlement estate, and the environment was really cramped.

english_meaning: to stand; to stand up
explanation_mandarin: 站立。粤语口语中表示站立的意思。
explanation_english: To stand. A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to stand up or to be standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好坐住啦，徛起身郁動下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 co5 zyu6 laa3, khei5 hei2 san1 juk1 dung6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要一直坐着了，站起来活动一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just sit there, stand up and move around a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢徛喺門口度等緊你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 khei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dou6 dang2 gan2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在门口等着你。
examples.english_sentence: He is standing at the doorway waiting for you.

english_meaning: from; since; through; via; follow; obey; pursue
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词, 动词, 副词
explanation_mandarin: 表示起点；表示顺从；表示依据；表示由来；表示从事；表示始终
explanation_english: Indicates origin/starting point; indicates obedience/following; indicates basis/according to; indicates source/derivation; indicates occupation/engagement; indicates consistency/from beginning to end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋從呢度出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cung4 ni1 dou6 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从这里出发。
examples.english_sentence: We start from here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你從边度嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cung4 bin1 dou6 lei4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你从哪里来的？
examples.english_sentence: Where are you from?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從小就鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 siu2 zau6 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从小就喜欢他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I have liked him/her since I was young.

english_meaning: to be faithful to one partner to the end (usually in marriage); to remain loyal; constancy
explanation_mandarin: 指对一个人始终如一，多用于婚姻方面，形容对配偶忠贞不渝。
explanation_english: Refers to remaining faithful to one person from beginning to end, often used in the context of marriage to describe unwavering loyalty to one's spouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚五十年，真係從一而終，好令人羡慕啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ng5 sap6 nin4, zan1 hai6 cung4 jat1 ji4 zung1, hou2 ling6 jan4 sin6 mou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚五十年，真是从一而终，很令人羡慕啊。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for fifty years, truly faithful to each other to the end. It's so enviable.

synonyms: 白頭偕老 (baak6 tau4 haai4 lou5)
矢志不渝 (si2 zi3 bat1 jyu4)

english_meaning: never
explanation_mandarin: 表示从来没有过某种行为或状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has never happened or been in a certain state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從不講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 bat1 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从不说谎。
examples.english_sentence: He never tells lies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從不食牛肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 bat1 sik6 ngau4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从不吃牛肉。
examples.english_sentence: I never eat beef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從不遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 bat1 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从不迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He is never late.

english_meaning: from it; out of it; therein; from within; in the process; during; between
explanation_mandarin: 表示从某个事物或过程中得到某种好处或结果；或者表示在两者之间起作用。
explanation_english: Indicates deriving some benefit or result from something or a process; or indicates acting between two things or people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺呢件事從中獲利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 cung4 zung1 wok6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在这件事中获利。
examples.english_sentence: They profited from this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以從中學習到好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 cung4 zung1 hok6 zaap6 dou3 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以从中学习到很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: We can learn a lot from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以從中幫到你哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 cung4 zung1 bong1 dou2 nei5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以从中帮到你们。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can help you through this.

english_meaning: to obstruct from within, to put a spoke in someone's wheel, to sabotage
explanation_mandarin: 在暗中设置障碍，使事情不能顺利进行。
explanation_english: To secretly obstruct or hinder someone's plans or actions, causing difficulties and preventing them from succeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度從中作梗，搞到我哋做嘢好唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 cung4 zung1 zok3 gang2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 hou2 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是从中作梗，搞得我们工作很不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts a spoke in our wheel, making our work very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好從中作梗啦，俾佢試下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 cung4 zung1 zok3 gang2 laa1, bei2 keoi5 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要从中作梗了，让他试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sabotage him, let him try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我怀疑佢哋從中作梗，令到单生意倾唔成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waai4 ji4 keoi5 dei6 cung4 zung1 zok3 gang2, ling6 dou3 daan1 saang1 ji3 king1 m4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怀疑他们从中作梗，导致这单生意没谈成。
examples.english_sentence: I suspect they sabotaged it, causing the deal to fall through.
