english_meaning: to be engaged in; to undertake; to deal with; to handle; to do
explanation_mandarin: 指做某种工作、事业。
explanation_english: To be engaged in a particular job, profession, or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從事教育工作已經超過十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 si6 gaau3 juk6 gung1 zok3 ji5 ging1 ciu1 gwo3 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从事教育工作已经超过十年了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been engaged in education for over ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將來想從事邊方面嘅工作？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 loi4 soeng2 cung4 si6 bin1 fong1 min6 ge3 gung1 zok3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你将来想从事哪方面的工作？
examples.english_sentence: What kind of work do you want to be engaged in in the future?

english_meaning: from now on; henceforth
explanation_mandarin: 表示从现在开始以后的一段时间。
explanation_english: Indicates a period of time starting from the present moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 從今以後，我會努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cung4 gam1 ji5 hau6, ngo5 wui5 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从今以后，我会努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: From now on, I will study hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從今以後唔會再信你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 gam1 ji5 hau6 m4 wui5 zoi3 seon3 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从今以后不会再相信你了。
examples.english_sentence: I won't trust you anymore from now on.

english_meaning: always; all along; ever; (not) ever; (not) in the slightest
explanation_mandarin: 表示从过去到现在一直都是这样，或者从来没有发生过。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has always been the case from the past to the present, or that it has never happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從來都唔信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从来都不相信他所说的话。
examples.english_sentence: I never believe what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從來都冇遲到過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mou5 ci4 dou3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从来没有迟到过。
examples.english_sentence: He has never been late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題我從來都未聽過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ngo5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mei6 ting1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题我从来都没听过。
examples.english_sentence: I have never heard of this problem before.

english_meaning: formerly, in the past, once upon a time
explanation_mandarin: 指过去的某个时间，相当于“以前”、“以往”。
explanation_english: Refers to a time in the past; equivalent to "previously" or "in the past". Can be used to introduce a story or to refer to a period of time that has already passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 從前有座山，山上面有間廟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cung4 cin4 jau5 zo6 saan1, saan1 soeng6 min6 jau5 gaan1 miu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从前有座山，山上有个庙。
examples.english_sentence: Once upon a time, there was a mountain, and on the mountain, there was a temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從前喺香港住㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 cin4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以前住在香港的。
examples.english_sentence: I used to live in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你從前做咩㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cung4 cin4 zou6 me1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以前是做什么的？
examples.english_sentence: What did you used to do?

english_meaning: Subordinate clause, dependent clause
explanation_mandarin: 语法学术语，依附于主句，不能独立成句的句子成分。
explanation_english: A grammatical term referring to a clause that is dependent on a main clause and cannot stand alone as a complete sentence. A subordinate clause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句句子有個從句，你睇唔睇得出啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 geoi3 zi2 jau5 go3 cung4 geoi3, nei5 tai2 m4 tai2 dak1 ceot1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个句子有个从句，你看得出来吗？
examples.english_sentence: This sentence has a subordinate clause, can you identify it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢解釋乜嘢係名詞性從句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai2 sik1 mat1 je5 hai6 ming4 ci4 sing3 cung4 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他解释什么是名词性从句。
examples.english_sentence: He explained what a noun clause is.

english_meaning: to obey an order; to comply; at your service; as you wish
explanation_mandarin: 听从命令，服从指示。
explanation_english: To obey a command or instruction; to comply with a request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細吩咐，我哋唯有從命啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 fan1 fu3, ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 cung4 ming6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板吩咐了，我们只好听从命令了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss has instructed us, so we have no choice but to obey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你咁堅持，我就從命啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 gam3 gin1 ci4, ngo5 zau6 cung4 ming6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你这么坚持，我就服从你的意思吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since you insist so much, I'll do as you wish.

english_meaning: to engage in commerce, to do business
explanation_mandarin: 指从事商业活动，做买卖。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in commercial activities or doing business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家都係從商嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 dou1 hai6 cung4 soeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家都是做生意的。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family is in business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都想從商，但係冇乜本錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng2 cung4 soeng1, daan6 hai6 mou5 mat1 bun2 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都想经商，但是没什么本钱。
examples.english_sentence: He has always wanted to go into business, but he doesn't have much capital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人都想從商，自己做老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 cung4 soeng1, zi6 gei2 zou6 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都想经商，自己当老板。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people want to go into business and be their own boss.

english_meaning: readily accepting good advice; to accept good advice like water flowing downstream; to be receptive to good ideas
explanation_mandarin: 形容乐于接受正确的意见，如同水从高处流向低处一样顺畅自然。
explanation_english: Describes someone who readily accepts good advice or suggestions. The metaphor compares it to water flowing downstream, suggesting smoothness and ease of acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好從善如流㗎，你畀啲意見佢，佢會考慮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung4 sin6 jyu4 lau4 gaa3, nei5 bei2 di1 ji3 gin3 keoi5, keoi5 wui5 hau2 leoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很从善如流的，你给他一些意见，他会考虑的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very receptive to advice. If you give him some suggestions, he will consider them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細嘅優點就係從善如流，所以公司嘅氣氛好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 ge3 jau1 dim2 zau6 hai6 cung4 sin6 jyu4 lau4, so2 ji5 gung1 si1 ge3 hei3 fan1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板的优点就是从善如流，所以公司的气氛很好。
examples.english_sentence: The boss's strength is his receptiveness to good advice, so the company's atmosphere is very good.

synonyms: 虛心納諫 (heoi1 sam1 naap6 gaan3)

english_meaning: always; ever; all along; from the beginning; hitherto
explanation_mandarin: 表示一向如此，從過去到現在都是這樣。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has always been the case, from the past until now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從嚟都唔鍾意食榴槤㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 lai4 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 lau4 lin4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我從來都不喜歡吃榴莲的。
examples.english_sentence: I have never liked durian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從嚟都咁勤力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 lai4 dou1 gam3 kan4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都很勤奋的。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been so diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從嚟未去過日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 lai4 mei6 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我從來没有去過日本。
examples.english_sentence: I have never been to Japan.

english_meaning: to fall from the sky; to appear out of nowhere; a sudden, unexpected arrival
explanation_mandarin: 指像从天上掉下来一样。比喻突然出现，意想不到。
explanation_english: Describes something falling from the sky or appearing suddenly and unexpectedly, often implying it's a lucky or surprising occurrence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似從天而降咁，突然間就出現喺我面前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 cung4 tin1 ji4 gong4 gam2, dat6 jin4 gaan1 zau6 ceot1 hin3 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像从天而降一样，突然间就出现在我面前。
examples.english_sentence: He appeared as if he fell from the sky, suddenly appearing in front of me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中咗六合彩就好似從天而降嘅橫財咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 zau6 hou2 ci5 cung4 tin1 ji4 gong4 ge3 waang4 coi4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中了彩票就像从天而降的横财一样。
examples.english_sentence: Winning the lottery is like a windfall falling from the sky.

english_meaning: calm; unhurried; leisurely; composed
explanation_mandarin: 形容镇定、不慌张的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being calm, unhurried, and composed, especially in the face of difficulty or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遇到咁大嘅困難都表現得好從容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyu6 dou3 gam3 daai6 ge3 kwan3 naan4 dou1 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 cung4 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他遇到这么大的困难都表现得很从容。
examples.english_sentence: He remained very calm even when faced with such a big difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從容噉完成咗呢個任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 yung4 gam2 waan4 sing4 zo2 ni1 go3 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从容地完成了这个任务。
examples.english_sentence: He completed this task calmly.

english_meaning: calm and unhurried; leisurely; composed
explanation_mandarin: 形容在紧急或繁忙的情况下，也能保持镇定，不慌不忙。
explanation_english: Describes being calm and unhurried, even in urgent or busy situations; maintaining composure and not being flustered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算趕時間，佢都好似從容不迫咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 gon2 si4 gaan3, keoi5 dou1 hou2 ci5 cung4 yung4 bat1 bik1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使赶时间，他也好像从容不迫的样子。
examples.english_sentence: Even when he's in a hurry, he still appears calm and unhurried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢處理危機嘅時候，永遠都係從容不迫，好可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyu5 lei5 ngai4 gei1 ge3 si4 hau6, wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 cung4 yung4 bat1 bik1, hou2 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他处理危机的时候，永远都是从容不迫，很可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He is always calm and composed when dealing with crises, very reliable.

mandarin_meaning: 从容就义 (cóng róng jiù yì)
english_meaning: To die a martyr calmly; to face death with composure for a just cause
explanation_mandarin: 指为了正义事业而从容地面对死亡，表现出大义凛然、视死如归的精神。
explanation_english: Describes the act of facing death calmly and with composure for a just cause, displaying a spirit of righteousness and fearlessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明知會死，但係都從容就義，真係好偉大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 zi1 wui5 sei2, daan6 hai6 dou1 cung4 yung4 zau6 ji6, zan1 hai6 hou2 wai5 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明知道会死，但是还是从容就义，真的很伟大。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he would die, but he still faced death calmly for the cause, he is truly great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 革命烈士為咗國家嘅獨立，從容就義，精神可嘉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 ming6 lit6 si6 wai4 zo2 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 duk6 laap6, cung4 yung4 zau6 ji6, zing1 san4 ho2 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 革命烈士为了国家的独立，从容就义，精神可嘉。
examples.english_sentence: The revolutionary martyrs faced death calmly for the independence of the country, their spirit is commendable.

english_meaning: Confess truthfully; Tell the truth and nothing but the truth; Own up
explanation_mandarin: 指坦白交代，把事情的真相说出来。多用于审问或责问的语境。
explanation_english: To confess truthfully; to tell the truth, especially when interrogated or questioned. It implies an urging to reveal the whole truth without holding back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人叫佢從實招來，唔好再講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 jan4 giu3 keoi5 cung4 sat6 ziu1 loi4, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察叫他从实招来，不要再说谎了。
examples.english_sentence: The police told him to confess truthfully and not lie anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好都係從實招來，唔係嘅話後果自負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 cung4 sat6 ziu1 loi4, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 hau6 gwo2 zi6 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好还是从实招来，不然的话后果自负。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better confess truthfully, or you'll bear the consequences.

synonyms: 坦白從寬 (taan2 baak6 cung4 fun1)

english_meaning: from childhood; since childhood
explanation_mandarin: 表示从幼年时期开始。
explanation_english: Indicates starting from a young age; from childhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從小就鍾意食甜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 siu2 zau6 zung1 ji3 sik6 tim4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从小就喜欢吃甜食。
examples.english_sentence: I have liked eating sweets since I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從小就好叻讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 siu2 zau6 hou2 lek1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就很会读书。
examples.english_sentence: He has been very good at studying since childhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥從小就照顧我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 cung4 siu2 zau6 ziu3 gu3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥从小就照顾我。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother has taken care of me since I was a child.

english_meaning: subordinate, dependent, affiliated, subsidiary
explanation_mandarin: 指归属，隶属，依附于某个事物或组织。
explanation_english: Referring to belonging to, being affiliated with, or being dependent on something or an organization. Indicates a relationship of subordination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間分公司係從屬於總公司嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fan1 gung1 si1 hai6 cung4 suk6 jyu1 zung2 gung1 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家分公司是隶属于总公司的。
examples.english_sentence: This branch company is subordinate to the head office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前係英國嘅從屬地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 hai6 jing1 gwok3 ge3 cung4 suk6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港以前是英国的附属地。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to be a British dependency.

english_meaning: to begin a career in filmmaking; to enter the film industry
explanation_mandarin: 指开始从事电影相关的职业，如演员、导演等。
explanation_english: To embark on a career related to film, such as acting, directing, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就夢想住大個要從影，做個大明星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 mung6 soeng2 zyu6 daai6 go3 jiu3 cung4 jing2, zou6 go3 daai6 ming4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就梦想长大后要从事电影工作，成为大明星。
examples.english_sentence: He dreamed since he was young that he would enter the film industry when he grew up and become a big star.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從影三十幾年，拍過好多經典電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 jing2 saam1 sap6 gei2 nin4, paak3 gwo3 hou2 do1 ging1 din2 din6 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从事电影工作三十多年，拍过很多经典电影。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in the film industry for over thirty years and has made many classic films.

english_meaning: to follow one's heart's desires; to do as one pleases; to have one's way
explanation_mandarin: 指按照自己的心意去做事，想做什么就做什么。
explanation_english: To do whatever one wants; to act according to one's desires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家有錢，可以從心所欲咁生活啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 cin2, ho2 ji5 cung4 sam1 so2 juk6 gam2 sang1 wut6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在有钱了，可以随心所欲地生活了。
examples.english_sentence: Now that he's rich, he can live as he pleases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔可以從心所欲，都要顧及其他人嘅感受㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 cung4 sam1 so2 juk6, dou1 jiu3 gu3 kap6 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 gam2 sau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不能随心所欲，也要顾及其他人的感受啊。
examples.english_sentence: One cannot just do as one pleases; you need to consider other people's feelings.

english_meaning: to engage in politics; to enter politics; to pursue a political career
explanation_mandarin: 指参与政治活动，从事政治工作。
explanation_english: Refers to participating in political activities and engaging in political work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣已經立志從政。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 lap6 zi3 cung4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就已经立志从政了。
examples.english_sentence: He had already resolved to enter politics when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人覺得香港嘅政治環境好複雜，所以唔想從政。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 gok3 dak1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zing3 zi6 waan4 ging2 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, so2 ji5 m4 soeng2 cung4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人觉得香港的政治环境很复杂，所以不想从政。
examples.english_sentence: Many people feel that Hong Kong's political environment is very complicated, so they don't want to engage in politics.

english_meaning: never; have never
explanation_mandarin: 表示从来没有发生过。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has never happened before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從未去過日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 mei6 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从未去过日本。
examples.english_sentence: I have never been to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢從未遲到過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung4 mei6 ci4 dou3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从未迟到过。
examples.english_sentence: He has never been late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從未見過咁靚嘅風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 mei6 gin3 gwo3 gam3 leng3 ge3 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从未见过这么美的风景。
examples.english_sentence: I have never seen such beautiful scenery.

english_meaning: employee, worker
explanation_mandarin: 指从事某种职业的人员，泛指在职员工。
explanation_english: Refers to personnel engaged in a certain occupation; generally refers to employed staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有好多從業員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 cung4 jip6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有很多从业人员。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has many employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 所有嘅從業員都應該準時返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 jau5 ge3 cung4 jip6 jyun4 dou1 jing1 goi1 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有的从业人员都应该准时上班。
examples.english_sentence: All employees should arrive at work on time.

english_meaning: from now on; henceforth; since then
explanation_mandarin: 表示从这个时候开始。
explanation_english: Indicates from this point onward; from now on; since then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我決定以後唔再飲汽水，從此以後淨係飲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ji5 hau6 m4 zoi3 yam2 hei3 seoi2, cung4 ci2 ji5 hau6 zing6 hai6 yam2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我决定以后不再喝汽水，从此以后只喝水。
examples.english_sentence: I decided to stop drinking soda from now on, and only drink water from now on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢哋結婚之後，從此過住幸福嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6, cung4 ci2 gwo3 zyu6 hang6 fuk1 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他们结婚之后，从此过着幸福的生活。
examples.english_sentence: Since they got married, they have lived a happy life since then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗份工，從此就開始咗自己嘅事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, cung4 ci2 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞掉了工作，从此就开始了自己的事业。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job and started his own business from then on.

english_meaning: accessory
explanation_mandarin: 指在共同犯罪中起次要或辅助作用的犯罪人。
explanation_english: An accessory; a person who assists in the commission of a crime but is not the principal offender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然有份參與，但只係從犯，唔係主謀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jyun4 jau5 fan6 caam1 jyu5, daan6 zi2 hai6 cung4 faan2, m4 hai6 zyu2 mau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然有参与，但只是从犯，不是主谋。
examples.english_sentence: Although he participated, he was only an accessory, not the mastermind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方拉咗個從犯，希望佢可以指證主腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 laai1 zo2 go3 cung4 faan2, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 zi2 zing3 zyu2 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方逮捕了一个从犯，希望他可以指证主脑。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested an accessory, hoping he can identify the mastermind.

english_meaning: to simplify; to keep things simple; to do something simply
explanation_mandarin: 指简化程序、过程或仪式，不铺张浪费。
explanation_english: To simplify a process, procedure, or ceremony; to avoid extravagance and waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次婚禮想從簡，唔想搞得太複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 fan1 lai5 soeng2 cung4 gaan2, m4 soeng2 gaau2 dak1 taai3 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这次婚礼想从简，不想搞得太复杂。
examples.english_sentence: We want to keep our wedding simple this time, we don't want to make it too complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喪禮一切從簡，唔需要大排筵席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: song1 lai5 jat1 cai3 cung4 gaan2, m4 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 paai4 jin4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 葬礼一切从简，不需要大摆筵席。
examples.english_sentence: The funeral should be simple, no need for a large banquet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議從簡，主要係想快啲達成共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui5 ji5 cung4 gaan2, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 soeng2 faai3 di1 daat6 sing4 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议从简，主要是想快点达成共识。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting will be simplified, mainly to reach a consensus quickly.

english_meaning: thus; thereby; as a result; consequently
explanation_mandarin: 表示上文是原因、条件等，下文是结果、目的等，连接前后两个分句。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that the preceding sentence is the cause or condition, and the following sentence is the result or purpose. It connects two clauses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力讀書，從而考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6 duk6 syu1, cung4 ji4 haau2 dou2 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力学习，从而考到了好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: He studied very hard, thus achieved good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 提高生產力，從而增加盈利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai4 gou1 sang1 caan2 lik6, cung4 ji4 zeng1 gaa1 jing4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 提高生产力，从而增加盈利。
examples.english_sentence: Improve productivity, thereby increasing profits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多啲運動，從而改善健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 di1 wan6 dung6, cung4 ji4 goi2 sin6 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多运动，从而改善健康。
examples.english_sentence: Exercise more, consequently improving your health.

english_meaning: to turn over a new leaf (specifically of a prostitute); to go straight
explanation_mandarin: 指妓女或不正当职业的女性放弃原有的职业，改为从事正当职业，过正常的生活。
explanation_english: Refers to a prostitute or a woman engaged in an illicit occupation giving up her profession to pursue a legitimate career and lead a normal life; to reform oneself (especially from a disreputable profession).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢想從良，搵份正經嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 soeng2 cung4 loeng4, wan2 fan6 zing3 ging1 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她想从良，找一份正经的工作做。
examples.english_sentence: She said she wants to go straight and find a proper job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前佢做偏門嘢，而家決心從良，重新做人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 keoi5 zou6 pin1 mun4 je5, ji4 gaa1 kyut3 sam1 cung4 loeng4, cung4 san1 zou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前他做不正当的事情，现在决心从良，重新做人。
examples.english_sentence: He used to do shady things, but now he is determined to turn over a new leaf and start over.

english_meaning: to join the army; to enlist
explanation_mandarin: 指参加军队，成为军人。
explanation_english: To join the army; to enlist as a soldier. It implies becoming a member of the armed forces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候就已經想從軍保家衛國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 ji5 ging1 soeng2 cung4 gwan1 bou2 gaa1 wai6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就想从军保家卫国。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to join the army to defend his country since he was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時好多後生仔都選擇從軍打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 hou2 do1 hau6 sang1 zai2 dou1 syun2 zaak6 cung4 gwan1 daa2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时很多年轻人都选择从军打仗。
examples.english_sentence: At that time, many young people chose to join the army to fight.

english_meaning: to give a lenient sentence, to let off lightly
explanation_mandarin: 指对犯错的人给予较轻的处罚。
explanation_english: To give a person who has committed an offense a lighter punishment than they might otherwise have received.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢犯咗法，但係佢認錯態度良好，希望法官可以從輕發落啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 faan6 zo2 faat3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 jing6 co3 taai3 dou6 loeng4 hou2, hei1 mong6 faat3 gun1 ho2 ji5 cung4 hing1 faat3 lok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他犯了法，但是他认错态度良好，希望法官可以从轻发落。
examples.english_sentence: Although he broke the law, he has shown remorse and a good attitude, hopefully the judge can give him a lighter sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為係初犯，而且情節輕微，所以法庭決定從輕發落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 hai6 co1 faan2, ji4 ce2 cing4 zit3 hing1 mei4, so2 ji5 faat3 ting4 kyut3 ding6 cung4 hing1 faat3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为是初犯，而且情节轻微，所以法庭决定从轻发落。
examples.english_sentence: Because it was his first offense and the circumstances were minor, the court decided to give him a lenient sentence.

english_meaning: as soon as possible; promptly; quickly
explanation_mandarin: 尽快，赶快。
explanation_english: To do something as quickly as possible; promptly; without delay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要從速處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 cung4 suk1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事要从速处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你從速回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 cung4 suk1 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你从速回复。
examples.english_sentence: Please reply as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會從速跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 cung4 suk1 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会从速跟进。
examples.english_sentence: We will follow up promptly.

english_meaning: to consider something at length; to take one's time in deliberation; to give careful consideration
explanation_mandarin: 慢慢地、从长远考虑商议。指不急于做出决定，留出充分的时间进行考虑和讨论。
explanation_english: To consider something at length and from a long-term perspective. It suggests taking one's time to deliberate and discuss an issue thoroughly before making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁重要，我哋都要從長計議吓先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 zung6 jiu3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 cung4 coeng4 gai3 ji5 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么重要，我们都要从长计议一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so important, we need to consider it carefully first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁快決定嘅，不如我哋返去從長計議下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 kyut3 ding6 ge3, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 faan1 heoi3 cung4 coeng4 gai3 ji5 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么快决定，不如我们回去从长计议一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's no need to decide so quickly, how about we go back and consider it carefully?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話呢個計劃要從長計議，睇嚟都仲有好多嘢要改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 cung4 coeng4 gai3 ji5, tai2 lai4 dou1 zung1 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说这个计划要从长计议，看来还有很多东西要改。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said this plan needs to be carefully considered, it seems there are still many things that need to be changed.

english_meaning: from the beginning; again; starting over
explanation_mandarin: 表示从开始的地方；重新开始。
explanation_english: Indicates starting from the beginning point; to start again or over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要從頭開始學過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 tau4 hoi1 si2 hok6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要从头开始重新学习。
examples.english_sentence: We need to start learning all over again from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定從頭嚟過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 cung4 tau4 lai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定从头再来。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to start over from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以從頭講一次？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 cung4 tau4 gong2 jat1 ci3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以从头讲一次吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you tell it again from the beginning?

english_meaning: to start over; to begin again from scratch
explanation_mandarin: 表示从头开始，重新开始做某件事情。
explanation_english: Means to start over, to begin something again from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次失敗咗唔緊要，我哋可以從頭再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sat1 baai6 zo2 m4 gan2 jiu3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 cung4 tau4 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次失败了没关系，我们可以从头再来。
examples.english_sentence: It doesn't matter that we failed this time, we can start over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執咗笠，但係我唔灰心，我會從頭再嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 zo2 lap1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 fui1 sam1, ngo5 wui5 cung4 tau4 zoi3 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，但是我不会灰心，我会重新开始的。
examples.english_sentence: The company closed down, but I'm not discouraged, I will start over.

english_meaning: from beginning to end; from start to finish; all the way through
explanation_mandarin: 指从开始到结束的整个过程。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire process from beginning to end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我從頭到尾都冇聽過佢講呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 mou5 ting1 gwo3 keoi5 gong2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从头到尾都没听过他/她说过这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I never heard him/her mention this matter from beginning to end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲我從頭到尾都覺得好悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ngo5 cung4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影我从头到尾都觉得很闷。
examples.english_sentence: I found this movie boring from start to finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要從頭到尾檢查清楚份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 tau4 dou3 mei5 gim2 caa4 cing1 co2 fun5 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要从头到尾仔细检查这份报告。
examples.english_sentence: We need to check this report carefully from start to finish.

english_meaning: from head to toe; all over
explanation_mandarin: 指从头部到脚部，表示全身，全部。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire body, from head to toe; all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢濕晒，從頭到腳都係水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sap1 saai3, cung4 tau4 dou3 geok3 dou1 hai6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他湿透了，从头到脚都是水。
examples.english_sentence: He's soaking wet, completely covered in water from head to toe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好攰，從頭到腳都攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6, cung4 tau4 dou3 geok3 dou1 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很累，从头到脚都累。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so tired today, exhausted from head to toe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗一身新衫，從頭到腳都係名牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 san1 san1 saam1, cung4 tau4 dou3 geok3 dou1 hai6 ming4 paai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿了一身新衣服，从头到脚都是名牌。
examples.english_sentence: He's wearing a whole new outfit, designer brands from head to toe.

english_meaning: to attract; to entice; to lure
explanation_mandarin: 用手段或方法使人或物來到自己身邊。
explanation_english: To attract or entice someone or something to come closer using various means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識徠客嘅，好多人都幫襯佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 laai1 haak3 ge3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 bong1 caan3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会招揽顾客，很多人都光顾他。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to attract customers; many people patronize his business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳用優惠價錢徠客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 yung6 jau1 wai6 gaa3 cin2 laai1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅用优惠价格招揽顾客。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant attracts customers with promotional prices.

english_meaning: to control, to drive, to resist; imperial
explanation_mandarin: 1. 驾驭：控制，驱使。2. 防御：抵挡，防止。3. 皇帝用的，与皇帝有关的。
explanation_english: 1. To control, drive, or manage. 2. To defend or resist. 3. Relating to the emperor; imperial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想御住呢個局面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 jyu6 zyu6 ni1 go3 guk6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想控制这个局面。
examples.english_sentence: They want to control this situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好有御用嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 jau5 jyu6 yung6 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很有皇家专用的感觉。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant gives a feeling of being exclusively for the emperor/royalty.

english_meaning: Big Three, The Three Families, The Three Pillars
explanation_mandarin: 原指日本江户时代有资格继承德川幕府的三个家族。后来泛指在某个领域中，实力最强的三个集团、势力或家族。 在香港，通常指某行业或领域的龙头企业或机构。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the three families eligible to succeed the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan's Edo period. Later, it generally refers to the three most powerful groups, forces, or families in a certain field. In Hong Kong, it usually refers to the leading companies or institutions in a certain industry or field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅銀行業，匯豐、中銀、渣打就係御三家嚟㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ngan4 hang4 jip6, wui6 fung1, zung1 ngan4, zaa1 daat6 zau6 hai6 jyu6 saam1 gaa1 lai4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的银行业，汇丰银行、中国银行和渣打银行就是三大银行。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong's banking industry, HSBC, Bank of China, and Standard Chartered are the Big Three.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司喺地產界都算係御三家之一啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 dei6 caan2 gaai3 dou1 syun3 hai6 jyu6 saam1 gaa1 zi1 jat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司在房地产界也算是三大公司之一了。
examples.english_sentence: Their company can be considered one of the Big Three in the real estate industry.

english_meaning: Older sister type, mature woman, 'onee-san' (Japanese)
explanation_mandarin: 源自日语的流行词语，指外表成熟、有气场，并且有母性气质的年轻女性。通常指20岁以上的女性，身材好，性格独立自信，能给人安全感。
explanation_english: A popular term originating from Japanese, referring to a young woman who appears mature, has an aura of confidence, and possesses maternal qualities. It typically refers to women over 20, with a good figure, independent and confident personality, and able to provide a sense of security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似個御姐咁，好有安全感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 go3 jyu6 ze2 gam2, hou2 jau5 on1 cyun4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的个性像个御姐一样，很有安全感。
examples.english_sentence: Her personality is like an 'onee-san', very reassuring.

english_meaning: Otaku, geek, homebody, someone who is obsessed with hobbies and spends most of their time at home
explanation_mandarin: 指热衷于特定事物，例如动漫、游戏等，并且大部分时间都待在家中，很少社交的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are obsessed with specific hobbies, such as anime, games, etc., and spend most of their time at home with little social interaction. The term originated from Japanese 'otaku'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企打機，真係一個御宅族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 daa2 gei1, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 jyu6 zaak6 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在家玩游戏，真是一个宅男。
examples.english_sentence: He plays video games at home all day, he's really an otaku.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁鍾意睇動漫，會唔會俾人話你係御宅族㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 zung1 ji3 tai2 dung6 maan6, wui5 m4 wui5 bei2 jan4 waa6 nei5 hai6 jyu6 zaak6 zuk6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那么喜欢看动漫，会不会被人说你是宅男/宅女啊？
examples.english_sentence: You like watching anime so much, will people call you an otaku?

english_meaning: Official; designated; appointed for exclusive use by the emperor/organization
explanation_mandarin: 原指皇帝专用的，现在泛指某些机构或个人专门使用的，带有官方或指定的意思。
explanation_english: Originally referring to items exclusively used by the emperor, now it generally refers to something designated or officially appointed for exclusive use by a particular organization or individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳係佢哋公司嘅御用飯堂嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai6 keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 jyu6 yung6 faan6 tong4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅是他们公司的专用食堂。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is their company's designated canteen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係嗰個明星嘅御用化妝師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go2 go3 ming4 sing1 ge3 jyu6 yung6 faa3 zong1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是那个明星的御用化妆师。
examples.english_sentence: He is that celebrity's designated makeup artist.

english_meaning: Queen's Counsel (QC), King's Counsel (KC)
explanation_mandarin: 原指英国或其他英联邦国家的律师，因被君主委任而获得特别的法律地位和荣誉。香港回归前也有此制度，但回归后已废除，现在改名为资深大律师。
explanation_english: Formerly, a senior barrister or advocate appointed to Queen's Counsel (QC) in the United Kingdom and some Commonwealth countries. The appointment was made by the monarch and conferred a special status and honor. Hong Kong had this system before the handover to China, but it was abolished and replaced with the title 'Senior Counsel' after the handover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前香港都有御用大律師㗎，不過回歸之後就冇喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 jau5 jyu6 yung6 daai6 leot6 si1 gaa3, bat1 gwo3 wui4 gwai1 zi1 hau6 zau6 mou5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前香港也有皇家大律师，不过回归之后就没有了。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong used to have Queen's Counsel, but there aren't any after the handover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗御用大律師，真係好叻呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 jyu6 yung6 daai6 leot6 si1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就成为了皇家大律师，真是很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He became Queen's Counsel at such a young age, he's really amazing!

english_meaning: everywhere; all over; throughout; once through; one time
explanation_mandarin: 量词，用于动作从头到尾的次数。副词，表示普遍，全部。
explanation_english: Measure word for complete actions (from start to finish). Adverb indicating universality or completeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇咗呢本书三徧喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 zo2 ni1 bun2 syu1 saam1 pin3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看了这本书三遍了。
examples.english_sentence: I have read this book three times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成个屋企都搜查咗一徧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 go3 uk1 kei5 dou1 sau1 caa4 zo2 jat1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个家都搜查了一遍。
examples.english_sentence: The entire house has been searched once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢个消息传徧咗成个城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 cyun4 pin3 zo2 seng4 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个消息传遍了整个城市。
examples.english_sentence: This news spread throughout the entire city.

english_meaning: hesitant; irresolute; wandering; uncertain
explanation_mandarin: 形容心里不确定，不知如何是好，犹豫不定。
explanation_english: Describing a state of uncertainty and indecision, not knowing what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺十字路口度彷徨咗好耐，都唔知應該行邊條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 dou6 pong4 wong4 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 m4 zi1 ying1 goi1 haang4 bin1 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在十字路口徬徨了很久，都不知道应该走哪条路。
examples.english_sentence: He hesitated at the crossroads for a long time, not knowing which road to take.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對未來，佢感到一片茫然，十分彷徨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 mei6 loi4, keoi5 gam2 dou3 jat1 pin3 mong4 jin4, sap6 fan1 pong4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对未来，他感到一片茫然，十分徬徨。
examples.english_sentence: Facing the future, he felt lost and very uncertain.

english_meaning: to repeat; to recover; to reply; again; complex; compound
explanation_mandarin: 恢复原来的状态；再次；复杂的。
explanation_english: To return to a former state; again; complex or compound. Can also mean 'to reply'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恢復原狀真係好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fui1 fuk6 jyun4 zong6 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恢复原状真的很困难。
examples.english_sentence: It's really difficult to restore things to their original state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋覆咗我封email啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fuk1 zo2 ngo5 fung1 email laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们回复了我的邮件了。
examples.english_sentence: They replied to my email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 fuk1 zan2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要复诊。
examples.english_sentence: Need a follow-up appointment.

english_meaning: revenge; vengeance
explanation_mandarin: 报复仇恨。采取行动来报复所受到的伤害或冒犯。
explanation_english: To take revenge; to exact vengeance. To inflict harm in return for injury or wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決心要復仇，為屋企人報仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 sam1 jiu3 fuk6 cau4, wai6 uk1 kei5 jan4 bou3 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决心要复仇，为家人报仇。
examples.english_sentence: He is determined to take revenge and avenge his family.

english_meaning: to recover; to restore; to reinstate
explanation_mandarin: 恢复到原来的状态。
explanation_english: To return to the original state; to recover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，依家終於復元得七七八八啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji1 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 fuk6 jyun4 dak1 cat1 cat1 baat3 baat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，现在终于恢复得差不多了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been sick for a long time, but now he's finally almost recovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦格式化咗之後，要復元返啲數據好麻煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 gaak1 sik1 faa3 zo2 zi1 hau6, jiu3 fuk6 jyun4 faan1 di1 so3 geoi3 hou2 maa4 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑格式化之后，要恢复那些数据很麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: After formatting the computer, it's troublesome to restore the data.

english_meaning: to return (to work or public life); comeback
explanation_mandarin: 指（从退隐或停顿后）重新回到原来的事业或公众生活中。
explanation_english: To return to one's former career or public life after a period of retirement or hiatus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢休息咗幾年，今年宣佈復出拍戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hiu1 sik1 zo2 gei2 nin4, gam1 nin4 syun1 bou3 fuk6 ceot1 paak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她休息了几年，今年宣布复出拍戏。
examples.english_sentence: She rested for a few years and announced her comeback to acting this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拆夥之後，估唔到隔咗十年又再次復出合作。

examples.english_sentence: After they broke up, I didn't expect them to come back together and collaborate again after ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一段時間嘅沉澱，佢準備好復出樂壇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 ge3 cam4 din6, keoi5 zyun2 bei6 hou2 fuk6 ceot1 ngok6 taan4.

examples.english_sentence: After a period of reflection, he is ready to return to the music scene.

english_meaning: to resume publication, to republish
explanation_mandarin: 指停刊后重新开始发行刊物。
explanation_english: To resume publication of a periodical (magazine, newspaper, etc.) after it has been discontinued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本雜誌停咗刊咁耐，而家終於復刊喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 zaap6 zi3 ting4 zo2 hon1 gam3 noi6, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 fuk6 hon1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本杂志停刊这么久，现在终于复刊了！
examples.english_sentence: This magazine has been discontinued for so long, and now it's finally being republished!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋籌緊錢，希望可以盡快復刊份報紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cau4 gan2 cin2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zeon6 faai3 fuk6 hon1 fan6 bou3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在筹钱，希望可以尽快复刊这份报纸。
examples.english_sentence: They are raising money, hoping to resume publishing the newspaper as soon as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 复刻, 复制, 重新发行
english_meaning: Reproduction, remake, reissue, to replicate faithfully, retro (style)
explanation_mandarin: 指重新制作、复制或发行过去的产品，通常指电子游戏、服装、鞋类等。 也可形容某事物具有复古风格。
explanation_english: Refers to the reproduction, remake, or reissue of a product from the past, often referring to video games, clothing, shoes, etc. It can also describe something as having a retro style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對波鞋係復刻版嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 bo1 haai4 hai6 fuk1 hak1 baan2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双运动鞋是复刻版。
examples.english_sentence: These sneakers are a reproduction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部復刻遊戲機好受歡迎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台复刻游戏机很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This retro game console is very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋出咗隻復刻嘅唱片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceot1 zo2 zek3 fuk1 hak1 ge3 coeng3 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发行了一张复刻唱片。
examples.english_sentence: They released a remastered record.

english_meaning: to recover, to restore, to return to normal
explanation_mandarin: 恢复到原来的状态或功能。
explanation_english: To return to a previous state; to recover or restore something to its original condition or function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做完手術之後，需要時間復原。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6, seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 fuk6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做完手术之后，需要时间恢复。
examples.english_sentence: He needs time to recover after the surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，要攞去整，希望可以復原返啲數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 zing2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 fuk6 jyun4 faan1啲sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，要拿去修，希望可以恢复一些数据。
examples.english_sentence: The computer broke down, I need to get it repaired, hopefully they can recover some of the data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟開始復原，希望會好啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 hoi1 chi2 fuk6 jyun4, hei1 mong6 wui5 hou2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济开始恢复，希望会好一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is starting to recover, hopefully it will get better.

english_meaning: retro, vintage, revival of old styles
explanation_mandarin: 指重新流行或模仿过去的风格、事物。
explanation_english: Referring to the revival or imitation of past styles and things; retro or vintage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年興復古風，好多後生仔都鍾意著啲舊款嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 nin4 hing1 fuk6 gu2 fung1, hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 zung1 ji3 zoek3 di1 gau6 fun2 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来流行复古风，很多年轻人喜欢穿老款的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: Retro style has been popular in recent years, and many young people like to wear vintage clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修好復古，好似返咗去七十年代咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 hou2 fuk6 gu2, hou2 ci5 faan1 zo2 heoi3 cat1 sap6 nin4 doi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅装修很复古，好像回到了七十年代。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's decor is very retro, like going back to the 1970s.

english_meaning: to reconcile; to get back together (usually referring to romantic relationships)
explanation_mandarin: 指（通常是恋爱关系中的）双方重新和好，重新在一起。
explanation_english: Refers to (usually romantic) partners getting back together after a breakup; reconciliation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋分手之後，竟然又復合返喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6, ging2 jin4 jau6 fuk6 hap6 faan1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们分手之后，竟然又复合了！
examples.english_sentence: After they broke up, they actually got back together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以同佢復合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 fuk6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以和他/她复合。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can reconcile with him/her.

english_meaning: restore a country; restoration of a country
explanation_mandarin: 恢复国家。可以是动词，表示恢复国家的行为；也可以是名词，表示恢复后的国家。
explanation_english: To restore a country to its former state. Can be used as a verb describing the act of restoring a nation, or as a noun referring to the restored country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅一生都奉獻俾復國大業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jat1 sang1 dou1 fung6 hin3 bei2 fuk6 gwok3 daai6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一生都奉献给了复国大业。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated his entire life to the cause of restoring the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果復國成功，人民一定會過上好日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 fuk6 gwok3 sing4 gung1, yan4 man4 jat1 ding6 wui5 gwo3 soeng5 hou2 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果复国成功，人民一定会过上好日子。
examples.english_sentence: If the country is successfully restored, the people will definitely live a good life.

english_meaning: Resume work; return to work; restart work
explanation_mandarin: 指停止工作一段时间后，重新开始工作。
explanation_english: To resume work after a period of suspension or interruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日復工啦，希望一切順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 fuk6 gung1 laa1, hei1 mong6 jat1 cai3 seon6 lei6.

examples.english_sentence: We're resuming work tomorrow, I hope everything goes smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停工咗咁耐，終於可以復工，真係鬆一口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 gung1 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 fuk6 gung1, zan1 hai6 sung1 jat1 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停工了这么久，终于可以复工，真是松了一口气。
examples.english_sentence: After being suspended for so long, we can finally resume work, what a relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣布下個禮拜可以分階段復工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 ho2 ji5 fan1 gaai1 dyun6 fuk6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布下个礼拜可以分阶段复工。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced that work can be resumed in stages next week.

english_meaning: to resume business; to reopen (a market or shop)
explanation_mandarin: 指暂停营业之后重新开始营业。
explanation_english: Refers to the resumption of business operations after a period of suspension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個街市因為裝修而停咗業幾個月，聽日終於復市喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gaai1 si5 yan1 wai6 zong1 sau1 ji4 ting4 zo2 je5 gei2 go3 jyut6, ting1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 fuk6 si5 laa3.

examples.english_sentence: This wet market was closed for several months due to renovation, and it will finally reopen tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情過後，好多商舖都陸續復市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 gwo3 hau6, hou2 do1 soeng1 pou3 dou1 luk6 zuk6 fuk6 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情过后，很多商铺都陆续恢复营业。
examples.english_sentence: After the pandemic, many shops have gradually resumed business.

english_meaning: return to normal, back to normal, resumption of normalcy
explanation_mandarin: 恢复到正常状态。指社会、经济、生活等方面恢复到疫情前的状态。
explanation_english: To return to a normal state, especially after a period of disruption or abnormality. Often refers to society, the economy, or daily life returning to pre-pandemic conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望可以盡快復常啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zeon6 faai3 fuk6 soeng4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望可以尽快恢复正常。
examples.english_sentence: We hope we can return to normal as soon as possible.

examples.english_sentence: The government says the economy will return to normal quickly, but I'm a bit skeptical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情過後，大家都盼望生活可以復常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 gwo3 hau6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 paan3 mong6 sang1 wut6 ho2 ji5 fuk6 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情过后，大家都盼望生活可以恢复正常。
examples.english_sentence: After the pandemic, everyone hopes that life can return to normal.

english_meaning: rehabilitation; recovery

examples.english_sentence: He spent a long time in rehabilitation after the car accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府提供復康服務俾有需要嘅人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tai4 gung1 fuk1 hong1 fuk6 mou6 bei2 jau5 seoi1 yiu3 ge3 yan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府向有需要的人士提供康复服务。
examples.english_sentence: The government provides rehabilitation services for people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾個月嘅物理治療，佢嘅復康進度良好。

examples.english_sentence: After several months of physiotherapy, his rehabilitation progress is good.

english_meaning: to resume a meeting; resumption of a meeting

english_meaning: resurrection, revival, to revive, to come back to life
explanation_mandarin: 指从死亡状态恢复生命，或指事物重新兴盛。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的复活节，我们要买一只复活节兔子巧克力给小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: This Easter, we need to buy an Easter Bunny chocolate for the children.

english_meaning: Easter
explanation_mandarin: 基督教纪念耶稣复活的节日。
explanation_english: The Christian festival celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年復活節去咗日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 fuk6 wut6 zit3 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年复活节去了日本旅行。

examples.english_sentence: The kids really like Easter eggs.

english_meaning: Easter egg

explanation_english: Easter egg, a decorated egg used during the Easter holiday, symbolizing new life and hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年整咗好多靚靚嘅復活蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 zing2 zo2 hou2 do1 leng3 leng3 ge3 fuk6 wut6 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年做了很多漂亮的复活节彩蛋。
examples.english_sentence: We made a lot of beautiful Easter eggs this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友好鍾意玩搵復活蛋嘅遊戲。

examples.english_sentence: Kids love to play the game of hunting for Easter eggs.

english_meaning: Resumption of trading (of stocks)

examples.english_sentence: That company was suspended for three months and will finally resume trading tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋預計下個月可以復牌，但係要睇情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jyu6 gai3 haa6 go3 jyut6 ho2 ji5 fuk6 paai4, daan6 hai6 jiu3 tai2 cing4 fong3.

examples.english_sentence: They estimate that trading can resume next month, but it depends on the situation.

english_meaning: to recover; to resuscitate; recovery; resuscitation
explanation_mandarin: 指（经济、社会、健康等）恢复生机或元气。
explanation_english: To recover or revive, typically referring to economic conditions, society, or health.

explanation_english: To recur; to relapse; to break out again (of a disease, bad habit, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅舊患復發，又要入院喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gau6 waan6 fuk6 faat3, jau6 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 laa3.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚佢會復發，所以成日提住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 keoi5 wui5 fuk6 faat3, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 tai4 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕他会复发，所以总是提醒着他。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid he will relapse, so I always remind him.

examples.english_sentence: The government encourages farmers to resume cultivation of the abandoned fields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗增加糧食供應，我哋要積極復耕。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了增加粮食供应，我们要积极复耕。
examples.english_sentence: In order to increase the food supply, we need to actively resume cultivation.

english_meaning: to resume work; to return to one's post; reinstatement
explanation_mandarin: 恢复原来的职位或工作。
explanation_english: To return to one's former position or job; to be reinstated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病好返之後就立即復職喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 hou2 faan1 zi1 hau6 zau6 lap1 zik1 fuk1 zik1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病好后就立刻复职了。
examples.english_sentence: He resumed his post immediately after recovering from his illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被炒魷魚之後，一直都希望可以復職。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被解雇后，一直都希望可以复职。
examples.english_sentence: After being fired, he always hoped to be reinstated.

english_meaning: revival, resurgence, rejuvenation, restoration
explanation_mandarin: 使衰落的事物重新兴盛起来。
explanation_english: To revive, restore, or rejuvenate something that has declined or fallen into disuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望可以復興香港嘅電影業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 fuk1 hing1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 din6 ying2 yip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望可以复兴香港的电影业。
examples.english_sentence: We hope we can revive the Hong Kong film industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾十年嘅努力，呢個古老嘅文化終於得到復興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 sap6 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, ni1 go3 gu2 lou5 ge3 man4 faa3 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 fuk1 hing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几十年的努力，这个古老的文化终于得到了复兴。
examples.english_sentence: After decades of effort, this ancient culture has finally been revived.

english_meaning: to recover; to resuscitate; recovery; resuscitation
explanation_mandarin: 恢复生机或活力。
explanation_english: To regain consciousness, health, or strength; to revive or recover; the act of reviving or recovering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟開始復蘇，但係仲有好多挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 hoi1 chi2 fuk6 sou1, daan6 hai6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济开始复苏，但是还有很多挑战。
examples.english_sentence: The economy has started to recover, but there are still many challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過急救，佢終於復蘇返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gap1 gau3, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 fuk6 sou1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过急救，他终于复苏了。
examples.english_sentence: After first aid, he finally recovered.

english_meaning: Resume classes; return to school (after a break or suspension)
explanation_mandarin: 指学校在停课一段时间后重新开始上课。
explanation_english: Refers to the resumption of classes at a school after a period of suspension or closure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校停咗課咁耐，終於聽日復課喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 ting4 zo2 fo3 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 ting1 jat6 fuk1 fo3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校停课这么久，终于明天复课了！
examples.english_sentence: The school has been suspended for so long, finally classes will resume tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情穩定咗之後，政府宣布所有學校可以分階段復課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 wan2 ding6 zo2 zi1 hau6, zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 so2 jau5 hok6 haau6 ho2 ji5 fan1 gei1 daan6 fuk1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情稳定之后，政府宣布所有学校可以分阶段复课。
examples.english_sentence: After the epidemic stabilized, the government announced that all schools could resume classes in stages.

english_meaning: restoration (of a monarchy); to restore a deposed monarch; restoration (politics)
explanation_mandarin: 指恢复已经灭亡的君主政权，也指已经退位的君主重新登上王位。比喻恢复已经消失的旧事物或旧制度。
explanation_english: Refers to the restoration of a defunct monarchical regime, or the regaining of the throne by an abdicated monarch. Figuratively, it refers to the restoration of old things or old systems that have disappeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想搞復辟，真係痴人說夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 gaau2 fuk6 bik1, zan1 hai6 ci1 jan4 syut3 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想搞复辟，真是痴人说梦。
examples.english_sentence: They want to restore the monarchy, it's just a pipe dream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史唔會復辟，時代已經唔同曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 m4 wui5 fuk6 bik1, si4 doi6 ji5 ging1 m4 tung4 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史不会复辟，时代已经完全不同了。
examples.english_sentence: History won't repeat itself in this way; times are completely different.

english_meaning: resume; reopen; to hold again; to reinstate
explanation_mandarin: 重新办理或举办已经停止的事情。
explanation_english: To resume or reopen something that has been discontinued; to hold an event again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定今年復辦花車巡遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 gam1 nin4 fuk6 baan6 faa1 ce1 seon4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定今年重新举办花车巡游。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to resume the float parade this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校宣布下個禮拜復辦面授課堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 syun1 bou3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 fuk6 baan6 min6 sau6 fo3 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校宣布下周恢复线下课堂。
examples.english_sentence: The school announced that face-to-face classes will resume next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府考慮復辦旅客入境免稅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 haau2 leoi6 fuk6 baan6 leoi5 haak3 jap6 ging2 min5 seoi3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府考虑重新实行旅客入境免税政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government is considering reinstating the duty-free policy for inbound tourists.

english_meaning: to follow, to abide by, to adhere to, according to
explanation_mandarin: 依照某种规则、方式或习惯去做。
explanation_english: To follow a rule, method, or custom; to act in accordance with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋循規蹈矩，好少犯錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seon4 kwai1 dou6 geoi2, hou2 siu2 faan6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们循规蹈矩，很少犯错。
examples.english_sentence: They are law-abiding and rarely make mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該循法律途徑解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 seon4 faat3 leot6 tou4 ging3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该循法律途径解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: We should resolve the issue through legal channels.

english_meaning: as a rule, according to usual practice, as usual, routinely
explanation_mandarin: 依照惯例，按照常规处理事情。
explanation_english: According to usual practice or routine; to do something according to established custom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋循例都會喺聖誕節交換禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceon4 lai6 dou1 wui5 hai2 sing3 daan3 zit3 gaau1 waan6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们照例都会在圣诞节交换礼物。
examples.english_sentence: We exchange gifts at Christmas as a rule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 循例都要問下你嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon4 lai6 dou1 jiu3 man6 haa5 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照例都要问一下你的意见。
examples.english_sentence: As usual, we need to ask for your opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程序循例要做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 zeoi6 ceon4 lai6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序按惯例是要做的。
examples.english_sentence: This procedure has to be done as a matter of course.

english_meaning: to proceed step by step; to advance gradually
explanation_mandarin: 指按照一定的步骤和顺序逐渐发展或提高。
explanation_english: Refers to progressing or improving gradually by following a certain sequence and order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學嘢要循序漸進，唔可以一步登天㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 je5 jiu3 ceon4 seoi6 zim6 zeon3, m4 ho2 ji3 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习要循序渐进，不可以一步登天。
examples.english_sentence: Learning requires a step-by-step approach; you can't achieve instant success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓要循序漸進，打好個地基先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau2 jiu3 ceon4 seoi6 zim6 zeon3, daa2 hou2 go3 dei6 gei1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盖楼要循序渐进，先要把地基打好。
examples.english_sentence: Building a building requires a gradual approach; you must first lay a solid foundation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 減肥都要循序漸進，唔好一下子減咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam2 fei4 dou1 jiu3 ceon4 seoi6 zim6 zeon3, m4 hou2 jat1 haa5 zi2 gaam2 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 减肥也要循序渐进，不要一下子减那么多。
examples.english_sentence: Even losing weight requires a gradual approach; don't lose too much weight at once.

english_meaning: to guide patiently and systematically; to teach with skill and patience; to lead someone on the right path step by step
explanation_mandarin: 指善于有步骤地引导、教育人。
explanation_english: It refers to being good at guiding and educating people step by step in a skillful and patient manner. It emphasizes a systematic and gradual approach to teaching or mentoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿 Sir 好有耐性，循循善誘，教導我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir4 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3, seon4 seon4 sin6 jau5, gaau3 dou6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师很有耐心，循循善诱地教导我们。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is very patient, guiding and teaching us step by step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母應該循循善誘咁教仔女做人嘅道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 ying1 goi1 seon4 seon4 sin6 jau5 gam2 gaau3 zai2 neoi5 zou6 yan4 ge3 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母应该循循善诱地教子女做人的道理。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should patiently guide their children in the principles of how to be a good person.

synonyms: 諄諄教誨 (zhun1 zhun1 gaau3 hui3)

english_meaning: cycle, circulate, loop, recurrence
explanation_mandarin: 重复运行的过程；事物周而复始的运动或变化；特指计算机程序中的循环。
explanation_english: A process that repeats; the recurring movement or change of things; specifically, a loop in a computer program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係一個惡性循環嚟㗎，越做越唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 ok3 sing3 ceon4 waan4 lai4 gaa3, yut6 zou6 yut6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个恶性循环，越做越糟糕。
examples.english_sentence: This is a vicious cycle, the more you do it, the worse it gets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要打破貧窮嘅循環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daa2 po3 pan4 kung4 ge3 ceon4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要打破贫穷的循环。
examples.english_sentence: We need to break the cycle of poverty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水喺大自然入面不停咁循環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 hai2 daai6 zi6 jin1 jap6 min6 bat1 ting4 gam2 ceon4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水在大自然中不停地循环。
examples.english_sentence: Water circulates endlessly in nature.

english_meaning: recycle, reuse
explanation_mandarin: 指将废弃物经过处理后再次使用，以减少资源浪费和环境污染。
explanation_english: To process and reuse waste materials in order to reduce waste and pollution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該盡量循環再用啲塑膠樽，減少製造垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zeon6 leong6 ceon4 waan4 zoi3 jung6 di1 sok3 gaau1 zeon2, gaam2 siu2 zai3 zou6 laap1 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尽量循环利用塑料瓶，减少制造垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: We should try our best to recycle plastic bottles to reduce waste production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好注重環保，好多嘢都循環再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 zyu3 zung6 waan4 bou2, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 ceon4 waan4 zoi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很注重环保，很多东西都循环利用。
examples.english_sentence: This company emphasizes environmental protection, and many things are recycled.

english_meaning: repeating decimal, recurring decimal
explanation_mandarin: 一个小数，从小数点的某一位开始，一个数字或几个数字依次不断地重复出现。
explanation_english: A decimal fraction in which a figure or group of figures is repeated indefinitely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三分一係一個循環小數，即係0.333333...
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 fan6 jat1 hai6 jat1 go3 ceon4 waan4 siu2 sou3, zik1 hai6 ling4 dim2 saam1 saam1 saam1 saam1 saam1 saam1...
examples.mandarin_sentence: 三分之一是一个循环小数，也就是0.333333...
examples.english_sentence: One third is a repeating decimal, that is 0.333333...

examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 sou3 gei1 hin2 si6 ge3 git3 gwo2 hai6 ceon4 waan4 siu2 sou3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zing6 hai6 hin2 si6 zo2 tau4 gei2 go3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 计算器显示的结果是循环小数，但是它只显示了前几位。
examples.english_sentence: The result displayed by the calculator is a repeating decimal, but it only shows the first few digits.

english_meaning: circulatory system
explanation_mandarin: 生物学概念，指人体或其他生物体内负责运输血液、淋巴液的系统，主要由心脏、血管等组成。
explanation_english: Biological concept referring to the system in the human body or other organisms responsible for transporting blood and lymph, mainly composed of the heart, blood vessels, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 循環系統對我哋嘅健康好緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon4 waan4 hai6 tung2 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gin6 hong1 hou2 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 循环系统对我们的健康很重要。
examples.english_sentence: The circulatory system is very important for our health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有循環系統嘅毛病，成日覺得暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 ceon4 waan4 hai6 tung2 ge3 mou4 beng6, seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有循环系统的问题，经常觉得头晕。
examples.english_sentence: He has problems with his circulatory system and often feels dizzy.

english_meaning: Circular route; Loop line
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆（如巴士、小巴）沿着一个环状路线行驶的线路。起点和终点通常是同一个地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a route where a vehicle (such as a bus or minibus) travels along a circular path, starting and ending at the same location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭呢架循環線巴士會返返起點嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 ni1 gaa3 ceon4 waan4 sin3 baa1 si2 wui5 faan1 faan1 hei2 dim2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搭乘这趟环线巴士会回到起点的。
examples.english_sentence: Taking this circular bus route will bring you back to the starting point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有好多小巴都係循環線嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 siu2 baa1 dou1 hai6 ceon4 waan4 sin3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多小巴都是环线线路的。
examples.english_sentence: There are many minibuses here that operate on circular routes.

english_meaning: circular reasoning, circular argument
explanation_mandarin: 一种逻辑谬误，指论证过程中的前提本身就依赖于结论，导致结论的成立反过来又依赖于前提，形成循环，无法真正证明任何东西。
explanation_english: A logical fallacy in which the reasoner begins with what they are trying to end with. The conclusion depends upon the premise, and the premise depends upon the conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你噉樣講咪即係循環論證囉，根本冇解釋到件事嘅真正原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 mai1 zik1 hai6 ceon4 waan4 leon6 zing3 lo1, gan1 bun2 mou5 gaai2 sik1 dou2 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 zeng3 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说不就是循环论证吗，根本没有解释到事情的真正原因。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is just circular reasoning, it doesn't actually explain the real reason for the matter.

english_meaning: round-robin tournament
explanation_mandarin: 一种体育比赛的赛制，所有参赛队伍或个人都要与其他队伍或个人进行比赛。
explanation_english: A tournament format where each participant plays against every other participant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆世界盃用循環賽嘅形式嚟決定出線隊伍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gaai3 sai3 gaai3 bui1 yung6 ceon4 waan4 coi3 ge3 ying4 sik1 lai4 kyut3 ding6 ceot1 sin3 deoi6 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这届世界杯用循环赛的形式来决定出线队伍。
examples.english_sentence: This year's World Cup uses a round-robin format to determine the qualifying teams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞咗個小型循環賽，睇下邊隊波最勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 zo2 go3 siu2 jing4 ceon4 waan4 coi3, tai2 haa5 bin1 deoi2 bo1 zeoi3 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搞了个小型循环赛，看看哪个球队最厉害。
examples.english_sentence: They organized a small round-robin tournament to see which team is the strongest.

english_meaning: to follow the rules and regulations; well-behaved; law-abiding; to behave properly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人遵守规矩，安分守己，不敢越轨。
explanation_english: Describes someone who follows rules and regulations, is well-behaved, and does not dare to overstep boundaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向都好循規蹈矩，唔會搞搞震㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 ceon4 kwai1 dou6 geoi2, m4 wui5 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向都很循规蹈矩，不会惹事的。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been well-behaved and wouldn't cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我阿媽教我做人要循規蹈矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 aa3 maa1 gaau3 ngo5 zou6 jan4 jiu3 ceon4 kwai1 dou6 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我妈妈教我做人要循规蹈矩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young, my mother taught me to be a well-behaved person.

english_meaning: to wander about; to hesitate; to be indecisive; wandering
explanation_mandarin: 在一個地方附近走來走去，不知道該怎麼辦。
explanation_english: To wander around in a place, uncertain about what to do; to hesitate, usually due to uncertainty or confusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街度徬咗好耐，都唔知去邊好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 pong4 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 m4 zi1 heoi3 bin1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上徘徊了很久，都不知道去哪里好。
examples.english_sentence: He wandered around on the street for a long time, not knowing where to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度徬啦，快啲做決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 pong4 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里徘徊了，快点做决定吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hesitate here, make a decision quickly.

english_meaning: to wander about irresolutely; to be indecisive; to hesitate
explanation_mandarin: 指徘徊不定，不知道往哪里去或做什么好。
