examples.mandarin_sentence: 我朋友买了一套恒大的房子，他现在很担心。
examples.english_sentence: My friend bought an Evergrande apartment, he's very worried now.

english_meaning: constant; regular; invariable; persistent
explanation_mandarin: 指事物长期不变，经常发生或存在的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being constant, regular, or persistent over a long period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都有恒常嘅運動習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jau5 hang4 soeng4 ge3 wan6 dung6 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都有经常性的运动习惯。
examples.english_sentence: He has a regular exercise habit every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅服務質素一直都保持恒常嘅水準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zat1 so3 jat1 zik6 dou1 bou2 ci4 hang4 soeng4 ge3 seoi2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的服务质量一直保持恒定的水平。
examples.english_sentence: The service quality of this company has always maintained a consistent standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要恒常嘅資金來源去維持計劃嘅運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 hang4 soeng4 ge3 zi1 gam1 lai4 jyun4 heoi3 wai4 chi4 gai3 waak6 ge3 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要恒定的资金来源去维持计划的运作。
examples.english_sentence: We need a constant source of funding to maintain the operation of the project.

english_meaning: Hang Seng Index (HSI)
explanation_mandarin: 香港股票市场的主要股票指数，反映香港股市整体表现。
explanation_english: The Hang Seng Index (HSI) is the main stock market index in Hong Kong, reflecting the overall performance of the Hong Kong stock market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日恒指升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hang4 zi2 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天恒生指数涨了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The Hang Seng Index went up a lot today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇實恒指嘅走勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 sat6 hang4 zi2 ge3 zau2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要密切关注恒生指数的走势。
examples.english_sentence: We need to keep a close watch on the trend of the Hang Seng Index.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恒指對香港經濟好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 zi2 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ging1 zai3 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恒生指数对香港经济很重要。
examples.english_sentence: The Hang Seng Index is very important to the Hong Kong economy.

english_meaning: fixed star, star
explanation_mandarin: 天文学上指能够自身发光发热的球状天体，如太阳。
explanation_english: In astronomy, a self-luminous and hot celestial body, such as the Sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽系入面嘅太陽係唯一嘅恒星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 hai6 jap6 min6 ge3 taai3 joeng4 hai6 wai4 jat1 ge3 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳系里的太阳是唯一的恒星。
examples.english_sentence: The Sun in the solar system is the only star.

english_meaning: Hang Seng University
explanation_mandarin: 香港一所私立大学。
explanation_english: A private university in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺恒生大學讀緊書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hang4 sang1 dai6 hok6 duk6 gan2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在恒生大学读书。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying at Hang Seng University.

mandarin_meaning: 恒生管理學院 / 香港恒生大學
english_meaning: Hang Seng Management College / Hang Seng University of Hong Kong
explanation_mandarin: 香港一所私立大學，前身為恒生管理學院。
explanation_english: A private university in Hong Kong, formerly known as Hang Seng Management College.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個表弟舊年喺恒管畢業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 biu2 dai2 gau6 nin4 hai2 hang4 gun2 bat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的表弟去年在恒生管理学院毕业。
examples.english_sentence: My cousin graduated from Hang Seng Management College last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家恒管已經升格做大學，叫做香港恒生大學啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hang4 gun2 ji5 ging1 sing1 gaak3 zou6 daai6 hok6, giu3 zou6 hoeng1 gong2 hang4 sang1 daai6 hok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在恒生管理学院已经升级为大学，叫做香港恒生大学了。
examples.english_sentence: Now Hang Seng Management College has been upgraded to a university, called Hang Seng University of Hong Kong.

english_meaning: pardon; forgive; excuse
explanation_mandarin: 表示请求或给予宽恕，原谅。
explanation_english: To pardon, forgive, or excuse. Usually used in formal expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恕我直言，你咁做係唔啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu3 ngo5 zik6 jin4, nei5 gam2 zou6 hai6 m4 ngaam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恕我直言，你这样做是不对的。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me for being frank, but what you're doing is wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如有冒犯，恕罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 jau5 mou6 faan6, syu3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如有冒犯，请原谅。
examples.english_sentence: If I have offended you, please forgive me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恕唔奉陪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu3 m4 fung6 pui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恕不奉陪。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I won't be able to join you.

english_meaning: Excuse me for speaking frankly; With all due respect, but...
explanation_mandarin: 客套话，表示接下来要说的可能是不好听的话，先礼貌地请求对方原谅。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used to preface a potentially critical or blunt statement. It signals that the speaker is about to express their honest opinion, even if it may be unwelcome or controversial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恕我直言，你咁樣做係唔得嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu3 ngo5 zik6 jin4, nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 hai6 m4 dak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恕我直言，你这样做是不行的。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me for speaking frankly, but what you're doing is not going to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恕我直言，你件衫真係唔啱你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu3 ngo5 zik6 jin4, nei5 gin6 saam1 zan1 hai6 m4 ngaam1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恕我直言，你这件衣服真的不适合你。
examples.english_sentence: With all due respect, this shirt really doesn't suit you.

english_meaning: to beg pardon; to ask for forgiveness; please forgive me
explanation_mandarin: 请求对方原谅自己的过失或冒犯。
explanation_english: To ask for forgiveness for one's mistakes or offenses. It's a formal way of saying "please forgive me."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱唔覺意撞到你，恕罪恕罪！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 m4 gok3 yi3 zong6 dou2 nei5, syu3 zeoi6 syu3 zeoi6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才不小心撞到你了，请原谅！
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally bumped into you just now, please forgive me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我有講錯嘢，唔好介意，恕罪啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 jau5 gong2 co3 je5, m4 hou2 gaai3 yi3, syu3 zeoi6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我说错了什么，请不要介意，请原谅！
examples.english_sentence: If I said something wrong, please don't mind, please forgive me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打擾晒你哋咁耐，真係恕罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 jiu2 saai3 nei5 dei6 gam3 noi6, zan1 hai6 syu3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打扰了你们这么久，真是抱歉。
examples.english_sentence: I've bothered you for so long, I'm truly sorry.

synonyms: 唔好意思 (m4 hou2 yi3 si1)

mandarin_meaning: 疾病; 灾祸; 安好
english_meaning: illness; misfortune; to be well; to be in good health (often used in formal inquiry)
explanation_mandarin: 书面语中询问对方身体是否安好的敬语。也指疾病或灾祸。
explanation_english: A formal, literary term used to inquire about someone's well-being, often in a respectful or polite manner. It can also refer to illness or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 別來無恙？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bit6 loi4 mou4 joeng6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别来无恙？
examples.english_sentence: Have you been well since we last met?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 身體有冇唔妥，有無咩恙呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 tai2 jau5 mou5 m4 to2, jau5 mou5 me1 joeng6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 身体有没有不舒服，有什么恙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is there anything wrong with your health? Are you feeling unwell?

english_meaning: to recover, to restore
explanation_mandarin: 恢复原状；恢复健康。
explanation_english: To recover; to restore to the original state or health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，終於恢返健康喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 fui1 faan1 gin6 hong1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，终于恢复健康了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a long time, but he has finally recovered his health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路封咗咁耐，依家終於恢復通行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 fung1 zo2 gam3 noi6, ji1 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 fui1 fuk6 tung1 hang4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路封了这么久，现在终于恢复通行了。
examples.english_sentence: This road has been closed for so long, and now it has finally been reopened.

english_meaning: to recover, to restore, to reinstate
explanation_mandarin: 回到原来的状态或功能。
explanation_english: To return to a previous state or condition; to bring back to a former condition or vigor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，依家終於恢復健康喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji1 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 fui1 fuk6 gin6 hong1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，现在终于恢复健康了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a long time, but now he has finally recovered his health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，我哋要恢復返出廠設置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fui1 fuk6 faan1 cheut1 chong2 sat1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，我们要恢复出厂设置。
examples.english_sentence: The computer broke down, we need to restore it to factory settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟恢復得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 fui1 fuk6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济恢复得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is recovering quickly.

english_meaning: indulge; unrestrained; wanton; arbitrary
explanation_mandarin: 放纵，任意行事，不受约束。
explanation_english: To indulge, to act arbitrarily, without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好恣意㗎，做嘢鍾意點就點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zi1 ji3 gaa3, zou6 je5 zung1 ji3 dim2 zau6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很任性，做事喜欢怎样就怎样。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very willful person, he does things however he likes.

mandarin_meaning: 放纵; 任性; 随意
english_meaning: unrestrained; wanton; wilfully; arbitrarily; to do as one pleases
explanation_mandarin: 指放纵自己的欲望，不受约束地行动。
explanation_english: Refers to indulging one's desires and acting without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有錢就恣意揮霍，唔理將來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 cin2 zau6 zi1 ji3 fai1 fok3, m4 lei5 zoeng1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有钱就恣意挥霍，不顾将来。
examples.english_sentence: He spends money wantonly when he has it, not caring about the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁恣意妄為，要考慮其他人嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 zi1 ji3 mong5 wai4, jiu3 hau2 leoi6 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这么恣意妄为，要考虑其他人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be so willful; you have to consider the feelings of others.

mandarin_meaning: 怜悯; 体恤; 关心
english_meaning: to sympathize with; to be considerate of; to care about; to pity
explanation_mandarin: 表示同情和关心，考虑别人的感受和需求。
explanation_english: To show sympathy and consideration for someone's feelings and needs; to be mindful of others' welfare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細都唔恤我哋班伙記嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dou1 m4 seot1 ngo5 dei6 baan1 fo2 gei3 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板都不体恤我们这班员工的感受。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't care about the feelings of us employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好恤人，成日幫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 seot1 jan4, seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很体恤人，经常帮助别人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very considerate and always helps others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好恤我哋，成日問我哋有冇嘢需要幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 seot1 ngo5 dei6, seng4 jat6 man6 ngo5 dei6 jau5 mou5 je5 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很关心我们，总是问我们有没有什么需要帮忙的。
examples.english_sentence: They are very caring, always asking if we need any help.

english_meaning: shirt (collared, button-down)
explanation_mandarin: 一种有领、有钮扣的上衣。
explanation_english: A collared garment for the upper body, typically with buttons down the front.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要着恤衫去見工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zoek3 seot1 saam1 heoi3 gin3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要穿衬衫去面试。
examples.english_sentence: I need to wear a shirt to the job interview tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件恤衫好啱你着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 seot1 saam1 hou2 ngaam1 nei5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫很适合你穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt suits you well.

english_meaning: to close shop, to shut down business (temporarily or permanently)
explanation_mandarin: 指商店或企业停止营业，可能是暂时性的，也可能是永久性的。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop or business ceasing operation, either temporarily or permanently. Often implies a closure due to financial difficulties or other problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近經濟唔好，好多鋪頭都恤門啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dou1 seot1 mun4-2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，很多店铺都关门了。
examples.english_sentence: The economy has been bad recently, many shops have closed down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳因為冇生意，唯有恤門唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jan1 wai4 mou5 saang1 ji3, wai4 jau5 seot1 mun4-2 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的餐厅因为没有生意，只好关门不做了。
examples.english_sentence: His restaurant had no business, so he had no choice but to close it down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打風，間百貨公司會恤門一日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1, gaan1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 wui5 seot1 mun4-2 jat1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天刮台风，那间百货公司会关门一天。
examples.english_sentence: There's a typhoon tomorrow, so that department store will be closed for a day.

english_meaning: to get a haircut; to have one's hair cut
explanation_mandarin: 修剪头发。指去理发店理发。
explanation_english: To have one's hair cut, usually at a barber shop or salon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去恤髮呀，頭髮都長到遮住眼喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 seot1 faat3 aa3, tau4 faat3 dou1 zoeng2 dou3 ze1 zyu6 ngaan5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去理发了，头发都长到遮住眼睛了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to get a haircut; my hair is so long it's covering my eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都去同一間髮型屋恤髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 tung4 jat1 gaan1 faat3 jing4 uk1 seot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是去同一家理发店理发。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes to the same hair salon to get a haircut.

english_meaning: shame; disgrace; humiliation
explanation_mandarin: 一种羞愧和屈辱的感觉。也可以指让人感到羞耻的事情。
explanation_english: A feeling of shame and dishonor. Can also refer to something that causes shame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得好羞恥啊，考試唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 sau1 ci2 aa3, haau2 si3 m4 gok3 gap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得很羞耻，考试没及格。
examples.english_sentence: I feel so ashamed that I failed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係我一生嘅恥辱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 ngo5 jat1 sang1 ge3 ci2 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是我一生的耻辱。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is a disgrace to me for my whole life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲咁嘅嘢，真係不知廉恥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 gam2 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 bat1 zi1 lim4 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了那些事，真是不知廉耻。
examples.english_sentence: What he did is truly shameless.

english_meaning: shamelessness, thick-skinnedness, lacking a sense of shame, tolerance for embarrassment
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人能忍受尴尬，不感到羞耻的能力，通常用于形容人脸皮厚，不在意别人的看法。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's ability to tolerate embarrassment and not feel ashamed. It's often used to describe someone who is thick-skinned and doesn't care about what others think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人真係恥力無限，做錯嘢都唔會面紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zan1 hai6 ci2 lik6 mou4 haan6, zou6 co3 je5 dou1 m4 wui5 min6 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是脸皮无限大，做错事都不会脸红。
examples.english_sentence: He's really shameless, he doesn't even blush when he does something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，為咗出名，可以去到幾盡，真係唔知佢哋嘅恥力底線喺邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2, wai6 zo2 ceot1 ming4, ho2 ji5 heoi3 dou3 gei2 zeon6, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ci2 lik6 dai2 sin3 hai2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，为了出名，可以做到什么程度，真不知道他们的羞耻底线在哪里。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people, to get famous, can go to any extent. I really don't know where their threshold for shame is.

english_meaning: to ridicule, to mock, to laugh at (in a scornful way)
explanation_mandarin: 带有轻蔑和嘲讽意味的嘲笑。
explanation_english: To laugh at someone or something with contempt or scorn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣恥笑人哋啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 ci2 siu3 jan4 dei6 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样嘲笑别人了，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't ridicule people like that, it's very impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅失敗俾人恥笑咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sat1 baai6 bei2 jan4 ci2 siu3 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的失败被人们嘲笑了很久。
examples.english_sentence: His failure was ridiculed for a long time.

english_meaning: Ashamed to be associated with; disdain to be in the same company as
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常瞧不起某人或某事物，认为和他们在一起是可耻的。
explanation_english: Describes feeling extremely disdainful of someone or something, considering it shameful to be associated with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲行為咁差，我哋點可以同佢哋為伍呀？簡直係恥與為伍啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 hang4 wai4 gam3 caa1, ngo5 dei6 dim2 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 dei6 wai4 ng5 aa3? gaan2 zik6 hai6 ci2 jyu5 wai4 ng5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的行为这么差，我们怎么可以和他们为伍呢？简直是耻与为伍啊！
examples.english_sentence: Their behavior is so bad, how can we associate with them? It's simply shameful to be in their company!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同啲作弊嘅人一齊，簡直係恥與為伍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 di1 zok3 bai6 ge3 jan4 jat1 cai4, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ci2 jyu5 wai4 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和那些作弊的人在一起，简直是耻与为伍。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be with those who cheat; it's simply shameful to be associated with them.

english_meaning: Ashamed to be associated with, disdain to be in the same rank/group
explanation_mandarin: 以和某人或某事为耻，不屑于与他们同列。
explanation_english: To be ashamed to be associated with someone or something, and to disdain being in the same rank or group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多衰嘢，我哋梗係恥與為伍啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, ngo5 dei6 gang2 hai6 ci2 jyu5 wai4 ng5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，我们当然引以为耻，不屑与他为伍。
examples.english_sentence: He's done so many bad things, of course we're ashamed to be associated with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司賣假貨，我哋做生意嘅，梗係恥與為伍㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 maai6 gaa2 fo3, ngo5 dei6 zou6 saang1 ji3 ge3, gang2 hai6 ci2 jyu5 wai4 ng5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司卖假货，我们做生意的，当然引以为耻，不屑与它为伍。
examples.english_sentence: That company sells counterfeit goods; as business people, we are definitely ashamed to be associated with them.

english_meaning: shame, humiliation, disgrace
explanation_mandarin: 羞辱；使人感到羞耻的事情。
explanation_english: A feeling of shame or humiliation; something that causes shame or disgrace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔合格，真係好大嘅恥辱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 m4 gok3 hap6, zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 ge3 ci2 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格，真是很大的耻辱。
examples.english_sentence: Failing the exam is a real disgrace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾人當眾咁樣侮辱，簡直係奇恥大辱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jan4 dong3 zung3 gam2 joeng2 mou5 juk6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 kei4 ci2 daai6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被人当众这样侮辱，简直是奇耻大辱。
examples.english_sentence: Being insulted in public like that is absolutely humiliating.

english_meaning: pubic bone
explanation_mandarin: 人体骨盆前方的两块骨头，在腹股沟区域。
explanation_english: The pubic bone, located in the front of the pelvis in the groin area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心撞到個枱角，整親恥骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 zong6 dou2 go3 toi2 gok3, zing2 san1 ci2 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心撞到桌角，弄伤了耻骨。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally bumped into the corner of the table and injured his pubic bone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 懷孕嗰陣，恥骨會痛，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waai4 jan6 go2 zan6, ci2 gwat1 wui2 tung3, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 怀孕的时候，耻骨会痛，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: During pregnancy, the pubic bone can hurt, it's very painful.

english_meaning: to regret; to hate; to resent
explanation_mandarin: 表示遗憾或怨恨的情感。
explanation_english: Expressing feelings of regret or hate; to feel bitterness towards something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好恨冇早啲開始學日文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 han6 mou5 zou2 di1 hoi1 chi2 hok6 jat6 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好后悔没有早点开始学日语。
examples.english_sentence: I really regret not starting to learn Japanese earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢恨死佢阿哥搶咗佢女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 han6 sei2 keoi5 aa3 go1 cheung2 zo2 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他恨透了他哥哥抢了他的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He hates his elder brother for snatching his girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我恨我自己咁蠢，俾人呃咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 han6 ngo5 zi6 gei2 gam3 cheun2, bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我恨我自己这么笨，被人骗了。
examples.english_sentence: I hate myself for being so stupid and getting scammed.

english_meaning: to be itching to; to be dying to; to long to; to wish one could
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常希望，但實際上不可能或難以實現。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong desire or wish, often for something that is impossible or difficult to achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我恨不得即刻飛去日本玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 han6 bat1 dak1 zik1 hak1 fei1 heoi3 jat6 bun2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我恨不得立刻飞去日本玩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm dying to fly to Japan to have fun right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢恨不得一巴掌摑落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 han6 bat1 dak1 jat1 baa1 zek3 gwaak3 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他恨不得一巴掌扇过去。
examples.english_sentence: He's itching to slap him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，我恨不得快啲長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 han6 bat1 dak1 faai3 di1 zoeng2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我恨不得快点长大。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I was longing to grow up quickly.

english_meaning: to hate someone/something with every fiber of one's being; to hate to the marrow of one's bones; to hate deeply
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某人或某事物极其憎恨，恨到骨头里。
explanation_english: Describes extremely deep hatred towards someone or something, hating them to the very core.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅仇恨簡直係恨之入骨，冇辦法化解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 cau4 han6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 han6 zi1 jap6 gwat1, mou5 baan6 faat3 faa3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的仇恨简直是恨之入骨，没有办法化解。
examples.english_sentence: The hatred between them is so deep, it's irreconcilable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為俾佢呃咗好多錢，所以恨佢恨之入骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 bei2 keoi5 aak1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, so2 ji5 han6 keoi5 han6 zi1 jap6 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他被他骗了很多钱，所以恨他恨之入骨。
examples.english_sentence: He hates him to the bone because he was cheated out of a lot of money.

english_meaning: To hate intensely; to loathe; to despise.
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深地憎恨、厌恶。比“恨”的程度更深。
explanation_english: Expresses a deep and intense feeling of hatred or loathing. Indicates a greater degree of hatred than just "恨" (han6). The '到' (dou3) emphasizes the extremity of the feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搶咗我條仔，我真係恨到佢入骨啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng2 zo2 ngo5 tiu4 zai2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 han6 dou3 keoi5 jap6 gwat1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她抢了我的男朋友，我真是恨她入骨！
examples.english_sentence: She stole my boyfriend, I really hate her to the bone!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時，畀佢蝦到喊，到而家我都仲係恨到佢死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, bei2 keoi5 haa1 dou3 haam3, dou3 ji4 gaa1 ngo5 dou1 zung1 hai6 han6 dou3 keoi5 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候被她欺负到哭，到现在我都还是恨死她。
examples.english_sentence: She bullied me to tears when I was little, and I still hate her to death even now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樓價貴到咁，真係恨到啲地產商死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lau2 gaa3 gwai3 dou3 gam2, zan1 hai6 han6 dou3 di1 dei6 caan2 soeng1 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价贵到这样，真是恨死那些房地产商了。
examples.english_sentence: The house prices are so expensive, I really hate the property developers to death.

mandarin_meaning: 恨之入骨; 恨得要命
english_meaning: To hate someone or something intensely; to hate someone/something so much it's like having a fever.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常憎恨某人或某事，程度深到好像发烧一样。
explanation_english: Describes hating someone or something intensely. The level of hatred is so strong that it's likened to having a fever. It emphasizes the intensity and strong negative emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我恨到發燒，點解佢可以咁樣對我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 han6 dou3 faat3 siu1, dim2 gai2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我恨得要命，他怎么可以这样对我？
examples.english_sentence: I hate it so much I could scream, how could he treat me like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試衰咗，我恨到發燒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 seoi1 zo2, ngo5 han6 dou3 faat3 siu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考砸了，我恨死自己了！
examples.english_sentence: I failed this exam, I hate it so much!

english_meaning: unable to hate; can't bring oneself to hate; can't hate
explanation_mandarin: 表示想恨却恨不起来，通常指对某人或某事失望或生气，但仍然无法真正憎恨对方。
explanation_english: Expresses the inability to hate someone or something despite feeling disappointment or anger. It implies a certain level of affection, understanding, or resignation that prevents one from truly hating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都蝦我，但我都恨唔到佢，可能因為佢係我細佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 haa1 ngo5, daan6 ngo5 dou1 han6 m4 dou2 keoi5, ho2 nang4 jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是欺负我，但我就是恨不来他，可能因为他是我弟弟。
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies me, but I just can't hate him. Maybe it's because he's my younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢咁樣對我，我都恨唔到佢，因為我知佢都唔係有心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 ngo5, ngo5 dou1 han6 m4 dou2 keoi5, jan1 wai6 ngo5 zi1 keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他这样对我，我还是恨不来他，因为我知道他也不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he treated me like that, I can't hate him because I know he didn't do it on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係恨唔到佢，佢咁錫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 han6 m4 dou2 keoi5, keoi5 gam3 sek3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的恨不来他，他那么疼我。
examples.english_sentence: I really can't hate him, he dotes on me so much.

english_meaning: Extremely envious; green with envy; to hate the neighbor (out of envy)
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常羡慕或嫉妒别人，以至于产生恨意。因为邻居通常是生活中会比较的对象，因此用“隔篱”来代表羡慕嫉妒的对象。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely envious or jealous of someone, often to the point of feeling resentment or hatred. The term 'neighbor' (隔籬) is used because neighbors are often people we compare ourselves to, making them a common target of envy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我升職，恨死隔籬咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 sing1 zik1, han6 sei2 gaak3 lei4 gam2 款.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我升职，非常羡慕嫉妒恨。
examples.english_sentence: He saw that I got a promotion and was green with envy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗架新車，真係恨死隔籬呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gaa3 san1 ce1, zan1 hai6 han6 sei2 gaak3 lei4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了辆新车，真是让人羡慕死了！
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car, I'm so envious!

english_meaning: to regret doing something wrong; to feel remorse for a mistake
explanation_mandarin: 指因做错某事而感到后悔、遗憾，通常带有较强的情绪色彩。
explanation_english: To feel regret or remorse for having done something wrong. It implies a strong emotional feeling about the mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係恨錯咗，當年唔應該咁對佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 han6 co3 zo2, dong1 nin4 m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 deoi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真是后悔做错了，当年不应该那样对他。
examples.english_sentence: I really regret my mistake; I shouldn't have treated him that way back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話恨錯決定，搞到而家咁嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 han6 co3 kyut3 ding6, gaau2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 gam2 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说后悔做错了决定，搞得现在这样。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he regrets making the wrong decision, which has resulted in this current situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道已經太遲，但係我都係好恨錯，冇好好珍惜你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 ji5 ging1 taai3 ci4, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dou1 hai6 hou2 han6 co3, mou5 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道已经太迟了，但是我还是非常后悔，没有好好珍惜你。
examples.english_sentence: I know it's too late, but I still deeply regret not cherishing you.

mandarin_meaning: 一失足成千古恨 (yī shī zú chéng qiān gǔ hèn)
english_meaning: Regret for mistakes is hard to undo; It's too late to regret.
explanation_mandarin: 后悔当初犯下的错误，但已经无法挽回，为时已晚。
explanation_english: Regretting a past mistake or action when it is impossible to reverse the consequences. Expresses a feeling of irreversible remorse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事都已經發生咗咁耐，而家先嚟後悔都恨錯難返啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 dou1 ji5 ging1 faat3 sang1 zo2 gam3 noi6, ji4 gaa1 sin1 lei4 hau6 fui3 dou1 han6 co3 naan4 faan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情都发生了这么久，现在才来后悔也已经为时已晚了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has already happened for so long, regretting it now is already too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為一時貪心做咗犯法嘅嘢，依家俾人拉咗，真係恨錯難返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 jat1 si4 taam1 sam1 zou6 zo2 faan6 faat3 ge3 je5, ji1 gaa1 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, zan1 hai6 han6 co3 naan4 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为一时贪心做了犯法的事，现在被抓了，真是悔之晚矣。
examples.english_sentence: Because he was greedy for a moment and did something illegal, he is now arrested. It's truly too late to regret.

synonyms: 後悔莫及 (hau6 fui3 mok6 gap6)

mandarin_meaning: 恨铁不成钢 (hèn tiě bù chéng gāng)
english_meaning: To hate that iron cannot be turned into steel; to be disappointed that someone does not live up to their potential.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻对某人期望很高，但是此人不争气，让人感到失望。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a feeling of disappointment and frustration when someone doesn't live up to their potential, despite having the ability to do so. It implies a sense of high expectations and the belief that the person could be much better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對佢咁高期望，點知佢咁唔生性，真係恨鐵不成鋼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 keoi5 gam3 gou1 kei4 mong6, dim2 zi1 keoi5 gam3 m4 sang1 sing3, zan1 hai6 han6 tit3 bat1 sing4 gong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对他期望那么高，没想到他这么不争气，真是恨铁不成钢。
examples.english_sentence: We had such high expectations for him, but he's so disappointing; it's a classic case of hating that iron cannot be turned into steel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話我讀書唔夠勤力，恨鐵不成鋼呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 duk6 syu1 m4 gau3 kan4 lik6, han6 tit3 bat1 sing4 gong3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是说我学习不够努力，真是恨铁不成钢啊。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always says I don't study hard enough; she's disappointed that I'm not living up to my potential.

english_meaning: favour, kindness, grace, obligation
explanation_mandarin: 指好处，好处。受人给予的好处，即恩惠。
explanation_english: Refers to a kindness, favour, or grace received from someone. An act of beneficence or gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我有恩，我一定要報答佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 jau5 yan1, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 daap3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我有恩情，我一定要报答他。
examples.english_sentence: He has been kind to me; I must repay him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲水思源，知恩圖報係基本嘅做人道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 seoi2 si1 jyun4, zi1 yan1 tou4 bou3 hai6 gei1 bun2 ge3 zou6 jan4 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 饮水思源，知恩图报是基本的做人道理。
examples.english_sentence: Be grateful for what you have. Gratitude is a fundamental principle of life.

english_meaning: benefactor, savior
explanation_mandarin: 指给予自己很大帮助、恩惠的人。
explanation_english: A person who has given someone significant help or kindness; a benefactor or savior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅恩人，如果唔係佢，我一早死咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ngan1 jan4, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5, ngo5 jat1 zou2 si2 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的恩人，如果不是他，我早就死了。
examples.english_sentence: He is my benefactor. If it weren't for him, I would have died a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 真係要好好報答我嘅恩人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 bou3 daap3 ngo5 ge3 ngan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真的要好好报答我的恩人。
examples.english_sentence: I really need to repay my benefactor properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢救咗我條命，簡直係我嘅恩人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gau3 zo2 ngo5 tiu4 meng6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ngan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他救了我的命，简直是我的恩人。
examples.english_sentence: He saved my life, he's practically my savior.

english_meaning: grace, favour, kindness; blessing
explanation_mandarin: 指给予的优待或好处，带有感谢和感激之情。
explanation_english: Refers to a favour or benefit granted, implying gratitude and appreciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅恩典，我一定會努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 yan1 din2, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 nu5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你的恩惠，我一定会努力的。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your kindness, I will definitely work hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗好多恩典我哋，我哋一定要報答佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 ho2 do1 yan1 din2 ngo5 dei6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 daap3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我们很多恩惠，我们一定要报答他。
examples.english_sentence: He has shown us so much kindness, we must repay him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 能夠得到呢份工，真係要感謝上天嘅恩典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nang4 gau3 dak1 dou2 ni1 fan6 gung1, zan1 hai6 jiu3 gam2 ze6 soeng6 tin1 ge3 yan1 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能够得到这份工作，真是要感谢上天的恩赐。
examples.english_sentence: Being able to get this job, I really have to thank God's grace.

english_meaning: to grant (permission); to allow (a request) as a favor
explanation_mandarin: 指上级或长辈同意下级或晚辈的请求，带有恩赐的意味。
explanation_english: To grant permission or approval, often from a superior to a subordinate, implying a sense of benevolence or favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好彩得到老細恩准放假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 coi2 dak1 dou3 lou5 sai3 yan1 zeon2 fong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很幸运得到老板恩准放假。
examples.english_sentence: He was lucky to have the boss grant him leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝皇上恩准臣退下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 wong4 soeng6 yan1 zeon2 san4 teoi3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢皇上恩准臣退下。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you, your majesty, for granting me permission to withdraw.

english_meaning: A debt of gratitude greater than being reborn; deeply grateful.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人给予的恩情非常大，像给自己再造生命一样。
explanation_english: This idiom describes an immense debt of gratitude, comparing the kindness received to being given a second life. It expresses profound thankfulness for someone's help or generosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢救返我條命，對我嘅恩情簡直恩同再造啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gau3 faan1 ngo5 tiu4 meng6, deoi3 ngo5 ge3 yan1 cing4 gaan2 zik6 yan1 tung4 zoi3 zou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他救了我的命，对我的恩情简直就像再造了我一样。
examples.english_sentence: He saved my life; his kindness to me is like being reborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次如果唔係你幫手，我哋間公司就執笠啦，你嘅恩同再造，我哋永遠都唔會忘記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 nei5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 zau6 zap1 laap1 laa1, nei5 ge3 yan1 tung4 zoi3 zou6, ngo5 dei6 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 mong4 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次如果不是你帮忙，我们公司就要倒闭了，你的恩情我们永远都不会忘记。
examples.english_sentence: If it weren't for your help this time, our company would have gone bankrupt. We'll never forget your profound kindness.

english_meaning: Patron, client (especially in the context of prostitution)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指妓女的顾客，现在泛指消费额度较高的顾客，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Historically, it refers to a prostitute's client. Now, it generally refers to a customer with high spending, often with a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵到個有錢嘅恩客，生活就好過好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 dou2 go3 jau5 cin2 ge3 jan1 haak3, sang1 wut6 zau6 hou2 gwo3 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她找到了一个有钱的恩客，生活就好过很多了。
examples.english_sentence: She found a wealthy patron, and her life became much better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間夜總會嘅恩客都好闊綽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 je6 zung2 wui2 ge3 jan1 haak3 dou1 hou2 fut3 che3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家夜总会的顾客都很阔绰。
examples.english_sentence: The patrons of this nightclub are all very generous.

english_meaning: to repay kindness with enmity, to bite the hand that feeds you
explanation_mandarin: 意思是接受了别人的恩惠，反而用仇恨来回报。形容忘恩负义，反咬一口。
explanation_english: Describes someone who repays kindness with enmity. It means to be ungrateful and turn against someone who has helped you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我咁幫佢，佢竟然恩將仇報，真係冇良心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam2 bong1 keoi5, keoi5 ging2 jin4 yan1 jeung1 sau4 bou3, zan1 hai6 mou5 leung4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这么帮他，他竟然恩将仇报，真是没良心。
examples.english_sentence: I helped him so much, and he actually repaid my kindness with enmity. He really has no conscience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好恩將仇報呀！人哋借錢俾你，你仲唔還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 yan1 jeung1 sau4 bou3 aa3! yan4 dei6 je3 cin2 bei2 nei5, nei5 zung6 m4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要恩将仇报啊！人家借钱给你，你还不还。
examples.english_sentence: Don't repay kindness with enmity! Someone lent you money, and you still haven't returned it.

synonyms: 反面無情 (faan2 min6 mou4 ching4)

english_meaning: respected teacher, benefactor teacher
explanation_mandarin: 指对自己有很深恩情的老师。表示尊敬。
explanation_english: Refers to a teacher who has shown great kindness and guidance. An expression of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李老師係我嘅恩師，佢教咗我好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 lou5 si1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 yan1 si1, keoi5 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李老师是我的恩师，他教了我很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li is my respected teacher, he taught me a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇恩師嘅教導，我就唔會有今日嘅成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 yan1 si1 ge3 gaau3 dou6, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 jau5 gam1 jat6 ge3 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有恩师的教导，我就不会有今天的成就。
examples.english_sentence: Without the guidance of my respected teacher, I wouldn't have the achievements I have today.

english_meaning: Enping (a county-level city in Guangdong province)
explanation_mandarin: 恩平是中国广东省江门市下辖的一个县级市。
explanation_english: Enping is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of Jiangmen City in Guangdong Province, China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺係恩平人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 ng1 ping4 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷是恩平人。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is from Enping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恩平嘅燒餅好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng1 ping4 ge3 siu1 beng2 hou2 cheut1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恩平的烧饼很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Enping's roasted sesame seed cakes are very famous.

english_meaning: grudges; past grievances; a complex of gratitude and resentment; love-hate relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指既有恩情又有仇恨的复杂关系，通常是长期积累的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to a complex relationship involving both gratitude and resentment, often accumulated over a long period of time. It can also describe a situation where there are long-standing grudges or grievances between people or groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅恩怨好難化解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 yan1 yun3 hou2 naan4 faa3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的恩怨很难化解。
examples.english_sentence: The grudges between them are hard to resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢冇乜恩怨，唔使咁樣對我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 mou5 mat1 yan1 yun3, m4 sai2 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他没什么恩怨，不需要这样对我。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have any grudges with him, you don't need to treat me like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上一代嘅恩怨，唔應該影響下一代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 jat1 dai6 ge3 yan1 yun3, m4 jing2 goi1 jing2 hoeng2 haa6 jat1 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上一代的恩怨，不应该影响下一代。
examples.english_sentence: The grudges of the previous generation shouldn't affect the next generation.

english_meaning: grievances, resentment, love, and hatred; a complex web of relationships and emotions; a saga of love, hate, and revenge
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 (often used as a noun phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间复杂的感情纠葛，包括恩情、仇恨、爱情等各种情感，通常用于形容情节复杂、充满戏剧性的故事。
explanation_english: Refers to the complex emotional entanglements between people, including gratitude, hatred, love, and other emotions. It's often used to describe complex and dramatic stories filled with intertwined relationships and conflicts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲講嘅就係兩大家族之間嘅恩怨情仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 ge3 zau6 hai6 loeng5 daai6 ga1 zuk6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 jan1 jyun3 cing4 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏讲述的是两个大家族之间的恩怨情仇。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells a story of grievances, resentment, love, and hatred between two large families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅恩怨情仇，真係講極都講唔完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 jan1 jyun3 cing4 sau4, zan1 hai6 gong2 gik1 dou1 gong2 m4 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的恩怨情仇，真是说也说不完。
examples.english_sentence: The saga of love, hate and revenge between them is truly endless.

english_meaning: Affectionate; loving; mutually loving and attached
explanation_mandarin: 形容夫妻或情侣之间感情深厚，非常相爱。
explanation_english: Describes the deep affection and love between a married couple or lovers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆結婚咁多年都仲係恩恩愛愛，真係令人羡慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 git3 fan1 gam3 do1 nin4 dou1 zung1 hai6 yan1 yan1 oi3 oi3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sin6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻结婚这么多年还这么恩爱，真是令人羡慕。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for so many years and are still so loving and affectionate, it's really enviable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望我哋第日都可以好似佢哋咁，恩恩愛愛，白頭到老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ngo5 dei6 dai6 jat6 dou1 ho2 ji5 hou2 ci5 keoi5 dei6 gam2, yan1 yan1 oi3 oi3, baak6 tau4 dou3 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望我们以后也可以像他们一样，恩恩爱爱，白头到老。
examples.english_sentence: I hope we can be like them in the future, loving and affectionate, and grow old together.

english_meaning: kindness; favour; grace; debt of gratitude
explanation_mandarin: 指受到的恩惠和情谊。
explanation_english: The kindness and affection received from someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫咗我咁多，我真係欠佢一份好大嘅恩情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 do1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 kim3 keoi5 jat1 fan6 hou2 daai6 ge3 ngan1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮了我这么多，我真是欠了他很大一份恩情。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me so much, I really owe him a great debt of gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母嘅恩情，我哋一世都報答唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 ge3 ngan1 cing4, ngo5 dei6 jat1 sai3 dou1 bou3 daap3 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母的恩情，我们一辈子都报答不完。
examples.english_sentence: We can never fully repay the kindness of our parents.

english_meaning: favor, grace, kindness, benefit
explanation_mandarin: 给予的优待或好处。
explanation_english: An act of kindness or favor; a benefit conferred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋好多謝佢嘅恩惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hou2 do1 ze6 keoi5 ge3 yan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们很感谢他的恩惠。
examples.english_sentence: We are very grateful for his kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢对我有恩惠，我一定要报答佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 jau5 yan1 wai6, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 daap3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我施有恩惠，我一定要报答他。
examples.english_sentence: He has shown me kindness, I must repay him.

english_meaning: loving, affectionate, conjugal love
explanation_mandarin: 形容夫妻或情侣之间感情深厚，彼此关爱。
explanation_english: Describes a deep and affectionate relationship between a married couple or lovers, showing mutual care and affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆好恩愛㗎，成日都一齊出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 hou2 yan1 oi3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 cai4 chut1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩很恩爱，经常一起出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: They are a very loving couple, they often go out and have fun together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢哋咁恩愛，真係令人羨慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 dei6 gam3 yan1 oi3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sim6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他们那么恩爱，真是令人羡慕。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how loving they are, it's really enviable.

english_meaning: to sever all ties of gratitude and obligation; to break off all relations
explanation_mandarin: 指恩情、情义完全断绝，不再有任何瓜葛。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where gratitude and all sense of obligation have been completely severed, ending any relationship or connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹因為爭遺產而恩斷義絕，以後都冇再聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 yan1 wai6 zaang1 wai4 caan2 yi4 yan1 dyun6 yi6 jyut6, yi5 hau6 dou1 mou5 zoi3 lyun4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹因为争夺遗产而恩断义绝，以后都没有再联系。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters broke off all ties due to a dispute over inheritance and never contacted each other again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為實在太過分，搞到我哋終於恩斷義絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 sat6 zoi6 taai3 gwo3 fan6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 yan1 dyun6 yi6 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为实在太过分，导致我们终于恩断义绝。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior was so outrageous that it finally led to us severing all ties.

english_meaning: Godsend; Treasure; Something highly valued and beneficial
explanation_mandarin: 指带来很大好处或帮助的物品，如同恩惠一样。
explanation_english: Refers to an item that brings great benefit or help, as if it were a blessing or a godsend. Something that is highly valued and considered beneficial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個除濕機真係恩物，回南天都唔怕屋企濕立立啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ceoi4 sap1 gei1 zan1 hai6 yan1 mat6, wui4 naam4 tin1 dou1 m4 paa3 uk1 kei5 sap1 lap1 lap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个除湿机真是个宝贝，回南天都不怕家里湿漉漉的了。
examples.english_sentence: This dehumidifier is truly a godsend; I'm not afraid of the house being damp during the humid season anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對湊小朋友嘅父母嚟講，尿片簡直係恩物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 cau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 fu6 mou5 lei4 gong2, niu6 pin3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 yan1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于照顾小孩的父母来说，尿片简直是宝贝。
examples.english_sentence: For parents taking care of young children, diapers are simply a godsend.

english_meaning: Imperial examination held as a special favor during the Qing Dynasty
explanation_mandarin: 清代为庆祝皇帝登基、太后万寿等喜庆事宜而特设的科举考试，称为恩科。
explanation_english: In the Qing Dynasty, an imperial examination (科举) specially established to celebrate auspicious events such as the emperor's enthronement or the Empress Dowager's birthday. It was considered a special favor (恩) granted by the emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺清朝嘅時候，有時會舉行恩科嚟慶祝皇帝登基。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 cing1 ciu4 ge3 si4 hau6, yau5 si4 wui5 geui2 hang4 ngon1 fo1 lai4 hing3 zuk1 wong4 dai3 dang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在清朝的时候，有时会举行恩科来庆祝皇帝登基。
examples.english_sentence: During the Qing Dynasty, sometimes special imperial examinations were held to celebrate the emperor's enthronement.

english_meaning: kindness and righteousness; favor and duty; a debt of gratitude
explanation_mandarin: 指别人给予的恩惠和自己应尽的道义。表示一种感恩和报答的心情。
explanation_english: Refers to the kindness or favor someone has bestowed upon you and the sense of duty you feel in return. It expresses a feeling of gratitude and the desire to repay that kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫咗我咁多，我一定要報答佢嘅恩義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 do1, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 daap3 keoi5 ge3 yan1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮了我这么多，我一定要报答他的恩情道义。
examples.english_sentence: He has helped me so much, I must repay his kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 受人點水之恩，當湧泉相報，做人要有恩義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau6 jan4 dim2 seoi2 zi1 yan1, dong1 yung2 cyun4 soeng1 bou3, zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 yan1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 受人滴水之恩，当涌泉相报，做人要有恩情道义。
examples.english_sentence: One should repay a drop of kindness with a spring of gratitude. A person should be righteous and grateful.

english_meaning: Shirt allowance, uniform subsidy
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或机构发给员工用于购买工作制服或衬衫的补贴。
explanation_english: A subsidy or allowance provided by a company or organization to its employees for purchasing work uniforms or shirts, especially in Hong Kong context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每年都會派恩裇金俾我哋買新嘅制服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 paai3 ng1 seot1 gam1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 maai5 san1 ge3 zai3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每年都会发恤衫金给我们买新的制服。
examples.english_sentence: The company gives us a shirt allowance every year for buying new uniforms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅恩裇金好似少咗喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 ng1 seot1 gam1 hou2 ci5 siu2 zo2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的制服津贴好像少了。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like the shirt allowance is less this year.

english_meaning: bestowal, grant, favour (from a superior)
explanation_mandarin: 指地位高的人给予地位低的人好处或赏赐。
explanation_english: A favour or gift granted by someone of higher status or power to someone of lower status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個獎學金係學校對我嘅恩賜，我一定會好好珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng2 hok6 gam1 hai6 hok6 haau6 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 yan1 ci3, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个奖学金是学校对我的恩赐，我一定会好好珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: This scholarship is a gift from the school to me. I will definitely cherish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋应该感谢大自然嘅恩賜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 gam2 ze6 daai6 zi6 jin4 ge3 yan1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该感谢大自然的恩赐。
examples.english_sentence: We should be grateful for the gifts of nature.

english_meaning: A debt of gratitude as weighty as a mountain; deeply indebted.
explanation_mandarin: 形容恩情极为深重，像山一样。
explanation_english: Describes a debt of gratitude that is extremely profound, like a mountain. It implies that someone has received an immense favor and is deeply grateful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢救咗我一命，真係恩重如山呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gau3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 ming6, zan1 hai6 yan1 cung5 jyu4 saan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他救了我一命，真是恩重如山啊。
examples.english_sentence: He saved my life, I am truly deeply indebted to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母嘅養育之恩，恩重如山，我哋一世都報答唔完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 ge3 joeng5 yuk6 zi1 yan1, yan1 cung5 jyu4 saan1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 sai3 dou1 bou3 daap3 m4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母的养育之恩，恩重如山，我们一辈子都报答不完。
examples.english_sentence: The kindness of our parents in raising us is as weighty as a mountain; we will never be able to repay it in our lifetime.

english_meaning: to respect, to abide by, to follow conscientiously
explanation_mandarin: 谨慎遵守，恭敬地对待。
explanation_english: To respect and conscientiously abide by rules, regulations, or principles. To treat something or someone with reverence and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該恪守公司嘅規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 kok3 sau2 gung1 si1 ge3 kwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该遵守公司的规矩。
examples.english_sentence: We should abide by the company rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直恪盡職守，從來冇偷懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 kok3 zeon6 zik1 sau2, cung4 loi4 mou5 tau1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直尽职尽责，从来没有偷懒。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been conscientious and never slacked off.

english_meaning: to adhere to, to abide by, to scrupulously observe
