examples.english_sentence: Hey, be quiet, so many people are looking at you!

english_meaning: to retire from making movies; to give up an acting career
explanation_mandarin: 指演员停止拍电影，退出电影界。
explanation_english: To retire from the film industry, usually referring to an actor or actress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺事業嘅高峰期選擇咗息影，返屋企湊仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 si6 jip6 ge3 gou1 fung1 kei4 syun2 zaak6 zo2 sik1 jeng2, faan1 uk1 kei2 cou3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在事业的高峰期选择了息影，回家带孩子。
examples.english_sentence: She chose to retire from acting at the peak of her career to stay home and raise her children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都覺得佢息影好可惜，佢演技咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 sik1 jeng2 hou2 ho2 sik1, keoi5 jin2 gei6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都觉得她息影很可惜，她的演技那么好。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think it's a pity that she retired, she was such a good actress.

english_meaning: to give up (hope); to resign oneself (to fate); to abandon (an idea, plan, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 死了心，放弃希望或想法。
explanation_english: To lose heart; to give up on something; to abandon hope or a plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都試咗咁多次，都唔成功，不如息心算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 si3 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3, dou1 m4 sing4 gung1, bat1 jyu4 sik1 sam1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都试了这么多次，都没成功，不如死心算了。
examples.english_sentence: You've tried so many times and haven't succeeded, why don't you just give up?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經對佢息心，唔再想同佢一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 deoi3 keoi5 sik1 sam1, m4 zoi3 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她已经对她死了心，不想再和她在一起。
examples.english_sentence: She has already given up on her and doesn't want to be with her anymore.

english_meaning: closely linked; intimately related; inextricably bound together
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常密切，相互影响。
explanation_english: Describes a very close relationship where things are intimately connected and mutually influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個國家嘅經濟息息相關，一個有事，另一個都會受到影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 ging1 zai3 sik1 sik1 soeng1 gwaan1, jat1 go3 jau5 si6, ling6 jat1 go3 dou1 wui5 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个国家的经济息息相关，一个有事，另一个都会受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: The economies of these two countries are closely linked. If something happens to one, the other will also be affected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 環保同我哋嘅生活息息相關，保護環境就係保護我哋自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan4 bou2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sang1 wut6 sik1 sik1 soeng1 gwaan1, bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2 zau6 hai6 bou2 wu6 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 环保和我们的生活息息相关，保护环境就是保护我们自己。
examples.english_sentence: Environmental protection is intimately related to our lives. Protecting the environment is protecting ourselves.

english_meaning: interest rate
explanation_mandarin: 指借款或存款所产生的利息与本金的比率。
explanation_english: The rate at which interest is paid by a borrower (typically bank) for the use of money that they borrow from a lender (typically bank).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行加咗息率，借錢會貴咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan4 hong4 gaa1 zo2 sik1 leot2, ze3 cin2 wui2 gwai3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行提高了利率，贷款会贵很多。
examples.english_sentence: The bank increased the interest rate, borrowing money will be much more expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲定期存款息率好低，唔係好抵做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 ding6 kei4 cyun4 款 sik1 leot2 hou2 dai1, m4 hai6 hou2 dai2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的定期存款利率很低，不太划算。
examples.english_sentence: The interest rate for fixed deposits is very low nowadays, it's not very worthwhile.

english_meaning: polyp
explanation_mandarin: 指从人体黏膜表面长出的赘生物，通常是良性的。
explanation_english: A polyp is an abnormal growth of tissue projecting from a mucous membrane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我嘅大腸入邊生咗粒息肉，要切除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 daai6 coeng2 jap6 bin1 saang1 zo2 lap1 sik1 juk6, jiu3 cit3 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的大肠里面长了个息肉，要切除。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that I have a polyp in my colon, which needs to be removed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 檢查報告顯示佢有胃息肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gim2 caa4 bou3 gou3 hin2 si6 keoi5 jau5 wai6 sik1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 检查报告显示他有胃息肉。
examples.english_sentence: The examination report shows that he has stomach polyps.

english_meaning: suitable, appropriate, fitting; exactly, precisely
explanation_mandarin: 形容状态、程度正好符合要求，或时机、地点等正好。
explanation_english: Describes something that is suitable, appropriate, or fitting; or the timing, location, etc. is just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫啱啱恰我著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hap6 ngo5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服正合适我穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits me perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋恰啱撞到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hap6 ngaam1 zong6 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们恰好碰到他。
examples.english_sentence: We happened to bump into him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢恰如其分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 hap6 jyu4 kei4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格恰如其分。
examples.english_sentence: This price is just right.

english_meaning: just like, as if, similar to
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常相似，就像…一样。
explanation_english: Expressing a close similarity or resemblance; just like, as if.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個情景恰似我細個嘅時候見過噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 ging2 hap1 ci5 ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 gin3 gwo3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个情景好像我小时候见过一样。
examples.english_sentence: This scene is just like something I saw when I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容恰似陽光噉溫暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 yung4 hap1 ci5 yeung4 gwong1 gam2 wan1 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容好像阳光一样温暖。
examples.english_sentence: His smile is as warm as sunlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅旋律恰似一陣微風，令人感覺好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 syun4 leot6 hap1 ci5 jat1 zan6 mei4 fung1, ling6 jan4 gam2 gok3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的旋律好像一阵微风，让人感觉很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The melody of this song is like a gentle breeze, making people feel very comfortable.

english_meaning: Exactly what one wants; hits the spot; right up one's alley; just what one needs
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或说话正合某人的心意，完全符合某人的期望或喜好。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or something said that is exactly what someone wants, perfectly matching their expectations or preferences. It literally translates to 'exactly arriving at (or hitting) the heart'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你送呢份禮物真係恰到上心口，我好鍾意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sung3 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 zan1 hai6 hap1 dou3 soeng6 sam1 hau2, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你送的这份礼物真是正中下怀，我好喜欢！
examples.english_sentence: This gift you gave me is exactly what I wanted, I really like it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好好味，真係恰到上心口，啱晒我口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6, zan1 hai6 hap1 dou3 soeng6 sam1 hau2, ngaam1 saai3 ngo5 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很好吃，真是正中下怀，完全符合我的口味。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is very delicious, it's exactly what I want, perfectly suits my taste.

synonyms: 啱晒口味 (ngaam1 saai3 hau2 mei6)

english_meaning: just right; perfectly; to a T; appropriate
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事或说话等正合分寸，非常合适。
explanation_english: Describing something that is just right, perfectly suitable, or appropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅尺寸啱啱好，真係恰到好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 chi2 cheon3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2, zan1 hai6 hap1 dou3 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的尺寸刚刚好，真是恰到好处。
examples.english_sentence: The size of this shirt is just right, it's perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅語氣恰到好處，唔會太過份，又唔會太保守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 jyu5 hei3 hap1 dou3 hou2 cyu3, m4 wui5 taai3 gwo3 fan6, jau6 m4 wui5 taai3 bou2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的语气恰到好处，不会太过分，也不会太保守。
examples.english_sentence: His tone of voice is just right, not too excessive, nor too conservative.

english_meaning: just right, exactly, precisely, coincidentally
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间、数量、程度等正好符合要求或期望。
explanation_english: Indicates that the time, quantity, degree, etc., are just right or meet expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱到，你都恰好到咗，真係好啱時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 dou3, nei5 dou1 haap6 hou2 dou3 zo2, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaam1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚到，你也刚好到了，真是时间掐得太准了。
examples.english_sentence: I just arrived, and you happened to arrive at the same time. The timing is perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫嘅size恰好啱我着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 ge3 size haap6 hou2 ngaam1 ngo5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的尺码正好适合我穿。
examples.english_sentence: The size of this shirt fits me perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋恰好撞正佢喺街度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haap6 hou2 zong6 zeng3 keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正好在街上碰见了他。
examples.english_sentence: We happened to run into him on the street.

english_meaning: just right, appropriate, fitting, perfect
explanation_mandarin: 指事情或东西做得、说得、或者处理得正好，非常合适，不多不少。
explanation_english: Describes something that is done, said, or handled perfectly, in a way that is just right, not too much and not too little; appropriate, fitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意見好中肯，分析得恰如其分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3 hou2 zung1 hang2, fan1 sik1 dak1 hap1 jyu4 kei4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意见很中肯，分析得恰如其分。
examples.english_sentence: His opinion is very impartial, and his analysis is just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個禮物嘅價錢恰如其分，唔會太貴又唔會太 cheap。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lai5 mat6 ge3 gaa3 cin4 hap1 jyu4 kei4 fan6, m4 wui5 taai3 gwai3 jau6 m4 wui5 taai3 cip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个礼物的价格恰如其分，不会太贵也不会太便宜。
examples.english_sentence: The price of this gift is just right, not too expensive and not too cheap.

english_meaning: by chance, coincidentally, as it happens
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生得很偶然，刚好。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened by chance, just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺機場恰巧撞到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gei1 coeng4 hap1 haau2 zong6 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们恰好在机场碰到了他。
examples.english_sentence: We happened to run into him at the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恰巧你嚟嘅時候佢都喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap1 haau2 nei5 lai4 ge3 si4 hau6 keoi5 dou1 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碰巧你来的时候他也在。
examples.english_sentence: As it happened, he was there when you came.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恰巧我帶咗遮，如果唔係就淋濕晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap1 haau2 ngo5 daai3 zo2 ze1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 lam4 sip3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恰巧我带了伞，不然就淋湿了。
examples.english_sentence: Luckily, I brought an umbrella, otherwise I would have gotten soaked.

english_meaning: just right; exactly; precisely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，相当于“正好”、“恰好”。
explanation_english: Indicates degree; equivalent to "just right," "exactly," or "precisely."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫我著落恰恰好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngo5 zoek3 lok6 haap1 haap1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服我穿着正好。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits me just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲餸嘅鹹淡恰恰好，好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sung3 ge3 haam4 daam6 haap1 haap1 hou2, hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜的味道咸淡正好，很好吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: The saltiness of the dishes is just right, it's so delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋到嘅時間恰恰趕得切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou3 ge3 si4 gaan3 haap1 haap1 gon2 dak1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们到达的时间恰好赶得上。
examples.english_sentence: The time we arrived was just in time.

english_meaning: appropriate; suitable; proper; fitting
explanation_mandarin: 指合适，妥当，没有不合适的地方。
explanation_english: Describes something that is suitable, proper, and without any inappropriate aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得咁樣做先至最恰當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 gam2 joeng2 zou6 sin1 zi3 zeoi3 hap6 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这样做才是最恰当的。
examples.english_sentence: I think this is the most appropriate way to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅回應非常恰當，冇任何問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 wui4 jing3 fei1 soeng4 hap6 dong3, mou5 jam6 ho4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的回应非常恰当，没有任何问题。
examples.english_sentence: Your response was very appropriate, there are no issues at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個場合，着呢件衫都幾恰當嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ho2 cheung2, zoek3 ni1 gin6 saam1 dou1 gei2 hap6 dong3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个场合，穿这件衣服挺合适的。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing this outfit is quite appropriate for this occasion.

english_meaning: suitable; appropriate; fitting; something that fits well
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物很适合，很恰当，很合适。也指合适的事情。
explanation_english: Describes something that is suitable, appropriate, or fitting. It can also refer to something that fits well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好恰西你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 haap6 sai1 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很适合你呀！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt looks great on you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做邊行先至恰西我呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 bin1 hang4 sin1 zai3 haap6 sai1 ngo5 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做什么行业才适合我呢？
examples.english_sentence: What kind of job is suitable for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種場合唔係咁恰西著得咁求其嘅衫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 cheung4 hap6 m4 hai6 gam3 haap6 sai1 jeuk3 dak1 gam3 kau4 kei4 ge3 saam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种场合不适合穿这么随意的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's not appropriate to wear such casual clothes for this kind of occasion.

mandarin_meaning: 心思; 想法; 念頭
english_meaning: mind; thought; idea
explanation_mandarin: 指心中的想法、念頭。多用於口語，表達內心所想。
explanation_english: Refers to one's thoughts, ideas in the mind. Often used in colloquial speech to express what one is thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知你心入面唸緊乜恴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 sam1 jap6 min6 nim6 gan2 mat1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道你心里在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what you're thinking in your heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講吓你嘅恴啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 haa5 nei5 ge3 dak1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说说你的想法吧！
examples.english_sentence: Tell us your thoughts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好少表達自己嘅恴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 biu2 daat6 zi6 gei2 ge3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很少表达自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He rarely expresses his own thoughts.

english_meaning: patronize, favor with one's presence (especially a shop or restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 光顾，惠顾。通常用于商家对顾客的客套话。
explanation_english: To patronize; to favor with one's presence. Typically used by businesses towards customers as a polite gesture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你哋嘅恵顧！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 ge3 wai6 gu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感谢你们的光顾！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your patronage!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下次再恵顧啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 ci3 zoi3 wai6 gu3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下次再来光顾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Please come again next time!

english_meaning: to instigate, to urge on, to encourage (someone to do something wrong or risky)
explanation_mandarin: 怂恿，鼓动，怂恿别人做不好的事情。
explanation_english: To instigate or urge someone to do something, especially something wrong, risky, or ill-advised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日恿我買啲冇用嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jung2 ngo5 maai5 di1 mou5 jung6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是怂恿我买一些没用的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He always instigates me to buy useless things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好恿佢賭錢啦，對佢唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jung2 keoi5 dou2 cin2 laa1, deoi3 keoi5 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要怂恿他赌钱了，对他不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't instigate him to gamble; it's not good for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢講，佢係度恿你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 gong2, keoi5 hai2 dou6 jung2 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他说，他只是在怂恿你而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to him; he's just instigating you.

english_meaning: quiet, silent, stealthily, quietly
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境或动作不发出声音。也可作副词，表示偷偷地，暗暗地。
explanation_english: Describes a silent environment or action. Can also be used as an adverb meaning stealthily or quietly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬼鬼鼠鼠咁，悄悄雞噉走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gwai2 gwai2 syu2 syu2 gam2, ciu2 ciu2 gai1 gam2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们鬼鬼祟祟的，悄悄地走了。
examples.english_sentence: They were acting suspiciously, leaving stealthily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路哥悄悄咁走入嚟，嚇我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 go1 ciu2 ciu2 gam2 zau2 jap6 lai4, haak3 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那小孩悄悄地走进来，吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: That kid quietly walked in and gave me a fright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成間屋靜悄悄咁，乜人都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 gaan1 uk1 zing6 ciu2 ciu2 gam2, mat1 je5 yan4 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整间屋静悄悄的，什么人都没有。
examples.english_sentence: The whole house is very quiet, there's nobody here.

english_meaning: quietly; secretly; stealthily
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音很小或行动不声张。
explanation_english: Describes something done in a quiet or secretive manner, without drawing attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢悄悄咁走咗，冇同任何人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ciu2 ciu2 gam2 zau2 zo2, mou5 tung4 jam6 ho4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他悄悄地走了，没有跟任何人说。
examples.english_sentence: He left quietly, without telling anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋悄悄咁入去，俾個驚喜佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ciu2 ciu2 gam2 jap6 heoi3, bei2 go3 ging1 hei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们悄悄地进去，给他一个惊喜。
examples.english_sentence: Let's sneak in and give him a surprise.

english_meaning: whisper, words spoken in a low voice
explanation_mandarin: 指轻声细语，私下说的话。
explanation_english: Refers to words spoken softly or in a whisper, often in private.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺度講緊悄悄話，唔知講乜嘢咁鬼神秘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 dou6 gong2 gan2 ciu4 ciu4 waa2, m4 zi1 gong2 mat1 je5 gam3 gwai2 san1 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在那里说悄悄话，不知道在说什么这么神秘。
examples.english_sentence: They are whispering over there, I wonder what they are talking about so mysteriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺課室度講悄悄話，會影響到其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 fo3 sat1 dou6 gong2 ciu4 ciu4 waa2, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 gei2 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在教室里说悄悄话，会影响到其他人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't whisper in the classroom, it will affect others.

english_meaning: pleased, happy, delighted
explanation_mandarin: 表示心情愉快、高兴。
explanation_english: Expressing a feeling of happiness and delight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到呢個消息好喜悅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting3 dou2 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hou2 hei2 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到这个消息很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very happy to hear this news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表演令觀眾感到愉悅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 ling6 gun1 zung3 gam2 dou3 jyu4 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演让观众感到愉快。
examples.english_sentence: His performance made the audience feel delighted.

english_meaning: happy, pleased, delighted
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情舒畅，感到快乐和满意。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of being cheerful, happy, and satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到份禮物之後，好悅星啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou2 fan6 lai5 mat6 zi1 hau6, hou2 jyut6 sing1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到礼物之后，非常高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He was very happy after receiving the gift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個好消息，我真係好悅星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting3 dou2 ni1 go3 hou2 siu1 sik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jyut6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个好消息，我真的很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: I am really happy to hear this good news.

english_meaning: pleasing to the eye; visually appealing
explanation_mandarin: 指事物外形美好，让人感到愉悦。
explanation_english: Describing something that is beautiful or attractive to look at, making one feel pleased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園嘅設計真係好悅目，令人心曠神怡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun2 ge3 sat3 gai3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jyut6 muk6, ling6 jan4 sam1 kwong3 san4 yi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园的设计真的很悦目，令人心旷神怡。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this garden is really pleasing to the eye, making people feel relaxed and happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着嘅衫好悅目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 ge3 saam1 hou2 jyut6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿的衣服很悦目。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes she is wearing today are visually appealing.

english_meaning: pleasing to the eye; eye-pleasing; attractive
explanation_mandarin: 使眼睛感到愉悦；好看；美丽
explanation_english: Describes something that is visually appealing and pleasing to the eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園啲花好悅目呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun4 di1 faa1 hou2 jyut6 muk6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园里的花真悦目啊！
examples.english_sentence: The flowers in this garden are so pleasing to the eye!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅顏色好悅目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 jyut6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画的颜色很悦目。
examples.english_sentence: The colors of this painting are very pleasing to the eye.

english_meaning: pleasing to the ear; melodious
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音动听，使人感到愉快。
explanation_english: Describing a sound that is pleasing to the ear and makes one feel happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌把聲好悅耳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheung3 go1 baa2 seng1 hou2 jyut6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌的声音很好听。
examples.english_sentence: His singing voice is very melodious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲鳥叫聲好悅耳，令人覺得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 niu5 giu3 seng1 hou2 jyut6 ji5, ling6 yan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鸟叫声很悦耳，让人觉得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The birdsong is very pleasing to the ear, making people feel comfortable.

english_meaning: pleasant to hear; melodious
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音动听，好听。
explanation_english: Describing a sound as pleasant, melodious, or agreeable to the ear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅旋律好悅耳，我好鍾意聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 syun4 leut6 hou2 jyut6 ji5, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的旋律很好听，我很喜欢听。
examples.english_sentence: The melody of this song is very pleasant to hear; I really enjoy listening to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好悅耳，令人覺得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 jyut6 ji5, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音很好听，让人觉得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very pleasant to hear, making people feel comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 知道, 清楚, 全, 都
english_meaning: to know, to understand clearly, all, entirely
explanation_mandarin: 知道，了解；全部，完全。通常用于书面语或正式场合。
explanation_english: To know, to understand; all, entirely. Commonly used in written language or formal settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 悉隨尊便啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 ceoi4 zyun1 bin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 悉听尊便吧。
examples.english_sentence: As you wish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詳情容後悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 cing4 jung4 hau6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 详情容后再说。
examples.english_sentence: Details will be provided later.

english_meaning: Sydney
explanation_mandarin: 澳大利亚的新南威尔士州首府，也是澳大利亚最大的城市。
explanation_english: Sydney, the capital of New South Wales, Australia, and the largest city in Australia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去悉尼旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 sik1 nei4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去悉尼旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I will travel to Sydney next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 悉尼嘅歌劇院好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 nei4 ge3 go1 kek3 yun2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 悉尼的歌剧院很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The Sydney Opera House is very famous.

mandarin_meaning: 指喜欢背后说人坏话，搬弄是非的人
english_meaning: Someone who talks behind people's backs, stirs up trouble, or gossips (lit. Sydney mouse)
explanation_mandarin: “悉尼老鼠”在粤语俚语中，指的是喜欢在背后搬弄是非，挑拨离间的人。 这个说法可能源于“老鼠”给人一种偷偷摸摸，喜欢在暗处活动的印象，加上“悉尼”一词，使整个说法更加生动形象，也带有一点调侃的意味。
explanation_english: "Sydney mouse" in Cantonese slang refers to someone who enjoys gossiping behind people's backs and stirring up trouble. The term likely originates from the image of a "mouse" as sneaky and active in the dark, and the addition of "Sydney" makes the expression more vivid and humorous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪信佢呀，佢係悉尼老鼠嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 hai6 sik1 nei4 lou5 syu2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他是喜欢背后说人坏话的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he's a backstabber.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入邊最多悉尼老鼠，日日講是非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 bin6 zeoi3 do1 sik1 nei4 lou5 syu2, jat1 jat1 gong2 si6 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司里最多喜欢搬弄是非的人，天天说人坏话。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many gossips in the company, talking behind people's backs every day.

english_meaning: meticulous, attentive, with great care
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常用心、细致。
explanation_english: Describes someone being very attentive, meticulous, and taking great care in doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢悉心照顧佢阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 sam1 ziu3 gu3 keoi5 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他悉心照顾他的妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: He takes meticulous care of his mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生悉心為病人診治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 sik1 sam1 wai4 beng6 yan2 zan2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生悉心为病人诊治。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor meticulously diagnosed and treated the patient.

english_meaning: entirely; completely; all
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，没有遗漏。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is complete, without anything being left out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲錢悉數捐咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 cin2 sik1 sou3 gyun1 zo2 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那些钱全部捐出去了。
examples.english_sentence: He donated all of the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生悉數通過咗考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 sik1 sou3 tung1 gwo3 zo2 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些学生全部通过了考试。
examples.english_sentence: All of the students passed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋悉數到齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sik1 sou3 dou3 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全部到齐了。
examples.english_sentence: They have all arrived.

english_meaning: As you wish; Whatever you prefer; At your convenience
explanation_mandarin: 完全按照您的意愿行事。表示尊重对方，听从对方的安排。
explanation_english: To act completely according to your wishes; to indicate respect and deference to someone else's arrangements or preferences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去邊度食飯呀？悉隨尊便啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 sik6 faan6 aa3? sik1 ceoi4 zyun1 bin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去哪里吃饭？悉听尊便。
examples.english_sentence: Where shall we go for dinner? Whatever you prefer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房點樣佈置？悉隨尊便，你鍾意點咪點囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 dim2 joeng2 bou3 zi3? sik1 ceoi4 zyun1 bin6, nei5 zung1 ji3 dim2 mai1 dim2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间怎么布置？悉听尊便，你喜欢怎样就怎样吧。
examples.english_sentence: How should we decorate the room? As you wish; you can do whatever you like.

english_meaning: Fraternal submission; brotherly love and respect for elders; filial piety towards older siblings
explanation_mandarin: 指弟弟敬爱兄长，顺从兄长之道；引申为敬重长辈的一种美德。
explanation_english: Refers to the respect and obedience of younger brothers towards their elder brothers; by extension, a virtue of respecting elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孝悌忠信禮義廉恥係傳統嘅美德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau3 dai6 zung1 seon3 lai5 ji6 lim4 ci2 hai6 cyun4 tung2 ge3 mei5 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孝悌忠信礼义廉耻是传统的道德。
examples.english_sentence: Filial piety, brotherly love, loyalty, trustworthiness, propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame are traditional virtues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重孝悌，對屋企人好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 haau3 dai6, deoi3 uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很注重孝悌，对家人很好。
examples.english_sentence: He values filial piety and brotherly love, and he is very good to his family.

english_meaning: fierce, brave, intrepid, aggressive
explanation_mandarin: 形容勇猛、强硬、凶狠。
explanation_english: Describes someone as fierce, brave, strong, or aggressive. Often implies a negative connotation of being unreasonable or difficult to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好悍，乜都唔怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hon5, mat1 dou1 m4 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很强悍，什么都不怕。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very fierce person, he's not afraid of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個老細好悍，唔容易應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou5 sai3 hou2 hon5, m4 jung4 ji6 ying3 fui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个老板很凶悍，不容易应付。
examples.english_sentence: This boss is very aggressive; he's not easy to deal with.

english_meaning: heavily armed robber; ruthless bandit; violent criminal
explanation_mandarin: 指持有重型武器、手段凶残的匪徒。
explanation_english: Refers to a heavily armed and ruthless bandit or criminal, often involved in violent crimes like armed robbery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方啱啱捉咗班持械行劫嘅悍匪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ngaam1 ngaam1 zuk1 zo2 baan1 ci4 haai6 hang4 gip3 ge3 hon6 fei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方刚刚抓捕了一批持械抢劫的悍匪。
examples.english_sentence: The police have just arrested a group of heavily armed robbers.

english_meaning: fierce general, valiant warrior, a strong and capable person (often in a specific field)
explanation_mandarin: 形容勇猛善战的将领，也可用来形容在某个领域非常出色、能干的人。
explanation_english: Describes a brave and skilled general. Can also be used to describe someone who is outstanding and capable in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司係個悍將嚟㗎，乜嘢難題都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hai6 go3 hon6 jeung3 lai4 gaa3, mat1 je5 naan4 tai4 dou1 gaau2 dak1 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司是个悍将，什么难题都能解决。
examples.english_sentence: He is a fierce general in the company and can solve any problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊波嘅前鋒真係個悍將，入波好勁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi2 bo1 ge3 cin4 fung1 zan1 hai6 go3 hon6 jeung3, jap6 bo1 hou2 ging6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支球队的前锋真是个悍将，进球很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: The striker of this team is really a fierce general, he's great at scoring goals!

english_meaning: brazenly; flagrantly; defiantly; openly; without hesitation
explanation_mandarin: 表示态度强硬，不顾一切地（做坏事或不应做的事）。
explanation_english: Indicates a brazen, defiant, or reckless attitude in doing something wrong or inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋悍然入侵咗人哋嘅電腦系統，偷走咗好多機密資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hon6 jin4 jap6 ceon1 zo2 jan4 dei6 ge3 din6 nou5 hai6 tung2, tau1 zau2 zo2 hou2 do1 gei1 mat6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们悍然入侵了别人的电脑系统，偷走了很多机密资料。
examples.english_sentence: They brazenly hacked into other people's computer systems and stole a lot of confidential information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢悍然拒絕咗老闆嘅要求，結果俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hon6 jin4 geoi5 jyut6 zo2 lou5 baan2 ge3 jiu1 kau4, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他悍然拒绝了老板的要求，结果被解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: He defiantly refused the boss's request and ended up getting fired.

english_meaning: depressed, melancholy, feeling down
explanation_mandarin: 指心情不舒畅，感到郁闷，闷闷不乐。
explanation_english: Refers to a feeling of discomfort, depression, and unhappiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排心情好悒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 sam1 ching4 hou2 ap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近心情很郁闷。
examples.english_sentence: I've been feeling down lately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日愁眉苦臉，好似有啲嘢悒住悒住咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 ye5 ap1 zyu6 ap1 zyu6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是愁眉苦脸的，好像有什么事情闷闷不乐的。
examples.english_sentence: He always looks sad, as if something is bothering him.

english_meaning: to regret
explanation_mandarin: 感到做错了事或说错了话而懊恼。
explanation_english: To feel sorrow or remorse for something one has done or failed to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好悔冇早啲買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 fui3 mou5 zou2 di1 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常后悔没有早点买房。
examples.english_sentence: I really regret not buying a flat earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千金難買早知道，後悔都冇用㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 gam1 naan4 maai5 zou2 zi1 dou3, hau6 fui3 dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千金难买早知道，后悔也没用了。
examples.english_sentence: It's too late to regret; what's done is done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一定會後悔咁樣對你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 hau6 fui3 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一定会后悔这样对你的。
examples.english_sentence: He will definitely regret treating you like that.

english_meaning: to regret not having done something in the first place; to rue one's initial decision
explanation_mandarin: 后悔当初没有那样做。表示对过去的行为感到后悔。
explanation_english: An idiom expressing deep regret about a past decision or action, wishing one had acted differently from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣冇努力讀書，依家就悔不當初喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge2 zan6 mou5 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, ji1 ga1 zau6 fui3 bat1 dong3 co1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候没有努力读书，现在就后悔当初了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't study hard when I was young, and now I regret it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一早就應該聽你講，唔好投資嗰隻股票，依家真係悔不當初啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zou2 zau6 jing1 goi1 teng1 nei5 gong2, m4 hou2 tau4 zi1 go2 zek3 gu2 piu3, ji1 ga1 zan1 hai6 fui3 bat1 dong3 co1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早就应该听你的话，不要投资那只股票，现在真是后悔当初啊。
examples.english_sentence: I should have listened to you and not invested in that stock. Now I really regret it.

english_meaning: to call off a wedding, to break off an engagement
explanation_mandarin: 取消已经订好的婚约，不结婚了。
explanation_english: To cancel a previously agreed-upon wedding; to break off an engagement and not proceed with the marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋本嚟下個月結婚，點知新郎哥臨門一腳悔婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bun2 lai4 haa6 go3 jyut6 git3 fan1, dim2 zi1 san1 long4 go1 lam4 mun4 jat1 goek3 fui3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们本来下个月结婚，没想到新郎临近结婚时悔婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They were originally getting married next month, but unexpectedly the groom called off the wedding at the last minute.

english_meaning: remorse, regret, repentance
explanation_mandarin: 对过去所做的事情感到后悔和遗憾。
explanation_english: A feeling of deep regret or remorse about past actions or decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好悔恨當時冇聽阿媽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 fui3 han6 dong1 si4 mou5 ting1 aa3 maa1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常后悔当时没有听妈妈的话。
examples.english_sentence: I deeply regret not listening to my mother back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對自己嘅所作所為感到好悔恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 so2 zok3 so2 wai4 gam2 dou3 hou2 fui3 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对自己的所作所为感到非常后悔。
examples.english_sentence: He feels great remorse for what he did.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 與其事後悔恨，不如事前做好準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 kei4 si6 hau6 fui3 han6, bat1 jyu4 si6 cin4 zou6 hou2 zhun2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 与其事后后悔，不如事前做好准备。
examples.english_sentence: Better to prepare well beforehand than to regret afterwards.

english_meaning: remorse, regret
explanation_mandarin: 后悔的心情；悔恨之意。
explanation_english: A feeling of regret or remorse for one's actions or past behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現出好大嘅悔意，希望可以得到原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 hin6 ceot1 hou2 daai6 ge3 fui3 ji3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表现出很大的悔意，希望可以得到原谅。
examples.english_sentence: He showed great remorse, hoping to be forgiven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道錯喇，我好有悔意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 co3 laa3, ngo5 hou2 jau5 fui3 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道错了，我很有悔意。
examples.english_sentence: I know I was wrong, I am very remorseful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅眼神充滿咗悔意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 san4 cung1 mun5 zo2 fui3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼神充满了悔意。
examples.english_sentence: His eyes were full of regret.

english_meaning: repent; to repent; to reform
explanation_mandarin: 认识到自己做错了事并下决心改正。
explanation_english: To feel remorse or contrition for one's sins or misdeeds and to resolve to change one's behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知錯喇，而家好想悔改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 co3 laa3, ji4 gaa1 hou2 soeng2 fui3 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己错了，现在很想悔改。
examples.english_sentence: He knows he's wrong and now really wants to repent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁衰，都唔識得悔改嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 seoi1, dou1 m4 sik1 dak1 fui3 goi2 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么坏，都不知道悔改吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're so bad, don't you know how to repent?

english_meaning: to take back a move in chess or other board game, to renege on a move
explanation_mandarin: 在下棋时，走了一步棋之后又想收回。比喻反悔已经做出的决定或承诺。
explanation_english: To regret a chess move; to take back a move in a board game. Figuratively, to regret a decision or commitment that has already been made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你唔好咁樣悔棋啦，咁樣無癮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 fui3 kei2 laa1, gam2 joeng2 mou5 yan5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你不要这样悔棋了，这样很没意思的。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't take back your move like that, it's not fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔可以成日悔棋，講咗出口就要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 seng4 jat6 fui3 kei2, gong2 zo2 chut1 hau2 zau6 jiu3 fu3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不可以总是悔棋，说出口就要负责任。
examples.english_sentence: You can't keep reneging on your words; you have to be responsible for what you say.

mandarin_meaning: 不吉利的话；触霉头的话
english_meaning: Unlucky words; jinxing words; words that bring bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 指不吉利，令人不舒服或不愉快的话语。在粤语文化中，人们避免说这类话，尤其是在节日或重要场合。
explanation_english: Refers to unlucky, unpleasant, or uncomfortable words. In Cantonese culture, people avoid saying such words, especially during festivals or important occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年流流，唔好講埋啲晦氣說話啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 lau4 lau4, m4 hou2 gong2 maai4 di1 fui3 hei3 syut3 waa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年期间，不要说那些不吉利的话。
examples.english_sentence: It's the New Year, don't say unlucky things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲晦氣說話，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 fui3 hei3 syut3 waa6, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说一些不吉利的话，真是很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He always says unlucky things, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺醫院講啲晦氣說話，大吉利是。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ji1 jyun2 gong2 di1 fui3 hei3 syut3 waa6, daai6 gat1 lei6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在医院说不吉利的话，真是大不吉利。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say unlucky things in the hospital, it's very inauspicious.

english_meaning: discouraging words, pessimistic remarks
explanation_mandarin: 指令人感到沮丧、消极的话语。
explanation_english: Refers to words or remarks that are discouraging, pessimistic, or convey a lack of hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日講啲悔氣説話啦，積極啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 fui3 hei3 syut3 waa6 laa1, zik1 gik1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是说丧气话了，积极一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always say discouraging things, be more positive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講埋啲悔氣説話，聽都聽到灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 fui3 hei3 syut3 waa6, teng1 dou1 teng1 dou3 hui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说一些丧气话，听了都觉得灰心。
examples.english_sentence: He always says discouraging things, it's disheartening to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家唔係講悔氣説話嘅時候，要諗辦法解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 m4 hai6 gong2 fui3 hei3 syut3 waa6 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 nam2 baan2 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在不是说丧气话的时候，要想办法解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Now is not the time to say discouraging things, we need to find ways to solve the problem.

english_meaning: remorse; regret; contrition
explanation_mandarin: 表示对过去的错误或不当行为感到后悔和内疚。
explanation_english: To feel regret, remorse, or contrition about past mistakes or wrongdoings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯咗咁多嘢，而家終於感到悔疚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 gam2 dou3 fui3 gau3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多错事，现在终于感到后悔了。
examples.english_sentence: He made so many mistakes, and now he finally feels remorse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對傷害咗你感到非常悔疚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 soeng1 hoi6 zo2 nei5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 fui3 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对伤害了你感到非常懊悔。
examples.english_sentence: I feel very remorseful about hurting you.

english_meaning: to repent, to reform, to show remorse, to make amends
explanation_mandarin: 承认错误并改正。表示对过去的错误行为感到后悔，并决心改正。
explanation_english: To acknowledge one's mistakes and try to correct them. It expresses remorse for past wrongdoings and a determination to reform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯咗嘢，而家好後悔，想悔過自新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 je5, ji4 gaa1 hou2 hau6 fui3, soeng2 fui3 gwo3 zi6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错了事情，现在很后悔，想要悔过自新。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake and is now very regretful, wanting to repent and start anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過監獄嘅改造，佢決心悔過做個好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gaam1 juk6 ge3 gaai2 zou6, keoi5 kyut3 sam1 fui3 gwo3 zou6 go3 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过监狱的改造，他决心悔过做好人。
examples.english_sentence: After rehabilitation in prison, he is determined to repent and become a good person.

english_meaning: letter of repentance; written self-criticism; written confession
explanation_mandarin: 承认错误并表示悔改的书面材料。
explanation_english: A written document expressing regret and acknowledging wrongdoing, often written as a form of self-criticism or confession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細逼住寫悔過書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 bik1 zyu6 se2 fui3 gwo3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板逼着写悔过书。
examples.english_sentence: He was forced by his boss to write a letter of repentance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 犯咗錯就要勇於承擔，唔好諗住寫份悔過書就乜事都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan6 zo2 co3 zau6 jiu3 jung5 jyu1 sing4 daam1, m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 se2 fan6 fui3 gwo3 syu1 zau6 mat1 si6 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 犯了错就要勇于承担，不要想着写一份悔过书就什么事都没有了。
examples.english_sentence: If you make a mistake, you should bravely take responsibility. Don't think that writing a letter of repentance will make everything alright.

english_meaning: to disobey, to violate, to go against, contrary to
explanation_mandarin: 指违背、违反某种规定、原则或常理。
explanation_english: Refers to disobeying, violating, or acting contrary to certain rules, principles, or common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為完全悖離咗我哋嘅期望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 jyun4 cyun4 bui6 lei4 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 kei4 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为完全背离了我们的期望。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior completely went against our expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做悖住良心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 bui6 zyu6 loeng4 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做是违背良心的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this goes against one's conscience.

english_meaning: paradox
explanation_mandarin: 指一种导致矛盾或逻辑上不可接受的结论的陈述或情况。
explanation_english: A statement or situation that leads to a contradiction or a seemingly absurd conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間旅行成日都出現悖論㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 leoi5 hang4 sing4 jat1 dou1 ceot1 hin3 bui6 leon6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间旅行经常出现悖论的啦。
examples.english_sentence: Time travel often involves paradoxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個諗法本身就好似個悖論噉，好難理解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lam2 faat3 bun2 san1 zau6 hou2 ci5 go3 bui6 leon6 gam2, hou2 naan4 lei5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个想法本身就像一个悖论，很难理解。
examples.english_sentence: This idea itself is like a paradox, it's difficult to understand.

english_meaning: to frighten; to scare; to intimidate
explanation_mandarin: 用言语或行为使人感到害怕或畏惧。
explanation_english: To frighten or intimidate someone through words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日悚啲細路哥啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sung2 di1 sai3 lou6 go1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是吓唬小孩子啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always frighten the children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意悚人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 sung2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢吓唬人。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to scare people.

english_meaning: to repent; to reform; to mend one's ways
explanation_mandarin: 指改正错误，改过自新。常用于书面语。
explanation_english: To repent, to reform, to correct one's mistakes and turn over a new leaf. Commonly used in written language or formal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知錯，希望可以悛改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 co3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 syun1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道错了，希望可以悔改。
examples.english_sentence: He knows he was wrong and hopes to be able to repent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屢教不悛，真係冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 leoi5 gaau3 bat1 syun1, zan1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他屡教不改，真是没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He never mends his ways despite repeated teaching, it's truly hopeless.

english_meaning: stupid; foolish; silly
explanation_mandarin: 表示愚蠢、笨拙，头脑不灵活。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being stupid, foolish, or silly; lacking intelligence or common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁悞啦，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ng6 laa1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么傻了，这么简单的东西都不会做？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you can't even do such a simple thing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人傻悞悞咁嘅，成日都唔記得嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 so4 ng6 ng6 gam2 ge3, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人傻乎乎的，总是忘记东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's a bit silly, always forgetting things.

english_meaning: to realize, to comprehend, to understand
explanation_mandarin: 理解，领会。指通过思考或体验而明白事理。
explanation_english: To understand, comprehend, realize. It refers to understanding the principles and reasons behind something through thinking or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家終於悟到佢講緊乜嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 ng6 dou2 keoi5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在终于领悟到他在说什么了。
examples.english_sentence: I finally understand what he's talking about now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷咗咁多嘢，佢先至悟到人生嘅真諦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, keoi5 sin1 zi3 ng6 dou2 jan4 sang1 ge3 zan1 dai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历了这么多事情，他才领悟到人生的真谛。
examples.english_sentence: After experiencing so much, he finally realized the true meaning of life.

english_meaning: Comprehension, understanding, the ability to learn and understand quickly
explanation_mandarin: 指对事物理解和领悟的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability to understand and comprehend things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好醒，悟性好高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 sing2, ng6 sing3 hou2 go1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很聪明，悟性很高。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very smart person with high comprehension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學嘢好快，證明佢悟性唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3, zing3 ming4 keoi5 ng6 sing3 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学东西很快，证明他的悟性不错。
examples.english_sentence: He learns things quickly, which proves that he has a good understanding.

english_meaning: leisurely, long, protracted, drawn-out
explanation_mandarin: 形容悠闲自在，或形容时间长久。
explanation_english: Describes being leisurely and carefree, or describes something lasting a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都過得好悠閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 gwo3 dak1 hou2 jau4 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都过得很悠闲。
examples.english_sentence: He lives a very leisurely life every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事拖咗好悠久喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 to1 zo2 hou2 jau4 gau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事拖了很久了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has been dragging on for a long time.

english_meaning: long-standing; age-old; ancient
explanation_mandarin: 形容历史长远，时间久远。
explanation_english: Describing something that is long-standing, of a long history, or ancient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校歷史悠久，有成過百年㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2, jau5 sing4 gwo3 baak3 nin4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校历史悠久，已经有一百多年了。
examples.english_sentence: This school has a long history, over a hundred years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中國文化歷史悠久，博大精深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 gwok3 man4 faa3 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2, bok3 daai6 zing1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中国文化历史悠久，博大精深。
examples.english_sentence: Chinese culture has a long history and is profound.

english_meaning: leisurely, carefree, relaxed, at ease
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活悠閒自在，無憂無慮。
explanation_english: Describes a life that is leisurely, carefree, and without worries. It implies a state of being relaxed and at ease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退休之後，佢日日都悠哉游哉咁過日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 jau4 zoi1 jau4 zoi1 gam2 gwo3 jat1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退休之后，他每天都悠哉游哉地过日子。
examples.english_sentence: After retirement, he spends his days living a leisurely life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好悠哉，咩都唔擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau4 zoi1, me1 dou1 m4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很悠哉，什么都不担心。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very carefree person, doesn't worry about anything.

english_meaning: long; lingering; leisurely; carefree; unhurried
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间长久，持续不断；也形容缓慢、悠闲的样子。
explanation_english: Describes something that is long lasting or continuous; also describes a slow, leisurely, or carefree manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歲月悠悠，轉眼就過咗幾十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 jyut6 jau4 jau4, zyun2 ngaan5 zau6 gwo3 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 岁月悠悠，转眼就过去了幾十年。
examples.english_sentence: Time flies, and decades have passed in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢悠悠閒咁嘆咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 jau4 haan4 gam2 taan2 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他悠悠闲闲地品咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: He leisurely enjoyed his coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事仲悠悠地，唔使咁急嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 zung6 jau4 jau4 dei2, m4 sai2 gam3 gap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事还早着呢，不用这么着急。
examples.english_sentence: There's plenty of time for this matter; no need to rush.

english_meaning: leisurely, relaxed, carefree
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常悠闲、轻松自在的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a very leisurely, relaxed, and carefree state of being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後，每日都悠悠閒閒咁過日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3休hau6, mui5 jat6 dou1 jau4 jau4 haan4 haan4 gam2 gwo3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，每天都悠闲自在地过日子。
examples.english_sentence: After he retired, he lived a leisurely life every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日就應該悠悠閒閒咁樣過，唔好咁大壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 zau6 ying1 goi1 jau4 jau4 haan4 haan4 gam2 joeng2 gwo3, m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期天就应该悠闲地度过，不要有那么大的压力。

english_meaning: tragedy
explanation_mandarin: 指令人悲伤或不幸的事件或情况，通常带有毁灭性的结局。
explanation_english: An event or situation causing great suffering, destruction, and distress, such as a serious accident, crime, or natural catastrophe.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 bei1 kek6.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的爱情故事最后变成了一出悲剧。
examples.english_sentence: Their love story eventually turned into a tragedy.

english_meaning: sorrow; sadness; grief; lament
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常难过和伤心，常用于描述因不幸遭遇而产生的强烈负面情绪。
explanation_english: Describing a feeling of great sadness and sorrow, often used to describe strong negative emotions arising from unfortunate circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企發生咗咁大嘅事，真係好悲哀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 faat3 sang1 zo2 gam3 daai6 ge3 si6, zan1 hai6 hou2 bei1 oi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家里发生了这么大的事，真是很悲哀。
examples.english_sentence: Such a big thing happened in his family, it's truly sorrowful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到啲戰爭嘅畫面，令人覺得好悲哀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 di1 zin3 zaang1 ge3 waa6 min6, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 bei1 oi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到战争的画面，令人觉得很悲哀。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the scenes of war makes people feel very sorrowful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅經歷實在太悲哀，聽咗令人心酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ging1 lik6 sat6 zoi6 taai3 bei1 oi1, teng1 zo2 ling6 jan4 sam1 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的经历实在太悲哀，听了令人心酸。
examples.english_sentence: His experience is so sorrowful, it breaks your heart to hear it.

english_meaning: tragicomedy, tragicomedy
explanation_mandarin: 既有悲剧成分又有喜剧成分的戏剧或故事；指人生中既有欢乐又有悲伤的情况。
explanation_english: A drama or story that combines tragic and comic elements; refers to a situation in life that involves both joy and sorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲真係一齣悲喜劇，頭先我仲笑到肚痛，轉頭就喊到收唔到聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 zan1 hai6 jat1 ceot1 bei1 hei2 kek6, tau4 sin1 ngo5 zung6 siu3 dou3 tou5 tung3, zyun2 tau4 zau6 haam3 dou3 sau1 m4 dou2 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏真是一部悲喜剧，刚才我还笑得肚子疼，转眼就哭得停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: This play is really a tragicomedy, just now I was laughing so hard my stomach hurt, and in the blink of an eye I was crying uncontrollably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生就係一場悲喜劇，有高潮有低潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 zau6 hai6 jat1 coeng4 bei1 hei2 kek6, jau5 gou1 ciu4 jau5 dai1 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生就是一场悲喜剧，有高潮有低潮。
examples.english_sentence: Life is a tragicomedy, with highs and lows.

english_meaning: to lament, to sigh sadly, to grieve
explanation_mandarin: 因伤心或痛苦而叹息。
explanation_english: To express sorrow or grief by sighing or lamenting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為失戀而悲嘆咗好耐。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为失恋而悲叹了很久。
examples.english_sentence: He lamented for a long time because of a broken heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到個壞消息之後，佢忍唔住悲嘆一聲。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到那个坏消息后，他忍不住悲叹一声。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the bad news, he couldn't help but let out a sigh of grief.

english_meaning: tragic and heroic; heroic and moving
explanation_mandarin: 形容场面、行为等既悲哀又壮烈，令人感动。
explanation_english: Describes a scene, action, etc., that is both tragic and heroic, moving people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅犧牲真係好悲壯，令我哋好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hei1 saang1 zan1 hai6 hou2 bei1 zong3, ling6 ngo5 dei6 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的牺牲真是很悲壮，让我们很感动。
examples.english_sentence: Their sacrifice was truly tragic and heroic, moving us deeply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔講述一個好悲壯嘅英雄故事。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事讲述一个很悲壮的英雄故事。
examples.english_sentence: This story tells a very tragic and heroic tale of a hero.

english_meaning: to have compassion for humanity; to be deeply concerned about the suffering of the world
explanation_mandarin: 形容对社会黑暗和人民疾苦感到悲痛和怜悯。
explanation_english: Describes feeling sorrow and compassion for the darkness of society and the suffering of the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁悲天憫人，成日都諗住點樣幫助啲窮人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 bei1 tin1 man5 yan4, seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 yeung2 bong1 zo6 di1 kung4 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他如此悲天悯人，总是想着怎样帮助穷人。
examples.english_sentence: He is so compassionate, always thinking about how to help the poor.

synonyms: 宅心仁厚 (zaak6 sam1 yan4 hau5)

english_meaning: melodramatic; pathetic; tragic; sentimental; victim complex
explanation_mandarin: 形容一种沉溺于悲伤情绪的状态，常带有自我怜悯或夸张的成分。也指带有悲剧色彩的情感或事件。
explanation_english: Describing a state of being immersed in sadness, often with self-pity or exaggeration. It can also refer to emotions or events with tragic overtones. It often implies a melodramatic or exaggerated sense of victimhood.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是摆出一副悲情的样子，好像全世界都欠了他的。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on a melodramatic face, as if the whole world owes him something.

examples.english_sentence: This movie tells a tragic love story.

english_meaning: miserable, tragic, wretched

examples.english_sentence: His experience is really tragic.

examples.english_sentence: The ending of this movie is so tragic that it made me cry.

english_meaning: joys and sorrows of life; vicissitudes of life; partings and reunions

explanation_english: Refers to the various experiences in life, including sadness, joy, separation, and reunion. It describes a life full of rich and varied experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生就係悲歡離合，冇辦法預測。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 zau6 hai6 bei1 fun1 lei4 hap6, mou5 baan6 faat3 jyu6 cak1.

examples.english_sentence: This movie is about the joys and sorrows of a family.

explanation_mandarin: 对事物的发展趋势持有消极、失望的看法。
explanation_english: Having a negative or pessimistic outlook on things; a tendency to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度好悲觀，成日都覺得唔會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 bei1 gun1, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 wui5 sing4 gung1.

examples.english_sentence: His attitude is very pessimistic; he always thinks he won't succeed.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pessimistic, try to think about good things.

english_meaning: bitterly sad; melancholic
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情悲伤，带有酸楚的味道。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of sadness tinged with bitterness and melancholy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講起佢嘅經歷，真係令人覺得好悲酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 hei2 keoi5 ge3 ging1 lik6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 bei1 syun1.

explanation_mandarin: 形容人因为忧愁、劳累等原因而精神不振，面容憔悴。
explanation_english: Describes a person who looks tired, pale, and unhealthy due to worry, fatigue, or illness.

explanation_english: Describes a feeling of disappointment and frustration due to something not going as planned or hoped for; feeling a sense of loss or melancholy.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他回忆起以前的时光，觉得有些惆怅。
examples.english_sentence: He recalled the old times and felt a little melancholic.

english_meaning: melancholy; disconsolate; regretful; a sense of loss and disappointment
explanation_mandarin: 形容因失意或不如意而感到不快和惆悵。
explanation_english: Describing a feeling of unhappiness and melancholy due to disappointment or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考唔到大學，覺得好悵惘。

examples.english_sentence: He didn't get into university and feels very melancholy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 回憶起以前嘅美好時光，總會令人感到一絲悵惘。

examples.english_sentence: Recalling good old times always makes one feel a slight sense of melancholy.

english_meaning: feeling a sense of loss and disappointment; feeling lost and empty
explanation_mandarin: 形容因失去而感到失落、空虚的样子。通常指失去重要的人、事物或希望后，内心产生的失落感。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of loss, emptiness, and disappointment after losing something important, such as a person, an object, or a hope.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毕业之后，离开了校园，有点怅然若失的样子。

explanation_english: An idiom meaning that when someone is in love, they perceive their lover as beautiful and perfect, regardless of objective standards of beauty. It suggests that love can make someone see their partner in an idealized way, even if others may not see them as attractive or desirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明個樣都唔係好靚啫，但佢男朋友就覺得佢好似西施咁，真係情人眼裏出西施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 go3 joeng2 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 leng3 ze1, daan6 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 zau6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 sai1 si1 gam3, zan1 hai6 cing4 yan4 ngaan5 leoi5 ceot1 sai1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她明明长得不是很漂亮，但是她的男朋友觉得她像西施一样，真是情人眼里出西施。
examples.english_sentence: She's obviously not very beautiful, but her boyfriend thinks she's like Xi Shi, truly beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強成日話佢女朋友係全世界最靚嘅，可能真係情人眼裏出西施啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 keung4 sing4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 hai6 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 zeoi3 leng3 ge3, ho2 nang4 zan1 hai6 cing4 yan4 ngaan5 leoi5 ceot1 sai1 si1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强总是说他的女朋友是世界上最漂亮的，可能真是情人眼里出西施吧。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung always says his girlfriend is the most beautiful in the world, maybe it's really beauty in the eye of the beholder.

jyutping: cing4 jan4 ngaan5 leoi5 ceot1 sai1 si1
english_meaning: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder
explanation_mandarin: 意思是说在恋人眼中，对方是非常美丽的，即使在外人看来并不漂亮。形容爱情使人盲目，情人之间相互欣赏。
explanation_english: This idiom means that in the eyes of a lover, their partner is beautiful, even if they may not be considered attractive by others. It describes how love can be blinding and how lovers appreciate each other's qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得條仔好靚仔，真係情人眼裡出西施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 tiu4 zai2 hou2 leng3 zai2, zan1 hai6 cing4 jan4 ngaan5 leoi5 ceot1 sai1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她觉得那个男生很帅，真是情人眼里出西施。
examples.english_sentence: She thinks that guy is really handsome. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇阿明女朋友咁普通，但係佢就覺得佢好靚，咪即係情人眼裡出西施囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 aa3 ming4 neoi5 pang4 jau5 gam3 pou2 tung1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zau6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 leng3, mai1 zik1 hai6 cing4 jan4 ngaan5 leoi5 ceot1 sai1 si1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看阿明的女朋友很普通，但是他就觉得她很漂亮，不就是情人眼里出西施吗？
examples.english_sentence: Look, Ah Ming's girlfriend is so ordinary, but he thinks she's really beautiful. Isn't that beauty in the eye of the beholder?

english_meaning: Valentine's Day
explanation_mandarin: 庆祝情侣之间爱情的节日，通常在每年的2月14日。
explanation_english: A day for celebrating romantic love between couples, typically observed on February 14th each year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年情人節你諗住點樣慶祝啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 cing4 jan4 zit3 nei5 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng6 hing3 zuk1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年情人节你打算怎么庆祝啊？
examples.english_sentence: How are you planning to celebrate Valentine's Day this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情人節送花好浪漫啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 jan4 zit3 sung3 faa1 hou2 long5 maan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情人节送花好浪漫啊！
examples.english_sentence: Giving flowers on Valentine's Day is so romantic!

english_meaning: Affection; sentimental ties; bond of affection; consideration based on past relations
explanation_mandarin: 人与人之间因感情而产生的关系和情意。也指看在交情上给予的照顾或方便。
explanation_english: Affection or sentimental ties between people, often built on shared experiences or history. It can also refer to the consideration or leniency given to someone based on an existing relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋識咗咁耐，都有一啲情份喺度嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik1 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 jau5 jat1 dik1 cing4 fan6 hai2 dou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们认识这么久了，总归还是有些情分的。
examples.english_sentence: We've known each other for so long, there's bound to be some bond of affection between us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇喺以前嘅情份上，我咪幫你呢次囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hai2 ji5 cin4 ge3 cing4 fan6 soeng6, ngo5 mai1 bong1 nei5 ni1 ci3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看在以前的情分上，我就帮你这一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of our past relationship, I'll help you out this one time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算冇晒愛情，都有啲情份喺度嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 mou5 saai3 oi3 cing4, dou1 jau5 di1 cing4 fan6 hai2 dou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算没有了爱情，总归还是有些情分在的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if there's no more love, there's still some sentimental ties between us.

english_meaning: How can one bear it?
explanation_mandarin: 指感情或处境到了难以忍受的地步，不知道该如何是好。表示承受了巨大的打击或委屈，不知如何应对。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or feeling that is unbearable, leaving one at a loss. It indicates that someone has suffered a huge blow or been deeply wronged and doesn't know how to cope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾人咁樣屈法，真係情何以堪呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jan4 gam2 joeng2 wat1 faat3, zan1 hai6 cing4 ho4 ji5 ham1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被别人这样冤枉，真是情何以堪啊！
examples.english_sentence: Being framed like this, how can I bear it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁努力準備考試，點知最後都係肥佬，真係情何以堪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 nu5 lik6 zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 fei4 lou2, zan1 hai6 cing4 ho4 ji5 ham1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么努力准备考试，谁知最后还是没及格，真是情何以堪。
examples.english_sentence: He prepared for the exam so diligently, but failed in the end, how can he bear it?

english_meaning: couple (romantic relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 指恋爱中的两个人。
explanation_english: Refers to two people who are in a romantic relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一對好sweet嘅情侶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 deoi3 hou2 sweet ge3 cing4 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一对很甜蜜的情侣。
examples.english_sentence: They are a very sweet couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳成日都逼滿晒啲情侶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 sing4 jat6 dou1 bik1 mun5 saai3 di1 cing4 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅总是挤满了情侣。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is always packed with couples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱先至開始做情侶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aam1 aam1 sin1 zi3 hoi1 chi2 zou6 cing4 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们才刚开始成为情侣。
examples.english_sentence: They just recently started dating.

english_meaning: matching outfits for couples
explanation_mandarin: 指情侣穿着相似或者风格统一的服装，以显示彼此的关系。
explanation_english: Matching outfits worn by couples to show their relationship. These outfits are usually similar in style or design.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日着情侶裝出街，好sweet呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 zoek3 cing4 leoi5 zong1 ceot1 gaai1, hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常穿着情侣装出门，好甜蜜啊！
examples.english_sentence: They often wear matching outfits when they go out, it's so sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同男朋友想買套情侶裝去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 naam4 pang4 jau5 soeng2 maai5 tou3 cing4 leoi5 zong1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想和男朋友买一套情侣装去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a matching outfit with my boyfriend to go on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋件情侶裝幾襯呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gin6 cing4 leoi5 zong1 gei2 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们的情侣装很搭配啊！
examples.english_sentence: Your matching outfits are very coordinated!

english_meaning: love letter
explanation_mandarin: 表达爱慕之情的信件。
explanation_english: A letter expressing romantic love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我後生嗰陣成日寫情信俾我女朋友㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 se2 cing4 seon3 bei2 ngo5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我年轻的时候经常写情书给我的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I used to write love letters to my girlfriend a lot when I was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到好多封情信，真係好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 fung1 cing4 seon3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她收到了很多封情书，真的很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: She received many love letters, she's really popular.

english_meaning: heartbreak, emotional wound (from a romantic relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 感情上的伤害，通常指恋爱失败或分手带来的痛苦。
explanation_english: Emotional wound or pain caused by a failed romantic relationship, such as a breakup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱失戀，仲未走出情傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sat1 lyun2, zung6 mei6 zau2 ceot1 cing4 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她刚刚失恋，还没走出情伤。
examples.english_sentence: She just had a breakup and hasn't recovered from the heartbreak yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間可以沖淡一切，但係情傷嘅痛楚需要時間慢慢復原。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 ho2 ji5 cung1 daam6 jat1 cai3, daan6 hai6 cing4 soeng1 ge3 tung3 co2 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 maan6 maan6 fuk1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间可以冲淡一切，但是情伤的痛楚需要时间慢慢复原。
examples.english_sentence: Time can heal everything, but the pain of heartbreak needs time to slowly recover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借酒消愁，想忘記情傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze3 zau2 siu1 sau4, soeng2 mong4 gei3 cing4 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天借酒消愁，想忘记情伤。
examples.english_sentence: He drowns his sorrows in alcohol, trying to forget the heartbreak.

mandarin_meaning: 情谊, 情面, 人情
english_meaning: affection, sentiment, emotional bond, personal connection, goodwill, favor
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间的感情关系，情谊，人情。可以是好的感情，也可以是指对方顾念情面而给予的照顾或优待。
explanation_english: Refers to the emotional relationship, affection, or sentiment between people. It can refer to positive feelings, or the consideration and preferential treatment given due to a personal connection or favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋咁多年嘅朋友，總有啲情分㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 pang4 jau5, zung2 jau5 di1 cing4 fan6 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这么多年的朋友，总有一些情谊的嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We've been friends for so many years, there's got to be some affection between us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇喺我哋嘅情分上，你就幫吓佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 cing4 fan6 soeng6, nei5 zau6 bong1 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看在我们情谊上，你就帮帮他吧。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of our relationship, please help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔俾啲情分，真係冇人情味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 bei2 di1 cing4 fan6, zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 cing4 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都不给一点情面，真是没有人情味。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't show any consideration, he's really devoid of human touch.

english_meaning: When love reaches its peak; When love is at its most intense
explanation_mandarin: 形容感情发展到非常浓烈，非常投入的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state when love and affection have developed to a very intense and passionate level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情到濃時，佢哋決定結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 dou3 nung4 si4, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情到深处，他们决定结婚。
examples.english_sentence: When love reached its peak, they decided to get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲講述男女主角情到濃時嘅浪漫故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 gong2 syut6 naam4 neoi5 zyu2 gok3 cing4 dou3 nung4 si4 ge3 long6 maan6 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述了男女主角情到深处的浪漫故事。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the romantic story of the male and female leads when their love reached its peak.

english_meaning: situation; circumstances; state of affairs; trend
explanation_mandarin: 指一定时期内的情况和发展趋势。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of affairs and development trends within a certain period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅情勢對我哋好唔利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 cing4 sai3 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 m4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的形势对我们很不利。
examples.english_sentence: The current situation is very unfavorable to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇下個情勢點樣先決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 haa5 go3 cing4 sai3 dim2 joeng2 sin1 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看看形势怎么样再决定吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's see how the situation develops before making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要密切留意事態嘅發展情勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 mat6 chit3 lau4 yi3 si6 taai3 ge3 faat3 zin2 cing4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要密切留意事态的发展形势。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pay close attention to the development of the situation.

english_meaning: to have a bond of brotherhood; as close as brothers; to feel as close as siblings
explanation_mandarin: 形容感情深厚，像亲兄弟一样。
explanation_english: Describes a very close relationship between people, like that of siblings or brothers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋自細一齊長大，情同手足咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi6 sai3 jat1 cai4 zoeng2 daai6, cing4 tung4 sau2 zuk1 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们从小一起长大，情同手足一样。
examples.english_sentence: They grew up together since they were young, and they are as close as brothers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢哋唔係親兄弟，但係感情情同手足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 m4 hai6 can1 hing1 dai6, daan6 hai6 gam2 cing4 cing4 tung4 sau2 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他们不是亲兄弟，但是感情情同手足。
examples.english_sentence: Although they are not biological brothers, their relationship is like that of real siblings.

english_meaning: emotional intelligence (EQ)
explanation_mandarin: 指情绪商数，是指一个人识别、评估、控制和利用自身情感以及识别、评估他人情感的能力。
explanation_english: Emotional quotient (EQ), refers to the ability of a person to recognize, assess, control, and utilize their own emotions, as well as the ability to recognize and assess the emotions of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢情商好高，所以人緣好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cing4 soeng1 hou2 gou1, so2 ji5 jan4 jyun4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他情商很高，所以人缘很好。
examples.english_sentence: He has high emotional intelligence, so he is very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺職場上，情商同智商一樣咁重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6, cing4 soeng1 tung4 zi3 soeng1 jat1 joeng6 gam3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在职场上，情商和智商一样重要。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace, emotional intelligence is as important as IQ.

english_meaning: information, intelligence
explanation_mandarin: 关于某事物的消息或资料，尤指秘密或敏感的信息。
explanation_english: Information or intelligence, especially secret or sensitive information, about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到情報話佢哋今晚會採取行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou3 cing4 bou3 waa6 keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan1 wui5 coi2 ceoi3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到情报说他们今晚会采取行动。
examples.english_sentence: We received intelligence that they will take action tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方依據情報成功破獲咗一個販毒集團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 yi1 geoi3 cing4 bou3 sing4 gung1 po3 wok6 zo2 jat1 go3 faan3 duk6 zaap6 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方根据情报成功捣毁了一个贩毒集团。
examples.english_sentence: Based on the intelligence, the police successfully cracked down on a drug trafficking group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間諜嘅工作係收集情報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 dip6 ge3 gung1 zok3 hai6 sau1 zaap6 cing4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 间谍的工作是收集情报。
examples.english_sentence: A spy's job is to gather intelligence.

english_meaning: the arena of love; the battlefield of love; romantic relationships
explanation_mandarin: 指感情的场所，通常用来形容恋爱关系中的竞争和挑战。可以指现实中的恋爱过程，也可以指一种比喻，表示感情世界中的复杂情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the 'arena' or 'battlefield' of love and romantic relationships, often implying competition, challenges, and complexities involved in finding and maintaining love. It can refer to the real process of dating and relationships or be used metaphorically to describe the complex situations in the emotional world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺情場上面好失意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cing4 coeng4 soeng6 min6 hou2 sat1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在情场上很失意。
examples.english_sentence: He is very unlucky in love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情場如戰場，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 coeng4 jyu4 zin3 coeng4, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情场如战场，要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The arena of love is like a battlefield, so be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個情場高手，好多人鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 cing4 coeng4 gou1 sau2, hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个情场高手，很多人喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a love expert; many people like him.

english_meaning: situation; context; scenario
explanation_mandarin: 指特定的环境、情况、处境或背景。
explanation_english: Refers to a specific environment, situation, circumstance, or context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺唔同嘅情境之下，我哋嘅反應都會唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 cing4 ging2 zi1 haa6, ngo5 dei6 ge3 faan2 ying3 dou1 wui5 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在不同的情境下，我们的反应都会不同。
examples.english_sentence: In different situations, our reactions will be different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你了解晒成個情境，先至可以做一個明智嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 liu2 gaai2 saai3 sing4 go3 cing4 ging2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 zou6 jat1 go3 ming4 zai3 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你了解清楚整个情境，才可以做一个明智的决定。
examples.english_sentence: You need to understand the whole situation clearly before you can make a wise decision.

english_meaning: lover (male), paramour, illicit lover
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚妇女的非婚姻关系中的男性伴侣。
explanation_english: Refers to a male partner in a non-marital relationship with a married woman. Implies an illicit or adulterous relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老婆發現佢有個情夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 po2 faat3 hin1 keoi5 jau5 go3 cing4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老婆发现他有个情夫。
examples.english_sentence: His wife discovered that he had a lover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條八婆養咗個後生嘅情夫，日日去嘆世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 baat3 po4 joeng5 zo2 go3 hau6 saang1 ge3 cing4 fu1, jat1 jat1 heoi3 taan3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个女人包养了一个年轻的情夫，每天去享受生活。
examples.english_sentence: That woman is keeping a young lover and enjoys life every day.

english_meaning: in a moment of desperation, in a desperate situation, under pressure, in a rush

explanation_english: Indicates that someone takes a certain action in an emergency or critical situation due to the urgency of the situation.

english_meaning: lovey-dovey; being overly affectionate in public
explanation_mandarin: 形容情侣之间非常亲昵，过分展示他们的爱意，有时带有负面含义，觉得他们过于做作。
explanation_english: Describes a couple being very affectionate and demonstrative with their love, often in a way that is considered excessive or cloying. Can carry a negative connotation, suggesting the display is artificial or contrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺公園度情情塔塔，真係睇見都覺得尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 cing4 cing4 taap3 taap3, zan1 hai6 tai2 gin3 dou1 gok3 dak1 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在公园里卿卿我我，看得我都觉得尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: Those two were being so lovey-dovey in the park, it was embarrassing to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意佢哋成日喺Facebook度放閃，情情塔塔咁。

english_meaning: affection; feelings; sentiment; goodwill
explanation_mandarin: 指感情和心意，多指爱慕之情或友好的情谊。
explanation_english: Refers to feelings and intentions, often referring to feelings of love or friendly affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我嘅情意，我一直都知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 cing4 ji3, ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我的情意，我一直都知道。
examples.english_sentence: I've always known about his feelings for me.
