explanation_english: Refers to something of a malignant or vicious nature that leads to negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個惡性腫瘤擴散得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ok3 sing3 zung2 lau4 kwong3 saan3 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的恶性肿瘤扩散得很快。
examples.english_sentence: His malignant tumor is spreading very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種惡性競爭對大家嚟講都冇好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 ok3 sing3 ging6 zang1 deoi3 daai6 gaa1 lai4 gong2 dou1 mou5 hou2 chu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种恶性竞争对大家来说都没有好处。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of vicious competition benefits no one.

english_meaning: vicious cycle
explanation_mandarin: 指一种情况或过程，坏的结果导致更坏的结果，形成一个不断恶化的循环。
explanation_english: A situation or process in which a bad result leads to an even worse result, creating a continuously deteriorating cycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失業搞到冇錢，冇錢又搞到壓力大，壓力大又更加難搵到工，真係惡性循環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 jip6 gaau2 dou3 mou5 cin2, mou5 cin2 jau6 gaau2 dou3 aat3 lik6 daai6, aat3 lik6 daai6 jau6 gang3 gaa1 naan4 wan2 dou3 gung1, zan1 hai6 ok3 sing3 ceon4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失业导致没钱，没钱又导致压力大，压力大又更难找到工作，真是恶性循环。
examples.english_sentence: Losing my job leads to having no money, having no money leads to high stress, and high stress makes it even harder to find a job. It's a vicious cycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅賭癮搞到佢借咗好多錢，借錢還唔到又逼住要再賭，根本就係惡性循環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 dou2 jan5 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 ze3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, ze3 cin2 waan4 m4 dou2 jau6 bik1 zyu6 jiu3 zoi3 dou2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 ok3 sing3 ceon4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的赌瘾导致他借了很多钱，借钱还不上又被迫要再赌，根本就是恶性循环。
examples.english_sentence: His gambling addiction caused him to borrow a lot of money. Not being able to repay the loan forces him to gamble again. It's basically a vicious cycle.

english_meaning: malice, ill will, evil intentions
explanation_mandarin: 指不良的意图或企图，通常涉及伤害他人。
explanation_english: Refers to bad intentions or attempts, usually involving harming others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做明顯係有惡意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 ming5 hin2 hai6 jau5 ok3 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做明显是有恶意的。
examples.english_sentence: It's obvious that he did that with malice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔認為佢哋有惡意，可能只係誤會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 jing6 wai4 keoi5 dei6 jau5 ok3 ji3, ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 ng6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不认为他们有恶意，可能只是误会。
examples.english_sentence: I don't think they had any malice, it might just be a misunderstanding.

english_meaning: fierce-looking; menacing; appearing angry or aggressive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或动物外表看起来很凶狠、不易接近的样子。指外貌上給人一種很不友善、充滿敵意的感覺。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that looks fierce, unfriendly, or intimidating. It implies a menacing appearance and suggests that the person or animal is likely to be angry or aggressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣惡揗揗咁，好似想打交噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 ok3 tan4 tan4 gam2, hou2 ci5 soeng2 daa2 gaau1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来凶巴巴的，好像要打架一样。
examples.english_sentence: He looks fierce, like he wants to fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗惡揗揗咁吠我，我嚇到唔敢行埋去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 ok3 tan4 tan4 gam2 fai6 ngo5, ngo5 haak3 dou3 m4 gam2 haang4 maai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗凶巴巴地对着我叫，我吓得不敢走近。
examples.english_sentence: The dog barked at me fiercely, I was so scared that I didn't dare to approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭啲伙記個個都惡揗揗，唔怪得冇乜人幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 di1 fo2 gei2 go3 go3 dou1 ok3 tan4 tan4, m4 gwaai3 dak1 mou5 mat1 jan4 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的店员个个看起来都凶巴巴的，难怪没什么人光顾。
examples.english_sentence: The shop assistants in this store all look fierce, no wonder there aren't many customers.

english_meaning: spoof, parody, prank, to satirize, to create a humorous or irreverent version
explanation_mandarin: 指以戏谑、调侃、模仿等方式，对某事物进行改编、歪曲或恶作剧，达到娱乐效果。通常带有讽刺或解构意味。
explanation_english: Refers to creating a humorous, irreverent, or satirical version of something through parody, spoofing, or prankish alterations. It often involves subverting the original meaning or intention for comedic effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日惡搞啲新聞片段，真係好搞笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 ok3 gaau2 di1 san1 man4 pin3 dyun6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gau2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常恶搞新闻片段，真的很好笑。
examples.english_sentence: They often create parodies of news clips, it's really funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個惡搞嘅廣告喺網上好hit。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ok3 gaau2 ge3 gwong2 gou3 hai2 mong5 soeng6 hou2 hit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个恶搞的广告在网上很火。
examples.english_sentence: This spoof advertisement is very popular online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惡搞人哋啦，會傷害人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 gaau2 jan4 dei6 laa1, wui5 soeng1 hoi6 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么恶搞别人了，会伤害人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make fun of other people like that, it can be hurtful.

synonyms: 二次創作 (ji6 ci3 cong3 zok3)

english_meaning: extremely fierce; very aggressive; turning nasty
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人變得非常凶惡，態度惡劣，行為不友善，甚至帶有攻擊性。
explanation_english: Describes someone who becomes extremely fierce, aggressive, nasty, and unfriendly in attitude and behaviour. It can also imply that someone is acting unreasonably or being a bully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一飲醉酒就惡晒，周圍鬧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zau6 ok3 saai3, zau1 wai4 nau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝醉酒就变得非常凶恶，到处骂人。
examples.english_sentence: He turns extremely nasty when he gets drunk and starts yelling at people everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔知做乜咁惡晒，好似食咗火藥咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 zou6 mat1 gam2 ok3 saai3, hou2 ci5 sik6 zo2 fo2 joek6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不知道怎么了，变得这么凶，好像吃了火药一样。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what's wrong with him today, he's so aggressive, like he's eaten gunpowder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁惡晒啦，有咩事慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 ok3 saai3 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 maan6 maan2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么凶嘛，有什么事慢慢说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so aggressive, talk about things slowly.

english_meaning: evil will be requited with evil; you reap what you sow; what goes around comes around
explanation_mandarin: 指做了坏事的人最终会得到相应的惩罚。强调因果报应的道理。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the belief that evil deeds will eventually be punished. It emphasizes the concept of karmic retribution, suggesting that negative actions will inevitably lead to negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日蝦啲弱者，真係惡有惡報，而家終於俾人告上法庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haa1 di1 joek6 ze2, zan1 hai6 ok3 jau5 ok3 bou3, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 bei2 jan4 gou3 soeng5 faat3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是欺负弱者，真是恶有恶报，现在终于被人告上法庭。
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies the weak, it's truly a case of evil will be requited with evil, now he's finally been sued in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣呃人錢，遲早惡有惡報㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 aak1 jan4 cin2, ci4 zou2 ok3 jau5 ok3 bou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样骗人钱，迟早恶有恶报的。
examples.english_sentence: If you cheat people out of money like this, sooner or later you'll reap what you sow.

english_meaning: bitter fruit, dire consequences, bad outcome
explanation_mandarin: 比喻坏的结果，不良的后果。
explanation_english: A metaphor for bad results or negative consequences resulting from an action or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之前貪污，而家終於食返惡果喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 cin4 taam1 wu1, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 sik6 faan1 ok3 gwo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之前贪污，现在终于尝到恶果了。
examples.english_sentence: They were corrupt before, and now they are finally facing the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔努力讀書，第時就會自食惡果㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, dai6 si4 zau6 wui5 zi6 sik6 ok3 gwo2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不努力读书，将来就会自食恶果的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't study hard, you will face the consequences later.

english_meaning: thug, hooligan, ruffian, scoundrel
explanation_mandarin: 指行为恶劣、品质败坏的人，常使用暴力或欺诈手段为非作歹。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with a bad character and terrible behavior, often using violence or fraud to commit wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺條街度搞事，真係一班惡棍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 gaau2 si6, zan1 hai6 jat1 baan1 ok3 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天在街上闹事，真是一群恶棍。
examples.english_sentence: They are always causing trouble on the street, they're really a bunch of thugs.

english_meaning: fierce; ferocious; stern; strict; harsh
explanation_mandarin: 形容人态度凶狠、非常严厉，让人感到害怕。
explanation_english: Describes a person's attitude as fierce, extremely strict, and intimidating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老細惡死到呢，成日鬧人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 sai3 ok3 sei2 dou3 ni1, seng4 jat6 naau6 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个老板真凶，整天骂人！
examples.english_sentence: This boss is so fierce, he scolds people all the time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好惡死，唔敢行埋去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 ok3 sei2, m4 gam2 haang4 maai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来很凶，不敢走过去。
examples.english_sentence: He looks so fierce, I don't dare to approach him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽惡死起身鬧我，話我咁晏都唔起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 ok3 sei2 hei2 san1 naau6 ngo5, waa6 ngo5 gam3 aan3 dou1 m4 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很凶地起来骂我，说我这么晚了还不起床。
examples.english_sentence: My mother fiercely woke up and scolded me, saying I hadn't gotten up even this late.

english_meaning: to glare menacingly; to give someone a fierce, angry look
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常凶恶地瞪着眼睛，表达愤怒或威胁之情。
explanation_english: Describes someone glaring with a fierce and intimidating expression, expressing anger or making a threat. It implies a very aggressive and unfriendly look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再嘈啦，唔係我惡死睖瞪對住你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 cou4 laa1, m4 hai6 ngo5 ok3 sei2 ling1 daang3 deoi3 zyu6 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再吵了，不然我就要狠狠地瞪着你了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't make any more noise, or I'll glare at you fiercely!

examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 ok3 sei2 ling1 daang3, gaau2 dou3 di1 fo2 gei3 dou1 hou2 geng1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是凶狠地瞪着眼睛，搞得那些伙计都很怕他。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always glaring menacingly, which makes all the employees scared of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢惡死睖瞪咁望住我，我即刻唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ok3 sei2 ling1 daang3 gam2 mong5 zyu6 ngo5, ngo5 zik1 hak1 m4 gam2 chut1 seng1.

examples.english_sentence: He glared at me fiercely, and I immediately didn't dare to say a word.

english_meaning: fierce and overbearing; aggressive and domineering
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常凶恶、霸道，态度强硬，令人难以接近。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely fierce, domineering, and aggressive in their attitude, making them unapproachable and intimidating.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 ok3 sei2 nang4 deng1, bin1 go3 dou1 m4 gam2 jo2 keoi5.

examples.english_sentence: He is so fierce and overbearing that no one dares to offend him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老闆惡死能登，啲員工個個都做到戰戰兢兢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 baan2 ok3 sei2 nang4 deng1, di1 jyun4 gung1 go3 go3 dou1 zou6 dou3 zin3 zin3 ging1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板凶狠霸道，员工们都做得战战兢兢。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is fierce and domineering, so all the employees work with fear and trepidation.

english_meaning: vicious, malicious, venomous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人心肠狠毒，行为恶劣。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose heart is cruel and whose behavior is atrocious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅說話好惡毒，成日中傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 syut3 waa6 hou2 ok3 duk6, seng4 jat6 zung1 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的话很恶毒，总是中伤别人。

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 duk6 laa1, deoi3 jan4 hou2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么恶毒了，对人好一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so vicious, be kinder to people.

english_meaning: bad law; unjust law; oppressive law
explanation_mandarin: 指不公正、不合理的法律或规定，对民众不利的法律。
explanation_english: Refers to laws or regulations that are unjust, unreasonable, and detrimental to the people; an oppressive law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條惡法限制咗我哋嘅自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 ok3 faat3 haan6 zai3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zi6 jau4.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都唔滿意呢條惡法，所以就上街示威。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都不满意这条恶法，所以就上街示威。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone is dissatisfied with this bad law, so they went to the streets to protest.

english_meaning: Bully; Despot; Tyrant; someone who is aggressive and unreasonable
explanation_mandarin: 指仗势欺人、蛮横无理的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who abuses their power, is aggressive, unreasonable, and bullies others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日恰啲細路仔，真係一個惡爺。

examples.english_sentence: He always bullies the kids, he's such a bully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做惡爺，要尊重人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 ok3 je4, jiu3 zyun1 zung6 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做恶霸，要尊重别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a bully, respect others.

english_meaning: Bully, domineering person, tyrant (often used to describe someone who is unreasonable and forceful)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人性情凶恶，经常欺负他人，蛮横不讲理。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is fierce and often bullies others, being unreasonable and domineering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明係個惡爺頭，成日恰啲細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 go3 ok3 je4 tau4, seng4 jat6 hap1 di1 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆明是个恶霸，总是欺负小孩。
examples.english_sentence: He's clearly a bully, always picking on the kids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惡爺頭啦，講道理好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 je4 tau4 laa1, gong2 dou6 lei5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么霸道，讲道理比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a bully, it's better to reason things out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做惡爺頭呀，唔係冇人同你玩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 ok3 je4 tau4 aa3, m4 hai6 mou5 jan4 tung4 nei5 waan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别当恶霸啊，不然没人跟你玩了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a bully, or no one will play with you.

english_meaning: malignant disease; serious illness; intractable disease
explanation_mandarin: 指难以治疗的严重疾病，通常指恶性肿瘤或传染性强的疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to a serious and difficult-to-treat illness, usually a malignant tumor or a highly contagious disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不幸染上咗惡疾，要長期接受治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 hang6 jim5 soeng5 zo2 ok3 zat6, jiu3 coeng4 kei4 zip3 sau6 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不幸染上了恶疾，需要长期接受治疗。
examples.english_sentence: He unfortunately contracted a serious illness and needs long-term treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 預防勝於治療，及早檢查可以避免患上惡疾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 fong4 sing3 jyu1 zi6 liu4, kap6 zou2 gim2 caa4 ho2 ji5 bei6 min5 waan6 soeng5 ok3 zat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 预防胜于治疗，及早检查可以避免患上恶性疾病。
examples.english_sentence: Prevention is better than cure. Early check-ups can help prevent malignant diseases.

english_meaning: to be a heavy sleeper; to sleep soundly; to be hard to wake up; to be a sound sleeper
explanation_mandarin: 形容人睡觉很沉，不容易醒来。
explanation_english: Describes someone who sleeps very soundly and is difficult to wake up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好惡瞓㗎，打雷都唔醒嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ok3 fan3 gaa3, daa2 leoi4 dou1 m4 sing2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很贪睡，打雷都醒不来。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very heavy sleeper; he doesn't wake up even when it's thundering.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 maan1 taai3 gui6 laa3, ok3 fan3 dou3 naau6 zung1 dou1 ting1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚太累了，睡得很沉，闹钟都听不到。
examples.english_sentence: I was too tired last night and slept so soundly that I couldn't even hear the alarm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我阿媽成日話我好惡瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 hou2 ok3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我妈妈总是说我睡得很沉。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, my mom always said that I was a very sound sleeper.

english_meaning: bad habit, vice
explanation_mandarin: 不良的习惯；坏习惯。

examples.english_sentence: Gambling is a bad habit, it's very hard to quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好多惡習，成日講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 ok3 zaap6, seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很多恶习，整天说谎。
examples.english_sentence: He has many bad habits, always telling lies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友要避免染上惡習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 jiu3 bei6 min5 jim5 soeng5 ok3 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友要避免沾染上恶习。
examples.english_sentence: Children should avoid developing bad habits.

english_meaning: bad news; sad news; calamity
explanation_mandarin: 坏消息；令人悲痛的消息。
explanation_english: A piece of bad news; tragic or devastating news.

examples.english_sentence: He received the bad news of his family member's passing and immediately burst into tears.

examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou2 keoi5 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 gwo3 san1 ge3 ok3 hou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚我们收到了他交通事故去世的噩耗。
examples.english_sentence: Last night, we received the bad news that he passed away in a traffic accident.

english_meaning: foul smell; stench
explanation_mandarin: 难闻的气味，令人厌恶的味道。
explanation_english: A very unpleasant and offensive smell; a stench.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 垃圾房传来阵阵恶臭，真是受不了。
examples.english_sentence: The garbage room is emitting waves of foul odor, I really can't stand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公廁臭到有陣惡臭，我唔敢入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cai3 cau3 dou3 jau5 zan6 ok3 cau3, ngo5 m4 gam2 jap6 heoi3.

examples.english_sentence: This public toilet smells so bad it has a foul odor, I don't dare to go in.

english_meaning: evil deed; misdeed; crime; wickedness
explanation_mandarin: 指邪恶的行为、罪行。
explanation_english: Refers to evil acts or crimes.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ok3 hang4 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的恶行最终都被人揭发了。
examples.english_sentence: His evil deeds were eventually exposed.

english_meaning: to cram (for an exam); to swot up
explanation_mandarin: 指在短时间内，为了应付考试或某种需要而临时突击学习。
explanation_english: To cram intensely and at the last minute, typically for an exam or other important event. It implies a desperate attempt to catch up on material that should have been learned earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試啦，我要惡補一下先得。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试了，我要恶补一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, I need to cram for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日先知有測驗，依家要惡補都嚟唔切啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 sin1 zi1 jau5 cak1 jim6, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 ok3 bou2 dou1 lei4 m4 cit3 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: I only found out about the quiz yesterday, it's too late to cram now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都等到臨考試先嚟惡補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 dang2 dou3 lam4 haau2 si3 sin1 lei4 ok3 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都等到临考试前才来恶补。

english_meaning: to hurl abusive words at each other; to trade insults; to exchange harsh words
explanation_mandarin: 指用恶毒的语言互相攻击、辱骂。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算有意見分歧，都唔應該惡言相向，要嘗試理性溝通。

examples.english_sentence: Even if there are differences in opinion, you shouldn't trade insults; you should try to communicate rationally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩個因為啲小事就惡言相向，真係冇必要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai6 di1 siu2 si6 zau6 ok3 jin4 soeng1 hoeng3, zan1 hai6 mou5 bit1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩因为一些小事就恶语相向，真没必要。
examples.english_sentence: They started trading insults over some minor things; it's really unnecessary.

english_meaning: Full of wickedness; steeped in iniquity; brimming with evil; to have reached the limit of one's wickedness
explanation_mandarin: 形容罪恶极多，已达到不能再增加的地步。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose wickedness is extreme and has reached its limit, deserving of punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁多壞事都做齊，真係惡貫滿盈，遲早都會俾人拉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 do1 waai6 si6 dou1 zou6 cai4, zan1 hai6 ok3 gun3 mun5 ying4, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 bei2 jan4 laai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，真是恶贯满盈，迟早都会被人抓的。
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many bad things, he is truly full of wickedness and will get arrested sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個貪官惡貫滿盈，成日貪污市民嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 taam1 gun1 ok3 gun3 mun5 ying4, sing4 jat6 taam1 wu1 si5 man4 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个贪官恶贯满盈，整天贪污市民的钱。
examples.english_sentence: That corrupt official is full of wickedness, always embezzling money from the citizens.

english_meaning: bad luck, misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 指不好的运气，倒霉的遭遇。
explanation_english: Refers to bad luck or unfortunate experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年真係行緊惡運，做乜都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zan1 hai6 haang4 gan2 ok3 wan6, zou6 mat1 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年真是走霉运，做什么都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He's really having bad luck this year; nothing goes smoothly for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 信唔信風水嘅人，會話戴啲嘢嚟擋惡運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon3 m4 seon3 fung1 seoi2 ge3 jan4, wui5 waa6 daai3 di1 je5 lai4 dong2 ok3 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 相信风水的人会说戴些东西来挡厄运。
examples.english_sentence: People who believe in Feng Shui might say to wear something to ward off bad luck.

english_meaning: bully, local tyrant
explanation_mandarin: 指仗势欺人、横行霸道的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who bullies others, acts tyrannically, and dominates by force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校成日蝦啲同學，簡直係個惡霸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 seng4 jat6 haa1 di1 tung4 hok6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 go3 ok3 baa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在学校总是欺负同学，简直是个恶霸。
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies classmates at school, he's practically a tyrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前呢度有個惡霸，啲村民都好驚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ne1 dou6 jau5 go3 ok3 baa3, di1 cyun1 man4 dou1 hou2 geng1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前这里有个恶霸，村民们都很怕他。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be a bully here, the villagers were all very afraid of him.

mandarin_meaning: 难以忍受的；令人难受的
english_meaning: unbearable; difficult to endure; annoying; troublesome
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事或某个人让人感到非常不舒服、难以忍受，或者非常令人厌烦。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is extremely uncomfortable, difficult to endure, or very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日返工真係惡頂，做到我人都癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 zan1 hai6 ok3 ding2, zou6 dou3 ngo5 jan4 dou1 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天上班真是太难受了，累得我都快疯了。
examples.english_sentence: Working today was really unbearable, it drove me crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個客好惡頂，成日投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haak3 hou2 ok3 ding2, seng4 jat6 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个客人很让人难受，总是投诉。
examples.english_sentence: This customer is very annoying, always complaining.

english_meaning: fierce-looking, menacing, aggressive in appearance
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物看起来凶恶，令人害怕。通常指外表或语气，不一定代表实际行为。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that looks fierce, menacing, or aggressive. Usually refers to appearance or tone, and does not necessarily indicate actual behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢塊面惡騰騰咁，好似想打交咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faai3 min6 ok3 tang4 tang4 gam2, hou2 ci5 soeng2 daa2 gaau1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脸色凶巴巴的，好像要打架一样。
examples.english_sentence: His face looks fierce, like he wants to fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗惡騰騰咁吠，嚇到個細路仔喊晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 ok3 tang4 tang4 gam2 fai6, haak3 dou3 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 haam3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗恶狠狠地叫，吓得那个小孩哭了起来。
examples.english_sentence: That dog barked fiercely, scaring the child to tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲人睇落惡騰騰，其實心地幾好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jan4 tai2 lok6 ok3 tang4 tang4, kei4 sat6 sam1 dei6 gei2 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些人看起来凶巴巴的，其实心地挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: These people look fierce, but they actually have good hearts.

english_meaning: Difficult to swallow; to choke (on something)
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物难以吞咽，卡在喉咙里，导致噎住。也可以用来比喻遇到令人不快或者难以接受的事情。
explanation_english: Describes food being difficult to swallow and getting stuck in the throat, causing choking. It can also be used metaphorically to describe encountering something unpleasant or unacceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條魚好多骨，好易惡鯁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jyu2 hou2 do1 gwat1, hou2 ji6 ok3 gang2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条鱼很多刺，很容易噎住的。
examples.english_sentence: This fish has many bones; it's easy to choke on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講啲嘢咁難聽，真係聽到我惡鯁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 di1 je5 gam3 naan4 teng1, zan1 hai6 ting1 dou3 ngo5 ok3 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话这么难听，真听到我难以接受。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was so unpleasant, it was really hard to swallow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰番話簡直係惡鯁到飛起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 faan1 waa6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 ok3 gang2 dou3 fei1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的那番话简直是令人难以接受到了极点。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was absolutely impossible to swallow/extremely disagreeable.

english_meaning: fierce fight; fierce struggle; dogfight
explanation_mandarin: 指激烈的、凶狠的争斗或搏斗。
explanation_english: Refers to a fierce, vicious fight or struggle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗呢個職位惡鬥咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 ok3 dau3 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了这个职位恶斗了很久。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them have been fiercely fighting for this position for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉期間，各個黨派惡鬥得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 kei4 gaan1, gok3 go3 dong2 paai3 ok3 dau3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选举期间，各个党派之间竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: During the election period, the various parties fought fiercely.

english_meaning: Devil, demon, fiend
explanation_mandarin: 指邪恶的化身，带来灾难和痛苦的超自然存在。
explanation_english: Refers to an evil spirit or supernatural being that embodies wickedness and brings disaster and suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢簡直係個惡魔，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 go3 ok3 mo1, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他简直是个恶魔，整天搞事。
examples.english_sentence: He's practically a devil, always causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將佢睇成惡魔，佢都有佢嘅苦衷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 keoi5 tai2 sing4 ok3 mo1, keoi5 dou1 jau5 keoi5 ge3 fu2 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把他看成恶魔，他也有他的苦衷。
examples.english_sentence: Don't see him as a devil, he has his own difficulties.

english_meaning: uncomfortable, uneasy, not feeling well, feeling awkward; irritating; to feel choked up with emotion
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体或心理上的不舒服、不自在的感觉。也指令人感到烦恼或难受的情况。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of physical or mental discomfort and unease. It can also refer to a situation that is irritating or unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日食錯嘢，而家仲覺得好惡鯁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 sik6 co3 je5, ji4 gaa1 zung6 gok3 dak1 hou2 ok3 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天吃错了东西，现在还觉得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I ate something wrong yesterday, and I still feel very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工做得好惡鯁，我想辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 hou2 ok3 gang2, ngo5 soeng2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作做得很不舒服，我想辞职。
examples.english_sentence: This job is making me feel very uneasy, I want to quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁衰，聽落真係好惡鯁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 seoi1, teng1 lok6 zan1 hai6 hou2 ok3 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话那么难听，听起来真的让人很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was so awful, it really made me feel uncomfortable listening to it.

english_meaning: fierce, aggressive, domineering, unreasonable, bullying
explanation_mandarin: 形容人态度凶狠，不讲道理，喜欢欺负人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is fierce, unreasonable, and likes to bully others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好惡𠽤㗎，你唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ok3 gaau1 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很凶狠霸道，你不要惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very aggressive person, don't mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惡𠽤啦，有嘢慢慢傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 gaau1 laa1, jau5 je5 maan6 maan6 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么蛮横霸道，有什么事慢慢谈。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so aggressive, let's talk things over.

english_meaning: to think about; to remember with affection; to have (something) in mind; to be concerned about
explanation_mandarin: 心里记挂着，想着。
explanation_english: To have someone or something on your mind; to think of someone with affection; to be concerned about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都惦住你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 dim3 zyu6 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是惦记着你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm always thinking about you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使惦我，我自己搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 dim3 ngo5, ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用惦记我，我自己能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about me, I can handle it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使惦住佢，佢大個仔喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 dim3 zyu6 keoi5, keoi5 daai6 go3 zai2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用惦记着他，他已经是个大孩子了。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to worry about him, he's a big boy now.

english_meaning: to miss, to think of, to remember fondly
explanation_mandarin: 思念，记挂。
explanation_english: To think of someone or something fondly; to miss; to keep in mind with concern or affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日惦念住喺外國讀書嘅細佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 dim3 nim6 zyu6 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1 ge3 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是惦念着在国外读书的弟弟。
examples.english_sentence: I always miss my younger brother who is studying abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然離開咗香港好耐，但我都仲惦念香港嘅美食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 lei4 hoi1 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 noi6, daan6 ngo5 dou1 jung4 dim3 nim6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 mei5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然离开香港很久了，但是我还是惦念着香港的美食。
examples.english_sentence: Although I've been away from Hong Kong for a long time, I still miss Hong Kong's delicious food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日惦念住屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dim3 nim6 zyu6 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常惦念着家人。
examples.english_sentence: He often thinks about his family.

mandarin_meaning: 惦念; 牵挂; 挂念
english_meaning: to miss; to think about; to be concerned about; to worry about
explanation_mandarin: 思念，挂念。指对某人或某事感到担心或思念。
explanation_english: To miss someone, to be concerned about someone or something; to worry about someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好惦掛你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 dim3 gwaa3 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常想念你啊！
examples.english_sentence: I miss you very much!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽咪好惦掛你嘅健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa1 mi1 hou2 dim3 gwaa3 nei5 ge3 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很担心你的健康。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is very worried about your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人喺外國，屋企人好惦掛佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3, uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 dim3 gwaa3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人在国外，家人很牵挂他。
examples.english_sentence: He is alone abroad, and his family is very concerned about him.

english_meaning: to remember with affection; to be concerned about; to think of; to miss
explanation_mandarin: 记挂在心上，牵挂、思念。
explanation_english: To keep in mind with affection; to worry or be concerned about someone or something; to think of someone or something with fondness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都惦記住你呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 dim3 gei3 zyu6 nei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是惦记着你。
examples.english_sentence: I always think of you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使惦記我，我會照顧自己嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 dim3 gei3 ngo5, ngo5 wui5 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用惦记我，我会照顾自己的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about me, I'll take care of myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢離開咗咁耐，我都仲好惦記佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lei4 hoi1 zo2 gam3 noi6, ngo5 dou1 zung6 hou2 dim3 gei3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他离开这么久了，我还是很惦记他。
examples.english_sentence: He's been gone for so long, but I still miss him a lot.

english_meaning: lazy, indolent
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不喜欢劳动或不积极。
explanation_english: Describes a person who dislikes working or is not proactive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好惰㗎，成日都攤喺梳化度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 do6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 taan1 hai2 so1 fa2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懒惰的，整天都躺在沙发上。
examples.english_sentence: He's very lazy, always lying on the sofa all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惰啦，快啲做晒啲功課佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do6 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6晒 di1 gung1 fo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么懒惰了，快点做完功课吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so lazy, quickly finish your homework.

english_meaning: inertia, laziness, indolence
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏行动或改变的倾向；懒惰的性质。
explanation_english: Refers to the tendency to remain inactive or unchanged; the quality of being lazy or indolent. Can also refer to physical inertia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為有惰性，所以成日都唔肯做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 jau5 do6 sing3, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hang2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为有惰性，所以总是不愿意工作。
examples.english_sentence: Because he has inertia/is lazy, he is always unwilling to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要克服自己嘅惰性，先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hak1 fuk1 zi6 gei2 ge3 do6 sing3, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要克服自己的惰性，才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: You need to overcome your own inertia to succeed.

english_meaning: inert gas, noble gas
explanation_mandarin: 指化学性质不活泼的气体，通常指氦、氖、氩、氪、氙、氡等气体。
explanation_english: Refers to gases that are chemically unreactive, typically including helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, and radon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學堂教我哋關於惰性氣體嘅特性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 tong4 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 gwaan1 jyu1 do6 sing3 hei3 tai2 ge3 dak1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学课教我们关于惰性气体的特性。
examples.english_sentence: The science class taught us about the properties of inert gases.

english_meaning: to be annoyed, to be irritated, to be angry
explanation_mandarin: 表示生气，不高兴。一般程度较轻。
explanation_english: To feel annoyed or irritated. It usually indicates a milder form of anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日激嬲佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gik1 nou5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是惹他生气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always make him angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係講咗幾句，佢就惱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gong2 zo2 gei2 geoi3, keoi5 zau6 nou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只说了几句，他就生气了。
examples.english_sentence: I only said a few words, and he got annoyed.

english_meaning: annoying; irritating; bothersome
explanation_mandarin: 令人心烦、厌恶的人或事物。
explanation_english: Describing someone or something that is annoying, irritating, or bothersome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲蚊真係好惱人，咬到我成身都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 man1 zan1 hai6 hou2 nou5 jan4, ngaau5 dou3 ngo5 sing4 san1 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的蚊子真是很烦人，咬得我全身都是。
examples.english_sentence: The mosquitoes are really annoying these days, I'm covered in bites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日係度投訴，真係好惱人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 tau4 sou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 nou5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在抱怨，真是很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always complaining, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: to fly into a rage out of humiliation; to become enraged out of shame
explanation_mandarin: 因为羞愧或窘迫而发怒。
explanation_english: To become angry and aggressive due to feeling ashamed or embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人踢爆咗講大話，即刻惱羞成怒，仲鬧返人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tek3 baau3 zo2 gong2 daai6 waa6, zik1 hak1 nou5 sau1 sing4 nou6, zung2 naau6 faan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人揭穿了说谎，立刻恼羞成怒，还骂别人。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for lying and immediately became enraged out of shame, even scolding others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講佢啲缺點啦，佢會惱羞成怒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 keoi5 di1 kyut3 dim2 laa1, keoi5 wui5 nou5 sau1 sing4 nou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别说他的缺点了，他会恼羞成怒的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about his shortcomings, he'll get angry out of embarrassment.

english_meaning: to think; to want; to miss
explanation_mandarin: 思考；希望；怀念
explanation_english: To think about something; to want something; to miss someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住聽日去行山，你點睇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1, nei5 dim2 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想着明天去爬山，你觉得怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of going hiking tomorrow, what do you think?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想你啊！
examples.english_sentence: I miss you so much!

english_meaning: probably, presumably, I suppose
explanation_mandarin: 表示推测，相当于“大概”、“想必”。
explanation_english: Expresses speculation or presumption; equivalent to "probably," "presumably," or "I suppose."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁耐都未嚟，想來係唔得閒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 noi6 dou1 mei6 lai4, soeng2 lai4 hai6 m4 dak1 haan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么久都没来，想来是没空吧。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't come for so long; I suppose he's not free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨，想來都唔使返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, soeng2 lai4 dou1 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨，想来都不用上班。
examples.english_sentence: It's going to rain tomorrow; presumably, we don't have to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻，想來一定考得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1, soeng2 lai4 jat1 ding6 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么聪明，想来一定考得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He's so smart; I suppose he must have done well on the exam.

english_meaning: to imagine, to visualize, imagination
explanation_mandarin: 动词：设想，臆想。名词：设想出的形象或事物。
explanation_english: Verb: To form a mental image of something not present or experienced. Noun: The ability to form mental images or concepts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇想像過佢會咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 soeng2 zoeng6 gwo3 keoi5 wui5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有想象过他会这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't imagine he would do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅想像力好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的想象力很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: Your imagination is very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係靠想像，要睇下實際情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 kaau3 soeng2 zoeng6, jiu3 tai2 haa5 sat6 zai3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是靠想象，要看一下实际情况。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just rely on imagination, look at the actual situation.

english_meaning: imagination; creative power
explanation_mandarin: 构思新形象、新概念或新物体的能力。
explanation_english: The faculty or action of forming new ideas, or images or concepts of external objects not present to the senses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅想像力好豐富，成日都有啲好特別嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 hou2 fung1 fu3, seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 di1 hou2 dak6 bit6 ge3 lam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想象力很丰富，经常有一些很特别的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very rich imagination and often has some very special ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友嘅想像力真係無限嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 zan1 hai6 mou4 haan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友的想象力真是无限的。
examples.english_sentence: Children's imagination is truly limitless.

english_meaning: to have wild and unrealistic fantasies; to daydream; to let one's imagination run wild
explanation_mandarin: 指不切实际地幻想，想一些不可能实现的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to indulging in unrealistic fantasies, thinking about things that are impossible to achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都想入非非，點解唔腳踏實地做嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 jap6 fei1 fei1, dim2 gaai2 m4 goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是胡思乱想，为什么不脚踏实地工作呢？
examples.english_sentence: You are always having wild fantasies. Why don't you be more down-to-earth and work hard?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住買六合彩就可以發達，真係想入非非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 zoek3 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 zau6 ho2 ji5 faat3 daat6, zan1 hai6 soeng2 jap6 fei1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想着买彩票就能发财，真是胡思乱想。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he can get rich by buying lottery tickets. He's really letting his imagination run wild.

english_meaning: Wanting to... badly
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常渴望或渴望做某事的心情，语气强烈，通常用于不好的事情或不应该有的想法。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong desire or urge to do something, often something bad or a thought one shouldn't have. It implies a powerful temptation or impulse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試衰咗，想創佢老豆個心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 seoi1 zo2, soeng2 cong3 keoi5 lou5 dau6 go3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考砸了，想要打他爸爸的心。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam, and he has the urge to beat up his father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對你，你唔好想創佢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 nei5, nei5 m4 hou2 soeng2 cong3 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那样对你，你不要想要打他啊！
examples.english_sentence: He treated you like that, don't have the urge to hit him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個波咁靚，我真係想創爆佢個心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 bo1 gam3 leng3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 cong3 baau3 keoi5 go3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个球那么漂亮，我真的想要把它踢爆的心。
examples.english_sentence: That ball is so beautiful, I really have the urge to kick it to pieces.

english_meaning: It's quite difficult not to...
explanation_mandarin: 表示即使想避免某种情况或行为，也因为某种原因而很难做到。用于表达一种情不由己或难以控制的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that it is difficult to avoid a certain situation or action due to certain reasons. It is used to express a state of being involuntary or difficult to control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢咁好食，想唔肥都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 gam3 hou2 sik6, soeng2 m4 fei4 dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西这么好吃，想不胖也挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: The food is so delicious, it's hard not to get fat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁靚仔，想唔鍾意佢都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 leng3 zai2, soeng2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么帅，想不喜欢他都挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so handsome, it's hard not to like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日OT，想唔攰都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 OT, soeng2 m4 gui6 dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天加班，想不累都挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: Working overtime every day, it's hard not to be tired.

english_meaning: It's quite difficult not to...
explanation_mandarin: 表示即使想避免某种情况，也几乎不可能。
explanation_english: Indicates that even if you want to avoid a certain situation, it's almost impossible to do so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日對住咁靚嘅女仔，想唔鍾意佢都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 gam3 leng3 ge3 neoi5 zai2, soeng2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天面对这么漂亮的女孩，想不喜欢她都挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing such a pretty girl every day, it's quite difficult not to like her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢咁好食，想唔食多啲都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 gam3 hou2 sik6, soeng2 m4 sik6 do1 di1 dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西这么好吃，想不吃多一点都挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: The food is so delicious, it's quite difficult not to eat more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港地，想唔OT都幾難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dei6, soeng2 m4 OT dou1 gei2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，想不加班都挺难的。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, it's quite difficult not to work overtime.

english_meaning: want to ask; would like to ask; I was wondering
explanation_mandarin: 表达一种想要提问的意愿或礼貌地发起提问。
explanation_english: Expresses a desire to ask a question, or politely introduces a question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想問下，呢間餐廳好唔好食呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 man6 haa5, ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 m4 hou2 sik6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想问一下，这家餐厅好吃吗？
examples.english_sentence: I was wondering, is this restaurant good?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，想問條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, soeng2 man6 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我想问一下路。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I'd like to ask for directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想問吓你幾點放工呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 man6 haa5 nei5 gei2 dim2 fong3 gung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想问问你几点下班？
examples.english_sentence: I was wondering what time you finish work?

english_meaning: to miss, to think of
explanation_mandarin: 思念；惦念。
explanation_english: to miss someone or something, to think of someone or something fondly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想念屋企人呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 nim6 uk1 kei5 jan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想念我的家人啊！
examples.english_sentence: I really miss my family!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你走咗之後，我成日都想念你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 nim6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走之后，我总是想念你。
examples.english_sentence: After you left, I always miss you.

english_meaning: To try to provoke or annoy you greatly; to try to make you angry or frustrated; to rub it in.
explanation_mandarin: 故意做某些事情或说某些话来刺激对方，让对方感到非常生气、难受或不快。带有一种幸灾乐祸或故意挑衅的意味。
explanation_english: To deliberately do or say something to provoke someone, making them feel very angry, upset, or uncomfortable. It carries a sense of schadenfreude or deliberate provocation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知我減肥減得好辛苦，仲成日喺我面前食蛋糕，想愴我個心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi1 ngo5 gaam2 fei4 gaam2 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2, zung6 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 sik6 daan6 gou1, soeng2 cong3 ngo5 go3 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道我减肥减得很辛苦，还总是在我面前吃蛋糕，想气死我啊！
examples.english_sentence: He knows very well that I'm having a hard time dieting, and he keeps eating cake in front of me. He's just trying to provoke me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再講喇，你係咪想愴我個心？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3, nei5 hai6 mai1 soeng2 cong3 ngo5 go3 sam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再说了，你是不是想气死我？
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking, are you trying to annoy me?

english_meaning: to try every possible means; to rack one's brains; to do everything possible
explanation_mandarin: 想尽各种办法。形容想尽一切办法去解决问题或达到目标。
explanation_english: To exhaust all possible methods; to try every trick in the book. Describes using all possible ways to solve a problem or achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫佢，我哋想方設法籌錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 bong1 keoi5, ngo5 dei6 soeng2 fong1 cit3 faat3 cau4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮助他，我们想方设法筹钱。
examples.english_sentence: In order to help him, we tried every possible way to raise money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想方設法都搞唔掂份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 fong1 cit3 faat3 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想尽办法都搞不定这份报告。
examples.english_sentence: He tried every possible way, but he still couldn't finish the report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論如何，我都想方設法完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 jyu4 ho4, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 fong1 cit3 faat3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何，我都会想尽办法完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what, I will try every possible means to complete this project.

english_meaning: idea, thought, opinion, way of thinking
explanation_mandarin: 指脑海中产生的念头、主意或对某事的看法。
explanation_english: Refers to an idea, thought, opinion, or way of thinking about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對呢件事有咩想法啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 soeng2 faat3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对这件事有什么想法吗？
examples.english_sentence: What are your thoughts on this matter?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗法唔係咁樣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 faat3 m4 hai6 gam2 joeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的想法不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: That's not how I think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅想法好創新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 soeng2 faat3 hou2 coeng3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很创新。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very innovative.

english_meaning: To think of a way; to find a solution; to figure something out
explanation_mandarin: 想出办法、主意。
explanation_english: To try to come up with a method or idea to solve a problem or achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一定要想法子搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 soeng2 faat3 zi2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一定要想办法搞定他。
examples.english_sentence: I definitely have to find a way to deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲想法子啦，唔係就遲到喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 soeng2 faat3 zi2 laa1, m4 hai6 zau6 ci4 dou3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点想办法啊，不然就要迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: Think of a way quickly, or we'll be late!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一齊想法子解決呢個問題？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 soeng2 faat3 zi2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起想办法解决这个问题？
examples.english_sentence: How about we think of a way together to solve this problem?

english_meaning: to reminisce about the old days; thinking back to those years; back in the day
explanation_mandarin: 回忆过去美好的时光，常带有怀旧或感慨的意味。
explanation_english: To reminisce about the good old days; often implies a nostalgic or sentimental feeling about the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想當年我哋日日都喺公園踢波㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 dong1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 gung1 jyun2 tek3 bo1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想当年我们每天都在公园踢球呢。
examples.english_sentence: Back in the day, we played football in the park every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想當年，呢度仲係一片農田嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 dong1 nin4, ni1 dou6 zung6 hai6 jat1 pin3 nung4 tin4 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 回想当年，这里还是一片农田呢。
examples.english_sentence: Thinking back to those years, this place was still a farmland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想當年，話以前嘅嘢幾咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 dong1 nin4, waa6 ji5 cin4 ge3 je5 gei2 gwaan3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是回想当年，说以前的事情有多么好。
examples.english_sentence: He always reminisces about the old days, saying how good things were back then.

english_meaning: to take for granted; to assume; to presume
explanation_mandarin: 主观地认为事情理应如此，未经过验证或思考就认定为事实。
explanation_english: To assume something to be true without evidence or proper consideration; to take something for granted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好想當然以為佢會幫你手啦，佢自己都好忙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 soeng2 dong1 jin4 ji5 wai4 keoi5 wui5 bong1 nei5 sau2 laa1, keoi5 zi6 gei2 dou1 hou2 mong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想当然地认为他会帮你忙，他自己也很忙的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just assume that he will help you, he is very busy himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好想當然咁話佢一定會成功，好多嘢都仲有變數㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 soeng2 dong1 jin4 gam2 waa6 keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 zung1 jau5 bin3 sou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想当然地说他一定会成功，很多事情都还有变数。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just assume that he will succeed; many things are still uncertain.

synonyms: 理所當然 (lei5 so2 dong1 jin4)

english_meaning: to want to say; to have intended to say
explanation_mandarin: 表示想要说，或者本来想要说，但可能因为各种原因没有说出口。
explanation_english: Expresses the intention to say something, or the intention to have said something, but perhaps did not because of various reasons. It often implies a slight reluctance or change of mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先想話俾你知，不過最後都係唔敢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 soeng2 waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1, bat1 gwo3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 m4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才想告诉你的，不过最后还是不敢。
examples.english_sentence: I wanted to tell you earlier, but I didn't dare in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想話啲嘢好貴，但係老闆聽唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 waa6 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3, daan6 hai6 lou5 baan2 teng1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想说那些东西很贵，但是老板没听到。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to say that the things were very expensive, but the boss didn't hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實我一直都想話多謝你嘅幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 sat6 ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng2 waa6 do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其实我一直都想感谢你的帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Actually, I've always wanted to thank you for your help.

english_meaning: to recall, to remember, to think of
explanation_mandarin: 回忆起；记起
explanation_english: To recall something from the past; to bring something to mind; to remember.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗好耐都諗唔起佢個名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 lam2 m4 hei2 keoi5 go3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了很久都想不起他的名字。
examples.english_sentence: I've been thinking for a long time, but I still can't recall his name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一聽到呢首歌，我就即刻想起以前嘅開心時光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 ting1 dou2 ni1 sau2 go1, ngo5 zau6 zik1 hak1 soeng2 hei2 ji5 cin4 ge3 hoi1 sam1 si4 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一听到这首歌，我就立刻想起以前的开心时光。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as I hear this song, I immediately think of the happy times in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱瞓醒，先至想起我今日要交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 fan3 seng2, sin1 zi3 soeng2 hei2 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚睡醒，才想起我今天要交作业。
examples.english_sentence: I just woke up and then remembered that I have to submit my homework today.

english_meaning: idea, thought, notion, ambition, expectation
explanation_mandarin: 指想法，念头，也可以指希望或期望。
explanation_english: Refers to ideas, thoughts, or notions. It can also refer to hope or expectation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好多想頭，想做大生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 do1 soeng2 tau4, soeng2 zou6 daai6 seng1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很多想法，想做大生意。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of ideas, he wants to start a big business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多想頭啦，做好眼前嘅嘢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 soeng2 tau4 laa1, zou6 hou2 ngaan5 cin4 ge3 je5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想太多了，先把眼前的事情做好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't have so many ideas, focus on doing the task in front of you first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅想頭係移民去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 soeng2 tau4 hai6 ji4 man4 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法是移民去加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: His idea is to immigrate to Canada.

english_meaning: apprehensive, anxious, worried
explanation_mandarin: 形容心里不安，担心害怕。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of unease, worry, and fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好惴聽日個考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zeoi2 ting1 jat6 go3 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很担心明天的考试。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very anxious about the exam tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都好惴，唔知驚乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 zeoi2, m4 zi1 ging1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是很担忧，不知道在怕什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always apprehensive, I don't know what he's afraid of.

english_meaning: apprehensive, uneasy, anxious
explanation_mandarin: 形容因担心或害怕而心神不定，非常不安。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being anxious, apprehensive, and uneasy due to worry or fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要考試，我而家都仲係覺得惴惴不安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si5, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung6 hai6 gok3 dak1 zeoi2 zeoi2 bat1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要考试，我现在还是觉得惴惴不安。
examples.english_sentence: I have an exam tomorrow, and I still feel uneasy now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都驚我喺出邊會俾人呃，所以成日都惴惴不安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 geng1 ngo5 hai2 ceot1 bin1 wui5 bei2 jan4 aak1, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zeoi2 zeoi2 bat1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是担心我在外面会被人骗，所以总是惴惴不安。
examples.english_sentence: My mother is always worried that I will be scammed outside, so she is always uneasy.

english_meaning: afraid, fearful, apprehensive
explanation_mandarin: 表示恐惧，害怕，心中不安。
explanation_english: Expressing fear, dread, or anxiety; feeling uneasy or apprehensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日都惶恐不安，點做嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 dou1 wong4 hung2 bat1 on1, dim2 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整天都惶恐不安，怎么工作啊？
examples.english_sentence: Being constantly fearful and anxious, how can you work?

english_meaning: perturbed; alarmed; apprehensive; fearful; anxious; to be seized with panic
explanation_mandarin: 表示内心害怕、不安。
explanation_english: Expressing fear, unease, or anxiety in one's heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁講，我開始有啲惶恐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 hoi1 chi2 jau5 di1 wong4 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他这么说，我开始有点惶恐。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I started to feel a little apprehensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現得好惶恐，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 hin6 dak1 hou2 wong4 hung2, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表现得很惶恐，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He looks very perturbed, I wonder what happened.

english_meaning: to provoke, to cause, to incur, to attract
explanation_mandarin: 招引、引起（多指不好的事情）；触犯；引人注意或喜爱。
explanation_english: To provoke or incite (often negative); to offend; to attract attention or affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好惹佢啦，佢好惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 je5 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要惹他了，他很凶的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him, he's very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想惹麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 je5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to get into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好惹人喜愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 je5 jan4 hei2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很惹人喜爱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very likeable.

english_meaning: to cause trouble; to stir up trouble; to create problems
explanation_mandarin: 引起事端，制造麻烦。
explanation_english: To cause trouble or create problems. It often implies intentionally or unintentionally creating a disturbance or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺度惹事啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 je5 si6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是在这里惹事了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be causing trouble here!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最鍾意搞搞震，惹事生非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, je5 si6 sang1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最喜欢搞事，惹事生非。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to stir things up and cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔唔聽話，成日惹事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 teng1 waa6, seng4 jat6 je5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不听话，老是惹事。
examples.english_sentence: The kid doesn't listen and is always causing trouble.

english_meaning: to stir up trouble, to cause trouble, to be a troublemaker
explanation_mandarin: 招惹麻烦，引起事端。指无事生事，故意制造麻烦。
explanation_english: To provoke trouble or cause incidents; to create trouble for no reason; to deliberately create problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺學校惹事生非，搞到老師好頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 je5 si6 sang1 fei1, gaau2 dou3 lou5 si1 hou2 tau4 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在学校惹事生非，搞得老师很头疼。
examples.english_sentence: He is always stirring up trouble at school, giving the teacher a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再惹事生非喇，我哋都唔想俾你連累呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 je5 si6 sang1 fei1 laa3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 soeng2 bei2 nei5 lin4 leoi6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹事生非了，我们都不想被你连累啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause any more trouble, we don't want to be implicated by you!

english_meaning: Flavorful, appetizing, having a rich and appealing taste
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物味道浓郁，非常吸引人，让人想吃。
explanation_english: Describes food that has a strong and appealing flavor, making it very appetizing and desirable to eat. It implies a depth of taste beyond just being tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟豉油皇炒麵好惹味，我食咗兩碟喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 si6 jau4 wong4 caau2 min6 hou2 je5 mei6, ngo5 sik6 zo2 loeng5 dip6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘豉油皇炒面很够味，我已经吃了两盘了！
examples.english_sentence: This soy sauce chow mein is so flavorful, I've already had two plates!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅咖喱真係好惹味，好啱我口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ga3 lei1 zan1 hai6 hou2 je5 mei6, hou2 ngaam1 ngo5 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的咖喱真的很够味，很合我的口味。
examples.english_sentence: The curry at this restaurant is really flavorful, it suits my taste perfectly.

english_meaning: to get into trouble with the law, to be involved in a lawsuit
explanation_mandarin: 指招惹上诉讼、官司等法律纠纷。
explanation_english: To get into legal trouble; to be involved in a lawsuit or legal dispute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你千祈唔好貪嗰少少錢，如果唔係好易惹官非㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 taam1 go2 siu2 siu2 cin2, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 je5 gun1 fei1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你千万不要贪那一点小钱，不然很容易惹上官司的。
examples.english_sentence: You must not be greedy for that little bit of money, otherwise you'll easily get into trouble with the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞搞震，遲早惹官非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ci4 zou2 je5 gun1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天惹事生非，迟早会惹上官司的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble; sooner or later, he'll get into trouble with the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 非法賭博好容易惹官非，千祈唔好試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 faat3 dou2 bok3 hou2 jung4 ji6 je5 gun1 fei1, cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 非法赌博很容易惹上官司，千万不要尝试。
examples.english_sentence: Illegal gambling can easily lead to legal trouble; never try it.

english_meaning: to cause trouble; to stir up trouble; to be troublesome
explanation_mandarin: 招惹是非，引起麻烦。指故意或不小心地引发争端或问题。
explanation_english: To provoke disputes or cause trouble. It refers to deliberately or inadvertently triggering conflicts or problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都惹是惹非，唔怪得阿媽咁嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 je5 si6 je5 fei1, m4 gwaai3 dak1 aa3 maa1 gam3 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是惹事生非，难怪妈妈这么生气。
examples.english_sentence: You are always causing trouble, no wonder Mom is so angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好低調，唔會主動惹是惹非嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 dai1 diu6, m4 wui5 zyu2 dung6 je5 si6 je5 fei1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人很低调，不会主动惹事生非的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very low-profile person and would not actively cause trouble.

english_meaning: to provoke anger; to be provocative; sexy
explanation_mandarin: 使人生气；引起不满。也可形容衣着暴露，非常性感。
explanation_english: To provoke anger or dissatisfaction. Can also describe revealing clothing or being very sexy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再惹火佢啦，佢已經好嬲㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 je5 fo2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 ji5 ging1 hou2 nau1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹他生气了，他已经很生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, he's already very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着到咁惹火，想點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 gam3 je5 fo2, soeng2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得这么性感，想怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed so provocatively today, what does she want?

english_meaning: to cause trouble; to stir up trouble; to invite disaster
explanation_mandarin: 招惹麻烦或灾祸。
explanation_english: To cause trouble or disaster; to invite misfortune upon oneself or others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再惹禍喇，夠晒煩㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 je5 wo6 laa3, gau3 saai3 faan4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再惹祸了，已经够烦的了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause any more trouble, it's already annoying enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日惹禍，搞到屋企人好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 je5 wo6, gaau2 dou3 uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹祸，搞得家人很头痛。
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble, giving his family a headache.

mandarin_meaning: 惹麻烦; 招惹是非; 惹事
english_meaning: To stir up trouble; to invite problems; to be asking for it
explanation_mandarin: 比喻招惹麻烦，引来不必要的麻烦或问题。 形容某人的行为容易引起他人的不满或反感，导致不良后果。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to stirring up trouble, inviting unnecessary problems or issues. It describes someone's actions that easily cause dissatisfaction or resentment from others, leading to adverse consequences. Similar to 'asking for it'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣講嘢啦，好易惹蟻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5 laa1, hou2 ji6 je5 ngai5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样说话了，很容易惹麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk like that, it's very easy to stir up trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日惹蟻，搞到阿sir好頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 je5 ngai5, gaau2 dou3 aa3 sir1 hou2 tau4 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，搞得老师很头痛。
examples.english_sentence: He's always stirring up trouble, making the teacher have a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再搞搞震，小心惹蟻上身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, siu2 sam1 je5 ngai5 soeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再调皮捣蛋，小心惹麻烦上身。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep messing around, be careful you don't bring trouble upon yourself.

english_meaning: to cause trouble; to get into trouble; to stir up trouble
explanation_mandarin: 招惹麻烦；引起麻烦。
explanation_english: To cause or create trouble; to invite or get oneself into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再惹麻煩啦，已經夠煩㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 je5 maa4 faan4 laa1, ji5 ging1 gau3 faan4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹麻烦了，已经够烦的了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause any more trouble, it's already annoying enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日惹麻煩，搞到屋企人好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 je5 maa4 faan4, gaau2 dou3 uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，搞得家里人很担心。
examples.english_sentence: He always causes trouble, making his family very worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥唔聽話，好容易惹麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 m4 teng1 waa6, hou2 jung4 ji6 je5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不听话，很容易惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Children who don't listen are likely to get into trouble.

english_meaning: to cherish each other, to appreciate each other's talents (especially between people of similar ability or experience)
explanation_mandarin: 惺惺相惜：指有才能的人互相爱惜；同类的人互相怜惜。在粤语中，多用“惺”来表达“惺惺相惜”的意思，表示两人非常投缘，互相欣赏。
explanation_english: "惺惺相惜" (xing xing xiang xi) refers to talented people cherishing each other; people of the same kind pitying each other. In Cantonese, "惺" is often used to express the meaning of "惺惺相惜", indicating that two people are very compatible and admire each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一見面就覺得好惺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个一见面就觉得非常投缘。
examples.english_sentence: They felt a strong connection as soon as they met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個棋逢敵手，惺惺相惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 kei2 fung4 dik6 sau2, sing1 sing1 soeng1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个棋逢对手，惺惺相惜。
examples.english_sentence: Two equally matched opponents cherish each other's talents.

english_meaning: groggy, dazed, half-awake
explanation_mandarin: 形容刚睡醒时神志不清，迷迷糊糊的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being half-awake, groggy, and disoriented, typically after waking up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱瞓醒嗰陣，個人仲係好惺忪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 fan3 sing2 go2 zan6, go3 jan4 zung6 hai6 hou2 sing1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚睡醒的时候，人还是非常惺忪。
examples.english_sentence: When I just woke up, I was still very groggy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲完酒之後，佢成個人都好惺忪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 jyun4 zau2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 hou2 sing1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝完酒之后，他整个人都很惺忪。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking alcohol, he was completely dazed.

english_meaning: to be affected; to put on airs; to pose; to be pretentious
explanation_mandarin: 故意做作，显示自己的与众不同或高人一等。
explanation_english: To deliberately act in an affected or pretentious manner, often to show off or appear superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前惺惺作態，想搏表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 sing1 sing1 zok3 taai3, soeng2 bok3 biu2 hin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前装腔作势，想博取表现。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on airs in front of the boss, trying to get noticed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我面前惺惺作態，我知你咩底細㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 sing1 sing1 zok3 taai3, ngo5 zi1 nei5 me1 dai2 sai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在我面前装腔作势，我知道你是什么底细。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on airs in front of me, I know what you're really like.

english_meaning: To cherish each other (said of people of talent or similar interests who admire each other); mutual appreciation; recognizing a kindred spirit
explanation_mandarin: 形容有才华的人互相了解、互相倾慕，或者志同道合的人互相珍惜。
explanation_english: Describes people of talent understanding and admiring each other, or like-minded people cherishing each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係音樂界嘅天才，難怪會惺惺相惜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 jam1 ngok6 gaai3 ge3 tin1 coi4, naan4 gwaai3 wui5 sing1 sing1 soeng1 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都是音乐界的天才，难怪会惺惺相惜。
examples.english_sentence: They are both geniuses in the music industry, no wonder they cherish each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩位畫家風格雖然唔同，但係佢哋都好欣賞對方嘅作品，真係惺惺相惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 wai2 waa2 gaa1 fung1 gaak3 seoi1 jin4 m4 tung4, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 hou2 jan1 seong2 deoi3 fong1 ge3 zok3 ban2, zan1 hai6 sing1 sing1 soeng1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两位画家风格虽然不同，但是他们都很欣赏对方的作品，真是惺惺相惜。
examples.english_sentence: Although these two painters have different styles, they both appreciate each other's work, it's truly a case of mutual appreciation.

english_meaning: Sad, compassionate, empathetic, have pity
explanation_mandarin: 形容人感到悲伤，或者对他人表示怜悯、同情。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of sadness, or expressing pity and compassion towards others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個故仔之後，覺得好惻隱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 go3 gu3 zai2 zi1 hau6, gok3 dak1 hou2 cak1 yan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到这个故事之后，觉得很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the story, he felt very pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惻啦，事情總會過去嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cak1 laa1, si6 ching4 zung2 wui5 gwo3 heoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么悲伤了，事情总会过去的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sad, things will eventually pass.

english_meaning: compassion; pity; sympathy
explanation_mandarin: 怜悯之心；对别人的不幸表示同情。
explanation_english: A feeling of pity or compassion for someone who is suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有惻隱之心，成日幫助啲窮人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 cak1 yan2 zi1 sam1, sing4 jat6 bong1 zo6 di1 kung4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有同情心，经常帮助穷人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very compassionate and always helps the poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢咁慘，我都忍唔住有啲惻隱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 keoi5 gam3 caam2, ngo5 dou1 jan2 m4住 jau5 di1 cak1 yan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么惨，我都忍不住有些同情。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so miserable, I couldn't help but feel some pity.

english_meaning: to knit one's brow; to frown; to worry
explanation_mandarin: 表示皱眉头或忧愁的样子。
explanation_english: Expresses the action or state of knitting one's brow, showing worry or concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到份成績單，即刻愀晒眉頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 fan6 sing4 zik1 daan1, zik1 hak1 ciu2 saai3 mei4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到成绩单，立刻皱起了眉头。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the report card, he frowned immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁愀，船到橋頭自然直。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 ciu2, syun4 dou3 kiu4 tau4 zi6 jin1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么发愁，船到桥头自然直。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much, things will sort themselves out in the end (the boat will straighten when it reaches the bridge).

english_meaning: to worry, to be anxious, to fret
explanation_mandarin: 表示忧虑、担心，或感到烦恼。
explanation_english: To feel worried, anxious, or concerned about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好愁聽日嘅考試呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 sau4 ting1 jat6 ge3 haau2 si5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很愁明天的考试。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very worried about tomorrow's exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁愁眉苦臉啦，事情一定會好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sau4 mei4 ku2 lim5 laa1, si6 cing4 jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要愁眉苦脸的，事情一定会好的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look so worried, things will definitely get better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日愁錢銀，搞到個人都瘦晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau4 cin2 ngan2, gaau2 dou3 go3 jan4 dou1 sau3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天愁钱，搞得人都瘦了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always worrying about money, which has made him lose weight.

english_meaning: to wear a distressed expression; to look miserable; to wear a long face
explanation_mandarin: 形容忧愁、痛苦的表情。
explanation_english: Describes a facial expression of worry, distress, or unhappiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩愁眉苦臉啊？發生咗咩事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5 aa3? faat3 sang1 zo2 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做什么愁眉苦脸的？发生什么事了？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you looking so miserable? What happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考得唔好，佢成日都愁眉苦臉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考得不好，他整天都愁眉苦脸。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well on the exam, so he looks miserable all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日愁眉苦臉啦，笑多啲開心啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5 laa1, siu3 do1 di1 hoi1 sam1 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是愁眉苦脸的，多笑笑开心点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always look so miserable, smile more and be happier!

english_meaning: melancholy, feeling of sorrow, worried thoughts
explanation_mandarin: 忧愁的心情；忧虑的情绪。
explanation_english: A feeling of melancholy or sorrow; worried and anxious thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都充滿愁緒咁，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 cung1 mun5 sau4 seoi5 gam2, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是充满愁绪，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He is always filled with melancholy, I wonder what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 離別嘅愁緒湧上心頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei4 bit6 ge3 sau4 seoi5 jung2 soeng5 sam1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 离别的愁绪涌上心头。
examples.english_sentence: The sorrow of parting welled up in my heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊年嘅事仍然帶俾我好多愁緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 nin4 ge3 si6 ying4 jin4 daai3 bei2 ngo5 hou2 do1 sau4 seoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年的事仍然带给我很多愁绪。
examples.english_sentence: Last year's events still bring me a lot of sorrow.

english_meaning: melancholy, sorrowful feelings, worries, anxieties
explanation_mandarin: 忧愁的思绪；忧愁的心情。
explanation_english: A feeling of melancholy, sadness, or anxiety; sorrowful thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排工作唔順利，搞到我好多愁緖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai1 gung1 zok3 m4 seon6 lei6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 do1 sau4 seoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作不顺利，弄得我很多愁绪。
examples.english_sentence: My work hasn't been going well lately, which has caused me a lot of worries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到套咁慘嘅戲，搞到我充滿愁緖。
