examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日OT，個人睇落好憔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 OT, go3 jan4 tai2 lok6 hou2 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近经常加班，看起来很憔悴。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working overtime a lot lately, and he looks very haggard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁操勞，唔係好快會變得好憔悴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cou1 lou4, m4 hai6 hou2 faai3 wui5 bin3 dak1 hou2 ciu4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要太操劳，不然很快会变得很憔悴的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard, or you'll become haggard very quickly.

english_meaning: haggard, wan, worn-out
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因忧虑、疾病等而精神萎靡，面容不好看。
explanation_english: Describes a person who looks tired, ill, and generally unwell, often due to worry, illness, or lack of sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近睇落好憔悴喎，發生咩事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 tai2 lok6 hou2 ciu4 seoi6 wo3, faat3 sang1 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近看起来很憔悴，发生什么事了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You look really haggard lately, what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病咗咁耐，個人都憔悴晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 zo2 gam3 noi6, go3 jan4 dou1 ciu4 seoi6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病了这么久，人都憔悴了。
examples.english_sentence: Having been sick for so long, I'm all worn out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份報告搞到好憔悴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 gaau2 dou3 hou2 ciu4 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这份报告搞得很憔悴。
examples.english_sentence: He looks worn out because of the report.

english_meaning: to fear, to dread, to be afraid of, to be reluctant to, to hesitate
explanation_mandarin: 表示害怕、顾虑或忌惮的意思。
explanation_english: Expresses fear, dread, reluctance, or hesitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁憚，咪試吓囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daan3, mai5 si3 haa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么顾虑，试一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so reluctant, just give it a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔憚嘅，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 daan3 ge3, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不怕的，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He's not afraid of anything, you better be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我憚麻煩，所以唔想搞咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daan3 maa4 faan4, so2 ji5 m4 soeng2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕麻烦，所以不想搞那么多事。
examples.english_sentence: I dread the trouble, so I don't want to deal with so many things.

english_meaning: frightened, scared, terrified
explanation_mandarin: 形容因恐惧而发抖或害怕的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being frightened or terrified, often to the point of trembling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先見到隻曱甴，嚇到我憟晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 gin3 dou2 zek3 gaat6 zaat2, haak3 dou2 ngo5 sok3 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才看到一只蟑螂，吓得我浑身发抖！
examples.english_sentence: I saw a cockroach just now and it scared me so much I was terrified!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講起鬼故，佢就憟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 hei2 gwai2 gu3, keoi5 zau6 sok3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一说起鬼故事，他就害怕得发抖。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as you mention ghost stories, he gets terrified.

english_meaning: anger; indignation; resentment
explanation_mandarin: 表示因不公平或不如意的事情而产生的强烈不满和愤怒的情绪。
explanation_english: Expressing strong dissatisfaction and anger due to unfair or undesirable events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得好憤怒，因為佢嘅努力冇得到應有嘅認可。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 fan5 nou6, jan1 wai6 keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6 mou5 dak1 dou3 jing1 jau5 ge3 jing6 kok1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他感到非常愤怒，因为他的努力没有得到应有的认可。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very angry because his efforts didn't get the recognition they deserved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁憤啦，深呼吸一下，諗下解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fan5 laa1, sam1 fu1 kap1 jat1 haa5, nam2 haa5 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么愤怒了，深呼吸一下，想想解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, take a deep breath and think about a solution.

english_meaning: cynical; misanthropic; resentful of society
explanation_mandarin: 对社会、人生等感到愤恨、厌恶，并抱持批判的态度。
explanation_english: Feeling resentful and cynical towards society, life, and people in general; holding a critical and negative attitude towards the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擺出一副憤世嫉俗嘅樣，好似全世界都欠咗佢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bai2 ceot1 jat1 fu3 fan5 sai3 zat6 suk6 ge3 joeng2, hou2 ci5 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1欠咗 keoi5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是摆出一副愤世嫉俗的样子，好像全世界都欠了他一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on a cynical look, as if the whole world owes him something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為經歷過好多唔公平嘅事，所以變得憤世嫉俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ging1 lik6 gwo3 hou2 do1 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3 si6, so2 ji5 bin3 dak1 fan5 sai3 zat6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为经历过很多不公平的事情，所以变得愤世嫉俗。
examples.english_sentence: Because he has experienced many unfair things, he has become cynical.

english_meaning: anger, rage, wrath
explanation_mandarin: 强烈的不满或仇恨的情绪。
explanation_english: A strong feeling of displeasure and antagonism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老闆鬧完之後，好憤怒咁離開咗公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 baan2 nau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, hou2 fan5 nou6 gam2 lei4 hoi1 zo2 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，非常愤怒地离开了公司。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he left the company in a rage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用憤怒解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 fan5 nou6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用愤怒解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use anger to solve problems.

english_meaning: resentment, hatred, indignation
explanation_mandarin: 因不公正待遇或不幸遭遇而产生的强烈不满和憎恨。
explanation_english: A feeling of deep and bitter anger and ill-will, usually resulting from a perceived injustice or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅不公待遇充滿憤恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 bat1 gung1 dai6 jyu6 cung1 mun5 fan5 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的不公正待遇充满了愤恨。
examples.english_sentence: He is full of resentment towards the unfair treatment he received.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅眼神充滿咗憤恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 san4 cung1 mun5 zo2 fan5 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼神充满了愤恨。
examples.english_sentence: His eyes were filled with resentment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾憤恨控制你嘅人生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 fan5 han6 hung3 zai3 nei5 ge3 jan4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让愤恨控制你的人生。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let resentment control your life.

english_meaning: indignation, resentment, outrage
explanation_mandarin: 因不公平的事情而感到愤怒和不满。
explanation_english: A feeling of anger and dissatisfaction caused by something unjust or unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對公司嘅決定好憤慨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 fan5 koi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对公司的决定很愤慨。
examples.english_sentence: He is very indignant about the company's decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民對政府嘅貪污行為感到憤慨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 deoi3 zing3 fu2 ge3 taam1 wu1 hang4 wai4 gam2 dou3 fan5 koi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民对政府的贪污行为感到愤慨。
examples.english_sentence: The citizens feel indignant about the government's corruption.

english_meaning: indignant, resentful, incensed, infuriated
explanation_mandarin: 形容因不满或愤怒而情绪激动。
explanation_english: Describing a state of strong emotion, especially anger or resentment, caused by dissatisfaction or injustice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢哋咁樣做，我真係好憤激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 gam2 joeng2 zou6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 fan5 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他们这样做，我真的很愤慨。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing what they did, I feel really indignant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅言論引起咗好多人嘅憤激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin4 leon6 hei2 hung3 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 fan5 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的言论引起了很多人的愤慨。
examples.english_sentence: His remarks aroused the indignation of many people.

english_meaning: Angry youth; a term referring to young, nationalistic, and often outspoken individuals in China, often expressing strong opinions about social and political issues.
explanation_mandarin: 指中国大陆一些对社会和政治问题持强烈批判态度，并以民族主义和爱国主义为主要表达方式的年轻人。带有一定的贬义，指他们往往缺乏理性思考，容易被情绪所左右。
explanation_english: Refers to young people in mainland China who hold strongly critical attitudes towards social and political issues and express themselves primarily through nationalism and patriotism. The term often carries a negative connotation, implying that they lack rational thought and are easily swayed by emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上發表激進言論，俾人話佢係憤青。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng5 faat3 biu2 gik1 zeon3 jin4 leon6, bei2 jan4 waa6 keoi5 hai6 fan5 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在网上发表激进言论，被人说他是愤青。
examples.english_sentence: He often posts radical comments online, and people say he's an angry youth.

english_meaning: to sway; to shake; to move to and fro
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体摇摆、晃动。
explanation_english: Describes the movement of an object swaying or shaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樹喺風入面不停咁憧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu6 hai2 fung1 jap6 min6 bat1 ting4 gam2 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树在风中不停地摇晃。
examples.english_sentence: The trees are constantly swaying in the wind.

english_meaning: to long for; to look forward to; aspiration; vision
explanation_mandarin: 对未来的美好事物充满向往和期待。
explanation_english: To have a strong desire or hope for something in the future, often something positive or ideal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好憧憬將來可以去環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 cung1 ging2 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常憧憬将来可以去环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: I really look forward to traveling around the world in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對大學生活充滿憧憬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 daai6 hok6 sang1 wut6 cung1 mun5 cung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对大学生活充满憧憬。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of anticipation for university life.

english_meaning: foolish, silly, simple-minded
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人有点傻气，不太聪明，容易被骗。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is a bit foolish, not very clever, and easily tricked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁憨嘅，小心俾人呃啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ham1 ge3, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 aak1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么傻，小心被人骗啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're so foolish, be careful not to get cheated!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人憨憨哋，但係好老實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 ham1 ham1 dei2, daan6 hai6 hou2 lou5 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人傻傻的，但是很老实。
examples.english_sentence: He's a bit simple-minded, but he's very honest.

english_meaning: rest, take a break
explanation_mandarin: 休息，歇息。文言用法，在口语中较少单独使用，通常出现在一些较为正式的场合或者书面语中。
explanation_english: To rest; to take a break. A literary term rarely used alone in everyday Cantonese conversation. Usually appears in more formal contexts or written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺度稍作憩息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dou6 siu1 zok3 hei3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这里稍微休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a short rest here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵個地方俾我哋憩下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 go3 dei6 fong1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 hei3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找个地方给我们休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's find a place for us to rest.

english_meaning: to pity, to sympathize with, to have compassion for
explanation_mandarin: 怜悯，同情。对别人的不幸表示关切和同情。
explanation_english: To pity, to sympathize with someone, to feel compassion for their misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好慘呀，真係令人好憫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 caam2 aa3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 hou2 man5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很可怜啊，真的让人很同情。
examples.english_sentence: He's so pitiful, it really makes people feel sorry for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁憫我，我會搞掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 man5 ngo5, ngo5 wui5 gaau2 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么同情我，我会处理好的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to pity me so much, I'll take care of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好有愛心，好憫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1, hou2 man5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她很有爱心，很同情别人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very kind and compassionate, and has a lot of sympathy for others.

english_meaning: to long for; to yearn for; to look forward to
explanation_mandarin: 嚮往；憧憬。
explanation_english: To long for; to yearn for; to look forward to with eagerness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對將來充滿憧憬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 zoeng1 loi4 cung1 mun5 tung1 gwing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对未来充满憧憬。
examples.english_sentence: I am full of hope and anticipation for the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好憧憬去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tung1 gwing2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很憧憬去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He is looking forward to travelling a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對新生活充滿憧憬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 san1 sang1 wut6 cung1 mun5 tung1 gwing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对新生活充满憧憬。
examples.english_sentence: They are filled with anticipation for their new life.

english_meaning: disappointed, dispirited, dejected, at a loss, helpless
explanation_mandarin: 形容失望、失落，感到無可奈何的心情。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of disappointment, dejection, and helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，知道自己考得唔好，覺得好憮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 zi1 hau6, zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, gok3 dak1 hou2 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试之后，知道自己考得不好，觉得很失落。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, knowing that I didn't do well, I felt very dejected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就要搬走喇，望住間屋，覺得好憮啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 bun1 zau2 laa3, mong6 zyu6 gaan1 uk1, gok3 dak1 hou2 mou5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要搬走了，望着这间房子，觉得很失落啊。
examples.english_sentence: We're moving out tomorrow, looking at the house, I feel so disappointed.

english_meaning: constitution; military police
explanation_mandarin: （一）指宪法。（二）指宪兵。 香港口语中，“宪”常指皇家香港军团（义勇军）。
explanation_english: (1) Refers to the constitution. (2) Refers to military police. In Hong Kong colloquial speech, "憲" often refers to the Royal Hong Kong Regiment (The Volunteers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爸以前係香港義勇軍，即係俗稱嘅「皇軍」或者「憲兵」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 baa4 ji5 cin4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ji6 jung5 gwan1, zik1 hai6 suk6 cing1 ge3 "wong4 gwan1" waak6 ze2 "hin3 bing1".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸以前是香港义勇军，也就是俗称的“皇军”或者“宪兵”。
examples.english_sentence: My father used to be in the Royal Hong Kong Regiment (The Volunteers), also known as "Royal Army" or "Military Police" in colloquial terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個國家嘅憲法好完善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 hin3 faat3 hou2 jyun4 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个国家的宪法很完善。
examples.english_sentence: The constitution of this country is very comprehensive.

english_meaning: military police
explanation_mandarin: 指军队中负责维持军纪、执行法律的警察。
explanation_english: Military police, a member of the armed forces responsible for maintaining discipline and enforcing laws within the military.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿哥喺軍營做緊憲兵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 go1 hai2 gwan1 ying4 zou6 gan2 hin3 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哥哥在军营里当宪兵。
examples.english_sentence: His older brother is a military police officer in the army camp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲憲兵喺營區入面巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hin3 bing1 hai2 ying4 keoi1 jap6 min6 cheun4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宪兵在营区里面巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: The military police are patrolling inside the camp area.

english_meaning: constitutional system; constitution
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家的根本大法或政治制度的基础。着重于宪法的原则和体系。
explanation_english: Refers to the fundamental law or the basis of the political system of a country, focusing on the principles and system of the constitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅憲制地位係根據《基本法》嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hin3 zai3 dei6 wai2 hai6 gan1 geoi3 《gei1 bun2 faat3》 lei4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的宪制地位是根据《基本法》来的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's constitutional status is based on the Basic Law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個國家嘅憲制改革引發咗好多爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 hin3 zai3 goi2 gaak3 jan5 faat3 zo2 hou2 do1 zaang1 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个国家的宪制改革引发了很多争议。
examples.english_sentence: The constitutional reform of this country has sparked a lot of controversy.

english_meaning: Government Gazette
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府出版的官方刊物，刊登政府的公告、法律、规章、任命等。
explanation_english: The official publication of the Hong Kong Government, which publishes government notices, laws, regulations, appointments, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份嘢喺憲報度登咗喇，應該冇問題喇掛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 je5 hai2 hin3 bou3 dou6 dang1 zo2 laa3, ying1 goi1 mou5 man6 tai4 laa3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事已经在政府宪报上刊登了，应该没问题了吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has been published in the Government Gazette, so there shouldn't be any problems, right?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺政府新聞處嘅網頁度查閱最新嘅憲報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 zeng3 fu2 san1 man4 cyu3 ge3 mong5 jip6 dou6 caa4 yue6 zeui3 san1 ge3 hin3 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在政府新闻处的网页上查阅最新的政府宪报。
examples.english_sentence: You can check the latest Government Gazette on the website of the Information Services Department.

english_meaning: constitutionalism; constitutional government
explanation_mandarin: 指以宪法为根本法，限制政府权力，保障公民权利和自由的政治体制。
explanation_english: A political system in which the power of the government is limited by a constitution, and the rights and freedoms of citizens are guaranteed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 憲政係現代社會嘅重要基石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hin3 zing3 hai6 hiu3 daai6 se5 wui2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 gei1 sek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宪政是现代社会的重要基石。
examples.english_sentence: Constitutionalism is an important cornerstone of modern society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一路爭取香港嘅憲政發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 lou6 zaang1 ceoi2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hin3 zing3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直争取香港的宪政发展。
examples.english_sentence: They have been striving for the constitutional development of Hong Kong.

english_meaning: constitution
explanation_mandarin: 国家的根本大法，规定国家制度、公民权利和义务等。
explanation_english: The fundamental law of a country, stipulating the state system, citizens' rights and obligations, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅憲法係基本法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hin3 faat3 hai6 gei1 bun2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的宪法是基本法。
examples.english_sentence: The constitution of Hong Kong is the Basic Law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話政府做嘅嘢違反咗憲法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 zing3 fu2 zou6 ge3 je5 wai4 faan2 zo2 hin3 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说政府做的事情违反了宪法。
examples.english_sentence: They said that what the government did violated the constitution.

english_meaning: charter, constitution
explanation_mandarin: 指国家或团体的根本大法，或具有根本性质的重要文件。
explanation_english: A charter, constitution, or a fundamental document of a nation or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聯合國憲章係國際法嘅重要基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lyun4 hap6 gwok3 hin3 zoeng1 hai6 gwok3 zai3 faat3 ge3 zung6 jiu3 gei1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 联合国宪章是国际法的重要基础。
examples.english_sentence: The Charter of the United Nations is an important foundation of international law.

english_meaning: to recall; to remember; memory
explanation_mandarin: 回忆，记忆。指对过去的事情在脑海中重现。
explanation_english: To recall or remember something; memory of a past event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我憶起細個嘅時候，成日同屋企人去公園玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jik1 hei2 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, sing4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我回忆起小时候，经常和家人去公园玩。
examples.english_sentence: I remember when I was a child, I often went to the park to play with my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲都係我美好嘅回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 ngo5 mei5 hou2 ge3 wui4 yik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是我美好的回忆。
examples.english_sentence: These are all my wonderful memories.

english_meaning: to recall and narrate; to recount; to reminisce
explanation_mandarin: 回忆并叙述；追述往事。
explanation_english: To recall and narrate past events; to recount one's memories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憶述番細個嘅時候嘅趣事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jik1 seot6 faan1 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 ge3 cheoi3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他回忆起小时候的趣事。
examples.english_sentence: He recalled the funny things that happened when he was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺訪問入邊，佢憶述咗佢嘅事業起步嘅過程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fong2 mun6 jap6 bin1, keoi5 jik1 seot6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 hei2 bo6 ge3 gwo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在采访中，他回忆叙述了他的事业起步的过程。
examples.english_sentence: In the interview, he recounted the process of starting his career.

english_meaning: regret, remorse, disappointment
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为没有做成某事或没有达到某种目的而感到可惜或后悔的心情。
explanation_english: A feeling of sadness, disappointment, or regret, typically because something has not happened or been done as well as it could have been.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係好憾，如果當時我努力啲就好喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 haam6, jyu4 gwo2 dong1 si4 ngo5 nou5 lik6 di1 zau6 hou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真的很遗憾，如果当时我再努力一点就好了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is truly regrettable. If I had worked harder at that time, it would have been better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對冇機會去旅行覺得好遺憾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 mou5 gei1 wui2 heoi3 leoi5 haang4 gok3 dak1 hou2 wai4 haam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对于没有机会去旅行感到很遗憾。
examples.english_sentence: He feels a great sense of regret for not having the opportunity to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想人生留低任何遺憾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 jan4 sang1 lau4 dai1 jam6 ho4 wai4 haam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想人生留下任何遗憾。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to leave any regrets in my life.

english_meaning: regretful matter; regrettable incident; something to be regretted
explanation_mandarin: 令人感到遗憾的事情，未完成或未尽力的事情。
explanation_english: Something regrettable; a situation or event that causes regret due to being unfinished, unsatisfactory, or not done to the fullest extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇讀大學係我人生嘅一件憾事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 duk6 daai6 hok6 hai6 ngo5 jan4 sang1 ge3 jat1 gin6 haam6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没上大学是我人生的一件憾事。
examples.english_sentence: Not having gone to university is a regretful thing in my life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最後冇結婚，真係一件憾事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 mou5 git3 fan1, zan1 hai6 jat1 gin6 haam6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最后没结婚，真是一件憾事。
examples.english_sentence: It's truly a regrettable thing that they didn't get married in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 輸咗場比賽係好大嘅憾事，但係我哋下次會更加努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 zo2 coeng4 bi2 coi3 hai6 hou2 daai6 ge3 haam6 si6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 haa6 ci3 wui gaa1 gang3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 输掉比赛是很大的遗憾，但是我们下次会更加努力。
examples.english_sentence: Losing the game is a great regret, but we will work harder next time.

english_meaning: to understand, to know
explanation_mandarin: 了解、明白事物的道理或含义。
explanation_english: To understand, to comprehend the meaning or principles of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明唔明我講緊乜嘢呀？你聽唔聽得懂呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 m4 ming4 ngo5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5 aa3? nei5 teng1 m4 teng1 dak1 dung2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明白我在说什么吗？你听得懂吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you understand what I'm saying? Can you understand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好懂你嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 dung2 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太明白你的意思。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really understand what you mean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懂事㗎，唔使人擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 dung2 si6 gaa3, m4 sai2 jan4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂事，不用人担心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very sensible, no need to worry about him.

english_meaning: sensible; thoughtful; understanding; responsible (especially for a child)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人明事理，会体谅别人，尤其是指小孩很乖，比较成熟。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is sensible, understanding, and considerate, especially referring to a child who is well-behaved and relatively mature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好懂事，識得幫手做家務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 hou2 dung2 si6, sik1 dak1 bong1 sau2 zou6 gaa1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩很懂事，会帮忙做家务。
examples.english_sentence: This child is very sensible and knows how to help with chores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懂事，唔會亂咁使錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 dung2 si6, m4 wui5 lyun6 gam2 sai2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂事，不会乱花钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very responsible and doesn't spend money recklessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都咁大個，要懂事啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gam3 daai6 go3, jiu3 dung2 si6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都这么大了，要懂事一点了。
examples.english_sentence: You're so old now, you need to be more responsible.

english_meaning: to understand; to know; to be aware of; to comprehend
explanation_mandarin: 表示明白事理，了解，或掌握某种技能。
explanation_english: To understand a principle, to know something, or to have mastered a skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你懂唔懂得講廣東話啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dung2 m4 dung2 dak1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你懂不懂说广东话？
examples.english_sentence: Do you understand how to speak Cantonese?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懂得點樣氹人開心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 dung2 dak1 dim2 yeung2 tam5 yan4 hoi1 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得怎样哄人开心。
examples.english_sentence: He really knows how to make people happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔懂得修理呢部電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 dung2 dak1 sau1 lei5 ni1 bou6 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不懂得修理这台电脑。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to repair this computer.

english_meaning: diligent, attentive, solicitous, eager to please
explanation_mandarin: 形容人殷勤，勤快，非常乐意帮助别人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is diligent, attentive, and eager to please; willing to help others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對客人好懃力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 haak3 yan4 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对客人很殷勤。
examples.english_sentence: He is very attentive to the guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懃啦，我自己嚟就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 kan4 laa1, ngo5 zi6 gei2 lai4 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么殷勤，我自己来就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so solicitous, I can do it myself.

mandarin_meaning: 诚恳; 恳切; 恳请
english_meaning: sincere; earnest; earnestly request
explanation_mandarin: 形容词：形容态度真诚，感情真挚； 动词：诚恳地请求。
explanation_english: Adjective: Describing a sincere and earnest attitude; Verb: To earnestly request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懇切咁求我幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 han2 cit3 gam2 kau4 ngo5 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常诚恳地求我帮他。
examples.english_sentence: He earnestly asked me to help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度好懇，令我覺得佢係真心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 han2, ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hai6 zan1 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度很诚恳，让我觉得他是真心的。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is very sincere, making me feel that he is genuine.

english_meaning: sincere; earnest; cordial
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度诚恳、真挚。
explanation_english: Describing an attitude as sincere, earnest, and genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋懇切希望你可以考慮吓我哋嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 han2 cit3 hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 kaau2 leoi6 haa5 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们恳切希望你可以考虑一下我们的建议。
examples.english_sentence: We sincerely hope that you can consider our suggestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用懇切嘅眼神望住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 han2 cit3 ge3 ngaan5 san4 mong6 jyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用恳切的眼神看着我。
examples.english_sentence: He looked at me with sincere eyes.

english_meaning: to implore; to beseech; to plead earnestly
explanation_mandarin: 诚恳地请求。
explanation_english: To earnestly and sincerely request something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我懇求你俾多次機會我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 han2 kau4 nei5 bei2 do1 ci3 gei1 wui2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我恳求你再给我一次机会吧！
examples.english_sentence: I implore you, please give me another chance!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不斷噉懇求阿媽原諒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 dyun6 gam2 han2 kau4 aa3 maa1 jyun4 loeng6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不断地恳求妈妈原谅他。
examples.english_sentence: He kept imploring his mother to forgive him.

english_meaning: earnestly request; sincerely implore
explanation_mandarin: 诚恳地请求。
explanation_english: To earnestly and sincerely request someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我懇請你幫幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 han2 cing2 nei5 bong1 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我恳请你帮帮我。
examples.english_sentence: I earnestly request you to help me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋懇請各位支持我哋嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 han2 cing2 gok3 wai2 zi1 chi4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们恳请各位支持我们的工作。
examples.english_sentence: We earnestly request everyone to support our work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大會懇請各位保持肅靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 wui2 han2 ching2 gok3 wai2 bou2 chi4 suk1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大会恳请各位保持肃静。
examples.english_sentence: The committee earnestly requests everyone to remain silent.

english_meaning: lax, negligent, slack, relaxed
explanation_mandarin: 表示精神状态不集中，不努力；松懈。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being unfocused, not diligent, or relaxed and lacking effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近做嘢好懈，成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 je5 hou2 haai4, seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近工作很松懈，总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He's been very lax at work lately, always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懈呀，考試就嚟到㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 haai4 aa3, haau2 si5 zau6 lai4 dou3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么松懈啊，考试就要到了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slack, the exam is coming soon.

english_meaning: negligent, lax, slack, remiss
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事不认真，松懈懒散的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being not serious, lax, and lazy in doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懈怠呀，要做嘢㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 haai5 doi6 aa3, jiu3 zou6 je5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么懈怠呀，要做事啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so negligent, you need to work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好懈怠，成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 haai5 doi6, seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很懈怠，总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He's been very negligent lately, always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔努力，淨係識得懈怠，好快就會俾人淘汰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 nu5 lik6, zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 haai5 doi6, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 bei2 jan4 tau4 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不努力，只会懈怠，很快就会被人淘汰。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work hard and only know how to be negligent, you'll quickly be eliminated.

english_meaning: to answer; to respond; to agree; to comply; should; ought to; suitable; appropriate
explanation_mandarin: 有多重含义，包括答应、回应、适合等。作为动词，表示答应、回应；作为形容词，表示适合、应该。
explanation_english: Has multiple meanings, including to answer, respond, suitable, etc. As a verb, it means to answer or respond. As an adjective, it means suitable or should.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫佢嘅時候，佢有冇應你呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 keoi5 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 jau5 mou5 jing3 nei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你叫他的时候，他有没有回应你啊？
examples.english_sentence: When you called him, did he respond to you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫幾應你著㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 gei2 jing3 nei5 zoek3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服挺适合你穿的。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt suits you quite well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應該點做呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ying1 goi1 dim2 zou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我应该怎么做啊？
examples.english_sentence: What should I do?

english_meaning: to deal with; to cope with; to handle; to manage; to get by; to make do
explanation_mandarin: 处理，应付；敷衍了事。
explanation_english: To deal with a situation or person, sometimes implying doing so in a perfunctory or inadequate way.  Can also simply mean to cope or manage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好識得應付啲麻煩友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 sik1 dak1 ying3 fu6 di1 maa4 faan4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很懂得应付那些麻烦的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at dealing with troublesome people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲廣東話都係啱啱夠應付日常生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 dou1 hai6 ngaam1 ngaam1 gau3 ying3 fu6 jat1 sang1 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的广东话勉强能够应付日常生活。
examples.english_sentence: My Cantonese is just enough to cope with daily life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project 真係好難應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 ying3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目真的很棘手，很难应付。
examples.english_sentence: This project is really difficult to handle.

english_meaning: should be, ought to be, it's only right, it's one's duty
explanation_mandarin: 指事情本来就应该如此，理所当然，是份内之事。
explanation_english: Refers to something that should be done, it's only right and proper, it's one's duty or obligation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 照顧屋企人係應份嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu3 gu3 uk1 kei2 jan4 hai6 jing3 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照顾家人是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: Taking care of family is only right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫朋友係應份㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 pang4 jau5 hai6 jing3 fan6 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮助朋友是理所当然的嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Helping friends is only right, isn't it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我交稅係應份嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaau1 seoi3 hai6 jing3 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我交税是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: It's my duty to pay taxes.

english_meaning: to agree, to promise, to grant permission
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意、允许或答应做某事。
explanation_english: To agree to do something, to give permission, or to promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於應允咗我嘅請求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jing3 wan5 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ching2 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于答应了我的请求。
examples.english_sentence: He finally agreed to my request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應允咗佢會幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing3 wan5 zo2 keoi5 wui5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们答应了他会帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: We promised him that we would help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽唔應允我去咁夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 m4 jing3 wan5 ngo5 heoi3 gam3 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈不允许我去这么晚。
examples.english_sentence: My mother doesn't allow me to go out so late.

mandarin_meaning: 应该的, 理所当然的
english_meaning: one's duty, one's responsibility, should be, ought to be, it's only right (that)
explanation_mandarin: 指某件事是某人应该做的事情，或者某件事是理所当然的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that someone should do or that is a matter of course; something that is one's duty or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫屋企人做嘢係應分嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 uk1 kei5 jan4 zou6嘢係jing1 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮助家人做事是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: Helping family members is one's duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做細嘅，孝順父母係應分㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 sai3 ge3, haau3 seon6 fu6 mou5 hai6 jing1 fan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做儿女的，孝顺父母是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: As children, it's only right that we are filial to our parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀返錢你係應分嘅，佢之前借咗你錢嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 faan1 cin2 nei5 hai6 jing1 fan6 ge3, keoi5 zi1 cin4 ze3 zo2 nei5 cin2 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还钱给你是应该的，他之前借了你的钱嘛。
examples.english_sentence: It's only right that he returned the money to you, he borrowed it from you before.

english_meaning: to answer a call (usually for service); to respond to a summons (often with negative connotation referring to prostitution)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为回应召唤。 在特定语境下，特指妓女被召唤提供性服务。
explanation_english: Literally means to answer a call. In specific contexts, it often refers to a prostitute being summoned to provide sexual services. It carries a strong negative connotation in this sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人拉咗，話佢應召女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, waa6 keoi5 jing3 ziu6 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被人抓了，说她是应召女。
examples.english_sentence: She was arrested and accused of being a call girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為應召好搵錢，好多辛酸嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 jing3 ziu6 hou2 wan2 cin2, hou2 do1 san1 syun1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为做应召女很容易赚钱，有很多辛酸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that being a call girl is easy money, there are many hardships.

english_meaning: Call girl, prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指接受召唤提供性服务的女性。
explanation_english: A woman who provides sexual services upon being called or requested; a prostitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話佢係高級應召女郎，好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 gou1 kap1 ying3 zhaau1 neui5 long4, hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说她是高级应召女郎，很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: They say she's a high-class call girl, very expensive.

english_meaning: whether or not; should or should not
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择疑问，詢問是否應該做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates a choice or uncertainty about whether something should be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知應否同佢講真相好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 jing3 fau2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zan1 soeng2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道是否应该告诉他真相。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know whether or not I should tell him the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你認為我應否辭職？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing4 wai6 ngo5 jing3 fau2 ci4 zik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你认为我是否应该辞职？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think I should resign?

english_meaning: to deal with; to cope with; to handle; response; reply
explanation_mandarin: 处理、应付、答复。
explanation_english: To deal with a situation or person; to respond or reply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得應對唔同嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 jing3 deoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得如何应对不同的人。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to deal with different kinds of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到突發情況要冷靜應對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 dat6 faat3 cing4 kwong3 jiu3 laang5 ging6 jing3 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到突发情况要冷静应对。
examples.english_sentence: We should calmly deal with unexpected situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅應對好得體，令人覺得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jing3 deoi3 hou2 dak1 tai2, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的应对很得体，让人觉得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: His response was very appropriate, making people feel comfortable.

english_meaning: current year; this year's; graduating (year); the year of graduation
explanation_mandarin: 指当年毕业的，或在当年进行的（考试、活动等）。
explanation_english: Refers to graduating in the current year, or (examinations, activities, etc.) carried out in the current year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係應屆畢業生，而家搵緊工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 jing3 gaai3 bat1 jip6 sang1, ji4 gaa1 wan2 gan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是应届毕业生，现在正在找工作。
examples.english_sentence: I am a graduating student, and I'm looking for a job now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 應屆考生要好好準備考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing3 gaai3 haau2 sang1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zyun2 bei6 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 应届考生要好好准备考试。
examples.english_sentence: This year's candidates should prepare well for the exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司請應屆大學畢業生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 jing3 gaai3 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司招聘应届大学毕业生。
examples.english_sentence: This company is hiring recent university graduates.

english_meaning: in season; to be on the market
explanation_mandarin: 指某些商品（尤其是食物）在特定的季节或时期供应充足，适合购买和食用。也指上市销售。
explanation_english: Refers to goods (especially food) being plentiful and available for purchase and consumption during a specific season or period. Also refers to being on the market for sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲生果好應市㗎，而家食就啱曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sang1 gwo2 hou2 ying3 si5 gaa3, yi4 gaa1 sik6 zau6 ngaam1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些水果很应季，现在吃最合适了。
examples.english_sentence: These fruits are in season. It's the perfect time to eat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲大閘蟹開始應市喇，好多人都去買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 daai6 zaap6 haai5 hoi1 chi2 ying3 si5 laa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 heoi3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大闸蟹开始应季上市了，很多人都去买。
examples.english_sentence: Hairy crabs are now in season and on the market, many people are going to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年芒果唔係好應市，所以貴咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 mong1 gwo2 m4 hai6 hou2 ying3 si5, so2 ji5 gwai3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的芒果不是特别应季，所以贵了很多。
examples.english_sentence: This year's mangoes are not very in season, so they are much more expensive.

english_meaning: deserved; rightfully earned; entitled to
explanation_mandarin: 指某人理应得到的，合乎情理的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that someone deserves or is rightfully entitled to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係你應得㗎，你做得咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 nei5 jing3 dak1 gaa3, nei5 zou6 dak1 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是你应得的，你做得这么好。
examples.english_sentence: This is what you deserve, you did so well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞到獎金係應得嘅，佢一直都好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 dou2 zoeng2 gam1 hai6 jing3 dak1 ge3, keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他获得奖金是应得的，他一直都很努力。
examples.english_sentence: It's only right that he received the bonus, he has always worked very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 付出咗咁多，成功係應得嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 ceot1 zo2 gam3 do1, sing4 gung1 hai6 jing3 dak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 付出了这么多，成功是应得的。
examples.english_sentence: Having put in so much effort, success is deserved.

english_meaning: to apply (for a job); to answer an advertisement
explanation_mandarin: 接受招聘广告，主动申请职位。
explanation_english: To respond to a job advertisement and actively apply for a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我準備聽日去應徵嗰份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ying3 zing1 go2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我准备明天去应聘那份工作。
examples.english_sentence: I'm preparing to apply for that job tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應徵咗幾多份工啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying3 zing1 zo2 gei2 do1 fan6 gung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应聘了多少份工作啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many jobs have you applied for?

english_meaning: emergency, to meet an emergency
explanation_mandarin: 应对紧急情况，临时采取的措施。
explanation_english: To cope with an emergency situation, temporary measures taken to address the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要準備定啲應急物資，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun2 bei6 ding6 di1 ying3 gap1 mat6 zi1, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要准备一些应急物资，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: We need to prepare some emergency supplies in case of an emergency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係應急方案，如果原本嘅計劃唔work，就用呢個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ying3 gap1 fong1 on3, jyu4 gwo2 jyun4 bun2 ge3 gai3 waak6 m4 work, zau6 yung6 ni1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个应急方案，如果原本的计划行不通，就用这个。
examples.english_sentence: This is an emergency plan. If the original plan doesn't work, use this one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司設立咗一個應急小組，處理突發事件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sat6 lap6 zo2 jat1 go3 ying3 gap1 siu2 zou2, cyu2 lei5 dat6 faat3 si6 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司设立了一个应急小组，处理突发事件。
examples.english_sentence: The company has set up an emergency response team to handle unexpected events.

english_meaning: to accept a challenge; to engage in battle; to confront an opponent
explanation_mandarin: 接受挑战并进行对抗。
explanation_english: To accept a challenge and engage in combat or competition. It implies a willingness to confront an adversary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋向我哋挑機，我哋一定要應戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoeng3 ngo5 dei6 tiu1 gei1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ying3 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们向我们挑战，我们一定要应战。
examples.english_sentence: They challenged us, we definitely have to accept the challenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對逆境，我哋要積極應戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 jik6 ging2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zik1 gik1 ying3 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对逆境，我们要积极应战。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with adversity, we must actively confront it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定應戰呢場疫情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 ying3 zin3 ni1 coeng4 yik6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定应战这场疫情。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to combat this epidemic.

english_meaning: to promise, to agree, to consent
explanation_mandarin: 答应，同意，承诺。
explanation_english: To promise, to agree to do something, to give one's word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應承咗佢聽日同佢去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing3 sing4 zo2 keoi5 ting1 jat6 tung4 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我答应他明天和他去看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I promised him I would go to the movies with him tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗我就要做到㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing3 sing4 zo2 ngo5 zau6 jiu3 zou6 dou3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应了我就要做到！
examples.english_sentence: If you promised me, you must do it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應承我會幫我搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing3 sing4 ngo5 wui5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应我会帮我搬家。
examples.english_sentence: He promised me he would help me move house.

english_meaning: to be too busy to deal with (everything); to be overwhelmed; to have more than one can cope with
explanation_mandarin: 形容来人或事情太多，接待应付不过来。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there are too many people or things to handle, making it impossible to attend to everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾好多客嚟問價，忙到我哋應接不暇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 hou2 do1 haak3 lai4 man6 gaa3, mong4 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ying3 zip3 bat1 haa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年终有很多顾客来询价，忙得我们应接不暇。
examples.english_sentence: At the end of the year, many customers come to inquire about prices, keeping us so busy that we're overwhelmed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會門票一開賣就俾人搶晒，搞到售票處嘅職員應接不暇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yin2 cheung3 wui2 mun4 piu3 yat1 hoi1 maai6 jau6 bei2 yan4 cheung2 saai3, gaau2 dou3 sau6 piu3 chu3 ge3 jik1 yun4 ying3 zip3 bat1 haa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会门票一开卖就被抢光了，搞得售票处的职员应接不暇。
examples.english_sentence: The concert tickets sold out as soon as they went on sale, overwhelming the staff at the ticket office.

english_meaning: to support, to cheer on, to root for (a performer, group, or activity)
explanation_mandarin: 为某人或某事物加油、支持，通常指为偶像明星或体育赛事中的队伍加油助威，提供各种形式的支持。
explanation_english: To support or cheer on someone or something, typically referring to supporting idol stars or teams in sports events by providing various forms of support, such as cheering, buying merchandise, and attending events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚要去演唱會應援我嘅偶像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 jiu3 heoi3 jin2 cheung3 wui2 ying3 wun4 ngo5 ge3 ngau5 jeung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚要去演唱会应援我的偶像。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to the concert tonight to support my idol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好落力噉應援自己支持嘅球隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 lok6 lik6 gam2 ying3 wun4 zi6 gei2 chi1 chi4 ge3 kau4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们非常努力地应援自己支持的球队。
examples.english_sentence: They are very enthusiastically supporting the team they support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多 fans 都買應援物嚟支持佢哋嘅偶像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 fans dou1 maai5 ying3 wun4 mat6 lai4 chi1 chi4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ngau5 jeung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多粉丝都买应援物来支持他们的偶像。
examples.english_sentence: Many fans buy support merchandise to support their idols.

english_meaning: seasonal; in keeping with the season; to mark an occasion; festive
explanation_mandarin: 指为了配合某种特定的时节或场合而做的事物或行为，带有庆祝或纪念的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to things or actions done to coincide with a specific season or occasion, often carrying a celebratory or commemorative meaning. It means doing something appropriate for a particular season or occasion, to be festive or in the spirit of the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年梗係要買啲應景嘅裝飾品啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 gang2 hai6 jiu3 maai5 di1 jing3 ging2 ge3 zong1 sik1 ban2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年当然要买一些应景的装饰品啦。
examples.english_sentence: Of course we need to buy some seasonal decorations for the New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中秋節食月餅係應景嘅習俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 cau1 zit3 sik6 jyut6 beng2 hai6 jing3 ging2 ge3 zaap6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中秋节吃月饼是应景的习俗。
examples.english_sentence: Eating mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival is a seasonal custom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗應景，都買咗棵聖誕樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jing3 ging2, dou1 maai5 zo2 po1 sing3 daan3 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了应景，他也买了一棵圣诞树。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a Christmas tree to be festive.

english_meaning: Deserved retribution; what goes around comes around; reaping what you sow.
explanation_mandarin: 指做了坏事，理应受到这样的报应。
explanation_english: Refers to the karmic consequence of bad deeds; deserving the punishment or misfortune one receives due to one's past actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰格，俾人呃錢都係應有此報啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, bei2 jan4 aak1 cin2 dou1 hai6 jing3 jau5 ci2 bou3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么品行不好，被人骗钱也是罪有应得。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a terrible person, being scammed out of money is just deserved retribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日恰啲細路，而家俾人恰返，咪就係應有此報囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 hap1 di1 sai3 lou6, ji4 gaa1 bei2 jan4 hap1 faan1, mai6 zau6 hai6 jing3 jau5 ci2 bou3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是欺负小孩，现在被人欺负回来，那不是罪有应得吗？
examples.english_sentence: You always bully kids, now you're getting bullied back, isn't that just what you deserve?

synonyms: 罪有應得 (zeoi6 jau5 jing1 dak1)
自作自受 (zi6 zok3 zi6 sau6)

english_meaning: to have everything that one could wish for; to have all one needs; to be richly provided; to have everything imaginable
explanation_mandarin: 应该有的全都有。形容很齐全，应有的一切都有。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everything that is expected or desired is available. It signifies completeness and abundance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅設施應有盡有，無論你想游水定係做gym都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 sik1 si1 jing3 jau5 zeon6 jau5, mou4 leon6 nei5 soeng2 jau4 seoi2 ding6 hai6 zou6 gym1 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的设施应有尽有，无论你想游泳还是健身都可以。
examples.english_sentence: This hotel has everything you could wish for; whether you want to swim or work out at the gym, it's all available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋仔雖然細，但係入面嘅嘢應有盡有，住起嚟都幾舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 zai2 seoi1 jin4 sai3, daan6 hai6 jap6 min6 ge3 je5 jing3 jau5 zeon6 jau5, zyu6 hei2 lai4 dou1 gei2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家的小房子虽然小，但是里面的东西应有尽有，住起来也挺舒服的。
examples.english_sentence: Although his small house is small, it has everything one needs inside, so it's quite comfortable to live in.

english_meaning: cooperative; agreeable; willing to play along; to be a good sport; to go along with something for fun
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很配合，很会迎合气氛，一起凑热闹。通常是积极的、褒义的。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is cooperative, willing to play along, and knows how to contribute to a lively atmosphere. Usually positive and complimentary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好應棍㗎，叫佢做咩都肯。

explanation_mandarin: 适应时势的要求而产生。
explanation_english: To come into being as a result of a favorable or opportune situation or trend; to emerge in response to the times or circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 互聯網嘅普及，令到好多新嘅商業模式應運而生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 lyun4 mong5 ge3 puk1 gap3, ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 soeng1 jip6 mou4 sik1 jing3 wan6 ji4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 互联网的普及，使得许多新的商业模式应运而生。
examples.english_sentence: The popularization of the internet has led to the emergence of many new business models.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隨住人口老化，針對長者嘅服務應運而生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zoek6 jan4 hau2 lou5 faa3, zam1 deoi3 zoek3 zoeng2 ze2 ge3 fuk6 mou6 jing3 wan6 ji4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随着人口老化，针对老年人的服务应运而生。
examples.english_sentence: With the aging population, services targeting the elderly have emerged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情，網上教學就應運而生，解決咗學生停課嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jik6 cing4, mong5 soeng6 gaau3 hok6 zau6 jing3 wan6 ji4 sang1, gaai2 kyut3 zo2 hok6 sang1 ting4 fo3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情，网上教学就应运而生，解决了学生停课的问题。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the pandemic, online teaching emerged to solve the problem of students being unable to attend school.

english_meaning: to accept an invitation; at the invitation of
explanation_mandarin: 接受邀请。接受别人的邀请。
explanation_english: To accept an invitation; to be invited; to do something at someone's invitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應邀去咗佢屋企食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing3 yiu1 heoi3 zo2 keoi5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我应邀去了他家吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I accepted the invitation and went to his house for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋應邀出席咗個頒獎典禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jing3 yiu1 cheut1 sik6 zo2 go3 baan1 zoeng2 din2 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们应邀出席了颁奖典礼。
examples.english_sentence: They attended the awards ceremony at the invitation of the organizers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應邀喺研討會上發表演講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing3 yiu1 hai2 jin4 tou2 wui2 soeng5 faat3 biu2 jin2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他应邀在研讨会上发表演讲。
examples.english_sentence: He was invited to give a speech at the symposium.

english_meaning: socialize; have social intercourse; entertain
explanation_mandarin: 为了工作或社交需要而参加的交际活动。也指待人接物。
explanation_english: To socialize or have social intercourse, often for business or social reasons; to entertain (guests, clients, etc.). It also refers to handling interpersonal relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴晚去咗應酬，飲咗好多酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 ngaan1 heoi3 zo2 jing3 cau4, yam2 zo2 hou2 do1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚去应酬了，喝了很多酒。
examples.english_sentence: I went to a social gathering last night and drank a lot of alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都要應酬，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 jing3 cau4, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是要应酬，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: He always has to socialize, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意應酬啲客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 jing3 cau4 di1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢应酬那些客户。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like entertaining those clients.

english_meaning: to answer the door
explanation_mandarin: 去开门
explanation_english: To go and answer (open) the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，幫手應門啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, bong1 sau2 jing3 mun4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你，帮我开一下门！
examples.english_sentence: Please, help me answer the door!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到有人拍門，我去應門先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 dou2 jau5 jan4 paak3 mun4, ngo5 heoi3 jing3 mun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到有人敲门，我先去应门。
examples.english_sentence: I heard someone knocking on the door, I'll go answer it first.

english_meaning: to come true; to be fulfilled; to prove true
explanation_mandarin: 指预言、预感等成为事实，与预期的一致。
explanation_english: Refers to a prediction, premonition, etc. that becomes a reality, aligning with what was expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話今年會發達，估唔到真係應驗咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gam1 nin4 wui5 faat3 daat6, gu2 m4 dou3 zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说今年会发财，没想到真的应验了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would become rich this year, and unexpectedly it really came true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話我唔聽話，大個咗就會後悔，點知真係應驗咗，而家我真係好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 m4 ting1 waa6, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 wui5 hau6 fui3, dim2 zi1 zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2, ji4 gaa1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是说我不听话，长大了就会后悔，没想到真的应验了，现在我真的很后悔。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always said that if I didn't listen, I would regret it when I grew up. Turns out it really came true, and now I really regret it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話唔好亂咁講嘢，講得多就會應驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2 je5, gong2 dak1 do1 zau6 wui5 jing3 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说不要乱说话，说多了就会应验。
examples.english_sentence: People say you shouldn't talk nonsense, because the more you say it, the more likely it is to come true.

english_meaning: annoyed; vexed; regretful
explanation_mandarin: 表示因事情不如意而心里不舒服，后悔或烦恼。
explanation_english: Expressing a feeling of discomfort, regret, or annoyance due to something not going as desired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考得唔好，覺得好懊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, gok3 dak1 hou2 ngou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考得不好，觉得很懊恼。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well on the exam, and I feel very annoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗錯失咗個機會感到好懊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 co3 sat1 zo2 go3 gei1 wui6 gam2 dou3 hou2 ngou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为错失了那个机会感到很懊恼。
examples.english_sentence: He feels very regretful for missing that opportunity.

english_meaning: to regret, to repent
explanation_mandarin: 对过去所做的事情感到后悔，希望事情没有发生。
explanation_english: To feel regret or remorse for something one has done or failed to do in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好懊悔冇聽你嘅勸告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngou3 fui3 mou5 teng1 nei5 ge3 hyun3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很后悔没有听你的劝告。
examples.english_sentence: I really regret not listening to your advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懊悔自己噉樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngou3 fui3 zi6 gei2 gam2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他后悔自己这样做。
examples.english_sentence: He regrets doing it that way.

english_meaning: annoyed; upset; vexed; frustrated; regretful
explanation_mandarin: 形容因事不顺心而烦恼、不高兴。
explanation_english: To feel annoyed, upset, or frustrated due to something not going as planned or desired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日考試考得唔好，好懊惱呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, hou2 ngou3 nou5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天考试考得不好，很懊恼。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well on the exam yesterday, I'm very upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲到而錯過咗火車，覺得好懊惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ci4 dou3 ji4 co3 gwo3 zo2 fo2 ce1, gok3 dak1 hou2 ngou3 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为迟到而错过了火车，感到很懊恼。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very frustrated because he was late and missed the train.

english_meaning: careful; cautious; cold; chilly
explanation_mandarin: 形容天气寒冷，或形容小心谨慎的样子。
explanation_english: Describes cold weather, or describes the appearance of being careful and cautious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好懍啊，記得着多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 lam4 aa3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很冷啊，记得多穿一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is very chilly today, remember to wear an extra layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢要懍啲，唔好咁大頭蝦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 jiu3 lam4 di1, m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 tau4 haa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事要小心谨慎一点，不要这么粗心。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be more careful in your work, don't be so careless.

mandarin_meaning: 舒适; 安适; 惬意
english_meaning: comfortable; cosy; pleasant; at ease
explanation_mandarin: 表示感觉舒适、安逸。形容环境或状态令人感到放松愉快。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of comfort, ease, and contentment. Characterizes an environment or state that makes one feel relaxed and happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張梳化好懕啊，坐落去唔想起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 so1 faa2 hou2 ngam1 aa3, co5 lok6 heoi3 m4 soeng2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张沙发很舒服啊，坐下去就不想起来。
examples.english_sentence: This sofa is very comfortable; I don't want to get up once I sit down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲氣氛好懕，好啱傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 hei3 fan1 hou2 ngam1, hou2 ngaam1 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的气氛很舒适，很适合聊天。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere of this restaurant is very pleasant and suitable for chatting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房佈置到好懕，令人覺得好放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 bou3 zi3 dou3 hou2 ngam1, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间布置得很舒适，让人觉得很放松。
examples.english_sentence: The room is decorated in a very comfortable way, making people feel very relaxed.

english_meaning: muddled, confused, dazed, ignorant
explanation_mandarin: 形容人头脑不清楚，反应迟钝，迷糊。 也可表示什么都不懂，无知。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being unclear-headed, slow to react, muddled or ignorant. It can also mean not understanding anything, or being ignorant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢懞盛盛咁呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 mung4 sing4 sing4 gam2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在做什么，怎么这么迷糊啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing? Why are you so dazed?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我头先瞓醒，个人仲有啲懞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 fan3 sing2, go3 jan4 zung6 jau5 di1 mung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚睡醒，人还有点糊涂。
examples.english_sentence: I just woke up, and I'm still a little muddled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢对呢方面嘅嘢好懞下嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 fong1 min6 ge3 je5 hou2 mung4 haa5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这方面的东西很无知。
examples.english_sentence: He is quite ignorant about this area.

english_meaning: cowardly, weak, timid
explanation_mandarin: 形容人缺乏勇气，胆小怕事。
explanation_english: Describes a person lacking courage, being timid and afraid of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懦啦，試下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 no6 laa1, si3 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么懦弱了，试试吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cowardly, give it a try!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好懦，乜都唔敢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 no6, mat1 dou1 m4 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很懦弱，什么都不敢做。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very cowardly person, he doesn't dare to do anything.

english_meaning: coward
explanation_mandarin: 胆小怕事的人。
explanation_english: A person who lacks courage in the face of danger, pain, or opposition; a coward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪做個懦夫啦，去同佢講清楚！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 zou6 go3 no6 fu1 laa1, heoi3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 cing1 co2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做个懦夫，去和他说清楚！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a coward, go and talk to him clearly!

english_meaning: cowardly, weak, timid
explanation_mandarin: 缺乏勇气和胆量，胆小怕事。
explanation_english: Lacking courage; easily frightened; timid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁懦弱啦，試下勇敢啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 no6 joek6 laa1, si3 haa5 jung2 gam2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么懦弱了，试着勇敢一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cowardly, try to be a bit braver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅懦弱令佢錯失咗好多機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 no6 joek6 ling6 keoi5 co3 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的懦弱让他错失了很多机会。
examples.english_sentence: His cowardice caused him to miss many opportunities.

english_meaning: listless; languid; weary; spiritless
explanation_mandarin: 形容精神萎靡，沒有活力。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being listless, lacking energy and vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病咗之後，成個人都懨懨哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 jim1 jim1 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生病之后，整个人都恹恹的。
examples.english_sentence: After being sick, I feel very listless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似有啲懨，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 jim1, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像有点没精神，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He seems a bit listless today, I wonder what happened.

english_meaning: to punish; punishment; to discipline
explanation_mandarin: 惩罚，使人因错误或罪行受到处罚。
explanation_english: To punish; to discipline; to inflict a penalty or hardship on someone for a wrong doing or offence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁曳，梗要受到懲罰㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jai6, gang2 jiu3 sau6 dou2 cing4 fat6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么调皮，肯定要受到惩罚的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so naughty, you will definitely be punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係佢應得嘅懲罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 keoi5 ying1 dak1 ge3 cing4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是他应得的惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: This is the punishment he deserves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔會隨便懲罰員工嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 wui5 ceoi4 bin2 cing4 fat6 yun4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不会随便惩罚员工的。
examples.english_sentence: The company won't punish employees randomly.

english_meaning: to discipline; to punish (as a form of discipline); disciplinary action
explanation_mandarin: 以示警戒或惩罚的手段或行为。动词时，指施行惩罚；名词时，指惩罚的行为或结果。
explanation_english: An act or means of punishment or warning. As a verb, it refers to administering punishment; as a noun, it refers to the act or result of punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為違反紀律而受到懲戒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai4 faan2 wan6 gei2 leot6 ji4 sau6 dou2 cing4 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为违反纪律而受到了惩戒。
examples.english_sentence: They were disciplined for violating discipline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師決定要對佢哋作出嚴厲嘅懲戒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 jok3 ceot1 jim4 lai6 ge3 cing4 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师决定要对他们做出严厉的惩戒。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher decided to impose a severe punishment on them.

english_meaning: Correctional Services Department
explanation_mandarin: 香港特别行政区政府负责监管监狱、羁留中心及其他惩教机构的部门。
explanation_english: The government department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region responsible for the administration of prisons, detention centres and other correctional institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺懲敎署做嘢，負責管理監獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cing4 gaau3 cyu5 zou6 je5, fu3 zaak3 gun2 lei5 gaam1 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在惩教署工作，负责管理监狱。
examples.english_sentence: He works at the Correctional Services Department and is responsible for managing the prison.

english_meaning: Correctional institution; prison
explanation_mandarin: 指监狱或劳教所等惩罚和教育犯罪人员的场所。
explanation_english: A correctional institution is a place where individuals convicted of crimes are incarcerated; a prison or penitentiary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗法，入咗懲教所三年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 faat3, jap6 zo2 cing4 gaau3 so2 saam1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了法，进了惩教所三年。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the law and went to a correctional institution for three years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 懲教所嘅生活好辛苦，一定要好好反省。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 gaau3 so2 ge3 sang1 wut6 hou2 san1 fu2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 faan2 sing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 惩教所的生活很辛苦，一定要好好反省。
examples.english_sentence: Life in a correctional institution is very hard; you must reflect on your actions.

english_meaning: Correctional Services Department
explanation_mandarin: 香港特别行政区政府保安局辖下的部门，负责监管监狱、羁留中心等，以及为在囚人士提供更生服务。
explanation_english: The Correctional Services Department (CSD) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government, under the Security Bureau, is responsible for the management of prisons, detention centers, etc., and for providing rehabilitation services to inmates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿哥喺懲教署做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 go1 hai2 cing4 gaau3 cyu5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哥哥在惩教署工作。
examples.english_sentence: His older brother works for the Correctional Services Department.

english_meaning: to punish; to discipline; to bring to justice
explanation_mandarin: 对犯错误或犯罪的人进行惩罚和整治。
explanation_english: To punish or discipline someone who has made a mistake or committed a crime; to bring to justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗咁大嘅罪，一定要嚴懲治佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 gam3 daai6 ge3 zeoi6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 jim4 cing4 zi6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了这么大的罪，一定要严惩他。
examples.english_sentence: He committed such a serious crime, he must be severely punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污嘅官員應該要受到懲治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 ge3 gun1 jyun4 jing1 goi1 jiu3 sau6 dou3 cing4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污的官员应该受到惩治。
examples.english_sentence: Corrupt officials should be punished.

english_meaning: punishment, to punish
explanation_mandarin: 对犯错误的人给予处分，使其受到教训。
explanation_english: The infliction or suffering of punishment as retribution for wrongdoing; to punish someone for a crime or misdeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為考試作弊而被學校懲罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 haau2 si5 zok3 bai6 ji4 bei6 hok6 haau6 cing4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为考试作弊而被学校惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: He was punished by the school for cheating on the exam.

english_meaning: to punish; punishment; disciplinary action
explanation_mandarin: 对犯错误的人或事进行惩罚处理。
explanation_english: To punish someone for wrongdoing; the act of punishing someone for wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為考試作弊而受到學校嘅懲處。

examples.english_sentence: He was punished by the school for cheating on the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會對違反紀律嘅員工作出嚴厲嘅懲處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 deoi3 wai4 faan2 gei2 leot6 ge3 wun4 gung1 zok3 chut1 jim4 lai6 ge3 cing4 cyu2.

examples.english_sentence: The company will impose severe punishment on employees who violate discipline.
