english_meaning: muddle-headed; dazed; confused; stunned; ignorant; foolish
explanation_mandarin: 形容头脑不清楚、反应迟钝，或对事情不了解的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being unclear-headed, slow to react, or unaware of what is happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完之後，成個人都懵晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naam6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 mung2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，整个人都懵了。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he was completely dazed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先撞親個頭，而家有啲懵懵哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 zong6 can1 go3 tau4, ji4 gaa1 jau5 di1 mung2 mung2 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才撞到头，现在有点迷糊。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped my head earlier, and now I feel a bit dazed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁懵下懵下啦，快啲做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mung2 haa5 mung2 haa5 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么糊里糊涂的，快点工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so muddle-headed, hurry up and get to work!

english_meaning: idiot, fool, blockhead, dimwit
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，反应迟钝。略带贬义。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is foolish, stupid, or slow-witted. It carries a slightly derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係懵丙㗎喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 mung2 bing2 gaa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你连这个都不懂，真是个傻瓜啊。
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this? You're really an idiot.

english_meaning: fool, simpleton, idiot, clueless person
explanation_mandarin: 指愚笨、糊涂的人，带贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a foolish, muddleheaded, or clueless person. Often used in a derogatory way, but can also be used affectionately, especially towards children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁懵仔啦，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mung2 zai2 laa1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么傻啦，这么简单的事情都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a fool. You can't even do something so simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好懵仔㗎，成日跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 hou2 mung2 zai2 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩子很傻的，经常摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is quite clumsy; he falls all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁懵仔，提防啲騙子呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 mung2 zai2, tai4 fong4 di1 pin3 zi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么傻，提防着点骗子啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so naive, be careful of scammers.

mandarin_meaning: 迷幻药；使人迷糊的药物
english_meaning: Date rape drug; drug that causes confusion or disorientation
explanation_mandarin: 一种非法药物，通常指使人失去意识或判断力的药物，常用于性侵犯等犯罪活动中。 比喻让人糊里糊涂的手段或事物。
explanation_english: An illegal drug, often referring to a drug that causes a person to lose consciousness or judgment, commonly used in crimes such as sexual assault. Figuratively refers to methods or things that make people confused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好飲陌生人俾你嘅嘢，分分鐘係懵仔丸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 yam2 mak6 sang1 jan4 bei2 nei5 ge3嘢, fan1 fan1 cung1 cung1 hai6 mung2 zai2 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，不要喝陌生人给你的东西，很可能是迷幻药。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't drink anything given to you by strangers, it could very well be a date rape drug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司用好多懵仔丸嘅手法，呃啲客買佢哋嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yung6 hou2 do1 mung2 zai2 jyun2 ge3 sau2 faat3, aak1 di1 haak3 maai5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司用了很多让人糊涂的手段，骗那些顾客买他们的产品。
examples.english_sentence: That company used a lot of confusing tactics to trick those customers into buying their products.

english_meaning: bad debt; uncollectible account; book for recording bad debts
explanation_mandarin: 用来记录无法收回的债务的账簿。比喻永远收不回来的东西，永远无法实现的目标。
explanation_english: A book or record used to keep track of debts that are unlikely to be recovered. Figuratively, it refers to something that is permanently uncollectible or an unachievable goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢借咗畀佢，擺明係入咗懵仔簿㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 ze3 zo2 bei2 keoi5, baai2 ming4 hai6 jap6 zo2 mung2 zai2 bou2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱借给他，很明显就是成了呆账了。
examples.english_sentence: Lending money to him, it's obviously gone into the bad debt book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃睇嚟都係入懵仔簿㗎喇，唔會有成果㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 tai2 lai4 dou1 hai6 jap6 mung2 zai2 bou2 gaa3 laa3, m4 wui5 jau5 sing4 gwo2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划看来是要变成坏账了，不会有成果的。
examples.english_sentence: This project seems to be going into the bad debt book, there won't be any results.

mandarin_meaning: 迷魂药；使人昏迷的药物
english_meaning: Date rape drug; a drug that causes confusion or unconsciousness; literally "fool needle"
explanation_mandarin: 一种使人昏迷或意识模糊的药物，常用于犯罪行为，如性侵犯或盗窃。 "懵仔" 指容易受骗的人，"針" 指针，引申为药物。
explanation_english: A drug that induces confusion or unconsciousness, often used in criminal activities such as sexual assault or theft. "Mung Zai" refers to someone easily fooled, and "Zam" means needle, extended to mean drug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺酒吧要小心啲，千祈唔好飲陌生人畀你嘅嘢飲，費事中咗懵仔針啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 jyu1 baa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 jam2 mak6 sang1 jan4 bei2 nei5 ge3 je5 jam2, fai3 si6 zung3 zo2 mung2 zai2 zam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在酒吧要小心点，千万不要喝陌生人给你的饮料，免得中了迷魂药。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful in the bar, never drink anything given to you by a stranger, in case it's laced with a date rape drug.

english_meaning: fool, idiot, simpleton
explanation_mandarin: 指头脑不清醒、糊涂、愚笨的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a foolish, clueless, or unintelligent person; a simpleton or idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢啦，真係成個懵佬咁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, zan1 hai6 seng4 go3 mung2 lou2 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨了，真像个傻瓜一样！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you're really like an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做啲無厘頭嘅嘢，成日俾人話佢係懵佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 mou4 lei4 tau4 ge3 je5, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 waa6 keoi5 hai6 mung2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是做一些莫名其妙的事情，总是被人说他是傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: He always does nonsensical things and is often called a fool.

english_meaning: Extremely clueless, hopelessly confused; so stupid it's obvious.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常糊涂，迟钝，反应慢，甚至到了让人一眼就能看出来的地步。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely clueless, slow, or unresponsive, to the point where it's glaringly obvious to others. It implies a level of stupidity that is easily perceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都懵到上心口，唔知佢點樣返工嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mung2 dou3 soeng5 sam1 hau2, m4 zi1 keoi5 dim2 joeng2 faan1 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是糊里糊涂的，不知道他是怎么上班的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always extremely clueless, I don't know how he manages to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁懵到上心口啦，講咗咁多次都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mung2 dou3 soeng5 sam1 hau2 laa1, gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么糊涂了，都说了这么多次还不明白。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clueless, I've explained it so many times and you still don't understand.

english_meaning: idiot, fool, simpleton
explanation_mandarin: 指愚笨，糊涂的人。带有贬义，语气强烈。
explanation_english: A derogatory term referring to a foolish, stupid, or clueless person. The tone is quite strong and offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢咁懵卵呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 mung2 leon2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干什么这么傻啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being such an idiot?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係懵卵嚟嘅，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 mung2 leon2 lai4 ge3, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个傻瓜，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a fool, doesn't know anything.

english_meaning: Dazed and confused; looking blank and bewildered
explanation_mandarin: 形容人神情呆滞，一时反应不过来，有点傻乎乎的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who looks dazed, confused, and slow to react, often with a blank expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱起身，懵口懵面咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hei2 san1, mung2 hau2 mung2 min6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚起床，傻乎乎的。
examples.english_sentence: He just woke up, looking all dazed and confused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撞車之後，佢懵口懵面，乜都唔記得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong6 ce1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 mung2 hau2 mung2 min6, me1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车祸之后，他神情呆滞，什么都不记得了。
examples.english_sentence: After the car accident, he was dazed and confused, and couldn't remember anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到老闆炒佢魷魚，佢即刻懵口懵面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 lou5 baan2 caau2 keoi5 jau4 jyu2, keoi5 zik1 hak1 mung2 hau2 mung2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到老板解雇他，他立刻懵住了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the boss fire him, he immediately looked dazed and confused.

english_meaning: ignorant; muddled; confused; innocent (of world affairs)
explanation_mandarin: 指人对事物不了解，迷糊不清醒的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being unaware, unclear, or confused about things; innocent and naive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣好懵懂，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 mung2 dung2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候很懵懂，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He was very ignorant when he was young and didn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好怪佢，佢仲係懵懂少年，唔識得人情世故。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwaai3 keoi5, keoi5 zung6 hai6 mung2 dung2 siu3 nin4, m4 sik1 dak1 jan4 cing4 sai3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要怪他，他还是懵懂少年，不懂人情世故。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame him, he's still a naive teenager and doesn't understand the ways of the world.

english_meaning: a little bit confused; slightly dazed; a bit spacey
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有点迷糊，不太清醒，反应迟钝。程度较轻。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is a little bit confused, not very clear-headed, or slow to react. It implies a mild state of confusion or dazedness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱瞓醒，仲有啲懵懵哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 fan3 sing2, zung6 jau5 di1 mung2 mung2 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚睡醒，还有点懵懵的。
examples.english_sentence: He just woke up and is still a bit spacey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗酒，個人懵懵哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zo2 zau2, go3 jan4 mung2 mung2 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝了酒，人有点迷糊。
examples.english_sentence: He drank alcohol, and he's a bit dazed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我頭先有啲懵懵哋，冇聽到你講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 tau4 sin1 jau5 di1 mung2 mung2 dei2, mou5 teng1 dou2 nei5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我刚才有点糊涂，没听到你说什么。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I was a bit out of it just now and didn't hear what you said.

english_meaning: muddled, confused, dim-witted; absent-minded
explanation_mandarin: 形容人头脑不清醒，迷糊，反应迟钝，有点傻。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is muddled, confused, slow to understand, or a bit dim-witted. It can also describe someone who is absent-minded or not paying attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都懵懵閉閉咁，做嘢都唔知醒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mung2 mung2 bai3 bai3 gam2, zou6 je5 dou1 m4 zi1 sing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是迷迷糊糊的，工作也不知道醒目点。
examples.english_sentence: You're always so muddled, you don't even know how to be alert when you're working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似懵懵閉，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 mung2 mung2 bai3, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像迷迷糊糊的，不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He seems absent-minded today, I don't know what's up with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好懵懵閉閉咁行過馬路，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mung2 mung2 bai3 bai3 gam2 haang4 gwo3 maa5 lou6, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要迷迷糊糊地过马路，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk across the road in a daze, it's very dangerous.

english_meaning: idiot, moron, fool (very vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 非常粗俗的粤语词汇，指愚蠢、迟钝的人。带有强烈的贬义和侮辱色彩。
explanation_english: A very vulgar Cantonese term used to describe someone who is stupid, foolish, or slow-witted. It carries a strong negative and insulting connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪懵撚㗎？咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai6 mung2 lan2 gaa3? gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是傻逼吗？这么简单的东西都不会做！
examples.english_sentence: Are you an idiot? You can't even do something so simple!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪同個懵撚講咁多嘢啦，佢都唔明嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tung4 go3 mung2 lan2 gong2 gam3 do1 je5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 m4 ming4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别跟那个傻逼说那么多，他都不明白的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk so much to that idiot, he won't understand.

english_meaning: fool, idiot, blockhead, clueless person
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，反應遲鈍，容易上当受骗。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is foolish, slow-witted, easily tricked, or lacking in common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁懵炳啦，人哋呃你都唔知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mung2 bing2 laa1, jan4 dei6 aak1 nei5 dou1 m4 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么傻了，别人骗你都不知道！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foolish, you don't even know when people are tricking you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日懵懵炳炳，真係唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 mung2 mung2 bing2 bing2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是糊里糊涂的，真不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so clueless when he works, I really don't know what to do.

english_meaning: completely unaware, totally ignorant, oblivious
explanation_mandarin: 形容对情况完全不了解，没有察觉。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being completely unaware of a situation; lacking any perception or understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掛住打機，對屋企發生嘅事懵然不知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1, deoi3 uk1 kei5 faat3 sang1 ge3 si6 mung2 jin4 bat1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天沉迷于打游戏，对家里发生的事情浑然不知。
examples.english_sentence: He's always engrossed in playing video games, completely unaware of what's happening at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時我懵然不知自己嘅決定會帶來咁大嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 mung2 jin4 bat1 zi1 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyut3 ding6 wui5 daai3 loi4 gam3 daai6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时我完全不知道自己的决定会带来这么大的影响。
examples.english_sentence: At that time, I was completely unaware that my decision would have such a big impact.

english_meaning: dazed, clueless, absent-minded, in a confused or befuddled state
explanation_mandarin: 形容人头脑不清醒，迷糊，不明白情况。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not clear-headed, confused, or unaware of the situation. Implies a state of being somewhat out of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都懵盛盛咁，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mung2 sing6 sing6 gam2, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是糊里糊涂的，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so dazed, I don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜懵盛盛咁行出馬路呀？好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 mung2 sing6 sing6 gam2 haang4 ceot1 maa5 lou6 aa3? hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛这么糊里糊涂地走到马路上？很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Why are you walking onto the road so cluelessly? It's very dangerous!

english_meaning: Scatterbrained, absent-minded, clueless, out of it
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常健忘，或者反应迟钝，经常犯迷糊。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very forgetful, slow to react, or often makes silly mistakes due to absent-mindedness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日懵神三星咁，小心整唔見嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 mung2 san4 saam1 sing1 gam2, siu2 sam1 zing2 m4 gin3 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是这么迷糊，小心丢东西啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're always so scatterbrained, be careful not to lose anything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似懵神三星咁，問佢咩都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 mung2 san4 saam1 sing1 gam2, man6 keoi5 me1 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像迷迷糊糊的，问他什么都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: He seems really out of it today, he doesn't know anything you ask him.

mandarin_meaning: 眼神呆滞; 眼神茫然
english_meaning: dazed look; blank stare; glazed eyes; vacant expression; dopey look
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人眼神呆滞，像猪一样，反应迟钝。通常带有轻微贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a person with a dazed or blank stare, resembling a pig's eyes, suggesting slow reaction and dullness. Usually carries a slightly derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢搞到咁懵豬眼啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gaau2 dou3 gam3 mung2 zyu1 ngaan5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做什么弄得这么眼神呆滞啊？
examples.english_sentence: What did you do to make you look so dazed?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都懵豬眼咁，好似瞓唔醒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mung2 zyu1 ngaan5 gam2, hou2 ci5 fan3 m4 sing2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都眼神茫然，好像没睡醒一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always has a glazed look, like he hasn't woken up properly.

english_meaning: Dazed, clueless, spaced out, in a stupor
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人反应迟钝，迷糊不清，搞不清楚状况。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slow to react, confused, and unaware of what's happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都懵閉閉咁，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mung2 bai1 bai1 gam2, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是傻乎乎的，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so dazed, I don't know what he's thinking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢咁懵閉閉呀？醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 mung2 bai1 bai1 aa3? sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在干什么傻乎乎的？清醒一点！
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing being so spaced out? Wake up!

english_meaning: lazy; idle
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不愿意工作或活动；不勤奋。
explanation_english: Describes someone unwilling to work or be active; not diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懶，成日都唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 laan5, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懒，整天都不做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, he doesn't do anything all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懶啦，快啲起身啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 laan5 laa1, faai3 di1 hei2 san1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么懒了，快点起床吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so lazy, get up quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁懶，第時點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 laan5, dai6 si4 dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么懒，以后怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're so lazy, what are you going to do in the future?

english_meaning: A lazy person uses a long thread (to sew); lazy people find clever ways to avoid work.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻懒人为了省事，会想出一些看似方便，但实际上可能效率不高甚至弄巧成拙的办法。强调懒人会用一些取巧的方式避免麻烦。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how lazy people often devise seemingly convenient but potentially inefficient or even counterproductive methods to avoid work. It emphasizes the tendency of lazy individuals to seek shortcuts to circumvent effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都遲到，但係又唔早啲起身，真係懶人使長線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 zou2 di1 hei2 san1, zan1 hai6 laan5 jan4 sai2 coeng4 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，但是又不早点起床，真是懒人有懒办法。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, but he doesn't wake up earlier. A lazy person finds a lazy way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣貪方便，懶人使長線，到時整壞咗咪仲麻煩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 taam1 fong1 bin6, laan5 jan4 sai2 coeng4 sin3, dou3 si4 zing2 waai6 zo2 mai1 zung6 maa4 faan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样贪图方便，懒人有懒办法，到时候弄坏了不是更麻烦吗？
examples.english_sentence: You are just looking for an easy way out, a lazy person's method. Wouldn't it be more troublesome if you break it in the end?

english_meaning: Cheat sheet, summary, simplified explanation (for lazy people)
explanation_mandarin: 指为了方便那些不愿花时间阅读冗长资料的人而提供的，经过精简和总结的信息集合，通常包含关键要点。
explanation_english: Refers to a compilation of simplified and summarized information, usually containing key points, designed to be easily digestible for those who are unwilling to spend time reading lengthy materials. It's a cheat sheet or a readily accessible summary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新聞嘅懶人包幫我快速理解咗成件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 man4 ge3 laan5 jan4 baau1 bong1 ngo5 faai3 suk1 lei5 gaai2 zo2 sing4 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新闻的懒人包帮我快速理解了整件事。
examples.english_sentence: This news cheat sheet helped me quickly understand the whole thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 準備考試嘅時候，最好自己整返個懶人包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3 ge3 si4 hau6, zeoi3 hou2 zi6 gei2 zeng2 faan1 go3 laan5 jan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 准备考试的时候，最好自己做一个懒人包。
examples.english_sentence: When preparing for the exam, it's best to make your own cheat sheet.

english_meaning: Lazy people have many problems; Lazy people make excuses a lot.
explanation_mandarin: 形容懒惰的人总是借口很多，事情还没开始做就有很多顾虑和问题。也指懒人麻烦多。
explanation_english: This idiom describes lazy people who always have many excuses and concerns before even starting to do something. It implies that lazy people tend to create more problems for themselves and others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁懶人多屎尿啦，快啲做埋佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 laan5 jan4 do1 si2 niu6 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 maai4 gei2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么懒人屎尿多，快点做完它吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so full of excuses, just finish it quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日懶人多屎尿，叫佢做嘢就話唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 laan5 jan4 do1 si2 niu6, giu3 keoi5 zou6 je5 zau6 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是找借口，叫他做事就说不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He's always full of excuses. When you ask him to do something, he says he's not feeling well.

mandarin_meaning: 偷懒的方法，简单省事的方法
english_meaning: Lazy man's Kung Fu; A simple, easy way of doing something; a shortcut.
explanation_mandarin: 指一种简单、省力，甚至有点偷懒的方式来完成某件事。通常指一些不正统但有效的方法。
explanation_english: Refers to a simple, effortless, and even somewhat lazy way of accomplishing something. Usually refers to unconventional but effective methods, or taking shortcuts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都用懶佬功夫，不過都幾有效率嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 laan5 lou2 gung1 fu1, bat1 gwo3 dou1 gei2 jau5 haau6 leot2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是用简单省事的方法，不过效率还挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses lazy man's kung fu to do things, but it's quite efficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住有懶佬功夫，要一步一步嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 jau5 laan5 lou2 gung1 fu1, jiu3 jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着有什么捷径，要一步一步来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think there's a shortcut, you have to take it step by step.

english_meaning: Lazy man's method; a simple and easy way (often implying a shortcut or a less professional approach); a quick and dirty solution.
explanation_mandarin: 指一种简单、省力，但可能不太精细或专业的做事方法。通常带有一种不求甚解，只想快速完成的态度。
explanation_english: Refers to a simple, effortless way of doing things, which may not be very refined or professional. It often implies an attitude of not seeking thorough understanding, but only wanting to complete the task quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住用啲懶佬工夫嚟搞掂份報告，但係結果錯漏百出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 yung6 di1 laan5 lou2 gung1 fu1 lai4 gaau2 dim6 fan6 bou3 gou3, daan6 hai6 git3 gwo2 co3 lau6 baak3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想用一些简便方法来完成报告，但是结果错误百出。
examples.english_sentence: He intended to use some lazy man's methods to finish the report, but the result was full of errors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住用懶佬工夫呀，呢啲嘢一定要認真做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 yung6 laan5 lou2 gung1 fu1 aa3, ni1 di1 ye5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jing6 zan1 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着用简便方法，这些东西一定要认真做啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about using lazy man's methods, you have to do these things seriously.

synonyms: 偷雞摸狗 (tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2)

english_meaning: recliner chair, easy chair
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以调整靠背角度，让人可以半躺或平躺的椅子，通常用来休息或放松。
explanation_english: A type of chair with a reclining back, allowing the user to sit in a semi-reclined or fully reclined position, typically used for resting or relaxing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我放工返到屋企，最鍾意就係坐喺懶佬椅度睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fong3 gung1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, zeoi3 zung1 jui3 zau6 hai6 co5 hai2 laan5 lou2 ji2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下班回到家，最喜欢的就是坐在躺椅上看电视。
examples.english_sentence: When I get home from work, my favorite thing is to sit in the recliner and watch TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日坐喺懶佬椅度瞓晏覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 laan5 lou2 ji2 dou6 fan3 aan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是坐在躺椅上午睡。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always takes a nap in the recliner.

english_meaning: Loafers; Slip-on shoes; Sandals (sometimes)
explanation_mandarin: 指容易穿脱的鞋子，通常不需要系鞋带。可以是便鞋、拖鞋或其他类似的鞋款。
explanation_english: Refers to shoes that are easy to slip on and off, typically without laces. This can include loafers, slip-on shoes, sandals, or other similar footwear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都著住對懶佬鞋周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zoek3 zyu6 deoi3 laan5 lou2 haai4 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿着一双便鞋到处走。
examples.english_sentence: He's always wearing a pair of loafers wherever he goes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天著懶佬鞋最舒服啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 zoek3 laan5 lou2 haai4 zeoi3 syu1 fuk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天穿便鞋最舒服了。
examples.english_sentence: It's most comfortable to wear slip-on shoes in summer.

english_meaning: acting as if one is something special; putting on airs; pretentious
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人自以为是，装模作样，觉得自己很了不起的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts as if they are special or superior; putting on airs; pretentious behavior. It often implies disapproval or mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年嘢啫，就懶係嘢噉，好似好叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 je5 ze1, zau6 laan5 hai6 je5 gam2, hou2 ci5 hou2 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作了几年而已，就装模作样，好像很厉害似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's only worked for a few years, but he's already acting as if he's something special, like he's very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懶係嘢啦，其實你都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 laan5 hai6 je5 laa1, kei4 sat6 nei5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么装模作样了，其实你都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pretentious, you don't even know.

english_meaning: lazy; indolent; disinclined to work
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人非常懶惰，不喜歡做事或工作，缺乏積極性。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very lazy, dislikes doing things or working, and lacks motivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好懶刮，成日瞓覺唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 laan5 gwaat3, seng4 jat6 fan3 gaau3 m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很懒惰，整天睡觉不做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's really lazy, sleeping all day and not doing anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁懶刮啦，快啲幫手做埋啲嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 laan5 gwaat3 laa1, faai3 di1 bong1 sau2 zou6 maai4 di1 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么懒惰了，快点帮忙把这些事做完吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so lazy, hurry up and help finish these things!

english_meaning: Lazy to the bone
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常懒惰，懒到深入骨髓，已经成为一种根深蒂固的习惯。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely lazy, lazy to the core, ingrained in their nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係懶到出骨，叫佢洗個碗都唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 laan5 dou3 ceot1 gwat1, giu3 keoi5 sai2 go3 wun2 dou1 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是懒到骨子里了，叫他洗个碗都不愿意。
examples.english_sentence: He's really lazy to the bone, he won't even wash a bowl when asked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好簡單啫，你都唔肯做？你懶到出骨㗎喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 gaan2 daan1 ze1, nei5 dou1 m4 hang2 zou6? nei5 laan5 dou3 ceot1 gwat1 gaa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很简单而已，你都不肯做？你真是懒到骨子里了。
examples.english_sentence: This job is simple, but you still don't want to do it? You are really lazy to the bone.

english_meaning: acting smart but actually not; pretending to be knowledgeable
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人明明不了解情况，却装作很懂的样子，卖弄小聪明。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts like they are very knowledgeable and smart, but in reality, they are not and are just showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁懶叻啦，你都唔識嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 laan5 lek1 laa1, nei5 dou1 m4 sik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么自作聪明了，你都不懂的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so smart, you don't even know about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都懶叻，但其實好多嘢都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 laan5 lek1, daan6 kei4 sat6 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是自作聪明，但其实很多东西都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts smart, but actually he doesn't know a lot of things.

english_meaning: to be too lazy to; to be bothered to
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为懒惰而不愿意做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates unwillingness to do something due to laziness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我懶得煮飯，我哋出去食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 laan5 dak1 zyu2 faan6, ngo5 dei6 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我懒得做饭，我们出去吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm too lazy to cook. Let's eat out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懶得理你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laan5 dak1 lei5 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他懒得理你。
examples.english_sentence: He can't be bothered to pay attention to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我懶得解釋咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 laan5 dak1 gaai2 sik1 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我懒得解释那么多。
examples.english_sentence: I can't be bothered to explain so much.

mandarin_meaning: 懒得炫耀; 懒得装模作样; 懒得摆架子
english_meaning: Too lazy to show off; Can't be bothered to act pretentious; Too lazy to put on airs
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人懒得炫耀自己，或者懒得装模作样，不想摆出高人一等的姿态。通常表示一种不屑于或不愿表现自己的态度。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is too lazy or unwilling to show off, act pretentious, or put on airs. It usually expresses an attitude of not bothering to or not wanting to exhibit oneself in a conceited or superior manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明好叻，但係懶得戚，好謙虛嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 laan5 dak1 cik1, hou2 him1 heoi1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明很厉害，但是懒得炫耀，很谦虚。
examples.english_sentence: He is obviously very capable, but he doesn't bother to show off; he's very humble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，有少少成就就猛咁曬命，好少見到咁懶得戚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2, jau5 siu2 siu2 sing4 zau6 zau6 maang5 gam2 saai3 ming6, hou2 siu2 gin3 dou3 gam3 laan5 dak1 cik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，有点成就就拼命炫耀，很少见到这么不爱显摆的。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people show off like crazy when they achieve something; it's rare to see someone so unwilling to flaunt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人就係咁，懶得戚，所以好多人鐘意同佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam2, laan5 dak1 cik1, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是这样的人，懒得装腔作势，所以很多人喜欢和他做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: That's just the kind of person he is; he doesn't bother putting on airs, so many people like to be friends with him.

synonyms: 唔鍾意曬命 (m4 zung1 ji3 saai3 ming6)

english_meaning: Too lazy to bother; don't feel like dealing with it
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为懒惰或觉得麻烦而不愿意去管、去理会某事。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of being too lazy or finding something too troublesome to deal with or manage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲嘢咁污糟，我懶得敕佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 je5 gam3 wu1 zou1, ngo5 laan5 dak1 cik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的东西那么脏，我懒得管他。
examples.english_sentence: His things are so dirty, I don't feel like dealing with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲客咁無理取鬧，真係懶得敕佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 haak3 gam3 mou4 lei5 cheoi2 naau6, zan1 hai6 laan5 dak1 cik1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些客人那么无理取闹，真是懒得理他们。
examples.english_sentence: Those customers are so unreasonable, I really can't be bothered to deal with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅恩情，我會懷住一世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 yan1 cing4, ngo5 wui5 waai4 zyu6 jat1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的恩情，我会铭记一辈子。
examples.english_sentence: I will remember your kindness for the rest of my life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅教誨，我一直懷住喺心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gaau3 fui3, ngo5 jat1 zik6 waai4 zyu6 hai2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的教诲，我一直铭记在心。
examples.english_sentence: I have always kept his teachings in my heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望大家懷住感恩嘅心面對每一日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 daai6 gaa1 waai4 zyu6 gam2 yan1 ge3 sam1 min6 deoi3 mui5 jat1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望大家怀着感恩的心面对每一天。
examples.english_sentence: I hope everyone faces each day with a grateful heart.

english_meaning: To reminisce about the past and cherish the present
explanation_mandarin: 怀念古代的事物，珍惜现在的时光。
explanation_english: To reflect on the past (often with fondness or regret) and appreciate the value of the present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇住呢啲舊相，真係令人懷古惜今。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 zyu6 ni1 di1 gau6 soeng2, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 waai4 gu2 sik1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看着这些老照片，真是令人怀古惜今。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at these old photos really makes one reminisce about the past and cherish the present.

english_meaning: pregnant
explanation_mandarin: 指女性受精卵在子宫内发育的过程。
explanation_english: The state of carrying a developing embryo or fetus within the female body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱發現自己懷孕，好開心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 faat3 hin1 zi6 gei2 waai4 jan6, hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她刚刚发现自己怀孕了，非常开心！
examples.english_sentence: She just found out she's pregnant and is very happy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢懷孕三個月喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 waai4 jan6 saam1 go3 jyut6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说她怀孕三个月了。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said she is three months pregnant.

english_meaning: to cherish the memory of; to think of; to reminisce
explanation_mandarin: 思念；回想并惦念。
explanation_english: To think fondly of someone or something from the past; to cherish the memory of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好懷念以前喺香港讀書嘅日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 waai4 nim6 ji5 cin4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 duk6 syu1 ge3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常怀念以前在香港读书的日子。
examples.english_sentence: I really miss the days when I studied in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日懷念阿嫲煮嘅飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 waai4 nim6 aa3 maa4 zyu2 ge3 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是怀念奶奶做的饭。
examples.english_sentence: They always miss the food cooked by their grandmother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次聽到呢首歌，都會懷念起以前嘅初戀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 ting1 dou2 ni1 sau2 go1, dou1 wui5 waai4 nim6 hei2 ji5 cin4 ge3 co1 lyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次听到这首歌，都会怀念起以前的初恋。
examples.english_sentence: Every time I hear this song, I reminisce about my first love.

english_meaning: to bear a grudge; to harbor resentment
explanation_mandarin: 心中怀着仇恨和不满，长期不能释怀。
explanation_english: To hold a grudge in one's heart; to harbor resentment and be unable to let go of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直懷恨在心，遲早都會報仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 waai4 han6 zoi6 sam1, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 bou3 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直怀恨在心，迟早都会报仇。
examples.english_sentence: He has been harboring resentment, sooner or later he will take revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好懷恨在心啦，放低佢，對你都好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 waai4 han6 zoi6 sam1 laa1, fong3 dai1 keoi5, deoi3 nei5 dou1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别怀恨在心了，放下它，对你也好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hold a grudge, let it go, it will be better for you.

english_meaning: To be talented but not appreciated; to have abilities but no opportunities
explanation_mandarin: 指有才能却得不到赏识和重用，境遇不好。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is talented and capable, but lacks the opportunity to showcase their abilities or be recognized and utilized effectively. Often implies feelings of frustration and disappointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己懷才不遇，所以辭咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 waai4 coi4 bat1 jyu6, so2 ji5 ci4 zo2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己怀才不遇，所以辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: He felt like he was not being appreciated for his talents, so he resigned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少大學畢業生都呻話好難搵到份可以發揮所長嘅工，覺得自己懷才不遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 sang1 dou1 san1 waa6 hou2 naan4 wan2 dou2 fan6 ho2 ji5 faat3 fai1 so2 coeng4 ge3 gung1, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 waai4 coi4 bat1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少大学毕业生都抱怨很难找到一份可以发挥所长的工作，觉得怀才不遇。
examples.english_sentence: Many university graduates complain that it's hard to find a job where they can fully utilize their talents, feeling like their abilities are wasted.

mandarin_meaning: 怀抱; 拥抱; 胸怀
english_meaning: embrace; bosom; aspiration; ambition; dream
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指胸前，通常是拥抱的姿势；动词：拥抱，比喻抱负、理想。
explanation_english: Noun: the chest, especially in the context of embracing; Verb: to embrace, figuratively referring to aspirations, ideals, or ambitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽將個BB抱入懷抱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zoeng1 go3 bi1 bi1 pou5 jap6 waai4 pou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈把宝宝抱入怀抱。
examples.english_sentence: The mother held the baby in her arms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢充滿對未來嘅懷抱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cung1 mun5 deoi3 mei6 loi4 ge3 waai4 pou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他充满对未来的憧憬。
examples.english_sentence: He is full of dreams for the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅懷抱好溫暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waai4 pou5 hou2 wan1 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的怀抱很温暖。
examples.english_sentence: His embrace is very warm.

english_meaning: to be lovesick; to be in the throes of first love (usually used of a young woman)
explanation_mandarin: 形容少女开始思慕异性，产生爱慕之情。
explanation_english: Describes a young woman beginning to feel romantic love and longing for a male companion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日發夢都夢見個男同學，睇嚟都係懷春啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 faat3 mung6 dou1 mung6 gin3 go3 naam4 tung4 hok6, tai2 lai4 dou1 hai6 waai4 ceon1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近总是做梦梦见那个男同学，看来是怀春了。
examples.english_sentence: She's been dreaming about that male classmate lately, seems like she's lovesick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，佢成日話我懷春，但我根本唔明佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 waai4 ceon1, daan6 ngo5 gan1 bun2 m4 ming4 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，她总是说我怀春，但我根本不明白她在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, she always said I was lovesick, but I didn't understand what she was talking about at all.

english_meaning: to appease; to pacify; to use a policy of conciliation
explanation_mandarin: 安抚，用温和的手段使对方归顺或减轻敌意。
explanation_english: To appease or pacify someone using gentle methods; to adopt a policy of conciliation to reduce hostility or encourage submission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該採取懷柔政策去解決社會問題，唔係淨係用強硬手段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 coi2 ceoi2 waai4 jau4 zing3 caak3 heoi3 gaai2 kyut3 se5 wui2 man6 tai4, m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 yung6 koeng5 ngaang6 sau2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该采取怀柔政策去解决社会问题，而不是仅仅使用强硬手段。
examples.english_sentence: The government should adopt a policy of appeasement to solve social problems, instead of solely using harsh measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想用懷柔嘅方式去處理勞資糾紛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 yung6 waai4 jau4 ge3 fong1 sik1 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 lou4 zi1 gau2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想用怀柔的方式去处理劳资纠纷。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to use a conciliatory approach to handle the labor dispute.

english_meaning: To invite disaster by possessing a treasure; To be punished for possessing something valuable
explanation_mandarin: 比喻身藏才华或宝物，反而招致祸患。
explanation_english: A metaphor for inviting trouble by possessing talent or valuable objects, which may lead to misfortune or be coveted by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就咁有錢，真係懷璧其罪，小心啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 sang1 zau6 gam3 jau5 cin2, zan1 hai6 waai4 bik1 kei4 zeoi6, siu2 sam1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就这么有钱，真是怀璧其罪，小心点好。
examples.english_sentence: He's so young and already so rich, it's truly like inviting disaster by possessing a treasure, he should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁招搖，正所謂懷璧其罪，低調啲穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ziu1 jiu4, zing3 so2 wai6 waai4 bik1 kei4 zeoi6, dai1 diu6 di1 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么招摇，正所谓怀璧其罪，低调点稳妥。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so ostentatious, as they say, it's like inviting disaster by possessing a treasure, being low-key is safer.

english_meaning: to suspect, to doubt
explanation_mandarin: 认为不可信或不相信；猜疑。
explanation_english: To feel uncertain about the truth, reality, or sincerity of something; to have suspicions about someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我懷疑佢講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waai4 ji4 keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怀疑他说谎。
examples.english_sentence: I suspect he is lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅能力有啲懷疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6 jau5 di1 waai4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的能力有些怀疑。
examples.english_sentence: I have some doubts about his ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好懷疑我嘅誠意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 waai4 ji4 ngo5 ge3 sing4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要怀疑我的诚意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't doubt my sincerity.

english_meaning: to doubt one's life; to question the meaning of one's existence; existential crisis
explanation_mandarin: 开始对自己的生活、选择、价值等产生怀疑，感到迷茫和困惑。
explanation_english: To begin to doubt one's life, choices, values, etc., and feel lost and confused. It often describes a feeling of disillusionment or a questioning of one's purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完公開試，成績咁差，我真係懷疑人生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 gung1 hoi1 si5, sing4 jik1 gam3 caa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 waai4 ji4 jan1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完公开考试，成绩这么差，我真是怀疑人生。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing the public exam and getting such bad grades, I really doubt my life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾老細鬧完，我開始懷疑人生，係咪唔應該做呢份工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 jyun4, ngo5 hoi1 chi2 waai4 ji4 jan1 sang1, hai6 mai1 m4 ying1 goi1 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被老板骂完，我开始怀疑人生，是不是不应该做这份工作？
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by my boss, I started to doubt my life, wondering if I shouldn't be doing this job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日OT，做到懷疑人生，唔知為乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 OT, zou6 dou3 waai4 ji4 jan1 sang1, m4 zi1 wai6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天加班，做到怀疑人生，不知道为了什么。
examples.english_sentence: Working overtime every day, I'm working to the point of questioning my life, not knowing what it's for.

english_meaning: Kaiseki (a traditional multi-course Japanese dinner)
explanation_mandarin: 怀石料理，是一种日本料理，通常指在正式茶道中享用的轻便膳食。现在也指一种高级的日本料理形式，以其精致的食材、烹饪技巧和呈现方式而闻名。
explanation_english: Kaiseki is a traditional multi-course Japanese haute cuisine. It originated from the simple meals served in the tea ceremony but has evolved into an elaborate and refined dining experience, known for its meticulous preparation, seasonal ingredients, and artistic presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食懷石料理慶祝啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 waai4 sek6 liu5 lei6 hing3 zuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去吃怀石料理庆祝吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat Kaiseki tonight to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅懷石料理好出名，好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 waai4 sek6 liu5 lei6 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的怀石料理很有名，很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's Kaiseki is very famous, many people are queuing up.

english_meaning: to reminisce, to recall fondly, to think back on
explanation_mandarin: 回忆、思念过去的人、事或物，通常带有一种美好的情感。
explanation_english: To recall or think back on past people, events, or things, usually with a fond or sentimental feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日懷緬以前嘅快樂時光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 waai4 min5 ji5 cin4 ge3 faai3 lok6 si4 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们总是怀念以前的快乐时光。
examples.english_sentence: We often reminisce about the happy times we had in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽住呢首歌，令我懷緬起細個嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 zyu6 ni1 sau2 go1, ling6 ngo5 waai4 min5 hei2 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听着这首歌，让我想起了小时候。
examples.english_sentence: Listening to this song makes me reminisce about my childhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日懷緬過世嘅嫲嫲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waai4 min5 gwo3 sai3 ge3 maa4 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是怀念去世的奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: He often reminisces about his deceased grandmother.

english_meaning: nostalgia; to reminisce; to be nostalgic
explanation_mandarin: 回忆过去，对过去的事物或时光怀有美好的感情。
explanation_english: To have a sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations; to reminisce fondly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修好懷舊，好似返咗去六十年代噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 hou2 waai4 gau6, hou2 ci5 faan1 zo2 heoi3 luk6 sap6 nin4 doi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很怀旧，好像回到了六十年代一样。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very nostalgic, like going back to the 1960s.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日一齊懷舊，講翻以前啲傻事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waai4 gau6, gong2 faan1 ji5 cin4 di1 so4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常一起怀旧，说回以前的傻事。
examples.english_sentence: We often reminisce together, talking about silly things we did in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌好懷舊，一聽就諗起以前細個嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hou2 waai4 gau6, jat1 teng1 zau6 lam2 hei2 ji5 cin4 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很怀旧，一听就想起小时候。
examples.english_sentence: This song is very nostalgic, it reminds me of my childhood when I listen to it.

mandarin_meaning: 悬, 危险, 没把握
english_meaning: to hang, suspended; dangerous; uncertain; unlikely; no hope
explanation_mandarin: 吊挂，挂着；比喻危险，没有把握，没有希望。
explanation_english: To hang; suspended. Metaphorically refers to being dangerous, uncertain, or hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩懸住係度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sing4 hyun4 zyu6 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 绳子悬挂在那里。
examples.english_sentence: The rope is hanging there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試好懸啊，可能肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 hou2 hyun4 aa3, ho2 nang4 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试很悬啊，可能不及格。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is very uncertain; I might fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅情況好懸，隨時有危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ching4 fong3 hou2 hyun4, cheui4 si4 yau5 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的情况很危险，随时都有危险。
examples.english_sentence: His situation is very precarious, there is danger at any time.

english_meaning: to practice medicine and help the people; to dedicate oneself to healing the world
explanation_mandarin: 指以行医为职业，救济百姓，解除他们的病痛。
explanation_english: Refers to practicing medicine as a profession with the aim of helping the common people and relieving their suffering from illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢立志做個醫生，懸壺濟世，幫助啲有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lap6 zi3 zou6 go3 ji1 sang1, hyun4 wu4 zai3 sai3, bong1 zo6 di1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他立志当一名医生，悬壶济世，帮助那些需要帮助的人。
examples.english_sentence: He aspires to be a doctor, dedicating himself to healing the world and helping those in need.

english_meaning: cliff, precipice
explanation_mandarin: 陡峭的悬垂的山崖。
explanation_english: A steep cliff or precipice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嗰陣要小心啲，唔好行咁埋懸崖邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai5 jyun4 ngaai4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山的时候要小心一点，不要走得太靠近悬崖边。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when hiking, don't walk too close to the edge of the cliff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢企喺懸崖邊，好似想跳落去咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kei5 hai2 jyun4 ngaai4 bin1, hou2 ci5 soeng2 tiu3 lok6 heoi3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在悬崖边，好像想跳下去一样。
examples.english_sentence: He was standing on the edge of the cliff, as if he wanted to jump.

english_meaning: to pull back from the brink; to rein in at the edge of a precipice; to turn back before it's too late; to stop short before disaster
explanation_mandarin: 比喻到了危险的边缘及时清醒回头。
explanation_english: An idiom that means to come to one's senses just before it's too late; to pull back from a dangerous situation at the last moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到癲咗，好彩佢老婆懸崖勒馬，先至冇輸曬啲身家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 din1 zo2, hou2 coi2 keoi5 lou5 po4 hyun4 ngaai4 lak6 maa5, sin1 zai3 mou5 syu1 saai3 di1 san1 ga1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌疯了，幸好他老婆悬崖勒马，才没有输光家产。
examples.english_sentence: He was gambling like crazy, but luckily his wife pulled him back from the brink, so he didn't lose all their assets.

english_meaning: to worry, to be concerned about, anxiety, worry
explanation_mandarin: 担心，放心不下。指对某事或某人感到忧虑和牵挂。
explanation_english: To worry, to be concerned, to have something on your mind. It refers to feeling anxious and concerned about something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好懸念佢嘅安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 hyun4 nim6 keoi5 ge3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很担心他的安全。
examples.english_sentence: I am very worried about his safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁懸念，佢會照顧自己嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 hyun4 nim6, keoi5 wui5 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么担心，他会照顾自己的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to worry so much, he will take care of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試成績令我好懸念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 sing4 jik1 ling6 ngo5 hou2 hyun4 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试成绩让我很担心。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results make me very worried.

english_meaning: to hang, to suspend
explanation_mandarin: 用绳子、钩子等使物体挂起来。
explanation_english: To hang or suspend something using rope, hooks, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺屋企門口懸掛咗一個花環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 hyun4 gwaa3 zo2 jat1 go3 faa1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在家的门口悬挂了一个花环。
examples.english_sentence: They hung a wreath on the door of their house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆上面懸掛住好多畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 soeng6 min6 hyun4 gwaa3 zyu6 hou2 do1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙上悬挂着很多画。
examples.english_sentence: There are many paintings hanging on the wall.

english_meaning: unsolved case; cold case; pending case
explanation_mandarin: 指长期未解决的案件，通常指刑事案件。
explanation_english: Refers to a long-unsolved case, usually a criminal case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單兇殺案到依家都仲係懸案，冇人破到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 hung1 saat3 on3 dou3 ji1 gaa1 dou1 zung6 hai6 hyun4 on3, mou5 jan4 po3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这起凶杀案到现在还是悬案，没有人破得了。
examples.english_sentence: This murder case is still an unsolved case until now, no one can solve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方重新調查咗幾宗舊嘅懸案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 cung4 san1 diu6 caa4 zo2 gei2 zung1 gau6 ge3 hyun4 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方重新调查了几宗旧的悬案。
examples.english_sentence: The police reinvestigated several old unsolved cases.

english_meaning: to hang oneself from the rafters and prick one's thigh (idiom); to study assiduously
explanation_mandarin: 形容刻苦学习，不怕困苦的精神。出自《战国策·秦策一》和《汉书·孙敬传》。悬梁是把头发悬挂在房梁上，防止打瞌睡；刺股是用锥子刺自己的大腿，使自己保持清醒。
explanation_english: An idiom describing diligence in study and a spirit that is not afraid of hardship. It comes from "Strategies of the Warring States - Qin Strategy 1" and "Book of Han - Biography of Sun Jing." "Hanging from the rafters" refers to tying one's hair to the rafters to prevent falling asleep; "pricking one's thigh" refers to using an awl to prick one's own thigh to stay awake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗考到好成績，真係做到懸樑刺股噉呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1, zan1 hai6 zou6 dou3 jyun4 loeng4 ci3 gu2 gam2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了考出好成绩，他真是做到了悬梁刺股啊。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get good grades, he really went to the extent of hanging himself from the rafters and pricking his thigh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功唔係淨係靠天份，都要有懸樑刺股嘅精神先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 kaau3 tin1 fan6, dou1 jiu3 jau5 jyun4 loeng4 ci3 gu2 ge3 zing1 san4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成功不只是靠天分，也要有悬梁刺股的精神才行。
examples.english_sentence: Success doesn't just depend on talent; you also need a spirit of diligence and perseverance.

english_meaning: disparate; widely different; far apart; a great disparity
explanation_mandarin: 形容差别很大，距离很远。
explanation_english: Describing a significant difference or distance between two things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅實力懸殊，根本冇得比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat6 lik6 hyun4 syu1, gan1 bun2 mou5 dak1 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的实力悬殊，根本没法比。
examples.english_sentence: The difference in ability between the two of them is so great, there's no comparison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次比賽嘅結果顯示咗兩隊實力嘅懸殊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ge3 git3 gwo2 hin2 si6 zo2 loeng5 deoi2 sat6 lik6 ge3 hyun4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛的结果显示了两队实力的悬殊。
examples.english_sentence: The result of this competition showed the disparity in strength between the two teams.

english_meaning: to suspend; to float; suspension
explanation_mandarin: 指物体漂浮在空中或液体中，不沉没也不落地。也指一种悬而未决的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to an object floating in the air or a liquid, neither sinking nor falling to the ground. It can also refer to a state of suspense or being unresolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架火車好似懸浮喺半空咁，好神奇呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fo2 ce1 hou2 ci5 hyun4 fau4 hai2 bun3 hung1 gam2, hou2 san4 kei4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆火车好像悬浮在半空中一样，好神奇啊！
examples.english_sentence: That train seems to be suspended in mid-air, it's amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係一直懸浮喺朋友同戀人之間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 jat1 zik6 hyun4 fau4 hai2 pang4 jau5 tung4 lyun2 jan4 zi1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系一直悬浮在朋友和恋人之间。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has been suspended between friends and lovers.

english_meaning: Suspended particulate matter (PM)
explanation_mandarin: 指悬浮在空气中的微小固体或液体颗粒。
explanation_english: Refers to tiny solid or liquid particles suspended in the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅空氣污染好嚴重，懸浮粒子超標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hung1 hei3 wu1 jim5 hou2 jyun5 zung6, hyun4 fau4 lai2 zi2 ciu1 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的空气污染很严重，悬浮颗粒超标。
examples.english_sentence: The air pollution in Hong Kong is very serious, and the suspended particulate matter exceeds the standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日出街戴咗口罩，費事吸入太多懸浮粒子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ceot1 gaai1 daai3 zo2 hau2 zaau3, fai3 si6 kap1 jap6 taai3 do1 hyun4 fau4 lai2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天出门戴了口罩，免得吸入太多悬浮颗粒。
examples.english_sentence: I wore a mask when I went out today, to avoid inhaling too much suspended particulate matter.

english_meaning: suspense; suspenseful
explanation_mandarin: 指一种令人感到疑惑、紧张、期待结果的心理状态，或者指情节曲折、引人入胜，充满未知性的故事类型。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of mind that makes people feel confused, nervous, and expectant of the outcome; or refers to a story type with a convoluted plot, captivating, and full of unknowns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅劇情好懸疑，睇到我好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 hyun4 ngai4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gan2 cheung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很悬疑，看得我很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very suspenseful, it made me very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個懸疑故仔嘅結局出乎意料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hyun4 ngai4 gu3 zai2 ge3 git3 guk6 cheut1 fu1 ji3 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个悬疑故事的结局出乎意料。
examples.english_sentence: The ending of this suspenseful story was unexpected.

english_meaning: suspended; hanging in the air; unresolved; pending
explanation_mandarin: （动）指物体没有支撑而挂在空中，或者事情没有确定结果、没有解决。
explanation_english: (verb) to hang in the air without support; (adjective) unresolved, pending, hanging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橋懸空喺山谷上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kiu4 hyun4 hung1 hai2 saan1 guk1 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桥悬空在山谷上面。
examples.english_sentence: The bridge is suspended over the valley.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事仲懸空，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 jung4 hyun4 hung1, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事还悬而未决，不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is still pending; I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: reward, bounty
explanation_mandarin: 公开以金钱或其他利益征求协助，通常用于寻找失物或抓捕罪犯。
explanation_english: To offer a reward (usually money) for information leading to the recovery of lost property or the apprehension of a criminal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋懸紅一百萬蚊，希望有人可以提供到兇手嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hyun4 hung4 jat1 baak3 maan6 man1, hei1 mong6 jau5 jan4 ho2 ji5 cung4 cung1 dou3 hung1 sau2 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们悬赏一百万港币，希望有人可以提供凶手的信息。
examples.english_sentence: They offered a reward of one million dollars, hoping someone could provide information about the murderer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懸紅捉拿呢個通緝犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hyun4 hung4 zuk1 naa4 ni1 go3 tung1 cip3 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方悬赏捉拿这个通缉犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police are offering a reward for the capture of this wanted criminal.

english_meaning: to offer a reward; reward
explanation_mandarin: 指公开出钱征求（消息、线索等）；用金钱或实物酬谢。
explanation_english: To offer a reward publicly (for information, clues, etc.); to reward with money or goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懸賞一百萬蚊捉拿疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hyun4 soeng2 jat1 baak3 maan6 man1 zuk1 naa5 ji4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方悬赏一百万港币捉拿嫌疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police are offering a reward of one million Hong Kong dollars for the arrest of the suspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋懸賞搵返隻走失咗嘅狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hyun4 soeng2 wan2 faan1 zek3 zau2 sat1 zo2 ge3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们悬赏找回走失的狗。
examples.english_sentence: They are offering a reward to find their lost dog.

english_meaning: Glabellar lines (vertical lines between the eyebrows)
explanation_mandarin: 指印堂（两眉之间）出现的一条垂直的皱纹，在面相学中，常被认为是不吉之兆，可能代表忧虑、烦恼或性格固执等。
explanation_english: Refers to a vertical wrinkle that appears between the eyebrows (glabella). In physiognomy (face reading), it is often considered an inauspicious sign, potentially representing worry, anxiety, or stubbornness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條懸針紋咁深，睇嚟好多嘢都放唔低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 hyun4 zam1 man4 gam3 sam1, tai2 lai4 ho2 do1 je5 dou1 fong3 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的悬针纹这么深，看来很多事情都放不下。
examples.english_sentence: His glabellar line is so deep, it seems he can't let go of many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日皺眉，細個就咁多懸針紋，大個點算？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zau3 mei4, sai3 go3 zau6 gam3 do1 hyun4 zam1 man4, daai6 go3 dim2 syun3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是皱眉头，小时候就这么多悬针纹，长大了怎么办？
examples.english_sentence: Don't frown so often, you have so many glabellar lines at a young age, what will happen when you grow up?

english_meaning: to repent; to regret sincerely; to confess sins
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，表示承认错误并请求宽恕。也泛指悔恨。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term meaning to acknowledge one's wrongdoings and ask for forgiveness. More generally, it refers to repentance and remorse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯咗好多嘢，依家好後悔，想懺悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, ji1 gaa1 hou2 hau6 fui3, soeng2 caam3 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了很多错事，现在很后悔，想忏悔。
examples.english_sentence: He has done many wrong things, and now he regrets it very much and wants to repent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢誠心懺悔，希望可以得到原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 sam1 caam3 fui3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他诚心忏悔，希望可以得到原谅。
examples.english_sentence: He sincerely repents, hoping to be forgiven.

english_meaning: repent; confess and regret; remorse
explanation_mandarin: 认识到自己的错误或罪过，并表示后悔和改正的决心。
explanation_english: To acknowledge one's mistakes or sins, express regret, and show determination to correct them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗自己嘅行為感到好懺悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 hang4 wai4 gam2 dou3 hou2 caam3 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为自己的行为感到非常忏悔。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very remorseful for his actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過反省，佢終於懺悔自己嘅過錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 faan2 sing2, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 caam3 fui3 zi6 gei2 ge3 gwo3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过反省，他终于忏悔了自己的过错。
examples.english_sentence: After introspection, he finally repented his mistakes.

english_meaning: to fear, to dread
explanation_mandarin: 害怕，畏惧。表示对某种事物感到恐惧和担心。
explanation_english: To be afraid of; to fear; to dread. Expresses a feeling of fear and worry towards something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該懼怕挑戰，反而應該勇敢面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 geoi6 paa3 tiu1 zin3, faan2 ji4 jing1 goi1 jung5 gam2 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该害怕挑战，反而应该勇敢面对。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't fear challenges, but rather face them bravely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懼高，唔敢行上山頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 geoi6 gou1, m4 gam2 haang4 soeng5 saan1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很恐高，不敢走到山顶。
examples.english_sentence: He is afraid of heights and doesn't dare to walk to the top of the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好懼怕失敗，從失敗中學習先至可以進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 geoi6 paa3 sat1 baai6, cung4 sat1 baai6 zung1 hok6 zaap6 sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要害怕失败，从失败中学习才可以进步。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid of failure; you can only progress by learning from it.

english_meaning: to fear, to be afraid of
explanation_mandarin: 感到害怕和恐惧。
explanation_english: To feel fear or be afraid of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好懼怕黑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 geoi6 paa3 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很害怕黑暗。
examples.english_sentence: He is very afraid of the dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使懼怕，我會喺你隔離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geoi6 paa3, ngo5 wui5 hai2 nei5 gaak3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用害怕，我会在你旁边。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid, I'll be beside you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該懼怕挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 geoi6 paa3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该惧怕挑战。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't be afraid of challenges.

english_meaning: fearful expression; look of fear
explanation_mandarin: 恐惧的表情或神色。
explanation_english: An expression or look showing fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽見警察嚟就露出咗懼色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ting1 gin3 ging2 caat3 lei4 zau6 lau6 ceot1 zo2 geoi6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到警察来了就露出了惧色。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he heard the police were coming, a look of fear appeared on his face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人成日都驚青，有少少事就已經滿面懼色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 seng4 jat6 dou1 geng1 ceng1, jau5 siu2 siu2 si6 zau6 ji5 ging1 mun5 min6 geoi6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人总是胆小怕事，稍微有点事就满脸惧色。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very timid person; even the smallest thing will put a look of fear on his face.

english_meaning: to intimidate, to daunt, to be awed
explanation_mandarin: 使人感到恐惧、害怕，通常带有威慑的意味。
explanation_english: To intimidate or daunt someone, often implying a sense of power or authority causing fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅氣勢真係好懾人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hei3 sai3 zan1 hai6 hou2 sip3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的气势真的很慑人。
examples.english_sentence: His aura is truly intimidating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老闆嘅眼神懾住咗，一句嘢都講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 baan2 ge3 ngaan5 san4 sip3 zyu6 zo2, jat1 geoi3 je5 dou1 gong2 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板的眼神震慑住了，一句话也说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was intimidated by the boss's gaze and couldn't say a word.

english_meaning: intimidating, awe-inspiring, frightening, imposing
explanation_mandarin: 形容气势、力量或景象令人感到畏惧，产生震慑作用。
explanation_english: Describes something that is intimidating, awe-inspiring, or frightening due to its power, presence, or intensity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅眼神好懾人，唔敢同佢對望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 san4 hou2 zip3 jan4, m4 gam2 tung4 keoi5 deoi3 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼神很慑人，不敢和他对视。
examples.english_sentence: His gaze is so intimidating; I don't dare to look him in the eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個展覽嘅氣氛好懾人，好似置身喺戰場入面噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 ge3 hei3 fan1 hou2 zip3 jan4, hou2 ci5 zi3 san1 hai2 zin3 coeng4 jap6 min6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个展览的气氛很慑人，好像置身于战场里面一样。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere of this exhibition is very intimidating, like being in a battlefield.

english_meaning: to subdue, to overawe, to intimidate into submission, to conquer by force or influence
explanation_mandarin: 用威势使人屈服；震慑使对方顺从。
explanation_english: To subdue, overawe, or intimidate someone into submission by means of power, authority, or fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅氣勢好勁，懾服咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hei3 sai3 hou2 ging6, sip3 fuk6 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的气势很强大，慑服了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: His aura was very strong, and it subdued many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅實力唔夠，好難懾服到班老臣子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sat6 lik6 m4 gau3, hou2 naan4 sip3 fuk6 dou3 baan1 lou5 san4 zi2.
