english_meaning: Simple-minded, honest to a fault, straightforward, gullible, naive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人头脑简单，为人耿直，有时带有贬义，指人容易受骗。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is simple-minded, honest, and straightforward, sometimes to the point of being gullible or naive. Often carries a slightly negative connotation, implying someone is easily fooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好戇直㗎，成日俾人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ngong6 zik6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 aak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很憨直，总是被人骗。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very simple-minded person, always getting scammed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁戇直啦，小心俾人賣咗都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ngong6 zik6 laa1, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 maai6 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么憨直了，小心被人卖了都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so naive, be careful or you'll get taken advantage of without even realizing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然戇直，但係心地好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 ngong6 zik6, daan6 hai6 sam1 dei6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然憨直，但是心地很好。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's simple-minded, he has a very good heart.

english_meaning: Stupid, idiot, fool
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚蠢，笨拙。这是一个比较粗俗的词语，不宜在正式场合使用。
explanation_english: A vulgar term used to describe someone as stupid, foolish, or idiotic. It is generally considered offensive and should be avoided in formal settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩咁戇鳩㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 gam3 ngong6 gau1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛这么傻啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so stupid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁戇鳩啦，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 ngong6 gau1 laa1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨啦，这么简单的事情都不会。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you can't even do something so simple.

english_meaning: Stupid fellow; idiot; fool
explanation_mandarin: 用来骂人愚蠢、笨拙的词语，带有侮辱性质。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to call someone stupid, foolish, or idiotic. It is an insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁戇鳩，梗係俾人鬧啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 ngong6 gau1, gang2 hai6 bei2 jan4 naau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么蠢，当然会被人骂了。
examples.english_sentence: You're so stupid at doing things, of course, you'll get scolded.

mandarin_meaning: 傻瓜把愚蠢的事情当有趣
english_meaning: A fool finds amusement in foolish things; To find something stupid amusing; to make light of something stupid.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人愚蠢，把一些很无聊或者低俗的事情当成有趣的事情。含有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is foolish and finds boring or vulgar things amusing. Has a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度講埋啲低俗笑話，仲以為自己好幽默，真係戇鳩當有趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 maai4 di1 dai1 suk6 siu3 waa6, zung6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 jau1 mak6, zan1 hai6 ngong6 gau1 dong3 jau5 cheoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里讲一些低俗的笑话，还以为自己很幽默，真是傻瓜把愚蠢的事情当有趣。
examples.english_sentence: He's always telling vulgar jokes here, thinking he's so funny, it's really a case of a fool finding amusement in foolish things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日戇鳩當有趣啦，做好啲正經嘢先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ngong6 gau1 dong3 jau5 cheoi3 laa1, zou6 hou2 di1 zing3 ging1 je5 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是把愚蠢的事情当有趣了，做好一些正经事才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: Stop finding stupid things amusing all the time, you need to do some serious things first.

synonyms: 無聊當有趣 (mou4 liu4 dong3 jau5 cheoi3)

english_meaning: Silly, foolish, idiotic, dumbfounded, clueless (often with a slightly endearing or teasing tone)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人反应迟钝，傻气，有点呆呆的样子。语气可以带点戏谑或宠溺。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to react, silly, and a bit dazed or absent-minded. The tone can be playful, teasing, or even affectionate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日戇鳩鳩咁啦，醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 ngong6 gau1 gau1 gam2 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是傻乎乎的，清醒一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be so silly, wake up and be alert!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日戇鳩鳩咁笑，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ngong6 gau1 gau1 gam2 siu3, m4 zi1 lam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是傻乎乎地笑，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always smiles foolishly, I wonder what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁戇鳩鳩啦，呢啲嘢好簡單啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ngong6 gau1 gau1 laa1, ni1 di1 je5 hou2 gaan2 daan1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么傻乎乎的，这些东西很简单。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, these things are very simple.

english_meaning: dagger-axe; halberd; a type of ancient Chinese weapon; (Cantonese slang) to hit on someone; to flirt
explanation_mandarin: 古代的一种兵器，也指用戈刺或砍。广东话俚语，指追求异性，调情。
explanation_english: An ancient weapon, a dagger-axe or halberd. In Cantonese slang, it means to hit on someone, to flirt or pursue romantically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去戈啲女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 gwo1 di1 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是去追那些女孩。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to hit on those girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好戈我啦，我唔鍾意你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwo1 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别追我了，我不喜欢你。
examples.english_sentence: Stop flirting with me, I don't like you.

synonyms: 追女仔 (zeoi1 neoi5 zai2) - to chase girls

english_meaning: Gobi Desert; desolate; barren
explanation_mandarin: 指戈壁沙漠，也可用来形容地方荒凉，人烟稀少。
explanation_english: Refers to the Gobi Desert. It can also be used to describe a place as desolate and sparsely populated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好似戈壁咁，乜嘢都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 ci5 gwo1 bik1 gam2, mat1 je5 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里像戈壁一样，什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: This place is like the Gobi Desert, there's nothing here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條街靜到好似戈壁咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gaai1 zing6 dou3 hou2 ci5 gwo1 bik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街安静得像戈壁一样。
examples.english_sentence: The street is as quiet as the Gobi Desert.

english_meaning: Fifth of the ten Heavenly Stems
explanation_mandarin: 天干的第五位，用于纪年、月、日等。通常也指代第五。
explanation_english: Fifth of the ten Heavenly Stems, used in the Chinese sexagenary cycle for recording years, months, and days. It often refers to the ordinal number 'fifth'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年係戊戌年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hai6 mou6 seot1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年是戊戌年。
examples.english_sentence: This year is the year of Wu Xu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績排戊等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 paai4 mou6 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩排第五等。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are ranked in the fifth tier.

english_meaning: 戌, the eleventh Earthly Branch
explanation_mandarin: 地支的第十一位，与生肖狗相对应。 也可指时间上的戌时（晚上七点到九点）。
explanation_english: The eleventh Earthly Branch, corresponding to the zodiac animal dog. It can also refer to the time of day, specifically the 'xu shi' which is from 7 PM to 9 PM.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年係戌年，即係狗年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hai6 seot1 nin4, zik1 hai6 gau2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年是戌年，也就是狗年。
examples.english_sentence: This year is the year of Xu, which is the year of the dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常喺戌時食完飯就開始睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 hai2 seot1 si4 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常在戌时吃完饭就开始看电视。
examples.english_sentence: I usually start watching TV after dinner during the Xu time (7-9 PM).

english_meaning: To talk nonsense, to ramble on incoherently, to spout rubbish
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话没有逻辑，没有重点，信口开河，胡说八道。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks illogically, without a clear point, and talks nonsense or rubbish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再喺度戌門啦，冇人信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 seot1 mun4 laa1, mou5 jan4 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再在这里胡说八道了，没有人相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking nonsense here, no one believes you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日戌門，講啲嘢都唔知真定假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 seot1 mun4, gong2 di1 je5 dou1 m4 zi1 zan1 ding6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡说八道，说的话都不知道是真是假。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense, I don't know if what he says is true or false.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢戌門，佢根本咩都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ting1 keoi5 seot1 mun4, keoi5 gan1 bun2 me1 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他胡说八道，他根本什么都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his nonsense, he doesn't know anything at all.

english_meaning: to garrison; to defend (a place)
explanation_mandarin: 军队驻扎防守。
explanation_english: To station troops in a place for defense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派咗好多士兵去邊境戍守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 zo2 hou2 do1 si6 bing1 heoi3 bin1 ging2 syu3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派了很多士兵去边境驻守。
examples.english_sentence: They sent many soldiers to garrison the border.

english_meaning: to garrison, to defend (a border, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指军队驻守边疆要地，进行防卫。
explanation_english: Refers to troops stationed in important frontier areas for defense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日夜戍守邊疆，保護國家安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 je6 syu3 sau2 bin1 goeng1, bou2 wu6 gwok3 gaa1 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们日夜戍守边疆，保护国家安全。
examples.english_sentence: They garrison the border day and night, protecting national security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊兵戍守喺嗰個戰略要塞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi2 bing1 syu3 sau2 hai2 go2 go3 zin3 loek6 jiu3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这队士兵戍守在那个战略要塞。
examples.english_sentence: This troop of soldiers is garrisoned in that strategic fortress.

english_meaning: to defend the border; to garrison the frontier
explanation_mandarin: 指军队驻扎在边境地区，担任守卫边防的职责。
explanation_english: Refers to troops being stationed in border areas to defend the frontier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代嘅士兵成日都要去戍邊，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 ge3 si6 bei1 sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 syu3 bin1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的士兵经常都要去戍边，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, soldiers often had to defend the border; it was very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺以前係解放軍，去新疆戍邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 ji5 cin4 hai6 gaai2 fong3 gwan1, heoi3 san1 goeng1 syu3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷以前是解放军，去新疆戍边。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather used to be in the People's Liberation Army, and he went to Xinjiang to defend the border.

english_meaning: weapons; military affairs; warfare
explanation_mandarin: 指武器、军事或战争。 在粤语中，通常出现在成语或较正式的语境中。
explanation_english: Refers to weapons, military affairs, or warfare. In Cantonese, it usually appears in idioms or more formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日講到兵戎相見咁，其實都係口頭講下啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 gong2 dou3 bing1 jung4 soeng1 gin3 gam2, kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 hau2 tau4 gong2 haa5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说到兵戎相见那样，其实都只是口头说说而已。
examples.english_sentence: They always talk about resorting to war, but it's just talk.

english_meaning: military troops; military journey
explanation_mandarin: 指军队或军事活动。 也可指军事旅程，战争的经历。
explanation_english: Refers to military troops or military activities. It can also refer to a military journey or the experience of war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日講以前嘅戎旅生涯，聽到我都悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 gong2 ji5 cin4 ge3 jung4 leoi5 sang1 ngaai4, teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说以前的戎马生涯，听得我都厌烦了。
examples.english_sentence: They always talk about their past military life, I'm getting bored of hearing it.

english_meaning: military uniform; full battle dress
explanation_mandarin: 指军人穿着的制式服装，尤指全副武装的装束。
explanation_english: Refers to the standard uniform worn by military personnel, especially when fully armed and equipped for battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住戎裝，真係好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zoek3 jung4 zong1, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着军装，真的很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He looks really handsome in his military uniform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 閱兵嘅時候，所有士兵都要著戎裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yut6 bing1 ge3 si4 hau6, so2 jau5 si6 bing1 dou1 jiu3 zoek3 jung4 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阅兵的时候，所有士兵都要穿军装。
examples.english_sentence: During the military parade, all soldiers must wear military uniform.

english_meaning: A lifetime spent in military service; a life of warfare.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人一生中大部分时间都在军队中度过，经历过很多战争。
explanation_english: Describes a person who has spent most of their life in the military, experiencing many wars and battles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戎馬半生，為國家奉獻咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung4 maa5 bun3 sang1, wai6 gwok3 gaa1 fung6 hiến3 zo2 hóu2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他半生戎马，为国家奉献了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lifetime in military service and has dedicated much to the country.

english_meaning: to become, to turn into, to complete, to accomplish, to succeed, tenth, percent
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词, 形容词, 数词
explanation_mandarin: 1. 完成，成功。2. 成为。3. 达到某种程度或数量。4. (数词) 十分之……；百分之……。
explanation_english: 1. to complete; to accomplish; to finish. 2. to become; to turn into. 3. to reach a certain level or quantity. 4. (numeral) tenth; percent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於成功，變成咗一個出色嘅醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1, bin3 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 ceot1 sik1 ge3 yi1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于成功了，变成了一个出色的医生。
examples.english_sentence: He finally succeeded and became an outstanding doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事已經成咗一半，差唔多搞掂喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 sing4 zo2 jat1 bun3, caa1 m4 do1 gaau2 dim6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事已经完成一半了，差不多完成了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is already half done, almost finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅測驗，佢拎到八成嘅分數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 cak1 jim6, keoi5 ling1 dou2 baat3 seng4 ge3 fan1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的测验，他拿到了百分之八十的分数。
examples.english_sentence: In this test, he got 80 percent of the marks.

english_meaning: lifetime, whole life, all one's life
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人全部的生命时间。
explanation_english: Refers to the entirety of a person's lifespan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成世都冇離開過香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 sai3 dou1 mou5 lei4 hoi1 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一辈子都没有离开过香港。
examples.english_sentence: He has never left Hong Kong in his whole life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想成世都做呢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sing4 sai3 dou1 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想一辈子都做这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to do this job for my entire life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成世人為咗家庭付出咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 sai3 jan4 wai4 zo2 gaa1 ting4 fu6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一辈子为家庭付出了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated a lot to his family throughout his life.

english_meaning: lifetime, all one's life
explanation_mandarin: 表示一个人从出生到死亡的整个生命周期。强调时间跨度长，涵盖了整个生命历程。
explanation_english: Refers to the entirety of a person's life, from birth to death. Emphasizes the long duration and covers the complete lifespan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成世人都未見過咁奇怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 sai3 jan4 dou1 mei6 gin3 gwo3 gam3 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一辈子都没见过这么奇怪的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I've never seen such a strange thing in my entire life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成世人都好努力工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 sai3 jan4 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一辈子都很努力工作。
examples.english_sentence: He worked very hard his whole life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗咁多啦，成世人流流長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 gam3 do1 laa1, sing4 sai3 jan4 lau4 lau4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想那么多啦，一辈子还很长呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think too much, you have your whole life ahead of you.

mandarin_meaning: 一辈子; 一辈子的人; 终身
english_meaning: Lifetime; whole life; one's entire life
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的一生；一生，终身。 多带有一种惋惜、无奈或讽刺的语气。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's entire life or lifetime. Often carries a tone of regret, helplessness, or sarcasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成世仔都係咁窮，真係陰公。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 sai3 zai2 dou1 hai6 gam2 kung4, zan1 hai6 yam1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一辈子都这么穷，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He's been poor his whole life; it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成世仔都未見過咁靚嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 sai3 zai2 dou1 mei6 gin3 gwo3 gam3 leng3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一辈子都没见过这么漂亮的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I've never seen anything so beautiful in my entire life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成世仔都唔會明㗎啦，唔好嘥時間同你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 sai3 zai2 dou1 m4 wui5 ming4 gaa3 laa1, m4 hou2 saai1 si4 gaan3 tung4 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一辈子都不会明白的，别浪费时间跟你说了。
examples.english_sentence: You'll never understand in your entire life, so I won't waste time talking to you.

mandarin_meaning: 人生路还长; 来日方长
english_meaning: Life is long; There's plenty of time; The future is a long time.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人生漫长，未来还有很多机会或时间，不必急于一时。
explanation_english: Describes that life is long and there will be many opportunities or time in the future, so there is no need to rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁擔心嘅，成世流流長，下次咪做得好啲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 ge3, sing4 sai3 lau4 lau4 coeng4, haa6 ci3 mai6 zou6 dak1 hou2 di1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么担心，人生路还长，下次做好一点就好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much, life is long, you can do better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁快放棄啊，成世流流長，仲有好多可能性㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3 aa3, sing4 sai3 lau4 lau4 coeng4, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ho2 nang4性 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快放弃啊，来日方长，还有很多可能性的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly, the future is long, there are still many possibilities.

english_meaning: to succeed, to accomplish, to get things done
explanation_mandarin: 指事情获得成功，达到预期的目的。
explanation_english: Refers to the successful completion of a task or achievement of a desired goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要齊心協力，先可以成事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cai4 sam1 hip3 lik6, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要齐心协力，才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: We must work together to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有能力，一定可以成事嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 sing4 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有能力，一定可以成功的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable and will definitely succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要你堅持，就一定可以成事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 nei5 gin1 ci4, zau6 jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 sing4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要你坚持，就一定可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you persevere, you will definitely succeed.

english_meaning: deal closed; transaction completed; sold!
explanation_mandarin: 买卖双方达成协议，交易完成。
explanation_english: Indicates that a deal or transaction has been finalized and agreed upon between two or more parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好，成交！我俾呢個價錢你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2, sing4 gaau1! ngo5 bei2 ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好，成交！我给你这个价钱。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, deal closed! I'll give you this price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拍賣官一鎚定音，最後以一百萬成交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paak3 mai6 gun1 jat1 teoi4 ding6 jam1, zeoi3 hau6 ji5 jat1 baak3 maan6 sing4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍卖官一槌定音，最后以一百万成交。
examples.english_sentence: The auctioneer brought down the hammer, and the final bid was one million (and the deal was closed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傾咗咁耐，終於成交啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: king1 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gaau1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谈了这么久，终于成交啦！
examples.english_sentence: After talking for so long, we finally closed the deal!

english_meaning: transaction price; agreed price; final price
explanation_mandarin: 指买卖双方最终达成的价格。
explanation_english: Refers to the final price agreed upon by the buyer and seller in a transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅成交價係五百萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 sing4 gaau1 gaa3 hai6 ng5 baak3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的成交价是五百万。
examples.english_sentence: The transaction price of this house is five million.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾咗好耐，最後成交價都係高過我預期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 hou2 noi6, zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gaau1 gaa3 dou1 hai6 gou1 gwo3 ngo5 jyu6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈了很久，最终成交价还是高于我的预期。
examples.english_sentence: We talked for a long time, but the final price was still higher than I expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想用幾多錢嘅成交價買入呢隻股票？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jung6 gei2 do1 cin2 ge3 sing4 gaau1 gaa3 maai5 jap6 ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想要用多少钱的成交价买入这只股票？
examples.english_sentence: What transaction price do you want to buy this stock at?

english_meaning: adult
explanation_mandarin: 指已经达到法定年龄，具有完全民事行为能力的人。
explanation_english: A person who has reached the age of majority; an adult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經係個成人，要自己為自己嘅行為負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 hai6 go3 sing4 jan4, jiu3 zi6 gei2 wai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 hang4 wai4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经是个成年人，要自己为自己的行为负责。
examples.english_sentence: He's already an adult and must be responsible for his own actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲唔啱未滿十八歲嘅成人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 m4 ngaam1 mei6 mun5 sap6 baat3 seoi3 ge3 sing4 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影不适合未满十八岁的成年人看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is not suitable for adults under the age of eighteen.

english_meaning: To help someone accomplish something; to help someone achieve their aim; to fulfill another's wishes; to help someone to a good end; to facilitate.
explanation_mandarin: 成全别人的好事，帮助人实现愿望。通常指帮助别人完成婚事或成全别人的某种美好的愿望。
explanation_english: To help someone achieve their goal or fulfil their wishes, usually referring to helping someone get married or achieve a positive outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫佢女朋友，梗係會成人之美，幫佢實現夢想啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5, gang2 hai6 wui5 sing4 jan4 zi1 mei5, bong1 keoi5 sat6 hin6 mung6 soeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么爱他的女朋友，肯定会成人之美，帮她实现梦想的。
examples.english_sentence: He loves his girlfriend so much, he will definitely help her achieve her dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然佢哋咁相愛，我哋應該成人之美，唔好阻止佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 keoi5 dei6 gam3 soeng1 oi3, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 sing4 jan4 zi1 mei5, m4 hou2 zo2 zi3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然他们这么相爱，我们应该成人之美，不要阻止他们。
examples.english_sentence: Since they love each other so much, we should help them be together and not stop them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢真係咁想去外國讀書，我哋都應該成人之美，支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 keoi5 zan1 hai6 gam3 soeng2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 ying1 goi1 sing4 jan4 zi1 mei5, zi1 chi4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他真的很想去国外读书，我们都应该成人之美，支持他。
examples.english_sentence: If he really wants to study abroad, we should help him achieve his goal and support him.

english_meaning: Adult film, pornographic movie
explanation_mandarin: 指包含色情内容的电影。
explanation_english: Refers to a film containing pornographic content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷偷哋睇成人電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 tau1 dei2 tai2 sing4 jan4 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷偷地看成人电影。
examples.english_sentence: He secretly watches adult films.

english_meaning: ingredient; component; element
explanation_mandarin: 指构成某种事物的物质或要素。
explanation_english: The constituents or elements that make up something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥嘅成份係乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ge3 sing4 fan6 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个药的成分是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What are the ingredients in this medicine?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下個產品嘅成份表先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 go3 caan2 ban2 ge3 sing4 fan6 biu2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先看一下产品的成分表吧。
examples.english_sentence: You should check the product's ingredient list first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好複雜，有好多唔同嘅成份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 sing4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的为人很复杂，有很多不同的成分。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is very complex, with many different components.

english_meaning: What kind of behavior is this?; What a disgrace!; How improper!
explanation_mandarin: 形容行为举止非常不合规矩，不合礼仪，不成样子。多用于长辈批评晚辈，或对不合礼仪的行为表示不满。
explanation_english: Used to describe behavior that is extremely improper, disregards etiquette, and is simply unacceptable. Often used by elders to criticize younger generations, or to express dissatisfaction with behavior that does not conform to proper manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔喺大庭廣眾度咁大聲喧嘩，成何體統呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 hai2 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 dou6 gam3 daai6 seng1 hyun1 waa6, sing4 ho4 tai2 tung2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子在大庭广众之下这么大声喧哗，成何体统啊？
examples.english_sentence: For a child to make such a loud commotion in public, what kind of behavior is this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你著住條爛牛仔褲去見客，成何體統呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 zyu6 tiu4 laan6 ngau4 zai2 fu3 heoi3 gin3 haak3, sing4 ho4 tai2 tung2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你穿着破烂的牛仔裤去见客户，成何体统啊？
examples.english_sentence: Wearing ripped jeans to meet a client, what a disgrace!

jyutping: seng4 go3 lou5 can3, cung4 ci2 bei6 kwan3
mandarin_meaning: 完全被当成冤大头，从此被困住
english_meaning: Completely fooled (like a sucker), trapped ever since.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人被完全欺骗、占便宜，损失惨重，并且因此而陷入困境，难以摆脱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has been completely cheated, taken advantage of, suffered a great loss, and as a result is trapped in a difficult situation from which they cannot easily escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買咗呢間爛樓，成個老襯，從此被困，每月要還巨額按揭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zo2 ni1 gaan1 laan6 lau2, seng4 go3 lou5 can3, cung4 ci2 bei6 kwan3, mui5 jyut6 jiu3 waan4 geoi6 ngaak6 on3 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买了这间破房子，完全被当成冤大头，从此被困，每个月都要还巨额房贷。
examples.english_sentence: I bought this dilapidated building, completely got ripped off, trapped ever since, and now I have to pay a huge mortgage every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 信咗佢嘅投資計劃，成個老襯，從此被困，啲錢全部無晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 tau4 zi1 gai3 waak6, seng4 go3 lou5 can3, cung4 ci2 bei6 kwan3, di1 cin2 cyun4 bou6 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 相信了他的投资计划，完全被当成冤大头，从此被困，钱全部都没了。
examples.english_sentence: I trusted his investment plan, completely got ripped off, trapped ever since, and all my money is gone.

synonyms: 被人搵笨 (bei6 jan4 wan2 ban6)

mandarin_meaning: 简直像一个模子刻出来的
english_meaning: Like two peas in a pod; exactly alike; spitting image
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人长相非常相似，就像用一个饼印压出来的一样。
explanation_english: Describes two people who look very similar, as if they were made from the same mold (cookie cutter).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两兄弟真係成個餅印咁，唔熟嘅人好難分到佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 zan1 hai6 seng4 go3 beng2 jan3 gam2, m4 suk6 ge3 jan4 hou2 naan4 fan1 dou3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟真是像一个模子刻出来的一样，不熟悉的人很难分清他们。
examples.english_sentence: Those two brothers are really like two peas in a pod. It's hard for people who aren't familiar with them to tell them apart.

english_meaning: to help (sb) achieve their wish; to make it happen; to fulfil; to complete; to grant
explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人实现愿望或完成心愿。
explanation_english: To help someone achieve their wish or fulfill their desires; to grant or fulfill a request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望你可以成全我哋兩個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 sing4 cyun4 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望你可以成全我们两个。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you can grant us both our wish (to be together).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅父母最終都成全咗佢哋嘅婚事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fu6 mou5 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 sing4 cyun4 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fan1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的父母最终都成全了他们的婚事。
examples.english_sentence: Their parents finally gave their blessing for their marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然佢咁堅持，不如就成全佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 keoi5 gam3 gin1 chi4, bat1 jyu4 zau6 sing4 cyun4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然他这么坚持，不如就成全他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since he insists so much, why don't we just let him have his way?

english_meaning: ingredient; component; element; constituent
explanation_mandarin: 构成事物的物质或因素。
explanation_english: A substance or factor that makes up something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕嘅成分好簡單，主要係麵粉、雞蛋同糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 ge3 sing4 fan6 hou2 gaan2 daan1, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 min6 fan2, gai1 daan2 tung4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕的成分很简单，主要是面粉、鸡蛋和糖。
examples.english_sentence: The ingredients of this cake are very simple, mainly flour, eggs and sugar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇清楚食品嘅成分表，先至可以買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 cing1 chu2 sik6 ban2 ge3 sing4 fan6 biu2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要看清楚食品的成分表，才可以买。
examples.english_sentence: We need to look carefully at the ingredient list of the food before we can buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好複雜，有好嘅成分，都有唔好嘅成分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jau5 hou2 ge3 sing4 fan6, dou1 jau5 m4 hou2 ge3 sing4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很复杂，有好的成分，也有不好的成分。
examples.english_sentence: He is a complex person, with good components and bad components.

english_meaning: success, to succeed
explanation_mandarin: 达到预期目的或获得预期的结果；成就。
explanation_english: The accomplishment of an aim or purpose; achieving what you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅努力終於成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的努力终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: His efforts finally succeeded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要祝你成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zuk1 nei5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要祝你成功。
examples.english_sentence: We want to wish you success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划很成功。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very successful.

english_meaning: sense of accomplishment, feeling of success
explanation_mandarin: 因完成某事或达到目标而产生的满足感和自豪感。
explanation_english: A feeling of satisfaction and pride resulting from completing a task or achieving a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目完成之後，我真係好有成功感啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 waan4 sing4 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sing4 gung1 gam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目完成之后，我真的很有成就感！
examples.english_sentence: After completing this project, I really have a strong sense of accomplishment!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考到個牌之後，佢覺得好有成功感，更加有動力去學其他嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 dou2 go3 paai4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 sing4 gung1 gam2, gang3 gaa1 jau5 dung6 lik6 heoi3 hok6 kei4 taa1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考到执照之后，他觉得很有成就感，更有动力去学其他东西。
examples.english_sentence: After getting the license, he felt a great sense of accomplishment and was more motivated to learn other things.

english_meaning: to successfully strive for; to successfully lobby for; to achieve through effort
explanation_mandarin: 通过努力，成功获得某事物或达到某个目标。
explanation_english: To successfully obtain something or achieve a goal through effort and persistence. Often implies a degree of difficulty or resistance that had to be overcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成功爭取到公司加人工喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 zang1 ceoi2 dou3 gung1 si1 gaa1 yan4 gung1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们成功争取到公司加薪了！
examples.english_sentence: We successfully lobbied the company for a pay raise!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多次談判，佢哋終於成功爭取到更長嘅假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 ci3 taam4 paan3, keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zang1 ceoi2 dou3 gang3 coeng4 ge3 gaa3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多次谈判，他们终于成功争取到更长的假期。
examples.english_sentence: After many negotiations, they finally succeeded in obtaining a longer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生會成功爭取到學校改善飯堂嘅食物質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 sang1 wui2 sing4 gung1 zang1 ceoi2 dou3 hok6 haau6 goi2 sin6 faan6 tong4 ge3 sik6 mat6 zat1 so3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生会成功争取到学校改善食堂的食物质量。
examples.english_sentence: The student union successfully lobbied the school to improve the quality of food in the cafeteria.

english_meaning: tens of thousands; thousands upon thousands; countless; innumerable
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，数不清。
explanation_english: Describes a very large number, countless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會現場嚟咗成千上萬嘅歌迷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 jin6 coeng4 lei4 zo2 sing4 cin1 soeng6 maan6 ge3 go1 mai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会现场来了成千上万的歌迷。
examples.english_sentence: Tens of thousands of fans came to the concert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅成本成千上萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 bun2 sing4 cin1 soeng6 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的成本成千上万块钱。
examples.english_sentence: The cost of this project is tens of thousands of dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗慈善籌到成千上萬嘅善款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 ci4 sin6 cau4 dou3 sing4 cin1 soeng6 maan6 ge3 sin6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了慈善筹到了成千上万的善款。
examples.english_sentence: They raised tens of thousands of dollars for charity.

english_meaning: Genghis Khan
explanation_mandarin: 蒙古帝国创始人、第一位大汗。
explanation_english: The founder and first Great Khan of the Mongol Empire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史書有講過成吉思汗嘅事跡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 syu1 jau5 gong2 gwo3 sing4 gat1 si1 hon4 ge3 si6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史书上有讲过成吉思汗的事迹。
examples.english_sentence: History books talk about the deeds of Genghis Khan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似成吉思汗咁，好有領導才能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 sing4 gat1 si1 hon4 gam2, hou2 jau5 ling5 dou6 coi4 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像成吉思汗一样，很有领导才能。
examples.english_sentence: He is like Genghis Khan, very talented in leadership.

jyutping: sing4 gat1 si1 hon4 daa2 zai2
mandarin_meaning: 形容人非常凶狠，打人很厉害
english_meaning: Describing someone as extremely fierce and a very hard hitter; a tough disciplinarian.
explanation_mandarin: “成吉思汗”是蒙古族的著名征服者，以其凶猛的战斗风格著称。 “打仔”指打架的人，打人者。 因此，整个短语形容某人像成吉思汗一样凶猛，打人毫不留情。
explanation_english: "Genghis Khan" (成吉思汗) was a famous Mongol conqueror known for his fierce fighting style. "Daa2 zai2" (打仔) refers to someone who fights or hits people. Therefore, the entire phrase describes someone as fierce as Genghis Khan and extremely good (or brutal) at hitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣成日蝦啲同學，真係成吉思汗打仔咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 haa1 di1 tung4 hok6, zan1 hai6 sing4 gat1 si1 hon4 daa2 zai2 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常欺负同学，真是像成吉思汗打仔一样。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he often bullied his classmates; he was really like Genghis Khan hitting people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢教仔好嚴厲，成日都話要成吉思汗打仔先得，啲仔女咪畀佢嚇親囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau3 zai2 hou2 jim4 lai6, seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 jiu3 sing4 gat1 si1 hon4 daa2 zai2 sin1 dak1, di1 zai2 neoi5 mai1 bei2 keoi5 haak3 chan1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他教育孩子很严格，总是说要像成吉思汗打仔一样才行，孩子们都给他吓着了。
examples.english_sentence: He disciplines his children very strictly, always saying they need to be treated like Genghis Khan hitting people; the children are terrified of him.

english_meaning: to become famous; to make a name for oneself
explanation_mandarin: 获得名声，变得有名。
explanation_english: To achieve fame; to become well-known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加完選秀節目之後，一炮而紅，迅速成名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 jyun4 syun2 sau3 zit3 muk6 zi1 hau6, jat1 paau3 ji4 hung4, suk1 seoi3 sing4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加完选秀节目之后，一炮而红，迅速成名。
examples.english_sentence: After participating in the talent show, he became an instant hit and quickly became famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都希望可以成名，但係成功需要付出努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 sing4 ming4, daan6 hai6 sing4 gung1 seoi1 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都希望可以成名，但是成功需要付出努力。
examples.english_sentence: Many people hope to become famous, but success requires effort.

english_meaning: finished product; finished goods
explanation_mandarin: 经过加工制造完成的产品。
explanation_english: A product that has been completely manufactured or processed; finished goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋公司嘅最新成品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 zeoi3 san1 sing4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们公司最新的成品。
examples.english_sentence: This is our company's latest finished product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件成品嘅質量好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 sing4 ban2 ge3 zat1 loeng6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件成品的质量很好。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this finished product is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲成品要經過嚴格嘅檢查先可以出貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sing4 ban2 jiu3 ging1 gwo3 jim4 gaak3 ge3 gim2 caa4 sin1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些成品要经过严格的检查才可以出货。
examples.english_sentence: These finished products must undergo strict inspection before they can be shipped.

english_meaning: member
explanation_mandarin: 组织或团体中的个体。
explanation_english: A person or thing belonging to a group or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係呢個團隊嘅重要成員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ni1 go3 teoi4 deoi2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是这个团队的重要成员。
examples.english_sentence: They are important members of this team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新成員要尽快适应公司嘅文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 sing4 jyun4 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 sik1 ying3 gung1 si1 ge3 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新成员要尽快适应公司的文化。
examples.english_sentence: New members need to adapt to the company's culture as soon as possible.

english_meaning: A lump of rice; (figuratively) utterly useless, good-for-nothing
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是「一块饭」。引申用来形容一个人很没用，像一块饭一样，毫无价值。
explanation_english: Literally means "a lump of rice". Figuratively, it's used to describe someone who is utterly useless, incompetent, or a good-for-nothing. The comparison suggests the person is as worthless as a lump of plain rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁慢，真係成嚿飯咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 maan6, zan1 hai6 seng4 gau6 faan6 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事这么慢，真是个废物。
examples.english_sentence: He works so slowly, he's really a good-for-nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁話佢啦，佢都盡力㗎啦，雖然係成嚿飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 waa6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 zeon6 lik6 gaa3 laa1, seoi1 jin4 hai6 seng4 gau6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么说他了，他已经尽力了，虽然他很没用。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about him, he's tried his best, even though he's a good-for-nothing.

english_meaning: cause; origin; factor
explanation_mandarin: 事物形成的原因或要素。
explanation_english: The cause, origin, or factor that leads to the formation or occurrence of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個病嘅成因好複雜，可能係基因或者環境因素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng6 ge3 sing4 jan1 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, ho2 nang4 hai6 gei1 yan1 waak6 ze2 waan4 ging2 jyun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个病的成因很复杂，可能是基因或者环境因素。
examples.english_sentence: The cause of this illness is very complex, possibly due to genetic or environmental factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 交通意外嘅成因好多時都係因為司機唔小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 sing4 jan1 hou2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 hai6 yan1 wai6 si1 gei1 m4 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 交通事故的成因很多时候都是因为司机不小心。
examples.english_sentence: The cause of traffic accidents is often due to the driver's carelessness.

english_meaning: to get married, to marry
explanation_mandarin: 正式结婚，结为夫妻。
explanation_english: To formally get married; to become husband and wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聽日就成婚喇，恭喜晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zau6 sing4 fan1 laa3, gung1 hei2 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们明天就要结婚了，恭喜！
examples.english_sentence: They are getting married tomorrow, congratulations!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成婚十年，感情都仲係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 fan1 sap6 nin4, gam2 cing4 dou1 zung6 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚十年，感情还是那么好。
examples.english_sentence: They have been married for ten years, and their relationship is still so good.

english_meaning: to get married and establish a home and career; to settle down
explanation_mandarin: 指结婚并建立家庭，同时在事业上有所成就。
explanation_english: Refers to getting married, establishing a family, and achieving success in one's career; settling down and starting a new life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗拖咁耐，都應該成家立室啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 to1 gam3 noi6, dou1 ying1 goi1 sing4 gaa1 lap6 sat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了这么久的恋爱，也应该成家立业了吧。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for so long, they should get married and settle down already.

synonyms: 結婚生仔 (git3 fan1 sang1 zai2)

mandarin_meaning: 成就, 成绩, 造就
english_meaning: achievement, accomplishment, success, to achieve
explanation_mandarin: 指事业上的成绩或造就。也可以作动词，表示完成或达到某种目标。
explanation_english: Refers to achievements or accomplishments in one's career or life. Can also be used as a verb, meaning to achieve or accomplish a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就好大，真係令人佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 hou2 daai6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 pui3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就很大，真是令人佩服。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements are great, it's really admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年努力，佢終於成就咗佢嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 nu5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 zau6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年努力，他终于实现了他的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: After many years of hard work, he finally achieved his dream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程係一個重大嘅成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 hai6 jat1 go3 zung6 daai6 ge3 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程是一个重大的成就。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a significant achievement.

english_meaning: sense of achievement, feeling of accomplishment
explanation_mandarin: 指完成某件事情后获得的满足感和自豪感。
explanation_english: A feeling of satisfaction and pride gained from achieving something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 完成咗呢個 project，我真係好有成就感呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun4 sing4 zo2 ni1 go3 project, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sing4 zau6 gam2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 完成了这个项目，我真的很有成就感啊。
examples.english_sentence: Having completed this project, I really have a great sense of achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教識個細路仔寫字，我都覺得好有成就感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 sik1 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 se2 zi6, ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 sing4 zau6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教会那个小孩写字，我也觉得很有成就感。
examples.english_sentence: Teaching that child to write, I also feel a great sense of accomplishment.

english_meaning: Achievement unlocked
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词性短语 (míng cí xìng duǎn yǔ)
explanation_mandarin: 源自电子游戏用语，指玩家完成特定目标或任务后获得成就。
explanation_english: Derived from video game terminology, referring to the achievement a player unlocks after completing a specific goal or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於考到車牌啦，成就解鎖！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou2 ce1 paai4 laa1, sing4 zau6 gaai2 so2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于考到驾照了，成就解锁！
examples.english_sentence: He finally passed his driving test, achievement unlocked!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂份project，成就解鎖，可以放鬆下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 fan6 project, sing4 zau6 gaai2 so2, ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞定了这份项目，成就解锁，可以放松一下了！
examples.english_sentence: Finished the project, achievement unlocked, time to relax!

english_meaning: adult; grown-up
explanation_mandarin: 指达到法定年龄，具备完全民事行为能力的人；也可以形容已经长大了。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has reached the legal age of majority and has full civil capacity; can also describe someone who has grown up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都成年喇，應該自己識得照顧自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 sing4 nin4 laa3, ying1 goi1 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都成年了，应该自己懂得照顾自己。
examples.english_sentence: He's an adult now, he should know how to take care of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔細路仔啦，我都成年㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sai3 lou6 zai2 laa1, ngo5 dou1 sing4 nin4 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是小孩子了，我都成年了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm not a kid anymore, I'm an adult!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成年人要為自己嘅行為負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 nin4 yan4 yiu3 wai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 hang4 wai4 fu3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成年人要为自己的行为负责。
examples.english_sentence: Adults must be responsible for their actions.

english_meaning: to take shape; to form; to materialize
explanation_mandarin: 指事物逐渐形成固定的形状或状态。
explanation_english: Refers to something gradually forming a fixed shape or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃開始成形喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 hoi1 chi2 sing4 jing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划开始成型了。
examples.english_sentence: The plan is starting to take shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雲望落好似就嚟成形咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wan4 mong6 lok6 hou2 chi5 zau6 lei4 sing4 jing4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些云看起来好像就要成形了。
examples.english_sentence: Those clouds look like they are about to take shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法慢慢成形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 maan6 maan6 sing4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法慢慢成型。
examples.english_sentence: His idea is slowly taking shape.

english_meaning: effectiveness; result; effect; success
explanation_mandarin: 指所产生的效果或结果。
explanation_english: Refers to the effect or result produced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法嘅成效好顯著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 ge3 sing4 haau6 hou2 hin2 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法的成效很显著。
examples.english_sentence: The effectiveness of this method is very significant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇下呢個廣告嘅成效點樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 haa5 ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 ge3 sing4 haau6 dim2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要看看这个广告的成效怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: We need to see how effective this advertisement is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾個月嘅努力，計劃終於有成效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 go3 jyut6 ge3 nou5 lik6, gai3 waak6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 sing4 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几个月的努力，计划终于有成效。
examples.english_sentence: After months of effort, the plan finally has results.

english_meaning: success or failure; victory or defeat
explanation_mandarin: 成功或失败。指事情的结果，不确定性。
explanation_english: Success or failure; victory or defeat. Refers to the outcome of a matter, often involving uncertainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論成敗都好，最緊要係盡力嘗試過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 sing4 baai6 dou1 hou2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zeon6 lik6 si3 soeng4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论成败，最重要的是尽力尝试过。
examples.english_sentence: Regardless of success or failure, the most important thing is to have tried your best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽嘅成敗，好大程度取決於團隊合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ge3 sing4 baai6, hou2 daai6 cing4 dou6 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 teoi1 deoi2 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛的成败，很大程度取决于团队合作。
examples.english_sentence: The success or failure of this competition largely depends on teamwork.

english_meaning: percentage; probability; likelihood; degree of certainty
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、成功的可能性或占整体的比例。
explanation_english: Indicates the degree, probability of success, or the proportion of the whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資嘅成數有幾高呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 ge3 sing4 sou3 jau5 gei2 gou1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资的成功率有多高啊？
examples.english_sentence: How high is the probability of success for this investment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢有幾成數真㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jau5 gei2 sing4 sou3 zan1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话有几成是真的？
examples.english_sentence: What percentage of what he said is true?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得呢件事嘅成數唔高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 sing4 sou3 m4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这件事成功的可能性不高。
examples.english_sentence: I think the probability of success for this matter is not high.

english_meaning: always, often, all day long, frequently
explanation_mandarin: 表示经常、总是。指时间上连续不断或重复出现。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens frequently or always. Refers to something continuous or repeating over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，激死我喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gik1 sei2 ngo5 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，气死我了！
examples.english_sentence: He is always late, it's driving me crazy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日打機，唔讀書，將來點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 daa2 gei1, m4 duk6 syu1, zoeng1 loi4 dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是玩游戏，不读书，将来怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: You are always playing games and not studying, what will you do in the future?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨，我成日都喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雨，我整天都待在家里。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining today, I've been at home all day.

english_meaning: the whole night, all night long
explanation_mandarin: 表示整个晚上。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成晚都冇瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 maan5 dou1 mou5 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我整晚都没睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep all night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成晚掛住打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 maan5 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整个晚上都在玩游戏。
examples.english_sentence: He spent the whole night playing games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成晚都喺度諗緊呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 maan5 dou1 hai2 dou6 nam2 gan2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我整个晚上都在想着这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I was thinking about this all night long.

english_meaning: A strong smell/taste; a strong hint of something (often negative)
explanation_mandarin: 形容气味浓烈，或者比喻某种事物带有强烈的味道或暗示，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a strong smell or taste, or metaphorically, a strong hint or indication of something, often with negative connotations. It implies that something is very obvious or prominent, and usually undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房成朕煙味，好難頂呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong2 seng4 zan6 yin1 mei6, hou2 naan4 ding2 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房间一股烟味，很难受啊！
examples.english_sentence: This room has a strong smell of smoke, it's unbearable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成朕酸味，擺明係妒忌人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2嘢 seng4 zan6 syun1 mei6, baai2 ming4 hai6 dou3 gi3 yan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话带着一股酸味，摆明是嫉妒别人。
examples.english_sentence: There's a strong hint of jealousy in his words, it's obvious he's envious of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事成朕陰謀味，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 seng4 zan6 yam1 mau4 mei6, nei5 siu2 sam1啲.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事带着一股阴谋的味道，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has a strong hint of conspiracy, be careful.

english_meaning: cost, capital
explanation_mandarin: 生产、经营商品或提供服务所耗费的全部费用。
explanation_english: The total cost incurred in producing, operating, or providing goods or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅成本好平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 sing4 bun2 hou2 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的成本很便宜。
examples.english_sentence: The cost of this shirt is very cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 計埋人工，成本高咗好多。

english_meaning: cost price

explanation_english: The price at which something is bought or produced, not including any profit or other additional charges.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sing4 bun2 gaa3 maai6 bei2 nei5 laa1, m4 zaan6 nei5 cin2.

examples.english_sentence: I'll sell you this shirt at cost price; I won't make any profit off you.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的货全部都是成本价清仓。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is clearing all goods at cost price.

english_meaning: cost-effectiveness
explanation_mandarin: 指所付出的成本与所获得的效益之间的比较关系，强调以较少的成本获得较大的效益。
explanation_english: The relationship between the cost of something and the benefits it provides; emphasis on achieving greater benefits with lower costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要考慮吓呢個計劃嘅成本效益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haau2 leoi6 haa5 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sing4 bun2 haau6 yik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要考虑一下这个计划的成本效益。
examples.english_sentence: We need to consider the cost-effectiveness of this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然貴啲，但係長遠嚟講，佢嘅成本效益會更高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gwai3 di1, daan6 hai6 coeng4 jyun5 lai4 gong2, keoi5 ge3 sing4 bun2 haau6 yik1 wui geng1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然贵一点，但是长远来说，它的成本效益会更高。
examples.english_sentence: Although it's more expensive, its cost-effectiveness will be higher in the long run.

english_meaning: to become a useful person, to become a success, to make something of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人经过培养和努力，成为有用的人才，取得成功。
explanation_english: Refers to a person becoming a useful and successful individual through cultivation and hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 望仔女大個可以成材啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望孩子们长大后能成才。
examples.english_sentence: Hoping that our children will become successful when they grow up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要俾心機讀書，第日先可以成材㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 bei2 sam1 gei1 duk6 syu1, dai6 jat6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 caai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要用心学习，将来才能成才啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to study hard so that you can become successful in the future.

english_meaning: A whole village of people; many people; everyone knows
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是整个村子的人。通常用来形容很多人，或指某件事很多人都知道。
explanation_english: Literally means "a whole village of people." It's often used to describe a large number of people or to indicate that something is widely known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事成村人都知啦，你仲想瞞住我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 seng4 cyun1 jan4 dou1 zi1 laa1, nei5 zung6 soeng2 maan4 zyu6 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事所有人都知道了，你还想瞒着我？
examples.english_sentence: Everyone knows about this, are you still trying to hide it from me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個演唱會成村人去睇咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 seng4 cyun1 jan4 heoi3 tai2 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个演唱会好像全村的人都去看一样。

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceot1 ming4, seng4 cyun1 jan4 dou1 sik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么出名，很多人都认识他。
examples.english_sentence: He is so famous that everyone knows him.

english_meaning: result; achievement; gain; outcome
explanation_mandarin: 经过努力而取得的好的结果。
explanation_english: A positive result or achievement obtained after effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽我哋攞到好好嘅成果。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的比赛我们取得了很好的成果。
examples.english_sentence: We achieved excellent results in this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅成果超出咗我哋嘅預期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sing4 gwo2 ceot1 ciu3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyu6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的成果超出了我们的预期。
examples.english_sentence: The results of this project exceeded our expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力咗咁耐，終於睇到成果喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 lik6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 tai2 dou3 sing4 gwo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力了这么久，终于看到成果了。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked so hard for so long, and finally he sees the results.

english_meaning: the entire street; the whole street
explanation_mandarin: 指整条街道。强调范围的广度。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire street. Emphasizes the wide scope or extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨落到成條街都濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 lok6 dou3 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 sip3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨下得整条街都湿透了。
examples.english_sentence: It rained so much that the entire street was soaked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢派傳單派到成條街都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paai3 cyun4 daan1 paai3 dou3 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发传单发得整条街都是。
examples.english_sentence: He handed out flyers so much that the entire street was covered in them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成條街都冇乜人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 mou5 mat1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整条街都没什么人。
examples.english_sentence: There's hardly anyone on the whole street.

english_meaning: a group of people, a bunch of people
explanation_mandarin: 指数量较多的人聚集在一起，通常带有一种稍显贬义或调侃的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people gathered together, often with a slightly negative or joking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日喺旺角見到成棚人喺度嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 hai2 wong6 gok3 gin3 dou2 sing4 paang4 jan4 hai2 dou6 cou4.

examples.english_sentence: Yesterday, I saw a group of people arguing in Mong Kok.

examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 jyun4 zo2, sing4 paang4 jan4 jung2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会结束了，一大群人涌了出来。
examples.english_sentence: After the concert ended, a large group of people rushed out.

english_meaning: to become, to turn into
explanation_mandarin: 变成；成为。
explanation_english: To become; to turn into; to be transformed into.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力讀書，希望將來成為一個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1, hei1 mong6 zoeng1 loi4 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1.

examples.english_sentence: He studies hard, hoping to become a doctor in the future.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jyu4 gwo2 sing4 gung1, hoeng1 gong2 zoeng1 wui5 sing4 wai4 aa3 zau1 ge3 gam1 yung4 zung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这个计划成功，香港将会成为亚洲的金融中心。
examples.english_sentence: If this plan succeeds, Hong Kong will become the financial center of Asia.

english_meaning: mature, ripe
explanation_mandarin: 指人、事物发展到完备的阶段；或者指果实完全长成。
explanation_english: Describing a person or thing that has developed to a complete or advanced stage; or referring to fruit that is fully grown or ripe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好成熟，好識得照顧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 sing4 suk6, hou2 sik1 dak1 ziu3 gu3 jan4.

examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mong1 gwo2 ji5 ging1 sing4 suk6 laa3, ho2 ji5 sik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 芒果已经成熟了，可以吃了。
examples.english_sentence: The mangoes are already ripe, we can eat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃重未成熟，需要再研究下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 mei6 sing4 suk6, seoi1 jiu3 zoi3 jin4 gau3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划还未成熟，需要再研究一下。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is not yet mature and needs further study.

english_meaning: to become; to turn into
explanation_mandarin: 变成；变为；变成某种身份或性质。
explanation_english: To become; to turn into; to develop into a certain status or nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想成爲一個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过努力，他终于成为了一个成功的商人。
examples.english_sentence: After much effort, he finally became a successful businessman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事令佢成爲咗一個更好嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 keoi5 sing4 wai4 zo2 jat1 go3 gang3 hou2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事让他成为了一个更好的人。
examples.english_sentence: This event made him a better person.

english_meaning: to become; to turn into
explanation_mandarin: 变成；变化成。
explanation_english: to transform into; to develop into; to turn into something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想成為一個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想成为一名医生。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to become a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年嘅努力，佢終於成為咗公司嘅CEO。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 nu5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 wai4 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 CEO.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方已经成为了一个旅游热点。
examples.english_sentence: This place has already become a tourist hotspot.

mandarin_meaning: 成者为王，败者为寇 (chéng zhě wéi wáng, bài zhě wéi kòu)
english_meaning: The winner is king, the loser is bandit; history is written by the victors; might makes right.
explanation_mandarin: 指成功的人被视为英雄，失败的人则被视为寇贼。强调历史是由胜利者书写的，胜败决定了人们的评价。
explanation_english: This idiom means that the winner is glorified as a hero, while the loser is branded as a villain. It highlights that history is often written from the perspective of the victors, and success or failure largely dictates how people are judged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界就係咁，成王敗寇，如果你輸咗，就咩都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 zau6 hai6 gam2, sing4 wong4 baai6 kau3, jyu4 gwo2 nei5 syu1 zo2, zau6 me1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界就是这样，成王败寇，如果你输了，就什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: That's how the world is, the winner takes all, the loser gets nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打贏咗場仗，而家咪成王敗寇囉，乜都佢哋話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 wing4 zo2 coeng4 zoeng3, ji4 gaa1 mai1 sing4 wong4 baai6 kau3 lo1, mat1 dou1 keoi5 dei6 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打赢了这场仗，现在就是成王败寇了，什么都是他们说了算。
examples.english_sentence: They won the war, so now it's a case of the winner takes all, they get to decide everything.

mandarin_meaning: 整个盘子; 全部; 全部的事情
english_meaning: A whole tray/plate; the whole thing; the entire situation; the whole shebang
explanation_mandarin: 原意指一整个盘子或托盘。引申义指全部，整个或全部的事情，可以用于形容全部事情、问题或食物等。
explanation_english: Literally means a whole tray or plate. Figuratively, it refers to the entirety, the whole thing, or the entire situation. It can be used to describe all the events, problems, food, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將成盤嘢食食晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 sing4 pun4 je5 sik6 sik6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把整盘东西都吃光了。
examples.english_sentence: He ate the entire plate of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係成盤都係問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 sing4 pun4 dou1 hai6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真是整个都是问题。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really a whole mess (the entire situation is problematic).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞搞震，如果唔係成盤輸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 sing4 pun4 syu1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要搞事，不然整个都输光了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble, otherwise the whole thing will be lost.

english_meaning: to come true, to become reality, to be realized
explanation_mandarin: 指愿望、梦想或计划最终实现，变成现实。
explanation_english: Refers to a wish, dream, or plan that is eventually realized and becomes a reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望我嘅願望可以成真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ngo5 ge3 jyun6 mong6 ho2 ji5 sing4 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望我的愿望可以实现吧。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully my wish can come true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年嘅努力，佢嘅夢想終於成真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 zung1 jyu1 sing4 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年的努力，他的梦想终于实现。
examples.english_sentence: After many years of hard work, his dream finally came true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢相信只要堅持，所有嘅嘢都會成真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 seon3 zi2 jiu3 gin1 ci4, so2 jau5 ge3 ye5 dou1 wui5 sing4 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他相信只要坚持，所有的事情都会实现。
examples.english_sentence: He believes that as long as you persevere, everything will come true.

english_meaning: Like a log; stiff; wooden; unresponsive; lacking animation
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常僵硬，呆板，没有反应或缺乏活力，就像一块木头一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person as being very stiff, awkward, unresponsive, or lacking animation, like a log of wood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企喺度成碌木咁，做乜啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 hai2 dou6 seng4 luk1 muk6 gam2, zou6 mat1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你站在那里像木头一样，干什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: You're standing there like a log, what are you doing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老闆，即刻成碌木咁，一句嘢都唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 lou5 baan2, zik1 hak1 seng4 luk1 muk6 gam2, jat1 geoi3 je5 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见到老板，立刻像木头一样，一句话都不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the boss, he immediately became like a log, not daring to say a word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳舞跳到成碌木咁，真係冇天份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 tiu3 dou3 seng4 luk1 muk6 gam2, zan1 hai6 mou5 tin1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跳舞跳得像根木头一样，真是没有天分。
examples.english_sentence: He dances like a log, he really has no talent.

english_meaning: like a log; stiff as a board; unresponsive; wooden
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，像木头一样呆板，没有反应。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unresponsive, stiff, or wooden, like a log. Often used to describe a person's lack of reaction or enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成碌木噉坐喺度，乜嘢都唔講。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他像木头一样坐在那里，什么都不说。
examples.english_sentence: He sat there like a log, not saying anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成碌木噉企喺度，帮下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 luk1 muk6 gam2 kei5 hai2 dou6, bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要像木头一样站在那里，帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand there like a log, lend a hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳舞跳到成碌木噉，一啲都唔生動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 tiu3 dou3 seng4 luk1 muk6 gam2, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 sang1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跳舞跳得像木头一样，一点都不生动。
examples.english_sentence: He dances like a log, not lively at all.

english_meaning: to establish; to found; to set up; to be valid; to hold water (of an argument)
