explanation_english: To establish, found, or set up (an organization, institution, etc.); to be valid or hold water (of an argument, claim, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成立咗十年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 lap6 zo2 sap6 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司成立十年了。
examples.english_sentence: This company has been established for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅講法唔成立㗎，冇證據支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 gong2 faat3 m4 sing4 lap6 gaa3, mou5 zing3 geoi3 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的说法不成立，没有证据支持。
examples.english_sentence: Your argument doesn't hold water; there's no evidence to support it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成立咗個慈善機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 lap6 zo2 go3 ci4 sin6 gei1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们成立了一个慈善机构。
examples.english_sentence: They established a charity organization.

english_meaning: achievement, grade, score, result
explanation_mandarin: 指学习、工作或其他活动中所取得的成果或表现。
explanation_english: Refers to the result, performance, or achievement gained in studies, work, or other activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試嘅成績好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试的成绩很好。
examples.english_sentence: His exam results were very good this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要提升成績，就要努力溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 tai4 sing1 sing4 zik1, zau6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要提高成绩，就要努力复习。
examples.english_sentence: To improve your grades, you need to study hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅業績成績好理想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 yip6 zik1 sing4 zik1 hou2 lei5 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的业绩成绩很理想。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance results are very ideal.

english_meaning: report card, transcript
explanation_mandarin: 记录学生学习成绩的文件。
explanation_english: A document that records a student's academic performance, typically issued at the end of a term or academic year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話我今次成績表差咗好多，要罰我冇得睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 gam1 ci3 sing4 zik1 biu2 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1, jiu3 fat6 ngo5 mou5 dak1 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说我这次的成绩单差了很多，要罚我不可以看电视。
examples.english_sentence: My mom said my report card is much worse this time, and I'm being punished by not being allowed to watch TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢派咗成績表，全部都係A，好叻仔呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paai3 zo2 sing4 zik1 biu2, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ei1, hou2 lek1 zai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发了成绩单，全部都是A，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He got his report card, and they're all A's, he's so smart!

english_meaning: in groups, in flocks, in droves, to gather in groups
explanation_mandarin: 聚集成为一群。形容数量多，聚集在一起。
explanation_english: To gather or exist in a group or flock. Describes a large number of things or people gathered together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雀仔成羣噉飛過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cheuk3 zai2 seng4 kwan4 gam2 fei1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鸟儿成群地飞过。
examples.english_sentence: The birds flew past in flocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成羣結隊咁行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 kwan4 git3 deui2 gam2 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们成群结队地逛街。
examples.english_sentence: They were walking down the street in a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一到放學，啲學生就成羣噉湧出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 dou3 fong3 hok6, di1 hok6 sang1 zau6 seng4 kwan4 gam2 yung2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一放学，学生们就成群地涌出来。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as school finishes, the students swarm out in groups.

english_meaning: in groups; in flocks; in droves
explanation_mandarin: 形容许多东西聚集在一起的样子。
explanation_english: Describing many things gathering together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成羣蚊飛嚟飛去，好鬼核突啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 kwan4 man1 fei1 lai4 fei1 heoi3, hou2 gwai2 hat6 dat6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成群的蚊子飞来飞去，好恶心啊！
examples.english_sentence: Groups of mosquitoes are flying around, it's so disgusting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工時間，成羣人湧曬出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 si4 gaan3, sing4 kwan4 jan4 jung2 saai3 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班时间，成群的人涌出来。
examples.english_sentence: It's after-work hours, groups of people are rushing out.

english_meaning: in groups; in droves; in flocks; a large number of people or animals together
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量众多的人或动物聚集成群。
explanation_english: Describes a large number of people or animals gathering together in groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工時間，啲人成群噉行出地鐵站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 si4 gaan3, di1 jan4 sing4 kwan4 gam2 haang4 chut1 dei6 tit3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班时间，人们成群地走出地铁站。
examples.english_sentence: During rush hour after work, people walk out of the subway station in groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雀仔成群噉飛過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zoek3 zai2 sing4 kwan4 gam2 fei1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鸟儿成群地飞过。
examples.english_sentence: The birds flew by in flocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生成群結隊去食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 sing4 kwan4 git3 deoi2 heoi3 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生们成群结队地去吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: The students went to eat in large groups.

mandarin_meaning: 成份; 纯度; 品质; 质量
english_meaning: purity (of gold, silver, etc.); quality; fineness; degree of excellence
explanation_mandarin: 指金屬的純度或品質；比喻事物的質量或水平。
explanation_english: Refers to the purity or quality of a metal, especially gold or silver. By extension, it can also refer to the quality or standard of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件金器嘅成色好高，好值錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 gam1 hei3 ge3 sing4 sik1 hou2 gou1, hou2 zik6 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件金器的成色很高，很值钱的。
examples.english_sentence: The purity of this gold ornament is very high, it's very valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司啲產品嘅成色都幾好，所以好多人都鍾意買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 di1 caan2 ban2 ge3 sing4 sik1 dou1 gei2 hou2, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的产品的质量都挺好的，所以很多人都喜欢买。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of their company's products is quite good, so many people like to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個演員嘅演技成色麻麻地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 yin2 yun4 ge3 yin2 gei6 sing4 sik1 maa4 maa2 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个演员的演技水平一般。
examples.english_sentence: This actor's acting skills are so-so.

english_meaning: prepared medicine; over-the-counter medicine
explanation_mandarin: 指已经配制好的，可以直接使用的药物，通常可以在药店里不需要处方购买。
explanation_english: Refers to pre-prepared medicines that can be used directly, usually available in pharmacies without a prescription; over-the-counter medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭痛呀，去藥房買啲成葯食吓先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 tung3 aa3, heoi3 joek6 fong4 maai5 di1 sing4 joek6 sik6 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 头疼啊，去药房买些成药吃一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: I have a headache. I'll go to the pharmacy to buy some over-the-counter medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻成葯好有效，食完好快就無事喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sing4 joek6 hou2 jau5 haau6, sik6 jyun4 hou2 faai3 zau6 mou4 si6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种成药很有效，吃完很快就没事了。
examples.english_sentence: This over-the-counter medicine is very effective. You'll be fine quickly after taking it.

english_meaning: patent medicine; over-the-counter medicine; ready-made medicine
explanation_mandarin: 指不需医生处方，可以直接在药店购买的成药。
explanation_english: Refers to ready-made medicine that can be purchased directly from pharmacies without a doctor's prescription; over-the-counter medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有啲感冒成藥，你攞啲嚟食住先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 di1 gam2 mou6 sing4 joek6, nei5 lo2 di1 lai4 sik6 zyu6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里有些感冒成药，你先拿一些吃着吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are some over-the-counter cold medicines at home, take some and eat them first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買成藥都要睇清楚說明書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 sing4 joek6 dou1 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 syut3 ming4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买成药也要看清楚说明书。
examples.english_sentence: You should read the instructions carefully when buying over-the-counter medicine.

english_meaning: Jackie Chan; adult
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指的是成年人。 2. 特指香港影星成龙。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to an adult. 2. Specifically refers to the Hong Kong movie star Jackie Chan. This is a play on his name, as '成龍' (sing4 lung4) and '成蟲' (sing4 cung4) sound similar in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再當我係細路仔啦，我而家都成蟲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 dong3 ngo5 hai6 sai3 lou2 zai2 laa1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 sing4 cung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再把我当小孩子了，我现在都成年人了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat me like a kid anymore, I'm an adult now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇成蟲啲戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 sing4 cung4 di1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看成龙的电影。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes watching Jackie Chan's movies.

english_meaning: to form a row; to be in rows; in lines
explanation_mandarin: 指排列成行、成列。
explanation_english: Refers to being arranged in rows or lines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生喺操場度成行噉企好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 hai2 cou1 coeng4 dou6 seng4 hong4 gam2 kei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生们在操场上排成行站好。
examples.english_sentence: The students lined up in rows on the playground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲鋪頭成行咁開喺條街度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pou1 tau3 seng4 hong4 gam2 hoi1 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商店一排排地开在街上。
examples.english_sentence: The shops are lined up along the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樹成行咁種喺條路兩邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu6 seng4 hong4 gam2 zung2 hai2 tiu4 lou6 loeng5 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树木成排地种在路的两边。
examples.english_sentence: Trees are planted in rows on both sides of the road.

english_meaning: Forming rows and becoming a market; ubiquitous; prevalent everywhere.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物非常普遍，到处可见，好像形成了一条条街市一样。
explanation_english: Describes something as being very common and ubiquitous, seen everywhere, as if it has formed rows and rows of streets and markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲共享單車，成行成市，周圍都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 gung1 hoeng2 daan1 ce1, sing4 hang4 sing4 si5, zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的共享单车，成行成市，到处都是。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, shared bicycles are ubiquitous, they are everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從嗰間餐廳出名之後，啲山寨版嘅鋪頭就成行成市，間間都差唔多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ceot1 ming4 zi1 hau6, di1 saan1 zaai2 baan2 ge3 pu3 tau3 zau6 sing4 hang4 sing4 si5, gaan1 gaan1 dou1 caa1 m4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从那间餐厅出名之后，山寨版的店铺就成行成市，家家都差不多。
examples.english_sentence: After that restaurant became famous, the copycat shops became ubiquitous, and they're all pretty much the same.

english_meaning: ready-made clothes, ready-to-wear clothes
explanation_mandarin: 已经制作完成，可以直接穿的衣服。
explanation_english: Ready-made clothes that are manufactured and available for immediate wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣好多平價成衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 ping4 gaa3 sing4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店卖很多廉价的成衣。
examples.english_sentence: This store sells a lot of cheap ready-made clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常都買成衣，因為方便快捷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 maai5 sing4 ji1, jan1 wai6 fong1 bin6 faai3 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常都买成衣，因为方便快捷。
examples.english_sentence: I usually buy ready-made clothes because it's convenient and quick.

english_meaning: preconceived idea; prejudice; bias
explanation_mandarin: 事先形成的、未经证实的看法或偏见。
explanation_english: A preconceived idea or prejudice formed before having sufficient information or experience; a bias.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好帶住成見去睇呢件事，可能會發掘到新嘅嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daai3 zyu6 sing4 gin3 heoi3 tai2 ni1 gin6 si6, ho2 nang4 wui5 faat3 gwat6 dou2 san1 ge3 ye5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要带着成见去看这件事，可能会发掘到新的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look at this matter with preconceived notions; you might discover something new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對啲後生仔有啲成見，覺得佢哋唔捱得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 jau5 di1 sing4 gin3, gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 m4 ngaai4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对年轻人有些成见，觉得他们吃不了苦。
examples.english_sentence: He has some prejudices against young people, thinking they can't handle hardship.

english_meaning: to get married, to marry
explanation_mandarin: 指男女双方结为夫妻，举行婚礼。
explanation_english: Refers to a man and woman becoming husband and wife, typically involving a wedding ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下個月就成親啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 sing4 can1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们下个月就要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They are getting married next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋幾時成親呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gei2 si4 sing4 can1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们什么时候结婚啊？
examples.english_sentence: When are you getting married?

english_meaning: idiom; proverb
explanation_mandarin: 汉语中的固定短语，多为四字格，源于古代故事或典故，具有特定的意义和用法。
explanation_english: A type of set expression in Chinese, typically consisting of four characters, derived from ancient stories or allusions, with specific meanings and usages. Often used to convey complex ideas concisely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日用成語，好有文采。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 sing4 jat6 yung6 sing4 jyu5, hou2 jau5 man4 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是用成语，很有文采。
examples.english_sentence: He often uses idioms when he speaks, very eloquent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個成語嘅意思好深奧，要查吓先知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 jyu5 ge3 ji3 si1 hou2 sam1 ou3, jiu3 caa4 haa5 sin1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个成语的意思很深奥，要查一下才知道。
examples.english_sentence: The meaning of this idiom is very profound, I need to look it up to understand.

english_meaning: whole body; all over the body; entire body
explanation_mandarin: 指整个身体。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日跑完步，成身都好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 paau2 jyun4 bou6, seng4 san1 dou1 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天跑完步，全身都很累。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very tired all over my body after running today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，整到成身都係泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, zing2 dou3 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒了，弄得全身都是泥。
examples.english_sentence: He fell down and got mud all over his body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨，我成身都濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5, ngo5 seng4 san1 dou1 sap1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完雨，我全身都湿透了。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, my whole body is soaking wet.

english_meaning: to succeed, to work; Okay, all right, alright (used to indicate agreement or understanding)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情可以完成，或表示同意、理解的回应语。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something will be successful or work out. Also used as a response to indicate agreement or understanding, similar to 'Okay' or 'Alright'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搞得掂呀？成都！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3? sing4 dou1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能搞定吗？好的！
examples.english_sentence: Can you handle it? Okay!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃成都會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sing4 dou1 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划一定会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: This plan will definitely succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日見，成都！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gin3, sing4 dou1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天见，好的！
examples.english_sentence: See you tomorrow, alright!

english_meaning: growth, development; to grow up
explanation_mandarin: 指生物体或事物由小到大，由简单到复杂的演变过程；也指人经历磨练后变得成熟。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of biological entities or things evolving from small to large, from simple to complex; also refers to people becoming mature after experiencing hardships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇住啲細路仔成長，真係好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 zyu6 di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 cing4 zoeng2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看着孩子们成长，真的很开心。
examples.english_sentence: It's really joyful to watch the children grow up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司近年成長得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gan1 nin4 cing4 zoeng2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司近年来成长得很快。
examples.english_sentence: This company has grown very fast in recent years.

english_meaning: in pairs; in couples; in twos
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物总是以双数出现，多指情侣。
explanation_english: Describes things appearing in pairs or couples. Often used to describe couples in love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成雙成對咁行街，真係好sweet呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 soeng1 sing4 deoi3 gam2 haang4 gaai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个成双成对地逛街，真甜蜜啊！
examples.english_sentence: They are strolling on the street in couples, how sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情人節嗰日，啲情侶成雙成對咁去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 jan4 zit3 go2 jat6, di1 cing4 leoi5 sing4 soeng1 sing4 deoi3 gam2 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情人节那天，情侣们成双成对地去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: On Valentine's Day, couples went out for dinner in pairs.

english_meaning: Covered in sweat; drenched in sweat; sweating profusely
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常热或者非常紧张，导致头部出了很多汗。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is sweating profusely, usually due to heat or nervousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱跑完步，成頭汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngam1 ngam1 paau2 jyun4 bou6, sing4 tau4 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚刚跑完步，满头大汗。
examples.english_sentence: Just finished running, I'm drenched in sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試出嚟，佢緊張到成頭汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 chut1 lai4, keoi5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 sing4 tau4 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试出来，他紧张得满头大汗。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, he was so nervous that he was covered in sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係熱到成頭汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 jit6 dou3 sing4 tau4 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真是热得满头大汗。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today that I'm drenched in sweat.

english_meaning: to become a trend; to become common practice; to be in vogue
explanation_mandarin: 指某种做法或现象逐渐流行，成为一种普遍的习惯或风尚。
explanation_english: Refers to a practice or phenomenon that gradually becomes popular and becomes a common habit or trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔成日喺網上發表意見，呢個已經成風喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 sing4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng5 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3, ni1 go3 ji5 ging1 sing4 fung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人经常在网上发表意见，这已经成为一种风气了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people often express their opinions online, which has become a trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 炒賣演唱會飛已經成風，政府應該要正視呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caau2 maai6 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 ji5 ging1 sing4 fung1, zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 jiu3 zing3 si6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炒卖演唱会门票已经成为一种风气，政府应该要正视这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: Scalping concert tickets has become common practice, and the government should address this issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大學生畢業之後創業都開始成風，唔少人都想做自己嘅老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 hok6 saang1 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 cong3 jip6 dou1 hoi1 ci2 sing4 fung1, m4 siu2 dou1 soeng2 zou6 zi6 gei2 ge3 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大学生毕业之后创业也开始成为一种风气，不少人都想做自己的老板。
examples.english_sentence: Starting a business after graduating from university has become a trend, and many people want to be their own boss.

english_meaning: I; me
explanation_mandarin: 指说话者自己。
explanation_english: Refers to the speaker himself/herself. First-person singular pronoun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫陳大文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 can4 daai6 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叫陈大文。
examples.english_sentence: My name is Chan Tai Man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道呀。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat rice.

english_meaning: we, us
explanation_mandarin: 表示包括自己在内的若干人。
explanation_english: Pronoun referring to a group of people including the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊去睇戲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去看电影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the movies together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係香港人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是香港人。
examples.english_sentence: We are Hong Kongers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我哋唔識路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 dei6 m4 sik1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我们不认识路。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, we don't know the way.

english_meaning: we; us
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中的“我们”或“咱们”。
explanation_english: Cantonese for "we" or "us". It refers to a group of people including the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋幾時嚟我哋屋企玩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gei2 si4 lai4 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 waan2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们什么时候来我们家玩啊？
examples.english_sentence: When are you guys coming to our house to play?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係香港人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是香港人。
examples.english_sentence: We are Hong Kongers.

english_meaning: Our country; My country (referring to the speaker's nation)
explanation_mandarin: 指说话者所属的国家。
explanation_english: Refers to the country to which the speaker belongs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要愛我國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 oi3 ngo5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要爱我们的国家。
examples.english_sentence: We must love our country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以我國嘅文化為榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ngo5 gwok3 ge3 man4 faa3 wai4 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以我们国家的文化为荣。
examples.english_sentence: I am proud of my country's culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嚟自邊個國家？我嚟自我國香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lai4 zi6 bin1 go3 gwok3 gaa1? ngo5 lai4 zi6 ngo5 gwok3 Hoeng1 Gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你来自哪个国家？我来自我国香港。
examples.english_sentence: Which country are you from? I'm from my country, Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 我思故我在 (Wǒ sī gù wǒ zài)
english_meaning: I think, therefore I am
explanation_mandarin: 笛卡尔提出的著名哲学命题，表达了人的存在可以通过思考来证明。
explanation_english: A famous philosophical proposition by René Descartes, expressing that one's existence can be proved through thought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「我思故我在」呢句嘢，反映咗人嘅思考能力係存在嘅證明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si1 gu3 ngo5 zoi6 ne1 geoi3 je5, faan2 jing2 zo2 jan4 ge3 si1 haau1 nang4 lik6 hai6 chyun4 zoi6 ge3 jing3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “我思故我在”这句话，反映了人的思考能力是存在的证明。
examples.english_sentence: The saying 'I think, therefore I am' reflects that human's ability to think is proof of existence.

mandarin_meaning: 我手写我口; 言为心声
english_meaning: I write what I speak; to write in a vernacular and natural style; writing as one speaks; writing in a way that reflects one's true thoughts and feelings.
explanation_mandarin: 指写作风格自然，口语化，表达真实的思想感情，不拘泥于形式或文法。
explanation_english: Refers to a writing style that is natural, colloquial, and expresses genuine thoughts and feelings without being bound by formality or grammar. It emphasizes writing in a way that directly reflects how one speaks and thinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲文章好「我手寫我口」㗎，睇落好親切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 man4 zoeng1 hou2 "ngo5 sau2 se2 ngo5 hau2" gaa3, tai2 lok6 hou2 can1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的文章很“我手写我口”的，读起来很亲切。
examples.english_sentence: His articles are very "I write what I speak", making them feel very approachable to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人喺網上寫嘢都「我手寫我口」噉樣，唔使咁formal。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 se2 je5 dou1 "ngo5 sau2 se2 ngo5 hau2" gam2 joeng2, m4 sai2 gam3 formal.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人在网上写作都“我手写我口”这样，不用那么正式。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people write online in an "I write what I speak" style, without being so formal.

english_meaning: to go one's own way; to be a maverick; to stick to one's guns
explanation_mandarin: 指按照自己认为对的方式去做，不顾及别人的意见和看法。
explanation_english: Describes someone who does things their own way, regardless of others' opinions or expectations. They act independently and follow their own principles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好我行我素㗎，你叫佢做乜嘢佢都未必聽你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ngo5 hang4 ngo5 sou3 gaa3, nei5 giu3 keoi5 zou6 mat1 je5 keoi5 dou1 mei6 bit1 teng1 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很我行我素，你叫他做什么他都不一定听你的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very much his own person; he might not listen to you no matter what you tell him to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁我行我素啦，考慮下人哋嘅感受嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ngo5 hang4 ngo5 sou3 laa1, haau2 leoi6 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 gam2 sau6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么我行我素了，考虑一下别人的感受嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so independent, consider other people's feelings.

synonyms: 獨斷獨行 (duk6 dyun3 duk6 hang4)

english_meaning: pitiful in appearance; evokes pity and love (upon seeing); to be so delicate or charming that one inspires compassion and affection
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子容貌美丽柔弱，令人心生怜爱之情。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's appearance as beautiful, delicate, and pitiable, evoking feelings of tenderness and affection in others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得咁我見猶憐，好難唔想錫住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 saang1 dak1 gam3 ngo5 gin3 jau4 lin4, hou2 naan4 m4 soeng2 sek3 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她长得那么我见犹怜，很难不想疼惜她。
examples.english_sentence: She looks so pitifully beautiful that it's hard not to want to cherish her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個角色設計到我見猶憐，令人覺得佢好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 sai3 gai3 dou3 ngo5 gin3 jau4 lin4, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个角色设计得我见犹怜，让人觉得她很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: This character is designed to be so pitifully endearing that people feel very sorry for her.

english_meaning: to abstain from; to give up; to quit; to warn; to guard against
explanation_mandarin: 停止或放弃某种行为、习惯等。
explanation_english: To abstain from or give up a habit, action, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我決定戒煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 gaai3 yin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我决定戒烟。
examples.english_sentence: I've decided to quit smoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫佢戒口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 giu3 keoi5 gaai3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生让他忌口。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told him to abstain from certain foods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，戒備啲人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, gaai3 bei6 di1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，提防那些人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, be wary of those people.

english_meaning: to be on guard; to be vigilant; vigilance; guard
explanation_mandarin: 指警惕防备；也指警惕防备的状态。
explanation_english: To be on guard; to be vigilant. Can also refer to the state of being alert and prepared for potential danger or threats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺銀行外面高度戒備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 ngan4 hong4 ngoi6 min6 gou1 dou6 gaai3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在银行外面高度戒备。
examples.english_sentence: The police are on high alert outside the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要時刻保持戒備，提防賊仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 si4 hak1 bou2 ci4 gaai3 bei6, tai4 fong4 caak6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要时刻保持戒备，提防小偷。
examples.english_sentence: We must always be on guard and watch out for thieves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過上次嘅事件之後，佢哋嘅保安程度明顯提高咗，一直處於戒備狀態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 soeng6 ci3 ge3 si6 gin2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dei6 ge3 bou2 on1 cing4 dou6 ming4 hin2 tai4 gou1 zo2, jat1 zik6 cyu2 jyu1 gaai3 bei6 zong6 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过上次的事件之后，他们的保安程度明显提高了，一直处于戒备状态。
examples.english_sentence: After the last incident, their security level has obviously increased, and they have been in a state of vigilance.

english_meaning: to abstain from certain foods (usually for health reasons)
explanation_mandarin: 为了健康原因，避免食用某些食物。
explanation_english: To abstain from eating certain foods, usually for health reasons or dietary restrictions. This often involves avoiding specific ingredients or food groups that may aggravate a medical condition, allergy, or personal preference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家戒口，唔食海鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gaai3 hau2, m4 sik6 hoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在忌口，不吃海鲜。
examples.english_sentence: I'm abstaining from certain foods now, I don't eat seafood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我戒口，唔好食咁多油膩嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 gaai3 hau2, m4 hou2 sik6 gam3 do1 jau4 nei6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我忌口，不要吃那么多油腻的东西。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to abstain from certain foods, don't eat so much greasy food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話戒口嗰陣唔好食生冷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 gaai3 hau2 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 sik6 sang1 laang5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说忌口的时候不要吃生冷的食物。
examples.english_sentence: Mom said when you are abstaining from certain foods, don't eat raw and cold food.

english_meaning: martial law
explanation_mandarin: 指国家在特殊时期（如战争、动乱等）采取的一种紧急状态，由军队接管政府的某些职能，限制公民的某些权利，以维护社会秩序。
explanation_english: The imposition of military rule over a civilian population, typically during a time of emergency, war, or civil unrest. It involves the suspension of ordinary law and the temporary government of a country or part of it by military tribunals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣佈喺嗰個城市實行戒嚴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 hai2 go2 go3 sing4 si5 sat6 hang4 gaai3 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布在那个城市实行戒严。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced the implementation of martial law in that city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺戒嚴時期，好多人嘅自由受到限制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gaai3 jim4 si4 kei4, hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 zi6 jau4 sau6 dou3 haan6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在戒严时期，很多人的自由受到限制。
examples.english_sentence: During the period of martial law, many people's freedoms were restricted.

english_meaning: wean (a baby off breast milk)
explanation_mandarin: 指停止给婴儿喂母乳或奶粉。
explanation_english: To wean a baby off breast milk or formula; to stop feeding a baby with breast milk or formula and introduce other solid food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋準備幫BB戒奶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyun2 bei6 bong1 bi1 bi1 gaai3 naai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们准备帮宝宝断奶了。
examples.english_sentence: We are preparing to wean the baby off milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話佢嗰陣時好快就幫我戒咗奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 keoi5 go2 zan6 si4 hou2 faai3 zau6 bong1 ngo5 gaai3 zo2 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说她那时很快就帮我断奶了。
examples.english_sentence: My mother said that she weaned me off milk very quickly back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戒奶唔係一件容易嘅事，要慢慢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai3 naai5 m4 hai6 jat1 gin6 jung4 ji6 ge3 si6, jiu3 maan6 maan6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 断奶不是一件容易的事，要慢慢来。
examples.english_sentence: Weaning is not an easy task, it has to be done gradually.

english_meaning: ruler for discipline; cane; paddle (used for corporal punishment in schools)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时私塾或学校中，教师用来惩罚学生的尺子或板子。
explanation_english: A ruler or paddle used by teachers in old-fashioned private schools or schools to punish students, often by striking their hands or buttocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲老師成日用戒尺打學生手板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 lou5 si1 seng4 jat6 jung6 gaai3 cek3 daa2 hok6 sang1 sau2 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的老师总是用戒尺打学生的手板。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, teachers often used the discipline ruler to strike students' palms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個唔聽話，成日俾阿爸用戒尺打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 m4 teng1 waa6, seng4 jat6 bei2 aa3 baa4 jung6 gaai3 cek3 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候不听话，经常被爸爸用戒尺打。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he was disobedient and was often beaten by his father with a ruler.

english_meaning: precepts and rules; religious discipline; commandment
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，指约束僧尼言行的各种规定。 也泛指道德或宗教的规范。
explanation_english: In Buddhism, precepts and rules that restrict the words and deeds of monks and nuns. Also, broadly refers to moral or religious norms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛教嘅戒律好嚴格㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 gaau3 ge3 gaai3 leot6 hou2 jim4 gaak3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛教的戒律很严格的。
examples.english_sentence: The Buddhist precepts are very strict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅教條同埋戒律好多㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gaau3 tiu4 tung4 maai4 gaai3 leot6 hou2 do1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的教条和戒律很多。
examples.english_sentence: Their doctrines and precepts are many.

english_meaning: vigilance; wariness; guardedness; alertness; precaution; suspicion
explanation_mandarin: 提防别人，小心警惕的心情。
explanation_english: A state of wariness, caution, and suspicion towards others; the feeling of being guarded and on alert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大戒心啦，我哋都係想幫你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 gaai3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么大的戒心啦，我们都只是想帮你而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so wary, we just want to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對陌生人嘅戒心好重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 mak6 sang1 jan4 ge3 gaai3 sam1 hou2 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对陌生人的戒备心很重。
examples.english_sentence: He is very wary of strangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意一定要有戒心，唔可以咁容易信人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 gaai3 sam1, m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意一定要有戒备心，不可以这么容易相信别人。
examples.english_sentence: You must be wary in business; you can't trust people so easily.

mandarin_meaning: 戒骄戒躁，遇事要冷静忍耐。
english_meaning: Refrain from impatience, be patient and tolerant.
explanation_mandarin: 告诫人们要戒除急躁情绪，遇到事情要冷静忍耐，不要冲动行事。
explanation_english: An idiom advising people to refrain from impatience and to remain calm and tolerant when encountering problems, avoiding impulsive actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢千祈要戒急用忍，唔好咁心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 cin1 kei4 jiu3 gaai3 gap1 yung6 yan2, m4 hou2 gam3 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作的时候千万要戒骄戒躁，不要这么着急。
examples.english_sentence: When working, you must refrain from impatience and be patient; don't be so anxious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到困難嘅時候，記住要戒急用忍，諗清楚先做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou2 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 zyu6 jiu3 gaai3 gap1 yung6 yan2, nam2 cing1 chu2 sin1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到困难的时候，记住要冷静忍耐，想清楚再做。
examples.english_sentence: When facing difficulties, remember to be patient and tolerant, and think clearly before acting.

english_meaning: ring
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手指上的装饰品，通常用金属、玉石等制成。
explanation_english: A decorative band worn on a finger, typically made of metal, jade, or other materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢求婚嘅時候送咗隻鑽石戒指畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kau4 fun1 ge3 si4 hau6 sung3 zo2 zek3 dyun3 sek6 gaai3 zi2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他求婚的时候送给我了一枚钻戒。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a diamond ring when he proposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻戒指太細，我戴唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gaai3 zi2 taai3 sai3, ngo5 daai3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这戒指太小了，我戴不进去。
examples.english_sentence: The ring is too small, I can't wear it.

english_meaning: Ring pop candy
explanation_mandarin: 一种糖果，形状像戒指，可以戴在手指上。
explanation_english: A type of candy shaped like a ring that can be worn on the finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日都買戒指糖嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 dou1 maai5 gaai3 zi2 tong2 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常买戒指糖来吃。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I often bought ring pops to eat.

english_meaning: to quit, to give up, to break (a habit)
explanation_mandarin: 指停止或放弃某种习惯、嗜好或依赖行为。
explanation_english: To stop or give up a habit, addiction, or dependent behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我決定戒掉食煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 gaai3 diu6 sik6 yin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我决定戒掉抽烟。
examples.english_sentence: I've decided to quit smoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戒掉咗飲咖啡嘅習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai3 diu6 zo2 yam2 gaa3 fe1 ge3 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戒掉了喝咖啡的习惯。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up the habit of drinking coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要戒掉呢個壞習慣唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yiu3 gaai3 diu6 ni1 go3 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3 m4 yung4 yi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要戒掉这个坏习惯不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to quit this bad habit.

english_meaning: prescription; written order for medicine
explanation_mandarin: 指医生开具的药方，通常是纸质的。
explanation_english: Refers to a doctor's prescription, usually a written document, that allows a patient to obtain specific medication from a pharmacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生開咗張戒方俾我，叫我去藥房執藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 zoeng1 gaai3 fong1 bei2 ngo5, giu3 ngo5 heoi3 yoek6 fong4 zap1 yoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生给我开了一张处方，叫我去药房拿药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor gave me a prescription and told me to get the medicine from the pharmacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拎住張戒方去藥房配藥就得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling1 zyu6 zoeng1 gaai3 fong1 heoi3 yoek6 fong4 pui3 yoek6 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿着这张处方去药房配药就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Just take the prescription to the pharmacy to get the medicine.

english_meaning: precept; rule; commandment; discipline
explanation_mandarin: 指宗教或团体的规章、戒律，亦可指一般的生活守则或规定。
explanation_english: Refers to rules and commandments of a religion or organization; it can also refer to general rules or regulations for life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛教有五戒，係佛教徒要遵守嘅戒條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 gaau3 jau5 ng5 gaai3, hai6 fat6 gaau3 tou4 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 ge3 gaai3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛教有五戒，是佛教徒要遵守的戒律。
examples.english_sentence: Buddhism has five precepts, which are the commandments that Buddhists must follow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校好多戒條，學生唔可以染頭髮，又唔可以帶手機返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 do1 gaai3 tiu4, hok6 sang1 m4 ho2 ji5 jim5 tau4 faat3, jau6 m4 ho2 ji5 daai3 sau2 gei1 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间学校有很多规章，学生不可以染头发，也不可以带手机上学。
examples.english_sentence: This school has a lot of rules; students can't dye their hair and can't bring their phones to school.

english_meaning: to quit drugs, drug rehabilitation
explanation_mandarin: 指戒除毒瘾的行为或过程。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or process of overcoming drug addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決心要戒毒，重新做人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 sam1 jiu3 gaai3 duk6, cung4 san1 zou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决心要戒毒，重新做人。
examples.english_sentence: He is determined to quit drugs and start a new life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府提供好多戒毒服務俾有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 cung4 gung1 hou2 do1 gaai3 duk6 fuk6 mou6 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府为有需要的人提供很多戒毒服务。
examples.english_sentence: The government provides many drug rehabilitation services to people in need.

english_meaning: rehabilitation center for drug addicts, drug rehabilitation center
explanation_mandarin: 专门帮助吸毒者戒除毒瘾的场所。
explanation_english: A specialized facility dedicated to helping drug addicts overcome their addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾屋企人送咗去戒毒所，希望佢可以成功戒甩毒癮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4 sung3 zo2 heoi3 gaai3 duk6 so2, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1 gaai3 lat1 duk6 yan5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被家人送去了戒毒所，希望他可以成功戒掉毒瘾。
examples.english_sentence: His family sent him to the rehabilitation center, hoping he can successfully kick his drug habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人覺得入戒毒所係一件好羞恥嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 gok3 dak1 jap6 gaai3 duk6 so2 hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 sau1 ci2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人觉得进戒毒所是一件很羞耻的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Many people feel that going to a rehabilitation center is a very shameful thing.

english_meaning: to quit smoking
explanation_mandarin: 停止吸烟。
explanation_english: To stop smoking; to give up smoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住下個月開始戒煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 gaai3 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算下个月开始戒烟。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to start quitting smoking next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戒煙對身體好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai3 jin1 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戒烟对身体好。
examples.english_sentence: Quitting smoking is good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫佢戒煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 keoi5 gaai3 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫他戒烟。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told him to quit smoking.

english_meaning: to give up, to quit (a habit), to break (an addiction)
explanation_mandarin: 指戒掉某种不良习惯或瘾好。
explanation_english: To give up or quit a bad habit or addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決心要戒除食煙嘅習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 sam1 jiu3 gaai3 ceoi4 sik6 jin1 ge3 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决心要戒掉吸烟的习惯。
examples.english_sentence: He is determined to quit smoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戒除賭博並唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai3 ceoi4 dou2 bok3 bing4 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戒掉赌博并不容易。
examples.english_sentence: Quitting gambling is not easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議佢戒除咖啡因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 keoi5 gaai3 ceoi4 gaa3 fe1 yan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议他戒掉咖啡因。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suggested that he quit caffeine.

english_meaning: to kill; to harm; to damage; to injure
explanation_mandarin: 杀害，伤害。在粤语中，这个字通常带有一种比较强烈的，比较正式或者书面的意味。
explanation_english: To kill, harm, or injure. In Cantonese, this word usually carries a more intense, formal, or literary connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋戕害咗好多無辜嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 coeng1 hoi6 zo2 hou2 do1 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们杀害了很多无辜的人。
examples.english_sentence: They killed many innocent people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為一時衝動就戕害自己嘅前途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai4 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6 zau6 coeng1 hoi6 zi6 gei2 ge3 cin4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为一时冲动就伤害自己的前途。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ruin your future because of a momentary impulse.

english_meaning: or
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择关系的连词，相当于“或者”。
explanation_english: A conjunction expressing a choice or alternative; equivalent to "or".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想飲咖啡或茶呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jam2 gaa3 fe1 waak6 caa4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想喝咖啡或者茶？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to drink coffee or tea?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日去或聽日去都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 waak6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天去或者明天去都可以。
examples.english_sentence: You can go today or tomorrow.

english_meaning: more or less; to some extent
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、数量等不确定，但存在一定的范围之内。
explanation_english: Indicates that a degree, quantity, etc., is uncertain but exists within a certain range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功或多或少都要歸功於佢嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 waak6 do1 waak6 siu2 dou1 jiu3 gwai1 gung1 jyu1 keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功或多或少都要归功于他的努力。
examples.english_sentence: His success is more or less attributable to his hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事或多或少對佢造成咗影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 waak6 do1 waak6 siu2 deoi3 keoi5 zou6 sing4 zo2 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事或多或少对他造成了影响。
examples.english_sentence: This matter more or less had an impact on him.

english_meaning: or, perhaps, maybe, possibly
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择关系或不确定的情况。
explanation_english: Indicates an alternative or a situation of uncertainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想飲咖啡，或者茶呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jam2 gaa3 fe1, waak6 ze2 caa4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想喝咖啡，或者茶？
examples.english_sentence: Would you like coffee, or tea?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢或者聽日會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 ze2 ting1 jat6 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他或许明天会来。
examples.english_sentence: He might come tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 或者咁做會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waak6 ze2 gam2 zou6 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 也许这样做会好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Perhaps it would be better to do it this way.

english_meaning: perhaps, maybe
explanation_mandarin: 表示不確定的推測或可能性。
explanation_english: Indicates uncertainty, conjecture, or possibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 或許聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waak6 heui2 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 或许明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢或許唔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 heui2 m4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他或许不会来。
examples.english_sentence: Perhaps he won't come.

english_meaning: to stand up; to erect; to be vertical; to cock (slang, referring to male genitalia)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体竖立的状态。口语中常用来指男性生殖器勃起。
explanation_english: Indicates the state of an object standing upright. In colloquial Cantonese, it's often used to refer to a male erection (vulgar slang).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓瞓吓突然戙起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 fan3 haa5 dat6 jin4 dong6 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡着睡着突然站起来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sleeping and suddenly stood up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 支旗戙喺山顶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 kei4 dong6 hai2 saan1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旗子竖立在山顶。
examples.english_sentence: The flag is standing up on the top of the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條嘢又戙起咗啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 je5 jau6 dong6 hei2 zo2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的那个又勃起了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is your thing up again?

english_meaning: to stand up; standing
explanation_mandarin: 站立，通常指比较突然或快速地站起来。
explanation_english: To stand up; often implies a sudden or quick standing motion. Can also be used to describe something that is standing upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到個消息就即刻戙企起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ting1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 zik1 hak1 dong6 kei5 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到这个消息就立刻站起来。
examples.english_sentence: He stood up immediately after hearing the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枝筆戙企喺檯面度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 bat1 dong6 kei5 hai2 toi2 min6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 笔直立在桌面上。
examples.english_sentence: The pen is standing upright on the table.

mandarin_meaning: 待宰的肥羊, 冤大头
english_meaning: A sitting duck; someone easily cheated or taken advantage of
explanation_mandarin: 比喻容易被欺骗、占便宜的人，就像站着不动的鱼一样容易被抓。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone who is easily deceived, cheated, or taken advantage of, like a fish standing upright and easily caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，擺明係一條戙企水魚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, baai2 ming4 hai6 jat1 tiu4 dong6 kei5 seoi2 jyu4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么笨，摆明就是一条待宰的肥羊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he's obviously a sitting duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做戙企水魚俾人呃啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 dong6 kei5 seoi2 jyu4 bei2 jan4 aak1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做待宰的肥羊被人骗啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a sitting duck and get cheated!

mandarin_meaning: 竖旗; 立旗; 支起; 勃起 (俚语)
english_meaning: To erect a flag; to raise a flag; to pitch a tent; to get an erection (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是竖起旗帜。在俚语中，通常指男性勃起。
explanation_english: Literally means to raise a flag. In slang, it usually refers to a male erection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢见到佢嘅女神即刻戙旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 ge3 nui5 san4 zik1 hak1 dung6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见到他的女神立刻勃起了。
examples.english_sentence: He got an erection immediately upon seeing his goddess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班童軍喺营地度戙旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 tung4 gwan1 hai2 ying4 dei6 dou6 dung6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 童子军在营地里竖起旗帜。
examples.english_sentence: The boy scouts raised flags at the campsite.

english_meaning: Standing upright; to stand straight (often implying clumsiness or instability)
explanation_mandarin: 形容直直地站立着，多指站立不稳，摇摇晃晃的样子，或指像木头人一样直立不动。
explanation_english: Describes someone standing straight upright, often implying unsteadiness, wobbliness, or standing rigidly like a wooden figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉咗酒，戙篤企都企唔穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zo2 zau2, dong6 duk1 kei5 dou1 kei5 m4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉了酒，站都站不稳。
examples.english_sentence: He's drunk; he can't even stand straight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度戙篤企啦，坐低休息下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 dong6 duk1 kei5 laa1, co5 dai1 rest1 sik1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里站着了，坐下休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand there, sit down and have a rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路戙篤企喺度，好似唔知發生咩事咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 dong6 duk1 kei5 hai2 dou6, hou2 ci5 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩直愣愣地站在那里，好像不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: The child is standing there stiffly, as if he doesn't know what's happening.

english_meaning: Stand-up comedy
explanation_mandarin: 一种单人表演的喜剧形式，表演者通常站在舞台上，通过幽默的言语、故事和观察来逗乐观众。
explanation_english: A type of solo comedy performance where the performer typically stands on stage and entertains the audience with humorous speech, stories, and observations. It's the Cantonese term for stand-up comedy, often associated with performances similar to those by Dane Cook or Jerry Seinfeld but in a Cantonese cultural context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去睇黃子華嘅戙篤笑啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 wong4 zi2 waa4 ge3 dong6 duk1 siu3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去看黄子华的栋笃笑吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go watch Dayo Wong's stand-up comedy show tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅戙篤笑真係好好笑，全場爆笑！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 dong6 duk1 siu3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 siu3, cyun4 coeng4 baau3 siu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的栋笃笑真的很好笑，全场都笑了！
examples.english_sentence: His stand-up comedy was really funny, the whole audience was laughing!

english_meaning: to get out of bed
explanation_mandarin: 起床。竖起床板，表示从床上起来。
explanation_english: To get out of bed. Literally, it means to put up the bed board (an older style of bed frame), indicating that one is getting out of bed.  More casually and commonly used to mean 'get up' or 'wake up'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲戙起床板啦，唔係就遲到喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 dung6 hei2 chong4 baan2 laa1, m4 hai6 jau6 chi4 dou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点起床吧，不然就要迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: Get out of bed quickly, or you'll be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要好早戙起床板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 hou2 zou2 dung6 hei2 chong4 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要很早起床。
examples.english_sentence: I have to get out of bed very early tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 装病不上班；装病躲避工作
english_meaning: To feign illness to avoid work; to skive; to pull a sickie
explanation_mandarin: 指故意装病，从而逃避工作或责任。
explanation_english: Refers to pretending to be sick in order to avoid work or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都戙起床板，老闆都知佢係扮嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 dung6 hei2 cong4 baan2, lou5 baan2 dou1 zi1 keoi5 hai6 baan6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装病不上班，老板都知道他是装的。
examples.english_sentence: He always calls in sick, the boss knows he's faking it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住戙起床板，要努力工作先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 dung6 hei2 cong4 baan2, jiu3 nu5 lik6 gung1 zok3 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老想着装病不上班，要努力工作才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about pulling a sickie, you need to work hard.

mandarin_meaning: 准备打架； 竖起床板
english_meaning: To prepare for a fight; literally, to prop up the bed board
explanation_mandarin: 原本的意思是竖起床板来作为防御，引申为准备打架，摆出战斗姿态。也可能真的只是竖起床板，取决于语境。
explanation_english: Originally, it literally means to prop up the bed board to use it as a shield for defense. By extension, it means to prepare for a fight, to get into a fighting stance. It can also literally mean propping up a bed board depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你咪搞搞震，唔係我戙起牀板㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, nei5 mai5 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, m4 hai6 ngo5 dung6 hei2 cong4 baan2 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你别惹事生非，不然我就要准备和你打架了！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't cause trouble, or I'll get ready to fight you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一言不合就戙起牀板，差啲打起上嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 jin4 bat1 hap6 zau6 dung6 hei2 cong4 baan2, caa1 di1 daa2 hei2 soeng5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个一言不合就要打架，差点就打起来了。
examples.english_sentence: They almost started fighting because they disagreed and got ready to fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房太細，我咪戙起牀板，慳啲位囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 taai3 sai3, ngo5 mai1 dung6 hei2 cong4 baan2, haan1 di1 wai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间太小了，我就把床板竖起来，节省点空间。
examples.english_sentence: The room is too small, so I propped up the bed board to save some space.

擺出架勢 (baai2 chut1 gaa3 sai3)

english_meaning: To feign illness; to pretend to be sick; to put on an act
explanation_mandarin: “戙高床板”比喻装病，装模作样，假装身体不适。 这是粤语中一种形象的说法，意思是把床板竖起来，表示病人卧床不起，以此来逃避责任或博取同情。
explanation_english: "戙高床板" (dung6 go1 cong4 baan2) metaphorically means to feign illness or pretend to be sick. It's a vivid Cantonese expression depicting someone propping up the bed boards to indicate they are bedridden, often to avoid responsibility or gain sympathy. The asterisk (*) in '戙高床板*' implies that it is often used somewhat sarcastically or with a hint of disbelief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪再喺度戙高床板啦，個個都知你扮嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 zoi3 hai2 dou6 dung6 go1 cong4 baan2 laa1, go3 go3 dou1 zi1 nei5 baan6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再装病了，大家都知道你是在装样子。
examples.english_sentence: Stop feigning illness, everyone knows you're just pretending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都戙高床板，想攞多啲病假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 dung6 go1 cong4 baan2, soeng2 lo2 do1 di1 beng6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装病，想多请几天病假。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be sick, wanting to take more sick leave.

english_meaning: Just you wait; you'll see
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种带有威胁或挑衅意味的等待看结果的态度。 类似于普通话的“等着瞧”、“走着瞧”。
explanation_english: Expresses a threatening or provocative attitude of waiting to see the outcome. Similar to "Just you wait" or "You'll see" in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家唔聽我講，戙高牀板，睇你到時點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 m4 teng1 ngo5 gong2, dung6 gou1 cong4 baan2, tai2 nei5 dou3 si4 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在不听我的话，等着瞧，看你到时候怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: You're not listening to me now, just you wait, see what you'll do then.

english_meaning: Relative; close; near
explanation_mandarin: 指亲戚，也可以表示关系近。
explanation_english: Refers to relatives. Can also indicate that the relationship is close or near.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我遠房戚
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 jyun5 fong4 cik1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的远房亲戚
examples.english_sentence: He is my distant relative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢嘅關係都幾戚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 dou1 gei2 cik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他的关系也挺近的。
examples.english_sentence: My relationship with him is quite close.

mandarin_meaning: 停止; 突然停止; 终止
english_meaning: to stop abruptly; to halt; to cease
explanation_mandarin: 表示突然停止，中断。
explanation_english: Indicates a sudden stop or interruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車突然戛咗喺度，嚇死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 dat6 jin4 gaat3 zo2 hai2 dou6, hak1 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车突然停了下来，吓死我了。
examples.english_sentence: The car stopped abruptly, scaring me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講講下，佢突然戛然而止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 gong2 haa5, keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaat3 jin4 ji4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说着说着，他突然戛然而止。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly stopped speaking in the middle of his sentence.

english_meaning: To contradict; to argue back; to talk back; to be argumentative
explanation_mandarin: 指顶撞、抬杠，不听劝告，喜欢争辩。
explanation_english: Refers to contradicting, arguing back, not listening to advice, and liking to argue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日同阿媽戟嘴啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tung4 aa3 maa1 gik1 zeoi2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是和妈妈顶嘴了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always argue with your mother!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意戟人，所以冇乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 gik1 jan4, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢抬杠，所以没什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to argue back, so he doesn't have many friends.

english_meaning: to feel pleased for someone else; to be happy for someone (often mixed with a tinge of envy)
explanation_mandarin: 对别人的成就感到高兴，但也可能带有一点羡慕或嫉妒的情绪。
explanation_english: To feel happy for someone else's success or good fortune, sometimes with a slight feeling of envy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係戥你高興啊，升咗職！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 dang3 nei5 gou1 hing3 aa3, sing1 zo2 zik1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真为你高兴啊，升职了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm really happy for you, you got promoted!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗新車，我戥佢開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 san1 ce1, ngo5 dang3 keoi5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了新车，我替他高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car, I'm happy for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到大學，我都戥佢叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 daai6 hok6, ngo5 dou1 dang3 keoi5 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上大学了，我也觉得他很棒。
examples.english_sentence: He got into university, I'm really proud of him.

english_meaning: To be happy for someone; to feel joy on behalf of someone
explanation_mandarin: 为他人感到高兴。表示因为别人遇到好事而由衷地感到快乐。
explanation_english: To feel genuinely happy for someone because of their good fortune or success. It expresses sincere joy on their behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係戥你開心，你終於搵到份好工啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 dang3 nei5 hoi1 sam1, nei5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 fan6 hou2 gung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的替你开心，你终于找到一份好工作啦！
examples.english_sentence: I'm really happy for you, you've finally found a good job!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到你結婚嘅消息，我好戥你開心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 nei5 git3 fan1 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 hou2 dang3 nei5 hoi1 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到你结婚的消息，我好替你开心呀！
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of your marriage, I'm so happy for you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞到獎，我戥佢好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 dou2 zo2 zoeng2, ngo5 dang3 keoi5 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他获奖了，我替他很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He won an award, I'm very happy for him.

english_meaning: to feel sorry for someone who has been treated unfairly; to feel indignation on someone's behalf; to feel that someone doesn't deserve their misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 为他人遭遇不公正对待或不幸感到不值、同情，甚至愤慨。
explanation_english: To feel sorry for someone who has been treated unfairly or has experienced misfortune. It conveys a sense of indignation and the feeling that the person deserves better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力做嘢，但係老細都唔加人工俾佢，真係戥佢唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6 zou6 je5, daan6 hai6 lou5 sai3 dou1 m4 gaa1 jan4 gung1 bei2 keoi5, zan1 hai6 dang3 keoi5 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力工作，但是老板都不给他加工资，真是替他不值。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard, but the boss doesn't give him a raise. I really feel sorry for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就走咗，真係戥佢屋企人唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 dang3 keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就去世了，真是替他家人感到不值。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away at such a young age, I really feel sorry for his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人呃咗咁多錢，我真係戥佢唔抵囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 dang3 keoi5 m4 dai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了这么多钱，我真是替他不值啊。
examples.english_sentence: He was cheated out of so much money, I really feel sorry for him.

english_meaning: to help; to lend a hand
explanation_mandarin: 帮助别人做事情，提供协助。
explanation_english: To help someone do something; to lend a hand; to offer assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你使唔使我戥手呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai2 m4 sai2 ngo5 dang3 sau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要我帮忙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you need me to help?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋咁多嘢，你都嚟戥下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 gam3 do1 je5, nei5 dou1 lai4 dang3 haa5 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家这么多东西，你也来帮下手吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many things to move. Come and lend a hand.

english_meaning: to mix evenly; to stir until blended; to distribute fairly
explanation_mandarin: 将不同成分混合均匀。也引申为将利益或负担公平分配。
explanation_english: To mix different ingredients evenly. It also implies the fair distribution of benefits or burdens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我將啲麵粉同水戥番勻佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 di1 min6 fan2 tung4 seoi2 dang3 faan1 wan4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把面粉和水搅拌均匀吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me mix the flour and water evenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次分錢要戥番勻，唔可以有人蝕底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 fan1 cin2 jiu3 dang3 faan1 wan4, m4 ho2 ji5 jau5 jan4 sit3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次分钱要分公平，不能让任何人吃亏。
examples.english_sentence: The money must be distributed fairly this time, so that no one suffers a loss.

english_meaning: to mix evenly, to stir evenly
explanation_mandarin: 将不同成分的东西充分混合，使其均匀分布。
explanation_english: To mix different ingredients thoroughly so that they are evenly distributed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我戥番勻啲粉，唔好有粉粒呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 dang2 faan1 wan4 di1 fan2, m4 hou2 jau5 fan2 lap1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把面粉搅拌均匀，不要有面粉颗粒啊。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me mix the flour evenly, there shouldn't be any lumps of flour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煮咖哩最緊要係要戥番勻啲香料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 gaa3 lei1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 jiu3 dang2 faan1 wan4 di1 hoeng1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煮咖喱最重要的是要把香料搅拌均匀。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing when cooking curry is to mix the spices evenly.

english_meaning: to contribute a share (often in a good cause); to feel happy for someone (used when someone gets a good result or experiences good fortune); to be envious (in a good way); to join in and support
explanation_mandarin: 原本指在秤东西时，如果重量不够，额外增加重量使达到所需重量。引申为凑份子或为他人获得好运而感到高兴，略带羡慕之情。也指支持，参与。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to adding weight to a scale to reach the required weight. By extension, it means to contribute a share (often money for a good cause) or to feel happy for someone's good fortune, often with a hint of envy. It can also mean to support or participate in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職，我真係戥佢高興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 dang2 keoi5 gou1 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，我真为他高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He got a promotion, I'm really happy for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次籌款，我都想戥秤一份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 cau4 fun2, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 dang2 cing3 jat1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次筹款，我也想凑一份。
examples.english_sentence: I also want to contribute a share to this fundraising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到你咁成功，我真係戥你開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 nei5 gam3 sing4 gung1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 dang2 nei5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到你这么成功，我真为你开心。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing you so successful, I am truly happy for you.

synonyms: 分享 (fan1 hoeng2 - share the joy)

mandarin_meaning: 比喻非常重情义，十分讲义气
english_meaning: Extremely loyal and supportive; to stand by someone through thick and thin
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常重情义，即使面对困难也会尽力帮助朋友。戥子是旧时称量金银等贵重物品的精密衡器，穿石表示力量强大，能穿透石头。整个词语比喻情义深重，可以帮助朋友克服任何困难。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely loyal and supportive, willing to stand by their friends and help them through any difficulty. 'Dang' refers to a small, precise scale used for weighing precious metals like gold and silver. 'Chyun sek' means to pierce a stone, indicating great strength. The idiom as a whole signifies profound loyalty and the ability to help friends overcome any obstacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個真係戥穿石咁嘅朋友，無論發生咩事都會互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zan1 hai6 dang3 cyun1 sek6 gam2 ge3 pang4 jau5, mou4 leon6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 dou1 wui5 wu6 soeng1 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩真是像戥穿石一样的朋友，无论发生什么事都会互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: They are truly friends who stick together through thick and thin; no matter what happens, they will support each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明份人最講義氣，簡直係戥穿石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 fan6 jan4 zeoi3 gong2 ji6 hei3, gaan2 zik1 hai6 dang3 cyun1 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明这个人最讲义气，简直是戥穿石。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is the most righteous person, he's practically like a friend who sticks with you through thick and thin.

synonyms: 有情有義 (jau5 cing4 jau5 ji6)
兩肋插刀 (loeng5 lak6 caap3 dou1)

mandarin_meaning: 调匀; 掺和均匀; 平均分配
english_meaning: To mix evenly; to blend; to stir; to average out; to make something even or fair.
explanation_mandarin: 1. 动词：将不同的东西混合均匀。2. 形容词：形容事物分配或混合得非常均匀。
explanation_english: 1. Verb: To mix different things thoroughly and evenly. 2. Adjective: Describes something that is distributed or mixed very evenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得將啲油同醋戥翻勻先落去沙律度呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 zoeng1 di1 jau4 tung4 cou3 dang2 faan1 wan4 sin1 lok6 heoi3 saa1 leot6 dou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得先把油和醋调匀再放到沙拉里。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to mix the oil and vinegar evenly before adding it to the salad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將啲錢戥翻勻，每人攞一份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 cin2 dang2 faan1 wan4, mui5 jan4 lo2 jat1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把钱平均分配，每人拿一份。
examples.english_sentence: They averaged out the money and everyone took a share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要戥翻勻啲工作，唔可以淨係一個人做晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dang2 faan1 wan4 di1 gung1 zok3, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要平均分配工作，不能只让一个人做完。
examples.english_sentence: We need to distribute the work evenly; we can't let just one person do it all.

english_meaning: to mix thoroughly; to blend evenly; to stir and make even
explanation_mandarin: 用工具（如筷子、勺子等）将食物或液体搅拌均匀。
explanation_english: To mix ingredients thoroughly and evenly, typically food or liquid, using utensils like chopsticks or spoons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我戥翻勻啲醬呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 dang3 faan1 wan4 di1 zoeng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把这些酱拌匀一下。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me mix this sauce thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲麵撈完都唔夠勻，要戥翻勻佢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 min6 lou1 jyun4 dou1 m4 gau3 wan4, jiu3 dang3 faan1 wan4 keoi5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面拌得不够匀，要再搅拌一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: The noodles aren't mixed evenly enough; they need to be mixed thoroughly again.

english_meaning: To play a supporting role; to provide assistance (often in a subordinate position); to flatter or build someone up; to be a foil.
explanation_mandarin: 原指用杆秤给人称东西时，在秤砣旁边戥一些东西来达到平衡。引申为在某件事情中起辅助作用，陪衬，衬托，有时带有贬义，指抬轿子，奉承别人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to adding small weights to a steelyard (traditional Chinese scale) to achieve balance. By extension, it means to play a supporting role in something, to complement or contrast, sometimes with a derogatory connotation, meaning to flatter or to 'carry someone's sedan chair'. It implies a supporting or secondary role where one enhances another's importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得喺老細面前戥腳，擦鞋擦到出汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 dang3 goek3, caat3 haai4 caat3 dou3 ceot1 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会在老板面前拍马屁，擦鞋擦得太厉害了。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to flatter the boss; he's sucking up to him so much it's ridiculous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想做呢個project 嘅戥腳，我想自己 lead 住嚟做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ni1 go3 pro1-dzek6 ge3 dang3 goek3, ngo5 soeng2 zi6 gei2 lead zyu6 lai4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想在这个项目里当配角，我想自己领导着做。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be a supporting player in this project; I want to lead it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉佢只係嚟戥腳，根本冇機會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 keoi5 zi2 hai6 lai4 dang3 goek3, gan1 bun2 mou5 gei1 wui2 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次选举他只是来陪衬，根本没有机会赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a token candidate in this election; he has no chance of winning.

english_meaning: to add to the fun, to join in the merriment, to liven things up, to add to the atmosphere
explanation_mandarin: 为增加热闹气氛而参与其中。指参与到某个活动中，使气氛更加活跃。
explanation_english: To participate in something to add to the lively atmosphere. It refers to joining an activity to make the atmosphere more active and enjoyable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見佢哋玩得咁開心，都想過去戥吓興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 keoi5 dei6 waan2 dak1 gam3 hoi1 sam1, dou1 soeng2 gwo3 heoi3 dang3 haa5 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到他们玩得这么开心，也想过去凑个热闹。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing them having so much fun, I want to go over and join in the merriment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，我只係想嚟戥吓興，唔係想搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 lai4 dang3 haa5 hing3, m4 hai6 soeng2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思啊，我只是想来凑凑热闹，不是想捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I just wanted to add to the fun, not to cause trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 称猪用的秤砣；比喻没用的人或物；累赘
english_meaning: A weight used for weighing pigs; a useless person or thing; a burden; dead weight
explanation_mandarin: 旧时用来称猪的秤砣。比喻没有用处的人或事物，累赘，多余。
explanation_english: Originally, a weight used for weighing pigs on a steelyard balance. Figuratively, it refers to a useless person or thing, a burden, or something superfluous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好似舊戥豬石咁，乜都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 gau6 dang3 zyu1 sek6 gam2, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里像个没用的东西一样，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a dead weight in the company, doesn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做戥豬石啦，幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 dang3 zyu1 sek6 laa1, bong1 saa2 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别当个累赘了，帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a burden, lend a hand.

synonyms: 阻頭阻勢 (zo2 tau4 zo2 sai3)

mandarin_meaning: 掺匀; 混合均匀; 分摊
english_meaning: To mix thoroughly; to blend evenly; to distribute proportionally; to share the burden equally.
explanation_mandarin: 指将不同的东西混合均匀，或者将责任、负担等平均分摊。
explanation_english: Refers to mixing different things thoroughly until they are evenly blended, or to distributing responsibilities or burdens proportionally among people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將啲水泥戥返勻佢先好用呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 di1 sai1 nai4 dang3 faan1 wan4 keoi5 sin1 hou2 yung6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要先把水泥混合均匀才能用。
examples.english_sentence: You have to mix the cement thoroughly before you can use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁大鑊，大家戥返勻佢啦，唔好淨係佢一個人孭飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 gam3 daai6 wok6, daai6 gaa1 dang3 faan1 wan4 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 be1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次事情这么严重，大家一起分担吧，不要让他一个人承担。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious, let's all share the burden; don't let him take the sole responsibility.

english_meaning: To mix evenly, to stir evenly
explanation_mandarin: 把东西搅拌或混合，使之均匀。
explanation_english: To stir or mix something thoroughly to ensure it is evenly distributed and combined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲粉戥返勻先至落鑊煎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 fan2 dang2 faan1 wan4 sin1 zi3 lok6 wok6 zin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把面粉搅拌均匀再下锅煎。
examples.english_sentence: Stir the flour evenly before putting it into the pan to fry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲粥嘅時候要記得戥返勻，唔係就會黐底㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 zuk1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 gei3 dak1 dang2 faan1 wan4, m4 hai6 zau6 wui5 ci1 dai2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煮粥的时候要记得搅拌均匀，不然就会粘锅底了。
examples.english_sentence: When cooking congee, remember to stir evenly, otherwise it will stick to the bottom of the pot.

english_meaning: To join in the fun; to add to the excitement; to support; to help along; to show support by being present
explanation_mandarin: 指参与到某件事情中，使气氛更加活跃或热闹，也指帮助别人或支持别人。多用于热闹的场合或表达支持之情。
explanation_english: Refers to joining in on something to make the atmosphere more lively and exciting, or to help or support someone. Often used in lively situations or to express support by being present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嚟戥下你頭，等你好睇啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai4 dang3 haa5 nei5 tau2, dang2 nei5 hou2 tai2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我来给你捧捧场，让你更好看一些。
examples.english_sentence: I'm here to support you and make you look better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚我哋去戥下頭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 dang3 haa5 tau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他结婚我们去凑个热闹吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's getting married, let's go join in the fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你哋嚟戥我頭呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 lai4 dang3 ngo5 tau2 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你们来捧我的场啊！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for coming to support me!

mandarin_meaning: 切断, 阻止, 截止
english_meaning: to cut off, to intercept, to stop, to discontinue, section, segment
explanation_mandarin: 1. 切断；割断。2. 阻止；拦截。3. 截止（时间）。4. 量词，表示一段。
explanation_english: 1. To cut off or sever. 2. To intercept, block, or stop something. 3. To have a deadline; to stop at a specific time. 4. (Measure word) Used for segments or sections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺半路截住佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 bun3 lou6 zit6 zyu6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在半路上截住了他们。
examples.english_sentence: We intercepted them halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就截稿喇，你交咗未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 zit6 gou2 laa3, nei5 gaau1 zo2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就截稿了，你交了吗？
examples.english_sentence: The deadline is tomorrow, have you submitted it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢截咗一段甘蔗嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zit6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 gam1 ze3 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他截了一段甘蔗来吃。
examples.english_sentence: He cut off a segment of sugar cane to eat.

english_meaning: to intercept, to stop, to flag down
explanation_mandarin: 使正在移动的人或物停止前进；阻拦。
explanation_english: To stop something or someone that is moving; to intercept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺路口截停咗架可疑嘅車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 lou6 hau2 zit6 ting4 zo2 gaa3 ho2 ji4 ge3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在路口拦截了一辆可疑的车辆。
examples.english_sentence: The police intercepted a suspicious vehicle at the intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺前面截停佢，唔可以俾佢走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 cin4 min6 zit6 ting4 keoi5, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 keoi5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在前面截住他，不能让他走。
examples.english_sentence: We need to stop him ahead, we can't let him go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想截停架巴士，但係司機冇停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 zit6 ting4 gaa3 baa1 si2, daan6 hai6 si1 gei1 mou5 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想拦住那辆巴士，但是司机没有停。
examples.english_sentence: They wanted to flag down the bus, but the driver didn't stop.

english_meaning: stop taking orders; cut-off time for orders
explanation_mandarin: 停止接受订单。通常用于餐厅、商店等在某一时间后不再接受新的订单。
explanation_english: To stop taking orders. Commonly used in restaurants, shops, etc. to indicate that they will no longer accept new orders after a certain time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 陣間八點就截單喇，你哋快啲落單啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan6 gaan1 baat3 dim2 zau6 zit6 daan1 laa3, nei5 dei6 faai3 di1 lok6 daan1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一会儿八点就停止接单了，你们快点下单吧！
examples.english_sentence: We're stopping taking orders at 8 o'clock, please order quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日太多人，廚房已經截單喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 taai3 do1 jan4, cyu4 fong2 ji5 ging1 zit6 daan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天人太多了，厨房已经停止接单了。
examples.english_sentence: There are too many people today, the kitchen has already stopped taking orders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為系統故障，我哋要暫時截單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 hai6 tung2 gu3 zoeng3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaam6 si4 zit6 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为系统故障，我们要暂时停止接单。
examples.english_sentence: Due to a system malfunction, we have to temporarily stop taking orders.

english_meaning: screenshot
explanation_mandarin: 指电脑或手机等电子设备上，将屏幕上显示的内容以图片形式保存下来的行为。
explanation_english: The act of capturing an image of what's displayed on a computer or mobile device screen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺手機度截咗張圖，send俾你睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 sau2 gei1 dou6 zit6 zo2 zoeng1 tou4, send bei2 nei5 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚在手机上截了一张图，发给你看看。
examples.english_sentence: I just took a screenshot on my phone and sent it to you to take a look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我截圖，因為我唔識點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zit6 tou4, jan1 wai6 ngo5 m4 sik1 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我截图吗？因为我不知道怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me take a screenshot? Because I don't know how to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得截圖保存重要嘅信息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 zit6 tou4 bou2 cyun4 zung6 jiu3 ge3 seon3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得截图保存重要的信息。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to screenshot and save important information.

english_meaning: Jeet Kune Do (JKD)
explanation_mandarin: 截拳道是由李小龙创立的一种武术哲学，强调简单、直接和非传统的训练方法。
