examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次输给我了，这次他还敢来挑战？不过是个手下败将而已。
examples.english_sentence: He lost to me last time, and he still dares to challenge me this time? Just a defeated opponent.

english_meaning: Spare someone; show mercy; be lenient
explanation_mandarin: 原指武术比试时，手下留有余地，不使出全力。现多用于请求对方宽容、饶恕或减轻惩罚。
explanation_english: Originally referred to martial arts competitions where one would hold back and not exert their full strength. Now it is often used to request someone to be lenient, forgive, or reduce punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，老細，今次真係唔好意思，下次唔會啦，手下留情啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, lou5 sai3, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 ji3 si1, haa6 ci3 m4 wui5 laa1, sau2 haa6 lau4 cing4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，老板，这次真是不好意思，下次不会了，手下留情啊！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, boss, I'm really sorry this time, it won't happen again, please show some mercy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都知錯㗎啦，你就手下留情，唔好咁重罰佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 zi1 co3 gaa3 laa1, nei5 zau6 sau2 haa6 lau4 cing4, m4 hou2 gam3 cung5 fat6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都知道错了，你就手下留情，不要那么重罚他了。
examples.english_sentence: He knows he was wrong, please be lenient and don't punish him so harshly.

synonyms: 網開一面 (mong5 hoi1 jat1 min6)

english_meaning: lucky hands; lucky touch; having good luck in gambling or games of chance
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人手气好，特别是在赌博或者涉及运气的游戏中表现出色。比喻运气非常好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has lucky hands, especially when gambling or playing games of chance. It implies having very good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日手仙到不得了，贏咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sau2 sin1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, wing4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天手气好得不得了，赢了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He had such lucky hands today, he won a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁手仙，不如買張六合彩試下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 sau2 sin1, bat1 jyu4 maai5 zoeng1 luk6 hap6 coi2 si3 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你手气这么好，不如买张六合彩试试？
examples.english_sentence: Since you have such lucky hands, why don't you buy a Mark Six ticket and try your luck?

english_meaning: Warrant (arrest warrant, search warrant)
explanation_mandarin: 由法官签发的，授权警察或其他执法人员进行逮捕或搜查的文件。
explanation_english: A legal document issued by a judge that authorizes police or other law enforcement officers to make an arrest or conduct a search.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬攞住張手令上嚟拉人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 lou2 lo2 zyu6 zoeng1 sau2 ling6 soeng5 lai4 laai1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察拿着一张逮捕令上来抓人。
examples.english_sentence: The police came up with an arrest warrant to arrest someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有手令，可以入嚟搜屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 sau2 ling6, ho2 ji5 jap6 lai4 sau1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有搜查令，可以进来搜查房子。
examples.english_sentence: They have a search warrant, so they can come in and search the house.

english_meaning: Handmade; handcrafted; artisanal
explanation_mandarin: 指用手工制作的东西，强调不是机器生产的。
explanation_english: Refers to things made by hand, emphasizing that they are not machine-made. It can also refer to the act of making something by hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手作嘅皮銀包好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 zok3 ge3 pei4 ngan2 baau1 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手工制作的皮钱包真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: This handmade leather wallet is so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意手作仔，成日自己整嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sau2 zok3 zai2, seng4 jat6 zi6 gei2 zeng2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很喜欢做手工，经常自己做东西。
examples.english_sentence: She loves making handicrafts and makes things herself all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲人興手作咖啡，覺得有風味啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 jan4 hing3 sau2 zok3 gaa3 fe1, gok3 dak1 jau5 fung1 mei6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人流行手工咖啡，觉得更有风味。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people are into handmade coffee, thinking it has more flavor.

english_meaning: handicraft; handmade item; small-scale handmade business or activity
explanation_mandarin: 指手工制作的小东西或小型的手工生意。也形容小打小闹，规模很小。
explanation_english: Refers to handmade items or a small-scale handmade business or activity. It can also describe something small-scale and insignificant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺屋企整啲手作仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei2 zing2 di1 sau2 zok3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢在家里做些手工活儿。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to make some handicrafts at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠賣手作仔幫補家計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 maai6 sau2 zok3 zai2 bong1 bou2 gaa1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠卖手工制品来补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: He supports his family by selling handmade items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣好多本地手作仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 sau2 zok3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖很多本地手工制品。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells many local handmade items.

synonyms: 手工藝品 (sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2)

english_meaning: souvenir; small gift bought for friends and family after travelling
explanation_mandarin: 指外出旅游或出差时，带回赠送亲友的小礼物或特产。
explanation_english: A small gift or souvenir brought back for friends and family after travelling or a business trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去咗日本旅行，買咗啲手信俾你哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4, maai5 zo2 di1 sau2 seon3 bei2 nei5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去日本旅行了，买了一些伴手礼给你们。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Japan for a trip and bought some souvenirs for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係我喺台灣買嘅手信，你試吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 hai2 toi4 waan1 maai5 ge3 sau2 seon3, nei5 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是我在台湾买的伴手礼，你尝尝吧。
examples.english_sentence: These are souvenirs I bought in Taiwan, have a taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁客氣，嚟探我咪就係最好嘅手信囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3, lei4 taam3 ngo5 mai1 zau6 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 sau2 seon3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么客气，你来看我就是最好的礼物了。
examples.english_sentence: No need to be so polite, your visit is the best gift.

mandarin_meaning: 停工就没饭吃; 不工作就没饭吃
english_meaning: No work, no food; If you stop working, you stop eating; One earns one's living by physical work.
explanation_mandarin: 指靠体力劳动为生的人，一旦停止工作，生活就没有保障。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone relies on manual labor for their livelihood and faces hardship if they stop working. It emphasizes the direct link between working and earning a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都要開工，手停口停㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 hoi1 gung1, sau2 ting4 hau2 ting4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都要工作，因为不工作就没饭吃。
examples.english_sentence: They have to work every day because no work means no food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做地盤嘅工人就係咁，手停口停，一唔舒服就無收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 dei6 paan4 ge3 gung1 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam2, sau2 ting4 hau2 ting4, jat1 m4 syu1 fuk6 zau6 mou5 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地上的工人就是这样，停工就没饭吃，一旦不舒服就没有收入。
examples.english_sentence: Construction workers are like this, if they stop working, they have no income. If they feel unwell, they have no income.

english_meaning: handbook, manual
explanation_mandarin: 提供特定信息或指导的小册子。
explanation_english: A small book or booklet providing specific information or instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本係公司嘅員工手冊，你要睇清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 jyun4 gung1 sau2 caak3, nei5 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是公司的员工手册，你要仔细看清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This is the company's employee handbook, you need to read it carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電器冇說明書，得返本簡單手冊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 hei3 mou5 syut3 ming4 syu1, dak1 faan1 bun2 gaan2 daan1 sau2 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电器没有说明书，只剩下一本简单的手册。
examples.english_sentence: This appliance doesn't have an instruction manual, only a simple handbook.

english_meaning: manual, handbook
explanation_mandarin: 提供指导、说明、信息等的文件。
explanation_english: A book or booklet containing instructions or information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要睇下份手册，先知点样安装。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 tai2 haa5 fan6 sau2 caak3, sin1 zi1 dim2 joeng2 on1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要看一下这份手册，才知道怎么安装。
examples.english_sentence: I need to look at the manual to know how to install it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份手册好有用，解释得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 sau2 caak3 hou2 jau5 yung6, gaai2 sik1 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份手册很有用，解释得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This manual is very useful; it explains things very clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 手刀 (shǒu dāo); 快速地做完
english_meaning: Hand chop; to finish something quickly and efficiently; to do something very quickly
explanation_mandarin: 原指武术中的手刀招式，后引申为形容动作迅速，效率高，快速完成某事。 类似于“快刀斩乱麻”。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the hand chop technique in martial arts, it is now used metaphorically to describe someone who acts quickly, is highly efficient, and completes tasks rapidly. Similar to 'cutting through tangled hemp with a sharp knife'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份嘢手刀搞掂，勁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 je5 sau2 dou1 gaau2 dim6, ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那份工作手刀就搞定了，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He finished that work in a flash, amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要手刀將啲貨搬晒上車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau2 dou1 zoeng1 di1 fo3 bun1 saai3 soeng5 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要迅速把货物都搬上车。
examples.english_sentence: We need to quickly move all the goods onto the truck.

english_meaning: easily accomplished; within easy reach; to get something easily
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常容易做到，毫不费力就能完成。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very easy to accomplish, effortlessly done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數咁簡單，對你嚟講咪手到拿來囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 gam3 gaan2 daan1, deoi3 nei5 lei4 gong2 mai1 sau2 dou3 naa4 loi4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题这么简单，对你来说不是轻而易举吗？
examples.english_sentence: This question is so simple, it's a piece of cake for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學嘢好快，啲新技能對佢嚟講都係手到拿來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3, di1 san1 gei1 nang4 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 dou1 hai6 sau2 dou3 naa4 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学东西很快，新的技能对他来说都很容易掌握。
examples.english_sentence: He learns things very quickly, new skills are easily acquired by him.

english_meaning: manual, manually operated
explanation_mandarin: 指用手操作的，而不是自动的。
explanation_english: Refers to something operated by hand, not automatically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部嘢要手動操作嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 je5 jiu3 sau2 dung6 cau1 zok3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个东西需要手动操作。
examples.english_sentence: This thing needs to be operated manually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我手動輸入晒啲資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau2 dung6 syu1 jap6 saai3 di1 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我手动输入了所有资料。
examples.english_sentence: I manually entered all the data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個年代仲用手動波箱嘅車好少見喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 nin4 doi6 zung6 yung6 sau2 dung6 bo1 soeng1 ge3 ce1 hou2 siu2 gin3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这个年代还用手动挡的车很少见了。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to see cars with manual transmissions nowadays.

english_meaning: Skill, craftsmanship, technique, gesture (less common)
explanation_mandarin: 指技巧、手艺，多指厨艺或手工艺。也可用於指人的身手或武功。
explanation_english: Refers to skill or craftsmanship, often in cooking or handicrafts. It can also refer to someone's agility or martial arts skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢煮嘢食嘅手勢好好㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu2 je5 sik6 ge3 sau2 sai3 hou2 hou2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做饭的手艺很好！
examples.english_sentence: His cooking skills are very good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個師傅嘅木工手勢真係一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si1 fu2 ge3 muk6 gung1 sau2 sai3 zan1 hai6 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位师傅的木工手艺真是一流。
examples.english_sentence: This craftsman's woodworking skills are truly top-notch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅功夫手勢好犀利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 fu1 sau2 sai3 hou2 sai1 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功夫很好。
examples.english_sentence: His martial arts skills are very impressive.

english_meaning: handprint, fingerprint
explanation_mandarin: 手的印记；手指的印记。
explanation_english: The impression of a hand; a fingerprint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺塊玻璃上面留低咗個手印。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faai3 bo1 lei1 soeng6 min6 lau4 dai1 zo2 go3 sau2 ngan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在玻璃上留下了一个手印。
examples.english_sentence: He left a handprint on the glass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺現場搵到好多手印，用嚟做證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 jin6 coeng4 wan2 dou2 hou2 do1 sau2 ngan3, yung6 lai4 zou6 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在现场找到了很多指纹，用来做证据。
examples.english_sentence: The police found many fingerprints at the scene to be used as evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 手动液压搬运车；手动叉车
english_meaning: Hand pallet truck; Pallet jack
explanation_mandarin: 一种人工操作的液压搬运工具，用于短距离搬运托盘货物。
explanation_english: A manual hydraulic pallet truck used for moving pallets over short distances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用手唧車將啲貨搬入倉庫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yung6 sau2 zik1 ce1 zoeng1 di1 fo3 bun1 jap6 cong1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们用手动叉车把货物搬进仓库。
examples.english_sentence: We use a hand pallet truck to move the goods into the warehouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部手唧車好重，推起嚟都幾吃力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau2 zik1 ce1 hou2 cung5, teoi1 hei2 lai4 dou1 gei2 hek3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆手动叉车很重，推起来很费力。
examples.english_sentence: This hand pallet truck is very heavy and it takes quite an effort to push it.

english_meaning: armpit
explanation_mandarin: 指手臂与身体连接处形成的凹陷部位，即腋窝。
explanation_english: The hollow or depression underneath the arm where it joins the shoulder; the armpit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢舉起隻手，抹手坳啲汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi2 hei2 zek3 sau2, mut3 sau2 aau3 di1 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他举起手臂，擦了擦胳肢窝的汗。
examples.english_sentence: He raised his arm and wiped the sweat from his armpit.

english_meaning: nosy, meddlesome, to have a tendency to interfere or touch things you shouldn't
explanation_mandarin: 指人喜欢多管闲事，喜欢乱动不该动的东西。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is nosy, meddlesome, or has a tendency to touch or interfere with things they shouldn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁手多啦，人哋嘅嘢唔好亂咁掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sau2 do1 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 je5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么爱多管闲事了，别人的东西不要乱碰。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy, don't touch other people's things without permission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係好手多，成日都喺度搬嚟搬去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau2 do1, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 bun1 lei4 bun1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是很多管闲事，整天都在搬来搬去。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a meddlesome person, always moving things around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁手多，幫倒忙就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sau2 do1, bong1 dou2 mong4 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么多事，帮倒忙就不好啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so meddlesome, it's not good if you end up hindering instead of helping.

english_meaning: to be fidgety; to have wandering hands; to be unable to keep one's hands to oneself; to be too handsy; to be overly curious with one's hands
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喜欢乱动别人的东西，或不应该碰的东西也去碰，带有负面含义。
explanation_english: Describes a person who likes to touch other people's things without permission, or touches things they shouldn't touch. It usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪手多多搞人哋啲嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 sau2 do1 do1 gaau2 yan4 dei6 di1 ye5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别乱动别人的东西！
examples.english_sentence: Don't go touching other people's things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你細個嘅時候成日手多多，乜嘢都要摸吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 sau2 do1 do1, mat1 ye5 dou1 jiu3 mo2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小时候总是爱动手动脚的，什么都要摸一下。
examples.english_sentence: When you were little, you were always so fidgety, you had to touch everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手多多咁樣，好容易整爛啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 do1 do1 gam2 yeung2, hou2 yung4 yi6 zing2 laan6 di1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么爱乱动，很容易弄坏东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's so handsy, it's easy for him to break things.

english_meaning: Hand Angel (referring to a volunteer organization that provides sexual assistance to severely disabled individuals)
explanation_mandarin: 指为严重残疾人士提供性服务的志愿者组织，名称源于该组织希望像天使一样，用手帮助残疾人士满足生理需求。
explanation_english: Refers to a volunteer organization that provides sexual assistance to severely disabled individuals. The name originates from the organization's aim to be like angels, using their hands to help disabled people fulfill their physiological needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅宗旨係希望手天使可以幫到啲嚴重殘疾嘅人，令佢哋都可以有權利享受性嘅歡愉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zung1 zi3 hai6 hei1 mong6 sau2 tin1 si2 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 di1 jim4 zung6 caan4 gei2 ge3 jan4, ling6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 ho2 ji5 jau5 kyn4 lei6 hoeng2 sau6 sing3 ge3 fun1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的宗旨是希望手天使可以帮助到一些严重残疾的人，让他们也都有权利享受性的愉悦。
examples.english_sentence: Their mission is to hope that Hand Angels can help severely disabled people, so that they also have the right to enjoy sexual pleasure.

english_meaning: glove
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手上，起保护或保暖作用的物品。
explanation_english: A covering for the hand, typically with separate sheaths for each finger and the thumb, used for protection or warmth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍親喇，戴返對手套先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 can1 laa3, daai3 faan1 deoi3 sau2 tou3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷了，先戴上手套。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold, put your gloves on first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生做手術要戴手套嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 zou6 sau2 seot6 jiu3 daai3 sau2 tou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生做手术要戴手套的。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors wear gloves when performing surgery.

english_meaning: handwritten, to write by hand
explanation_mandarin: 用手书写。
explanation_english: To write by hand; handwritten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份功課要手寫，唔可以用電腦打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 fo3 jiu3 sau2 se2, m4 ho2 ji5 yung6 din6 nou5 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份作业要手写，不可以用电脑打字。
examples.english_sentence: This assignment needs to be handwritten, you can't type it on a computer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意收手寫信，覺得好有心意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sau1 sau2 se2 seon3, gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 sam1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢收到手写信，觉得很有心意。
examples.english_sentence: I like receiving handwritten letters, I think it's very thoughtful.

english_meaning: graphics tablet; writing tablet; handwriting tablet
explanation_mandarin: 一种输入设备，通过在板上书写来输入信息。
explanation_english: An input device used to input information by writing on the tablet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用手寫板畫畫方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 sau2 se2 baan2 waa2 waa2 fong1 bin6 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用手写板画画方便多了。
examples.english_sentence: It's much more convenient for me to draw with a graphics tablet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲手寫板好靈敏㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 sau2 se2 baan2 hou2 ling4 man5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的触控板很灵敏的。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, handwriting tablets are very sensitive.

mandarin_meaning: 善后工作; 后续处理
english_meaning: follow-up work; aftermath; loose ends; consequences; aftercare
explanation_mandarin: 指事情结束后的后续处理工作，或者遗留下来的问题和麻烦。也指某人做事留下的后果。
explanation_english: Refers to the follow-up work after something is finished, or the problems and troubles left behind. It also refers to the consequences of someone's actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事做完都好多手尾跟，好麻煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zou6 jyun4 dou1 hou2 do1 sau2 mei1 gan1, hou2 maa4 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事做完还有很多后续工作要做，很麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of follow-up work to do after this is finished, it's very troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢唔乾淨俐落，成日留低手尾要人執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 m4 gon1 zing6 lei6 lok6, seng4 jat6 lau4 dai1 sau2 mei1 jiu3 jan4 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事不干净利落，总是留下手尾要别人收拾。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't work cleanly and efficiently, he always leaves loose ends for others to clean up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搞成咁，手尾你要自己跟番。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaau2 sing4 gam2, sau2 mei1 nei5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 gan1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你搞成这样，后果你要自己承担。
examples.english_sentence: Since you caused this mess, you have to deal with the consequences yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 手尾很长；善后工作多；麻烦
english_meaning: a lot of loose ends to tie up; troublesome to deal with; leaving a long trail of work; complicated and causing problems
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情处理起来有很多后续问题，或者需要很长时间才能完成清理和整理工作。也可以用来形容某人做事不干净利落，留下很多后续需要处理的问题。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there are many loose ends to tie up or it takes a long time to complete the cleaning and organizing work. It can also be used to describe someone who is not thorough in their work, leaving a lot of follow-up problems to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project好手尾長，唔知幾時先做得完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project hou2 sau2 mei1 coeng4, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 zou6 dak1 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目手尾很长，不知道什么时候才能做完。
examples.english_sentence: This project has a lot of loose ends, I don't know when it will be finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢唔小心，成日都手尾長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 m4 siu2 sam1, seng4 jat6 dou1 sau2 mei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事不小心，总是留下很多麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He is careless in his work and always leaves a lot of problems to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁多嘢，一定手尾長㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 do1 je5, jat1 ding6 sau2 mei1 coeng4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞这么多事情，肯定有很多后续问题。
examples.english_sentence: Doing so many things will definitely cause a lot of follow-up problems.

english_meaning: handicraft; handmade; manual work
explanation_mandarin: 指用手或简单的工具制作的物品或工作；也形容用手工制作的。
explanation_english: Refers to items made by hand or with simple tools; also describes something that is handmade or involving manual work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係手工整嘅，所以特別貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 sau2 gung1 zing2 ge3, so2 ji5 dak6 bit6 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是手工制作的，所以特别贵。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is handmade, so it's especially expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅手工藝品好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2 hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的手工艺品很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's handicrafts are very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻整手工嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 zing2 sau2 gung1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长做手工。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at making handicrafts.

english_meaning: Craft beer
explanation_mandarin: 指非大规模工业化生产的啤酒，通常由小型啤酒厂采用传统工艺和优质原料酿造，注重风味和个性。
explanation_english: Refers to beer that is not mass-produced industrially. It is typically brewed by small breweries using traditional methods and high-quality ingredients, emphasizing flavor and individuality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚收工想去酒吧飲杯手工啤放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sau1 gung1 soeng2 heoi3 baa1 gaa3 jam2 bui1 sau2 gung1 be1 fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚下班后想去酒吧喝一杯精酿啤酒放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to a bar and have a glass of craft beer to relax after work tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港而家好多酒吧都有好多唔同種類嘅手工啤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 baa1 gaa3 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 sau2 gung1 be1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在香港很多酒吧都有很多不同种类的精酿啤酒。
examples.english_sentence: Many bars in Hong Kong now have many different kinds of craft beer.

english_meaning: construction paper; craft paper
explanation_mandarin: 用于手工制作的彩色纸张，通常质地较厚，颜色多样。
explanation_english: Colored paper, typically thicker and available in various colors, used for arts and crafts projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔好鍾意用手工紙摺嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 zung1 yi3 yung6 hung1 gung1 zi2 zip3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子很喜欢用手工纸折东西。
examples.english_sentence: Kids love to fold things with construction paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校教我哋用手工紙剪窗花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 yung6 hung1 gung1 zi2 zin2 coeng1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校教我们用手工纸剪窗花。
examples.english_sentence: The school taught us to cut paper-cuts for window decorations using construction paper.

english_meaning: Homemade dishes; Dishes made by hand with traditional methods
explanation_mandarin: 指采用传统手工制作的菜肴，强调食材新鲜、制作过程精细，口味地道。
explanation_english: Refers to dishes made by hand with traditional methods, emphasizing fresh ingredients, meticulous preparation, and authentic flavors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅手工菜好好食，特別係佢哋嘅咕嚕肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sau2 gung1 coi3 hou2 hou2 sik6, dak6 bit1 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gu1 lou1 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的手工菜很好吃，特别是他们的咕噜肉。
examples.english_sentence: The homemade dishes at this restaurant are delicious, especially their sweet and sour pork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少餐廳會做真正嘅手工菜㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 caan1 teng1 wui5 zou6 zan1 zeng3 ge3 sau2 gung1 coi3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少餐厅会做真正的手工菜了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, very few restaurants make truly homemade dishes.

english_meaning: handicraft; handiwork; handmade crafts
explanation_mandarin: 用手工制作的工艺品或技能。
explanation_english: Crafts or skills that are made by hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手工藝好精緻，好多人都鍾意買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 gung1 ngai6 hou2 zing1 zyu3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 yi3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的手工艺品很精致，很多人都喜欢买。
examples.english_sentence: Her handicrafts are very exquisite; many people like to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣好多本地手工藝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖很多本地手工艺品。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells many local handicrafts.

english_meaning: handicraft; handmade crafts
explanation_mandarin: 用手工制作的具有艺术价值或实用性的物品。
explanation_english: Items made by hand, often with artistic or practical value; handicrafts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣好多唔同嘅手工藝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖很多不同的手工艺品。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells many different handicrafts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校搞咗個手工藝品展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 gaau2 zo2 go3 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校举办了一个手工艺品展览。
examples.english_sentence: Our school held a handicraft exhibition.

english_meaning: handkerchief; towel
explanation_mandarin: 擦手或脸的布。
explanation_english: A piece of cloth used for wiping hands or face; handkerchief or towel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，遞條手巾俾我呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, dai6 tiu4 sau2 gan1 bei2 ngo5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你，递条手帕给我。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, please pass me a handkerchief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲汗多到好似洗過面咁，快啲攞條手巾抹下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hon6 do1 dou3 hou2 ci5 sai2 gwo3 min6 gam3, faai3 di1 lo2 tiu4 sau2 gan1 mut3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汗多得像洗过脸一样，快点拿条手帕擦一下。
examples.english_sentence: There's so much sweat, it's like I washed my face. Quickly grab a towel and wipe it off.

english_meaning: small towel; small handkerchief
explanation_mandarin: 指小块的毛巾或手帕。
explanation_english: Refers to a small towel or handkerchief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 帶定條手巾仔，抹下汗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai3 ding6 tiu4 sau2 gan1 zai2, mut3 haa5 hon6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 带条小手帕，擦擦汗吧。
examples.english_sentence: Bring a small towel to wipe your sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日袋住條手巾仔喺身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 doi6 zyu6 tiu4 sau2 gan1 zai2 hai2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是随身带着一条小手帕。
examples.english_sentence: He always carries a small handkerchief with him.

english_meaning: handkerchief
explanation_mandarin: 擦拭汗水、眼泪或灰尘等的小块布。
explanation_english: A small piece of cloth used for wiping one's face, nose, or tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎咗條手帕出嚟抹汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zo2 tiu4 sau2 paak3 chut1 lai4 mut3 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一条手帕出来擦汗。
examples.english_sentence: He took out a handkerchief to wipe his sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你帶定條手帕好啲，陣間可能有用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daai3 ding6 tiu4 sau2 paak3 hou2 di1, zan6 gaan1 ho2 nang4 jau5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好带一条手帕，一会儿可能有用。
examples.english_sentence: You better bring a handkerchief, it might be useful later.

english_meaning: wristband; bracelet
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手腕上的环状物。
explanation_english: A band worn around the wrist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗條新手帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 san1 sau2 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一条新的手镯。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new wristband/bracelet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入場要戴手帶嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 coeng4 jiu3 daai3 sau2 daai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入场要戴手环的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to wear a wristband to enter.

english_meaning: Flashlight, Torch
explanation_mandarin: 一种便携式照明工具，通常由电池供电。
explanation_english: A portable handheld electric light, usually battery-powered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，借個手影機嚟睇下，我跌咗嘢喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, ze3 go3 sau2 ying2 gei1 lai4 tai2 haa5, ngo5 dit3 zo2 ye5 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，借个手电筒来看看，我掉了东西在地上。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, lend me your flashlight to see, I dropped something on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行夜山記得帶手影機，費事摸黑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 je6 saan1 gei3 dak1 daai3 sau2 ying2 gei1, fai3 si6 mo1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上爬山记得带手电筒，免得摸黑。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a flashlight when hiking at night, so you don't have to fumble around in the dark.

english_meaning: palm (of hand)
explanation_mandarin: 手的内部，握拳时包裹的部分。
explanation_english: The inner surface of the hand, the part that encloses when making a fist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手心濕晒，好似好緊張咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 sam1 sip3 saai3, hou2 ci5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手掌心都湿透了，好像很紧张一样。
examples.english_sentence: The palms of my hands are all wet, like I'm very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手心好暖，揸住好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 sam1 hou2 nuon5, zaa1 zyu6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手掌心很暖和，握着很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The palms of his hands are very warm, it's comfortable to hold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出咗好多汗，連手心都濕埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 chut1 zo2 hou2 do1 hon6, lin4 sau2 sam1 dou1 sip3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出了很多汗，连手掌心都湿了。
examples.english_sentence: He sweated a lot, even the palms of his hands were wet.

english_meaning: in a frantic rush; in a flurry; all fingers and thumbs
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事慌张，忙乱不堪。
explanation_english: Describes a state of panic and disorder when trying to do something, leading to clumsiness and inefficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嘅時候，我見到條題目咁難，即刻手忙腳亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 gin3 dou2 tiu4 tai4 muk6 gam3 naan4, zik1 hak1 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候，我看到题目这么难，立刻手忙脚乱。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, when I saw how difficult the question was, I immediately became frantic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次煮咁多嘢食，搞到手忙腳亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zyu2 gam3 do1 je5 sik6, gaau2 dou3 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次煮这么多食物，搞得手忙脚乱。
examples.english_sentence: It was his first time cooking so much food, which made him flustered.

jyutping: sau2 faai3 jau5 sau2 maan6 mou5
mandarin_meaning: 先下手为强，慢了就没了
english_meaning: First come, first served; he who hesitates is lost; grab it while you can.
explanation_mandarin: 形容机会难得，动作快的人才能得到，动作慢的人就错失良机。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is available on a limited basis or for a limited time, and those who act quickly will obtain it, while those who are slow will miss out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲演唱會飛好搶手㗎，手快有手慢冇，你快啲上網買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 hou2 coeng2 sau2 gaa3, sau2 faai3 jau5 sau2 maan6 mou5, nei5 faai3 di1 soeng5 mong5 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票很抢手，先下手为强，你快点上网买吧。
examples.english_sentence: The concert tickets are very popular, first come, first served. You should buy them online quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家做緊大減價，手快有手慢冇，唔好錯過呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3, sau2 faai3 jau5 sau2 maan6 mou5, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在正在打折大促销，先下手为强，不要错过啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's a big sale going on now, first come, first served, don't miss it!

english_meaning: feel (of something in one's hand); texture; tactile sensation
explanation_mandarin: 用手触摸时产生的感觉；触感。
explanation_english: The feeling or texture of something when touched or held in one's hand; tactile sensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫手感好好，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sau2 gam2 hou2 hou2, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服手感很好，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has a really nice feel to it, it's very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部新電話手感唔錯，但係太重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 san1 din6 waa2 sau2 gam2 m4 co3, daan6 hai6 taai3 cung5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这新款手机手感不错，但是太重。
examples.english_sentence: The new phone feels good in the hand, but it's too heavy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲麵粉嘅手感好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 min6 fan2 ge3 sau2 gam2 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些面粉的手感很滑。
examples.english_sentence: The texture of this flour is very smooth.

english_meaning: clumsy; awkward; fumbling; all over the place (doing things poorly)
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作笨拙，不灵活，手脚不听使唤的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy, awkward, and uncoordinated in their movements. Often implies a lack of skill or control in handling things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁手手腳腳啦，整爛晒啲嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sau2 sau2 goek3 goek3 laa1, zing2 laan6晒啲嘢 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨手笨脚的，把东西都弄坏了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, you'll break everything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好手手腳腳，成日都跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 sau2 sau2 goek3 goek3, seng4 jat6 dou1 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很笨手笨脚，总是摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very clumsy person and always falls down.

synonyms: 笨手笨腳 (ban4 sau2 ban4 goek3)

english_meaning: handcuffs
explanation_mandarin: 一种用来铐住犯人手腕的刑具。
explanation_english: A pair of metal restraints used to handcuff a prisoner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察用手扣將個賊鎖住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 yung6 sau2 kau3 zoeng1 go3 caak6 so2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察用手铐把贼锁住了。
examples.english_sentence: The police used handcuffs to lock up the thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人上手扣拉咗走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 soeng5 sau2 kau3 laai1 zo2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人戴上手铐拉走了。
examples.english_sentence: He was handcuffed and taken away.

english_meaning: To see with one's own eyes; to witness personally; firsthand experience
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常明显，亲眼看见，无需怀疑。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very obvious and witnessed firsthand, leaving no room for doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢親口認嘅，我哋都手扳眼見，仲有咩好拗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can1 hau2 ying6 ge3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3, cung4 jau5 me1 hou2 ngaau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他亲口承认的，我们都亲眼看见了，还有什么好争辩的？
examples.english_sentence: He confessed himself, and we all saw it with our own eyes, what's there to argue about?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁大鑊，電視新聞日日都報，手扳眼見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 daai6 wok6, din6 si6 san1 man4 yat6 yat6 dou1 bou3, sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情这么严重，电视新闻每天都报道，是亲眼可见的。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is so serious, the TV news reports it every day, it's there for all to see.

jyutping: sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1
mandarin_meaning: 实实在在的技能；真本事
english_meaning: Real skills; tangible skills that are immediately apparent; skills that can be seen and tested.
explanation_mandarin: 指通过实际操作和观察能够获得的、显而易见的技能或真本事。强调实际操作的经验和效果，而非理论知识。
explanation_english: Refers to skills or genuine abilities that can be acquired through practical operation and observation. It emphasizes practical experience and effectiveness rather than theoretical knowledge. It suggests skills that are demonstrable and easy to assess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整嘢嘅手扳眼見功夫真係唔錯，好快就搞掂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 je5 ge3 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1 zan1 hai6 m4 co3, hou2 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做东西的真本事真不错，很快就完成了。
examples.english_sentence: His tangible skills in crafting things are really good, he finished it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學師傅一定要跟住佢學手扳眼見功夫，唔係齋睇書冇用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 si1 fu6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gan1 zeoi6 keoi5 hok6 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, m4 hai6 zaai1 tai2 syu1 mou5 jung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跟师傅学习一定要跟着他学真本事，不然光看书没用的。
examples.english_sentence: When learning from a master, you must follow him to learn tangible skills; otherwise, just reading books is useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手扳眼見功夫，唔係一朝一夕可以練成㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, m4 hai6 jat1 ziu1 jat1 sik6 ho2 ji5 lin6 sing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的真本事不是一天两天可以练成的。
examples.english_sentence: His real skills are not something that can be acquired overnight.

jyutping: sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1
english_meaning: Seeing is believing; tangible proof; evidence before one's eyes.
explanation_mandarin: 指亲眼看到的事情才是真实可靠的，强调直接的、具体的证据。
explanation_english: Refers to the idea that seeing something with your own eyes is the most reliable and trustworthy way to know it is true. Emphasizes direct and concrete evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係聽佢講，要手扳眼見工夫先信得過㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 teng1 keoi5 gong2, jiu3 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1 sin1 seon3 dak1 gwo3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是听他说，要眼见为实才能相信啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just listen to what he says, you need to see it with your own eyes to believe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢一定要手扳眼見工夫，睇清楚先好買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, tai2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西一定要亲眼见到，看清楚才能买。
examples.english_sentence: You must see these things for yourself and examine them carefully before buying them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己好叻，但我都係要手扳眼見工夫先相信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, daan6 ngo5 dou1 hai6 jiu3 sau2 baan1 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1 sin1 soeng1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己很厉害，但我还是要眼见为实才相信。
examples.english_sentence: He says he is very capable, but I still need to see the proof before I believe it.

english_meaning: manuscript; handwritten copy
explanation_mandarin: 指用手抄写的书本或文本。
explanation_english: A manuscript; a book or text written by hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本手抄本歷史好耐，好珍貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 sau2 caau1 bun2 lik6 si2 hou2 noi6, hou2 zan1 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本手抄本历史悠久，非常珍贵。
examples.english_sentence: This manuscript is very old and precious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人冇電腦，啲書都係手抄本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 mou5 din6 nou5, di1 syu1 dou1 hai6 sau2 caau1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们没有电脑，书都是手抄本。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people didn't have computers, so books were all manuscripts.

english_meaning: Having bad luck, especially in gambling or drawing lots; to have butterfingers; clumsy
explanation_mandarin: 形容手气不好，运气差。也指做事笨手笨脚，容易出错。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has bad luck, especially in gambling or drawing lots. It can also refer to someone who is clumsy and prone to making mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日真係手抽呀，買咩都輸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 sau2 cau1 aa3, maai5 me1 dou1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天手气真差，买什么都输。
examples.english_sentence: You really have bad luck today, you lose everything you buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢抽獎啦，佢咁手抽，實抽唔到好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 cau1 zoeng2 laa1, keoi5 gam3 sau2 cau1, sat1 cau1 m4 dou2 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他抽奖了，他手气这么差，肯定抽不到好东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him draw the prize, he's so unlucky, he definitely won't draw anything good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日手抽到爆，做咩衰咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sau2 cau1 dou3 baau3, zou6 me1 seoi1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天运气差到极点，做什么错什么。
examples.english_sentence: I am extremely unlucky today, everything I do goes wrong.

english_meaning: to hold (in hand); to possess; to have on hand
explanation_mandarin: 用手拿着；拥有。
explanation_english: To hold something in your hand; to possess or have something on hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手持住一杯咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 ci4 zyu6 jat1 bui1 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手里拿着一杯咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: He is holding a cup of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手持香港身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 ci4 hoeng1 gong2 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他持有香港身份证。
examples.english_sentence: He holds a Hong Kong identity card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司手持好多現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sau2 ci4 hou2 do1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司手头有很多现金。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a lot of cash on hand.

english_meaning: finger
explanation_mandarin: 人的手上用于抓握东西的部位。
explanation_english: One of the digits on a hand, used for grasping and manipulating objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心整親隻手指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 can1 zek3 sau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心弄伤了手指。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally hurt my finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手指戴住隻戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 zi2 daai3 zyu6 zek3 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的手指戴着一枚戒指。
examples.english_sentence: She has a ring on her finger.

english_meaning: thumb
explanation_mandarin: 指手上的大拇指。
explanation_english: The thumb, the shortest and thickest finger on the hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心整親隻手指公，好痛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 can1 zek3 sau2 zi2 gung1, hou2 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心弄伤了大拇指，好痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally injured my thumb, it hurts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日啜手指公。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 sing4 jat6 cheut3 sau2 zi2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子总是吸吮拇指。
examples.english_sentence: Little kids always suck their thumbs.

english_meaning: fingertip
explanation_mandarin: 手指的最末端。
explanation_english: The very tip of a finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾紙𠝹到手指尖呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zi2 gaai1 dou2 sau2 zi2 zim1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被纸划到指尖了！
examples.english_sentence: He got a paper cut on his fingertip!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手指尖好痕呀，唔知咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2 zim1 hou2 han4 aa3, m4 zi1 dim2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的指尖很痒，不知道怎么回事。
examples.english_sentence: My fingertip is very itchy, I don't know what's going on.

english_meaning: pinky finger, little finger
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌上最细的一根手指。
explanation_english: Refers to the smallest finger on the hand, the little finger or pinky finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心夾親手指尾，痛死我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 gaap3 can1 sau2 zi2 mei1, tung3 sei2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心夹到小拇指了，疼死我了！
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally pinched my pinky finger, it hurts so much!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰只戒指戴喺手指尾上面幾好睇喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 zek3 gaai3 zi2 daai3 hai2 sau2 zi2 mei1 soeng6 min6 gei2 hou2 tai2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的那枚戒指戴在小拇指上很好看。
examples.english_sentence: Her ring looks very nice worn on her pinky finger.

jyutping: sau2 zi2 aau2 jap6 m4 aau2 ceot1
english_meaning: To favor insiders, to be biased towards one's own (family, group, etc.), nepotism.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻处理事情时偏袒自己人，不公平公正。
explanation_english: A metaphor for favoring one's own people when dealing with matters, lacking fairness and impartiality. It implies a bias towards those within one's own group, family, or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日手指拗入唔拗出，所以啲同事好唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau2 zi2 aau2 jap6 m4 aau2 ceot1, so2 ji5 di1 tung4 si6 hou2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胳膊肘往里拐，所以同事们很不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always favors his own people, so his colleagues don't like him very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要公平啲，唔好成日手指拗入唔拗出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 gung1 ping4 di1, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sau2 zi2 aau2 jap6 m4 aau2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作要公平一点，不要总是胳膊肘往里拐。
examples.english_sentence: You should be fair in your work, don't always favor your own people.

jyutping: sau2 zi2 aau2 ceot1 m4 aau2 jap6
english_meaning: To be biased against one's own family or group; to side with outsiders.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不帮助自己人，反而帮助外人。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who doesn't support their own family or group, and instead favors outsiders or competitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫外人唔幫自己屋企人，真係手指拗出唔拗入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 ngoi6 jan4 m4 bong1 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei2 jan4, zan1 hai6 sau2 zi2 aau2 ceot1 m4 aau2 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是帮外人不帮自己家人，真是胳膊肘往外拐。
examples.english_sentence: He always helps outsiders and not his own family, he's really siding with the outsiders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁手指拗出唔拗入啦，點解唔支持自己公司嘅產品？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 sau2 zi2 aau2 ceot1 m4 aau2 jap6 laa1, dim2 gaai2 m4 zi1 chi4 zi6 gei2 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么胳膊肘往外拐了，为什么不支持自己公司的产品？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so biased against us, why don't you support our company's products?

english_meaning: To point fingers (at someone); to criticize openly; to be judgmental
explanation_mandarin: 用手指指着别人，带有批评或指责的意味。
explanation_english: To point fingers at someone, often implying criticism or blame; to be judgmental or gossipy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺背後手指指人哋啦，有乜嘢咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 bui3 hau6 sau2 zi2 zi2 jan4 dei6 laa1, jau5 mat1 je5 mai6 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在背后指指点点别人啦，有什么直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't point fingers at others behind their backs, if you have something to say, just say it directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日手指指人，但係自己又做得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau2 zi2 zi2 jan4, daan6 hai6 zi6 gei2 jau6 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是指指点点别人，但是自己又做得不好。
examples.english_sentence: He always points fingers at others, but he himself doesn't do well.

english_meaning: fingerprint
explanation_mandarin: 手指上的纹路，用于身份识别。
explanation_english: The pattern of ridges and valleys on the surface of a fingertip, used for identification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺現場攞咗啲手指模做證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 jin6 coeng4 lo2 zo2 di1 sau2 zi2 mou4 zou6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在现场提取了一些指纹作为证据。
examples.english_sentence: The police took some fingerprints from the scene as evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部新電話可以用手指模解鎖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 san1 din6 waa2 ho2 ji5 yung6 sau2 zi2 mou4 gaai2 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新手机可以用指纹解锁。
examples.english_sentence: The new phone can be unlocked with a fingerprint.

english_meaning: between the fingers; finger gaps; literally: finger crack/slit
explanation_mandarin: 指手指之间的缝隙。也比喻非常少，不足以抓住。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the gaps between the fingers. Figuratively, it means something is very little or so small that it is difficult to hold or grasp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲沙幼到漏手指罅咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saa1 jau1 dou3 lau6 sau2 zi2 laa3 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沙子太细，细到从指缝里漏掉。
examples.english_sentence: The sand is so fine that it slips through your fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工低到連食飯都唔夠，真係漏手指罅囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 dai1 dou3 lin4 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 gau3, zan1 hai6 lau6 sau2 zi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资太低，连吃饭都不够，真是微不足道。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is so low that he can't even afford meals; it's really barely anything.

mandarin_meaning: 大手大脚，浪费，不善于理财
english_meaning: wasteful, extravagant, bad at managing money, having fingers with wide gaps (literal meaning leading to figurative meaning of money slipping through the fingers)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人花钱大手大脚，不善于理财，容易浪费钱财。字面意思是手指缝隙大，钱容易漏掉，引申为花钱无节制。
explanation_english: Describes a person who spends money wastefully, is not good at managing money, and easily wastes money. The literal meaning is having wide gaps between the fingers, so money easily slips through, which is extended to mean spending money without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人手指罅疏，成日洗腳唔抹腳，唔夠使就問屋企攞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 sau2 zi2 laa3 so1, seng4 jat6 sai2 goek3 m4 maat3 goek3, m4 gau3 sai2 zau6 man6 uk1 kei2 lo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人花钱大手大脚，总是浪费钱，不够用就问家里要。
examples.english_sentence: He's a wasteful person who always spends money extravagantly. If he runs out, he asks his family for more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好咁手指罅疏啦，儲返啲錢傍身好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 gam3 sau2 zi2 laa3 so1 laa1, cou5 faan1 di1 cin2 bong6 san1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还是不要这么大手大脚的，存些钱在身边比较好。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't be so wasteful, it's better to save some money for a rainy day.

english_meaning: ladyfingers (biscuit)
explanation_mandarin: 一种细长、松软的海绵蛋糕饼干，通常用于制作提拉米苏等甜点。
explanation_english: A type of small, sponge-like cake biscuit, often used in desserts such as tiramisu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買啲手指餅整tiramisu啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 sau2 zi2 beng2 zeng2 tiramisu aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一些手指饼干做提拉米苏。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some ladyfingers to make tiramisu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餅店嘅手指餅好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 beng2 dim3 ge3 sau2 zi2 beng2 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家饼店的手指饼干很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The ladyfingers from this bakery are delicious.

english_meaning: palm (of the hand)
explanation_mandarin: 手腕以下，手指以上的部位。
explanation_english: The inner surface of the hand between the wrist and the fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伸出你嘅手掌俾我睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ceot1 nei5 ge3 sau2 zoeng2 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伸出你的手掌给我看看。
examples.english_sentence: Stretch out your palm and let me see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手掌好大，一睇就知係做粗重嘢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 zoeng2 hou2 daai6, jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 hai6 zou6 cou1 cung5 je5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手掌很大，一看就知道是做粗重活的。
examples.english_sentence: His palm is very big. You can tell that he does heavy work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手掌俾針拮到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 zoeng2 bei2 zam1 gat1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手掌被针扎到了。
examples.english_sentence: My palm got pricked by a needle.

jyutping: sau2 zoeng2 hai6 juk6, sau2 bui3 jau6 hai6 juk6
english_meaning: Both the palm and the back of the hand are flesh; It's hard to choose between two equally valued options; They are both equally important/loved.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻无论怎样选择，都会顾此失彼。通常指难以偏袒任何一方的情况。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where it's difficult to choose between two options because both sides are equally important or loved. It implies that any decision will inevitably disappoint someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽有兩個仔，手掌係肉，手背又係肉，點會偏心㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jau5 loeng5 go3 zai2, sau2 zoeng2 hai6 juk6, sau2 bui3 jau6 hai6 juk6, dim2 wui5 pin1 sam1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈有两个儿子，手心手背都是肉，怎么会偏心呢？
examples.english_sentence: Mom has two sons, both are equally loved, how could she be biased?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩份工都好好，人工又差唔多，真係手掌係肉，手背又係肉，唔知點揀好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 fan6 gung1 dou1 hou2 hou2, jan4 gung1 jau6 caa1 m4 do1, zan1 hai6 sau2 zoeng2 hai6 juk6, sau2 bui3 jau6 hai6 juk6, m4 zi1 dim2 gaan2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两份工作都很好，工资也差不多，真是手心手背都是肉，不知道怎么选好。
examples.english_sentence: Both of these jobs are good and the salary is similar, it's really hard to choose, I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: handbrake; parking brake
explanation_mandarin: 通常指车辆上的手动刹车装置，用来固定车辆防止滑动。
explanation_english: Refers to the hand-operated brake in a vehicle, used to keep it stationary and prevent it from rolling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得拉手掣呀，唔好俾架車溜走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 laai1 sau2 zai3 aa3, m4 hou2 bei2 gaa3 ce1 lau1 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得拉手刹啊，不要让车溜走了。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to pull the handbrake, don't let the car roll away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔記得放手掣就開車，差啲撞到隔離架車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 gei3 dak1 fong3 sau2 zai3 zau6 hoi1 ce1, caa1 di1 zong6 dou3 gaak3 lei4 gaa3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忘记松手刹就开车了，差点撞到旁边的车。
examples.english_sentence: He forgot to release the handbrake before driving, and almost hit the car next to him.

english_meaning: handcart, pushcart, trolley
explanation_mandarin: 用手推动的车子，通常用于搬运货物。
explanation_english: A cart or trolley that is pushed by hand, typically used for transporting goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要買架手推車嚟搬啲貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 gaa3 sau2 teoi1 ce1 lai4 bun1 di1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要买一辆手推车来搬这些货物。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy a handcart to move these goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用手推車將啲泥沙運走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 sau2 teoi1 ce1 jeung1 di1 nai4 saa1 wan6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用手推车把那些泥沙运走。
examples.english_sentence: He used a handcart to move the sand and soil away.

synonyms: 雞公車 (gai1 gung1 ce1) - more old-fashioned, usually refers to a wheelbarrow

english_meaning: portable; handheld
explanation_mandarin: 方便携带的、手提的。
explanation_english: Easy to carry; portable; handheld.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部新嘅手提電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 sau2 tai4 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一部新的手提电话。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new mobile phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手提風扇好方便，夏天帶出街用啱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 tai4 fung1 sin3 hou2 fong1便, haa6 tin1 daai3 ceot1 gaai1 yung6 ngaam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提风扇很方便，夏天带出去用正好。
examples.english_sentence: This handheld fan is very convenient; it's perfect for using outside in the summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢帶咗個手提電腦去咖啡廳做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 go3 sau2 tai4 din6 nou5 heoi3 gaa3 fe1 ting1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他带了一个手提电脑去咖啡厅工作。
examples.english_sentence: He took a laptop to the cafe to work.

english_meaning: carry-on suitcase; hand luggage
explanation_mandarin: 指可以手提的小型行李箱，通常尺寸符合航空公司对手提行李的规定。
explanation_english: Refers to a small suitcase that can be carried by hand, usually with dimensions that meet airline regulations for carry-on baggage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個手提喼已經裝滿曬，可能要寄艙喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 sau2 tai4 gip1 ji5 ging1 zong1 mun5 saai3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 gei3 cong1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手提箱已经装满了，可能需要托运了。
examples.english_sentence: My carry-on suitcase is already full, I might need to check it in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得帶埋你個手提喼上機呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 nei5 go3 sau2 tai4 gip1 soeng5 gei1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得带上你的手提箱上飞机啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your carry-on suitcase onto the plane.

english_meaning: laptop computer
explanation_mandarin: 一种便携式的个人电脑，可以合上携带。
explanation_english: A portable personal computer that can be folded shut for carrying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部手提電腦壞咗，要攞去整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 sau2 tai4 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 zeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的笔记本电脑坏了，要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: My laptop is broken, I need to take it to get repaired.

synonyms: 筆記簿型電腦 (bat1 gei3 bou6 jing4 din6 nou5)

english_meaning: mobile phone, cell phone
explanation_mandarin: 可以随身携带的电话，即手机。
explanation_english: A portable telephone, more commonly known as a mobile phone or cell phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得帶手提電話出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 sau2 tai4 din6 waa2 chut1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记带手机出门了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my mobile phone when I went out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲手提電話功能越嚟越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 gaa1 di1 sau2 tai4 din6 waa2 gung1 nang4 yuet6 lai4 yuet6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的手机功能越来越多了。
examples.english_sentence: Mobile phones have more and more functions nowadays.

english_meaning: hands trembling, legs shaking; to tremble and shake (from fear, excitement, cold, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为害怕、紧张、兴奋或寒冷等原因，导致手和脚都剧烈地颤抖。
explanation_english: Describes the state of one's hands and legs shaking violently due to fear, nervousness, excitement, or cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要上台表演，我驚到手揗腳震啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 toi4 biu2 jin2, ngo5 geng1 dou3 sau2 tan4 goek3 zan3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要上台表演，我害怕得手脚发抖啊！
examples.english_sentence: I have to perform on stage tomorrow, I'm so scared that my hands and legs are shaking!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到鬼，嚇到手揗腳震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 gwai2, haak3 dou3 sau2 tan4 goek3 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见到鬼，吓得手脚发抖。
examples.english_sentence: He saw a ghost and was so scared that his hands and legs were shaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍到我手揗腳震，快啲入屋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dou3 ngo5 sau2 tan4 goek3 zan3, faai3 di1 jap6 uk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷得我手脚发抖，快点进屋吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so cold that my hands and legs are shaking, let's go inside quickly.

english_meaning: grip strength
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌握东西的力量。
explanation_english: The strength of one's grip; the ability to firmly hold something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手握力好勁，一啲都唔驚拎唔起啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 ngok1 lik6 hou2 ging6, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 ging1 ling1 m4 hei2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的握力很强，一点都不怕拿不起来东西。
examples.english_sentence: His grip strength is very strong; he isn't worried at all about not being able to lift things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生會檢查你嘅手握力，睇下你有冇肌肉萎縮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 sau2 ngok1 lik6, tai2 haa5 nei5 jau5 mou5 gei1 yuk6 wai2 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生会检查你的握力，看看你有没有肌肉萎缩。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor will check your grip strength to see if you have muscle atrophy.

english_meaning: Hand-shaken drink; to shake (by hand)
explanation_mandarin: 主要指通过人工摇晃制作的饮品，如奶茶、果汁等。也指用手摇晃的动作。
explanation_english: Primarily refers to hand-shaken drinks, such as bubble tea, fruit juice, etc. It can also refer to the action of shaking something by hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯手搖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 sau2 jiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一杯手摇饮品。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a hand-shaken drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度手搖緊啲嘢飲，好落力咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 sau2 jiu4 gan2 di1 je5 jam2, hou2 lok6 lik6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在摇晃那些饮料，非常卖力。
examples.english_sentence: He's shaking the drinks, doing it with a lot of effort.

synonyms: 台式飲品 (toi4 sik1 jam2 ban2) - Taiwanese style drink

english_meaning: Hand-shredded chicken
explanation_mandarin: 一种将熟鸡用手撕成条状或块状的菜肴。
explanation_english: A dish of cooked chicken that is shredded into strips or chunks by hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋去食手撕雞啦，聽講嗰間好好食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 sau2 si1 gai1 laa1, ting1 gong2 go2 gaan1 hou2 hou2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们去吃手撕鸡吧，听说那家很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat hand-shredded chicken today. I heard that restaurant is very delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅手撕雞做得好入味，啲雞肉又嫩滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sau2 si1 gai1 zou6 dak1 hou2 jap6 mei6, di1 gai1 juk6 jau6 nyun6 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的手撕鸡做得非常入味，鸡肉又嫩又滑。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's hand-shredded chicken is very flavorful, and the chicken is tender and smooth.

english_meaning: hand-shredded chicken; shredded chicken (dish)
explanation_mandarin: 一种菜式，将鸡肉煮熟后用手撕成丝状，通常伴以酱汁食用。
explanation_english: A dish where the chicken is cooked and then shredded by hand into thin strips. It's usually served with a sauce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日去咗間餐廳食手撕鷄，好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 sau2 si1 gai1, hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天去了一家餐厅吃手撕鸡，非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: I went to a restaurant yesterday and had hand-shredded chicken, it was so delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食阿媽整嘅手撕鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 yi3 sik6 aa3 maa1 zing2 ge3 sau2 si1 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃妈妈做的手撕鸡。
examples.english_sentence: I like my mom's hand-shredded chicken the most.

english_meaning: walking stick, cane
explanation_mandarin: 用于走路时支撑身体的棍子，通常给老年人或腿脚不便的人使用。
explanation_english: A stick used for support while walking, typically used by elderly people or those with mobility impairments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆行路要用手杖先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 haang4 lou6 jiu3 yung6 sau2 zoeng6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶走路需要用拐杖才行。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma needs a walking stick to walk.

english_meaning: palm of the hand
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌的正面部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the inner surface of the hand, the palm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 伸出你嘅手板嚟睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ceot1 nei5 ge3 sau2 baan2 lai4 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伸出你的手掌让我看看。
examples.english_sentence: Extend your palm and let me have a look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都用手板幫我朋友擋太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 sau2 baan2 bong1 ngo5 pang4 jau5 dong2 taai3 yeung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常用手掌帮我的朋友遮挡太阳。
examples.english_sentence: I often use my palm to shield my friend from the sun.

jyutping: sau2 baan2 hai6 juk6, sau2 bui3 jau6 hai6 juk6
english_meaning: Both the palm and the back of the hand are flesh; It's difficult to favour one over the other (when choosing between two equally loved/valued options).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻手心手背都是自己的肉，难以偏袒或有所偏颇。形容难以取舍，难以抉择，两边都很重要，无法割舍。
explanation_english: A metaphor for the difficulty in choosing between two options that are equally valued or loved. It emphasizes the challenge of being impartial when both options are important and cannot be easily sacrificed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話兩個仔都係手板係肉，手背又係肉，唔會偏心邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 waa6 loeng5 go3 zai2 dou1 hai6 sau2 baan2 hai6 juk6, sau2 bui3 jau6 hai6 juk6, m4 wui5 pin1 sam1 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是说两个儿子都是手心手背都是肉，不会偏袒任何一个。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always says that both her sons are equally loved, she won't favour one over the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揀邊間大學真係頭痛，間間都咁好，手板係肉，手背又係肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan2 bin1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 zan1 hai6 tau4 tung3, gaan1 gaan1 dou1 gam3 hou2, sau2 baan2 hai6 juk6, sau2 bui3 jau6 hai6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选哪间大学真让人头痛，每间都那么好，手心是肉，手背也是肉。
examples.english_sentence: It's really a headache to choose which university; they're all so good, it's hard to choose.

english_meaning: palm of the hand; very easy; a piece of cake
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常容易完成，就像在手掌心上一样容易。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very easy to accomplish, as if it's right on the palm of your hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數好手板堂啫，你一定識計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hou2 sau2 baan2 tong4 ze1, nei5 jat1 ding6 sik1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道题很简单，你肯定会算。
examples.english_sentence: This question is a piece of cake, you definitely know how to solve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對佢嚟講，攞個A手板堂咁易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2, lo2 go3 ei1 sau2 baan2 tong4 gam3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对他来说，拿A简直易如反掌。
examples.english_sentence: For him, getting an A is as easy as pie.

english_meaning: palm of the hand
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌的中心部位。
explanation_english: Refers to the central part of the palm of the hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都流手汗，成日濕晒手板心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lau4 sau2 hon6, seng4 jat6 sap1 saai3 sau2 baan2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是出汗，手掌心总是湿漉漉的。
examples.english_sentence: He always sweats, his palms are always wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌親嗰陣，用手板心撐住地下，唔係就會成塊面落地喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 can1 go2 zan6, yung6 sau2 baan2 sam1 caang1 zyu6 dei6 haa2, m4 hai6 zau6 wui5 seng4 faai3 min6 lok6 dei6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摔倒的时候，用手掌心撑住地面，不然就会整张脸着地了。
examples.english_sentence: When you fall, use the palm of your hand to brace yourself on the ground, otherwise your whole face will hit the ground.

english_meaning: obvious; plain to see; clear at a glance
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常明显，一看就明白，无需多加解释。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very obvious and easy to understand at a glance, requiring no further explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事手板眼見咁簡單，點解你都唔明？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gam3 gaan2 daan1, dim2 gaai2 nei5 dou1 m4 ming4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么简单，一目了然，为什么你都不明白？
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so simple and obvious, how come you still don't understand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅大話手板眼見，大家都唔信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 daai6 waa6 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3, daai6 ga1 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的谎言太明显了，大家都不会相信他。
examples.english_sentence: The lies he's telling are so obvious; nobody believes him.

synonyms: 顯而易見 (hin2 ji4 jik6 gin3)

jyutping: sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1
mandarin_meaning: 眼见为实的手艺，短时间内就能见效的技能
english_meaning: Skill that produces visible results quickly; skill where results are immediately apparent; immediate results
explanation_mandarin: 指一些技术含量不高，但可以立即见到成效的工作或技能。 通常也用来形容技巧简单，容易学会和掌握，并且成果立竿见影。
explanation_english: Refers to work or skills that don't require a high level of technical expertise but produce immediate results. It often describes simple techniques that are easy to learn and master, with tangible outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好手板眼見功夫，一落手就搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, jat1 lok6 sau2 zau6 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很快见效，一动手就搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very efficient at his work, he gets it done as soon as he starts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個唔係咩高深嘅技術，都係手板眼見功夫啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 m4 hai6 me1 gou1 sam1 ge3 gei6 seot6, dou1 hai6 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这不是什么高深的技术，都是一些立竿见影的技能罢了。
examples.english_sentence: This is not some profound technique, it's just a skill with immediate results.

jyutping: sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1
mandarin_meaning: 简单易学的工作；明摆着的功夫
english_meaning: Simple and straightforward work; easily mastered skill; obvious effort.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常简单容易学会的工作或技能，成果立即可见。
explanation_english: Describes work or a skill that is very simple and easy to learn, with immediately visible results. It often implies that the work requires little skill or expertise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲手板眼見工夫，你一學就識㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, nei5 jat1 hok6 zau6 sik1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些都是简单易学的工作，你一学就会的。
examples.english_sentence: This is simple and straightforward work, you'll learn it in no time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工都係手板眼見工夫，唔使點用腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 dou1 hai6 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, m4 sai2 dim2 jung6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作都是简单易学的工作，不用怎么动脑筋。
examples.english_sentence: His job is all simple and straightforward work, he doesn't need to use his brain much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整蛋糕對佢嚟講係手板眼見工夫，佢日日都整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 daan6 gou1 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 hai6 sau2 baan2 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做蛋糕对她来说是简单易学的功夫，她每天都做。
examples.english_sentence: Making cakes is a piece of cake for her, she makes them every day.

english_meaning: to use one's arm as a pillow; arm pillow
explanation_mandarin: 指用自己的手臂弯曲当作枕头使用。既可以指用手臂当枕头的行为，也可以指手臂枕头本身。
explanation_english: Refers to using one's arm as a pillow. It can refer to the act of using the arm as a pillow or the arm pillow itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺嘅時候成日都用手枕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 sau2 zam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡觉的时候总是用手当枕头。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses his arm as a pillow when he sleeps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞓喺度用手枕會痺㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan3 hai2 dou6 yung6 sau2 zam2 wui5 bei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 躺在那里用手当枕头会麻的。
examples.english_sentence: Lying there using your arm as a pillow will make it numb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日用手枕啦，隻手會麻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 yung6 sau2 zam2 laa1, zek3 sau2 wui5 maa4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是用手当枕头啦，手会麻的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always use your arm as a pillow, your arm will get numb.

english_meaning: Handle, grip
explanation_mandarin: 指可以握持的部位，通常用于控制或操作工具、设备等。
explanation_english: A part of an object designed to be held in the hand, especially for operating or controlling a tool or device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個遊戲機個手柄好靈敏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 gei1 go3 sau2 beng3 hou2 ling4 man5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游戏机的手柄很灵敏。
examples.english_sentence: The handle of this game console is very responsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗新嘅門手柄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 san1 ge3 mun4 sau2 beng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了新的门把手。
examples.english_sentence: He replaced the door handle with a new one.

english_meaning: hand grenade; (slang) very unattractive woman
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以手掷的炸弹。 俚语中也指外貌非常差的女性。
explanation_english: A small bomb that is thrown by hand. In slang, it refers to a very unattractive woman (offensive).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺戰爭嗰陣用好多手榴彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zin3 zaang1 go2 zan6 yung6 hou2 do1 sau2 lau4 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在战争时用了许多手榴弹。
examples.english_sentence: They used many hand grenades during the war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，條女真係手榴彈咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, tiu4 neoi2 zan1 hai6 sau2 lau4 daan2 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，那个女的真像手榴弹一样。
examples.english_sentence: Wow, that woman is really a hand grenade. (extremely unattractive - offensive)

english_meaning: handgun, pistol
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以单手握持和发射的短管枪械。
explanation_english: A short firearm that can be held and fired with one hand; a handgun or pistol.
