examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他瘦瘦的，其实他肌肉发达，打起架来也挺厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his skinny appearance, he's actually quite muscular and can put up a good fight.

english_meaning: fingernail; nail
explanation_mandarin: 手指上的指甲。
explanation_english: The nail on a finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲手甲咁長，應該剪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 sau2 gaap3 gam3 coeng4, ying1 goi1 zin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的指甲这么长，应该剪了。
examples.english_sentence: Your fingernails are so long, you should cut them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搽咗紅色嘅手甲油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa1 zo2 hung4 sik1 ge3 sau2 gaap3 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她涂了红色的指甲油。
examples.english_sentence: She put on red nail polish.

english_meaning: careless; negligent; inattentive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不仔细、不认真，容易出错。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is careless, negligent, or inattentive in their work, easily making mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好手疏，成日都搞錯啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 hou2 sau2 so1, seng4 jat6 dou1 gaau2 co3 di1嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很粗心大意，总是搞错东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's very careless in his work and always messes things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁手疏啦，下次小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sau2 so1 laa1, haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么粗心大意了，下次小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless, be more careful next time.

english_meaning: itchy hands; urge to touch or tamper with things; fidgety
explanation_mandarin: 形容忍不住想动手去做某事，多指一些不必要或会带来麻烦的行为。
explanation_english: Describes the irresistible urge to touch or tamper with something, often referring to unnecessary or troublesome actions. Literally "itchy hands."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞佢啲嘢啦，咪咁手痕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5 di1 je5 laa1, mai5 gam3 sau2 han4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别动他的东西了，别那么手痒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch his things, don't be so fidgety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到個掣就好手痕想撳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou2 go3 zai2 zau6 hou2 sau2 han4 soeng2 gam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到那个按钮就手痒想按。
examples.english_sentence: When I see that button, I have an itchy hand and want to press it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好手痕，成日搞爛啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sau2 han4, seng4 jat6 gaau2 laan6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很手痒，总是弄坏东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's very fidgety, always breaking things.

english_meaning: skill, ability, capability; dexterity and insight
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人做事有手段，有本事，善於應付各種情況。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is skillful, capable, and good at handling various situations. It implies both dexterity (doing things skillfully) and insight (understanding situations well).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人手眼好高，好識做生意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 sau2 ngaan5 hou2 gou1, hou2 sik1 zou6 seng1 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很有本事，很会做生意的。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very capable and knows how to do business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢冇啲手眼，好難喺呢間公司生存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 mou5 di1 sau2 ngaan5, hou2 naan4 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sang1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事没有点本事，很难在这间公司生存。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to survive in this company without some skills and abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要手眼夠快先搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 sau2 ngaan5 gau3 faai3 sin1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事要手脚和眼力都足够快才能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter requires quick hands and sharp eyes to handle.

english_meaning: stingy; tight-fisted; unwilling to spend money
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很吝啬，不愿意花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好手硬，請佢食飯都咁唔願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau2 ngaang6, cheng2 keoi5 sik6 faan6 dou1 gam3 m4 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是很吝啬，请他吃饭都不情愿。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy; he's even unwilling when I treat him to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁手硬啦，買份禮物俾女朋友啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sau2 ngaang6 laa1, maai5 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 neoi5 pang4 jau5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么小气啦，买份礼物给女朋友吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so tight-fisted, buy a gift for your girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆份人好手硬，唔會輕易加人工俾你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 fan6 jan4 hou2 sau2 ngaang6, m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 gaa1 jan4 gung1 bei2 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板这个人很吝啬，不会轻易给你加薪的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is a very stingy person; he won't easily give you a raise.

english_meaning: luck with one's hands (especially in games or gambling); having a hot hand; having good luck
explanation_mandarin: 指在需要用手进行的活动（如打麻将、玩游戏、做实验等）中，手气好，运气好，能获得好结果。
explanation_english: Refers to having good luck or skill in activities that involve using one's hands, such as playing mahjong, games, or conducting experiments, leading to favorable outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日手神好喎，次次都自摸！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 sau2 san4 hou2 wo3, ci3 ci3 dou1 zi6 mo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天手气真好，每次都自摸！
examples.english_sentence: You have such a hot hand today; you keep winning by self-drawing (in mahjong)!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日贏咗好多錢，真係手神到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 wing4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 sau2 san4 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天赢了很多钱，真是手气好得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: He won a lot of money yesterday; his luck was unbelievably good.

mandarin_meaning: 随便看看, 走马观花
english_meaning: to browse, to look around casually, to window shop
explanation_mandarin: 指随便看看，没有特定目标地逛，通常用于购物场合。
explanation_english: Refers to casually looking around without a specific goal, usually in a shopping context. It implies browsing or window shopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇嘢做，咪出去手禮拜下囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 je5 zou6, mai1 chut1 heoi3 sau2 lai5 baai3 haa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没事做，就出去随便看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: I have nothing to do today, so I'll just go out and browse around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋入去間鋪頭手禮拜下，睇下有冇嘢啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jap6 heoi3 gaan1 pou3 tau2 sau2 lai5 baai3 haa5, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 je5 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们进去那家店随便看看，看看有没有什么合适的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go into that shop and browse, see if there's anything we like.

english_meaning: manuscript
explanation_mandarin: 用手书写的稿件。
explanation_english: A manuscript written by hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份手稿係佢嘅作品嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 sau2 gou2 hai6 keoi5 ge3 zok3 pin2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份手稿是他的作品。
examples.english_sentence: This manuscript is his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將佢嘅手稿寄咗俾出版社。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 sau2 gou2 gei3 zo2 bei2 ceot1 baan2 se5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把他的手稿寄给了出版社。
examples.english_sentence: He sent his manuscript to the publisher.

mandarin_meaning: 手迹; 手艺; 作品
english_meaning: Handwriting; craftsmanship; work; authorship
explanation_mandarin: 指文字、绘画、工艺等的作者的风格、水平或作品本身。
explanation_english: Refers to the style, level, or the work itself of the author of writing, painting, craftsmanship, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅手筆好細膩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 sau2 bat1 hou2 sai3 nei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画的笔触非常细腻。
examples.english_sentence: The brushwork in this painting is very delicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手筆真係唔錯，好有大師風範。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 bat1 zan1 hai6 m4 co3, hou2 jau5 daai6 si1 fung1 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手笔真不错，很有大师风范。
examples.english_sentence: His work is really good, it has the air of a master.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅幕後黑手，肯定係佢嘅手筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 mok6 hau6 hak1 sau2, hang2 ding6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 sau2 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的幕后黑手，肯定是他做的。
examples.english_sentence: He is definitely the one behind this; it's his work.

english_meaning: palm lines; palmistry
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌上的纹路，也指通过观察手掌纹路来预测命运的学问。
explanation_english: Refers to the lines on the palm of the hand. It can also refer to the art of predicting fate by observing the lines on the palm, i.e., palmistry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好信手紋嘅，成日搵人睇相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 seon3 sau2 man4 ge3, seng4 jat6 wan2 jan4 tai2 seung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很相信掌纹，经常找人看相。
examples.english_sentence: He is very superstitious about palmistry and often gets his fortune told.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話手紋可以睇到你嘅未來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 sau2 man4 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou2 nei5 ge3 mei6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说掌纹可以看出你的未来。
examples.english_sentence: People say that palm lines can reveal your future.

english_meaning: short of money; strapped for cash; tight-fisted (sometimes with the implication of being temporarily short of money, not necessarily stingy)
explanation_mandarin: 形容经济状况不佳，手头不宽裕，缺少可用的钱。
explanation_english: Describes a financial situation where one is short of money and struggling to make ends meet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排手緊，唔敢亂咁使錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 sau2 gan2, m4 gam2 lyun6 gam2 sai2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近手头紧，不敢乱花钱。
examples.english_sentence: I'm short of money these days, so I don't dare to spend it carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到月底就手緊，要慳住啲使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 jyut6 dai2 zau6 sau2 gan2, jiu3 haan1 zyu6 di1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到了月底就手头紧，要省着点花。
examples.english_sentence: Towards the end of the month, I'm strapped for cash, so I need to be more frugal with my spending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢好有錢，但有時都會手緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hou2 jau5 cin2, daan6 jau5 si4 dou1 wui5 sau2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他很有钱，但有时也会手头紧。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's very rich, he's sometimes short of money.

synonyms: 銀根短缺 (ngan4 gan1 dyun2 kyut3)

english_meaning: procedure; formalities
explanation_mandarin: 指办理事情的程序或手续。
explanation_english: The procedures or formalities required to accomplish something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞呢啲嘢嘅手續好煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 ni1 di1 je5 ge3 sau2 zuk6 hou2 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 办这些事情的手续很麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: The procedures for handling these things are very troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入境手續搞掂晒未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 ging2 sau2 zuk6 gaau2 dim6 saai3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入境手续都办完了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you completed all the immigration procedures?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請護照嘅手續好簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 wu6 ziu3 ge3 sau2 zuk6 hou2 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请护照的手续很简单。
examples.english_sentence: The procedure for applying for a passport is very simple.

english_meaning: handling fee; service charge; processing fee
explanation_mandarin: 办理某种手续时需要支付的费用。
explanation_english: A fee charged for handling, processing, or completing a transaction or service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行攞錢要俾手續費㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan4 hong4 lo2 cin2 jiu3 bei2 sau2 zuk6 fai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在银行取钱需要支付手续费的。
examples.english_sentence: There is a handling fee for withdrawing money at the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上買嘢通常都有手續費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng6 maai5 je5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 jau5 sau2 zuk6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在网上买东西通常都有手续费。
examples.english_sentence: There is usually a service charge when buying things online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅手續費比較貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sau2 zuk6 fai3 bei2 gaau3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的手续费比较贵。
examples.english_sentence: This company's handling fees are relatively expensive.

english_meaning: Elbow
explanation_mandarin: 身体部位，连接上臂和前臂的关节。
explanation_english: The joint connecting the upper arm and forearm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲嘢放喺枱邊咁近，你撞到手肘就會掃跌曬㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 je5 fong3 hai2 toi2 bin1 gam3 gan6, nei5 zong6 dou2 sau2 zaau2 zau6 wui5 so3 dit3 saai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把东西放在桌子边这么近，你碰到胳膊肘就会全部扫掉的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put things so close to the edge of the table, you'll knock them all over if you bump your elbow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心撞親個手肘，痛到哇哇叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 zong6 can1 go3 sau2 zaau2, tung3 dou3 waa1 waa1 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心撞到胳膊肘，疼得哇哇叫。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally hit his elbow and cried out in pain.

english_meaning: back of the hand
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌的反面。
explanation_english: The back of the hand, the part opposite the palm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心俾刀割到手背。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 bei2 dou1 got3 dou2 sau2 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心被刀割到手背。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally cut the back of his hand with a knife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手背好粗糙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 bui3 hou2 cou1 cou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手背很粗糙。
examples.english_sentence: The back of his hand is very rough.

english_meaning: skill, tact, ability to handle things, maneuver, wrist (literal meaning also exists but is less common)
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情的手段、技巧或能力，有时也指手腕（身体部位）。 通常带有一定的策略性和灵活性的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to the skill, tact, or ability to handle situations effectively. It often implies a certain degree of strategy and flexibility. Can also refer to the physical wrist, though this meaning is less common in conversational contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有手腕㗎，搞得掂晒啲客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 sau2 wun2 gaa3, gaau2 dak1 dim6 saai3 di1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有手段，能搞定所有的客户。
examples.english_sentence: He's very skillful and tactful; he can handle all the clients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好用埋啲咁嘅手腕啦，光明正大啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jung6 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 sau2 wun2 laa1, gwong1 ming4 zeng3 daai6 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再用这些手段了，光明正大一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use these kinds of tactics anymore; be more honest and upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅手腕扭親咗，好痛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 sau2 wun2 nau2 can1 zo2, hou2 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手腕扭伤了，好痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: I sprained my wrist, it hurts a lot!

english_meaning: hands and feet; movement; manner of doing things; slyness; underhand means
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是手和脚，也可以引申为动作或手段。有时也指行为不干净、不诚实。
explanation_english: Literally means hands and feet. It can also refer to movement or means/manner of doing things. Sometimes, it implies slyness or underhand means; dishonest behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手腳好快，好叻做事嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 goek3 hou2 faai3, hou2 lek1 zou6 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手脚很快，很擅长做事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is quick in his movements and very good at doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你手腳乾淨啲，唔好偷嘢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau2 goek3 gon1 zing6 di1, m4 hou2 tau1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你手脚干净点，不要偷东西啊。
examples.english_sentence: Keep your hands clean, don't steal anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要手腳快啲，趕得切喺deadline之前交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau2 goek3 faai3 di1, gwaan2 dak1 cit3 hai2 deadline zi1 cin4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要手脚快点，赶得上在截止日期之前交作业。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be quick, so we can hand in our homework before the deadline.

english_meaning: honest; clean-handed; not involved in corruption or theft; nimble-fingered (literal meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人为人正直，不贪污受贿，不偷东西。也可指手脚灵活，动作利索。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is honest and does not engage in corruption, bribery, or theft. It can also refer to someone who is nimble-fingered and quick in their movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做會計手腳好乾淨，從來冇貪過公司啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 wui6 gai3 sau2 goek3 hou2 gon1 zeng6, cung4 loi4 mou5 taam1 gwo3 gung1 si1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做会计手脚很干净，从来没有贪过公司的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very honest accountant and has never embezzled any company money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個賊仔手腳好乾淨，一陣就偷咗佢條頸鏈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caak6 zai2 sau2 goek3 hou2 gon1 zeng6, jat1 zan6 zau6 tau1 zo2 keoi5 tiu4 geng2 lin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小偷手脚很利索，一会儿就偷了他的项链。
examples.english_sentence: This thief is very nimble-fingered; he stole his necklace in no time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫人執嘢手腳好乾淨，好快就搞掂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 jan4 zap1 je5 sau2 goek3 hou2 gon1 zeng6, hou2 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮人收拾东西手脚很利索，很快就弄好了。
examples.english_sentence: He's very efficient at helping people tidy up; he gets everything done quickly.

english_meaning: arm
explanation_mandarin: 指人的上肢，从肩膀到手腕的部分。
explanation_english: The upper limb of a human, from the shoulder to the wrist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢舉高隻手臂，想引起人嘅注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi2 gou1 zek3 sau2 bei3, soeng2 hei2 yan4 ge3 zyu3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他举高手臂，想引起别人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He raised his arm to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手臂上面有紋身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 bei3 soeng6 min6 yau5 wan4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手臂上有纹身。
examples.english_sentence: He has a tattoo on his arm.

english_meaning: to dance for joy; to gesticulate wildly; to be overjoyed
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常高兴、兴奋的样子，手脚都舞动起来。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being extremely happy and excited, with one's hands and feet moving wildly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到中咗頭獎，開心到手舞足蹈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ting1 dou2 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2, hoi1 sam1 dou3 sau2 mou5 zuk1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到中了头奖，高兴得手舞足蹈。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard he won the first prize, he was so happy that he danced for joy.

english_meaning: craftsmanship; skill; workmanship
explanation_mandarin: 指手工制作的技能或技巧。
explanation_english: Refers to the skill or technique of making things by hand; craftsmanship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手藝真係好好，整啲嘢好靚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 ngai6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2, zing2 di1 je5 hou2 leng3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手艺真好，做的东西很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: His craftsmanship is really good; the things he makes are very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學一門手藝都幾好，起碼餓唔死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jat1 mun4 sau2 ngai6 dou1 gei2 hou2, hei2 maa5 o6 m4 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学一门手艺也挺好的，至少饿不死。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a craft is quite good, at least you won't starve to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲人好多都冇乜手藝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 do1 dou1 mou5 mat1 sau2 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都没有什么手艺。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people don't have much of a craft.

english_meaning: operation, surgery
explanation_mandarin: 为了治疗疾病或损伤，医生用器械在人体上进行操作。
explanation_english: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments to repair damage or treat disease in a living body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要做個心臟手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu3 zou6 go3 sam1 zong6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他要做一个心脏手术。
examples.english_sentence: He needs to have a heart operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢要做手術先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他必须做手术才行。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs to have surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手術嘅風險好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 seot6 ge3 fung1 him2 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手术的风险很高。
examples.english_sentence: The risk of this operation is very high.

english_meaning: handbag, purse, bag
explanation_mandarin: 指女性使用的手提包或袋子，通常用来携带个人物品，如钱包、钥匙、化妆品等。
explanation_english: A handbag or purse, typically used by women, to carry personal belongings such as wallets, keys, and makeup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗個新手袋呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 sau2 doi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一个新手提包啊！
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new handbag today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個手袋入邊有啲乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 sau2 doi2 jap6 bin1 jau5 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的手提包里面有什么东西呀？
examples.english_sentence: What do you have in your handbag?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋好襯你件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 hou2 can3 nei5 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包很搭配你的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: This handbag matches your dress well.

english_meaning: sleeve (of a garment)
explanation_mandarin: 衣服袖子的部分
explanation_english: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫嘅手袖太長喇，要改短啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 ge3 sau2 zau6 taai3 coeng4 laa3, jiu3 goi2 dyun2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的袖子太长了，要改短一点。
examples.english_sentence: The sleeves of this shirt are too long, they need to be shortened a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摵起衫袖，好似好嬲咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 hei2 saam1 zau6, hou2 ci5 hou2 nau1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卷起袖子，好像很生气似的。
examples.english_sentence: He rolled up his sleeves, as if he was very angry.

english_meaning: tricks; tactics; underhanded methods; manipulation; gloves and socks (literal meaning, but rarely used)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不正当的手段或伎俩，常用于贬义。字面意思是手套和袜子，但通常用作比喻。
explanation_english: Figuratively refers to underhanded methods, tricks, or tactics, often used in a negative connotation. Literally means gloves and socks, but this meaning is rarely used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多手襪先至攞到個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 sau2 mat6 sin1 zai3 lo2 dou2 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了许多手段才拿到这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: He used a lot of tricks to get the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好玩咁多手襪啦，坦白啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 waan2 gam3 do1 sau2 mat6 laa1, taan2 baak6 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要玩那么多花招了，坦白一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use so many tricks, it's better to be honest.

english_meaning: Sign language
explanation_mandarin: 一种用手势表达意思的语言，通常用于聋哑人之间的交流。
explanation_english: A language expressed through hand gestures, typically used for communication among deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識得用手語同聾人溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 dak1 yung6 sau2 jyu5 tung4 lung4 jan4 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会用手语和聋人沟通。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to communicate with deaf people using sign language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有唔少手語課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 m4 siu2 sau2 jyu5 fo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多手语课程。
examples.english_sentence: There are many sign language courses in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to raise the knife and let it fall (idiom); to act swiftly and decisively; to get something done quickly and efficiently
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作非常迅速、果断，一气呵成。原指武术中出刀动作的利落，现多用于比喻处理事情干净利索。
explanation_english: Describes actions that are very quick, decisive, and completed in one go. Originally referred to the swiftness of drawing a knife in martial arts, it's now often used metaphorically to describe handling matters cleanly and efficiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞掂件事手起刀落，真係好有效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 dim6 gin6 si6 sau2 hei2 dou1 lok6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 haau6 leut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他处理这件事干净利落，真的很有效率。
examples.english_sentence: He handled the matter swiftly and efficiently; he's really efficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細想手起刀落咁解決問題，但係我覺得要再諗清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 soeng2 sau2 hei2 dou1 lok6 gam2 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 jiu3 zoi3 lam2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板想干脆利落地解决问题，但是我觉得要再想清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants to resolve the issue decisively and quickly, but I think we need to think more carefully.

synonyms: 快刀斬亂麻 (faai3 dou1 zaam2 lyun6 maa4)

english_meaning: Brothers; Siblings; Comrades; Fellow protesters
explanation_mandarin: 本义指兄弟姐妹。现在也指关系亲密的同伴，特别是参与同一社会运动的人，带有互相扶持，互相帮助的意味。
explanation_english: Literally refers to brothers and sisters. Now also refers to close companions, especially those participating in the same social movement, with the implication of mutual support and assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係手足，一定要互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 sau2 zuk1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是手足，一定要互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: We are brothers, we must support each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班手足一齊上街示威，為香港嘅自由而奮鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sau2 zuk1 jat1 cai4 soeng5 gaai1 si6 wai1, wai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zi6 jau4 ji4 fan5 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群手足一起上街示威，为香港的自由而奋斗。
examples.english_sentence: Those comrades went to the streets to protest together, fighting for the freedom of Hong Kong.

english_meaning: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD)
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的儿童传染病，主要症状为手、足、口腔等部位出现皮疹或疱疹。
explanation_english: A common infectious disease in children, characterized by rash or blisters on the hands, feet, and mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近啲幼稚園好多細路仔都有手足口病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 dik1 jau1 zi6 jyun2 hou2 do1 sai3 lou2 zai2 dou1 jau5 sau2 zuk1 hau2 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近幼儿园里很多小朋友都有手足口病。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, many children in kindergartens have hand, foot, and mouth disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手足口病嘅傳染性好高，要特別注意衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 zuk1 hau2 beng6 ge3 cyun4 jim5 sing3 hou2 gou1, jiu3 dak6 bit1 zyu3 ji3 wai6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手足口病的传染性很高，要特别注意卫生。
examples.english_sentence: Hand, foot, and mouth disease is highly contagious, so pay special attention to hygiene.

english_meaning: at a loss what to do; be at one's wit's end; be flustered
explanation_mandarin: 形容遇到突发情况，不知如何是好，非常慌乱。
explanation_english: Describes a state of panic and confusion when faced with a sudden and unexpected situation, not knowing what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嗰陣，突然間乜都唔記得晒，嚇到手足無措。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 go2 zan6, dat6 jin4 gaan1 mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1晒 saai3, haak3 dou3 sau2 zuk1 mou4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候，突然什么都记不起来了，吓得手足无措。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, he suddenly couldn't remember anything and was so frightened he was at a loss what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當佢發現自己嘅錢包唔見咗嘅時候，佢表現得好手足無措。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 keoi5 faat3 hin3 zi6 gei2 ge3 cin2 baau1 m4 gin3 zo2 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 sau2 zuk1 mou4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当他发现自己的钱包不见了的时候，他表现得很手足无措。
examples.english_sentence: When he realized that his wallet was missing, he seemed very flustered.

english_meaning: elbow
explanation_mandarin: 连接手臂上下部分的关节。
explanation_english: The joint between the upper and lower parts of the arm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用手踭撞人呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 sau2 zaang1 zong6 yan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用手肘撞人啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't elbow people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我手踭撞到枱角，好痛啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau2 zaang1 zong6 dou2 toi4 gok3, hou2 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手肘撞到桌角，好痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: I hit my elbow on the corner of the table, it hurts!

english_meaning: driving skills; workmanship
explanation_mandarin: 指駕駛車輛的技術，也可用於比喻其他方面的技術或手藝。
explanation_english: Refers to the skill of driving a vehicle. It can also be used metaphorically to describe skills or craftsmanship in other areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手車真係好勁，泊車泊得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6, paak3 ce1 paak3 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的驾驶技术真的很厉害，停车停得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: His driving skills are really amazing, he parks so well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個師傅嘅手車好好，整嘅嘢好襟用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si1 fu2 ge3 sau2 ce1 hou2 hou2, zeng2 ge3 je5 hou2 kam1 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个师傅的手艺很好，做的东西很耐用。
examples.english_sentence: This craftsman's workmanship is excellent; the things he makes are very durable.

english_meaning: to have a soft spot; to go soft; to be lenient; to be too generous; hand trembles
explanation_mandarin: 形容因心软而无法坚持原则或采取强硬手段；也指手部因疲劳或疾病而颤抖无力。
explanation_english: Describes being unable to stick to principles or take a hard line due to being soft-hearted. Also refers to the hand trembling and weak due to fatigue or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好對佢哋手軟啊，一定要嚴厲啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 sau2 jyun5 aa3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 jim4 lai6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要对他们手软啊，一定要严厉一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go soft on them, you need to be stricter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我拎住啲嘢太耐，隻手開始手軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ling1 zyu6 di1 je5 taai3 noi6, zek3 sau2 hoi1 ci2 sau2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拿着东西太久了，手开始发软。
examples.english_sentence: I've been holding things for too long, my hand is starting to tremble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁慘，我真係手軟，唔忍心懲罰佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 keoi5 gam3 caam2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau2 jyun5, m4 jan2 sam1 cing4 phạt6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么可怜，我真的心软了，不忍心惩罚他。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so miserable, I really went soft and couldn't bear to punish him.

english_meaning: Weak in the hands and legs; feeling weak and unsteady; to feel limp
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体虚弱，手脚无力。
explanation_english: Describes a state of physical weakness where the hands and legs feel weak and unable to support oneself. It can be due to fear, fatigue, or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日我發燒，搞到手軟腳軟，乜都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 ngo5 faat3 siu1, gaau2 dou3 sau2 jyun5 goek3 jyun5, mat1 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天我发烧，搞得我手脚发软，什么都做不了。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I had a fever, which made me feel weak in the hands and legs, and I couldn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一聽到佢要離開，我嚇到手軟腳軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 ting1 dou2 keoi5 jiu3 lei4 hoi1, ngo5 haak3 dou3 sau2 jyun5 goek3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一听到他要离开，我吓得手脚发软。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as I heard he was leaving, I was so frightened I felt weak in the hands and legs.

english_meaning: Model kit; figure; collectible figurine
explanation_mandarin: 指一种以人物或物体为原型，通常由塑料或树脂制成，手工组装和上色的模型。常见于动漫、游戏等流行文化周边产品。
explanation_english: Refers to a model kit or collectible figurine, usually made of plastic or resin, that is manually assembled and painted. Commonly found as merchandise for anime, games, and other popular culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意收藏手辦，屋企擺滿曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sau1 cong4 sau2 baan6, uk1 kei2 baai2 mun5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢收藏手办，家里摆满了。
examples.english_sentence: I really like collecting figurines, my house is full of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手辦好貴，但係佢嘅手工好精細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 baan6 hou2 gwai3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 sau2 gung1 hou2 zing1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手办很贵，但是它的手工很精细。
examples.english_sentence: This figurine is very expensive, but its craftsmanship is exquisite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多時間去砌佢嘅新手辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 cai3 keoi5 ge3 san1 sau2 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间去组装他的新手办。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time assembling his new model kit.

english_meaning: mobile game, mobile phone game
explanation_mandarin: 指在手机等移动设备上运行的游戏。
explanation_english: Refers to games played on mobile devices such as smartphones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近沉迷咗隻手遊，日日都玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 cam4 mai5 zo2 zek3 sau2 jau4, jat1 jat1 dou1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近沉迷了一款手机游戏，每天都在玩。
examples.english_sentence: I've become addicted to a mobile game recently and play it every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多手遊都要課金先可以玩得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 sau2 jau4 dou1 jiu3 fo3 gam1 sin1 ho2 ji5 waan2 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多手机游戏都要充值才能玩得好。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many mobile games require topping up to play well.

english_meaning: bracelet, bangle
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手腕上的环状饰品。
explanation_english: A ring-shaped ornament worn around the wrist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗隻新嘅手鈪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zek3 san1 ge3 sau2 ngaak2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她买了一个新的手镯。
examples.english_sentence: She bought a new bracelet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻手鈪係我阿嫲留低嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sau2 ngaak2 hai6 ngo5 aa3 po4 lau4 dai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手镯是我奶奶留下的。
examples.english_sentence: This bracelet was left by my grandmother.

english_meaning: handcuffs
explanation_mandarin: 一种铐住犯人双手的金属装置。
explanation_english: A pair of metal restraints used to secure a prisoner's hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人將個賊鎖上手銬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan4 zoeng1 go3 caak6 so2 soeng5 sau2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察把小偷铐上了手铐。
examples.english_sentence: The police handcuffed the thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人鎖咗手銬，帶返差館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 so2 zo2 sau2 kaau3, daai3 faan1 caa1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人铐上手铐，带回警察局。
examples.english_sentence: He was handcuffed and taken back to the police station.

english_meaning: wristwatch
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手腕上的计时工具。
explanation_english: A timepiece worn on the wrist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手錶冇電喇，行唔到喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 biu1 mou5 din6 laa3, haang4 m4 dou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手表没电了，走不动了。
examples.english_sentence: My wristwatch is out of battery, it's not working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻手錶幾錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sau2 biu1 gei2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: How much is this wristwatch?

english_meaning: handgun, pistol
explanation_mandarin: 一种小型枪械，可以单手使用。
explanation_english: A small firearm designed to be held and fired with one hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺套戲度攞住支手鎗好型咁嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou3 hei3 dou6 lo2 zyu6 zi1 sau2 cheung1 hou2 ying4 gam2 ge3 yeung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影里拿着手枪的样子很帅。
examples.english_sentence: He looked very cool holding a handgun in the movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察搜到佢袋入面有支手鎗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 chaat3 sau1 dou3 keoi5 doi2 jap6 min6 jau5 zi1 sau2 cheung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在他口袋里搜到了一把手枪。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a handgun in his pocket.

english_meaning: bracelet
explanation_mandarin: 戴在手腕上的链状装饰品。
explanation_english: An ornamental chain or band worn around the wrist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我生日嘅時候，男朋友送咗條手鏈畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 saang1 jat6 ge3 si4 hau6, naam4 pang4 jau5 sung3 zo2 tiu4 sau2 lin2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我生日的时候，男朋友送了一条手链给我。
examples.english_sentence: My boyfriend gave me a bracelet for my birthday.

mandarin_meaning: 爱管闲事; 手伸得长
english_meaning: nosy; meddlesome; to have a long reach (authority/influence)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人喜欢管别人的事情，或者权力、影响力很大，能够干涉超出自己范围的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is nosy and likes to interfere in other people's business, or whose power and influence are great, allowing them to interfere in matters beyond their jurisdiction or scope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好手長，乜嘢都要管一餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau2 coeng4, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 gun2 jat1 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是爱管闲事，什么都要管一下。
examples.english_sentence: He's really nosy, he wants to interfere in everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好手長，好多部門嘅嘢佢都有份管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 sau2 coeng4, hou2 do1 bou6 mun4 ge3 je5 keoi5 dou1 jau5 fan6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司权力很大，很多部门的事情他都有份管。
examples.english_sentence: He has a long reach in the company, he's involved in the management of many departments.

english_meaning: Mobile phone, cell phone
explanation_mandarin: 指可以随身携带的电话。
explanation_english: Refers to a telephone that can be carried around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得帶手電啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 sau2 din6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记带手机了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my mobile phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借我手電用一用啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5 sau2 din6 yung6 jat1 yung6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以借我手机用一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you lend me your mobile phone for a moment?

synonyms: 手機 (more common in Mandarin-influenced Cantonese)

english_meaning: flashlight, torch
explanation_mandarin: 一种手持式电子照明工具。
explanation_english: A portable, battery-operated light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋停電，搵返個手電筒出嚟先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting4 din6, wan2 faan1 go3 sau2 din6 tung2 chut1 lai4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们停电了，先找出手电筒。
examples.english_sentence: We have a power outage. Let's find the flashlight first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行夜山要帶手電筒，安全啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 je6 saan1 jiu3 daai3 sau2 din6 tung2, on1 cyun4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上爬山要带手电筒，安全一些。
examples.english_sentence: You should bring a flashlight when hiking at night; it's safer.

english_meaning: Temari ball, decorative thread-wrapped ball (Japanese origin)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种以线缠绕装饰的球形物品，源于日本的传统工艺品。
explanation_english: Refers to a decorative ball made by wrapping threads, originating from the traditional Japanese craft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆整咗個手鞠畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po4 zing2 zo2 go3 sau2 guk1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶做了一个手鞠给我。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma made a Temari ball for me.

english_meaning: on hand; at hand; currently available (money or resources); financial situation
explanation_mandarin: 指目前拥有的钱财或资源；也可以指经济状况。
explanation_english: Refers to the money or resources currently available to someone; can also refer to their financial situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近手頭緊，唔好問佢借錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sau2 tau4 gan2, m4 hou2 man6 keoi5 ze3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近手头紧，不要问他借钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's short on cash recently, don't ask him to borrow money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手頭有幾多錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 tau4 jau5 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手头有多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much money do you have on hand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我依家手頭比較鬆動，可以請你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji1 ga1 sau2 tau4 bei2 gaau3 sung1 dung6, ho2 ji5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在手头比较宽裕，可以请你吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm doing better financially now, I can treat you to a meal.

synonyms: 經濟狀況 (ging1 zai3 zong6 fong3)

english_meaning: short of money; strapped for cash; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容经济状况不好，缺少现金，经济拮据。
explanation_english: Describes a financial situation where one is short of money or has little cash available; financially strapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近手頭緊，唔好意思，請唔到你食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 sau2 tau4 gan2, m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ceng2 m4 dou2 nei5 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近手头有点紧，不好意思，请不了你吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a bit short of money recently, so I'm sorry I can't treat you to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾通常都手頭緊，因為要買好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 sau2 tau4 gan2, jan1 wai6 jiu3 maai5 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年底通常都很手头拮据，因为要买很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: People are usually short of money at the end of the year because they have to buy so many things.

english_meaning: to be flush with money; to have money to spare
explanation_mandarin: 形容近期经济状况良好，有足够的钱可以支配。
explanation_english: Describes a recent favorable financial situation where one has enough money to spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排升咗職，手頭鬆好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 sing1 zo2 zik1, sau2 tau4 sung1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近升职了，手头宽裕很多。
examples.english_sentence: I got promoted recently, so I'm flush with money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出咗糧，手頭鬆返啲，可以去食好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 zo2 leong4, sau2 tau4 sung1 faan1 di1, ho2 ji5 heoi3 sik6 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发了工资，手头松了一些，可以去吃点好的。
examples.english_sentence: I got paid, so I have some money to spare and can go eat something nice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾花紅多，手頭鬆，想去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 faa1 hung4 do1, sau2 tau4 sung1, soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年终奖很多，手头宽裕，想去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: With a large year-end bonus, I have money to spare and want to go travelling.

english_meaning: luck (in games or skill-based activities); form; condition; state (especially in gambling or games requiring skill)
explanation_mandarin: 指技术性活动中的运气、状态或表现。 多用于赌博、比赛或手工艺等领域。
explanation_english: Refers to luck, condition, or performance in skill-based activities. Often used in gambling, games, competitions, or handicrafts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日手風唔錯，贏咗唔少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sau2 fung1 m4 co3, wing4 zo2 m4 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天手气不错，赢了不少钱。
examples.english_sentence: My luck is good today, I've won a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日手風好順，打麻雀贏到開巷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 sau2 fung1 hou2 seon6, daa2 maa4 zoek3 wing4 dou3 hoi1 hong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天手气很顺，打麻将赢得很多。
examples.english_sentence: He had good luck yesterday, he won a lot playing mahjong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近寫書法嘅手風都唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 se2 syu1 faat3 ge3 sau2 fung1 dou1 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近写书法的状态都不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: My form in calligraphy hasn't been very good lately.

english_meaning: having a lucky streak; having a winning hand; in good form; playing well
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人在游戏中运气非常好，或表现出色。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very lucky or performing exceptionally well, especially in games of chance or skill (like mahjong or card games). It implies a winning streak or being in good form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚打麻雀，佢手風好順，贏咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 daa2 maa4 zoek3, keoi5 sau2 fung1 hou2 seon6, wing4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天晚上打麻将，他手气很好，赢了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He had a lucky streak playing mahjong last night, winning a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日波士好似手風好順咁，咁多嘢都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 bo1 si2 hou2 ci5 sau2 fung1 hou2 seon6 gam2, gam3 do1 je5 dou1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天老板好像状态很好，这么多事情都处理得好。
examples.english_sentence: The boss seems to be on a roll today; he's managing to handle so many things well.

english_meaning: accordion
explanation_mandarin: 一种乐器，通过拉动风箱和按键来发出声音。
explanation_english: A musical instrument with bellows and a keyboard that is played by pressing keys or buttons while expanding or contracting the bellows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街頭表演嗰陣，彈住手風琴唱歌，好好聽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 tau4 biu2 jin2 go2 zan6, daan6 jyu5 sau2 fung1 kam4 coeng3 go1, hou2 hou2 teng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街头表演的时候，弹着手风琴唱歌，很好听的。
examples.english_sentence: When he was busking on the street, he played the accordion and sang. It was very nice.

english_meaning: trembling, shaky (in hands and feet); flustered, in a state of panic
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常紧张、害怕或者疲惫时，手脚颤抖，动作慌乱的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme nervousness, fear, or exhaustion, causing trembling and shaky movements in the hands and feet, leading to flustered actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次上台表演，佢手騰腳震，差啲唔記得曬啲台詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng5 toi4 biu2 jin2, keoi5 sau2 tang4 goek3 zan3, caa1 di1 m4 gei3 dak1 saai3 di1 toi4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次上台表演，他手忙脚乱，差点忘了所有台词。
examples.english_sentence: The first time he performed on stage, he was trembling and shaky, and almost forgot all his lines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到咁多警察，佢嚇到手騰腳震，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 ging2 caat3, keoi5 haak3 dou3 sau2 tang4 goek3 zan3, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这么多警察，他吓得手忙脚乱，不知如何是好。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing so many policemen, he was so frightened that he was trembling and didn't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 手腕; 技能; 手艺
english_meaning: Wrist; skill; craftsmanship; (slang) 'kickback' or 'commission' (especially in a dodgy context)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是手腕的骨头。比喻做工的手艺、技术。也指不正当的佣金，回扣，类似于“油水”。
explanation_english: Literally means the bones of the wrist. Figuratively refers to one's skill or craftsmanship. As slang, it refers to 'kickback' or 'commission', often in a shady or illegal context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手骨好好，整啲嘢都好精細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 gwat1 hou2 hou2, zing2 di1 je5 dou1 hou2 zing1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手艺很好，做的东西都很精致。
examples.english_sentence: His craftsmanship is very good, and the things he makes are very delicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢你諗住分幾多手骨俾我呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 nei5 lam2 zyu6 fan1 gei2 do1 sau2 gwat1 bei2 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这单生意你打算分多少佣金给我啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much commission are you planning to give me from this deal?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢撈偏門，啲手骨唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 lou1 pin1 mun4, di1 sau2 gwat1 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他做不正当的生意，赚了不少油水。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he's involved in shady business and makes a lot of kickbacks.

english_meaning: skill; ability; capability; (literal) hands and feet
explanation_mandarin: 指人的身手，技能，办事的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's skill, ability, or capability to do things. Literally means 'hands and feet'. Often used to describe someone's competence or agility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學嘢好快，手骹都幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3, sau2 gaau3 dou1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学东西很快，身手也挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: He learns things very quickly, and his skills are quite good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢份工要醒目啲，手骹唔好就搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 jiu3 sing2 muk6 di1, sau2 gaau3 m4 hou2 zau6 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这份工作要聪明点，如果没能力就搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be smarter to do this job. If you don't have the skills, you can't handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人幾掂，手骹唔錯，好多嘢都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gei2 dim6, sau2 gaau3 m4 co3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人挺能干的，能力不错，很多事都能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He's quite capable. His skills are good, and he can handle a lot of things.

english_meaning: Generous; liberal (with money)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人花钱很大方，不吝啬。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is generous with money and not stingy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對屋企人好手鬆㗎，成日買嘢俾佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 uk1 kei5 jan4 hou2 sau2 sung1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对家人很大方，经常买东西给他们。
examples.english_sentence: He is very generous to his family and often buys them things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆今年年尾花紅出手好鬆，個個都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gam1 nin4 nin4 mei5 faa1 hung4 chut1 sau2 hou2 sung1, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今年年终奖给得很慷慨，每个人都很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The boss was very generous with the year-end bonus this year, and everyone is very happy.

english_meaning: Hand (radical); to lift, to hold; used in writing and slang as a substitute for '佢' (he/she/him/her)
explanation_mandarin: 作为汉字偏旁部首时，表示与手相关的动作。在网络用语中，模仿其外形，代替第三人称代词“他/她/它/他们/她们/它们”。
explanation_english: As a Chinese character radical, it indicates actions related to the hand. In online slang, its shape is mimicked and used as a substitute for the third-person pronouns "he/she/it/they".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你見過扌未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin3 gwo3 taa1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你见过他/她/它没有啊？
examples.english_sentence: Have you seen him/her/it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪搞扌啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gaau2 taa1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要打扰他/她/它啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother him/her/it!

english_meaning: only; just; ability; talent
explanation_mandarin: 作为副词，表示事情发生得晚或刚刚发生；作为名词，表示才能或能力。
explanation_english: As an adverb, it indicates that something happened late or just happened; as a noun, it refers to talent or ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱啱先至食完飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aam1 aam1 sin1 zoi3 sik6 jyun4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚刚才吃完饭。
examples.english_sentence: We just finished eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有才華㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 coi4 waa4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有才华的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very talented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得返一百蚊先至夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 faan1 jat1 baak3 man1 sin1 zoi3 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只剩下100元才够。
examples.english_sentence: Only 100 dollars is enough for me.

english_meaning: talented and handsome young man; promising young talent
explanation_mandarin: 形容年轻有才华，相貌英俊的男子。多用于赞扬。
explanation_english: Describes a young man who is talented and handsome. Often used as a compliment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生又叻仔，真係一個難得嘅才俊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 jau6 lek1 zai2, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 naan4 dak1 ge3 coi4 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻又聪明，真是一个难得的才俊。
examples.english_sentence: He's young and intelligent, truly a rare and promising talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆選美嘅評判都話呢位參賽者係一位才俊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gaai3 syun2 mei5 ge3 ping3 pun3 dou1 waa6 ni1 wai2 caam1 soi3 ze2 hai6 jat1 wai2 coi4 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这届选美的评委都说这位参赛者是一位才俊。
examples.english_sentence: The judges of this year's beauty pageant all said that this contestant is a talented and promising young man.

english_meaning: talented woman; woman of great talent
explanation_mandarin: 指有才华的女子，通常指在文学、艺术方面有突出表现的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman of talent, usually one who excels in literature or art.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺文學方面好有天賦，真係一位才女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 man4 hok6 fong1 min6 hou2 jau5 tin1 fu3, zan1 hai6 jat1 wai2 coi4 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在文学方面很有天赋，真是一位才女。
examples.english_sentence: She is very talented in literature, truly a talented woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅小說好好睇，大家都讚佢係才女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 siu2 syut3 hou2 hou2 tai2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zaan3 keoi5 hai6 coi4 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她写的小说很好看，大家都夸她是才女。
examples.english_sentence: The novels she writes are very good, everyone praises her as a talented woman.

english_meaning: Talented scholar; gifted writer; brilliant person
explanation_mandarin: 指有才华的人，尤指在文学艺术方面有成就的男子。
explanation_english: Refers to a man with great talent, especially in literature and the arts. Often used to describe a gifted writer or a brilliant scholar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生就俾人叫做「才子」㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 zau6 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 "coi4 zi2" gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就被人们叫做“才子”了。
examples.english_sentence: He was already called a "talented scholar" when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個編劇真係一個才子，寫啲劇本好有深度。

mandarin_meaning: 才智过人, 聪明过人

english_meaning: talent, ability, capability

examples.english_sentence: To develop your talents, you need to be brave enough to try new things.

english_meaning: talent; ability; gift
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一方面表现出的特殊能力或天赋。
explanation_english: Refers to special ability or talent demonstrated in a certain area.

explanation_english: Refers to a person's talents and skills, usually in the arts or performance.

(4) to be stationed: to camp. (5) (Cantonese slang) fashionable, trendy; refers to someone who dresses well and is up-to-date with the latest trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪嘅扎肉做得幾好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 zaat3 juk6 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的越南猪肉卷做得挺好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: The Vietnamese pork roll made in this shop is quite tasty.

english_meaning: woman with bound feet
explanation_mandarin: 指旧时缠足的妇女。缠足是古代一种陋习，通过人为方法使女性的脚变小。
explanation_english: Refers to women with bound feet in old times. Foot binding was an ancient custom where women's feet were artificially made smaller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅社會，好多女人都係扎腳婆，行路好唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 se5 wui2, hou2 do1 neoi5 jan2 dou1 hai6 zaat3 goek3 po4, haang4 lou6 hou2 m4 faan1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的社会，很多女人都是缠足的，走路很不方便。
examples.english_sentence: In the old society, many women were women with bound feet, and walking was very inconvenient.

english_meaning: Pork knuckle; Pig trotter (specifically, a pressed and jellied version, often served sliced)
explanation_mandarin: 一种广东特色菜，通常是将猪蹄经过腌制、卤制等工序后，压制成型，切片食用。口感爽脆，味道鲜美。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dish, typically made by marinating and braising pig trotters, then pressing them into shape. It is usually served sliced. The texture is crisp and the taste is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去酒樓食扎蹄啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 zau2 lau4 sik6 zaat3 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去酒楼吃扎蹄吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the restaurant to eat pork knuckle tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪嘅扎蹄做得好正宗，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 zaat3 tai4 zou6 dak1 hou2 zeng3 zung1, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的扎蹄做得非常正宗，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's pork knuckle is very authentic and delicious.

english_meaning: to wake up suddenly; to be alert; to be aware of something
explanation_mandarin: 指突然从睡梦中醒来，也指突然警觉或意识到某种情况。
explanation_english: Refers to waking up suddenly from sleep. It can also mean suddenly becoming alert or aware of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我半夜扎醒咗，以为地震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun3 je6 zaat3 sing2 zo2, ji5 wai4 dei6 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我半夜突然醒了，以为地震了。
examples.english_sentence: I woke up suddenly in the middle of the night, thinking there was an earthquake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁迟钝啦，扎醒啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ci4 deon6 laa1, zaat3 sing2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么迟钝了，警觉一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow. Be more alert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 见到佢眼神唔对路，我即刻扎醒咗，知佢想搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 ngaan5 san4 m4 deoi3 lou6, ngo5 zik1 hak1 zaat3 sing2 zo2, zi1 keoi5 soeng2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他眼神不对劲，我立刻警觉了，知道他想搞事。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that his eyes looked suspicious, I immediately became alert and knew he was up to no good.

english_meaning: Rebar fixing; Rebar worker; Reinforcement fixing; Reinforcement steelworker
explanation_mandarin: 名词指建筑工地上负责捆扎钢筋的工人。动词指捆扎钢筋的动作。
explanation_english: As a noun, it refers to a worker on a construction site who is responsible for fixing and tying reinforcing steel bars (rebar). As a verb, it refers to the act of tying rebar together to form reinforcement cages for concrete structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺地盤做扎鐵，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dei6 pun4 zou6 zaat3 tit3, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在工地做钢筋工，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a rebar worker on the construction site, it's very hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地盤要扎鐵嘅數量好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 pun4 jiu3 zaat3 tit3 ge3 sou3 loeng6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工地需要捆扎的钢筋数量很多。
examples.english_sentence: This construction site requires a large quantity of rebar fixing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 扎鐵佬日曬雨淋，真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaat3 tit3 lou2 jat6 saai3 jyu5 lam4, zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 yi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钢筋工日晒雨淋的，真不容易。
examples.english_sentence: Rebar workers are exposed to the sun and rain, it's really not easy.

english_meaning: to do a horse stance (martial arts); to stand firm; to get ready (often for a fight or confrontation)
explanation_mandarin: 一种武术基本功，指两腿分开下蹲，身体保持正直姿势。引申为准备就绪，采取防御姿态，或准备应付某种局面。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to the horse stance, a fundamental posture in martial arts where one squats with legs apart and the body upright. Figuratively, it means to prepare for something, take a defensive posture, or be ready to deal with a situation, often a difficult one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋尋晚因為少少事就差啲扎馬打交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cam4 maan1 jan1 wai6 siu2 siu2 si6 zau6 caa1 di1 zaat3 maa5 daa2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们昨晚因为一点小事就差点要摆开架势打架。
examples.english_sentence: They almost got into a fight last night over a small matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日老闆會喺會議上面問罪，大家扎馬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lou5 baan2 wui5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 man6 zeoi6, daai6 gaa1 zaat3 maa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天老板会在会议上问责，大家准备好了！
examples.english_sentence: The boss will be asking questions at the meeting tomorrow, everyone get ready!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗應付考試，我都要扎馬溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jing3 fu6 haau2 si3, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zaat3 maa5 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了应付考试，我也要认真准备复习。
examples.english_sentence: In order to prepare for the exam, I need to buckle down and study.

english_meaning: To flip; to turn over; to peel open
explanation_mandarin: 用手指或工具把东西掀开、翻开、剥开。主要用于体积较小或轻薄的物体。
explanation_english: To use fingers or a tool to flip, turn over, or peel something open. Mainly used for small or thin objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 扐開本書睇下入面寫乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lek1 hoi1 bun2 syu1 tai2 haa5 jam6 min6 se2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 翻开这本书看看里面写了什么。
examples.english_sentence: Flip open this book and see what's written inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扐咗粒花生嘅殼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lek1 zo2 lap1 faa1 sang1 ge3 hok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剥开了一粒花生的壳。
examples.english_sentence: He peeled open a peanut shell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好扐啲書咁大力，整爛咗就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lek1 di1 syu1 gam3 daai6 lik6, zing2 laan6 zo2 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要翻书这么用力，弄坏了就不好啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flip the books so hard, it's not good if you break them.

english_meaning: to fall; to tumble; to flap; to swat; to pat; to pounce on
explanation_mandarin: 指身体失去平衡，跌倒在地；也指用手或其他物体拍打。
explanation_english: Refers to losing balance and falling to the ground; also refers to patting or hitting with the hand or other objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心扑親，擦損咗手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 pok1 can1, chaat3 syun2 zo2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心摔倒了，擦伤了手。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally fell and scraped his hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撲熄啲火佢啦，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: pok1 sik1 di1 fo2 keoi5 laa1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把火扑灭了吧，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Put out the fire, it's very dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊去沙灘撲浪啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 saa1 taan1 pok1 long6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去沙滩冲浪吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the beach and play in the waves!

mandarin_meaning: 男同性恋者，男性同性恋
english_meaning: Gay man, homosexual man (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 带有贬义的称呼男同性恋者的词语，语气较粗俗。
explanation_english: A derogatory term for a gay man, with a rude and offensive tone. Equivalent to 'faggot' in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係淨係好朋友咁簡單，根本就係兩個扑佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 hou2 pang4 jau5 gam2 gaan2 daan1, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 loeng5 go3 puk1 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不仅仅是好朋友那么简单，根本就是两个男同性恋。
examples.english_sentence: They're not just good friends, they're basically two gay men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣鬧人哋啦，扑佬都係人嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 naau6 jan4 dei6 laa1, puk1 lou2 dou1 hai6 jan4 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样骂人啦，男同性恋也是人啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't insult people like that, gay men are people too!

english_meaning: fool; idiot; moron
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人很笨，头脑不灵光，是个傻瓜。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being foolish, unintelligent, or an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜咁蠢啊？成個扑傻瓜咁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 gam3 ceon2 aa3? seng4 go3 puk1 so4 gwaa1 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么笨啊？ 像个傻瓜一样！
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so stupid? Like a total idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣叫人啦，好冇禮貌㗎，扑傻瓜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 giu3 jan4 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3, puk1 so4 gwaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样叫别人，很没礼貌的，傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people that, it's rude, idiot.

mandarin_meaning: 凑近麦克风；对着麦克风说话
english_meaning: To get close to the microphone; To speak into the microphone
explanation_mandarin: 指讲话者为了让声音更清晰，更响亮，靠近麦克风说话。
explanation_english: Refers to the speaker getting close to the microphone in order to make their voice clearer and louder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢大聲啲啦，唔係嘅話就要撲咪喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 daai6 seng1 di1 laa1, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 zau6 jiu3 puk1 mai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话大声点儿吧，不然的话就要凑近麦克风了。
examples.english_sentence: Speak louder, or you'll have to get closer to the microphone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱歌嘅時候要識得撲咪，咁樣先會好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 go1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 sik1 dak1 puk1 mai1, gam2 joeng2 sin1 wui2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱歌的时候要懂得凑近麦克风，这样才会好听。
examples.english_sentence: When singing, you need to know how to get close to the microphone, that way it will sound good.

english_meaning: to have sex, to fuck
explanation_mandarin: 指发生性行为，较为粗俗的说法。
explanation_english: A vulgar term referring to the act of having sexual intercourse; to fuck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺度扑嘢，嘈到我瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 pok1 je5, cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是在这里做爱，吵得我睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: They are always having sex here, and it's so loud I can't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁心急啦，扑嘢都唔使咁快嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sam1 gap1 laa1, pok1 je5 dou1 m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么着急啦，做爱也不用这么快的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hasty, even sex doesn't need to be this fast.

english_meaning: very crispy; extremely crunchy
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物非常脆，口感很好。
explanation_english: Describes food that is very crispy and has a good texture. Emphasizes the crispness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲炸雲吞扑扑脆，好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zaa3 wan4 tan1 pok1 pok1 ceoi3, hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些炸云吞非常脆，很好吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: These fried wontons are extremely crispy and delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意食啲扑扑脆嘅薯片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sik6 di1 pok1 pok1 ceoi3 ge3 syu4 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢吃那些非常脆的薯片。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to eat those really crispy potato chips.

english_meaning: to bang the gavel (as in an auction), to finalize a deal, a done deal
explanation_mandarin: 源于拍卖行或法庭中法官敲槌表示成交或判决结束。引申为事情已经敲定，无法更改。
explanation_english: Derived from the act of banging the gavel by an auctioneer or judge to signify the completion of a sale or the end of a ruling. By extension, it means that something is finalized and cannot be changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經扑槌決定咗今年去日本旅行㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 pok1 ceoi4 kyut3 ding6 zo2 gam1 nin4 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经敲定今年去日本旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: We've already finalized our plans to go to Japan this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個盤數已經扑槌，唔可以再改㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 pun4 sou3 ji5 ging1 pok1 ceoi4, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 goi2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔账已经定案了，不可以再改了。
examples.english_sentence: The accounts are already finalized and can't be changed anymore.

english_meaning: to fall down (usually accidentally, often clumsily); to trip and fall
explanation_mandarin: 指失去平衡而摔倒。多指不小心或笨拙地跌倒。
explanation_english: Refers to losing balance and falling down. Usually implies an accidental or clumsy fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，扑濕咗喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1, puk1 sap1 zo2 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，摔倒在地上了。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't paying attention while walking and fell down on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺濕滑嘅地方跑，好易扑濕㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 sap1 waat6 ge3 dei6 fong1 paau2, hou2 ji6 puk1 sap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在湿滑的地方跑，很容易摔倒的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't run in slippery places, it's easy to fall.

english_meaning: to fall and get wet; to trip and get soaked
explanation_mandarin: 指摔倒在地并且被水或其他液体浸湿。
explanation_english: Refers to falling down and getting wet, usually from water or other liquids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚落大雨，佢喺街度扑濕咗，成身都濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 lok6 daai6 jyu5, keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 pok1 sap1 zo2, sing4 san1 dou1 sap1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚下大雨，他在街上摔倒弄湿了，全身都湿透了。
examples.english_sentence: Last night it rained heavily, he fell and got soaked in the street, his whole body was wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好跑咁快，小心扑濕啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 paau2 gam3 faai3, siu2 sam1 pok1 sap1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要跑那么快，小心摔倒弄湿啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't run so fast, be careful not to fall and get wet!

mandarin_meaning: 成交; 敲定; 同意; 拍板
english_meaning: To finalize; to seal a deal; to hammer down (an agreement); to agree; to consent; to stamp one's approval
explanation_mandarin: 原指在拍卖或交易中，用槌子敲击桌面表示交易完成。引申为最终决定、达成协议、同意的意思。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to striking a table with a gavel to signify the completion of a transaction, such as at an auction. By extension, it means to finalize a decision, reach an agreement, or consent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細扑鎚決定咗今年唔會加人工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 pok1 ceoi4 kyut3 ding6 zo2 gam1 nin4 m4 wui5 gaa1 yan4 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板拍板决定了今年不会加薪了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss has finalized the decision not to raise salaries this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾咗好耐，終於扑鎚簽咗份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 pok1 ceoi4 cim1 zo2 fan6 hap6 yeuk3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈了很久，终于敲定签了这份合同。
examples.english_sentence: We talked for a long time and finally sealed the deal by signing the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋傾咗好耐，個deal終於扑鎚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 zo2 hou2 noi6, go3 deal zung1 jyu1 pok1 ceoi4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了很久，这笔交易终于敲定了。
examples.english_sentence: They talked for a long time, and the deal was finally finalized.

english_meaning: to kowtow; to prostrate oneself; to worship devoutly (often used to describe blind devotion to someone or something)
explanation_mandarin: 原指磕头，叩拜。现在也用来形容盲目崇拜，毫无主见地跟随或模仿某人或事物。
explanation_english: Originally refers to kowtowing or prostrating oneself. Now, it is also used to describe blindly worshipping, following, or imitating someone or something without one's own judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咩都聽佢老細嘅，簡直係扑頭咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 me1 dou1 teng1 keoi5 lou5 sai3 ge3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 buk1 tau4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都听他老板的，简直是磕头一样。
examples.english_sentence: He listens to his boss in everything; it's practically kowtowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁扑頭啦，要有自己嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 buk1 tau4 laa1, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么磕头了，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so blindly devoted; you need to have your own thoughts.

english_meaning: Knockout scam gang; head-bumping scam gang; con artists who use distraction and sleight of hand to rob victims
explanation_mandarin: 指一种诈骗团伙，通常通过分散受害者注意力或用障眼法，使其被骗取财物。他们可能会用快速的动作拍打受害者头部，使其感到迷惑，从而更容易实施诈骗。
explanation_english: Refers to a scam gang that typically distracts victims or uses sleight of hand to swindle them out of their belongings. They may use quick movements to bump or pat the victim's head, causing confusion and making it easier to commit the fraud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多新聞都講有扑頭黨出沒，大家小心啲啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ho2 do1 san1 man2 dou1 gong2 jau5 puk1 tau4 dong2 ceot1 mut6, daai6 ga1 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多新闻都在说有迷魂党出没，大家小心点啊！
examples.english_sentence: Recently, a lot of news has been talking about knockout scam gangs appearing. Everyone, be careful!

mandarin_meaning: 抓, 搔, 扒窃, (网络用语)抄袭, 挖掘
english_meaning: to rake, to scratch, to pilfer, (Internet slang) to copy, to dig up (information)
explanation_mandarin: 1.用耙子等工具聚集或清理。2.用手或爪子抓、搔。3.扒窃：指偷窃。4.(网络用语)指抄袭别人的作品或创意。5.指深入挖掘信息或背景资料。
explanation_english: 1. To rake; to gather or clear with a rake or similar tool. 2. To scratch or claw with hands or claws. 3. To pilfer; to steal. 4. (Internet slang) To copy someone else's work or ideas (plagiarism). 5. To dig up information or background material thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺人哋嘅網站度扒資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 jan4 dei6 ge3 mong5 zaam6 dou6 paa1 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在别人的网站上扒资料。
examples.english_sentence: He's always scraping data from other people's websites.

examples.english_sentence: Don't snatch my food!

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你把树叶扒到一边。
examples.english_sentence: I'll help you rake the leaves to one side.

搵 (wan2) - find (for the meaning of digging up information)

explanation_english: Refers to a man who is supported by a woman and obtains money from her.

examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend is a total gigolo, always asking her for money.

english_meaning: Steakhouse
explanation_mandarin: 指专门供应牛排等西式扒类食物的餐馆。
explanation_english: A restaurant specializing in serving steaks and other grilled western-style dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去扒房食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 paa1 fong2 sik6 faan6 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: Let's go to a steakhouse for dinner tonight.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 paa1 fong2 di1 ngau4 paa2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家牛排馆的牛排很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The steaks in this steakhouse are very famous.

english_meaning: pickpocket
explanation_mandarin: 指盗窃他人财物的窃贼，特别是擅长在拥挤的地方偷东西的人。
explanation_english: A thief who steals from people's pockets or purses, especially in crowded places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺地鐵站要小心啲，好多扒手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, hou2 do1 paa1 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在地铁站要小心点，有很多扒手。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful at the subway station, there are many pickpockets.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 paa1 sau2 tau1 zo2 ngan2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被一个扒手偷了钱包。
examples.english_sentence: His wallet was stolen by a pickpocket.

english_meaning: Having an incestuous relationship with one's daughter-in-law
explanation_mandarin: 指公公与儿媳发生不正当关系，属于乱伦行为。这个词语通常带有强烈的贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a father-in-law having an improper relationship with his daughter-in-law, which constitutes incest. This term carries a strong negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 扒灰係一種好唔道德嘅行為，會受到社會嘅譴責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paa4 fui1 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 m4 dou6 dak1 ge3 hang4 wai4, wui5 sau6 dou3 se5 wui2 ge3 hin2 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公媳通奸是一种很不道德的行为，会受到社会的谴责。
examples.english_sentence: Sleeping with one's daughter-in-law is a highly immoral act that will be condemned by society.

english_meaning: to fail an exam, to fail, to flunk
explanation_mandarin: 指考试失败，没有通过。也泛指其他方面的失败，例如投资失利。
explanation_english: Refers to failing an exam or not passing. It can also be used more generally to refer to failure in other areas, such as a failed investment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次考試又扒艇喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 jau6 paa1 ting2 laa3!

examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam again this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資嗰隻股票扒咗艇，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 go2 zek3 gu2 piu3 paa1 zo2 ting2, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投资的那只股票失败了，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: His investment in that stock failed, losing a lot of money.

english_meaning: To cheat (on a test, exam, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指在考试中作弊，通过不正当手段获取答案。
explanation_english: Refers to cheating during an exam or test, obtaining answers through unfair means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就考試，你唔好諗住扒艇仔啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 haau2 si3, nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 paa4 teng5 zai2 aa3!

examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, don't even think about cheating!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上次考試扒艇仔俾人捉到，俾老師罰咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 ci3 haau2 si3 paa4 teng5 zai2 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2, bei2 lou5 si1 fat6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次考试作弊被人抓到，被老师罚了。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught cheating on the exam last time and was punished by the teacher.

english_meaning: to row upstream; to go against the current; to strive against adversity
explanation_mandarin: 比喻逆着潮流或阻力前进；形容处境艰难，努力奋斗。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to go against the current, metaphorically representing striving against adversity, challenges, or opposition. It describes a difficult situation where one needs to work hard to overcome obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，創業真係扒逆水咁，好難搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, cong3 jip6 zan1 hai6 paa4 jik6 seoi2 gam3, hou2 naan4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，创业真是逆水行舟，很难搞。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad right now; starting a business is really like rowing upstream, it's very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人孭起成頭家，真係好似扒逆水咁辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 be1 hei2 seng4 tau4 gaa1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 paa4 jik6 seoi2 gam3 san1 fu2.

examples.english_sentence: He is carrying the burden of the whole family by himself. It's really as hard as rowing upstream.

synonyms: 逆境求生 (jik6 ging2 kau4 sang1)

mandarin_meaning: 捞钱, 赚外快, 揩油
english_meaning: To rake in money, to earn extra money, to skim (money), to make a quick buck (often with negative connotations)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当或不光彩的手段快速捞取钱财，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to making money quickly and often through dishonest or shady means. It usually carries a negative connotation, implying that the money is obtained through unfair or unethical practices.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 caau2 gu2 piu3 paa4 cin2, hou2 faai3 zau6 faat3 zo2 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠炒股捞钱，很快就发财了。
examples.english_sentence: He made a quick buck by speculating on stocks and became rich very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲管理層成日都諗住點樣扒錢，根本唔理啲員工嘅死活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 gun2 lei5 cang4 sing4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 paa4 cin2, gan1 bun2 m4 lei5 di1 jyun4 gung1 ge3 sei2 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理层整天想着怎么捞钱，根本不顾员工的死活。
examples.english_sentence: The management of this company is always thinking about how to skim money, and they don't care about the well-being of the employees at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好鬼醒目，成日諗住點樣喺公司扒錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gwai2 seng2 muk6, sing4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 hai2 gung1 si1 paa4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很精明，整天想着怎么在公司捞钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's very shrewd and always thinking about how to make a quick buck in the company.

english_meaning: to queue up in a long line; to form a long queue
explanation_mandarin: 指排队的人很多，队伍很长。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where many people are queuing up, forming a long line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日間新餐廳開張，門口扒曬長龍呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaan1 san1 caan1 teng1 hoi1 zoeng1, mun4 hau2 paa1 saai3 coeng4 lung4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这家新餐厅开业，门口排了很长的队。
examples.english_sentence: This new restaurant opened today, and there's a long queue outside the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會飛一開賣就扒曬長龍，好難買到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 jat1 hoi1 maai6 zau6 paa1 saai3 coeng4 lung4, hou2 naan4 maai5 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票一开卖就排起了长队，很难买到。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the concert tickets went on sale, there was a long queue, it's hard to buy them.

english_meaning: to overtake (a vehicle); to cut in line; to jump the queue; to get ahead (of someone)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指车辆超车。引申为插队、抢先。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a vehicle overtaking another vehicle. It has been extended to mean cutting in line, jumping the queue, or getting ahead of someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條隊度扒頭，真係好無禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 deoi2 dou6 paa4 tau4, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6.

examples.english_sentence: He cut in line in the queue, it's really impolite.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 dik1 si2 paa4 tau4 zi1 hau6, hou2 faai3 zau6 m4 gin3 zo2 jeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出租车超车之后，很快就消失了。
examples.english_sentence: After the taxi overtook, it quickly disappeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住扒頭，一步一步嚟先穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 paa4 tau4, jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 lai4 sin1 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着抢先，一步一步来才稳妥。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about jumping ahead; it's safer to take it one step at a time.

english_meaning: to eat (rice)
explanation_mandarin: 用筷子或勺子将饭送入口中，特指吃米饭。
explanation_english: To eat rice, specifically implying the action of scooping or picking up rice with chopsticks or a spoon and putting it in your mouth. It emphasizes the eating of rice as a staple food.

examples.english_sentence: Don't just watch TV, come and eat rice now!

english_meaning: Dragon boat racing
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统的中国水上运动，通常在端午节举行。 指划龙舟比赛。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese water sport, usually held during the Dragon Boat Festival. It refers to the act of dragon boat racing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年端午節我哋去睇人哋扒龍舟啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年端午节我们去看别人赛龙舟吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go watch dragon boat races this Dragon Boat Festival.
