examples.english_sentence: The couple often have big fights, and the noise is so loud that the neighbors can hear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日同我最好嘅朋友打大交，依家唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 tung4 ngo5 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang1 jau5 daa2 daai6 gaau1, ji1 gaa1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天和我最好的朋友大吵了一架，现在不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: I had a big fight with my best friend yesterday, and now I don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 估计，大致计算，夸大数字
english_meaning: to overestimate, to exaggerate numbers, to ballpark
explanation_mandarin: 指大致估算或计算，通常是往高估算，也指夸大数字。
explanation_english: To estimate or calculate roughly, usually overestimating; also refers to exaggerating numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打大數預計今個月開支要一萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 daai6 sou3 jyu6 gai3 gam1 go3 jyut6 hoi1 zi1 jiu3 jat1 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大致估计这个月开支要一万元。
examples.english_sentence: I roughly estimate that this month's expenses will be ten thousand dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打大數啦，實際數字係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 daai6 sou3 laa1, sat6 zai3 sou3 zi6 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要夸大数字了，实际数字是多少？
examples.english_sentence: Don't exaggerate the numbers, what's the actual figure?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打大數，講嘅嘢唔可以盡信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daa2 daai6 sou3, gong2 ge3 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 zeon6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常夸大数字，说的话不能完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: He often exaggerates numbers, so you can't completely trust what he says.

english_meaning: to make a complete change; to overhaul; to turn something upside down; to completely reform
explanation_mandarin: 指完全地改变或翻新，通常指制度、系统或组织的大规模改革。
explanation_english: Refers to a complete and thorough change or overhaul, often involving large-scale reforms in systems, organizations, or institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司蝕錢蝕到咁，一定要打大翻先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 cin2 sit6 dou3 gam2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 daai6 faan1 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司亏损成这样，一定要彻底改革才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company is losing so much money, it definitely needs a complete overhaul.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗迎接新挑戰，我哋要將成個計劃打大翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jing4 zip3 san1 tiu1 zin3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 daa2 daai6 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了迎接新的挑战，我们要把整个计划彻底改变。
examples.english_sentence: In order to meet new challenges, we need to completely overhaul the entire plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，諗住將部門打大翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, nam2 zyu6 zoeng1 bou6 mun4 daa2 daai6 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，打算把部门彻底改变。
examples.english_sentence: After his promotion, he planned to completely reform the department.

english_meaning: Bare-chested; shirtless
explanation_mandarin: 指不穿上衣，裸露上半身。 大赤肋是程度更深，比只是脱衣服还要坦然，更随意。
explanation_english: Refers to being shirtless or bare-chested. '打大赤肋' implies a greater degree of casualness or nonchalance than simply '脱衣服' (taking off clothes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱到打大赤肋都覺得唔夠涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 dou3 daa2 daai6 cek3 lek3 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 gau3 leung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 热到光着膀子都觉得不够凉快。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot that even being shirtless doesn't feel cool enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企打大赤肋周圍行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 daa2 daai6 cek3 lek3 zau1 wai4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在家光着膀子到处走。
examples.english_sentence: He's always walking around the house shirtless.

english_meaning: To conquer the world; to establish an empire/business from scratch; to build up a career or enterprise
explanation_mandarin: 比喻从零开始，开创事业或建立政权。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to start from nothing and build up a career, enterprise, or even a political power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆白手興家，一齊打天下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1, jat1 cai4 daa2 tin1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩白手起家，一起打天下。
examples.english_sentence: The couple started from scratch and built their business together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嘅時候就已經開始打天下，依家好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 daa2 tin1 haa6, ji1 gaa1 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就开始创业，现在很成功。
examples.english_sentence: He started building his empire when he was young, and now he is very successful.

mandarin_meaning: 即兴发挥，临时抱佛脚，未经充分准备就仓促上阵
english_meaning: To wing it, to play by ear, to improvise (often implying a lack of preparation)
explanation_mandarin: 形容在没有充分准备的情况下，凭借自身聪明才智，临时应付，试图解决问题。 通常带有贬义，暗示应该事先做好准备。
explanation_english: Describes dealing with a situation or problem on the spot by relying on one's intelligence and wit, without sufficient prior preparation. Often carries a negative connotation, implying that better preparation would have been ideal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日考試啊？乜都未溫？咁你聽日咪要打天才波囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 haau2 si5 aa3? mat1 dou1 mei6 wan1? gam2 nei5 ting1 jat6 mai1 jiu3 daa2 tin1 coi4 bo1 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天考试啊？什么都没复习？那你明天不就要临时抱佛脚了！
examples.english_sentence: You have an exam tomorrow? And you haven't revised anything? Then you'll have to wing it tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個presentation聽日就做啦，但係我哋仲未準備好，唯有打天才波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 presentation ting1 jat6 zau6 zou6 laa1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zung6 mei6 zyun2 bei6 hou2, wai4 jau5 daa2 tin1 coi4 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的报告明天就要做了，但是我们还没准备好，只能临时应付了。
examples.english_sentence: Our presentation is tomorrow, but we're not ready yet, so we'll just have to play it by ear.

english_meaning: Action heroine, female martial artist (in film/TV)
explanation_mandarin: 指擅长武打，在电影、电视等作品中扮演武打角色的女性演员。
explanation_english: Refers to a female actor who is skilled in martial arts and plays action roles in films, television shows, etc. It often implies a strong and physically capable female character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係香港好出名嘅打女，拍咗好多動作片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 daa2 neoi5, paak3 zo2 hou2 do1 dung6 zok3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是香港很有名的女打星，拍了很多动作片。
examples.english_sentence: She's a very famous action heroine in Hong Kong, and she's filmed many action movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想做打女，好型呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 daa2 neoi5, hou2 jing4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想做女打星，好帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: I want to be an action heroine, it's so cool!

mandarin_meaning: 成双成对; 双份; 双倍
english_meaning: double; in pairs; twice as much
explanation_mandarin: 指数量加倍，两个一起；或指两个同样的。
explanation_english: Refers to doubling the quantity, two together; or two of the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要買打孖雪糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 maai5 daa2 maa1 syut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要买双份冰淇淋。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy double ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試打孖攞A，好叻呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 daa2 maa1 lo2 ei1, hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试双A，真厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He got double As on this exam, so amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日優惠，買一送一，即係打孖送俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau1 wai6, maai5 jat1 sung3 jat1, jik1 hai6 daa2 maa1 sung3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的优惠是买一送一，也就是双倍送给你。
examples.english_sentence: Today's promotion is buy one get one free, which is like giving you double.

english_meaning: To do something in double; To go up together (often implying a double helping or a combined effort)
explanation_mandarin: 指数量加倍，或者几个人同时做某事。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something in double quantity or multiple people doing something simultaneously. Often implies increased intensity or quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日間餐廳做緊promotion，買一送一，我哋打孖上啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zou6 gan2 promotion, maai5 jat1 sung3 jat1, ngo5 dei6 daa2 maa1 soeng5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这家餐厅在做促销，买一送一，我们吃两份吧！
examples.english_sentence: Today, this restaurant is having a promotion, buy one get one free, let's order double!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日個presentation好重要，我哋兩個打孖上，一齊present。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 go3 presentation hou2 zung6 jiu3, ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 daa2 maa1 soeng5, jat1 cai4 present.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天的演示很重要，我们两个人一起上，一起展示。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow's presentation is very important, we two will go together and present together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟打孖上，都唔夠人打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 daa2 maa1 soeng5, dou1 m4 gau3 jan4 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟一起上，也打不过人家。
examples.english_sentence: Even if the two brothers team up, they still can't beat him.

english_meaning: to type, to typewrite
explanation_mandarin: 用键盘输入文字。
explanation_english: To input text using a keyboard; to typewrite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要打字寫份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 daa2 zi6 se2 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要打字写一份报告。
examples.english_sentence: I need to type a report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打字打得好快㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 zi6 daa2 dak1 hou2 faai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打字打得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He types very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我打字呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 daa2 zi6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我打字吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me type?

english_meaning: Typewriter
explanation_mandarin: 一种用来在纸上打印文字的机械或机电设备。
explanation_english: A mechanical or electromechanical machine for typing characters onto paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺以前做嘢成日用打字機寫文件㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 ji5 cin4 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 yung6 daa2 zi6 gei1 se2 man4 gin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷以前工作的时候经常用打字机写文件。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather used to use a typewriter to write documents when he worked.

english_meaning: typing method; input method
explanation_mandarin: 指用于在电脑或移动设备上输入文字的方法，例如拼音输入法、仓颉输入法等。
explanation_english: Refers to a method used to input text on a computer or mobile device, such as Pinyin input method, Cangjie input method, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你用緊邊隻打字法？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 yung6 gan2 bin1 zek3 daa2 zi6 faat3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你正在用哪种打字方法？
examples.english_sentence: Which typing method are you using?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識速成打字法，只識倉頡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 suk1 sing4 daa2 zi6 faat3, zi2 sik1 cong1 kit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不懂速成输入法，只会仓颉。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know the Simplified Cangjie input method, I only know the Cangjie method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人都用智能電話嘅語音輸入功能，唔使學打字法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 yung6 zi3 nang4 din6 waa2 ge3 jyu5 yam1 sap6 jat6 gung1 nang4, m4 sai2 hok6 daa2 zi6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都用智能手机的语音输入功能，不用学打字方法。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people use the voice input function of smartphones, so they don't need to learn typing methods.

jyutping: daa2 jyun4 zaai1 m4 jiu3 wo4 soeng2
mandarin_meaning: 过河拆桥 (guò hé chāi qiáo)
english_meaning: To kick someone to the curb after they've served their purpose; to bite the hand that feeds you; to throw away the ladder after climbing up.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用完毕后，就把曾经帮助过自己的人抛弃或忘记。形容忘恩负义。
explanation_english: A metaphor for discarding or forgetting someone who has helped you after you have used them. Describes someone who is ungrateful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打完齋唔要和尚啦，人哋幫咗你咁多㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 daa2 jyun4 zaai1 m4 jiu3 wo4 soeng2 laa1, jan4 dei6 bong1 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么过河拆桥，人家帮了你这么多。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so ungrateful; they've helped you so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一升咗職就唔理我哋，真係打完齋唔要和尚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sing1 zo2 zik1 zau6 m4 lei5 ngo5 dei6, zan1 hai6 daa2 jyun4 zaai1 m4 jiu3 wo4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一升职就不理我们了，真是过河拆桥。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got promoted, he ignored us; he's really kicking away the ladder after climbing up.

synonyms: 卸磨杀驴 (xie4 mo4 sha1 lǘ)
過橋抽板 (gwo3 kiu2 cau1 baan2)

english_meaning: to go to court, to litigate, to file a lawsuit
explanation_mandarin: 指通过法律途径解决纠纷，向法院提起诉讼。
explanation_english: To engage in a legal dispute; to bring a lawsuit against someone; to resolve a dispute through the courts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為份合約嘅問題而要打官司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 fan6 hap6 joek3 ge3 man6 tai4 ji4 jiu3 daa2 gun1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为合同的问题而要打官司。
examples.english_sentence: They are going to court because of the contract issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔解決到，唯有打官司啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gaai2 kyut3 dou3, wai4 jau5 daa2 gun1 si1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果解决不了，只能打官司了。
examples.english_sentence: If it can't be resolved, we'll have to go to court.

english_meaning: to make up one's mind, to decide firmly, to have a set plan
explanation_mandarin: 预先下定决心，已经决定了。
explanation_english: To make a firm decision or have a clear plan in advance. It implies that someone has already considered the matter and has reached a definite conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經打定主意去英國讀書啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 daa2 ding6 zyu2 ji3 heoi3 ying1 gwok3 duk6 syu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经打定主意去英国读书了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already made up my mind to study in the UK.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打定主意唔會改變㗎啦，你唔使勸佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 ding6 zyu2 ji3 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 gaa3 laa1, nei5 m4 sai2 hyun3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经打定主意不会改变了，你不用劝他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's made up his mind and won't change it, so you don't need to persuade him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好快啲打定主意，唔係就冇機會㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 faai3 di1 daa2 ding6 zyu2 ji3, m4 hai6 zau6 mou5 gei1 wui2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好快点打定主意，不然就没机会了。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better make up your mind quickly, or you'll miss the opportunity.

mandarin_meaning: 认定会输; 预料失败
english_meaning: To resign oneself to defeat; to concede defeat beforehand; to expect to lose.
explanation_mandarin: 指在事情发生前，就已经预料到会失败，并提前做好失败的心理准备。
explanation_english: To assume defeat before even trying; to have already resigned oneself to losing; to give up hope before the actual result is known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽都未開始，你就打定輸數，咁樣唔得㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 dou1 mei6 hoi1 ci2, nei5 zau6 daa2 ding6 syu1 sou3, gam2 joeng2 m4 dak1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛都还没开始，你就认定会输，这样不行啊！
examples.english_sentence: The competition hasn't even started, and you've already resigned yourself to defeat, that's not good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個對手咁勁，已經打定輸數，唔想再比賽落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 go3 deoi3 sau2 gam3 ging6, ji5 ging1 daa2 ding6 syu1 sou3, m4 soeng2 zoi3 bei2 coi3 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到对手这么厉害，已经认定会输，不想再比赛下去了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how strong his opponent was, he had already resigned himself to defeat and didn't want to continue the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我數學咁差，今次考試都打定輸數㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sou3 hok6 gam3 caa1, gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 dou1 daa2 ding6 syu1 sou3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我数学这么差，这次考试肯定考不好啦。
examples.english_sentence: My math is so bad, I'm expecting to fail this exam.

english_meaning: to rob houses and plunder; to pillage
explanation_mandarin: 指抢劫人家的财物，形容土匪、强盗等犯罪行为。
explanation_english: Refers to robbing people's property, describing the criminal behavior of bandits, robbers, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲土匪成日打家劫舍，搞到啲百姓好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 tou2 fei2 sing4 jat6 daa2 gaa1 gip3 se3, gaau2 dou3 di1 baak3 sing3 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时的土匪经常打家劫舍，搞得老百姓很惨。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, bandits often robbed and plundered, making the common people miserable.

english_meaning: to compete directly, to go head-to-head, to set up a competing platform
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一时间或同一领域内，采取相似的方式进行竞争，通常带有对抗的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to direct competition, often involving launching a similar product, service, or event at the same time to compete for the same audience or market share. It implies an adversarial situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司不停打對台，搞到啲客都唔知點揀好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 bat1 ting4 daa2 deoi3 toi4, gaau2 dou3 di1 haak3 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaan2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司不停地竞争，搞得顾客都不知道怎么选才好。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies are constantly competing head-to-head, making it hard for customers to choose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢打對台，佢太有經驗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 daa2 deoi3 toi4, keoi5 taai3 jau5 ging1 jim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他对着干，他太有经验了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to compete with him, he's too experienced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋要同大公司打對台，就要諗啲創新嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung4 daai6 gung1 si1 daa2 deoi3 toi4, zau6 jiu3 nam2 di1 cong3 san1 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们要和大公司竞争，就要想一些创新的方法。
examples.english_sentence: If we want to compete with the big companies, we need to think of some innovative methods.

english_meaning: to be competitors; to compete; rival
explanation_mandarin: 指与他人或公司在生意、学术等方面形成竞争关系，互为对手。
explanation_english: Refers to being in a competitive relationship with another person or company in business, academics, etc., acting as rivals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司一直都打對頭，價錢鬥得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 jat1 zik6 dou1 daa2 deoi3 tau4, gaa3 cin2 dau3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司一直都是竞争对手，价格竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies have always been competitors, and the price competition is fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋同佢哋打對頭，一定要諗到新嘅方法先可以贏佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung4 keoi5 dei6 daa2 deoi3 tau4, jat1 ding6 jiu3 nam2 dou2 san1 ge3 fong1 faat3 sin1 ho2 ji5 wing4 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们和他们是竞争对手，一定要想到新的方法才可以赢他们。
examples.english_sentence: We are competitors with them, we must come up with new ways to beat them.

english_meaning: to beat petty people (a ritual performed to ward off bad luck and curses cast by enemies)
explanation_mandarin: 一种流行于香港、澳门的传统民间习俗，透过拍打象征小人的纸片，以达到驱赶小人、祈求平安顺利的目的。
explanation_english: A popular folk custom in Hong Kong and Macau, involving beating symbolic paper figures of 'petty people' to ward off bad luck and curses cast by enemies, and to pray for peace and good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係驚蟄，好多人會去鵝頸橋底打小人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 ging1 zat6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 ngo4 geng2 kiu4 dai2 daa2 siu2 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是惊蛰，很多人会去鹅颈桥底打小人的。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is Jingzhe (Awakening of Insects), many people will go to Canal Road Flyover to beat petty people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後搞搞震，真係想打佢小人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, zan1 hai6 soeng2 daa2 keoi5 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是背后搞小动作，真想打他小人。
examples.english_sentence: He is always causing trouble behind my back, I really want to beat his petty person.

english_meaning: to tattle, to tell tales, to rat someone out, to snitch
explanation_mandarin: 指向上级或有关部门反映别人的小过失或小错误。多含贬义，指告密。
explanation_english: To report minor wrongdoings or mistakes of others to superiors or relevant authorities. Often carries a negative connotation, implying informing or backstabbing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都打小報告，好乞人憎呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 siu2 bou3 gou3, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是告小状，真让人讨厌！
examples.english_sentence: You always tattle, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打小報告啦，佢都知錯㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 siu2 bou3 gou3 laa1, keoi5 dou1 zi1 co3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别告状了，他已经知道错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tattle, he already knows he's wrong.

english_meaning: to tattle, to tell tales, to inform on someone (especially to a superior)
explanation_mandarin: 指向领导或者长辈报告别人的小错误或者不当行为，通常带有负面含义，指背后说人坏话。
explanation_english: To report someone's minor mistakes or misbehavior to a leader or senior figure, usually with a negative connotation, implying speaking ill of someone behind their back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日打小報告啦，好乞人憎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 daa2 siu2 bou3 gou3 laa1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是打小报告了，很令人讨厌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tattle, it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打小報告，所以啲同事唔係好鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 siu2 bou3 gou3, so2 ji5 di1 tung4 si6 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是打小报告，所以同事们不太喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always tattles, so his colleagues don't really like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔先會成日打小報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 sin1 wui5 seng4 jat6 daa2 siu2 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子才会总是打小报告。
examples.english_sentence: Only children always tattle.

english_meaning: To cut in line, to jump the queue
explanation_mandarin: 在排队时插到别人前面。
explanation_english: To move ahead of others in a queue; to cut in line or jump the queue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好打尖啊，後面仲有好多人排緊隊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 zim1 aa3, hau6 min6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 gan2 deoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要插队啊，后面还有很多人在排队呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cut in line. There are still many people queuing behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁冇禮貌，竟然喺我前面打尖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 mou5 lai5 maau6, ging2 jin4 hai2 ngo5 cin4 min6 daa2 zim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么没礼貌，竟然在我前面插队。
examples.english_sentence: He's so rude, he actually cut in front of me in line.

mandarin_meaning: 小便时颤抖; 打冷颤
english_meaning: To shiver while urinating; To have the pee shivers
explanation_mandarin: 指小便时身体产生不由自主的颤抖，通常是因为身体受凉或神经系统反应。
explanation_english: Refers to the involuntary shivers or trembling that occurs while urinating, often due to being cold or a nervous system response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 沖完涼出嚟咁凍，打咗個尿震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cung1 jyun4 loeng4 chut1 lai4 gam3 dung3, daa2 zo2 go3 niu6 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洗完澡出来这么冷，打了个尿颤。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold coming out of the shower, I got the pee shivers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日打尿震，大人就少啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou5 zai2 sing4 jat6 daa2 niu6 zan3, dai6 jan4 zau6 siu2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子总是小便时发抖，大人就少一些。
examples.english_sentence: Kids often get the pee shivers, adults get it less often.

english_meaning: To smash someone's head; to beat someone senseless
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为打破头。引申义为狠狠地打，打到头破血流。也指竞争激烈，争夺头破血流。
explanation_english: Literally means to smash someone's head. Figuratively, it means to beat someone severely, potentially causing head injuries. It can also be used to describe fierce competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚條仔喺酒吧度同人打交，差啲打崩頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 tiu4 zai2 hai2 jau5 baa1 dou6 tung4 jan4 daa2 gaau1, caa1 di1 daa2 bang1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚那小子在酒吧和人打架，差点打破头。
examples.english_sentence: Last night, that kid got into a fight in the bar and almost got his head smashed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗升職，佢哋兩個打崩頭都喺所不惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 sing1 zik1, keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 daa2 bang1 tau4 dou1 hai2 so2 bat1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了升职，他们两个打破头也在所不惜。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of promotion, the two of them are willing to fight tooth and nail.

english_meaning: to draft; to make a rough copy; to prepare a preliminary plan
explanation_mandarin: 在正式进行之前，先做一个初步的、非正式的准备或计划。
explanation_english: To make a rough draft or preliminary plan before the final version; to prepare a first version of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如打個巢先，睇下點樣present份嘢會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 daa2 go3 caau4 sin1, tai2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 present fun6 je5 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们先打个草稿，看看怎样展示这份东西会更好。
examples.english_sentence: Let's make a draft first to see how to present this thing better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告我打咗個巢，你睇下有咩要改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 daa2 zo2 go3 caau4, nei5 tai2 haa5 jau5 me1 jiu3 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告我打了个草稿，你看看有什么要改。
examples.english_sentence: I've made a draft of this report, take a look and see if there's anything to change.

english_meaning: to work (for someone else); to be employed; to do manual labor
explanation_mandarin: 为别人工作，获取工资。
explanation_english: To work for someone else and receive wages; to be employed. It often implies working in a less skilled or lower-paying job, although it can also refer to general employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力啲打工，先可以搵多啲錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1 daa2 gung1, sin1 ho2 ji5 wan2 do1 di1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力工作，才能赚更多的钱。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work harder to earn more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺餐廳打工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 caan1 teng1 daa2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在餐厅打工。
examples.english_sentence: He works in a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多後生仔都唔想打工，想自己創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hau6 sang1 zai2 dou1 m4 soeng2 daa2 gung1, soeng2 zi6 gei2 cong3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人都想要自己创业，不想打工。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people don't want to work for someone else; they want to start their own business.

english_meaning: employee, worker, wage earner
explanation_mandarin: 指靠出卖劳力获得工资的人，通常指普通员工，有时带有一些自嘲或贬义的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who earns a living by selling their labor for wages. It usually refers to ordinary employees and sometimes carries a sense of self-deprecation or negative connotation, implying a lack of power or control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲打工仔真係好難撈啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 daa2 gung1 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 lou1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在打工的人真是不好混啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's really difficult to make a living as an employee nowadays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係一個普通嘅打工仔，冇乜權力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 ge3 daa2 gung1 zai2, mou5 mat1 kyun4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是一个普通的打工者，没有什么权力。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just an ordinary employee, I don't have much power.

english_meaning: Employee Emperor, highly-paid salaried employee, very successful professional manager
explanation_mandarin: 形容打工仔（受雇人士）收入非常高，待遇优厚，或者在职场上非常成功。
explanation_english: Describes an employee who earns a very high salary and enjoys excellent benefits, or who is highly successful in their career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做ibank做得咁成功，真係打工皇帝嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 i1 beng1 zou6 dak1 gam3 sing4 gung1, zan1 hai6 daa2 gung1 wong4 dai3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在投资银行工作这么成功，真是打工皇帝啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so successful working in investment banking, he's a real Employee Emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢係打工皇帝，但係佢都好努力工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 daa2 gung1 wong4 dai3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他是打工皇帝，但是他也很努力工作。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's a highly-paid employee, he still works very hard.

english_meaning: foundation; to lay the groundwork; to line (the stomach); to wear as a base layer; to prepare
explanation_mandarin: 1. 用作基础，在上面继续添加。2. 吃一些东西为之后的大餐做准备，垫肚子。3. 穿衣服时作为内衬。
explanation_english: 1. To lay a foundation; to prepare the base for something that will be added on top. 2. To eat something light before a larger meal, often to avoid getting drunk quickly. 3. To wear something as a base layer, like a slip or undershirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚陣間飲醉，所以食啲嘢打底先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 zan6 gaan1 jam2 zeoi3, so2 ji5 sik6 di1 je5 daa2 dai2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕一会儿喝醉，所以先吃点东西垫垫底。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid I'll get drunk later, so I'll eat something to line my stomach first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有presentation，今日要打底準備定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 presentation, gam1 jat6 jiu3 daa2 dai2 zeon2 bei6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有演示，今天要做些基础准备。
examples.english_sentence: I have a presentation tomorrow, so I need to lay the groundwork and prepare today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣凍，著多件衫打底啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dung3, zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 daa2 dai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气冷，多穿一件衣服打底吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold, wear an extra layer of clothing as a base.

english_meaning: leggings; tights; underskirt
explanation_mandarin: 紧身裤，一般穿在裙子或短裤里面，起到保暖或防止走光的作用。
explanation_english: Leggings or tights, usually worn under skirts or shorts for warmth or to prevent exposure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日凍凍哋，著條打底褲穩陣啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dung3 dung3 dei2, zoek3 tiu4 daa2 dai2 fu3 wan2 zin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有点冷，穿条打底裤保险一点。
examples.english_sentence: It's a bit cold today, it's safer to wear leggings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著短裙襯打底褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 dyun2 kwan4 can3 daa2 dai2 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她经常穿短裙配打底裤。
examples.english_sentence: She often wears short skirts with leggings.

english_meaning: after, afterwards, later on
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个时间或事件之后。
explanation_english: Refers to the time or event that follows a particular time or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打後我冇時間啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 hau6 ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天之后我没时间了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have time after tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試打後，我哋去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 daa2 hau6, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试之后，我们去旅行吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go traveling after the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打後嘅日子，我會更加努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 hau6 ge3 jat6 zi2, ngo5 wui5 gang3 gaa1 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以后的日子，我会更加努力。
examples.english_sentence: In the days to come, I will work even harder.

english_meaning: able to fight; can fight; capable of fighting; tough
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很能打，身手好，擅长打斗。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is skilled in fighting, good at combat, or tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好打得㗎，你唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 daa2 dak1 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能打的，你最好不要惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very tough, you better not mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李小龍真係好打得，功夫好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 siu2 lung4 zan1 hai6 hou2 daa2 dak1, gung1 fu1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李小龙真的很能打，功夫很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Bruce Lee was really capable of fighting; his Kung Fu was amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個角色需要一個好打得嘅演員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 hou2 daa2 dak1 ge3 jin2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个角色需要一个很能打的演员。
examples.english_sentence: This role requires an actor who is good at fighting.

english_meaning: Needs more beating/Deserves to be beaten
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人做了错事或行为不端，应该受到惩罚，但惩罚力度不够，需要再打一顿才能让他/她长记性。 带有玩笑或责备的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone has done something wrong or behaved badly and deserves punishment, but the punishment was not severe enough; they need to be beaten again to learn their lesson. Often used in a joking or reproachful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁唔聽話，真係打得少!
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 m4 teng1 waa6, zan1 hai6 daa2 dak1 siu2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么不听话，真是欠揍！
examples.english_sentence: You're so disobedient, you really need more beating!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又偷嘢？ 打得少啫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 tau1 je5? daa2 dak1 siu2 ze1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又偷东西了？那是没挨够打！
examples.english_sentence: He stole again? He just needs more beating!

jyutping: daa2 dak1 gang3 do1 je6 jau6 coeng4
mandarin_meaning: 工作时间更长，工作更多
english_meaning: Work even harder and longer hours (lit. hitting/working even more, nights are even longer)
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作非常努力，花费大量时间和精力。强调比原本已经很多的工作量还要更多，时间更长。
explanation_english: Describes working extremely hard, spending a lot of time and energy. Emphasizes working even harder and for longer than one already does.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣打得更多夜又長，身體邊度頂得順呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 daa2 dak1 gang3 do1 je6 jau6 coeng4, san1 tai2 bin1 dou6 ding2 dak1 seon6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样工作时间更长，工作更多，身体怎么能承受得住呢？
examples.english_sentence: Working even harder and longer hours like this, how can your body handle it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從公司裁員之後，我哋個個都要打得更多夜又長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gung1 si1 caai4 jyun4 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 jiu3 daa2 dak1 gang3 do1 je6 jau6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司裁员之后，我们每个人都要工作更长的时间，做更多的工作。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company's layoffs, we all have to work even harder and longer hours.

mandarin_meaning: 如火如荼; 热火朝天; 非常亲密
english_meaning: Burning with passion; extremely intimate; passionately in love; in full swing; at its peak
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常亲密，感情炽热；或者形容事情进行得非常热烈。
explanation_english: Describes a relationship that is very intimate and passionate, or describes something that is happening very intensely and enthusiastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個最近打得火熱，成日都喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zeoi3 gan6 daa2 dak1 fo2 jit6, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个最近打得火热，整天都在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Those two have been burning with passion lately, they are always together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司搞緊個新項目，而家打得火熱，個個都好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gaau2 gan2 go3 san1 hong6 muk6, ji4 gaa1 daa2 dak1 fo2 jit6, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司正在进行一个新项目，现在进行得热火朝天，每个人都很忙。
examples.english_sentence: The company is working on a new project, and it's in full swing right now, everyone is very busy.

mandarin_meaning: 打通; 接通; 行得通; 有效
english_meaning: To get through (on the phone); to be able to make contact; to work out; to be feasible; to be effective
explanation_mandarin: 1. (打电话)可以成功接通。2. (计划、办法等)行得通，能够成功实现。3. (关系)能搭上线，可以联系到。
explanation_english: 1. (Regarding phone calls) to successfully get through. 2. (Regarding plans, methods, etc.) to work, to be feasible, to be able to be successfully implemented. 3. (Regarding relationships) to be able to connect, to be able to get in touch with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗成日電話都打唔通，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 seng4 jat6 din6 waa2 dou1 daa2 m4 tung1, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打了一整天的电话都打不通，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: I've been trying to call all day but I can't get through. I wonder what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法好似打唔通喎，不如諗下其他計仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hou2 ci5 daa2 m4 tung1 wo3, bat1 jyu4 lam2 haa5 kei4 taa1 gai3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法好像行不通，不如想想其他办法。
examples.english_sentence: This method doesn't seem to be working, why don't we think of other solutions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想搵佢，我幫你打通關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 wan2 keoi5, ngo5 bong1 nei5 daa2 tung1 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想找他，我帮你疏通关系。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to find him, I can help you make the right connections.

english_meaning: from; since; ever since
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或起点的介词，相当于“自从”或“从...开始”。
explanation_english: A preposition indicating a time or starting point, equivalent to "from" or "since".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打從細個開始，我就鍾意睇卡通片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 cung4 sai3 go3 hoi1 ci2, ngo5 zau6 zung1 ji3 tai2 kaa1 tung1 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从小就喜欢看卡通片。
examples.english_sentence: I've loved watching cartoons since I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打從佢走咗之後，我就冇再見過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 cung4 keoi5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 mou5 zoi3 gin3 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他走了之后，我就没再见过他。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't seen him since he left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打從我識得佢，佢都係咁勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 cung4 ngo5 sik1 dak1 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 hai6 gam3 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从我认识他，他一直都很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been so diligent since I've known him.

english_meaning: from the bottom of one's heart; sincerely; genuinely
explanation_mandarin: 表示发自内心，真心实意。
explanation_english: Expresses something that comes from the heart, genuinely and sincerely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打從心底多謝你嘅幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 cung4 sam1 dai2 do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从心底里感谢你的帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I sincerely thank you for your help from the bottom of my heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打從心底覺得佢係個好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 cung4 sam1 dai2 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hai6 go3 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从心底里觉得他是个好人。
examples.english_sentence: I genuinely feel that he is a good person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打從心底希望件事可以順利解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 cung4 sam1 dai2 hei1 mong6 gin6 si6 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从心底里希望事情可以顺利解决。
examples.english_sentence: He sincerely hopes that the matter can be resolved smoothly.

english_meaning: to hiccup
explanation_mandarin: 指人体因膈肌痉挛而发出的声音，即打嗝。
explanation_english: To hiccup; the involuntary spasm of the diaphragm causing a sudden intake of breath, often accompanied by a characteristic sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食得太快，搞到打思噎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 dak1 taai3 faai3, gaau2 dou3 daa2 si1 at1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃得太快，搞得我打嗝了。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too fast, causing me to hiccup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲啲水可能可以止打思噎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 di1 seoi2 ho2 nang4 ho2 ji5 zi2 daa2 si1 at1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝点水可能可以止住打嗝。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking some water might stop the hiccups.

english_meaning: to flirt; to tease each other amorously; playful banter
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之间以打闹、戏谑的方式表达爱意，带有调情、嬉闹的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a playful and teasing way that lovers express affection, often involving gentle mock fighting or banter. It implies flirtation and playfulness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日喺度打情罵俏，真係好sweet！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 daa2 cing4 maa6 ciu3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sweet!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个总是在那里打情骂俏，真得很甜蜜！
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always flirting with each other, it's so sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺公共場合打情罵俏啦，有人會覺得尷尬㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gung1 gung1 coeng4 hap6 daa2 cing4 maa6 ciu3 laa1, jau5 jan4 wui5 gok3 dak1 gaam3 gaai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在公共场合打情骂俏啦，会有人觉得尴尬的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flirt in public, some people will feel awkward.

english_meaning: To flirt; to banter amorously; playful bickering between lovers
explanation_mandarin: 指恋人之间或关系亲密的人之间，用互相打闹、戏弄的方式来表达爱意或亲密关系。
explanation_english: Refers to the playful and affectionate teasing and bickering between lovers or people with close relationships. It describes a way of expressing affection or closeness through playful fighting and teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺度打情駡俏，睇得出佢哋好恩愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 daa2 cing4 maa6 ciu3, tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 dei6 hou2 yan1 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是在那里打情骂俏，看得出他们很恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: They are always flirting and bickering playfully there. You can see they are very loving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁驚訝，佢哋只係打情駡俏啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 ging1 ngaa5, keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 daa2 cing4 maa6 ciu3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么惊讶，他们只是在打情骂俏而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so surprised, they are just flirting playfully.

english_meaning: to get along very well, to mingle and become one, to be very close and harmonious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间相处融洽，关系亲密，像融为一体一样。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people get along very well, have a close relationship, and seem to blend together as one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好快就同班同學打成一片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 faai3 zau6 tung4 baan1 tung4 hok6 daa2 sing4 jat1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很快就和班里的同学打成一片。
examples.english_sentence: They quickly mingled and got along well with the classmates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個團隊好團結，大家都打成一片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 tyun4 deoi2 hou2 tyun4 git3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 daa2 sing4 jat1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的团队很团结，大家相处都很融洽。
examples.english_sentence: Our team is very united, and everyone gets along very well.

english_meaning: to stand upright; to put upright; upright
explanation_mandarin: 使物体竖立起来；直立的。
explanation_english: To stand something upright; to put something in an upright position; upright, erect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打戙啲書呀，會跌嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 dung6 di1 syu1 aa3, wui5 dit3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把书竖着放，会掉下来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put the books upright, they will fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將塊牌打戙咗喺路邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 faai3 paai4 daa2 dung6 zo2 hai2 lou6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把牌子竖立在了路边。
examples.english_sentence: They put the sign upright on the roadside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 棟樓打戙咗之後，望落好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 lau4 daa2 dung6 zo2 zi1 hau6, mong6 lok6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼竖立起来之后，看起来很高。
examples.english_sentence: After the building was erected, it looks very tall.

english_meaning: to sneak into a performance without paying; to gatecrash
explanation_mandarin: 指不买票或以不正当方式进入戏院或其他表演场所观看演出。
explanation_english: Refers to entering a theatre or other performance venue without paying for a ticket or by using dishonest methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日同啲朋友仔一齊打戲釘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 zai2 jat1 cai4 daa2 hei3 ding1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常和朋友们一起逃票去看戏。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often sneaked into performances with my friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住打戲釘呀，捉到要罰錢㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 daa2 hei3 ding1 aa3, zuk1 dou2 jiu3 fat6 cin2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想逃票啊，被抓到要罚钱的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about sneaking in, you'll be fined if you're caught!

mandarin_meaning: 帮凶; 枪手; 托儿
english_meaning: thug; hired hand; shill; someone who promotes something aggressively or unfairly
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇或受指使，通过暴力或不正当手段帮助他人达到目的的人；也指在网络上或现实中，受雇或受指使，通过发表评论或行动来支持、宣传或攻击特定对象的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is hired or instructed to help others achieve their goals through violence or improper means. It also refers to someone who is hired or instructed to support, promote, or attack a specific object by posting comments or taking action online or in real life. Can also refer to a 'shill'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗班打手嚟搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 baan1 daa2 sau2 lai4 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了一帮打手来闹事。
examples.english_sentence: They hired a group of thugs to cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司請咗好多打手喺網上讚佢哋嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 daa2 sau2 hai2 mong5 soeng6 zaan3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司请了很多枪手在网上赞美他们的产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired many shills to praise their products online.

english_meaning: Fighting and killing; violent
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常暴力，充满打斗和杀戮的场面或行为。
explanation_english: Describes scenes or behaviors filled with violence, fighting, and killing. It often refers to movies, games, or real-life situations that involve a lot of bloodshed and conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲太多打打殺殺嘅場面，唔啱細路仔睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 taai3 do1 daa2 daa2 saat3 saat3 ge3 coeng4 min6, m4 ngaam1 sai3 lou6 zai2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影太多打打杀杀的场面，不适合小孩子看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has too many violent scenes, it's not suitable for children to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意睇啲打打殺殺嘅戲，覺得好血腥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tai2 di1 daa2 daa2 saat3 saat3 ge3 hei3, gok3 dak1 hou2 hyut3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢看那些打打杀杀的电影，觉得很血腥。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like watching violent movies, I find them very bloody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日打打殺殺，搞到成個社區都好唔安寧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 daa2 daa2 saat3 saat3, gaau2 dou3 seng4 go3 se5 kui1 dou1 hou2 m4 on1 ning4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天打打杀杀，搞得整个社区都不安宁。
examples.english_sentence: They are always fighting and killing, making the whole community uneasy.

english_meaning: to dress up; to adorn; to deck out; to make up; to style (hair)
explanation_mandarin: 指梳妆打扮，装饰自己。
explanation_english: To dress oneself attractively; to put on makeup; to style one's hair to improve one's appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日特登打扮得好靚去見男朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 dak6 dang1 daa2 bun6 dak1 hou2 leng3 heoi3 gin3 naam4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天特意打扮得很漂亮去见男朋友。
examples.english_sentence: She made a special effort to dress up nicely today to see her boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁打扮嘅，我哋只係去街市買餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 daa2 bun6 ge3, ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用这么打扮的，我们只是去菜市场买菜。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to dress up so much, we're just going to the market to buy groceries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打扮得好有型，成個明星咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bun6 dak1 hou2 jau5 jing4, seng4 go3 ming4 sing1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打扮得很时尚，像个明星一样。
examples.english_sentence: He dressed up very stylishly, like a celebrity.

english_meaning: to give a discount; to sell at a discount; discount
explanation_mandarin: 降低商品的价格出售，给予折扣。也指折扣本身。
explanation_english: To reduce the price of a product; to give a discount. Also refers to the discount itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲衫打折打得好犀利啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 saam1 daa2 zit3 daa2 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这些衣服打折打得很厉害啊。
examples.english_sentence: These clothes are on a really big discount now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望佢哋可以打折俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 daa2 zit3 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望他们可以给我打折。
examples.english_sentence: I hope they can give me a discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭成日都有打折㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 daa2 zit3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店经常都有打折的。
examples.english_sentence: This shop often has discounts.

english_meaning: to back down; to chicken out; to quit before finishing
explanation_mandarin: 指在事情进行到一半或接近完成时，因为困难或害怕而放弃或停止。
explanation_english: To back down or give up on something when it's halfway done or near completion, usually due to fear or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本嚟話要跑馬拉松㗎，點知練咗幾日就打折頭喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 lai4 waa6 jiu3 paau2 maa5 laai1 sung3 gaa3, dim2 zi1 lin6 zo2 gei2 jat6 zau6 daa2 zit3 tau4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来打算跑马拉松的，结果练了几天就打退堂鼓了。
examples.english_sentence: He originally said he would run a marathon, but he backed down after training for a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快打折頭呀，試多幾次先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 daa2 zit3 tau4 aa3, si3 do1 gei2 ci3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快打退堂鼓啊，多试几次吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't back down so quickly, try a few more times.

english_meaning: to freeload; to sponge; to scrounge
explanation_mandarin: 指不花钱或少花钱而得到好处，通常是免费享受别人的东西或服务。
explanation_english: To obtain something for free or at a reduced price, often by taking advantage of someone else's generosity. It usually refers to enjoying someone else's food, drink, or services without paying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打抽豐，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 cau1 fung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是蹭吃蹭喝的，真是令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always freeloading, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住打抽豐，自己都要付出下先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 daa2 cau1 fung1, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 haa5 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着占便宜，自己也要付出一些才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about freeloading, you have to contribute something yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我請客，唔使打抽豐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 cheng2 haak3, m4 sai2 daa2 cau1 fung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我请客，不用占便宜啦。
examples.english_sentence: I'm treating tonight, no need to freeload.

english_meaning: to act crazy; to act erratically; to act like a lunatic; to have a fit of madness
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为不正常，精神错乱，像突然发病一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone acting abnormally, mentally confused, or behaving as if having a sudden fit or seizure. It implies erratic, nonsensical, or irrational behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩呀？成日打抽風咁款嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 aa3? seng4 jat6 daa2 cau1 fung1 gam2 fun2 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在做什么？整天像发神经一样？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing? You're acting crazy all day long?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔知點解，成日打抽風，唔好理佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 dim2 gai2, seng4 jat6 daa2 cau1 fung1, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不知道为什么，整天抽风，别理他了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why, but he's been acting crazy all day today. Just ignore him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打抽風啦，嚇親人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 daa2 cau1 fung1 laa1, hak1 can1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么抽风啦，会吓到人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so crazy, you'll scare people.

english_meaning: to greet someone; to say hello; to acknowledge someone's presence
explanation_mandarin: 向人问候或表示注意，通常通过言语或手势。
explanation_english: To greet someone or acknowledge their presence, usually through words or gestures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺街撞到佢，但係佢冇同我打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 zong6 dou2 keoi5, daan6 hai6 keoi5 mou5 tung4 ngo5 daa2 ziu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上碰到他，但是他没有和我打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into him on the street yesterday, but he didn't greet me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到老闆要記得打招呼啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 lou5 baan2 jiu3 gei3 dak1 daa2 ziu1 fu1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 见到老板要记得打招呼啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to greet the boss when you see him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好怕醜，唔鍾意同人打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 paa3 cau2, m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 daa2 ziu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很害羞，不喜欢和人打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: He is very shy and doesn't like to greet people.

english_meaning: To practice martial arts; To do boxing; To do shadow boxing; To box
explanation_mandarin: 指进行拳击运动或练习武术套路。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in the sport of boxing or practicing martial arts routines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個開始就學打拳，而家好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 hoi1 chi2 zau6 hok6 daa2 kyun4, ji4 gaa1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学拳击，现在很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning boxing when he was young and is very good now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早去公園，好多人都會打拳或者耍太極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: chiu4 zou2 heoi3 gung1 jyun2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 daa2 kyun4 waak6 ze2 saa2 taai3 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上到公园，很多人都会打拳或者打太极。
examples.english_sentence: Many people practice martial arts or Tai Chi in the park in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企對住鏡打拳，練緊反應同速度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 deoi3 zyu6 geng3 daa2 kyun4, lin6 gan2 faan2 jing3 tung4 suk1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里对着镜子打拳，练习反应和速度。
examples.english_sentence: He's practicing shadow boxing in front of the mirror at home, training his reflexes and speed.

english_meaning: to strive, to work hard, to struggle, to hustle
explanation_mandarin: 努力工作或生活，以求取得成功或改善现状。
explanation_english: To work hard or struggle to achieve success or improve one's current situation. It emphasizes the effort and determination involved in pursuing goals, often in challenging circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣就嚟香港打拼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 zau6 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 daa2 ping3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就来香港打拼。
examples.english_sentence: He came to Hong Kong to work hard when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗屋企，佢日日都好努力打拼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 uk1 kei2, keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 daa2 ping3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了家庭，他每天都很努力奋斗。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of his family, he works hard every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個競爭激烈嘅社會，一定要打拼先至可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 ging6 zang1 gik1 lit6 ge3 se5 wui2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 ping3 sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个竞争激烈的社会，一定要努力奋斗才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: In this competitive society, you must strive hard to succeed.

english_meaning: to stand (something) upright; to put (something) vertically; to right (something)
explanation_mandarin: 把本来横放的东西竖起来，或使倾倒的东西恢复竖直状态。
explanation_english: To stand something upright; to put something in a vertical position; to right something that has fallen over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我將個招牌打掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 go3 ziu1 paai4 daa2 dim3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我把那个招牌竖起来。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me stand the sign upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗落地，我即刻扶佢打掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6, ngo5 zik1 hak1 fu4 keoi5 daa2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒在地，我立刻扶他站起来。
examples.english_sentence: He fell on the ground, and I immediately helped him stand up.

english_meaning: to clean; to sweep
explanation_mandarin: 清理灰尘、垃圾等，使干净。
explanation_english: To clean a place by sweeping, dusting, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要打掃屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 daa2 sou3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天需要打扫家里。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clean the house today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我打掃間房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 daa2 sou3 gaan1 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我打扫房间。
examples.english_sentence: Mom told me to clean my room.

english_meaning: to applaud; to clap
explanation_mandarin: 拍手表示赞同或高兴。
explanation_english: To clap one's hands to show approval or appreciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表演好精彩，觀眾不停咁打掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 hou2 jing1 cai2, gun1 zung3 bat1 ting4 gam2 daa2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演很精彩，观众不停地鼓掌。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was excellent, and the audience kept applauding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢嘅演講，大家都忍唔住打掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 yun4 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2, daai6 ga1 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 daa2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他的演讲，大家都忍不住鼓掌。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to his speech, everyone couldn't help but applaud.

english_meaning: to inquire, to scout around, to investigate
explanation_mandarin: 探听消息；打听情况。
explanation_english: To inquire about something; to gather information by asking around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住打探下佢嘅口風先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nim2 zyu6 daa2 taam3 haa5 keoi5 ge3 hau2 fung1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想先打听一下他的口风。
examples.english_sentence: I want to sound him out first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打探到咩消息呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 taam3 dou3 me1 siu1 sik1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打听到什么消息了吗？
examples.english_sentence: What news have you found out?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好周圍打探人哋嘅私事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 daa2 taam3 yan4 dei6 ge3 si1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要到处打听别人的私事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go around prying into other people's private affairs.

english_meaning: to disturb; to trouble; to bother; excuse me (for disturbing you)
explanation_mandarin: 表示对对方的打扰，通常用于请求帮忙或打断对方时，表示礼貌和歉意。
explanation_english: An expression used to politely apologize for disturbing someone, usually when asking for help or interrupting them. It conveys politeness and regret for the inconvenience caused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打搞曬你咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 gaau2 saai3 nei5 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你这么久。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for bothering you for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打搞你問一問，想問吓點樣去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 gaau2 nei5 man6 jat1 man6, soeng2 man6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打扰一下，想问一下怎么去机场。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me for bothering you, I want to ask how to get to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打搞你一陣，幫我睇住啲嘢得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 gaau2 nei5 jat1 zan6, bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 di1 je5 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你一下，帮我看一下东西行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, can you watch my stuff for a moment?

english_meaning: Sorry for bothering you; Thank you for your trouble
explanation_mandarin: 表示打扰别人后的客套话，或者别人帮助了你之后表示感谢，同时带有歉意。
explanation_english: A polite expression used after bothering someone, or to thank someone for their help while also expressing apology for the trouble caused. It's often used when you feel you've inconvenienced someone or taken up their time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打搞晒你咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 gaau2 saai3 nei5 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你这么久。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry for bothering you for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係打搞晒，多謝你幫我搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 daa2 gaau2 saai3, do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真是麻烦了，谢谢你帮我搬家。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really sorry for bothering you today, thank you for helping me move house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使客氣，唔係好大件事，打搞晒至真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, m4 hai6 hou2 daai6 gin6 si2, daa2 gaau2 saai3 zi3 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用客气，不是什么大事，真正麻烦的是你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mention it, it's nothing much. Actually, you're the one who's been bothered.

english_meaning: to salvage; to dredge; to recover (from water)
explanation_mandarin: 从水里捞取，或从其他地方搜寻出来。
explanation_english: To retrieve or recover something from water; to salvage or dredge up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派咗隊潛水員去打撈沉咗嘅船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 zo2 deoi2 cim4 seoi2 jyun4 heoi3 daa2 lou1 cam4 zo2 ge3 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派了一队潜水员去打捞沉没的船。
examples.english_sentence: They sent a team of divers to salvage the sunken ship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾日嘅搜索，警方終於喺海入面打撈到失蹤人士嘅遺體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 jat6 ge3 sau1 sok3, ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 hai2 hoi2 jap6 min6 daa2 lou1 dou3 sat1 zung1 jan4 si6 ge3 wai4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几天搜索，警方终于在海里打捞到失踪人士的遗体。
examples.english_sentence: After several days of searching, the police finally recovered the missing person's body from the sea.

english_meaning: to hold a boxing match on a raised platform; to compete (esp. fiercely)
explanation_mandarin: 原指在擂台上进行比武竞赛。现在也指在各个领域里的竞争。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a martial arts contest on a raised platform. Now it also refers to competition in various fields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司為咗爭奪市場佔有率，打擂台打得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 zaang1 duk6 si5 coeng4 zim3 jau5 leot2, daa2 leoi4 toi2 daa2 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司为了争夺市场占有率，竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies are competing fiercely to gain market share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅歌唱比賽，個個都想打擂台，攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 go1 coeng3 bei2 coi3, go3 go3 dou1 soeng2 daa2 leoi4 toi2, lo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的歌唱比赛，每个人都想竞争，获得冠军。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone wants to compete and win the championship in this year's singing competition.

english_meaning: to hold a martial arts competition; to challenge; to compete; to contend
explanation_mandarin: 原指设立擂台比武，引申为公开竞争、挑战。
explanation_english: Originally refers to setting up a platform for martial arts competitions. By extension, it means to compete or challenge openly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗呢個職位打擂臺，睇下邊個叻啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 daa2 leoi4 toi4, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 lek1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了这个职位竞争，看看谁更厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are competing for this position to see who is better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆嘅歌唱比賽，競爭好激烈，好似打擂臺咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gaai3 ge3 go1 coeng3 bei2 coi3, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6, hou2 ci5 daa2 leoi4 toi4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这届的歌唱比赛，竞争很激烈，好像比武一样。
examples.english_sentence: The competition in this year's singing contest is very fierce, like a martial arts competition.

english_meaning: to strike; to hit; to attack; to crack down on; blow; setback
explanation_mandarin: 动词：撞击，打击。名词：挫折，打击。
explanation_english: Verb: to strike, hit, attack, crack down on. Noun: blow, setback, a negative experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受到好大嘅打擊，意志都消沉晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 dou3 hou2 daai6 ge3 daa2 gik1, ji3 chi3 dou1 siu1 cham4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受到了很大的打击，意志都消沉了。
examples.english_sentence: He suffered a big blow, and his will was completely sapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方要大力打擊罪案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 jiu3 daai6 lik6 daa2 gik1 zeoi6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方要大力打击犯罪。
examples.english_sentence: The police must vigorously crack down on crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市嘅下跌對投資者係一個重大打擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 ge3 haa6 dip3 deoi3 tau4 zi1 je5 hai6 jat1 go3 zhung6 daai6 daa2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市的下跌对投资者是一个重大打击。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crash was a major blow to investors.

english_meaning: to disturb; to bother; to trouble
explanation_mandarin: 表示妨碍别人或干扰别人做事。通常用于请求别人允许做某事，或表示歉意。
explanation_english: To disturb someone, to bother someone, or to interrupt someone's activities. It's often used to ask for permission to do something, or to express apology for interrupting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打擾晒你哋傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 jiu2 saai3 nei5 dei6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你们聊天了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry to have disturbed your conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打擾你一陣，我想問下路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 jiu2 nei5 jat1 zan6, ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你一下，我想问一下路。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, to bother you for a moment, I'd like to ask for directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望冇打擾到你休息啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 mou5 daa2 jiu2 dou3 nei5 jau1 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望没有打扰到你休息吧。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I didn't disturb your rest.

english_meaning: to disturb, to trouble, excuse me (when interrupting)
explanation_mandarin: 打扰，干扰别人。也用作礼貌用语，表示打断或麻烦了别人。
explanation_english: To disturb or bother someone. It is also used as a polite expression when interrupting or troubling someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打攪你一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 gaau2 nei5 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打扰你一下。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I'll just bother you for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對唔住，打攪你咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 m4 zyu6, daa2 gaau2 nei5 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对不起，打扰你这么久。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for troubling you for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想打攪佢溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 daa2 gaau2 keoi5 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想打扰他温习功课。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to disturb him while he is studying.

english_meaning: Sorry to have bothered you; Thanks for your trouble
explanation_mandarin: 表示感谢或道歉，感谢对方给予帮助或道歉打扰了对方。
explanation_english: A phrase used to express gratitude or apology, thanking someone for their help or apologizing for the inconvenience caused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係打攪晒你喇，唔該晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 daa2 gaau2 saai3 nei5 laa3, m4 goi1 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的打扰你了，非常感谢！
examples.english_sentence: I'm really sorry to have bothered you this time, thanks a lot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，咁晏先嚟搵你，打攪晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, gam3 aan3 sin1 lai4 wan2 nei5, daa2 gaau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这么晚才来找你，打扰了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for coming to you so late, sorry to have bothered you.

english_meaning: to save, to rescue, to help (someone in need)
explanation_mandarin: 拯救；救助。多指从困境中解救。
explanation_english: To save or rescue someone, usually from a difficult or dangerous situation. Implies providing help in times of need or distress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人呃咗好多錢，好彩有朋友打救佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, hou2 coi2 jau5 pang4 jau5 daa2 gau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了很多钱，幸好有朋友救助他。
examples.english_sentence: He was scammed out of a lot of money, luckily a friend rescued him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔努力，無人打救到你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 nou5 lik6, mou5 jan4 daa2 gau3 dou3 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不努力，没有人能救得了你啦。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work harder, no one can save you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望有奇蹟打救香港嘅經濟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 jau5 kei4 jik1 daa2 gau3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望有奇迹拯救香港的经济。
examples.english_sentence: Hoping that a miracle can save Hong Kong's economy.

english_meaning: to defeat, to beat, to be defeated
explanation_mandarin: 击败，战胜。
explanation_english: To defeat, to beat, to overcome an opponent or obstacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入邊打敗咗所有嘅對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 bin1 daa2 baai6 zo2 so2 jau5 ge3 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中打败了所有的对手。
examples.english_sentence: He defeated all his opponents in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要打敗呢個難關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 baai6 ni1 go3 naan4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要打败这个难关。
examples.english_sentence: We must overcome this difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅團隊最終打敗咗強勁嘅對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 tyun4 deoi2 zeoi3 chung1 daa2 baai6 zo2 koeng4 ging6 ge3 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的团队最终打败了强大的对手。
examples.english_sentence: Our team eventually defeated the strong opponent.

english_meaning: to lose a battle; to suffer a defeat; to fail
explanation_mandarin: 原指在战场上战败，引申为在任何竞争、比赛或任务中失败。
explanation_english: Originally referring to losing a battle in war, it is extended to mean failing in any competition, game, or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我打咗場大敗仗呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 daa2 zo2 coeng4 daai6 baai6 zoeng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考得很差！
examples.english_sentence: I failed terribly in this exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅新產品推出市場打咗敗仗，完全冇人買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 caan2 ban2 tui1 ceot1 si5 coeng4 daa2 zo2 baai6 zoeng3, wun4 cyun4 mou5 jan4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的新产品推向市场失败了，完全没人买。
examples.english_sentence: This company's new product launch was a failure; nobody bought it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先場波，我哋隊打咗敗仗，輸咗俾人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 coeng4 bo1, ngo5 dei6 deoi2 daa2 zo2 baai6 zoeng3, syu1 zo2 bei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那场球赛，我们的队伍输了。
examples.english_sentence: In the game just now, our team lost.

mandarin_meaning: 打乱; 解散; 打发
english_meaning: to break up; to scatter; to dismiss; to break into pieces; to distribute; to shuffle (cards)
explanation_mandarin: 將聚集在一起的事物分散開來; 解僱; 將事物分開分發。
explanation_english: To break up something that is gathered together; to scatter or disperse; to dismiss (employees); to break something into smaller pieces or distribute it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir叫我哋打散啲企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 daa2 saan3 di1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师叫我们站开一点。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher told us to spread out a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公司執笠，所有員工都俾人打散咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1, so2 jau5 wun4 gung1 dou1 bei2 jan4 daa2 saan3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司倒闭了，所有的员工都被解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: His company went bankrupt, and all the employees were dismissed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你將啲牌打散佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 zoeng1 di1 paai2 daa2 saan3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你把这些牌洗一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let me shuffle the cards for you.

english_meaning: to work odd jobs; to do casual labour; to freelance
explanation_mandarin: 指从事没有固定工作，以临时性质的工作为生。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in temporary or casual work without a fixed job. It implies working odd jobs to earn a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近冇嘢做，淨係可以打散工搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 mou5 je5 zou6, zing6 hai6 ho2 ji5 daa2 saan2 gung1 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近没有工作，只能打零工谋生。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have a job lately, so he can only do odd jobs to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好多人都逼住要打散工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 bik1 zyu6 jiu3 daa2 saan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多人都被迫要打零工。
examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't good right now, and many people are forced to do odd jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書嗰陣時，成日都會打散工幫補家計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 gwo2 zan6 si4, seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 daa2 saan2 gung1 bong1 bou2 gaa1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读书的时候，经常会打零工补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: When he was studying, he often did odd jobs to supplement the family income.

english_meaning: to calculate; to plan; to have an idea or plan; to count on
explanation_mandarin: （1）原指用算盘计算。 （2）引申为打算，计划，主意。也指把某人某事纳入考虑范围，对其抱有期望。
explanation_english: (1) Originally referred to calculating using an abacus. (2) By extension, it means to plan, to have an idea, or to take someone or something into consideration; to count on something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打數點樣做呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 sou3 dim2 joeng2 zou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算怎么做啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are your plans? / How do you plan to do it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打數遲啲移民去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 sou3 ci4 di1 ji4 man4 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算晚点移民去加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to immigrate to Canada later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔敢打數佢會幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gam2 daa2 sou3 keoi5 wui5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不敢指望他会帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I don't dare to count on him to help.

english_meaning: slanting; sloping; diagonal
explanation_mandarin: 表示倾斜的状态或方向。
explanation_english: Describes a state or direction that is slanted or sloping; diagonal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幅畫掛到打斜曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 waa2 gwaa3 dou3 daa2 ce4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画挂得倾斜了。
examples.english_sentence: The painting is hanging slanted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個招牌打斜咁擺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 ziu1 paai3 daa2 ce4 gam2 baai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把招牌斜着放。
examples.english_sentence: He placed the signboard diagonally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨嗰陣，啲雨打斜咁落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 go2 zan6, di1 jyu5 daa2 ce4 gam2 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨的时候，雨是斜着下的。
examples.english_sentence: When it rains, the rain falls diagonally.

english_meaning: to skim money from a transaction; to pad an expense account; to take a cut; to overcharge; to fiddle the books
explanation_mandarin: 指在经手金钱时从中克扣，多用于形容不正当的行为。通常指收取或挪用不属于自己的钱财，例如在报销费用时虚报金额，或者在交易中私自截留一部分款项。
explanation_english: To skim money from a transaction, often by overcharging or falsely reporting expenses. It implies dishonesty and the act of taking money that doesn't rightfully belong to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫公司買嘢都打斧頭，遲早俾人發現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bong1 gung1 si1 maai5 je5 dou1 daa2 fu2 tau4, chi4 zou2 bei2 jan4 faat3 yin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常帮公司买东西都从中克扣，迟早会被人发现的。
examples.english_sentence: He always skims money from the company when he buys things. Sooner or later, he'll get caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住打斧頭呀，今次我會睇實啲數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 daa2 fu2 tau4 aa3, gam1 chi3 ngo5 wui5 tai2 sat6 di1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想从中克扣了，这次我会仔细核对账目。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about skimming money this time; I'll be checking the numbers carefully.

english_meaning: to interrupt; to break off
explanation_mandarin: 指打断别人的说话或行为，使其停止。
explanation_english: To interrupt someone's speech or action, causing it to stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以唔好成日打斷人講嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 daa2 dyun3 jan4 gong2 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以不要总是打断别人说话啊？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please not always interrupt people?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，打斷你一打，我想問下路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, daa2 dyun3 nei5 jat1 daa2, ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，打断一下，我想问一下路。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me for interrupting, I want to ask for directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到興起，點知電話突然打斷咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 hing3 hei2, dim2 zi1 din6 waa2 dat6 jin4 daa2 dyun3 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲得正起劲，没想到电话突然打断了他。
examples.english_sentence: He was getting into his story when the phone suddenly interrupted him.

english_meaning: To doze off, to nod off, to take a nap (while sitting)
explanation_mandarin: 指坐着的时候打瞌睡，头一点一点的。
explanation_english: Refers to dozing off while sitting, with the head nodding intermittently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺車上面打昂，唔知幾時到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ce1 soeng6 min6 daa2 ngong4, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在车上打瞌睡，不知道什么时候到的。
examples.english_sentence: I dozed off in the car and didn't realize when we arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上堂打昂，俾老師鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 tong4 daa2 ngong4, bei2 lou5 si1 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上课打瞌睡，被老师骂了。
examples.english_sentence: He dozed off in class and got scolded by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，好多人都會忍唔住打昂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 jan2 m4 zyu6 daa2 ngong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，很多人都会忍不住打瞌睡。
examples.english_sentence: During meetings, many people can't help but doze off.

english_meaning: to sleep on one's back
explanation_mandarin: 指仰面朝上睡觉。形容睡觉的姿势。
explanation_english: Refers to sleeping on one's back, facing upwards. Describes a sleeping posture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打昂瞓，好似好舒服咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 ngong5 fan3, hou2 ci5 hou2 syu1 fuk6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是仰面睡，好像很舒服的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He always sleeps on his back, it looks very comfortable.

english_meaning: to signal secretly; to use a secret code; to give a coded message
explanation_mandarin: 指使用只有少数人知道的符号、动作或语言来传递信息，以便其他人不理解。
explanation_english: To use a secret code, sign, or signal to communicate information covertly, so that others cannot understand the message.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要打暗號，唔可以俾其他人知道我哋嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daa2 am3 hou6, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 gei2 taa1 jan4 zi1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要打暗号，不可以让其他人知道我们的计划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to use a secret code so that others can't find out about our plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用眼神打暗號，睇嚟有啲嘢瞞住我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 ngaan5 san4 daa2 am3 hou6, tai2 lai4 yau5 di1 ye5 mun6 zyu6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用眼神打暗号，看来有些事情瞒着我们。
examples.english_sentence: They're signaling to each other with their eyes, it seems like they're hiding something from us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班示威者互相打暗號，部署下一步行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 si6 wai1 ze2 wu6 soeng1 daa2 am3 hou6, bo6 seoi2 haa6 jat1 bou6 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些示威者互相打暗号，部署下一步行动。
examples.english_sentence: The protesters were signalling to each other to plan the next move.

english_meaning: to strike the hours (traditionally by night watchmen); night watch
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指夜间巡逻的人，敲打梆子或锣鼓报时。也指这种行为。
explanation_english: In the past, it referred to the night watchman who patrolled at night, striking a clapper or gong to announce the time. It also refers to this act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅更夫就係靠打更嚟提醒大家時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 gaang1 fu1 zau6 hai6 kaau3 daa2 gaang1 lai4 tai4 sing2 daai6 gaa1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的更夫就是靠打更来提醒大家时间。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, night watchmen relied on striking the hours to remind everyone of the time.

english_meaning: To browse books without buying; to look at books for free; to mooch off a bookstore.
explanation_mandarin: 在书店里长时间阅读书籍但不购买的行为。通常指长时间站着或坐在书店里免费阅读。
explanation_english: The act of reading books in a bookstore for an extended period of time without buying them. It often implies standing or sitting in the bookstore reading for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去樓上書店打書釘，慳返唔少買書錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 lau4 soeng6 syu1 dim3 daa2 syu1 ding1, haan1 faan1 m4 siu2 maai5 syu1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去楼上的书店蹭书看，省了不少买书的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the upstairs bookstore to browse books for free, saving a lot of money on buying books.
