examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁耐喺度打書釘啦，買本支持下人哋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 noi6 hai2 dou6 daa2 syu1 ding1 laa1, maai5 bun2 zi1 chi4 haa5 jan4 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里看书太久了，买一本支持一下人家吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't browse books here for so long, buy one to support them.

english_meaning: To work part-time; to moonlight; to do casual labour
explanation_mandarin: 指从事非正式的，临时的或兼职的工作，通常是为了赚取额外收入。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in informal, temporary, or part-time work, usually to earn extra income. It often implies taking on a second job or doing casual labour on top of a regular job or other commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份正職唔夠洗，唯有打月搵多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 zing3 zik1 m4 gau3 sai2, wai4 jau5 daa2 jyut6 wan2 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的正职不够开销，只好做兼职多赚些钱。
examples.english_sentence: His full-time job isn't enough to cover expenses, so he has to work part-time to earn more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近經濟唔好，好多人都打月幫補家計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 daa2 jyut6 bong1 bou2 gaa1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，很多人都做兼职补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: Recently the economy hasn't been good, many people are working part-time to support their families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放工之後，仲會打月做Uber司機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, zung6 wui5 daa2 jyut6 zou6 Uber si1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下班之后，还会做兼职开Uber。
examples.english_sentence: After work, he also moonlights as an Uber driver.

english_meaning: to provide capital; to give seed money; to finance
explanation_mandarin: 提供资金，作为启动资金或营运资金。
explanation_english: To provide capital, usually as seed money or working capital for a business or venture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爸打本俾我開間餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 baa1 daa2 bun2 bei2 ngo5 hoi1 gaan1 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸给我提供资金开一家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: My father gave me seed money to open a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想創業，但係冇人打本俾佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 cong3 jip6, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 daa2 bun2 bei2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想创业，但是没有人给他们提供资金。
examples.english_sentence: They want to start a business, but nobody is giving them capital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有咁多錢，不如打本俾啲有需要嘅人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 gam3 do1 cin2, bat1 jyu4 daa2 bun2 bei2 di1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有这么多钱，不如给一些需要帮助的人提供资金吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you have so much money, why not give seed money to those in need?

english_meaning: To start work; To clap the clapperboard (film production); To start; To begin.
explanation_mandarin: （1）开始工作，上班。（2）在电影或视频制作中，指使用场记板并发出声音，标志着拍摄开始，也指拍摄开始。
explanation_english: (1) To start work, to go to work. (2) In film or video production, it refers to using a clapperboard and making a sound to mark the start of filming; it also refers to the start of filming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要早啲起身打板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 di1 hei2 san1 daa2 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要早点起床上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to get up early and go to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演話三點打板，大家準備好未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou6 jin2 waa6 saam1 dim2 daa2 baan2, daai6 gaa1 zyun2 bei6 hou2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 导演说三点开始拍摄，大家准备好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: The director said we start filming at 3 o'clock, is everyone ready?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳新開張，今日第一日打板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 san1 hoi1 zoeng1, gam1 jat6 dai6 jat1 jat6 daa2 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅新开张，今天第一天开工。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is newly opened, today is the first day of business.

english_meaning: to fight, to brawl
explanation_mandarin: 指用拳脚等进行搏斗。
explanation_english: To engage in a physical fight, typically involving punches, kicks, and other forms of physical combat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日打架，好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 daa2 gaa3, hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是打架，很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: They are always fighting; it's really troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同人哋打架呀，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 dei6 daa2 gaa3 aa3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要和别人打架啊，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fight with others, it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我哋成日為咗啲小事打架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau2, ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 wai4 zo2 di1 siu2 si6 daa2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我们常常为了小事打架。
examples.english_sentence: When we were kids, we often fought over trivial matters.

english_meaning: To finish work; to clock off; to knock off
explanation_mandarin: 指结束一天的工作，下班。也指结束某项活动或任务。
explanation_english: Refers to finishing work for the day, clocking off. It can also mean to finish a particular activity or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，阿明，你今日幾點打柴啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, aa3 ming4, nei5 gam1 jat6 gei2 dim2 daa2 caai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，阿明，你今天几点下班啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, Ming, what time do you knock off today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂埋呢份文件，我哋就可以打柴喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 maai4 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2, ngo5 dei6 zau6 ho2 ji5 daa2 caai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 处理完这份文件，我们就可以下班了。
examples.english_sentence: Once we finish this document, we can knock off.

english_meaning: to pixelate, to censor (with mosaic-like blocks)
explanation_mandarin: 指在视频或图片上使用马赛克遮盖敏感或不适宜显示的部分。
explanation_english: To pixelate or censor a part of an image or video by covering it with small squares (like mosaic tiles). Used to hide sensitive or inappropriate content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目嘅敏感畫面全部都打晒格仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ge3 man5 gam2 waa2 min6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 daa2 saai3 gaak3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目的敏感画面全部都打了马赛克。
examples.english_sentence: All the sensitive scenes in this show have been pixelated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想畀人認出，所以幫自己張相打咗格仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 jing6 ceot1, so2 ji5 bong1 zi6 gei2 zoeng1 soeng2 daa2 zo2 gaak3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想被人认出来，所以把自己的照片打了马赛克。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to be recognized, so he pixelated his photo.

english_meaning: to prick, to poke, to feel a prickling sensation, to be bothered (by something small, like a small sharp object or a trivial matter)
explanation_mandarin: 指被细小尖锐的物体扎到或者感到不舒服。也指因小事而感到烦恼。
explanation_english: Refers to being pricked by a small, sharp object or feeling uncomfortable. It can also refer to being bothered by a trivial matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張凳有粒釘打棘親我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 dang3 jau5 lap1 ding1 daa2 kik1 cin1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 凳子上有颗钉子扎到我了。
examples.english_sentence: There was a nail on the chair that pricked me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙嘅標籤打棘住我，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 ge3 biu1签籤 daa2 kik1 zyu6 ngo5, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裙子的标签扎着我，很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The label on the dress is poking me, it's very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好小器，少少嘢都打棘親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 hei3, siu2 siu2 je5 dou1 daa2 kik1 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很小气，一点点小事都让他觉得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He's very petty, the smallest thing bothers him.

english_meaning: to shiver; to tremble; to shake
explanation_mandarin: 因为寒冷、害怕、激动等原因而身体颤抖。
explanation_english: To shiver, tremble, or shake due to cold, fear, excitement, or other causes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍到我打棟呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dou3 ngo5 daa2 dung6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我冷得直发抖！
examples.english_sentence: I'm shivering from the cold!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到打棟，連聲都唔敢出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 dou3 daa2 dung6, lin4 seng1 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕得直发抖，连声音都不敢发出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he was trembling, and he didn't even dare to make a sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完恐怖片，佢嚇到打棟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 hung2 bou3 pin2, keoi5 haak3 dou3 daa2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完恐怖片，他吓得直发抖。
examples.english_sentence: After watching the horror movie, he was so scared that he was shivering.

english_meaning: to drive piles (into the ground); to lay a foundation; (slang) pre-marital sex
explanation_mandarin: 原指建筑工程中打地基，将桩打入地下以稳固建筑物。也可用作俚语，指婚前性行为。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to driving piles into the ground in construction engineering to stabilize the building foundation. As slang, it refers to pre-marital sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓之前一定要打樁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau4 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盖楼之前一定要打地基。
examples.english_sentence: You must lay a foundation before building a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋未結婚就打咗樁喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mei6 git3 fan1 zau6 daa2 zo2 zong1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们还没结婚就发生性关系了。
examples.english_sentence: They had pre-marital sex before getting married.

english_meaning: pile driver, pile-driving machine
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于将桩打入地面的机械设备。
explanation_english: A machine used to drive piles into the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地盤度部打樁機好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 pun2 dou6 bou6 daa2 zong1 gei1 hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地里的那台打桩机很吵。
examples.english_sentence: That pile driver on the construction site is very noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓要用打樁機打地基。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau2 jiu3 yung6 daa2 zong1 gei1 daa2 dei6 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 建楼要用打桩机打地基。
examples.english_sentence: A pile driver is used to lay the foundations when building a building.

mandarin_meaning: 反着说; 不讲理; 横着来
english_meaning: To speak unreasonably; to be deliberately obstinate; to be perverse; to say the opposite of what is expected or reasonable; to go against the grain
explanation_mandarin: 指说话不讲道理，故意和别人对着干，不顺着别人意思说。 通常指人故意唱反调，不讲理，蛮横。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking unreasonably, deliberately opposing others, and not following their intentions. It usually means that someone is deliberately contradicting, being unreasonable, and acting stubbornly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打橫嚟講啦，明明係你錯，仲要賴人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2 laa1, ming4 ming4 hai6 nei5 co3, zung6 jiu3 laai6 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么不讲理，明明是你错了，还要赖别人！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unreasonable. It's clearly your fault, and you're still blaming others!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥成日都打橫嚟講，真係好難同佢溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 tung4 keoi5 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥总是反着说，真是很难和他沟通。
examples.english_sentence: My brother always says the opposite of what you expect, it's really hard to communicate with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢拗啦，佢打橫嚟講㗎，講嚟都嘥氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 aau3 laa1, keoi5 daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2 gaa3, gong2 lai4 dou1 saai1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别和他争辩了，他就是不讲理，说了也白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue with him. He's being deliberately obstinate. It's a waste of breath to talk to him.

synonyms: 扭橫折曲 (nau2 waang4 zit3 kuk1)

english_meaning: to play video games, to game
explanation_mandarin: 指玩电子游戏，通常是指使用游戏机或电脑进行的游戏。
explanation_english: Refers to playing video games, usually games played on consoles or computers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日放學返屋企就打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 fong3 hok6 faan1 uk1 kei2 zau6 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我常常放学回家就玩游戏。
examples.english_sentence: I often play video games as soon as I get home from school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機打到唔瞓覺，真係好沉迷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 m4 fan3 gaau3, zan1 hai6 hou2 cam4 mai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他玩游戏玩到不睡觉，真是太沉迷了。
examples.english_sentence: He plays video games until he doesn't sleep, he's really addicted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋一齊打機啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 daa2 gei1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们一起玩游戏吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's play video games together tonight!

english_meaning: horizontally, sideways, across
explanation_mandarin: 表示方向或状态，指横向的、与纵向垂直的。也指采取强硬或不讲理的态度。
explanation_english: Describes a direction or state, referring to something that is horizontal or perpendicular to the vertical direction. Can also refer to adopting a stubborn or unreasonable attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱打橫擺喺度，好阻掟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi4 daa2 waang4 baai2 hai2 dou6, hou2 zo2 deng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子横着放在那里，很碍事。
examples.english_sentence: The table is placed horizontally there, it's very obstructive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發爛渣，打橫嚟講，我都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 laan6 zaa1, daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他耍无赖，不讲理，我都不知道怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: He's acting like a rogue, being unreasonable, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將架車打橫泊喺路邊，好容易俾人抄牌架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 gaa3 ce1 daa2 waang4 paak3 hai2 lou6 bin1, hou2 jung4 yi6 bei2 jan4 caau1 paai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把车横着停在路边，很容易被人开罚单的。
examples.english_sentence: Parking the car horizontally on the roadside makes it very easy to get a ticket.

english_meaning: To be unreasonable, to act high-handedly, to go against the grain deliberately, to act in a bossy or overbearing manner.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人行事蛮横，不顾及他人感受，强行按照自己的意愿来。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts unreasonably, disregarding others' feelings and forcefully acting according to their own will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打橫嚟啦，大家傾下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daa2 waang4 lai4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 king1 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么蛮横，大家商量一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unreasonable, let's discuss it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都打橫嚟，根本唔理人哋點諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 daa2 waang4 lai4, gan1 bun2 m4 lei5 jan4 dei6 dim2 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都横着来，根本不理会别人怎么想。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts high-handedly and doesn't care about what others think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打橫嚟，件事要慢慢解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 waang4 lai4, gin6 si6 jiu3 maan6 maan6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要蛮横，这件事要慢慢解决。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be unreasonable, this matter needs to be resolved slowly.

english_meaning: To speak unreasonably; to talk in a domineering or high-handed manner; to talk without rhyme or reason
explanation_mandarin: 指说话态度蛮横不讲道理，强词夺理。通常形容一个人说话不按常理，不顾逻辑，强行辩解或无理取闹。
explanation_english: Describes speaking in an unreasonable, domineering, and illogical manner. It often implies that someone is arguing without rhyme or reason or behaving unreasonably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好打橫嚟講啦，件事根本唔係咁樣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2 laa1, gin6 si6 gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 gam2 joeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要蛮横不讲理了，事情根本不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk so unreasonably, that's not how things are at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次同人拗撬都係打橫嚟講，冇人可以同佢傾得埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 tung4 jan4 aau3 hip3 dou1 hai6 daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 king1 dak1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次和别人争吵都蛮横不讲理，没有人可以和他谈得来。
examples.english_sentence: Every time he argues with someone, he speaks unreasonably, no one can get along with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打橫嚟講，擺明想屈你啫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 waang4 lai4 gong2, baai2 ming4 soeng2 wat1 nei5 ze1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他蛮不讲理，明显想冤枉你罢了！
examples.english_sentence: He's speaking unreasonably, clearly just trying to frame you!

english_meaning: anyway, in any case, one way or another, horizontally or vertically
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论如何，不管怎样，横竖，总之。也指横着还是竖着。
explanation_english: Indicates 'anyway,' 'in any case,' 'no matter what,' 'one way or another.' It can also literally mean 'horizontally or vertically,' referring to orientation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打橫打掂我都要完成呢個任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 waang4 daa2 dim6 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 横竖我都要完成这个任务。
examples.english_sentence: Anyway, I have to complete this task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢打橫打掂都擺唔入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 daa2 waang4 daa2 dim6 dou1 baai2 m4 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西怎么放都放不进去。
examples.english_sentence: These things won't fit no matter how I arrange them (horizontally or vertically).

english_meaning: to act lawlessly; to act with impunity; to be a bully; to go sideways (like a crab)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为蛮横霸道，目中无人，不受约束。
explanation_english: Describes someone acting arrogantly, lawlessly, and without regard for others. Can also literally mean to walk sideways, like a crab.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢恃住自己老豆係大佬，喺條街度打橫行，冇人敢惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci5 zyu6 zi6 gei2 lou5 dau2 hai6 daai6 lou2, hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 daa2 waang4 haang4, mou5 jan4 gam2 jo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仗着自己爸爸是老大，在街上横行霸道，没人敢惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He relies on his dad being a big boss, so he acts lawlessly in the street, no one dares to provoke him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲蟹喺沙灘上面打橫行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 haai5 hai2 saa1 taan1 soeng6 min6 daa2 waang4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 螃蟹在沙滩上横着走。
examples.english_sentence: The crabs walk sideways on the beach.

english_meaning: to partner; to collaborate; to cooperate; to work together
explanation_mandarin: 指共同合作，一起做事。 多用于商业或工作方面。
explanation_english: Refers to working together, usually in a business or professional context. It implies forming a partnership or collaboration to achieve a common goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如打檔一齊開間舖頭吖？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 daa2 dong3 jat1 cai4 hoi1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 aa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如合伙一起开家店吧？
examples.english_sentence: How about we partner up and open a shop together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個打檔做生意，幾賺錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 daa2 dong3 zou6 saang1 ji3, gei2 zaan6 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个合伙做生意，很赚钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are in business together, and they're making a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同阿明打檔搞呢個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 daa2 dong3 gaau2 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和阿明合作搞这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: I'm working together with Ah Ming on this project.

english_meaning: to butt in (a conversation), to interrupt, to interject, to force one's way in
explanation_mandarin: 在别人说话的时候，强行插入自己的话语，或强行加入某个群体或活动。
explanation_english: To interrupt someone who is speaking, to force one's way into a conversation, or to force oneself into a group or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以唔好成日打櫼呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 daa2 caam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以不要总是插嘴啊？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please stop interrupting all the time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢硬要打櫼入我哋嘅傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaang6 jiu3 daa2 caam1 jap6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他硬要插进我们的聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He insisted on butting into our conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾緊正經嘢，你唔好喺度打櫼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 gan2 zing3 ging1 je5, nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 daa2 caam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在谈正经事，你不要在这里插嘴啦。
examples.english_sentence: We're talking about serious matters, don't butt in.

mandarin_meaning: 公开宣扬；公开打着…的旗号
english_meaning: to openly advocate; to fly the flag (of); to openly declare; to openly claim to
explanation_mandarin: 指公开宣扬某种主张、目的或身份，通常带有某种正式或官方的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to openly advocating a certain proposition, purpose, or identity, often with a formal or official connotation. It suggests doing something under a banner or with open declaration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打正旗號話要改革教育制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 zeng3 kei4 hou6 waa6 jiu3 gaai2 gaak3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公开宣扬要改革教育制度。
examples.english_sentence: They openly declared that they would reform the education system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司打正旗號賣有機食品，但係有啲人懷疑佢哋嘅貨源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 daa2 zeng3 kei4 hou6 maai6 jau5 gei1 sik6 ban2, daan6 hai6 jau5 di1 jan4 waai4 ji4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fo3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司公开打着卖有机食品的旗号，但是有些人怀疑他们的货源。
examples.english_sentence: The company openly claims to sell organic food, but some people doubt the source of their goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打正旗號話為咗大家好，其實只係為自己嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 zeng3 kei4 hou6 waa6 wai6 zo2 daai6 gaa1 hou2, kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 wai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要打着为了大家好的旗号，其实只是为了自己的利益。
examples.english_sentence: Don't openly claim that it's for everyone's benefit, when it's actually just for your own interests.

english_meaning: to beat to death; to the death; extremely; absolutely
explanation_mandarin: 动词表示将人或动物打死。副词表示程度极深，相当于“极其”，“绝对”。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to beat someone or something to death. As an adverb, it indicates a very high degree, equivalent to 'extremely' or 'absolutely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到想打死佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 soeng2 daa2 sei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气到想打死他。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he wanted to beat him to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打死都唔會咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 sei2 dou1 m4 wui5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我绝对不会这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I absolutely will not do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打死都唔信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 sei2 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我无论如何都不相信他。
examples.english_sentence: I absolutely don't believe him.

jyutping: daa2 sei2 bat1 lei4 can1 hing1 dai6
mandarin_meaning: 情同手足；关系非常密切，即使遇到困难也不分开
english_meaning: Brothers for life; inseparable brothers, even in the face of death or extreme adversity
explanation_mandarin: 形容兄弟之间感情深厚，即使遇到再大的困难也不会互相抛弃，关系非常亲密。
explanation_english: Describes the deep and unwavering bond between brothers, suggesting they will stick together through thick and thin, no matter the challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個打死不離親兄弟咁，做咩都一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 daa2 sei2 bat1 lei4 can1 hing1 dai6 gam2, zou6 me1 dou1 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个情同手足，做什么都在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are like brothers for life, they do everything together.

mandarin_meaning: 死也甘心; 心甘情願被打死
english_meaning: To be willing to be beaten to death without complaint; to be willing to accept the consequences without complaint; to be completely willing to do something regardless of the outcome.
explanation_mandarin: 表示即使被打死，也毫无怨言，形容心甘情愿承受后果，或者形容对某事决心已定，不顾一切。
explanation_english: Expresses a willingness to accept even death without complaint. It signifies a complete willingness to bear the consequences of one's actions or a resolute determination to do something, regardless of the cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咗佢，打死無怨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 zo2 keoi5, daa2 sei2 mou4 jyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了他，我死也甘心。
examples.english_sentence: For him, I am willing to die without complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資失敗咗，我都打死無怨，起碼我試過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 baai6 zo2, ngo5 dou1 daa2 sei2 mou4 jyun3, hei2 maa5 ngo5 si3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资失败了，我也毫无怨言，至少我尝试过了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if this investment fails, I won't complain. At least I tried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫佢，就算要我孭鑊，我都打死無怨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bong1 keoi5, zau6 syun3 jiu3 ngo5 be1 wok6, ngo5 dou1 daa2 sei2 mou4 jyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮他，就算要我背黑锅，我也毫无怨言。
examples.english_sentence: To help him, even if I have to take the blame, I'll do it without complaint.

english_meaning: To argue about the price after the deal is done; to negotiate after the fact; to complain about something after it's too late to change it.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情已经完成或确定，再来讨价还价，通常指不合理或为时已晚的行为。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the act of negotiating or complaining about something after it has already been agreed upon or completed. It suggests that the action is pointless or unfair because the outcome cannot be changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都簽咗合約啦，而家先嚟打死狗講價，都冇用㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 cim1 zo2 hap6 joek3 laa1, ji4 gaa1 sin1 lei4 daa2 sei2 gau2 gong2 gaa3, dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都签了合同了，现在才来事后讲价，没用的！
examples.english_sentence: You've already signed the contract, it's no use arguing about the price now after the fact!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋都起好咗棟樓啦，你先至話覺得太貴，咪即係打死狗講價囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dou1 hei2 hou2 zo2 dung6 lau2 laa1, nei5 sin1 zi3 waa6 gok3 dak1 taai3 gwai3, mai1 zik1 hai6 daa2 sei2 gau2 gong2 gaa3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们都盖好楼了，你才说觉得太贵，不就是事后讲价吗。
examples.english_sentence: They've already built the building, you only say you think it's too expensive now, isn't that just arguing about the price after the fact?

english_meaning: Even if I die, I will/won't...
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论发生什么情况，都不可能改变主意或采取某种行动。
explanation_english: Indicates a strong determination or unwillingness to do something, no matter what happens. It conveys a sense of absolute refusal or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打死我都唔會同佢拍拖㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 sei2 dou1 ngo5 m4 wui5 tung4 keoi5 paak3 to1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何我都不会和他/她谈恋爱的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if I die, I won't date him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打死我都唔會食榴槤㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 sei2 dou1 ngo5 m4 wui5 sik6 lau4 lin4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何我都不会吃榴莲的！
examples.english_sentence: Even if I die, I won't eat durian!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打死我都唔會出賣朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 sei2 dou1 ngo5 m4 wui5 cheot1 maai6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何我都不会出卖朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Even if I die, I won't betray my friends.

english_meaning: to cripple, to defeat badly, to beat down, to weaken severely
explanation_mandarin: 指通过打击或攻击使对方变得虚弱、无法反抗或失去行动能力。比喻在竞争或对抗中彻底击败对手。
explanation_english: To cripple someone, to defeat them badly, or to severely weaken them through physical or other forms of attack. Figuratively, it refers to completely defeating an opponent in competition or confrontation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅策略好成功，幾乎將對手打殘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 caak3 loek6 hou2 sing4 gung1, gei1 fu1 zoeng1 deoi3 sau2 daa2 caan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的策略很成功，几乎将对手打垮了。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's strategy was very successful, almost crippling their competitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多小商戶都俾大公司打殘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 siu2 soeng1 wu6 dou1 bei2 daai6 gung1 si1 daa2 caan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多小商户都被大公司打垮了。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the poor economy, many small businesses have been beaten down by large corporations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試，佢準備得唔夠，俾其他同學打殘咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3, keoi5 zeon2 bei6 dak1 m4 gau3, bei2 kei4 taa1 tung4 hok6 daa2 caan4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，他准备得不够，被其他同学击败了。
examples.english_sentence: This exam, he wasn't prepared enough and was defeated by the other students.

mandarin_meaning: 下毒手; 陷害; 栽赃
english_meaning: To stab someone in the back; to frame someone; to poison someone's mind; to undermine someone.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻暗中用阴险的手段陷害别人，使其受到损害或破坏。
explanation_english: A metaphor for secretly harming or undermining someone through insidious means, causing them to suffer damage or setbacks. It implies a malicious intent and covert action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前打毒針，搞到我升唔到職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 daa2 duk6 zam1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 sing1 m4 dou2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前陷害我，害得我升不了职。
examples.english_sentence: He's always stabbing me in the back in front of the boss, which is why I can't get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易信人，小心俾人打毒針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 daa2 duk6 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易相信别人，小心被人陷害。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, be careful of being stabbed in the back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用謠言嚟打毒針，想破壞我嘅聲譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 jiu4 jin4 lai4 daa2 duk6 zam1, soeng2 po3 waai6 ngo5 ge3 seng1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用谣言来陷害我，想破坏我的声誉。
examples.english_sentence: He's using rumors to undermine me and ruin my reputation.

english_meaning: to call (on the phone); to make a phone call
explanation_mandarin: 用电话与人联系，拨打电话。
explanation_english: To contact someone by phone; to make a phone call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我陣間打比你傾下偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 bei2 nei5 king1 haa5 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一会儿给你打电话聊聊天。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you later for a chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得打比我啊，唔好唔記得呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daa2 bei2 ngo5 aa3, m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得给我打电话啊，别忘了！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to call me, don't forget!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔打比我，真係嬲死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 daa2 bei2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 nau1 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她总是不给我打电话，真让我生气。
examples.english_sentence: He/She never calls me, it really makes me angry.

english_meaning: To participate in a competition; to compete
explanation_mandarin: 指参加各种形式的比赛，例如体育比赛、学术竞赛等。
explanation_english: Refers to participating in various forms of competition, such as sports competitions, academic contests, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個禮拜會去香港打比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 wui2 heoi3 Hoeng1 Gong2 daa2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个星期会去香港参加比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He will go to Hong Kong to compete next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成班同學都好支持佢打比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 baan1 tung4 hok6 dou1 hou2 zi1 chi4 keoi5 daa2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们全班同学都很支持他参加比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Our whole class supports him in competing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我想打籃球比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 soeng2 daa2 laam4 kau4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我想参加篮球比赛。
examples.english_sentence: I want to participate in a basketball competition this year.

english_meaning: to cheer on; to encourage; to support
explanation_mandarin: 为某人或某事加油鼓劲，给予支持和鼓励。
explanation_english: To cheer someone on; to provide support and encouragement to someone or for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為香港運動員打氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai6 hoeng1 gong2 wan6 dung6 yun4 daa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要为香港运动员加油。
examples.english_sentence: We need to cheer on the Hong Kong athletes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，我會喺你身邊打氣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ngo5 wui5 hai2 nei5 san1 bin1 daa2 hei3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，我会在你身边为你加油的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I will be there to cheer you on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日考試，我打電話同佢打氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 haau2 si3, ngo5 daa2 din6 waa2 tung4 keoi5 daa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天考试，我打电话给他加油。
examples.english_sentence: He had an exam yesterday, so I called him to cheer him on.

english_meaning: to fetch water; to pour water
explanation_mandarin: 指取水或倒水。 可以是去水源处取水，也可以是把水倒出来。
explanation_english: Refers to fetching or pouring water. It can mean going to a water source to collect water or pouring water out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我打啲水嚟，我好口渴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 daa2 di1 seoi2 lai4, ngo5 hou2 hau2 hot3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我打点水来，我很渴。
examples.english_sentence: Please fetch me some water, I'm very thirsty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢倒咗成煲熱水，打水落個樽度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 zo2 seng4 bou1 jit6 seoi2, daa2 seoi2 lok6 go3 zeon1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他倒了一整壶热水，倒水进那个瓶子里。
examples.english_sentence: He poured a whole pot of hot water, pouring water into that bottle.

mandarin_meaning: 打退堂鼓 / 临阵退缩
english_meaning: To back out at the last minute / to chicken out / to get cold feet
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在行动前或进行中突然放弃或退缩。通常指因为害怕或缺乏信心而放弃。
explanation_english: A figure of speech meaning to suddenly give up or back down before or during an action, usually due to fear or lack of confidence. It implies a failure to follow through on a commitment or plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本嚟應承咗幫手，點知臨尾打水撇，搞到我好狼狽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 lai4 ying1 sing3 zo2 bong1 sau2, dim2 zi1 lam4 mei5 daa2 seoi2 pit3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 long4 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来答应帮忙，结果临到最后却退缩了，害我很狼狈。
examples.english_sentence: He originally promised to help, but he chickened out at the last minute, leaving me in a very awkward situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都應承咗，唔好打水撇呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 ying1 sing3 zo2, m4 hou2 daa2 seoi2 pit3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都答应了，不要临阵退缩啊！
examples.english_sentence: You already promised, don't back out now!

mandarin_meaning: 打水漂儿; 偷懒; 敷衍了事
english_meaning: Skip stones (on water); slack off; shirk one's responsibilities; do a perfunctory job
explanation_mandarin: 原本指在水面上投掷扁平石块使其跳跃的动作，引申为工作或学习时偷懒、敷衍，不认真对待。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the action of skipping flat stones across the surface of water. Figuratively, it means to slack off, shirk one's responsibilities, or do a perfunctory job, not taking things seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都打水片，所以老闆好唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 seoi2 pin3, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 hou2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是偷懒，所以老板很不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always slacks off at work, so the boss doesn't like him very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好打水片呀，認真啲做啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 seoi2 pin3 aa3, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要敷衍了事啊，认真点做吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just do a perfunctory job, do it seriously!

english_meaning: To conquer a country; to establish an empire; to build up a business or enterprise from scratch; to create a foundation for something
explanation_mandarin: 指创业，建立基业，或者打败敌人，夺取政权。
explanation_english: Refers to starting a business, establishing a foundation, or defeating enemies and seizing power. It often implies overcoming great challenges and building something significant from nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆白手興家，打咗一番江山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1, daa2 zo2 jat1 faan1 gong1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩白手起家，打下了一片江山。
examples.english_sentence: The couple built their business from scratch and created a substantial empire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老一輩嘅人打江山好艱難㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jat1 bui3 ge3 jan4 daa2 gong1 saan1 hou2 gaan1 naan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老一辈的人创业是很艰难的。
examples.english_sentence: It was very difficult for the older generation to build their businesses from the ground up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司都算係佢一手一腳打返嚟嘅江山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 syun3 hai6 keoi5 jat1 sau2 jat1 goek3 daa2 faan1 lai4 ge3 gong1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司也算是他一手一脚打拼出来的江山。
examples.english_sentence: This company can be considered as the empire he built with his own hands and feet.

synonyms: 開創事業 (hoi1 chong3 si6 jip6)
開天闢地 (hoi1 tin1 pik1 dei6)

english_meaning: to suppress; to put down; to stifle; to sink (figuratively, e.g., an idea or a proposal)
explanation_mandarin: 指压制、打击，使无法发展或实现。 也可指否定。
explanation_english: To suppress, put down, or stifle something, preventing it from developing or being realized. Can also mean to reject or deny something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅建議俾人打沉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin3 ji5 bei2 jan4 daa2 cam4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的建议被人否决了。
examples.english_sentence: His suggestion was rejected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易打沉人哋嘅自信心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 daa2 cam4 jan4 dei6 ge3 zi6 seon3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易打击别人的自信心啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quick to put down other people's confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁灰心，唔可以俾少少挫折就打沉你嘅意志。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 fui1 sam1, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 siu2 siu2 co3 zit3 zau6 daa2 cam4 nei5 ge3 ji3 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么灰心，不能因为一点挫折就打击你的意志。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged; you can't let a little setback stifle your will.

english_meaning: to vomit, to throw up, to puke
explanation_mandarin: 指呕吐，将胃里的东西吐出来。
explanation_english: To vomit, to throw up the contents of one's stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋晚飲咗好多酒，結果打河打到七彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 ngaam5 jam2 zo2 hou2 do1 zau2, git3 gwo2 daa2 ho4 daa2 dou3 cat1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚喝了很多酒，结果吐得厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He drank a lot of alcohol last night and ended up vomiting badly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架船太搖擺，搞到我好想打河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 syun4 taai3 jiu4 baai2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 soeng2 daa2 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船太摇晃了，搞得我很想吐。
examples.english_sentence: The boat is rocking too much, it's making me want to throw up.

english_meaning: To write lighthearted, humorous verse; doggerel; to joke around, to fool around
explanation_mandarin: 指创作风格诙谐幽默的诗歌，内容多为讽刺或滑稽；也指开玩笑，胡闹。
explanation_english: Refers to writing lighthearted and humorous verse, often with satirical or comical content; also means to joke around, to fool around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打油，搞到大家都笑死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 jau2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 siu3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是开玩笑，弄得大家都笑死了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always joking around, making everyone laugh to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺好鍾意寫打油詩，啲內容好鬼搞笑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 hou2 zung1 ji3 se2 daa2 jau2 si1, di1 noi6 yung4 hou2 gwai2 gaau2 siu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷很喜欢写打油诗，内容非常搞笑。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa loves to write humorous verse, the content is really funny.

english_meaning: doggerel; light verse; simple and humorous poem
explanation_mandarin: 指一种通俗、诙谐、内容浅显的诗歌，通常不讲究格律。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of folk poem characterized by its simple language, humor, and often lack of strict adherence to poetic conventions. It is usually lighthearted and easy to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅嘢成日都好似打油詩咁，鬼馬又抵死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 ci5 daa2 jau4 si1 gam2, gwai2 maa5 jau6 dai2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的东西总是像打油诗一样，古灵精怪又有趣。
examples.english_sentence: What he writes is always like doggerel, quirky and funny.

english_meaning: to play ball (sports)
explanation_mandarin: 指进行球类运动，例如篮球、足球、排球等。
explanation_english: To play a ball sport, such as basketball, football, volleyball, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日一齊去打波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 daa2 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天一起去打球吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go play ball together tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意打咩波啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 daa2 me1 bo1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢打什么球啊？
examples.english_sentence: What ball sport do you like to play?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波打得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 daa2 dak1 ho2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球打得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He plays ball very well.

english_meaning: to play marbles
explanation_mandarin: 指玩弹珠游戏。弹珠是一种小型的玻璃或石头球，通常儿童会用来玩耍。
explanation_english: Refers to playing the game of marbles. Marbles are small glass or stone balls commonly used by children for play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日同啲朋友喺街邊打波子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 hai2 gaai1 bin1 daa2 bo1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常和朋友们在街边玩弹珠。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often played marbles with my friends on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲小朋友好少打波子喇，多數都係玩手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 siu2 daa2 bo1 zi2 laa3, do1 sou3 dou1 hai6 waan2 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的小朋友很少玩弹珠了，大部分都是玩手机。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, kids rarely play marbles, most of them play on their phones.

english_meaning: to make a hole; to punch a hole; to drill a hole; to perforate
explanation_mandarin: 用工具穿透物体，制造孔洞。
explanation_english: To make a hole in something using a tool or instrument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺塊木板上面打個洞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 faai3 muk6 baan2 soeng6 min6 daa2 go3 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在木板上打一个洞。
examples.english_sentence: We need to make a hole in the wooden board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用鑽打洞會快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 jun3 daa2 dung6 wui5 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用钻打洞会快一点。
examples.english_sentence: It's faster to make a hole with a drill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎咗個打洞機嚟喺張紙上面打洞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zo2 go3 daa2 dung6 gei1 lai4 hai2 zoeng1 zi2 soeng6 min6 daa2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了打孔机来在这张纸上面打孔。
examples.english_sentence: He took the hole puncher to make a hole in the paper.

mandarin_meaning: 消除; 取消; 打破
english_meaning: to dispel; to eliminate; to abandon (an idea); to give up
explanation_mandarin: 消除原有的念头或想法。
explanation_english: To get rid of an original thought or idea; to abandon a plan or intention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要打消佢嘅疑慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daa2 siu1 keoi5 ge3 ji4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要消除他的疑虑。
examples.english_sentence: We need to dispel his doubts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好打消呢個念頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 daa2 siu1 ni1 go3 nim6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好打消这个念头。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better abandon this idea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最終都打消咗辭職嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 daa2 siu1 zo2 ci4 zik1 ge3 lam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最终都放弃了辞职的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He eventually gave up the idea of resigning.

english_meaning: to wage guerrilla warfare; to strike and run; to work intermittently and in various places
explanation_mandarin: 原指军事上的游击战术，比喻做事不固定，到处流动。
explanation_english: Originally refers to guerrilla warfare in military terms. Figuratively, it means doing things in a non-fixed manner, moving around from place to place; intermittent work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打游擊咁做嘢，冇份工做得長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 jau4 gik1 gam2 zou6 je5, mou5 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是打游击一样工作，没有一份工作能做长久。
examples.english_sentence: He always works intermittently, never holding a job for long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日打游擊咁樣去唔同嘅舖頭格價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 daa2 jau4 gik1 gam2 joeng2 heoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 pou3 tau2 gaak3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天打游击一样去不同的店铺比较价格。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to different shops to compare prices today, just like waging guerrilla warfare.

english_meaning: to roll about; to struggle; to spend time in (a certain environment)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个环境中生活或工作了较长时间，经历了很多事情。也指在地上翻滚。
explanation_english: To roll about (literally); figuratively, to spend a long time in a certain environment, experiencing a lot, or to struggle to survive; also can mean literally rolling on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺娛樂圈打滾咗咁多年，乜嘢都見過晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jyu4 lok6 hyun1 daa2 gwan2 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4, mat1 je5 dou1 gin3 gwo3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在娱乐圈摸爬滚打了这么多年，什么都见过了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been struggling in the entertainment industry for so many years, he has seen everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友喺草地上面打滾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 cou2 dei6 soeng6 min6 daa2 gwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们在草地上打滚。
examples.english_sentence: The children are rolling on the grass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗生活，要喺社會底層打滾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 sang1 wut6, jiu3 hai2 se5 wui2 dai2 cang4 daa2 gwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了生活，他们要在社会底层摸爬滚打。
examples.english_sentence: To make a living, they have to struggle at the bottom of society.

english_meaning: To play truant; to skip school; to play hooky
explanation_mandarin: 指学生未经允许，私自逃离学校，不参加课程或活动的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a student leaving school without permission, skipping classes or activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打潛艇，所以成績好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 cim4 ting5, so2 ji5 sing4 jik1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常逃学，所以成绩很差。
examples.english_sentence: He often plays truant, so his grades are very bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再打潛艇喇，如果唔係會俾老師發現㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 daa2 cim4 ting5 laa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 wui5 bei2 lou5 si1 faat3 jin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再逃学了，不然会被老师发现的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play truant anymore, or the teacher will find out.

english_meaning: To dampen someone's spirits, to throw cold water on something, to be a killjoy
explanation_mandarin: 比喻使人扫兴，破坏气氛，使原本积极的气氛冷却下来。如同不小心把茶水泼洒出来一样，破坏了原本的完整。
explanation_english: A metaphor for dampening someone's spirits, spoiling the atmosphere, or cooling down a previously positive situation.  It's like accidentally spilling tea, disrupting the original completeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打瀉茶啦，大家都好開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daa2 se3 caa4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么扫兴嘛，大家都很开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a killjoy, everyone's having a good time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係講出事實，唔係想打瀉茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gong2 ceot1 si6 sat6, m4 hai6 soeng2 daa2 se3 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是说出事实，不是想泼冷水。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just stating the facts, I didn't mean to throw cold water on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嚟就打瀉茶，搞到個party即刻冇曬氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lai4 zau6 daa2 se3 caa4, gaau2 dou3 go3 party zik1 hak1 mou5 saai3 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一来就扫兴，搞得派对立刻没了气氛。
examples.english_sentence: He came and immediately dampened the atmosphere, making the party lose its vibe.

english_meaning: to light a fire; to ignite; to start a car engine
explanation_mandarin: 点燃火焰；启动（汽车）引擎。
explanation_english: To light a fire, flame, or cigarette; to start or ignite something; also used to start a car engine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我打火得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 daa2 fo2 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能帮我点个火吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you light my cigarette for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車打唔著火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 daa2 m4 zoek6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车打不着火。
examples.english_sentence: The car won't start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用打火機點煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 daa2 fo2 gei1 dim2 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用打火机点烟。
examples.english_sentence: He uses a lighter to light his cigarette.

english_meaning: lighter
explanation_mandarin: 一种点火的工具，通常用于点燃香烟、蜡烛等。
explanation_english: A device used to produce a flame, typically for lighting cigarettes, candles, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借個打火機嚟點煙得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 go3 daa2 fo2 gei1 lai4 dim2 jin1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借个打火机来点烟可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could I borrow a lighter to light a cigarette?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得帶打火機，冇得點蠟燭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 daa2 fo2 gei1, mou5 dak1 dim2 laap6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记带打火机了，没法点蜡烛。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring a lighter, so I can't light the candles.

english_meaning: flint, tinderbox, catalyst, impetus
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是用来点火的石头。引申意义是比喻引发某种事情或情绪的因素或契机。
explanation_english: Literally means flint, a stone used for making fire. Figuratively, it refers to something that sparks off an event, emotion, or situation; a catalyst or impetus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅一句說話好似打火石噉，即刻點燃咗我嘅怒火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jat1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 hou2 ci5 daa2 fo2 sek6 gam2, zik1 haak1 dim2 jin4 zo2 ngo5 ge3 nou6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一句话就像打火石一样，立刻点燃了我的怒火。
examples.english_sentence: His words were like a flint, immediately igniting my anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃係一個打火石，帶動咗成個社區嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 jat1 go3 daa2 fo2 sek6, daai3 dung6 zo2 sing4 go3 se5 keoi1 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划是一个打火石，带动了整个社区的发展。
examples.english_sentence: This plan was a catalyst, driving the development of the entire community.

english_meaning: to close (a shop) for the day; to shut down for the night
explanation_mandarin: 指商店结束一天的营业，关门。
explanation_english: Refers to the closing of a shop for the day, ending business operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間鋪頭夜晚十點就打烊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 pou3 tau2 je6 maan5 sap6 dim2 zau6 daa2 joeng4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那家商店晚上十点就关门了。
examples.english_sentence: Their shop closes at 10 pm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差唔多時間打烊，執拾下啲嘢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 m4 do1 si4 gaan3 daa2 joeng4, zap1 sap1 haa5 di1 je5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 差不多是关门的时间了，先收拾一下东西。
examples.english_sentence: It's almost closing time, let's tidy things up first.

mandarin_meaning: 打信号灯; 给暗示; 提醒
english_meaning: to signal (with lights); to give a hint; to alert someone; to inform
explanation_mandarin: 原意为用灯光发出信号。引申为通过某种方式（言语或行动）给别人提示或提醒。有时也指告密或通风报信。
explanation_english: Originally, it means to signal with lights. By extension, it means to give someone a hint or reminder through some means (words or actions). It can also refer to informing on someone or tipping them off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打燈俾我知，如果老細嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 dang1 bei2 ngo5 zi1, jyu4 gwo2 lou5 sai3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果老板来了，你给我打信号。
examples.english_sentence: Give me a signal if the boss comes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打燈俾佢哋，等佢哋自己發掘啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 dang1 bei2 keoi5 dei6, dang2 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 faat3 gwat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别给他们暗示，让他们自己发现吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give them hints, let them discover it themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個打燈報料㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 daa2 dang1 bou3 liu2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是谁通风报信的？
examples.english_sentence: Who tipped them off?

english_meaning: to smash; to break open; to overwhelm (in a competition); to max out (e.g., level in a game, phone storage); to burst; to blow out
explanation_mandarin: 指击破、打烂、使之爆裂；在竞争中彻底击败对手；也指达到上限或极限。
explanation_english: Refers to smashing, breaking open, or causing something to burst. In competition, it means to completely defeat an opponent. It can also mean to reach a limit or maximum value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日玩遊戲打爆咗機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 waan2 jau4 hei3 daa2 baau3 zo2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天玩游戏打爆了。
examples.english_sentence: I finished the game yesterday (by beating the final boss/reaching the end).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢部電話嘅儲存空間打爆咗，咩都裝唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 cyu5 cyun4 hung1 gaan1 daa2 baau3 zo2, me1 dou1 zong1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手机储存空间满了，什么都装不了。
examples.english_sentence: His phone storage is full; he can't install anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋籃球隊俾我哋打爆咗，輸得好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 laam4 kau4 deoi2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 daa2 baau3 zo2, syu1 dak1 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的篮球队被我们打爆了，输得很惨。
examples.english_sentence: Their basketball team was completely defeated by us; they lost badly.

english_meaning: To complete a video game; to beat a video game; to finish all levels of a game
explanation_mandarin: 指成功完成一个电子游戏的所有关卡或主要目标，达到游戏的结局。
explanation_english: Refers to successfully completing all levels or main objectives of a video game, reaching the game's ending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我花咗成個禮拜終於打爆機啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faa1 zo2 seng4 go3 lai5 baai1 zung1 jyu1 daa2 baau3 gei1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我花了一整个星期终于通关了！
examples.english_sentence: I spent a whole week and finally beat the game!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都打機，就係想打爆機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 daa2 gei1, zau6 hai6 soeng2 daa2 baau3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都玩游戏，就是想通关。
examples.english_sentence: He plays games every day because he wants to beat the game.

mandarin_meaning: 加油过多，耗尽燃料；比喻付出所有，不留余力
english_meaning: To fill the fuel tank completely and then some (metaphorically, to give it your all, to exhaust all resources)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指把油缸加满油，甚至加到溢出来。 比喻全力以赴，耗尽所有资源或精力，毫无保留。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to fill the fuel tank completely, even to the point of overflowing. Metaphorically, it means to give it your all, to exhaust all resources or energy, without reservation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我要打爆油缸，考到最好嘅成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jiu3 daa2 baau3 jau4 gong1, haau2 dou3 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我要全力以赴，考到最好的成绩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to give it my all for this exam, to get the best results possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗完成呢個項目，佢哋打爆油缸，日以繼夜咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, keoi5 dei6 daa2 baau3 jau4 gong1, jat6 ji5 gai3 je6 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了完成这个项目，他们全力以赴，日以继夜地工作。
examples.english_sentence: In order to complete this project, they gave it their all, working day and night.

english_meaning: to completely fail; to crash and burn; to screw up badly
explanation_mandarin: 指事情彻底失败，无法挽回的局面。比喻如同水缸被打破，无法修复。也形容情绪崩溃。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where something has completely failed, beyond repair. It's analogous to a water tank being smashed, impossible to fix. It can also describe an emotional breakdown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我打爆缸喇，肯定肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 daa2 baau3 gong1 laa3, hang2 ding6 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我彻底失败了，肯定要不及格了。
examples.english_sentence: I completely failed this exam; I'm definitely going to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢壓力太大，終於打爆缸，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6, zung1 jyu1 daa2 baau3 gong1, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他压力太大了，终于崩溃了，需要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He was under too much pressure and finally had a breakdown; he needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個項目咁重要，如果打爆缸就大件事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hong6 muk6 gam3 zung6 jiu3, jyu4 gwo2 daa2 baau3 gong1 zau6 daai6 gin6 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么重要，如果失败了就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so important; it would be terrible if it crashed and burned.

english_meaning: to break (something into pieces); to smash; to ruin; to mess up
explanation_mandarin: 使完整的东西破裂成碎片；弄坏、毁坏。
explanation_english: To break something into pieces, often unintentionally. It can also mean to ruin or mess up something, like a plan or a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力呀，打爛啲嘢就弊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 aa3, daa2 laan6 di1 je5 zau6 bai6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么用力啊，打碎东西就糟了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use so much force, it would be terrible if you broke something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心打爛咗隻杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 laan6 zo2 zek3 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心打碎了一个杯子。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally broke a cup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做會打爛曬成個計劃㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 zou6 wui2 daa2 laan6 saai3 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做会毁掉整个计划的！
examples.english_sentence: If you do that, you'll ruin the whole plan!

jyutping: daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 man6 dou3 gwai2
english_meaning: To ask questions until the bottom is reached; to dig deep to find out the truth; to be persistent in questioning.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻追根究底，非要弄清楚事情的来龙去脉。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is persistent in asking questions and investigating until they understand the whole story and every detail of a matter.  It implies a relentless pursuit of knowledge and truth, even if it requires great effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係打爛沙盆問到䐁，唔問清楚件事嘅真相都唔會收手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 man6 dou3 gwai2, m4 man6 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2 dou1 m4 wui5 sau1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是打破砂锅问到底，不问清楚事情的真相都不会罢休。
examples.english_sentence: He really asks questions until the bottom is reached; he won't stop until he finds out the truth about the matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打爛沙盆問到䐁啦，有啲嘢唔係一定要知得咁清楚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 man6 dou3 gwai2 laa1, jau5 di1 je5 m4 hai6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zi1 dak1 gam3 cing1 co2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么打破砂锅问到底了，有些事情不一定要知道得这么清楚的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask so many questions and dig so deep. There are some things you don't necessarily need to know so clearly.

jyutping: daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 man6 dou3 duk1
english_meaning: To get to the bottom of things; to probe deeply; to not give up until all questions are answered.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喜欢刨根问底，不弄清楚事情的真相不罢休。砂盆打烂了，还能问到盆底是什么情况，比喻追问到底，不放过任何细节。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who likes to get to the root of things and won't give up until they understand the truth.  It literally means to break a clay pot (sand pot) and ask what's at the bottom.  This implies relentless questioning and attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好咁打爛沙盆問到篤啦，人哋都講到咁白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 gam2 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 man6 dou3 duk1 laa1, yan4 dei6 dou1 gong2 dou3 gam2 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也不要这么打破砂锅问到底了，人家都说得这么明白了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so persistent in getting to the bottom of everything; they've already explained it so clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人就係咁，打爛沙盆問到篤，一定要知晒啲details 先安樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 yan4 zau6 hai6 gam2, daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 man6 dou3 duk1, yat1 ding6 jiu3 zi1晒啲details sin1 on1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的个性就是这样，打破砂锅问到底，一定要知道所有的细节才安心。
examples.english_sentence: That's just his personality, he always gets to the bottom of things; he needs to know all the details to be at peace.

jyutping: daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 wan6 dou3 gwai1 duk1
english_meaning: To break the clay pot and probe to the bottom (of the crack); to get to the bottom of things; to be persistent in questioning and investigation.
explanation_mandarin: 形容追根究底，非要弄清楚事情的真相。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is persistent in pursuing a matter to its very end, insisting on finding out the truth no matter what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一定要打爛沙盆璺到䐁，唔查清楚件事嘅真相佢都唔會罷休。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 wan6 dou3 gwai1 duk1, m4 caa4 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2 keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 baa6 jau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一定要打破砂锅问到底，不查清楚事情的真相他是不会罢休的。
examples.english_sentence: He must get to the bottom of things; he won't stop until he finds out the truth of the matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢可唔可以唔好咁打爛沙盆璺到䐁呀？有時適可而止就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 hou2 gam3 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 wan6 dou3 gwai1 duk1 aa3? jau5 si4 sik1 ho2 ji2 zi2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事可不可以不要这么打破砂锅问到底啊？有时候适可而止就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Can you not be so persistent in getting to the bottom of things when you work? Sometimes, it's enough to know when to stop.

jyutping: daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 wan3 dou3 duk1
english_meaning: To get to the bottom of things, to investigate thoroughly, to leave no stone unturned.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻追根究底，非要弄清楚事情的来龙去脉。即使已经很明显或对方不愿意透露，仍然坚持要问清楚所有细节。
explanation_english: This idiom means to investigate something thoroughly, to get to the bottom of things, even if it's obvious or the other party doesn't want to reveal the information. It implies a persistent desire to know all the details and background of a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對所有嘢都好認真，成日打爛沙盆璺到篤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 so2 jau5 je5 dou1 hou2 jing6 zan1, seng4 jat6 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 wan3 dou3 duk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对所有的事情都很认真，总是打破砂锅问到底。
examples.english_sentence: He is very serious about everything and always gets to the bottom of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再問啦，你都打爛沙盆璺到篤咁滞，人都唔想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 man6 laa1, nei5 dou1 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 wan3 dou3 duk1 gam2 zai6, jan4 dou1 m4 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再问了，你都打破砂锅问到底了，人家都不想说了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask anymore, you've already gotten to the bottom of it, and the person doesn't want to talk about it.

jyutping: daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 – wan6 dou3 duk1
english_meaning: Breaking a clay pot - inquiring right to the bottom; to get to the bottom of things; to pursue a matter to the very end; to get to the root of the problem.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻追根究底，非要弄清楚真相。
explanation_english: This idiom means to get to the bottom of things and pursue a matter to its very end. It implies a determination to find out the whole truth, even if it's unpleasant or difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好認真，一定要打爛砂盆——璺到篤先安樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jing6 zan1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 – wan6 dou3 duk1 sin1 on1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很认真，一定要打破砂锅问到底才安心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very serious about his work, he has to get to the bottom of things before he's satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁怕醜，有問題咪打爛砂盆——璺到篤問清楚囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 paa3 cau2, jau5 man6 tai4 mai1 daa2 laan6 saa1 pun4 – wan6 dou3 duk1 man6 cing1 co2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么害羞，有问题就打破砂锅问到底问清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so shy, if you have questions, then ask them thoroughly.

english_meaning: To ruin everything; to spoil the whole thing; to screw up completely; to break the rice bowl (of a monk - metaphorically, one's livelihood or reputation)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把事情彻底搞砸，断送了前途或生计。
explanation_english: A metaphor for ruining everything, jeopardizing one's future or livelihood. Literally, 'to break the vegetarian rice bowl'. It alludes to a monk breaking his alms bowl, thus losing his source of food and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，擺明想打爛齋缽啫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, baai2 ming4 soeng2 daa2 laan6 zaai1 but3 ze1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，摆明就是想砸锅！
examples.english_sentence: By doing this, it's obvious that you want to ruin everything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次衰咗，真係打爛齋缽，以後都冇機會喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 seoi1 zo2, zan1 hai6 daa2 laan6 zaai1 but3, ji5 hau6 dou1 mou5 gei1 wui2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次失败了，真是砸锅了，以后都没机会了。
examples.english_sentence: He failed this time, he really ruined everything, and there won't be any chances in the future.

english_meaning: to play mahjong/cards
explanation_mandarin: 指玩牌类游戏，通常指麻将或者扑克牌。
explanation_english: To play card games, usually referring to mahjong or poker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去打牌好唔好啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 daa2 paai4 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去打牌好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go play mahjong tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打牌打到好夜先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 daa2 paai4 daa2 dou3 hou2 je6 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是打牌打到很晚才回家。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays mahjong/cards until very late before going home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嗰陣，我哋一家人會一齊打牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 jat1 cai4 daa2 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，我们一家人会一起打牌。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, my family will play mahjong together.

english_meaning: to chat, to gossip, to engage in idle talk
explanation_mandarin: 指闲聊，无目的地聊天，通常包含一些非正式或琐碎的话题。
explanation_english: Refers to chatting idly, engaging in aimless conversation, often involving informal or trivial topics. It implies a relaxed and casual atmosphere where people are talking without a specific purpose or serious subject.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺茶餐廳打牙鉸，講下邊個明星結婚，邊個又離婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 daa2 ngaa4 gaau3, gong2 haa5 bin1 go3 ming4 sing1 git3 fan1, bin1 go3 jau6 lei4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在茶餐厅聊天，说说哪个明星结婚了，哪个又离婚了。
examples.english_sentence: We often chat in the tea restaurant, talking about which celebrity got married and which one got divorced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一見面就打牙鉸，講唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 daa2 ngaa4 gaau3, gong2 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩一见面就聊个不停。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them start chatting non-stop as soon as they meet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度打牙鉸啦，做嘢先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 daa2 ngaa4 gaau3 laa1, zou6 je5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里聊天了，先工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop chatting here, let's get to work first.

english_meaning: to chat, to gossip, to chew the fat
explanation_mandarin: 指闲聊，漫无目的地谈话，通常内容轻松随意。
explanation_english: Refers to chatting idly, engaging in aimless conversation, usually about light and casual topics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺茶餐廳打牙骹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 daa2 ngaa4 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在茶餐厅聊天。
examples.english_sentence: We often chat at the 'cha chaan teng' (Hong Kong-style cafe).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一見面就開始打牙骹，講唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 daa2 ngaa4 gaau3, gong2 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩一见面就开始聊天，说个不停。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as they meet, they start chatting and don't stop talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，同同事一齊去酒吧打牙骹放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, tung4 tung4 si6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jiu1 baa1 daa2 ngaa4 gaau3 fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，和同事一起去酒吧聊天放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: After work, I go to the bar with my colleagues to chat and relax.

english_meaning: to hunt
explanation_mandarin: 捕捉野生动物，通常是为了获取食物或消遣。
explanation_english: To hunt wild animals, usually for food or sport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日上山打獵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 soeng5 saan1 daa2 lip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常上山打猎。
examples.english_sentence: They often go hunting in the mountains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅人要靠打獵維生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 jan4 jiu3 kaau3 daa2 lip6 wai4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人要靠狩猎维持生计。
examples.english_sentence: People in the past relied on hunting for a living.

english_meaning: to manage, to take care of, to handle, to arrange
explanation_mandarin: 处理事务；管理；照料。
explanation_english: To manage affairs; to take care of; to handle; to arrange things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我打理屋企啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 daa2 lei5 uk1 kei2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我打理家里的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He helps me take care of the household chores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳要請個人打理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 jiu3 cing2 go3 jan4 daa2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅需要请一个人来管理。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant needs to hire someone to manage it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點打理你嘅頭髮㗎？咁靚嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 daa2 lei5 nei5 ge3 tau4 faat3 gaa3? gam3 leng3 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是怎么打理你的头发的？这么漂亮？
examples.english_sentence: How do you manage your hair? It's so beautiful?

english_meaning: to fight to the death; to fight tooth and nail; to work extremely hard
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常努力地工作或战斗，不顾一切，甚至不惜牺牲生命。
explanation_english: Describes working or fighting extremely hard, disregarding everything, even risking one's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗間公司打生打死，最後都係俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 gaan1 gung1 si1 daa2 sang1 daa2 sei2, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了公司拼死拼活，最后还是被解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: They worked their fingers to the bone for the company, but in the end, they were still fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗爭呢個合約，幾間公司都打生打死咁搶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zaang1 ni1 go3 hap6 joek3, gei2 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 daa2 sang1 daa2 sei2 gam2 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了争这个合同，几家公司都拼死拼活地抢。
examples.english_sentence: Several companies are fighting tooth and nail to get this contract.

english_meaning: To sacrifice a living person (usually for construction purposes); to use someone as a scapegoat; to be a patsy.
explanation_mandarin: 古代迷信习俗，在建造大型建筑物（如桥梁、城墙）时，将活人埋入地基或桩中，以祈求工程顺利完成。现在比喻找替罪羊，让某人承担责任或成为牺牲品。
explanation_english: Historically, a superstitious practice of burying a living person in the foundation or piles of large construction projects (like bridges or city walls) to pray for the project's smooth completion. Now it's used metaphorically to mean using someone as a scapegoat, making someone take responsibility, or being a victim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次咁慘，擺明就係俾人打生樁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 gam3 caam2, baai2 ming4 zau6 hai6 bei2 jan4 daa2 sang1 zong1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次这么惨，很明显是被当成牺牲品了。
examples.english_sentence: He's in such a terrible situation this time; it's clear he's been used as a scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁傻啦，唔好俾人打生樁呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 so4 laa1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 daa2 sang1 zong1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么傻了，别被人当成牺牲品啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, don't let yourself be used as a scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司出咗事，佢就被打生樁，炒咗魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceut1 zo2 si6, keoi5 zau6 bei2 daa2 sang1 zong1, caau2 zo2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出了事，他就被当成牺牲品，被炒鱿鱼了。
examples.english_sentence: When something went wrong with the company, he was made the scapegoat and got fired.

synonyms: 做替死鬼 (zou6 tai3 sei2 gwai2)

mandarin_meaning: 取消; 撤销; 甩掉
english_meaning: to cancel; to drop (charges); to shake off; to get rid of
explanation_mandarin: 取消、撤销、甩掉。常用于取消预定、撤销控诉、摆脱某些事物等情况。
explanation_english: To cancel, to revoke, or to shake off something. Commonly used to describe cancelling a reservation, dropping charges in a legal case, or getting rid of something undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人告，但係最後打甩咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gou3, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 daa2 lat1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人起诉，但是最后被撤销了控诉。
examples.english_sentence: He was sued, but the charges were dropped in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想去，不如打甩佢算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3, bat1 jyu4 daa2 lat1 keoi5 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想去，不如取消它算了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to go, let's just cancel it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想打甩啲壞習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 daa2 lat1 di1 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想摆脱一些坏习惯。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get rid of some bad habits.

english_meaning: to call (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 打电话给某人。 "畀" 在这里是 "给" 的意思。
explanation_english: To call someone. "畀" (bei2) means "to give" in this context, implying to give a call to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏啲打畀你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 di1 daa2 bei2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚一点打电话给你吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打畀佢問下佢幾時返呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 bei2 keoi5 man6 haa5 keoi5 gei2 si4 faan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打电话问一下他什么时候回来？
examples.english_sentence: Will you call him to ask when he's coming back?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得打畀阿媽拜年呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daa2 bei2 aa3 maa1 baai3 nin4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得打电话给妈妈拜年呀！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to call Mum to wish her a Happy New Year!

english_meaning: to get rid of; to send away; to spend time; to while away
explanation_mandarin: 指差遣、派遣，或指敷衍、应付，或指消磨时间。
explanation_english: Refers to sending someone away, dealing with something perfunctorily, or passing time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買啲嘢食打發時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 di1 ye5 sik6 daa2 faat3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买点东西吃打发时间。
examples.english_sentence: Let's buy some food to kill time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係想用啲錢打發我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeng6 hai6 soeng2 yung6 di1 cin2 daa2 faat3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只想用钱打发我。
examples.english_sentence: He just wants to get rid of me with money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用啲廢話打發我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 di1 fai3 waa6 daa2 faat3 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用废话敷衍我啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to brush me off with nonsense.

jyutping: daa2 faat3 gung1 fu1 waan4 gwai2 jyun6
english_meaning: To do something perfunctorily, just going through the motions, enough to satisfy a ghost (meaning it's the bare minimum).
explanation_mandarin: 指做事不认真，敷衍了事，只求过得去，像是为了应付鬼一样，只要鬼不闹事就行。
explanation_english: This idiom describes doing something in a perfunctory manner, just going through the motions with minimal effort. It implies that the work is done just well enough to avoid immediate problems or complaints, as if satisfying a ghost's needs just to keep it quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣打發功夫還鬼願，遲早俾老細炒魷魚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 daa2 faat3 gung1 fu1 waan4 gwai2 jyun6, ci4 zou2 bei2 lou5 sai3 caau2 jau4 jyu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样敷衍了事，迟早会被老板炒鱿鱼的。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep doing things perfunctorily like that, you'll get fired by the boss sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫到打發功夫還鬼願咁，肯定唔會俾人接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 daa2 faat3 gung1 fu1 waan4 gwai2 jyun6 gam2, hang2 ding6 m4 wui5 bei2 jan4 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告敷衍了事，肯定不会被人接受。
examples.english_sentence: The report he wrote was so perfunctory, it definitely won't be accepted.

synonyms: 敷衍了事 (fu1 jin2 liu5 shi4)

english_meaning: To go around in circles; to spin around; to be confused and disoriented.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人在原地转圈，或者比喻做事没有效率，徒劳无功，一直在原地打转。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to turn like a pigeon'. Describes someone going around in circles, or metaphorically, doing something inefficiently and achieving nothing, just going around in circles.  Implies confusion and lack of direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我蕩失路，喺條街度打白鴿轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dong6 sat1 lou6, hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 daa2 baak6 gap3 zyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我迷路了，在街上转来转去。
examples.english_sentence: I got lost and was going around in circles on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咗咁耐都搞唔掂，咪又係打白鴿轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6, mai1 jau6 hai6 daa2 baak6 gap3 zyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞了这么久都没搞定，还不是在原地打转。
examples.english_sentence: You've been working on it for so long and still haven't finished? You're just going around in circles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再諗喇，你越諗咪越打白鴿轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 lam2 laa3, nei5 yut6 lam2 mai1 yut6 daa2 baak6 gap3 zyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再想了，你越想就越转圈。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about it anymore, the more you think, the more you'll go around in circles.

english_meaning: to take a taxi
explanation_mandarin: 指乘坐出租车。
explanation_english: To take a taxi. Literally, 'to hit a taxi'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，要打的返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, jiu3 daa2 dik1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，要打车回家。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, I need to take a taxi home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落大雨，好難打的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, hou2 naan4 daa2 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雨，很难打车。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily today, it's hard to get a taxi.

english_meaning: vertical, upright, to straighten
explanation_mandarin: 表示使物体呈垂直方向的状态或动作。
explanation_english: Describing the state or action of making an object vertical or upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將張畫打直掛上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zoeng1 waa2 daa2 zik6 gwaa3 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把这幅画竖直挂上去。
examples.english_sentence: Hang this painting vertically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我打直條領呔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 daa2 zik6 tiu4 leng5 taai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把领带弄直。
examples.english_sentence: Help me straighten my tie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打直膊頭，企好佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zik6 bok3 tau4, kei5 hou2 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 挺直肩膀，站好！
examples.english_sentence: Straighten your shoulders and stand properly!

mandarin_meaning: 真枪实弹; 真刀真枪; 玩真的
english_meaning: to do something for real; to actually do something; to go all the way (often referring to sexual intercourse); to engage in real combat
explanation_mandarin: 本意指真枪实弹的战斗。比喻真的去做某件事，不弄虚作假。常用于指性行为是真实的，不只是表演或模拟。
explanation_english: Originally refers to real combat using real weapons. Figuratively, it means to actually do something without faking it. Often used to refer to real sexual intercourse, not just a performance or simulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍戲嗰陣，啲親熱戲都係打眞軍，好敬業㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 hei3 go2 zan6, di1 can1 jit6 hei3 dou1 hai6 daa2 zan1 gwan1, hou2 ging3 jip6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拍戏的时候，那些亲热戏都是真枪实弹的，非常敬业。
examples.english_sentence: When they filmed the movie, those intimate scenes were all done for real, they were very dedicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我哋要打眞軍，唔可以再拖延落去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daa2 zan1 gwan1, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1 jin4 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我们要真刀真枪地干了，不能再拖延下去了。
