examples.english_sentence: This time we have to do it for real, we can't keep delaying it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講，即係佢哋真係打眞軍啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2, zik1 hai6 keoi5 dei6 zan1 hai6 daa2 zan1 gwan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么说，就是说他们真的发生性关系了？
examples.english_sentence: Are you saying that they actually had sex?

english_meaning: to have real sex (in a movie or real life); to do something for real, without pretense
explanation_mandarin: 原指军队实弹演习。在电影界指在电影中真的发生性行为，或者指做事情不弄虚作假，来真的。
explanation_english: Originally referred to live ammunition military exercises. In the film industry, it means to have actual sexual intercourse during filming. More generally, it can mean to do something for real, without faking or pretending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話套戲打真軍，唔知堅定流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 tou3 hei3 daa2 zan1 gwan1, m4 zi1 gin1 ding6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说那部电影里是真做，不知道是真的还是假的。
examples.english_sentence: They said they had real sex in that movie, I wonder if it's true or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我哋要打真軍，唔可以再hea做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daa2 zan1 gwan1, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 hea1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我们要认真做了，不能再敷衍了事。
examples.english_sentence: This time we have to do it for real, we can't slack off anymore.

english_meaning: to sleep, to fall asleep
explanation_mandarin: 指睡觉，进入睡眠状态。
explanation_english: To sleep, to fall into a state of sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好眼瞓呀，想打睡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngaan5 fan3 aa3, soeng2 daa2 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好困啊，想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very sleepy, I want to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日溫書溫到好夜，今朝返工已經打緊睡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 wan1 syu1 wan1 dou3 hou2 je6, gam1 ziu1 faan1 gung1 ji5 ging1 daa2 gan2 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天复习功课到很晚，今天早上上班已经在打瞌睡了。
examples.english_sentence: He studied very late yesterday, and he's already dozing off at work this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺課室打睡呀，老師會鬧嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 fo3 sat1 daa2 seoi6 aa3, lou5 si1 wui5 naau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在教室睡觉啊，老师会骂的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sleep in the classroom, the teacher will scold you.

english_meaning: to doze off, to nod off, to snooze
explanation_mandarin: 指因为困倦而短暂地进入睡眠状态。
explanation_english: To fall asleep briefly, usually due to tiredness or boredom; to nod off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晏晝食飽飯好容易打瞌睡嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan3 zau3 sik6 baau2 faan6 hou2 rong4 ji6 daa2 hap1 seoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下午吃饱饭后很容易打瞌睡的。
examples.english_sentence: It's easy to doze off after a big lunch in the afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上堂嗰陣成日打瞌睡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 tong4 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 daa2 hap1 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上课的时候经常打瞌睡。
examples.english_sentence: He often dozes off during class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚冇瞓好，依家有啲想打瞌睡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 ngaam1 mou5 fan3 hou2, ji1 gaa1 jau5 di1 soeng2 daa2 hap1 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚没睡好，现在有点想打瞌睡。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep well last night, and now I feel like dozing off.

english_meaning: to freeload, to sponge off someone, to take advantage of someone
explanation_mandarin: 指利用他人，占小便宜，或趁机捞取好处。多含贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of others, freeloading, or seizing opportunities to gain benefits. Often carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打石湖，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 sek6 wu4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是占别人便宜，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always freeloads, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住打石湖，呢度冇免費午餐㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 daa2 sek6 wu4, ni1 dou6 mou5 min5 fai3 ng5 caan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想着占便宜，这里没有免费的午餐。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about freeloading, there's no free lunch here.

english_meaning: to put on a plaster cast; to apply plaster of Paris
explanation_mandarin: 用石膏固定骨折或受伤的肢体。
explanation_english: To apply a plaster cast to a fractured or injured limb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我跌斷咗手，醫生要幫我打石膏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dit3 dyun2 zo2 sau2, yi1 sang1 yiu3 bong1 ngo5 daa2 sek6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我摔断了手，医生要帮我打石膏。
examples.english_sentence: I broke my hand, the doctor needs to put a plaster cast on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波踢到腳腫晒，可能要打石膏固定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 tek3 dou3 goek3 zung2 saai3, ho2 nang4 yiu3 daa2 sek6 gou1 gu2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球踢到脚都肿了，可能要打石膏固定。
examples.english_sentence: He kicked the football and his foot swelled up, he might need a plaster cast to immobilize it.

english_meaning: to break; to smash; to defeat; to break (a record)
explanation_mandarin: 破坏，使完整的东西分成碎片；突破某种障碍或记录。
explanation_english: To break; to smash; to destroy the integrity of something. Can also mean to defeat or break a record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心打破咗隻玻璃杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 po3 zo2 zek3 bo1 lei1 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心打破了一个玻璃杯。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally broke a glass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打破咗世界紀錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 po3 zo2 sai3 gaai3 gei2 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打破了世界纪录。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the world record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打破沙煲問到篤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 po3 saa1 bou1 man6 dou3 duk1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打破沙锅问到底
examples.english_sentence: To get to the bottom of something; to pursue a matter to its conclusion (like breaking a clay pot to find out what's inside).

english_meaning: to break the silence
explanation_mandarin: 停止长时间的沉默，开始说话或表达意见。
explanation_english: To end a period of silence; to start speaking or expressing opinions after a long period of quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打破沉默，公開咗公司嘅秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 po3 cam4 muk6, gung1 hoi1 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打破沉默，公开了公司的秘密。
examples.english_sentence: They broke the silence and revealed the company's secrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁耐時間，終於有人打破沉默，講出真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 noi6 si4 gaan3, zung1 jyu1 jau5 jan4 daa2 po3 cam4 muk6, gong2 ceot1 zan1 seong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么长时间，终于有人打破沉默，说出真相。
examples.english_sentence: After so much time, someone finally broke the silence and told the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住打破沉默，主動同佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 daa2 po3 cam4 muk6, zyu2 dung6 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算打破沉默，主动和他说话。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to break the silence and take the initiative to talk to him.

english_meaning: DJing, to DJ, to spin records
explanation_mandarin: 指唱片骑师（DJ）通过操作唱机，混音台等设备播放音乐，进行音乐表演。
explanation_english: Refers to a DJ (Disc Jockey) playing music and performing by operating turntables, mixers, and other equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間酒吧打碟，啲音樂好正㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 baa1 daa2 dip6, di1 jam1 ngok6 hou2 zeng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在酒吧里做DJ，音乐很棒。
examples.english_sentence: He's DJing at the bar, the music is really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好想學打碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau2 hou2 soeng2 hok6 daa2 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很想学DJ。
examples.english_sentence: I really wanted to learn how to DJ when I was a kid.

english_meaning: to polish, to grind, to refine
explanation_mandarin: 通过研磨使物体表面光滑。比喻反复修改，使更加完善。
explanation_english: To polish or grind a surface to make it smooth; figuratively, to refine or perfect something through repeated revision and improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要打磨好份報告先可以交俾老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daa2 mo4 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 sin1 ho2 ji5 gaau1 bei2 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把这份报告打磨好才能交给老板。
examples.english_sentence: We need to polish this report before submitting it to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多時間去打磨佢嘅演技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 daa2 mo4 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间去打磨他的演技。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time refining his acting skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊玉石要打磨過先至會靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 yuk6 sek6 jiu3 daa2 mo4 gwo3 sin1 zi3 wui5 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块玉石要打磨过才会好看。
examples.english_sentence: This jade needs to be polished before it becomes beautiful.

english_meaning: to reap profits, to take advantage of a situation; to seize illicit gains
explanation_mandarin: 指在秋收时节趁机获取额外利益，引申为趁机占便宜，捞取好处。
explanation_english: Originally referred to taking advantage of the autumn harvest to gain extra benefits. Now it generally refers to taking advantage of a situation to gain an advantage or illicit gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣打秋豐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 daa2 cau1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在想着怎样占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to take advantage of situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺呢件事上面打秋豐啊，冇咁著數嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 min6 daa2 cau1 fung1 aa3, mou5 gam3 zoek3 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着可以在这件事上占便宜，没有那么好的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can take advantage of this situation; it's not that easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人專登搞啲嘢出嚟，就係想打秋豐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zyun1 dang3 gaau2 di1 je5 chut1 lai4, zau6 hai6 soeng2 daa2 cau1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人故意搞出一些事情，就是想要占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: Some people deliberately create problems just to take advantage of the situation.

english_meaning: to cadge, to sponge off someone, to freeload; to take advantage of someone's generosity
explanation_mandarin: 指藉着各种机会或名义向人索取财物，占小便宜。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of opportunities or pretexts to solicit money or goods from others, or to sponge off someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度打秋風，問人借錢又唔還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 daa2 cau1 fung1, man6 jan4 ze3 cin2 jau6 m4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里占便宜，问别人借钱又不还。
examples.english_sentence: He's always cadging here, borrowing money from people and not paying it back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠之後，佢就開始周圍打秋風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zau1 wai4 daa2 cau1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭之后，他就开始到处占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: After the company went bankrupt, he started freeloading everywhere.

mandarin_meaning: 播种; 埋下祸根; 留下种子
english_meaning: To sow seeds; to lay the groundwork for future problems; to leave a seed (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是播种，比喻义指为将来留下某种东西，可以是好的也可以是坏的。也可以指留下后代。
explanation_english: Literally means to sow seeds. Figuratively, it means to leave something for the future, which can be good or bad. It can also refer to leaving offspring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋諗住喺嗰度打種，等第日可以返嚟發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naam2 zyu6 hai2 go2 dou6 daa2 zung2, dang2 dai6 jat6 ho2 ji5 faan1 lai4 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打算在那里打下基础，等将来可以回来发展。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to lay the groundwork there, so they can come back and develop it in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做真係喺度打種，遲早會有麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 hai2 dou6 daa2 zung2, ci4 zou2 wui5 jau5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做真是在埋下祸根，迟早会有麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: What he's doing is really sowing the seeds of trouble; sooner or later, there will be problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚都咁耐，都未打種，屋企人都好心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 dou1 gam3 noi6, dou1 mei6 daa2 zung2, uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 hou2 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚都这么久了，还没留下后代，家里人都很着急。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for so long, but they haven't had children yet, and their family is very anxious.

mandarin_meaning: 攻击稻草人，树立稻草人论证
english_meaning: attacking a straw man, straw man argument
explanation_mandarin: 比喻歪曲对方的论点，使之易于攻击；或者虚构一个容易被驳倒的论点来攻击，从而误导听众。
explanation_english: To attack a straw man argument, which involves misrepresenting someone's argument to make it easier to attack. It means creating an easily refutable argument and attributing it to your opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日打稻草人啦，根本無人咁樣諗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 daa2 dou6 cou2 jan4 laa1, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 gam2 joeng2 nim2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是树立稻草人论证了，根本没有人这么想！
examples.english_sentence: Stop attacking a straw man argument all the time. No one even thinks that way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打稻草人，扭曲晒人哋嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 dou6 cou2 jan4, nau2 kuk1 saai3 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是树立稻草人论证，扭曲了别人的意思。
examples.english_sentence: He always attacks straw man arguments, distorting other people's meanings.

mandarin_meaning: 起草, 草稿, 撰稿
english_meaning: to draft, draft (noun), to write a draft, to prepare a script
explanation_mandarin: 指撰写文章、报告、演讲稿等的初步版本，即草稿。也指准备剧本、文案等。
explanation_english: To prepare a preliminary version of a document, report, speech, etc., i.e., a draft. Also refers to preparing a script, copywriting, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺聽日嘅會議之前打好份報告嘅稿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 ting1 jat6 ge3 wui6 ji5 zi1 cin4 daa2 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 gou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在明天的会议之前起草好这份报告的稿子。
examples.english_sentence: We need to draft the report before tomorrow's meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份演講稿仲未打好，佢仲要改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jin2 gong2 gou2 zung6 mei6 daa2 hou2, keoi5 zung6 jiu3 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲稿还没写好，他还需要修改。
examples.english_sentence: His speech draft is not finished yet, he still needs to revise it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廣告嘅打稿做得唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 ge3 daa2 gou2 zou6 dak1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个广告的草稿做得不错。
examples.english_sentence: The draft for this advertisement is well done.

mandarin_meaning: 使尴尬；使措手不及; 冒犯
english_meaning: to embarrass; to catch off guard; to offend (by being blunt or tactless)
explanation_mandarin: 指说话或行为不顾及对方的感受，使对方感到尴尬或不知所措。也指无意中冒犯了别人。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking or acting without considering the other person's feelings, causing them to feel embarrassed or caught off guard. Also refers to unintentionally offending someone, often due to being blunt or tactless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講嘢，好打突兀㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5, hou2 daa2 dat6 ngat6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说话，很让人尴尬的！
examples.english_sentence: The way you speak is very embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係想打突兀你，但我都要講真話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 daa2 dat6 ngat6 nei5, daan6 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 gong2 zan1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是想让你难堪，但我还是要说实话。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to embarrass you, but I have to tell the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我頭先句嘢可能打突兀咗你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 tau4 sin1 geoi3 je5 ho2 nang4 daa2 dat6 ngat6 zo2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我刚才那句话可能冒犯了你。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I might have offended you with what I said just now.

english_meaning: to interrupt, to cut someone off (speaking), to hinder, to obstruct
explanation_mandarin: 打断别人的说话或阻碍某事进展。
explanation_english: To interrupt someone's speech or hinder the progress of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以唔好成日打窒人講嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 daa2 zat6 jan4 gong2 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能不要老是打断别人说话呀？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please not interrupt people all the time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲暴雨打窒咗工程嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bou6 jyu5 daa2 zat6 zo2 gung1 cing4 ge3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴雨阻碍了工程的进度。
examples.english_sentence: The heavy rain hindered the progress of the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅時候俾人打窒，好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 si4 hau6 bei2 jan4 daa2 zat6, hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的时候被人打断了，很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He was interrupted while speaking and felt very unhappy.

english_meaning: hole punch, paper punch
explanation_mandarin: 一种在纸上打孔的工具，通常用于装订文件。
explanation_english: A tool used to create holes in paper, typically for binding documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部打窿機好耐用，用咗十年都冇壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 daa2 lung1 gei1 hou2 noi6 yung6, yung6 zo2 sap6 nin4 dou1 mou5 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台打孔机很耐用，用了十年都没坏。
examples.english_sentence: This hole punch is very durable; it hasn't broken even after ten years of use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該借個打窿機嚟打幾個窿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 je3 go3 daa2 lung1 gei1 lai4 daa2 gei2 go3 lung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请借一个打孔机来打几个孔。
examples.english_sentence: Please lend me a hole punch to punch a few holes.

english_meaning: to somersault, to tumble
explanation_mandarin: 一种身体运动，将身体倒立，双脚翻过头顶。
explanation_english: A physical activity involving turning the body upside down and rotating the feet over the head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度打緊筋斗，睇落好叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 daa2 gan1 dau2, tai2 lok6 hou2 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在那里翻筋斗，看起来很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing somersaults over there, he looks very skillful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日喺公園打筋斗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 yun2 daa2 gan1 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常在公园里翻筋斗。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I often did somersaults in the park.

english_meaning: to plan, to intend, plan, intention
explanation_mandarin: 动词：计划，盘算，筹划。名词：计划，意图。
explanation_english: Verb: To plan, to intend. Noun: A plan, an intention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今個星期六有咩打算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 jau5 me1 daa2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个星期六有什么计划吗？
examples.english_sentence: What are your plans for this Saturday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇任何打算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 jam6 ho4 daa2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有任何计划。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have any plans.

english_meaning: to calculate; to plan; to scheme
explanation_mandarin: 原指用算盘计算，引申为计划、算计，通常带有精打细算或算计他人的含义。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to calculating with an abacus. By extension, it means to plan, to calculate, often with the implication of being calculating, scheming, or being very meticulous with one's plans, sometimes to the point of being calculating at the expense of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打算盤，好少蝕底嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 syun3 pun4, hou2 siu2 sit6 dai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是很会算计，很少吃亏的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always calculating and rarely suffers a loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住打算盤，有時都要顧下人哋嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 daa2 syun3 pun4, jau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 gu3 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着算计，有时候也要顾及别人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be thinking about scheming; sometimes you need to consider other people's feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好識打算盤，成本控制得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 sik1 daa2 syun3 pun4, sing4 bun2 hung3 zai3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很会精打细算，成本控制得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This company knows how to calculate well; they control costs very well.

english_meaning: to update a bank book/passbook; to print the transaction history on a bank book
explanation_mandarin: 指到银行柜台或使用自助设备在存折上打印交易记录，更新存折上的信息。
explanation_english: To update a bank book (passbook) by printing the transaction history, either at a bank counter or using a self-service machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去銀行打簿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 daa2 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去银行打印存折。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the bank to update my passbook today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部自動櫃員機可以打簿㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 zi6 dung6 gwai6 yun4 gei1 ho2 ji5 daa2 bou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台自动柜员机可以打印存折。
examples.english_sentence: This ATM can update passbooks.

english_meaning: to collude, to conspire, to act in cahoots
explanation_mandarin: 指暗中勾结、串通，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: To collude, conspire, or act in cahoots with someone, often in a secretive or underhanded manner. It usually has negative connotations, suggesting that the parties involved are working together to deceive or manipulate others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打籠通嚟呃我錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 lung1 tung1 lai4 ngaak1 ngo5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们串通起来骗我的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They colluded to cheat me out of my money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同佢打籠通，我唔想畀人知㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 daa2 lung1 tung1, ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要和他串通，我不想被人知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't collude with him, I don't want people to know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以同黑社會打籠通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 hak1 se6 wui2 daa2 lung1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不可以和黑社会勾结。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot collude with the triads.

english_meaning: to tie a knot; to knot; to get tangled; to jam; to have a mental block
explanation_mandarin: 1. 把绳子等打成结。2. 比喻思路受阻，无法思考。
explanation_english: 1. To tie a knot, e.g., in a rope. 2. (Figurative) To get tangled; to be in a jam; to have a mental block; to be confused and unable to think clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩打咗個結，解唔開啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sing2 daa2 zo2 go3 git3, gaai2 m4 hoi1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 绳子打了个结，解不开啊。
examples.english_sentence: The rope has a knot, I can't untie it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗到打結，咩都諗唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 dou3 daa2 git3, me1 dou1 lam2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想到脑子打结，什么都想不出来。
examples.english_sentence: I have a mental block; I can't think of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條頸鏈打咗個結。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 geng2 lin2 daa2 zo2 go3 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 项链打了个结。
examples.english_sentence: The necklace is knotted.

english_meaning: to tie a knot; to knot
explanation_mandarin: 用绳子等缠绕、系在一起形成结。
explanation_english: To tie a knot, usually with string or rope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我打纈個袋口佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 daa2 git3 go3 doi2 hau2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我把袋子的口打个结吧。
examples.english_sentence: Help me tie a knot on the mouth of the bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條鞋帶鬆咗，打纈佢先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 haai4 daai2 sung1 zo2, daa2 git3 keoi5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鞋带松了，先把它打个结吧。
examples.english_sentence: The shoelace is loose, let's tie a knot in it first.

english_meaning: to beat and scold; physical and verbal abuse
explanation_mandarin: 指用暴力殴打和用语言责骂。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of both physically hitting and verbally scolding someone; involving both physical and verbal abuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打罵啲細路，真係好唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daa2 maa6 di1 sai3 lou2, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是打骂小孩，真是不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: He always beats and scolds the children, it's really irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意小朋友喺街度打罵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sai3 peng4 jau5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 daa2 maa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢小孩子在街上打闹。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like children fighting and scolding on the street.

english_meaning: to knock over, to spill, to overturn
explanation_mandarin: 使物体倾倒，使里面的东西溢出。
explanation_english: To cause something to fall over or spill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我唔小心打翻咗杯嘢飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 faan1 zo2 bui1 je5 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我不小心打翻了杯饮料。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I accidentally spilled the drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嬲就打翻晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nau1 zau6 daa2 faan1 saai3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生气就把东西都打翻了。
examples.english_sentence: He overturns everything when he gets angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車轉彎嗰陣打翻咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zyun3 waan1 go2 zan6 daa2 faan1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车转弯的时候翻车了。
examples.english_sentence: The car overturned when it was turning.

english_meaning: to snitch, to rat out, to tell tales
explanation_mandarin: 指向别人告发某人，通常指告发给长辈或上级。
explanation_english: To snitch on someone, usually to elders or superiors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日打耳呀，好乞人憎㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 daa2 ji5 aa3, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是打小报告啊，很令人讨厌的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always snitch, it's very annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打耳畀阿Sir話我哋上堂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 ji5 bei2 aa3 Sir1 waa6 ngo5 dei6 soeng5 tong4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是打小报告给老师说我们上课讲话。
examples.english_sentence: He always snitches to the teacher about us talking in class.

english_meaning: to inquire about; to ask about; to find out
explanation_mandarin: 询问、探听消息。
explanation_english: To make inquiries or ask around in order to find out information about something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打聽過，佢哋間公司待遇幾好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 teng1 gwo3, keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 doi6 jyu6 gei2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打听过了，他们公司待遇挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: I've inquired about it, their company's benefits are quite good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打聽吓邊度有平啲嘅蔬菜賣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 teng1 haa5 bin1 dou6 jau5 peng4 di1 ge3 so1 coi3 maai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打听一下哪里有便宜一点的蔬菜卖吧。
examples.english_sentence: Ask around to see where there are cheaper vegetables for sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想打聽吓佢搬咗去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 daa2 teng1 haa5 keoi5 bun1 zo2 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想打听一下他搬到哪里去了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to find out where he moved to.

english_meaning: to make a phone call, to phone
explanation_mandarin: 用电话进行通话。
explanation_english: To make a phone call to someone; to phone someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏啲打聾通俾你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 di1 daa2 lung4 tung1 bei2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚点打电话给你吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll give you a call later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你打聾通問下佢聽日得唔得閒呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 daa2 lung4 tung1 man6 haa5 keoi5 ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你打电话问问他明天有没有空。
examples.english_sentence: Please give him a call and ask if he's free tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打聾通騷擾人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 lung4 tung1 sau1 jiu2 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是打电话骚扰别人。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes phone calls to harass people.

english_meaning: To talk behind someone's back; to gossip about someone.
explanation_mandarin: 在背后议论别人，说别人的坏话。
explanation_english: To talk about someone negatively when they are not present; to engage in gossip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺度打背語啦，有咩咪直接同佢講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 daa2 bui3 jyu5 laa1, jau5 me1 mai6 zik6 zip3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是在这里背后议论别人，有什么就直接跟他说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always talk behind people's backs here. If you have something to say, just tell them directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最憎啲人打背語，當面就笑騎騎，轉過頭就話你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zang1 di1 jan4 daa2 bui3 jyu5, dong1 min6 zau6 siu3 ke4 ke4, zyun2 gwo3 tau4 zau6 waa6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最讨厌那些背后议论人的人，当面就笑嘻嘻的，转过头就说你。
examples.english_sentence: I hate people who talk behind your back. They're all smiles to your face, but then they talk about you behind your back.

english_meaning: to have an abortion
explanation_mandarin: 人工终止妊娠，即人工流产。
explanation_english: To terminate a pregnancy by artificial means; to have an abortion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣打過幾次胎，依家想生都好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 daa2 gwo3 gei2 ci3 toi1, ji1 gaa1 soeng2 saang1 dou1 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她年轻的时候堕过几次胎，现在想生都很难。
examples.english_sentence: She had several abortions when she was young, and now it's difficult for her to get pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打胎對個女人嘅身體好傷嘅，要諗清楚先好做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 toi1 deoi3 go3 neoi5 jan2 ge3 san1 tai2 hou2 soeng1 ge3, jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堕胎对女人的身体伤害很大，要考虑清楚再做。
examples.english_sentence: Having an abortion is very harmful to a woman's body, so you need to think carefully before doing it.

jyutping: daa2 zung2 min6 cung1 fei4 zai2
english_meaning: To slap one's face until it's swollen to look like a fat person; to pretend to be rich or well-off when one is not; to keep up appearances; to try to impress others by spending money one doesn't have.
explanation_mandarin: 形容明明经济实力不足，却为了面子装作很有钱的样子。比喻为了虚荣而勉强做自己做不到的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who pretends to be wealthy or capable despite lacking the resources to do so. It's about maintaining a facade and trying to impress others, often to one's own detriment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明冇乜錢，但係成日買貴嘢，真係打腫面充肥仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 mou5 mat1 cin2, daan6 hai6 seng4 jat6 maai5 gwai3 je5, zan1 hai6 daa2 zung2 min6 cung1 fei4 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明没什么钱，但是总是买贵的东西，真是打肿脸充胖子。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly doesn't have much money, but he's always buying expensive things. He's really just slapping his face to look like a fat guy (trying to appear rich).

english_meaning: to give a foot massage; to massage the soles of the feet
explanation_mandarin: 指通过按摩脚底来达到放松或治疗的目的。
explanation_english: Refers to giving a foot massage, usually to relax or for therapeutic purposes. It involves massaging the soles of the feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日行嚟行去，好攰呀，好想搵人打腳骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3, hou2 leoi5 aa3, hou2 soeng2 wan2 jan4 daa2 goek3 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我整天走来走去，很累啊，很想找人按摩脚底。
examples.english_sentence: I've been walking around all day, I'm so tired, I really want someone to give me a foot massage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間按摩鋪頭嘅打腳骨手勢好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 on3 mo1 pou3 tau2 ge3 daa2 goek3 gwat1 sau2 sai3 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间按摩店的脚底按摩技术很好。
examples.english_sentence: The foot massage skills at that massage parlor are really good.

english_meaning: to slap in the face; to lose face; to be discredited; to be proven wrong; to be contradicted
explanation_mandarin: 比喻使人丢脸，或者自己的言行被事实证明是错误的。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to cause someone to lose face, or to have one's words or actions proven wrong by the facts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁講嘢，擺明就係想打我哋臉囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 gong2 je5, baai2 ming4 zau6 hai6 soeng2 daa2 ngo5 dei6 lim5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样说话，摆明就是想打我们的脸。
examples.english_sentence: The way he's talking, it's obvious he's trying to make us lose face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔信佢講嘅嘢，遲早會俾事實打臉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, ci4 zou2 wui5 bei2 si6 sat6 daa2 lim5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不相信他说的话，迟早会被事实打脸的。
examples.english_sentence: I don't believe what he said. Sooner or later, he'll be proven wrong by the facts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前話樓價唔會跌，依家跌到咁，真係俾市場打晒臉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 waa6 lau2 gaa3 m4 wui5 dit3, ji1 gaa1 dit3 dou3 gam2, zan1 hai6 bei2 si5 coeng4 daa2 saai3 lim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前说房价不会跌，现在跌成这样，真是被市场打脸了。
examples.english_sentence: He previously said that housing prices would not fall. Now that they have fallen so much, he has really been proven wrong by the market.

english_meaning: to thicken (sauce, soup, etc.) with cornstarch/flour
explanation_mandarin: 用淀粉或面粉等使汤汁、酱汁等变浓稠。
explanation_english: To thicken a liquid (sauce, soup, gravy, etc.) by adding a starch-based ingredient like cornstarch, potato starch, or flour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個汁要打芡先會夠濃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zap1 jiu3 daa2 hin3 sin1 wui5 gau3 nung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个酱汁要勾芡才会浓稠。
examples.english_sentence: This sauce needs to be thickened with cornstarch to be thick enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽煮餸成日都打芡，啲餸汁撈飯一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zyu2 sung3 sing4 jat6 dou1 daa2 hin3, di1 sung3 zap1 lou1 faan6 jat1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈做菜总是勾芡，那些菜汁拌饭一流。
examples.english_sentence: My mother always thickens the sauce when cooking, the sauce mixed with rice is amazing.

english_meaning: to doze off; to nod off; to snooze
explanation_mandarin: 指短时间地睡着，通常是无意识的。
explanation_english: Refers to falling asleep for a short period of time, usually unconsciously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晏晝食飽飯好易打茄侖嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan3 zau3 sik6 baau2 faan6 hou2 ji6 daa2 ke1 leon4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下午吃饱饭很容易打瞌睡的。
examples.english_sentence: It's easy to doze off after having a full meal in the afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，佢忍唔住打咗陣茄侖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 daa2 zo2 zan6 ke1 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他忍不住打了个盹儿。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, he couldn't help but doze off for a while.

english_meaning: to French kiss; to make out
explanation_mandarin: 指情侣之间的一种深吻，通常带有性暗示。
explanation_english: Refers to a deep kiss between lovers, usually with sexual undertones; to French kiss, to make out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺公園度打茄輪，畀人見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 daa2 ke1 leon4, bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在公园里法式接吻，被人看到了。
examples.english_sentence: They were French kissing in the park and got caught.

mandarin_meaning: 作弊, 耍赖, 钻空子
english_meaning: to cheat, to play dirty, to bend the rules, to exploit loopholes
explanation_mandarin: 指在游戏中或竞争中，不遵守规则，利用规则漏洞或作弊来获取优势的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of not following the rules, exploiting loopholes, or cheating in a game or competition to gain an advantage. It implies unfairness and a lack of integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打茅波，所以冇人想同佢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 maau4 bo1, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是作弊，所以没人想和他玩。
examples.english_sentence: He always cheats, so no one wants to play with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打茅波啊，要公平競爭！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 maau4 bo1 aa3, jiu3 gung1 ping4 ging6 zang1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要作弊，要公平竞争！
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat, compete fairly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司打茅波避稅，結果俾政府罰錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 daa2 maau4 bo1 bei6 seoi3, git3 gwo2 bei2 zing3 fu2 fat6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司通过钻空子来避税，结果被政府罚款。
examples.english_sentence: The company avoided taxes by exploiting loopholes, and as a result, was fined by the government.

english_meaning: to beat the grass to scare the snake; to alert the enemy by rash action; to reveal one's intentions prematurely
explanation_mandarin: 比喻行事不密，使对方有所警觉，预先防备。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to alert the enemy by rash action, giving them advance warning. It describes a situation where one's actions inadvertently reveal their intentions, allowing the opponent to prepare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋查緊單案，唔好打草驚蛇，費時佢哋走佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 caa4 gan2 daan1 ngon3, m4 hou2 daa2 cou2 ging1 se4, fai3 si4 keoi5 dei6 zau2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在调查这件案子，不要打草惊蛇，免得他们逃跑了。
examples.english_sentence: We are investigating this case, so don't alert the suspects, otherwise they will run away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家問佢啲嘢，咪即係打草驚蛇囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 man6 keoi5 di1 je5, mai1 zik1 hai6 daa2 cou2 ging1 se4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在问他这些事，不就是打草惊蛇吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're asking him about these things now, aren't you just alerting him?

english_meaning: kitchen helper (especially one who prepares ingredients and plates dishes)
explanation_mandarin: 粤菜厨房术语，指在厨房里负责配菜、装盘等辅助工作的员工。
explanation_english: A Cantonese kitchen term referring to the kitchen helper whose responsibilities include preparing ingredients, plating dishes, and other auxiliary tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺酒樓做打荷，日日都好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zau2 lau4 zou6 daa2 ho4, jat1 jat1 dou1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在酒楼做配菜员，每天都很忙。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a kitchen helper in a restaurant and is very busy every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇少打荷，佢哋都好重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 daa2 ho4, keoi5 dei6 dou1 hou2 cung5 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看配菜员，他们都很重要的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate the kitchen helpers, they are all very important.

english_meaning: to pickpocket; pickpocket
explanation_mandarin: 指偷窃别人钱包的人，或指进行偷钱包的行为。
explanation_english: To pickpocket (verb) or a pickpocket (noun). Refers to stealing a wallet from someone's pocket or bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇住你個荷包呀，呢度好多人打荷包㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 zyu6 nei5 go3 ho4 baau1 aa3, ni1 dou6 ho2 do1 jan4 daa2 ho4 baau1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看着你的钱包，这里很多人是扒手。
examples.english_sentence: Watch your wallet, there are a lot of pickpockets here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺地鐵俾人打荷包，唔見咗成千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dei6 tit3 bei2 jan4 daa2 ho4 baau1, m4 gin3 zo2 seng4 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在地铁被人扒窃，丢了一千块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He was pickpocketed on the subway and lost a thousand dollars.

english_meaning: To kick someone when they are down; to hit a person when they are already struggling; to pile on someone who is already in a weakened or vulnerable position.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻攻击已经失势或身处困境的人。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to attacking someone who has already lost power or is in a difficult situation. It is often used negatively to describe behavior considered unsportsmanlike or cruel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都輸到咁慘，你就唔好打落水狗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 syu1 dou3 gam3 caam2, nei5 zau6 m4 hou2 daa2 lok6 seoi2 gau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都输得这么惨了，你就不要痛打落水狗了。
examples.english_sentence: He has already lost so badly; you shouldn't kick him when he's down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到人哋有麻煩就打落水狗，真係好冇品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 yan4 dei6 jau5 maa4 faan4 zau6 daa2 lok6 seoi2 gau2, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到别人有麻烦就痛打落水狗，真是很没品。
examples.english_sentence: It's really tasteless to kick people when they are down and in trouble.

english_meaning: To cane; to flog with a rattan cane
explanation_mandarin: 用藤条鞭打，通常指体罚，尤其是在学校。
explanation_english: To cane someone, typically referring to corporal punishment, especially in schools. It refers to hitting someone with a rattan cane as a form of punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲老師成日打藤嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 lou5 si1 seng4 jat6 daa2 tang4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的老师经常用藤条打人。
examples.english_sentence: Teachers used to cane students a lot in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日唔聽話，所以俾阿爸打藤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 m4 teng1 waa6, so2 ji5 bei2 aa3 baa4 daa2 tang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常不听话，所以被爸爸用藤条打。
examples.english_sentence: He often misbehaved when he was young, so his father caned him.

english_meaning: to swindle, to rip off; to take advantage of someone
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当手段获取利益，敲诈勒索或占人便宜。
explanation_english: Refers to obtaining benefits through illegitimate means, swindling, extorting, or taking advantage of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住打蛇，想唔勞而獲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 daa2 se4, soeng2 m4 lou4 ji4 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着敲诈勒索，想不劳而获。
examples.english_sentence: He is always thinking of swindling people, wanting to gain without effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易俾人打蛇呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 daa2 se4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易被人占便宜啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so easily taken advantage of by others.

mandarin_meaning: 打蛇打七寸 (dǎ shé dǎ qī cùn)
english_meaning: To strike a snake, strike its seven inches (from the head); to strike at the heart of the matter; to get straight to the point; to attack where it hurts.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做事要抓住要害，找准关键；要抓住问题的核心，才能有效地解决问题。
explanation_english: This idiom means to grasp the essentials when doing things and find the key point; to grasp the core of the problem in order to solve it effectively. It suggests directly addressing the most important aspect of a problem to achieve the best results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係講埋啲廢話，打蛇打七寸，直接講你想要啲乜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gong2 maai4 di1 fai3 waa6, daa2 se4 daa2 cat1 cyun3, zik6 zip3 gong2 nei5 soeng2 jiu3 di1 mat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只说那些废话，打蛇打七寸，直接说你想要什么吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk nonsense, get straight to the point, just say what you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，就要打蛇打七寸，搞清楚問題嘅根源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, zau6 jiu3 daa2 se4 daa2 cat1 cyun3, gaau2 cing1 co2 man6 tai4 ge3 gan1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，就要打蛇打七寸，搞清楚问题的根源。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, you need to get straight to the point and find out the root cause of the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 顺杆爬, 趁势, 得寸进尺
english_meaning: To seize an opportunity; to take advantage of a situation; to capitalize on someone's weakness; to push one's luck.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻抓住机会，进一步谋取利益；也指得寸进尺。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to take advantage of a situation when it presents itself, often in an opportunistic or even slightly unethical way. It can also describe someone who pushes their luck and takes things too far after gaining a small advantage. The literal translation is 'beat the snake along the stick', suggesting that once you start hitting the snake, you continue to do so using the stick as leverage to ensure it's thoroughly beaten (and taking the advantage to the fullest).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗少少甜頭你，你就打蛇隨棍上，問佢借埋錢，咁樣唔係幾好喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 siu2 siu2 tim4 tau4 nei5, nei5 zau6 daa2 se4 ceoi4 gwan3 soeng5, man6 keoi5 ze3 maai4 cin2, gam2 joeng2 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了你一点好处，你就顺杆爬，还问他借钱，这样做不太好吧。
examples.english_sentence: He gave you a small favor, and you took advantage of it to ask him to borrow money. That's not very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細讚咗佢一句，佢就打蛇隨棍上，要求升職加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 zaan3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 geoi3, keoi5 zau6 daa2 se4 ceoi4 gwan3 soeng5, jiu1 kiu4 sing1 zik1 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板夸了他一句，他就趁势要求升职加薪。
examples.english_sentence: The boss praised him once, and he immediately took the opportunity to ask for a promotion and a raise.

english_meaning: to form a long, winding queue (like a snake); to be in a very long queue
explanation_mandarin: 形容队伍非常长，蜿蜒曲折，像一条蛇一样。
explanation_english: Describes a queue that is very long and winding, resembling a snake. It implies a large number of people waiting in line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日銀行搞乜嘢啊？出面打晒蛇餅咁款！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngan4 hong4 gaau2 mat1 je5 aa3? ceot1 min6 daa2 saai3 se4 beng2 gam2 kwan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天银行在做什么啊？外面排了很长的队伍！
examples.english_sentence: What's going on at the bank today? There's a massive queue outside!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會飛開賣，排隊嘅人打晒蛇餅，唔知幾時先買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 hoi1 maai6, paai4 deoi2 ge3 jan4 daa2 saai3 se4 beng2, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会门票开售，排队的人排成长队，不知道什么时候才能买到。
examples.english_sentence: The concert tickets went on sale, and the queue was so long, like a snake. I don't know when I'll be able to buy them.

english_meaning: to beat eggs, to whisk eggs
explanation_mandarin: 把鸡蛋搅散，通常为了烹饪的目的。
explanation_english: To beat eggs, usually for cooking purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚整蛋糕，要打蛋啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 zing2 daan6 gou1, jiu3 daa2 daan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚做蛋糕，要打鸡蛋啊。
examples.english_sentence: We're making a cake tonight, we need to beat the eggs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打蛋嘅時候要輕手啲，唔好整到周圍都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 daan2 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 hing1 sau2 di1, m4 hou2 zing2 dou3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打鸡蛋的时候要轻一点，别弄得到处都是。
examples.english_sentence: Be gentle when beating the eggs, don't make a mess everywhere.

english_meaning: to wax (a floor, car, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 给物体表面涂抹蜡，使其光亮或起到保护作用。
explanation_english: To apply wax to a surface (like a floor, car, or furniture) in order to polish it and give it a shine, or to protect it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要打蠟，整返靚架車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 daa2 laap6, zing2 faan1 leng3 gaa3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要打蜡，把车弄漂亮点。
examples.english_sentence: I need to wax the car tomorrow and make it look nice again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日打蠟，所以屋企啲地板好令。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 daa2 laap6, so2 ji5 uk1 kei2 di1 dei6 baan2 hou2 leng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常打蜡，所以家里的地板很亮。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma waxes the floor often, so the floors at home are very shiny.

english_meaning: to play street basketball
explanation_mandarin: 指在街头或户外场地打篮球，通常是非正式的比赛。
explanation_english: To play basketball in a street or outdoor setting, typically referring to informal games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日放學就去公園打街波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 fong3 hok6 zau6 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 daa2 gaai1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常放学后就去公园打街头篮球。
examples.english_sentence: We often go to the park to play street basketball after school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打街波好勁㗎，成日贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gaai1 bo1 hou2 ging6 gaa3, sing4 jat6 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打街头篮球很厉害，经常赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's really good at street basketball, he always wins.

english_meaning: to pleat, to fold
explanation_mandarin: 指在布料上压出褶皱，通常是为了美观或调整尺寸。
explanation_english: To create pleats or folds in fabric, usually for aesthetic purposes or to adjust the size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙要打褶先好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 jiu3 daa2 zip3 sin1 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子要打褶才好看。
examples.english_sentence: This skirt looks better with pleats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我哋打褶，等件衫啱身啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 daa2 zip3, dang2 gin6 saam1 ngaam1 san1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我们打褶，让衣服更合身。
examples.english_sentence: He pleated it for us, so the clothes fit better.

english_meaning: to tease, to joke, to jest
explanation_mandarin: 指以玩笑的方式取笑或戏弄别人，使其感到有趣或尴尬。
explanation_english: Refers to teasing or joking with someone in a playful way, making them feel amused or embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日打豆我啦，我都唔好意思喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 daa2 dau6-2 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 dou1 m4 hou2 ji3 si3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是取笑我了，我都觉得不好意思了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tease me, I'm starting to feel embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打豆啲同事，不過佢哋都唔介意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daa2 dau6-2 di1 tung4 si6, bat1 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 dou1 m4 gaai3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常跟同事们开玩笑，但是他们都不介意。
examples.english_sentence: He often teases his colleagues, but they don't mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係打豆吓你啫，唔好咁認真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 daa2 dau6-2 haa5 nei5 ze1, m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是跟你开玩笑而已，不要那么认真。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just teasing you, don't take it so seriously.

english_meaning: to lie; to tell a lie
explanation_mandarin: 指说谎，欺骗人。是一个口语化的表达。
explanation_english: To lie, to deceive someone. This is a colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打貓，唔好信佢講嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 maau1, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是撒谎，不要相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He always lies, don't believe what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好打貓喇，我知你冇做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 maau1 laa3, ngo5 zi1 nei5 mou5 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别撒谎了，我知道你没做功课。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lie, I know you haven't done your homework.

english_meaning: to give a tip; to reward (with money or gifts); to donate
explanation_mandarin: 给予金钱或礼物作为奖励、赞赏或鼓励。
explanation_english: To give money or gifts as a reward, appreciation, or encouragement. It's similar to giving a tip, but can also refer to donating to creators or performers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺網上睇直播嘅時候，有時會打賞啲主播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng5 tai2 zik6 bo3 ge3 si4 hau6, jau5 si4 wui2 daa2 soeng2 di1 zyu2 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在网上看直播的时候，有时候会打赏主播。
examples.english_sentence: When I watch live streams online, sometimes I tip the streamers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日喺街頭表演打鼓，好多人打賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 tau4 biu2 jin2 daa2 gu2, hou2 do1 jan4 daa2 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天在街头表演打鼓，很多人打赏他。
examples.english_sentence: He was busking playing drums yesterday, and many people gave him tips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你覺得佢做得好，不妨打賞吓佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 zou6 dak1 hou2, bat1 fong4 daa2 soeng2 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你觉得他做得好，不妨打赏一下他吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you think he did a good job, why not give him a tip?

english_meaning: to bet, to wager
explanation_mandarin: 就某事的结果进行猜测并用财物作抵押。
explanation_english: To make a bet; to wager something of value on the outcome of an uncertain event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如打賭，睇下邊個會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 daa2 dou2, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 wui5 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如打个赌，看看谁会赢。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we make a bet to see who will win?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢打賭，佢一定會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 daa2 dou2, keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 chi4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他打赌，他一定会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: I bet him that he would be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你敢唔敢同我打賭？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 m4 gam2 tung4 ngo5 daa2 dou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你敢不敢和我打赌？
examples.english_sentence: Do you dare to bet with me?

english_meaning: to go topless; to be shirtless
explanation_mandarin: 指不穿上衣，赤裸着上半身。
explanation_english: Refers to going topless, with the upper body bare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路仔夏天成日打赤肋周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 zai2 haa6 tin1 seng4 jat6 daa2 cek3 lek1 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些小孩子夏天总是光着膀子到处跑。
examples.english_sentence: Those kids are always running around topless in the summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺沙灘度打赤肋曬太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 saa1 taan1 dou6 daa2 cek3 lek1 saai3 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在沙滩上光着膀子晒太阳。
examples.english_sentence: He's sunbathing topless on the beach.

english_meaning: to go barefoot; barefooted
explanation_mandarin: 指不穿鞋子，光着脚。
explanation_english: To go without shoes on; to be barefooted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺沙灘打赤腳行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 saa1 taan1 daa2 cek3 goek3 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢在沙滩上赤脚走路。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to walk barefoot on the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日打赤腳周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 daa2 cek3 goek3 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常赤脚到处走。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went barefoot everywhere.

english_meaning: to start, to cheer up, to dress up (elaborately)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 开始，发起：指开始做某事。2. 振作：指精神振作起来。3. 打扮：指精心打扮。
explanation_english: 1. To start, to initiate: to begin doing something. 2. To cheer up: to become energized and spirited. 3. To dress up (elaborately): to put on fancy or elaborate clothing and accessories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋打起精神，一齊諗辦法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 daa2 hei2 zing1 san4, jat1 cai4 nam2 bun6 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们振作起来，一起想办法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we cheer up and think of a solution together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日打起晒，唔知去邊度？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2 hei2 saai3, m4 zi1 heoi3 bin1 dou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天精心打扮，不知道去哪里？
examples.english_sentence: She's all dressed up today, I wonder where she's going?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打起場波先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 hei2 coeng4 bo1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先开始一场球赛吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's start a ball game first.

english_meaning: to tease, to make fun of, to banter
explanation_mandarin: 用言语或行动逗人发笑或开心，有时略带戏弄。
explanation_english: To tease or joke with someone, often in a lighthearted or playful way. It implies a degree of amusement and can sometimes involve gentle ridicule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都打趣我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daa2 ceoi3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是取笑我。
examples.english_sentence: He always teases me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁打趣佢啦，佢嬲嬲哋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 daa2 ceoi3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 nau1 nau1 dei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样取笑他了，他有点生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease him like that, he's getting a little angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺度打趣緊佢個新髮型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 daa2 ceoi3 gan2 keoi5 go3 san1 faat3 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在取笑他的新发型。
examples.english_sentence: We are making fun of his new hairstyle.

english_meaning: To cripple; to disable; to incapacitate; to undermine someone's ability to act or compete.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是打断腿使其跛行。比喻使人失去能力或竞争力，使其处于不利地位。
explanation_english: Literally means to break someone's leg, causing them to limp. Figuratively, it means to cripple someone, making them unable to function or compete effectively; to undermine their abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後搞小動作，想打跛我哋公司嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 gaau2 siu2 dung6 zok3, soeng2 daa2 bai2 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在背后搞小动作，想阻碍我们公司的发展。
examples.english_sentence: He's always scheming behind our backs, trying to cripple our company's development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅新政策可能會打跛啲小型企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 zing3 caak3 ho2 nang4 wui5 daa2 bai2 di1 siu2 jing4 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的新政策可能会使小型企业受到打击。
examples.english_sentence: The government's new policies might cripple small businesses.

english_meaning: to nudge with the elbow; to elbow someone
explanation_mandarin: 用胳膊肘轻轻撞击某人，通常为了引起注意或暗示。
explanation_english: To nudge someone gently with the elbow, usually to get their attention or give them a subtle hint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戲院打踭我，叫我唔好講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hei3 yun2 daa2 zaang1 ngo5, giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影院用胳膊肘碰我，叫我不要说话。
examples.english_sentence: He elbowed me in the cinema, telling me not to talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺條隊度打踭，排隊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 tiu4 deoi2 dou6 daa2 zaang1, paai4 deoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在队伍里用胳膊肘挤来挤去，排队吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't elbow your way through the line, queue up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打踭佢一下，暗示佢唔好再講落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zaang1 keoi5 jat1 haa5, am3 si6 keoi5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用胳膊肘碰了他一下，暗示他不要再说下去了。
examples.english_sentence: I nudged him with my elbow, hinting that he shouldn't continue speaking.

english_meaning: to buy in bulk; wholesale
explanation_mandarin: 指一次性大量购买货物，通常是为了获得更低的价格。
explanation_english: To buy goods in large quantities at a wholesale price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司專門打躉海鮮返嚟賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 daa2 dan2 hoi2 sin1 faan1 lai4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司专门批量进购海鲜来卖。
examples.english_sentence: Their company specializes in buying seafood in bulk to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你买得多，可以打躉，会平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 maai5 dak1 do1, ho2 ji5 daa2 dan2, wui5 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你买的多，可以批发，会便宜点。
examples.english_sentence: If you buy more, you can buy in bulk, it will be cheaper.

english_meaning: to trip, to stumble, to fall over (often unintentionally)
explanation_mandarin: 行走时被东西绊倒，身体失去平衡而跌倒。
explanation_english: To stumble or trip over something while walking, causing a loss of balance and a fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先喺條街度打躓，差啲跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 daa2 zi3, caa1 di1 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在街上绊倒了，差点摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: I tripped on the street just now, almost fell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得太快，結果打躓咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dak1 taai3 faai3, git3 gwo2 daa2 zi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走得太快，结果绊倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He walked too fast and ended up tripping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，前面有個窿，好易打躓㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, cin4 min6 jau5 go3 lung1, hou2 ji6 daa2 zi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，前面有个洞，很容易绊倒的。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, there's a hole ahead, it's easy to trip over.

english_meaning: French kiss, to make out
explanation_mandarin: 指长时间、热情的亲吻，通常带有舌头的接触。形容情侣之间激烈的接吻。
explanation_english: Refers to a long and passionate kiss, usually involving tongue contact. Describes an intense kiss between lovers, making out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺公園打車輪，俾人見到好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 daa2 ce1 leon4, bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2 hou2 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在公园里舌吻，被人看到很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: They were French kissing in the park, it was embarrassing to be seen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後生仔成日喺街度打車輪，都唔知醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 daa2 ce1 leon4, dou1 m4 zi1 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人总是在大街上接吻，都不知道害羞。
examples.english_sentence: Young people are always making out in the street, they have no shame.

english_meaning: to circle; to revolve; to spin around; to mill about; to be preoccupied (with a thought)
explanation_mandarin: 围绕一个中心点转动；也指心里一直想着某件事，无法摆脱。
explanation_english: To move in a circle around a central point; also refers to being preoccupied with something, unable to shake it off one's mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房入面打轉，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 jap6 min6 daa2 zyun3, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房间里转来转去，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's pacing around in the room, I don't know what he's thinking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機喺機場上空打轉，好似落唔到地咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 hai2 gei1 coeng4 soeng6 hung1 daa2 zyun3, hou2 ci5 lok6 m4 dou2 dei6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机在机场上空盘旋，好像降落不了。
examples.english_sentence: The plane is circling above the airport, it seems like it can't land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都為呢件事打轉，好煩惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 wai6 ni1 gin6 si6 daa2 zyun3, hou2 faan4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我整天都在为这件事烦恼。
examples.english_sentence: I'm constantly preoccupied with this matter, it's really bothering me.

mandarin_meaning: 打退堂鼓 (dǎ tuì táng gǔ)
english_meaning: to back down, to withdraw, to chicken out, to lose heart
explanation_mandarin: 原指戏曲开场前或紧急情况下敲击堂鼓，发出撤退的信号。引申为中途放弃，失去信心，打消原定计划。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the drum beat signaling a retreat in traditional Chinese opera or during emergencies. Figuratively, it means to back down, withdraw from a plan or activity due to lack of confidence or change of heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本來話要參加比賽，點知最後都係打退堂鼓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 loi4 waa6 jiu3 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 si6 daa2 teoi3 tong4 gu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来说要参加比赛，结果最后还是打退堂鼓了。
examples.english_sentence: He originally said he would participate in the competition, but in the end, he backed down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以咁容易就打退堂鼓，要堅持到底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 jung4 ji6 zau6 daa2 teoi3 tong4 gu2, jiu3 gin1 ci4 dou3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能这么容易就打退堂鼓，要坚持到底。
examples.english_sentence: We can't back down so easily; we must persevere to the end.

synonyms: 臨陣退縮 (lam4 zan6 teoi3 suk1)
半途而废 (bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3)

english_meaning: to get through (on the phone); to open up (a channel); to connect; to interlink; to understand something thoroughly
explanation_mandarin: 1. （电话）接通；拨通。 2. （通道）打开；使连接。 3. （思路）彻底明白；弄清楚。
explanation_english: 1. (Phone) To get through, to connect. 2. (Channel) To open up, to connect; to interlink. 3. (Ideas/Concepts) To understand thoroughly; to clarify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試過打通電話俾佢，但係冇人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 gwo3 daa2 tung1 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试着打电话给他，但是没人接。
examples.english_sentence: I tried to call him, but nobody answered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋諗住打通兩間房，令到間屋大啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 daa2 tung1 loeng5 gaan1 fong2, ling6 dou3 gaan1 uk1 daai6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想打通两间房，使房子大一点。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to connect the two rooms to make the house bigger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過佢嘅解釋，我終於打通咗條橋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 keoi5 ge3 gaai2 sik1, ngo5 zung1 jyu1 daa2 tung1 zo2 tiu4 kiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过他的解释，我终于弄明白了。
examples.english_sentence: After his explanation, I finally understood.

jyutping: daa2 tung1 jam6 duk1 ji6 mak6
english_meaning: To open up the Ren and Du meridians (often used metaphorically to mean achieving enlightenment or sudden improvement)
explanation_mandarin: 出自武侠小说，指打通人体任督二脉，使内力大增。现在常用来比喻突然开窍，或者在某个方面取得突破性进展。
explanation_english: From wuxia novels, it refers to opening up the Ren and Du meridians in the human body, greatly increasing internal energy. It is now often used metaphorically to describe sudden enlightenment or making a breakthrough in a certain area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加完個課程之後，就好似打通任督二脈咁，進步神速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 jyun4 go3 fo3 ching4 zi1 hau6, zau6 hou2 chi5 daa2 tung1 jam6 duk1 ji6 mak6 gam2, zeon3 bou6 san4 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加完那个课程之后，就好像打通了任督二脉一样，进步神速。
examples.english_sentence: After participating in that course, it's like he opened up his Ren and Du meridians, and his progress has been rapid.

english_meaning: to complete a game; to get through all the stages; to pass customs; to overcome all obstacles
explanation_mandarin: 原本指通过海关，现在也常用于比喻通过一个过程的所有阶段，完成任务，克服所有障碍，尤其指电子游戏通关。
explanation_english: Originally referring to passing through customs, it now often metaphorically means completing all stages of a process, finishing a task, overcoming all obstacles, especially in video games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我玩咗成個禮拜，終於打通關喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waan2 zo2 sing4 go3 lai5 baai1, zung1 jyu1 daa2 tung1 gwaan1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我玩了一个星期，终于通关了！
examples.english_sentence: I played for a whole week, and I finally completed the game!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃要打通關，需要各部門嘅合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 daa2 tung1 gwaan1, seoi1 jiu3 gok3 bou6 mun4 ge3 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划要顺利完成，需要各部门的合作。
examples.english_sentence: To successfully complete this project, cooperation from all departments is needed.

mandarin_meaning: 疏通关系; 搞好关系
english_meaning: to pull strings; to use connections; to cultivate relationships; to grease the wheels
explanation_mandarin: 指通过各种手段（通常涉及人情、礼物等）来疏通关系，以便达到某种目的。也指搞好人际关系。
explanation_english: Refers to using various means (often involving personal connections, gifts, etc.) to cultivate relationships in order to achieve a certain goal. It also refers to fostering good interpersonal relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗入呢間公司，四圍打通關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jap6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, sei3 wai4 daa2 tung1 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了进入这家公司，他到处疏通关系。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get into this company, he pulled strings everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，好多嘢都要靠打通關係先搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 kaau3 daa2 tung1 gwaan1 hai6 sin1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，很多事情都要靠疏通关系才能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, many things can only be settled by pulling strings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔打通關係，份合約好難攞到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 daa2 tung1 gwaan1 hai6, fan6 hap6 joek3 hou2 naan4 lo2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不疏通关系，这份合同很难拿到。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't pull strings, it'll be difficult to get this contract.

english_meaning: to pack up and go home; to head back home
explanation_mandarin: 收拾行装，返回家或出发地。
explanation_english: To pack up one's belongings and return home or to the place of origin. Often implies a sense of abandoning an activity or leaving because of dissatisfaction or completion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間都唔早喇，我哋都係打道回府啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 dou1 m4 zou2 laa3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 daa2 dou6 wui4 fu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间不早了，我们还是回家吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's getting late, let's head back home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得冇乜意思，咪打道回府囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 mou5 mat1 ji3 si1, mai1 daa2 dou6 wui4 fu2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得没什么意思，就回家了。
examples.english_sentence: He felt it wasn't interesting, so he headed back home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨喇，我哋唯有打道回府啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 laa3, ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 daa2 dou6 wui4 fu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，我们只好回家了。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining, we have no choice but to go home.

english_meaning: to eat hot pot
explanation_mandarin: 指一种饮食方式，将各种食材放入沸腾的汤底中煮熟后食用。
explanation_english: Refers to a style of eating where various ingredients are cooked in a simmering pot of soup broth and then eaten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋打邊爐，你想食咩料啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 daa2 bin1 lou4, nei5 soeng2 sik6 me1 liu2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃火锅，你想吃什么食材？
examples.english_sentence: We're having hot pot tonight, what ingredients do you want to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天最啱就係打邊爐，暖笠笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 zeoi3 ngaam1 zau6 hai6 daa2 bin1 lou4, nuon5 lap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天最适合吃火锅，暖烘烘的。
examples.english_sentence: Hot pot is the best thing to eat in winter, it's so warm.

mandarin_meaning: 侧面敲击；帮腔；从旁帮衬
english_meaning: to support someone from the sidelines; to second someone's opinion; to back someone up indirectly; to play along
explanation_mandarin: 比喻从旁协助，支持某人；通常指暗中或间接地支持，有时带有负面含义，表示帮腔作势。
explanation_english: Figuratively, to support someone from the sidelines, often indirectly or secretly. It can have a negative connotation, implying that someone is merely playing along or providing insincere support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得打邊鼓，又唔肯落手落腳幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 daa2 bin1 gu2, jau6 m4 hang2 lok6 sau2 lok6 goek3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会帮腔，又不肯真正出力帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to play along, but he's not willing to actually put in the effort to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係打邊鼓啦，不如俾啲實際嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 daa2 bin1 gu2 laa1, bat1 jyu4 bei2 di1 sat6 zai3 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要光帮腔，不如给一些实际的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just play along, give some practical advice instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺老細面前打邊鼓，搞到老細好信佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 daa2 bin1 gu2, gaau2 dou3 lou5 sai3 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在老板面前帮腔，搞得老板很信任他们。
examples.english_sentence: They often play along with the boss, making the boss trust them a lot.

jyutping: daa2 sing2 sap6 ji6 fan1 zing1 san4
english_meaning: to be on high alert, to be extremely vigilant, to pay utmost attention
explanation_mandarin: 比喻集中全部精神，保持高度警惕，非常注意。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to concentrate all of one's energy and attention, to be extremely vigilant and pay utmost attention to something. The 'twelve' emphasizes the intensity of focus and alertness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，我一定要打醒十二分精神，唔可以鬆懈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 sing2 sap6 ji6 fan1 zing1 san4, m4 ho2 ji5 sung1 haai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，我一定要打起十二分精神，不可以松懈。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is the exam, I must be on high alert and cannot be careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揸車嘅時候，一定要打醒十二分精神，尤其係落雨嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaa1 ce1 ge3 si4 hau6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 sing2 sap6 ji6 fan1 zing1 san4, jau4 kei4 hai6 lok6 jyu5 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你开车的时候，一定要打起十二分精神，尤其是在下雨的时候。
examples.english_sentence: When you are driving, you must be extremely vigilant, especially when it is raining.

mandarin_meaning: 杀鸡儆猴, 先给下马威
english_meaning: To make an example of someone to intimidate others; to set an example by punishing someone; to show who's boss.
explanation_mandarin: 先惩罚或警告一个人，以儆效尤，使其他人不敢再犯。 比喻通过惩罚一个人来警告其他人，从而达到震慑的目的。
explanation_english: To punish or warn one person as an example to deter others from committing similar offenses. It implies using someone as an example to intimidate others and establish dominance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今日炒咗阿明，根本就係打醒狗講價，等我哋個個都唔敢偷懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 caau2 zo2 aa3 ming4, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 daa2 sing2 gau2 gong2 gaa3, dang2 ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 m4 gam2 tau1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天炒了阿明，根本就是杀鸡儆猴，让我们每个人都不敢偷懒。
examples.english_sentence: The boss fired Ah Ming today. It's basically to set an example and warn us all not to be lazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要嚴懲呢啲違規嘅人，打醒狗講價，唔係以後啲人就唔會聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jim4 cing4 ni1 di1 wai4 gwai1 ge3 jan4, daa2 sing2 gau2 gong2 gaa3, m4 hai6 ji5 hau6 di1 jan4 zau6 m4 wui ting1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要严惩这些违规的人，杀鸡儆猴，不然以后人们就不会听话了。
examples.english_sentence: We must severely punish these people who violate the rules, to set an example and deter others, otherwise people won't listen in the future.

english_meaning: to buck up, to pull oneself together, to be alert, to be on the ball
explanation_mandarin: 提起精神，振作起来，保持警觉。
explanation_english: To become more alert and attentive; to rally one's spirits and focus; to be energetic and ready for action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試就嚟到啦，你要打醒精神溫書呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 zau6 lai4 dou3 laa3, nei5 jiu3 daa2 sing2 jing1 san4 wan1 syu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试就要到了，你要打起精神复习啊！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is coming soon, you need to buck up and study!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有個大project要做，今晚要打醒精神準備定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 daai6 project jiu3 zou6, gam1 maan5 jiu3 daa2 sing2 jing1 san4 zyun2 bei6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有个大项目要做，今晚要打起精神准备好。
examples.english_sentence: There's a big project to do tomorrow, I need to be on the ball and prepare well tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揸車嘅時候要打醒精神，唔可以分心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa1 ce1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 daa2 sing2 jing1 san4, m4 ho2 ji5 fan1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车的时候要打起精神，不可以分心啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be alert when driving, you can't be distracted.

english_meaning: to conduct a Taoist ritual (jiao); a Taoist sacrificial offering; Taoist mass
explanation_mandarin: 一种道教仪式，通常为了祈福、消灾、超度亡灵等目的而举行。
explanation_english: A Taoist ritual, usually conducted for the purpose of praying for blessings, dispelling disasters, or liberating the souls of the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋村今年會打個大醮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cyun1 gam1 nin4 wui5 daa2 go3 daai6 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们村今年会做一个大的道场。
examples.english_sentence: Their village will hold a large Taoist ritual this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年盂蘭節都有唔少地方會打醮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 jyu1 laan4 zit3 dou1 jau5 m4 siu2 dei6 fong1 wui5 daa2 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年盂兰节都有不少地方会做道场。
examples.english_sentence: Every year during the Hungry Ghost Festival, many places will hold Taoist rituals.
